strings.text: それが虚無ならば虚無自身がこのとほりで
strings.translated: If this be nothingness, then nothingness itself is just this,

strings.text: ある程度まではみんなに共通いたします
strings.translated: and to some degree, it is shared by us all;

strings.text: すべてがわたくしの中のみんなであるやうに
strings.translated: for just as everything within me is everyone,

strings.text: みんなのおのおののなかのすべてですから
strings.translated: so too is everything within each and every one.

strings.text: 『春と修羅』序
strings.translated: -- from the preface to "Spring and Asura"

strings.text: ただ、舞い散る桜を見ている。
strings.translated: I only watched the cherry blossoms fall.

strings.text: その風景には、悲しさも、痛みも、なかった。
strings.translated: There was no sadness, no pain in that scene.

strings.text: だから、俺は泣かなかったのだろうか？
strings.translated: Was that why I did not cry?

strings.text: 風に舞う<r うすくれない>薄紅</r>は、たしかに美しくはあったが、俺にはただそれだけの事としか感じられない。
strings.translated: The pale crimson dancing on the wind was undeniably beautiful, yet to my eyes it was nothing more than that.

strings.text: 鼻につくような桜の香り――いや、桜にそんな強い芳香などない――の中を人々の手によって大事に運ばれる棺。
strings.translated: A cloying scent of cherry blossoms -- no, cherry blossoms carry no such heavy fragrance -- and through it, the coffin borne along, cradled carefully in many hands.

strings.text: 桜の美しさの中にいる親父の死骸は、
strings.translated: My father's corpse, set amid the beauty of the cherry blossoms,

strings.text: ただ、醜いだけだった。
strings.translated: was simply ugly.

strings.text: 桜の美しさを引き立たせる役目すら負えない。
strings.translated: It could not even serve as a foil to the beauty of the cherry blossoms.

strings.text: 木箱につめられた親父の死骸。
strings.translated: My father's corpse, packed into its wooden box.

strings.text: 木箱から見つめる世界はどんなだろうか？
strings.translated: What sort of world was he looking out at from inside that wooden box?

strings.text: 彼の世界の終わり。
strings.translated: The end of his world.

strings.text: 彼が信じた世界の消失点。
strings.translated: The vanishing point of the world he had believed in.

strings.text: 桜の森。
strings.translated: The cherry-blossom forest.

strings.text: 風が吹く。
strings.translated: The wind blows.

strings.text: 桜が舞う。
strings.translated: The cherry blossoms dance.

strings.text: 春の空を<r うすくれない>薄紅</r>に染める。
strings.translated: They dye the spring sky in pale crimson.

strings.text: その姿は美しい。
strings.translated: The sight is beautiful.

strings.text: 葬儀場に降り注ぐ薄紅の花弁に視界を霞ませながら、俺は唯一の肉親であった、親父の棺を見送った。
strings.translated: My vision clouded by the pale-crimson petals showering down on the funeral grounds, I saw off my father's coffin -- the only blood I had left.

strings.text: 関係者だけのささやかな葬儀の終了と共に、親父の人生に一応の終止符をうつ。
strings.translated: With the close of that modest family funeral, a tentative period was placed upon my father's life.

strings.text: 今、桜の森で立つ俺の瞳からは涙は流れていない。
strings.translated: Now, standing here in the cherry-blossom forest, no tears flowed from my eyes.

strings.text: そして、悲しいという感情も見あたらない。
strings.translated: Nor could I find anything resembling grief within myself.

strings.text: ここからの風景に悲しさは見あたらない。
strings.translated: There was no trace of sorrow in the scenery before me.

strings.text: 周りの人たちはどうなんだろうか？
strings.translated: What about the people around me?

strings.text: やはり悲しいのだろうか？
strings.translated: Were they, at least, sad?

strings.text: 心が痛むのだろうか？
strings.translated: Did their hearts ache?

strings.text: ただ……舞い散る桜の下の死骸を見つめていると、否が応でも思い出してしまうものがある。
strings.translated: Still... standing there watching the corpse beneath the falling cherry blossoms, there was something I could not help but recall.

strings.text: 心に一瞬だけ亀裂が走る。
strings.translated: For an instant, a fissure ran through my heart.

strings.text: 親父が描いた桜の姿が……
strings.translated: The cherry blossom my father had painted...

strings.text: それこそ数えきれぬ作品をこの世に残した親父だが、
strings.translated: My father left behind countless works in this world, and yet

strings.text: あの男が描いた桜は一枚しかない。
strings.translated: that man had painted the cherry blossom only once.

strings.text: にもかかわらず、その一枚は彼の代表作と言われていた。
strings.translated: And yet that single canvas was hailed as his masterpiece.

strings.text: 他のあらゆる題材でなく、その一枚が彼を不動の芸術家とさせた。
strings.translated: More than any of his other works, that one painting cemented his place in the art world.

strings.text: ――横たわる櫻
strings.translated: -- The Reclining Sakura.

strings.text: この奇っ怪な題名の通りその絵は、
strings.translated: True to its odd title, the painting

strings.text: ねじ曲がり、地べたにはいつくばる様な桜の絵であった。
strings.translated: was of a cherry tree twisted and crawling along the ground.

strings.text: それは完全に死者を連想させる。
strings.translated: It called the dead to mind at once.

strings.text: 絶命の床にある桜が――
strings.translated: A cherry tree upon its deathbed --

strings.text: 薄暗い闇に白を咲き散らす様相。
strings.translated: scattering white blossoms into the dim gloom.

strings.text: もちろん、ここにはその様な奇っ怪な桜の木などない。
strings.translated: Of course, there was no such uncanny cherry tree here.

strings.text: ごく見慣れた春の風景があるにすぎない。
strings.translated: Only the ordinary, familiar scenery of spring.

strings.text: にも関わらず、あの男の死が彩られた桜の森は、
strings.translated: And yet, the cherry-blossom forest, colored by that man's death,

strings.text: 横たわる櫻の呪いにかかったかの様に、不気味な< うすざくら>薄桜</r>を咲き散らしている様に見えた。
strings.translated: seemed to have fallen under the spell of The Reclining Sakura, scattering its pale blossoms in eerie profusion.

strings.text: 『横たわる櫻』以外にあの男は桜の絵を発表しなかった。
strings.translated: Aside from The Reclining Sakura, that man never released another cherry-blossom painting.

strings.text: それでも彼の一般的なイメージは桜であったし、そして彼自身も桜を愛していた。
strings.translated: Even so, the public image of him was cherry blossoms, and he himself loved cherry blossoms.

strings.text: 批評家は口にする。
strings.translated: The critics put it thus:

strings.text: 静止した美しき世界。絶命の一瞬。
strings.translated: A still, breathtaking world. The very moment of death.

strings.text: 薄桜を咲き散らす老桜の巨木は、腐敗臭を放つ死骸の様であり、透き通った永遠の死でもあり、
strings.translated: The great, aged cherry, scattering pale blossoms, is at once a corpse giving off the stench of decay and a transparent, eternal death;

strings.text: それは美しくも醜い、死のイメージそのものである。
strings.translated: it is the very image of death itself -- beautiful and ugly both.

strings.text: 何度か雑誌でその様な文章を目にした。
strings.translated: I had read passages to that effect in magazines any number of times.

strings.text: 批評家と言われる偉くて頭が良い人達が言うのだから、たぶんそうなのだろう。
strings.translated: If the critics -- those great, clever people -- say so, then no doubt that is how it is.

strings.text: 俺にはよく分からないし、
strings.translated: I don't really understand it,

strings.text: あまり分かりたくもない。
strings.translated: and I don't much want to.

strings.text: ただ俺でも分かることがある。
strings.translated: But there is one thing even I understand.

strings.text: 今、この場にある風景。
strings.translated: The scene here, in this place, now.

strings.text: 桜色が咲き散るこの森の下で、運ばれる彼の死骸に、その様な複雑な様相などない。
strings.translated: Yet in the corpse borne beneath this canopy of falling cherry blossoms, there was no such complexity.

strings.text: あるのは当たり前すぎる対比。
strings.translated: There was only a contrast almost painfully obvious.

strings.text: 美しい桜と醜い死骸。
strings.translated: Beautiful cherry blossoms and an ugly corpse.

strings.text: 咲き誇る強い香りと、腐敗臭を殺す防腐剤漬けの死骸だけ。
strings.translated: Only the strong perfume of blossoms at their peak, and a corpse pickled in preservatives to kill the stench of rot.

strings.text: 桜の森の下。
strings.translated: Beneath the cherry-blossom forest,

strings.text: 俺は今、あの絵を思い出した。
strings.translated: I found myself recalling that painting.

strings.text: そして少しだけ考えた。
strings.translated: And thought about it, a little.

strings.text: ここからの風景とあいつの絵の事を、
strings.translated: The scenery before me and that man's painting --

strings.text: だがそれは同じだからではなく。
strings.translated: not because they were the same,

strings.text: 決定的に違うからこそ想起された。
strings.translated: but precisely because they were so decisively different, one called forth the other.

strings.text: そう結論づけた。
strings.translated: That was the conclusion I reached.

strings.text: 非凡な桜の姿を描いた男の死は、平凡な葬式でその幕を閉じた。
strings.translated: The man who had painted cherry blossoms like no other had met his final curtain in an utterly ordinary funeral.

strings.text: もしかしたら、そう思うことが、草薙健一郎に対するもっとも屈辱的な復讐を成すという、ガキっぽい妄想だったのかもしれない……。
strings.translated: Perhaps it was only a childish fancy of mine -- that such an ordinary send-off was the greatest humiliation I could inflict upon Kusanagi Ken'ichirou...

strings.text: 実際、それもよく分からない。
strings.translated: In truth, I don't really know about that either.

strings.text: よく分からないが――
strings.translated: I don't know, but --

strings.text: どちらにしろ、俺と唯一、血のつながった最後の人間が世界から消え失せた日であった。
strings.translated: Either way, today was the day the last person in this world who shared my blood vanished from it.

strings.text: その事だけはたしかであった。
strings.translated: That much, at least, was certain.

strings.text: 「終わったな、直哉……」
strings.translated: "It's over, Naoya..."

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「ああ、終わったな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. It's over..."

strings.text: 「大変だったな……」
strings.translated: "That must have been rough..."

strings.text: 「いや、別に……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, not really..."

strings.text: 「身内の葬式はこれで二回目だしな、大変な事もなかった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This is my second family funeral, so nothing about it was particularly rough..."
"Naoya..."

strings.text: 悲しそうな表情で、まるで少女の様な顔が俺をのぞき込む。
strings.translated: A face like a young girl's peered at me with a sorrowful expression.

strings.text: 潤んだ瞳……透き通る肌。
strings.translated: Moist eyes... translucent skin.

strings.text: 何も知らない男ならば、この容姿にこの様な表情でのぞき込まれれば、それだけで平静ではいられないかもしれない。
strings.translated: Any man who didn't know better might have been so enchanted that he forgot the solemnity of the occasion.

strings.text: だが、この美しい顔の持ち主の性別を知って、同性ならば、違った感情に満たされると思われる。
strings.translated: But for a fellow man who knew the true sex of this beauty, it stirred a very different sort of feeling.

strings.text: 当然、こいつは少女でもなんでもない。
strings.translated: Needless to say, this creature was no girl.

strings.text: 名は夏目圭。男だ。
strings.translated: His name was Natsume Kei. A man.

strings.text: 「圭、そんな顔で俺を見ないでくれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kei, don't look at me with a face like that..."

strings.text: 圭
strings.translated: Kei

strings.text: 「直哉……どうしたんだ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya... what's wrong?"

strings.text: 「少し……気持ちが悪いんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I feel a little... queasy..."

strings.text: 「どうした？　気分が悪いのか？　直哉？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What is it? You feel sick? Naoya?"

strings.text: 「ああ……そうかもしれないな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah... maybe so..."

strings.text: 俺は空を仰ぎ……舞い散る桜を見つめる。
strings.translated: I looked up at the sky... and stared at the falling cherry blossoms.

strings.text: 「本当は違った……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The truth is different..."

strings.text: 「違うのか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Am I wrong?"

strings.text: 「圭に真実など告げられなかった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I couldn't bring myself to tell you the truth, Kei..."

strings.text: 「し、真実って何だ？　直哉？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "T-truth? What truth? Naoya?"

strings.text: 「いくら何でもお前の顔がキモイとは言えなかったから……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No matter how you slice it, I couldn't say to your face that your face is creepy..."

strings.text: 「な、なんだと！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "W-what did you say!"

strings.text: 「そんなキモイ顔でのぞき込まれたら、そりゃ気分も悪くなるだろう……なんてとても言えない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Peered at by a face that creepy, of course anyone would feel sick... I really couldn't say that..."

strings.text: 「うわぁん！　なんだと！　俺の顔はキモくなんかないぞ！　ひどいぞいきなり！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Waaah! What did you say! My face is not creepy! That's cruel, out of nowhere!"

strings.text: 「な、何故俺が考えてた事を！？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-why did you know what I was thinking!?"

strings.text: 「あ！　しまった！　圭を傷つけないためにもモノローグで言ってたつもりだったのに！　ああ、あれか！　圭があまりに気持ち悪かったんで、心の声が外に漏れだしてしまっていたのかぁ（棒読み）」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah! Damn it! I was supposed to say it in monologue so I wouldn't hurt Kei's feelings! Ah, that must be it! Kei was so creepy that the voice in my heart leaked out into the open (flat delivery)."

strings.text: 「なんだそれ！　俺が気持ちが悪いとかひどいぞ！　訂正しろ！　訂正しろ！　訂正しないと、うわぁぁぁん、コロスぅぅ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "The hell is that! Calling me creepy is cruel! Take it back! Take it back! If you don't take it back, waaaah, I'll kill you!"

strings.text: 「あははははははは抱きつくな！　このキモイ生き物はぁ、コロスぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahahahahaha, don't cling to me! I'll kill you, you creepy creature!"

strings.text: 「なんだと！　殺されるのはお前だ！　うわぁん！　いちいちむかつく事を言う奴だな！！　抱きついてるんじゃない！　殴りかかってるんだ！　このぉ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What was that! You're the one getting killed! Waaah! Every single thing you say pisses me off! I'm not clinging to you! I'm punching you! Take this!"

strings.text: 「う、うおぉ……ま、待て……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-whoa... w-wait..."

strings.text: 「痛てて……危ないヤツだなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ow ow ow... you're dangerous, you know that..."

strings.text: 「直哉が俺の事を馬鹿にするからだ……人の事をキモイキモイっていいやがって！！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's because you make fun of me, Naoya... calling me creepy, creepy!"

strings.text: 「だって……さぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But... come on..."

strings.text: 彼と目があう。
strings.translated: My eyes met his.

strings.text: 「あはははははは！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 「何故笑う！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why are you laughing!"

strings.text: 「あはははははははははははは！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahahahahahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 「うわぁん！　なんだそれ！　もう辛抱たまらん！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Waaah! What is that! I can't take it anymore!"

strings.text: しまった。
strings.translated: Damn it.

strings.text: 俺とした事が、なんと自分の感情が抑えきれなくなって笑ってしまった。
strings.translated: Of all things, I couldn't hold my emotions in, and I laughed.

strings.text: 「あはははははは！　ま、待て！　これには理由があるんだ！　うはははは！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahahahahaha! W-wait! There's a reason for this! Uhahaha!"

strings.text: 「どんな理由だ！　人の顔を見て笑いやがって！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What kind of reason! Laughing at a person's face!"

strings.text: 「あ、あれだ、笑いと恐怖は紙一重と言うだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Y-you know, they say laughter and terror are two sides of the same coin, right?"

strings.text: 「ど、どういう事だ？　それ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wh-what do you mean by that?"

strings.text: 「あ、いやな、お前が襲ってきて、恐怖してだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, well, you were coming at me, and I got scared, see"

strings.text: 「俺が襲ってきて？　恐怖？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I was coming at you? Scared?"

strings.text: 「ああ、あまりの恐怖で笑ってしまったんだよ……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I got so scared I laughed...

strings.text: お前が恐ろしすぎてだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: You were just too terrifying."

strings.text: 「そ、そうか？　そ、そんなに俺が怖かったのか？　恐ろしかったのか？　そ、そうか？　ごめんなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "R-really? Y-you were that scared of me? That terrified? R-really? Sorry about that."

strings.text: 何　故　か　うれしそうに夏目圭は笑う。
strings.translated: F-o-r s-o-m-e r-e-a-s-o-n, Natsume Kei smiled with delight.

strings.text: “恐怖”したという事実に、彼はご満悦の様であった。
strings.translated: The fact that he had inspired "terror" seemed to please him no end.

strings.text: 「そうだよな。俺みたいな<r おとこぎ>侠気</r>あふれる<r おとこ>男</r>が凄みをきかせたら、そりゃ怖いわな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Right, right. When a chivalrous m-a-n like me lays down the pressure, of course it'd be scary."

strings.text: 「<r おとこぎ>侠気</r>あふれる<r おとこ>男</r>……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A chivalrous m-a-n..."

strings.text: <r じゅうげん>重言</r>を駆使してまで、自らの「オトコ」を強調する夏目圭。
strings.translated: Natsume Kei, deploying redundant phrasing just to underscore his "manliness."

strings.text: 俺はそんな彼を少しだけ<r ふびん>不憫</r>に思った。
strings.translated: I felt a little sorry for him.

strings.text: 夏目圭という生き物は、女にしかみえない。
strings.translated: The creature called Natsume Kei looked like nothing but a girl.

strings.text: だが本人はまったくその事実を受け入れようとしない。
strings.translated: And yet he refused, entirely, to accept that fact.

strings.text: 現実が見えない男なのだ圭は……。
strings.translated: A man who could not see reality -- that was Kei...

strings.text: そんな彼をみていると……。
strings.translated: Watching him like that...

strings.text: 悲しすぎて、俺は……
strings.translated: it was so sad that I...

strings.text: 「あははははははははははは！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahahahahahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 「そんな笑うなよぉ……直哉ぁ、俺はそんな怖くないぞ。直哉には優しいだろ？　いつも」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Don't laugh so much... Naoya, I'm not that scary. I'm nice to you, aren't I? Always."

strings.text: 「あはははははははははははははははは！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahahahahahahahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 「たしかに、俺って少し強そうだし、実際強いしなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's true I look pretty tough, and I am tough..."

strings.text: 「うははははははははははははははははうはははははははは！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Uhahahahahahahahahahahauhahahahahaha!"

strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "...Naoya."

strings.text: 「わははははははははははははははははははははははははははははは！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 「なんかお前……嘘ついてないか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Somehow you... you're lying, aren't you?"

strings.text: 「何を根拠に？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "On what grounds?"

strings.text: 何事も<r す>過</r>ぎたるは<r なおおよ>猶及</r>ばざるが如し。
strings.translated: In all things, too much is as bad as too little.

strings.text: やり過ぎてはいけない。
strings.translated: Do not overdo it.

strings.text: 俺はいつもの冷静な俺に戻る。
strings.translated: I returned to my usual, composed self.

strings.text: 「俺が嘘などつくわけ……ぷっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As if I would lie... pff."

strings.text: 「なに吹いてるんだよ！　やっぱり直哉は俺をバカにしてるだろ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What are you snorting at! I knew it, Naoya, you're making fun of me!"

strings.text: なんかこいつの瞳に吹いてしまった。
strings.translated: Something in his eyes made me snort.

strings.text: 「うわぁん！　コロス！　コロス！　もう本気でコロス！　海よりも深く！　山よりも高く！　空よりも広くコロス！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Waaah! I'll kill you! Kill you! I'm seriously going to kill you now! Deeper than the sea! Higher than the mountains! Wider than the sky, I'll kill you!"

strings.text: 「あははははは！　くすぐったい！　くすぐったいわ！　あはははははは！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahahahaha! That tickles! That tickles! Ahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 「何がくすぐったいだぁ！　殴ってるんだぞぉ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What do you mean tickles! I'm hitting you!"

strings.text: 「あははははははははは！　やめれ！　やめてくれぇ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahahahahahaha! Stop! Please stop!"

strings.text: 「にゃあ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Nyaa!"

strings.text: 「はぁ、はぁ、笑い死ぬかと思った……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Haah, haah, I thought I was going to die laughing..."

strings.text: 「直哉……痛いぞ。頭がじんじんするんだぞ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya... that hurts. My head's throbbing..."

strings.text: 「ああ……そうだな。痛くしたからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah... yeah. I made it hurt."

strings.text: 「なんで叩く。痛いぞ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why are you hitting me. It hurts..."

strings.text: 「いや、先に攻撃してきたのはお前だし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, you were the one who attacked first."

strings.text: 「お、俺の攻撃は愛があるから！　い、痛くないんだぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "M-my attacks have love in them, so... th-they don't hurt!"

strings.text: 「あはははははは、非力だからだろ。このカマ野郎」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahahahahaha, that's just because you're weak. You queer bastard."

strings.text: 「うわぁん！　ひどいぞ！　カマとかひどい！　この野郎！　すね毛生えてないからって馬鹿にするなぁ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Waaah! That's cruel! Calling me a queer is cruel! You bastard! Don't make fun of me just because I don't have hair on my shins!"

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事言ってな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I didn't say anything like tha--"

strings.text: 「わぁ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whoa!"

strings.text: 「はぁ、はぁ、はぁ、ふぅ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Haah, haah, haah, phew..."

strings.text: 「はぁ、はぁ、はぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Haah, haah, haah..."

strings.text: まだ風にほんのり寒さが残る。四月の昼。
strings.translated: The wind still carried a faint hint of cold. An April afternoon.

strings.text: 舞い散る桜の下で、俺と圭はごろりと横になっていた。
strings.translated: Beneath the falling cherry blossoms, Kei and I sprawled out on our backs.

strings.text: 空が見えた。
strings.translated: The sky came into view.

strings.text: そして桜が見えた。
strings.translated: And the cherry blossoms came into view.

strings.text: 桜の花が散らされていく。
strings.translated: The cherry blossoms were being scattered.

strings.text: 視界を花びらが埋め尽くす様に……
strings.translated: As if petals would fill my whole field of vision...

strings.text: そして、
strings.translated: And,

strings.text: 雲が流れる。
strings.translated: clouds drifted by.

strings.text: ゆっくりと……
strings.translated: Slowly...

strings.text: 大きな空に雲が流れていく……。
strings.translated: Across the great sky, the clouds drifted by...

strings.text: 「何でもないんだよ……何でも……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's nothing... nothing..."

strings.text: 「そうなんだ……何でもない事なんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's right... it's nothing at all..."

strings.text: 無言で圭は俺を見つめる。
strings.translated: Kei looked at me in silence.

strings.text: 「だから、そういうのやめてくれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So don't do that..."

strings.text: 「湿っぽいのは得意じゃない。そのぐらい知っているだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sappy stuff isn't my strong suit. You know that much..."

strings.text: 「……分かってる。分かってるつもりなんだけどさ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "...I know. Or I mean to know, anyway..."

strings.text: 「分かってるなら、その不景気な顔はやめてくれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If you know, then quit making that gloomy face..."

strings.text: 「不景気な顔って、景気関係ないだろ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Gloomy face -- gloom's got nothing to do with it..."

strings.text: 「そうかもな、景気の振れ幅でお前の顔がおもしろおかしくなるわけじゃないもんな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Maybe not. It's not like the ups and downs of the economy make your face any funnier..."

strings.text: 「って！　その前に、俺の顔はそんなおもしろおかしくなんかないぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Hey! Before that -- my face isn't that funny to begin with!"

strings.text: 「そうか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really?"

strings.text: 「な　ぜ　不　思　議　そ　う　な　顔　を　す　る　！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "W-h-y d-o y-o-u l-o-o-k s-o p-u-z-z-l-e-d!"

strings.text: 「だ　っ　て　不　思　議　じ　ゃ　な　い　？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I m-e-a-n, i-s-n-'-t i-t p-u-z-z-l-i-n-g?"

strings.text: 「全然不思議じゃねぇ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's not puzzling in the slightest!"

strings.text: 「なら、なぜお前はそんな顔がおもしろおかしく変化するのだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then why does your face change into something so funny?"

strings.text: 「俺の顔はおもしろおかしくなんか変化なぞしない！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "My face does not change into anything funny!"

strings.text: 「な　ぜ　会　話　を　ル　ー　プ　さ　せ　る　！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "W-h-y a-r-e y-o-u l-o-o-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-o-n-v-e-r-s-a-t-i-o-n!"

strings.text: 「だ　っ　て　不　思　議　な　の　だ　も　の　？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "B-e-c-a-u-s-e i-t i-s p-u-z-z-l-i-n-g, i-s-n-'-t i-t?"

strings.text: 「不思議じゃねぇ！　もうこの会話終わり！　そんな事言う直哉はダメなんだからな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It is not puzzling! This conversation is over! Naoya, you're a bad guy for saying stuff like that!"

strings.text: 圭は不機嫌そうにそっぽを向いた。
strings.translated: Kei turned away in a huff.

strings.text: 俺は苦笑いしてから、そのまま空を見上げた。
strings.translated: I gave a wry smile, then looked back up at the sky.

strings.text: 春の空を……
strings.translated: The spring sky...

strings.text: 桜に包まれていた春の空。
strings.translated: The spring sky, wrapped in cherry blossoms.

strings.text: 「それにしてもあれだな……圭」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even so, you know... Kei."

strings.text: 「なんだ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「桜が綺麗だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The cherry blossoms are beautiful..."

strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "The cherry blossoms?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだ……桜だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right... the cherry blossoms..."

strings.text: 突き抜ける様な青の中を、咲き散る<r うすくれない>薄紅</r>を、俺は見つめながら、ぽつりと呟く。
strings.translated: Gazing at the pale crimson petals scattering through that piercing blue, I let the words slip out.

strings.text: その視線の先を圭も追いかける。
strings.translated: Kei followed the line of my gaze.

strings.text: 桜の花びらが風に舞って空高く吹き荒れる。
strings.translated: Cherry petals danced on the wind, whipped high into the sky.

strings.text: 「ああ、今年の桜は最高にきれいだな……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, this year's cherry blossoms really are gorgeous..."

strings.text: 「今年の桜は、最高に……か」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This year's cherry blossoms, the most gorgeous ever... huh."

strings.text: 毎年同じ様に咲く様に思われた桜。
strings.translated: Cherry blossoms that I had thought bloomed the same every year.

strings.text: たしかに圭の言うとおり、今年の桜は俺にも最高に美しく思えた。
strings.translated: Just as Kei said, this year's blossoms did strike me as the most beautiful I'd ever seen.

strings.text: 圭にも、美しく見えるこの桜。
strings.translated: Cherry blossoms that even Kei found beautiful.

strings.text: だったら、圭にも木箱に詰められた親父の姿は醜くうつったのであろうか？
strings.translated: Then did my father's figure, packed away in a wooden box, look just as ugly to Kei as well?

strings.text: それとも――。
strings.translated: Or...

strings.text: 「芸術は自然を模倣する……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Art imitates nature..."

strings.text: 「あるいは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Or perhaps..."

strings.text: 「自然は芸術を模倣する……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nature imitates art..."

strings.text: 「何それ？　まったく逆の意味じゃない？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What's that? Isn't that the exact opposite meaning?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

strings.text: 「どういう事なの？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What does that even mean?"

strings.text: 「さぁな。まぁ、どうでも良い事だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who knows. Well, it doesn't really matter."

strings.text: 『横たわる櫻』を描いた男。
strings.translated: The man who painted The Reclining Sakura.

strings.text: 俺の父親は「世界的に名の知れた芸術家」であった。
strings.translated: My father was "a world-renowned artist."

strings.text: 世界的に名の知れた芸術家。
strings.translated: A world-renowned artist.

strings.text: 今の時代、こんな胡散臭い響きが他にあるだろうか？
strings.translated: In this day and age, could any title sound more dubious?

strings.text: あり得ない。
strings.translated: Hardly.

strings.text: だから彼は、胡散臭い芸術家としても知られていた。
strings.translated: And sure enough, he was just as famous for being a charlatan of an artist.

strings.text: 起業家、虚業家、ペテン師、そして芸術家。
strings.translated: Entrepreneur, con-man, swindler, and artist.

strings.text: 草薙健一郎に対する呼び名は複数に及んだ。
strings.translated: Kusanagi Ken'ichirou went by any number of names.

strings.text: 彼は世界的有名人でもあったが、
strings.translated: He was world-famous, yes, but he was also

strings.text: 胡散臭さの象徴でもあった。
strings.translated: the very symbol of dubiousness.

strings.text: だがしかし、
strings.translated: And yet,

strings.text: 誰もが、
strings.translated: every single person,

strings.text: あの絵を前にした時だけ違った。
strings.translated: when standing before that painting, was different.

strings.text: あの絵を前にしたあらゆる人間がこう思った。
strings.translated: Everyone who stood before that painting thought the same thing.

strings.text: 「この美しさは本物である」
strings.translated: "This beauty is real."

strings.text: 「この感動は本物である」
strings.translated: "This emotion is real."
That was what they thought...

strings.text: 絵画『横たわる櫻』
strings.translated: The painting, The Reclining Sakura.

strings.text: 彼を悪く言う者は多いが、あの絵を悪く言う者は多くはない。
strings.translated: Many spoke ill of the man, but few spoke ill of the painting.

strings.text: 『横たわる櫻』とはそういう作品であったし、
strings.translated: The Reclining Sakura was that kind of work,

strings.text: 草薙健一郎という男はそういう芸術家であった。
strings.translated: and Kusanagi Ken'ichirou was that kind of artist.

strings.text: そんな親父との関係は、彼の死により決定的に絶たれた。
strings.translated: Whatever relationship I'd had with my father was decisively severed by his death.

strings.text: 彼との最後の繋がりは、振り込まれた一生生活に困らない額の金が記入された通帳。
strings.translated: My final tie to him was a bankbook, showing a deposit large enough to keep me from ever wanting for money in my life.

strings.text: 彼が死ぬ数ヶ月前。
strings.translated: A few months before he died.

strings.text: 俺はその通帳を見せられた。
strings.translated: I was shown that bankbook.

strings.text: その時思った。
strings.translated: And I thought:

strings.text: ああ……そうか……。
strings.translated: Ah... I see...

strings.text: これで一生遊んで暮らせる。
strings.translated: With this I can live a life of leisure forever.

strings.text: あの男は金持ちだもんな。
strings.translated: Well, the man is rich, after all.

strings.text: だから、遺産相続したら今度は俺が金持ちになる。
strings.translated: So once I inherit, I'll be the rich one this time.

strings.text: 誰もが憧れる夢の生活だ。
strings.translated: It's the dream life everyone longs for.

strings.text: 学校を卒業した後も、就活とかでヒイヒイ言わなくて良い。
strings.translated: Even after I graduate, I won't have to sweat over job hunting.

strings.text: 世間では、
strings.translated: Out in the world, they say

strings.text: 就職氷河時代が日常です！
strings.translated: the employment ice age is now the norm!

strings.text: 面接逝ったらジエンド！
strings.translated: Show up to an interview and it's game over!

strings.text: と言われるぐらいに、就職が出来ないという。
strings.translated: That's how impossible it is to get hired, they say.

strings.text: 社会に出てもつらいが、出させてもくれないのが実情。
strings.translated: Life is hard once you're out in society, but the truth is society won't even let you in.

strings.text: そんな世の中にあって俺は働かなくて良いのだ。
strings.translated: In a world like that, I don't have to work.

strings.text: 労働から解放されたのだ。
strings.translated: I've been liberated from labor.

strings.text: これは勝ち組というやつだ。
strings.translated: I'm what you'd call a winner.

strings.text: 格好良く言うと高等遊民！
strings.translated: Put in fancy terms: a man of leisure!

strings.text: まさに毎日が日曜日。
strings.translated: Truly, every day is a Sunday.

strings.text: 素晴らしき日々。
strings.translated: Wonderful days.

strings.text: ハロー　セカイ。
strings.translated: Hello, world.

strings.text: わーい。わーい。
strings.translated: Yaaay. Yaaay.

strings.text: そう思った。
strings.translated: That's what I thought.

strings.text: たしかに<r ・>あ</r><r ・>の</r><r ・>時</r>はそう思った……。
strings.translated: That, indeed, was what I thought *at that time*...

strings.text: だけど、今ではそういう感情も起こらなかった。
strings.translated: But now, those feelings no longer came.

strings.text: すべての風景が、俺には平べったく見える。
strings.translated: Every landscape looked flat to me.

strings.text: フラットに……。
strings.translated: Flat...

strings.text: 「何でだろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why, I wonder..."

strings.text: 「何でこんなに平べったいのだろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why does everything look so flat..."

strings.text: そんな俺の姿を見て、圭が心配そうにのぞき込む。
strings.translated: Seeing me like that, Kei peered at me with a worried look.

strings.text: 俺は苦笑して、心配ない事を圭に伝える。
strings.translated: I gave a wry smile and let him know I was fine.

strings.text: 俺の感情が平べったい理由。
strings.translated: The reason my emotions felt flat.

strings.text: すべてが遠く感じる理由。
strings.translated: The reason everything felt distant.

strings.text: たぶん、それは……
strings.translated: Perhaps, it was...

strings.text: あれが原因だろう。
strings.translated: that thing, that was the cause.

strings.text: 俺にはそう思えた……。
strings.translated: That was how it felt to me...

strings.text: あれは、俺が最後に通帳を見せられた時の事だ。
strings.translated: It happened the last time I was shown the bankbook.

strings.text: 遺産管財人とやらの前で俺はこう言った。
strings.translated: Before the so-called estate administrator, I said:

strings.text: 「俺はこの金は受け取れません……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I can't accept this money..."

strings.text: 「この金を受け取れるほど、草薙健一郎氏と俺には関係がありません……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There isn't enough of a relationship between Kusanagi Ken'ichirou and me for me to accept this money..."

strings.text: 関係者Ａ
strings.translated: Person Concerned A

strings.text: 「関係ないって……」
strings.speaker: 関係者Ａ
strings.translated: "Not enough of a relationship, you say...?"

strings.text: 関係者Ｂ
strings.translated: Person Concerned B

strings.text: 「直哉くんと草薙氏はたしかに親子じゃないか…それをまた何故？」
strings.speaker: 関係者Ｂ
strings.translated: "But surely, Naoya-kun, you and Kusanagi-shi are father and son... so why, again?"

strings.text: その場にいる全員が驚いた顔で俺を見つめていた。
strings.translated: Everyone present stared at me with astonished faces.

strings.text: 当然だ。
strings.translated: Of course they did.

strings.text: 唯一の血縁である俺が、世界的な芸術家の遺産のすべてを受け取らないと言ったのだから……。
strings.translated: Because I, his only blood relative, had just said I wouldn't accept a single yen of a world-famous artist's estate...

strings.text: ただ一人、目の前の男だけが鋭い目つきで俺を見つめていた。
strings.translated: Only one man, right in front of me, kept his sharp gaze fixed on me.

strings.text: 「関係？」
strings.translated: "Relationship?"

strings.text: 男は草薙健一郎の管財人だと名乗っていた。
strings.translated: The man had introduced himself as Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's estate trustee.

strings.text: もちろん俺はこの男とまったく面識が無い設定だ。
strings.translated: Of course, the setup was that I had absolutely no prior acquaintance with him.

strings.text: 実際、健一郎とどんな関係なのかすら良く理解してなかった。
strings.translated: In fact, I didn't even really understand what his relationship to Ken'ichirou was.

strings.text: 管財人
strings.translated: Trustee

strings.text: 「関係ないとはどういう事ですか？」
strings.speaker: 管財人
strings.translated: "What do you mean, no relationship?"

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎氏と俺は……、赤の他人だと言ってるんです……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm saying Kusanagi Ken'ichirou and I... are complete strangers..."

strings.text: 「赤の他人？」
strings.speaker: 管財人
strings.translated: "Complete strangers?"

strings.text: 「ああ、だから俺はこの金を受け取れない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's why I can't accept this money."

strings.text: その場がざわついた。
strings.translated: The room stirred.

strings.text: そこにいるすべての人間が動揺しているのが分かった。
strings.translated: I could tell that everyone there was shaken.

strings.text: 俺はそれを見て、うつむき……。
strings.translated: Seeing that, I lowered my head...

strings.text: そしてほくそ笑んだ。
strings.translated: And smirked to myself.

strings.text: そうだよな……。
strings.translated: That's right...

strings.text: 十数億の遺産を受け取らない。
strings.translated: Refusing an inheritance worth over a billion yen.

strings.text: “俺と父とはそんな関係ではないから……”
strings.translated: "Because my father and I weren't that kind of family..."

strings.text: そんな理由で……受け取らない。
strings.translated: For a reason like that... I refuse it.

strings.text: 大芸術家の息子。
strings.translated: The son of a great artist.

strings.text: 草薙直哉。
strings.translated: Kusanagi Naoya.

strings.text: つまり俺。
strings.translated: In other words, me.

strings.text: 格好イイ……。
strings.translated: So cool...

strings.text: 今の俺は格好イイ……。
strings.translated: I was so cool right now...

strings.text: 誰だってこんな自分に憧れるだろう。
strings.translated: Anyone would look up to a version of themselves like this.

strings.text: 「金で汚れぬ高潔な精神」
strings.translated: "A noble spirit unstained by money."

strings.text: 「幸せは金では買えない」
strings.translated: "Happiness cannot be bought with money."

strings.text: 彼らにそう宣言するかのごとき俺の姿は、
strings.translated: My figure, as though declaring these very things to them,

strings.text: 物語で言えばクライマックスだ。
strings.translated: was, in story terms, the climax.

strings.text: 俺の精神は少し高揚していたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: My spirits may have been running a bit high.

strings.text: 言い訳程度に言わせてもらおう。
strings.translated: Let me say this by way of excuse.

strings.text: ほんの出来心だった。
strings.translated: It was just a passing whim.

strings.text: やってみたら格好いいかなぁ……。
strings.translated: Wouldn't it be cool if I tried it...?

strings.text: ぐらいのノリであったのかもしれない。
strings.translated: It may have been just about that level of impulse.

strings.text: それに、そこは日本人の美しさというか、最初はとりあえず断っておく的な感じもあるだろう。
strings.translated: And besides, there's that Japanese sense of aesthetics -- the whole "decline the first time as a matter of form" thing.

strings.text: だって十数億の遺産だし。
strings.translated: I mean, it was over a billion yen in inheritance.

strings.text: あんまり仲良くない父親の金だし。
strings.translated: And it was the money of a father I wasn't especially close to.

strings.text: ここにいる人達も知らない人ばかりだし、
strings.translated: And everyone here was a total stranger to me,

strings.text: とりあえず断っておくのも有りだ。
strings.translated: so declining, for the moment, was a valid option.

strings.text: 有りか無しかで言ったら、有りだろう。
strings.translated: If you asked me whether it was on the table or not, I'd say it was on the table.

strings.text: （なにを仰いますかかカッ！）
strings.translated: (Whatever are you saying?!)

strings.text: （いやいや、そんな事言わず、どうしても！）
strings.translated: (No, no, don't say such things, please!)

strings.text: （これはあなた様がお受け取り下さい！）
strings.translated: (This is for you to receive!)

strings.text: （世界的な芸術家である草薙健一郎が残した遺産には、多くの芸術作品もあります）
strings.translated: (The estate left behind by the world-famous artist Kusanagi Ken'ichirou includes many works of art.)

strings.text: （これは唯一の血族である直哉様が受け取るべきものなのです）
strings.translated: (These must be received by you, Naoya-sama, his only blood relation.)

strings.text: （うーん、そうですか？）
strings.translated: (Hmm, you think so?)

strings.text: （そうかなぁ……。そうかもしれませんなぁ）
strings.translated: (Is that right...? Perhaps it is so.)

strings.text: （そこまで言われたら、まぁ、仕方ないですかねぇ）
strings.translated: (If you insist that far, well, I suppose it can't be helped.)

strings.text: （たしかに父とは血もつながっていたわけですしぃ……）
strings.translated: (It is true I was tied to my father by blood...)

strings.text: （皆様がそこまで言うのでしたらお受け取りしましょうか……）
strings.translated: (If everyone insists so strongly, then I shall accept...)

strings.text: これだ！
strings.translated: This!

strings.text: これがごく一般的な日本人の作法ではないか？
strings.translated: Isn't this the standard etiquette of the average Japanese?

strings.text: 一度目は断る。
strings.translated: Decline the first time.

strings.text: それでも相手は引き下がらない。
strings.translated: But the other party doesn't back down.

strings.text: 是非、受け取ってくれと言い続ける。
strings.translated: They keep insisting, please, do accept it.

strings.text: 頃合いの良いタイミングで、
strings.translated: And at the appropriate moment,

strings.text: “それでは”という事でありがたく頂戴する。
strings.translated: with a "very well, then," you graciously accept.

strings.text: それが日本的な美意識というものではないだろうか？
strings.translated: Isn't that what constitutes the Japanese sense of aesthetics?

strings.text: にも関わらず。
strings.translated: And yet.

strings.text: 「分かりました」
strings.speaker: 管財人
strings.translated: "Understood."

strings.text: 管財人は青い目をキラっキラさせて頷いた。
strings.translated: The trustee nodded, his blue eyes sparkling.

strings.text: ヤツは外人だった。
strings.translated: The guy was a foreigner.

strings.text: 名はマーティ・フリッドマン。
strings.translated: His name was Marty Friedman.

strings.text: 毛唐なんぞに日本の美しき作法など分からなかった。
strings.translated: A hairy barbarian couldn't possibly understand the beautiful etiquette of Japan.

strings.text: 教えたとしてもだ！
strings.translated: Not even if you taught him!

strings.text: この白ブタ野郎。
strings.translated: This white pig bastard.

strings.text: フリッドマンは痩せていて格好いいが……。
strings.translated: Friedman was thin and good-looking, but...

strings.text: ヤツは俺の一言を聞くやいなや、てきぱきと遺産放棄の書類を作成してくれた。
strings.translated: The moment he heard my line, he briskly drew up the documents for renouncing the inheritance.

strings.text: そして……
strings.translated: And then...

strings.text: フリッドマン
strings.translated: Friedman

strings.text: 「さぁ、サインを、草薙直哉」
strings.speaker: フリッドマン
strings.translated: "Now, your signature, Kusanagi Naoya."

strings.text: その場にいる人間すべてが注目している。
strings.translated: Every person present had their eyes on me.

strings.text: 俺の一挙一動を見落とさない様に……
strings.translated: So as not to miss a single one of my movements...

strings.text: 俺は今までにないほどの緊張感を味わっていた。
strings.translated: I was experiencing a tension I had never felt before.

strings.text: なんだこれは？
strings.translated: What is this?

strings.text: なんなんだ？
strings.translated: What the hell is this?

strings.text: 俺は察した。
strings.translated: I sensed it.

strings.text: すべてを察したのだった。
strings.translated: I sensed everything.

strings.text: 「<r は>嵌</r>　め　ら　れ　た　！」
strings.translated: "I . W A S . S E T . U P !"

strings.text: 心の中で叫んだ俺。
strings.translated: I screamed inside my heart.

strings.text: 時遅し、
strings.translated: Too late,

strings.text: いとをかし、
strings.translated: how quaint,

strings.text: おかしくねぇ！
strings.translated: it's not quaint!

strings.text: <r おもむき>趣</r>もねぇ！
strings.translated: There's no charm to it either!

strings.text: 俺から笑みは消え、代わりに脂汗がどっと流れた。
strings.translated: The smile vanished from my face; in its place, a gush of cold sweat.

strings.text: 「お　か　し　い」
strings.translated: "S O M E T H I N G . I S . O F F."

strings.text: 「絶対におかしいぃ」
strings.translated: "This is absolutely off."

strings.text: 段取り的におかしい。
strings.translated: Procedurally, it's off.

strings.text: こんなシナリオでは無かった！
strings.translated: This wasn't how the scenario was supposed to go!

strings.text: 最低でも三回は確認するシナリオでは無かったのか？
strings.translated: Wasn't the scenario supposed to include at least three rounds of confirmation?

strings.text: それが正しい進行であっただろう！
strings.translated: That was the proper progression, wasn't it?!

strings.text: フリッドマン！
strings.translated: Friedman!

strings.text: いろいろ考えたが、あまりに格好良く断言しすぎた手前。
strings.translated: I thought over all sorts of options, but having declared it so cool-headedly moments ago...

strings.text: 「あれ嘘です！」
strings.translated: "That was a lie!"

strings.text: 「今のなし！」
strings.translated: "Scratch what I just said!"

strings.text: 「金ほしい！」
strings.translated: "I want the money!"

strings.text: 「金もらえるならここで全裸にでもなります！」
strings.translated: "If you'll give me the money, I'll strip naked right here!"

strings.text: 「むしろ全裸にならせてください！」
strings.translated: "Actually, please let me strip naked!"

strings.text: とか言う事も出来ずに……
strings.translated: I couldn't bring myself to say any of that, and...

strings.text: 俺は……
この俺は……
strings.translated: This me of mine...

strings.text: 「これで、草薙健一郎と俺は関係ありませんから……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So, with this, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou and I have no relation..."

strings.text: 「以後、俺と関わらないでください……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "From here on, please do not involve me in anything..."

strings.text: と一言残して、その部屋から出てきた。
strings.translated: Leaving those words behind, I walked out of that room.

strings.text: あの日から俺は……
strings.translated: From that day on, I...

strings.text: 草薙健一郎との関係をすべて断ち切った。
strings.translated: severed every connection with Kusanagi Ken'ichirou.

strings.text: だからだろうか……
strings.translated: Perhaps that's why...

strings.text: 俺の心がこんなに平べったくなってしまったのは……
strings.translated: my heart had become so flat...

strings.text: すべての風景が平べったくなってしまった……。
strings.translated: Every landscape had become flat...

strings.text: 「って、直哉、直哉ってば！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Hey -- Naoya, Naoya, come on!"

strings.text: 「ど、どうしたんだよいきなり！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wh-what's the matter, all of a sudden?!"

strings.text: 「あ、ああ、すまん。色々な事を思い出してた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah, sorry. I was remembering all sorts of things..."

strings.text: 「な、なんかたくさん流してたぞ……やっぱりお父さんの死が悲しいんだな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Y-you were shedding a whole bunch of it... I guess your dad's death really is getting to you."

strings.text: 「涙？　流れてたか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Tears? Was I shedding them?"

strings.text: 「いや鼻血だったけど……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "No, it was a nosebleed, but..."

strings.text: 「そうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 「心はこんなに平べったいのに……身体は血を流してしまうんだなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even though my heart is this flat... my body still sheds blood."

strings.text: 「そうだな……心より身体の方が正直なのかもしれない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's right... maybe the body is more honest than the heart..."

strings.text: 心がいくら平べったくとも……身体は正直にあの時の事を覚えている。
strings.translated: No matter how flat my heart may be... my body honestly remembers what happened that day.

strings.text: （やっぱり全裸土下座してでも金をもらうべきだった！）
strings.translated: (I really should have gotten the money, even if it meant stripping naked and prostrating myself!)

strings.text: そう俺の身体は血を流して叫んでいるのだ。
strings.translated: That is what my body is screaming, shedding blood.

strings.text: 「だが、男には、そう出来ない時だってある」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But there are times when a man just can't do that."

strings.text: 「耐えなきゃいけない時もあるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There are times when you have to endure..."

strings.text: 「な、直哉……なんか少し格好いい……。お、男は涙じゃなくて血を流せって事だな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "N-Naoya... that's kind of cool... A m-man sheds not tears but blood -- that's what you mean, right?!"

strings.text: 「お前ら……その漫才をいつまで続ける気だ？」
strings.translated: "You two... how long do you plan to keep up that comedy routine?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A-Ai?"

strings.text: 「姉貴、まだ帰ってなかったのか」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Sis, you hadn't gone home yet?"

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 「外じゃ夏目先生だと言ってるだろ。まったく記憶力がない弟だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I told you outside I go by Natsume-sensei. Really, what a brother with no memory."

strings.text: 「それはそうと、草薙……今回は大変だったな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Anyway, Kusanagi... you had a rough time of it this round, didn't you."

strings.text: 圭の傍らに現れたその女性は、真っ黒な美しい髪を揺らしながら俺に向かって軽く頭を垂れた。
strings.translated: The woman who appeared at Kei's side inclined her head lightly toward me, her beautiful jet-black hair swaying.

strings.text: 「いや……こっちこそいろいろと藍には世話になってしまったな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No... if anything, I'm the one who owes you for helping with a lot of things, Ai."

strings.text: 「あ、いや葬式の件じゃなくて遺産放棄の件だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, no, I wasn't talking about the funeral -- I meant the inheritance renunciation business."

strings.text: 「何それ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What's that?"

strings.text: なんで藍が知ってるんだ？
strings.translated: Why does Ai know about that?

strings.text: 一部の人間しか知らない事なハズだが……。
strings.translated: It should be something only a handful of people know...

strings.text: 「最初聞いた時は驚いたけど、よくよく考えたらお前らしいなぁ。と思ったよ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "When I first heard, I was surprised, but thinking it over, I thought, 'yeah, that's just like you.'"

strings.text: 「お、俺らしいか……そうかもな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just... just like me, huh... maybe so..."

strings.text: 俺らしいか……、
strings.translated: Just like me, huh...

strings.text: 藍から見ても、俺という人間はそう見えるのだろう……。
strings.translated: So even from Ai's perspective, that's how I look as a person...

strings.text: 金に揺らがぬ高潔な精神。
strings.translated: A noble spirit unswayed by money.

strings.text: 世俗の事などに惑わされる事無く、自分の美意識を貫く。
strings.translated: Never led astray by worldly concerns, holding fast to one's own aesthetic.

strings.text: 俺という人間はやはりそう見えてしまうのだろう。
strings.translated: That, apparently, is how I come across after all.

strings.text: 「お前の事だから、“少しかっこいいなぁ”とか思って言ったのだろう。んで引くに引けない状態になったんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Knowing you, you probably thought 'this'd be kinda cool' and said it. And then you couldn't back out, right?"

strings.text: 「な　に　を　根　拠　に　言　っ　て　る　の　？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W . H . A . T . B . A . S . I . S . I . S . T . H . A . T . O . N . ?"

strings.text: 「意　意　意　味　が　わ　か　ら　な　い　わ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I . H . A . V . E . N . O . I . D . E . A . W . H . A . T . Y . O . U . M . E . A . N."

strings.text: 「めちゃくちゃ動揺してるだろ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You're rattled out of your mind, aren't you..."

strings.text: 「し　し　し　て　い　な　い　わ　よ　動　揺」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I . A . M . N . O . T . R . A . T . T . L . E . D , dear."

strings.text: 「どうでもいいが、なんでカマ言葉になるんだ……お前……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Whatever, but why does your speech turn all girly...?"

strings.text: 「あ、藍が、めちゃくちゃな事を言うからだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It-it's because Ai says the most ridiculous things..."

strings.text: 「ふぅ……なにがめちゃくちゃだ。めちゃくちゃはお前だろう。普通ならあんなまねしないぞ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hah... what's ridiculous is you. A normal person wouldn't pull a stunt like that..."

strings.text: 「これでもお前の事をずっと見てきた私だぞ。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I'm someone who's been watching you all this time, you know.

strings.text: お前が何故あんな事をしたのかだいたい分かる……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: I pretty much understand why you did what you did..."

strings.text: 「なんであんな馬鹿げたまねをしたのか……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Why you pulled that ridiculous stunt...

strings.text: 鈍い私でも分かる……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Even someone as slow as me can figure it out..."

strings.text: 「だ、だから、何の話だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "L-like I said, what are you talking about?"

strings.text: 「遺産相続の放棄だよ。今更とぼける気か？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The renunciation of the inheritance. You're still going to play dumb, at this point?"

strings.text: 「と、とぼけるも何も、俺には何の事だかさっぱりだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "P-play dumb or not, I have absolutely no idea what you mean..."

strings.text: 「ふーんそうか……。あくまでもとぼけるのか。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hmmm, is that so... So you're going to keep playing dumb all the way through.

strings.text: せっかく、遺産放棄の書類を無効にする方法を教えようと思ったのに」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: And here I was, thinking I'd teach you how to invalidate the renunciation paperwork."

strings.text: 「え？　まじ？　マジで？　うそ、教えて！　全裸にだってなるし、土下座だってするよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Seriously? For real? No way, tell me! I'll strip naked, I'll grovel on the floor!"

strings.text: 「さすがにひくわ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Okay, that's genuinely off-putting..."

strings.text: 「ち、違う、今のはその？　なんだ？　全裸が好きというか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no, that just now was, uh, what was it? It's not that I like being naked or anything..."

strings.text: 「露出狂か！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "So you're an exhibitionist!"

strings.text: 「そうだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's right!"

strings.text: 「苦し紛れにでたらめ言うな！　あほか！　余計自分を追い詰めてるぞ！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Don't just spout nonsense to cover yourself! You idiot! You're only making it worse for yourself!"

strings.text: 「だって、そうでもしないと……ちきしょう、ちきしょう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But, unless I do something like that... damn it, damn it..."

strings.text: 「やっぱり金がほしかったんだろう……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "So you did want the money after all..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだよ。本当は金がほしかったんだよ。喉から手が出るぐらい金がほしかったんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. The truth is, I wanted the money. I wanted it so badly my hands were reaching for my throat..."

strings.text: 「金ってなんだよ？　その遺産放棄って何の話なんだ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Money? What's this about renouncing an inheritance, anyway?"

strings.text: 「草薙なぁ、草薙健一郎の遺産を全額放棄したんだよ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Kusanagi, you see, renounced the entirety of Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's inheritance."

strings.text: 「そうなんだ……。んで？　いくらぐらいなの？　その遺産って」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Is that so... And? Roughly how much was this inheritance?"

strings.text: 「およそ１５億円」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Around 1.5 billion yen."

strings.text: 「マジで？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "For real?"

strings.text: 「つい出来心でな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It was just a moment of weakness..."

strings.text: 「なんでそんな無茶したんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why the hell would you do something that reckless?"

strings.text: 「だから出来心だと言ってるだろう……日本人的な美意識というか倫理観というか、芸術的判断というか……そういう高尚なものが俺を揺るがしたんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I told you, it was a moment of weakness... Japanese aesthetic sensibilities, or ethics, or artistic judgment... some lofty thing like that shook me..."

strings.text: 「高尚なものが判断を揺るがした。ねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Lofty things shook your judgment, hmm..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうなんだ。でも、今なら分かるんだ。金がどれだけ大事か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. But now I understand. How important money is..."

strings.text: 「金は魂よりも命よりも重い。金が無ければ首が無いのと同じだ。金で世界は動いている。世界とは金の総体なんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Money is heavier than the soul, heavier than life. Without money, it's the same as having no head. The world runs on money. The world is the sum total of money..."

strings.text: 「とてもじゃないが、高尚な美意識を持った人間の発言とは思えんぞ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That doesn't sound like something a person with a lofty aesthetic sense would say, does it?"

strings.text: 「そんな事はどうでもイイ！　金が大事だ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "None of that matters! Money is what matters!"

strings.text: 「そんな<r す>荒</r>れた発言するなよ。なんか悲しいぞ俺は……。だいたい姉貴がどうにかしてくれるらしいじゃないか……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Don't make such crude declarations. It's kind of sad to me... Besides, my sister said she'd take care of it somehow..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだよ。ありがとう藍。これで、俺は金持ちだ……。金ですべてが買える。金ですべてを支配出来る。良かった、本当に良かったよぉ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Thank you, Ai. With this, I'm rich... Money can buy everything. Money can control everything. Thank goodness, thank goodness..."

strings.text: 「良かったなぁ。直哉」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Good for you, Naoya."

strings.text: 「良かった。良かったよぉ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Thank goodness. Thank goodness..."

strings.text: 「嘘だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That was a lie."

strings.text: 「ウソダ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A LIE?"

strings.text: 「あれは嘘だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That was a lie."

strings.text: 「アレハウソダ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "THAT-WAS-A-LIE?"

strings.text: 「遺産放棄を無効にする方法など知らん」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I don't know any way to invalidate the renunciation."

strings.text: 「伊サン箒ヲ婿ニスル方法ナドシラン？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "IZANY-BROOM-INTO-A-BRIDEGROOM?"

strings.text: 「現実逃避はやめろ……お金は返ってこないぞ。というか格好つけただけならいざ知らず、ご丁寧にサインまでして、金なんぞ返ってくるわけが無いだろう……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Quit trying to escape reality... The money isn't coming back. I mean, if you'd just been posturing, sure, but you went and politely signed everything -- there's no way the money's coming back..."

strings.text: 「カネナンゾカエッテクルワケナイダロー」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "THERES-NO-WAY-THE-MONEYS-COMING-BACK."

strings.text: 「ダロー」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "-BACK."

strings.text: 「え、えっと……あ、あのさぁ直哉……。現実を直視しようよ。現実逃避しても仕方ないじゃないか」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "U-um... h-hey, Naoya... let's face reality. There's no point running from it, is there?"

strings.text: 「ゲ…ン…ジ…ツ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 「そうだよ。どうやら何をやっても遺産は手に入らないみたいなんだからさ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That's right. Apparently no matter what you do, the inheritance is out of reach."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Reality..."

strings.text: 「なんだとぉぉおお！　何をやっても遺産は手に入らないだとぉ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "WHAAAAAAT?! There's no way to get the inheritance no matter what I do?!"

strings.text: 「遅いわ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Bit late for that..."

strings.text: 「つまり藍！　貴様俺をたぶらかしたなぁ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In other words, Ai! You tricked me, you fiend!"

strings.text: 「アホかお前は……だいたいそんな方法を一教師の私が知るわけがない」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What an idiot you are... First off, there's no way a mere teacher like me would know how to do something like that."

strings.text: 「ぐぬぬ……、貴様俺の心をもてあそんだのだなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Grrrhh... You toyed with my heart..."

strings.text: 「お前がとぼけた事ぬかすからだ。本当にお前らは無理な格好つけばかりだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It's because you kept playing dumb. Honestly, both of you keep trying to strike impossible poses."

strings.text: 「うう、俺の金ぇ、俺の遺産、棚からぼた餅的な大金……さらにあんな努力して上乗せしたのにぃ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Uuh, my money, my inheritance, that windfall from heaven... and I even worked so hard to raise it..."

strings.text: 「自業自得だろう……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You reap what you sow..."

strings.text: 「アホだな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What an idiot."

strings.text: 「お前に言われたくない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't want to hear that from you!"

strings.text: 「まぁいいではないか。とても草薙らしくて」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Now, now, let it go. It's very Kusanagi of you."

strings.text: 「ぐぬぬ、まだ言うか。まだ、俺をアホって罵る気か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Grrhh, you're still going? You're still going to call me an idiot?"

strings.text: 「何度も言ってるだろう。お前をずっと見てきた私だぞ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I've said it many times, haven't I. I'm someone who's been watching you all this time..."

strings.text: 「だから俺のアホさを見抜けるとでもぬかすか！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So you're saying you can see right through my idiocy?!"

strings.text: 「そうだな……。それなりに見てきたからお前がアホな事を良く知ってる」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That's right... I've watched you long enough to know your idiocy well."

strings.text: 「お前らは本当に意地っ張りだからな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You two really are stubborn..."

strings.text: 「さっきからお前“ら”って何だよ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's with the 'you two'?

strings.text: お、俺はたしかに、少し意地っ張りなところがあったかもしれんが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: G-granted, I might have a slightly stubborn side, but..."

strings.text: 「少しなものか……二人ともとてつもなく、意地っ張りで、見栄っ張りだ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Slightly, my foot... Both of you are outrageously stubborn, and full of vanity too..."

strings.text: 「そんな意地っ張りな二人には礼を言わなきゃいけないのにな。いや、謝罪かもしれない……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "And yet I ought to be thanking those two stubborn men. Or perhaps apologizing..."

strings.text: 「何だよそれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's that supposed to mean..."

strings.text: 「私は今回も何も出来なかったのだからな……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I couldn't do anything again this time either...

strings.text: 私は無力だよ。今まで何をしてきたのか……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: I'm powerless. What have I even been doing all this time..."

strings.text: 「……バカか、その事をお前は知らないはずだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...You idiot, you're not supposed to know about that..."

strings.text: 「もう、何も問題は無いのだろ？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's all settled now, isn't it?

strings.text: だったら、何も言うべきではない。すべてが新しくなったのだからさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Then you shouldn't say anything. Everything's been renewed."

strings.text: 「それに、道化を演じる者のその素顔をさらすもんじゃない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Besides, one shouldn't expose the true face of the one playing the fool.

strings.text: そいつが、どんな汗をかいたか知らないが、たぶん舞台裏は絶対に見せたくないハズだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: However much he sweated for it -- I'm sure the last thing he wants is to show what went on backstage."

strings.text: 「道化……、あれを道化と言うのだろうかな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The fool... Should that even be called playing the fool..."

strings.text: 「ああ、道化師はトランプだったら切り札だからな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, the fool -- in a deck of cards, he's the trump. The wild card.

strings.text: どんな、逆境だって、一発逆転させるのが道化師の役目さ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Whatever the adversity, the fool's role is to turn the whole game around in one stroke."

strings.text: 「ゲームが違ったら、命取りにもなる」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "In a different game, it can cost you your life."

strings.text: 「そういう事もあるが、まぁ、そのゲームはもう終わったんだよ。勝負の結果が今だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That happens too, but well, that game's already over. The result of the match is where we are now."

strings.text: 「うん」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「私は知らないんだ。だからお礼を言う事も、謝罪も言えない……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I don't know anything. That's why I can't offer thanks, or apologies either...

strings.text: 一生を尽くしても返しきれないほどの借りなのに……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Even though it's a debt I couldn't repay in a lifetime..."

strings.text: 「あの時からずっと同じだ……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It's been the same ever since that time...

strings.text: 私は――」
strings.speaker: 藍

strings.text: 「うおおおお大変だぁ！！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "WAAAAAH, this is terrible!!"

strings.text: 「うわぁ、驚いた。ど、どうした圭？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Whoa, you startled me. Wh-what is it, Kei?"

strings.text: 「いや、大した事じゃないんだけどな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "No, it's nothing all that big."

strings.text: 「だから、どうした」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, what is it?"

strings.text: 「いきなり湧いて出てきた謎の幼○が、幼○の分際で年上風をふかせたので、つい大声だしてみたぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "This mysterious little gir* just popped up out of nowhere, and even though she's a little gir* she was putting on airs like she's older, so I ended up crying out."

strings.text: 「ほう……圭。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Oho... Kei.

strings.text: 草薙の悪影響で毒舌か？
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Have you turned sharp-tongued from Kusanagi's bad influence?

strings.text: 似合わない事すると死ぬぞ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Do things that don't suit you and you'll die..."

strings.text: 「だって、だって、姉貴が割り込むから悪いんだぞ！　俺と直哉が大事な話をしている時に！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Because -- because it's your fault for cutting in, sis! While Naoya and I were having an important talk!"

strings.text: 「大事な話？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "An important talk?"

strings.text: 「そうだ！　あの話しろって言ってたの姉貴だろ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That's right! You were the one telling me to bring that up, sis..."

strings.text: 「あの話って……、なんだお前、まだ終わっていなかったのか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That talk...? Hey, wait -- you mean you haven't finished it yet?"

strings.text: 「まだとか言うな！　物事には機微というものがあってだな！
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Don't say 'yet'! There's such a thing as delicacy!

strings.text: 簡単なものではないんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: It's not that simple."

strings.text: 「それで、話ってなんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So what's this talk?"

strings.text: 「あのな、どこから話せばいいかなぁ……あのな直哉。どうやって説明すればいいんだかわからないんだけどな……あのさ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, where should I start... Um, Naoya. I don't know how to explain this... um, you see..."

strings.text: 「そんな複雑な話なのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is it that complicated a story?"

strings.text: 「うーん。複雑ではないんだけど、あのな、どう言って説明していいのか、なかなか難しくてな……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Um. It's not complicated, but, well, it's really hard to figure out how to say it..."

strings.text: 「草薙」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「はい？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes?"

strings.text: 「ウチに住め」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Come live at our place."

strings.text: 三秒ぐらいの世界の静止。
strings.translated: About three seconds of the world standing still.

strings.text: 「はぁ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「ウチってどこのウチなんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Your place -- where's your place?"

strings.text: 「夏目の家だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The Natsume house."

strings.text: 「夏目の家って？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The Natsume house?"

strings.text: 「ウチだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Our place."

strings.text: 「ウチって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Your place, meaning..."

strings.text: 「小音羽の夏目の屋敷だ。お前だって良く知っているだろ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The Natsume estate in Kootoba. You know it well, don't you?"

strings.text: 「知ってるも何も……小音羽の夏目屋敷って……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, of course I know it... but the Natsume estate in Kootoba...

strings.text: あのなぁ、藍……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Hey now, Ai..."

strings.text: 「ほら！　姉貴は機微がわかってないんだよ！　直接すぎるんだよ！　直哉混乱してるじゃんかよ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "See! Sis, you don't get delicacy at all! You're way too direct! You've got Naoya all confused!"

strings.text: 「圭こそ横やりをいれるなっ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You're the one butting in, Kei."

strings.text: 「あー、待て、待て、喧嘩はよせ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, wait, wait, don't fight.

strings.text: えっと、そのなんだ？　つまり“ウチに来ないか”とは、それは小音羽の夏目家で、藍や圭の家に厄介になれということか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Um, so, uh, what? By 'come to our place,' you mean the Natsume house in Kootoba, meaning I'd be imposing on you and Kei at your home?"

strings.text: 「そうだ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That's right..."

strings.text: 「それは今日という意味か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Are you saying today?"

strings.text: 「私は今日からでもかまわん」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I don't mind if it's from today."

strings.text: 「今日からって……いつまでだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "From today until... until when?"

strings.text: 「お前が一人前になるまでだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Until you can stand on your own two feet."

strings.text: 「一人前って……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Stand on my own two feet, meaning..."

strings.text: 「これから、学校を卒業するまで、ウチでみんなで暮らそうと言っているんだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I'm saying we should all live together at our place until you graduate from school."

strings.text: 「藍、あのなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ai, listen..."

strings.text: 「夏目の屋敷は良く知ってるだろ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You know the Natsume estate well, don't you."

strings.text: 「当たり前だ……だがな藍」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Of course I do... but, Ai..."

strings.text: 「早急かもしれない、たしかにお前はそう感じるかもしれない……だけど、私だって考えに考えた末に言ってることだ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It might seem sudden -- I'm sure it feels that way to you... but I've thought and thought about it before saying this..."

strings.text: 「考えた末って……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Thought and thought about it..."

strings.text: 「だいたいお前は金がないのだろ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "For starters, you have no money, right?"

strings.text: 「ああ金は無いな！　笑えるぐらい！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I have no money! Laughably so!"

strings.text: 「そんなやけくそで強調しなくても……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You don't have to emphasize it so desperately..."

strings.text: 「だったら一緒に住めばいいじゃないか」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Then just live with us. What's the problem?"

strings.text: 「そういう問題じゃないだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not the issue here..."

strings.text: 「それだけでも十分に一緒に住む理由になるだろう」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That alone is more than enough reason to live together."

strings.text: 「たしかにそうかもしれないが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You may be right about that, but..."

strings.text: 「無理にとは言わんが……
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I won't force you, but...

strings.text: “絶対に一緒に住め！”
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: 'You WILL live with us!'

strings.text: 私が言えるのはただそれだけだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: That's all I can say."

strings.text: 「無理にでもと言ってるだろそれ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's forcing me, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「草薙、私はお前の事をずっと圭と同じく、実の弟と思ってきた。だから一緒に暮らしたいと思った……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Kusanagi, I've always thought of you as a real brother, just like Kei. That's why I want us to live together..."

strings.text: 「一緒に暮らす……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Live together..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだ。あの頃の様にまた一緒に暮らしたいと思った」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I wanted us to live together again, like we did back then."

strings.text: 「あの頃とはまた古い話だな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Back then... that's going pretty far back..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだ……とは言ってもそんな記憶はないか」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah, it is... though I suppose you don't remember much from that time."

strings.text: 「そうでもないさ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not necessarily true..."

strings.text: 俺の言葉に藍は少しだけ嬉しそうに笑う。
strings.translated: At my words, Ai smiles, looking just a little happy.

strings.text: その笑顔で、俺は少しだけ気分が軽くなる。
strings.translated: That smile makes me feel a little lighter.

strings.text: 「ま、いろいろとうれしい話ではあるが。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I'm grateful for all of it, really.

strings.text: 俺には俺の家がある」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: But I have my own home."

strings.text: 「あの家はあの家で大切なものなんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That house means something to me too, in its own way."

strings.text: 「それは分かっている。分かっているさ……あの家がお前にとってどんな場所であるか……でもだな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I understand that. I do... I know what that house is to you... but even so..."

strings.text: 「あれだぞ。夏目の屋敷はおっきいからな！　空きの部屋だってあるし、アトリエ代わりに使える倉もあるからさ！　全然余裕で住めるハズなんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Come on! The Natsume estate is huge, you know! There are spare rooms, and there's even a storehouse you could use as an atelier! There's more than enough space for you to live there!"

strings.text: 「まぁ、あの屋敷なら人一人増えたところで手狭になるような事が無いのは認めるが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I'll grant you that adding one more person to that estate wouldn't exactly make it feel cramped..."

strings.text: 「だったら一緒に住もうぜ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "So live with us already!"

strings.text: 「いや、それとこれとは話が別でな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that's a whole separate matter..."

strings.text: 「でも、草薙健一郎が死んで、お前は天涯孤独だろ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But with Kusanagi Ken'ichirou dead, you're all alone in the world, right?"

strings.text: 「身よりが無いのはたしかだが、一人なのはいま始まった事じゃない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's true I have no family left, but being alone isn't something that just started now.

strings.text: おれは母親が死んでからずっと一人だった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I've been alone ever since my mother died..."

strings.text: 「直哉……そうじゃなくてさぁ。もっと単純な話でさ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya... that's not what I'm getting at. It's simpler than that."

strings.text: 「いや、分かっている。分かっているさ。圭が言いたい事も……だけど違うんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I know. I know what you're trying to say, Kei... but it's not that..."

strings.text: 「すまん……うれしいお誘いではあったんだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm sorry... it was a kind offer, but..."

strings.text: 藍は俺の頭をつかむとそのまま抱きしめる。
strings.translated: Ai grabbed my head and pulled me into an embrace.

strings.text: あまりの突然の行動で俺は抵抗すら出来なかった。
strings.translated: It was so sudden I couldn't even resist.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-hey? A-Ai?"

strings.text: 「そうだな。私が少し身勝手すぎたかもしれんな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah. Maybe I was being too selfish about this..."

strings.text: 「草薙は、まだあのひとを許していないのだな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Kusanagi, you still haven't forgiven him, have you..."

strings.text: 「……あのひと？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
直哉
strings.translated: "...not really."

strings.text: 「そうか、まぁそれも仕方がないかもしれないな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I see. Well, I suppose that can't be helped either..."

strings.text: 「……だ、だから別にあいつに何も……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...I-I'm telling you, it's not like I have anything against him..."

strings.text: 「出来たら、健一郎さんをあまり恨まないでくれ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "If you can, please try not to hate Ken'ichirou-san too much..."

strings.text: 「これはあくまでもお願いだが、お前のお父さんをあまり恨まないでほしい……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It's only a request, but... I'd like you not to hate your father so much..."

strings.text: 「……どいつもこいつも、女はあいつを弁護するのだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Every last one of you. It's always the women who defend him..."

strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The women?"

strings.text: 「母親も……最後まで同じ事を言っていた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "My mother too... she was saying the same thing right up to the end."

strings.text: 「くす……あははははは……そうか、そうとも言えるな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Heh... ahahahaha... I see, I suppose you could put it that way..."

strings.text: 「そうとも言えるじゃない。あいつの事を擁護するのはたいていは女だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not just 'could put it that way.' The ones who defend him are almost always women..."

strings.text: 「なるほど、母親を取られてくやしいのか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, so it bothers you that he took your mother from you?"

strings.text: 「まさか、ばかばかしい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As if. Don't be ridiculous."

strings.text: 「あと、何を勘違いしてるか知らんが、本当にヤツの事を恨んでもいなければ許すも何もない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And I don't know what you're getting at, but I really don't hate the guy, so there's nothing to forgive to begin with..."

strings.text: 「ったく……にも関わらず、本当にどいつもこいつもあの男にいらぬ擁護ばかりする……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Honestly... and yet every last one of you keeps rushing to defend that man when no one asked you to..."

strings.text: 「いつも無表情の草薙が分かりやすく不機嫌になったな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Look at that -- Kusanagi, who's always expressionless, is visibly in a bad mood now."

strings.text: 「そんな事はない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not true..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、あの人はモテたからな。仕方がないか」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, he was popular with women. Can't be helped."

strings.text: 「そういった意味では少し恨まれておいた方がいいな。あのひとは……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "In that sense, it might be better for him to be resented a little. That man..."

strings.text: 「どういう意味でだよ。意味わからん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In what sense? You're not making any sense."

strings.text: 「はははは、そうか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hahaha, really?"

strings.text: 藍に頭をこんな風に抱かれたのは久しぶりだと思う。
strings.translated: It had been a while since Ai held my head like this.

strings.text: ガキの頃は、よく藍は俺の頭をこうやって抱いた。
strings.translated: When I was little, Ai used to hold my head this way often.

strings.text: そうやってガキ扱いする藍を疎ましくも思ったが、正直うれしくもあった……。
strings.translated: I resented her for treating me like a kid, but honestly, it also made me happy...

strings.text: そんな事をしてくれたのは死んだ母ぐらいだったから……。
strings.translated: After all, the only other person who'd done that for me was my dead mother...

strings.text: 藍は今は自分が通う学校の教師をしている。だけど藍は幼き俺にとって姉であった。
strings.translated: Ai is now a teacher at the school I attend. But to the young me, Ai was an older sister.

strings.text: 小さい時、生意気で、子供のくせに世の中を舐めていた俺を……。
strings.translated: When I was small, cheeky, a kid who thought he had the world figured out...

strings.text: そんな俺を彼女だけは許してくれた。
strings.translated: she alone was willing to forgive that side of me.

strings.text: あの日以来……。
strings.translated: Ever since that day...

strings.text: 藍だけが唯一俺の事を心から許してくれていた。
strings.translated: Ai was the only one who truly forgave me from the heart.

strings.text: 「わかったから人の頭を抱くのはやめろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Alright, I get it, so stop cradling my head already..."

strings.text: 「照れるな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Don't be embarrassed."

strings.text: 「うるさい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shut up..."

strings.text: 「だいたい一緒に住むって……、
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Besides, live together, you say...

strings.text: 圭と藍と一つ屋根の下で住むという事だろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: That means living under one roof with you and Kei, right?"

strings.text: 「あ、そうだ、それだけじゃないぞ。妹が帰ってきた」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Oh, right, it's not just that. My little sister came back home."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Little sister?"

strings.text: 「ああ、先月から妹が帰ってきてな。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah, my sister came back last month.

strings.text: 今は夏目の屋敷に三人暮らしだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Right now it's the three of us living at the Natsume estate."

strings.text: 「あー、そうか、妹か、妹がいたんだー」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, I see, a little sister, so you had a little sister-"

strings.text: 「まぁ、その辺りは夏目家なんでな……あはは」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, that side of things is the Natsume family for you... ahaha."

strings.text: ばつが悪そうに藍が笑う。
strings.translated: Ai laughed awkwardly.

strings.text: 「それで妹さんの名前は？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So what's your sister's name?"

strings.text: 「雫だよ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Shizuku."

strings.text: 「しずく……雫か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shizuku... Shizuku, huh..."

strings.text: 「あれ？　どうしたの？　直哉って雫と会った事無いよな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? What's wrong? You've never met Shizuku, right, Naoya?"

strings.text: 「無いよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I haven't."

strings.text: 「そうなんだ。なんか雫の名前を聞いて納得していた様な……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Really? It kinda seemed like something clicked when you heard her name..."

strings.text: 「いや、別に他意はない。ただ、そういう名前なんだな。と思っただけで」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, there's nothing to it. I just thought, so that's her name."

strings.text: 「んで、なんだ、その雫さんがいきなり知らない人間が家に入ってくるなんて許すわけないだろ？　会った事もない人間だぞ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyway, no way this Shizuku is going to accept some stranger she's never met suddenly moving into her house, right? Someone she's never even seen?"

strings.text: 「それなら問題ない。もちろん雫にも承諾を貰ってる」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "No problem there. Of course, I've already got Shizuku's consent."

strings.text: 「ああ、あのバカ。面識も無い人間が一つ屋根の下に住む事をそんな易々と承諾するなよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh, that idiot. Don't just casually consent to living under the same roof as someone you've never even met..."

strings.text: 「え？　やっぱり、雫知ってるの？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? So you do know Shizuku after all?"

strings.text: 「知らないよ。だから面識が無いと言ってるだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't. That's why I said I've never met her."

strings.text: 「なんか変な反応するヤツだなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You react in weird ways, you know."

strings.text: 「まぁ、とりあえず、夏目家側は準備万端という事だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, in any case, things are all in order on the Natsume side."

strings.text: 「ふぅ、なるほど。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Fwoo, I see.

strings.text: そうみたいだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: It seems that way..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、急にこんなこと言われても、迷っちまうと思うけど……よく考えてくれよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, being told all this out of nowhere, I'm sure you'll want to think about it... give it careful thought, okay?"

strings.text: 「ああ、分かった。分かった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, got it. I got it..."

strings.text: 「でも、とりあえず、今日は終わったんだ……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But anyway, today's over now...

strings.text: だから休みたい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: So I want to rest..."

strings.text: 「うん、それがいいな……。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's a good idea...

strings.text: 何はともあれ終わったばかりなのだからな……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: If nothing else, everything just ended, after all..."

strings.text: 「そうだな……終わったのだものな。あの人の葬式も……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That's true... it's over. His funeral too..."

strings.text: そう言って藍が空を見上げた。
strings.translated: Saying that, Ai looked up at the sky.

strings.text: 見上げた先には、桜の森の上につきだした煙突。
strings.translated: Beyond her gaze, a chimney rose above the forest of cherry trees.

strings.text: 煙がまだ立ち上っている。
strings.translated: Smoke was still rising from it.

strings.text: 「終わったばかりだから、新しくはじめるのはもう少し後でもいいだろう……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Since it's only just ended, there's no harm in starting something new a little later on..."

strings.text: 「そうだよな、健一郎……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That's right, isn't it, Ken'ichirou..."

strings.text: 「よし、いい返事待ってるぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Alright, I'll be waiting for a good answer!"
