strings.text: 「いい返事って……何がお前にとっていい返事になるんだか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A good answer... I have no idea what qualifies as a good answer to you..."

strings.text: 「そんなの当たり前じゃん。俺たちと一緒に住むって返事だよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Isn't that obvious? An answer saying you'll live with us."

strings.text: 「そんな事言うなよ。そんな事言われると」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't say things like that. When you say things like that,"

strings.text: 「素直に気色が悪い……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "honestly, it just creeps me out..."

strings.text: 「んだとぉ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What did you say?!"

strings.text: 「それはそうと、圭、そろそろ五時になるぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "By the way, Kei, it's almost five o'clock."

strings.text: 「ええええぇ！？　あわわわわ、お、俺、バイクとりにいくぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Whaaaat?! Uwawawa, I-I've gotta go get my bike!"

strings.text: 「何焦ってるんだ？　お前？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you panicking for?"

strings.text: 「ここの葬儀場って市営らしいから五時で駐車場が閉まるんだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "This funeral hall is run by the city, so the parking lot closes at five."

strings.text: 「なら急いだ方がいいぞ……あと五分で閉まる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then you'd better hurry... it closes in five minutes."

strings.text: 「ひぃぃい。大変だぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Aiieee. This is bad!"

strings.text: そう言い放つと、圭は葬儀場の横にある駐車場へと姿を消した。
strings.translated: With that, Kei vanished toward the parking lot beside the funeral hall.

strings.text: 「さてと、私もそろそろ帰るか……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well then, I should be heading home too..."

strings.text: 「あの、あのさ……藍」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Um, hey... Ai."

strings.text: 「ん？　なんだ草薙」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hm? What is it, Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、なんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's nothing..."

strings.text: 「なんだ？　用事なら早く言え……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What? If you have something to say, spit it out..."

strings.text: 「あいつの葬式に、出てくれてありがとう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Thanks for coming to his funeral..."

strings.text: 「ぷっ……なんだそれは？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Pft... what's that about?"

strings.text: 「な、なんだよ、見ての通りだよ。お礼を言ったんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-what? It's just what it sounds like. I was thanking you."

strings.text: 「くす、くす、素直じゃないな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Heh, heh, you're not very honest, are you..."

strings.text: 「なんでそうなるんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How does it come out to that?!"

strings.text: 「ならなんで目をそらして、すねた様に言うんだ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Then why look away and say it in that sulky tone..."

strings.text: 「草薙……いや直哉……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Kusanagi... no, Naoya..."

strings.text: 「なんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is it..."

strings.text: 「お前は、変わらないな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You haven't changed a bit..."

strings.text: 「なんだよ、それ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's that supposed to mean."

strings.text: 「ここの桜の森はまさに満開という感じだな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The cherry forest here is truly in full bloom, isn't it..."

strings.text: 「話そらすなよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't change the subject..."

strings.text: 「桜は何度見ても同じ様に咲き、同じ様に散る」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "No matter how many times you see them, cherry blossoms bloom the same way, and scatter the same way."

strings.text: 「同じでは無いのに……まるで10年前の桜も、昨日の桜も同じ様に咲いている……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Even though they aren't the same... the cherry blossoms from ten years ago and the ones from yesterday all seem to bloom the same way..."

strings.text: 「もしかしたら同じなんじゃないかと思ってしまう様に……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "So much so that you start thinking maybe they really are the same..."

strings.text: 「でもたぶんそうではない。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "But that's probably not true.

strings.text: 桜はそれこそ１００年も１０００年も１００００年も前だって同じように咲いていたのだろう……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Cherry blossoms have been blooming this same way for a hundred years, a thousand years, ten thousand years..."

strings.text: 「誰に見られる事がなくとも、それでも昨晩と同じように……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Even with no one to see them, still the same as the night before..."

strings.text: 「ずっと昔から……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "For a very long time..."

strings.text: 「だから、桜は恐ろしいんだと思う……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That's why I think cherry blossoms are terrifying..."

strings.text: 「お前と私……最初に会った時も桜が咲いていた」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You and I... when we first met, the cherry blossoms were blooming too."

strings.text: 「まるで満開の桜の森の様だった……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It was just like a cherry forest in full bloom..."

strings.text: 「ああ……四月生まれだからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah... I was born in April, after all."

strings.text: 「私はあの時うれしかったんだぞ……
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I was so happy back then, you know...

strings.text: 本当は悔しかったはずなのに、
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Even though I should have felt bitter,

strings.text: 本当に、本当に、うれしかった……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: truly, truly, I was happy..."

strings.text: 本当は悔しかった。
strings.translated: She really had felt bitter.

strings.text: その意味は分からない。
strings.translated: I don't know what she meant by that.

strings.text: けど、何となく彼女の表情からその意味は察する事は出来た。
strings.translated: But somehow, from her expression, I could sense what she meant.

strings.text: 何故、悔しくて、そしてうれしく思ってくれたのか……。
strings.translated: Why she had felt bitter, and yet also felt happy for me...

strings.text: 「仮象のはるいろそらいちめん
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Across the whole illusory spring-colored sky,

strings.text: ただやみくもの因果的交流電燈
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: only a blind chain of causal electric lamps,

strings.text: 明るく明るく明るく灯ります」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: burning bright, bright, bright."

strings.text: 「Watermelonの電気石
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The tourmaline of Watermelon,

strings.text: 音と言語の交差地点
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: the crossroads of sound and language,

strings.text: ますます色彩過多の世界にて」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: in a world of ever more chromatic excess."

strings.text: 「七つの櫻が追い越した」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Seven Sakura overtook me."

strings.text: 「わたしめがけて追い越した」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "They overtook me, aimed straight at me."

strings.text: 「ふうけいより先にわたしはなく
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Before the landscape, I am not,

strings.text: わたしより先にふうけいはなく」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: before me, the landscape is not."

strings.text: 「追いかけ追いつきいなくなる」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Chasing, catching up, disappearing."

strings.text: 「ふわふわとつつまれ世界は消えていく」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Softly wrapped, the world fades away."

strings.text: 「ふわふわの櫻の森で世界が鳴った
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "In the softly drifting cherry forest, the world rang out,

strings.text: 美しい音色で世界が鳴った」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: in a clear, resonant tone, the world rang out."

strings.text: 「それが虚無ならば虚無自身がこのとほりで
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If this be nothingness, then nothingness itself is just this,

strings.text: ある程度まではみんなに共通いたします」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: and to some degree, it is shared by us all."

strings.text: 「（すべてがわたくしの中のみんなであるやうに
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "(For just as everything within me is everyone,

strings.text: みんなのおのおののなかのすべてですから）」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: so too is everything within each and every one.)"

strings.text: 「あの詩は、最後に宮澤賢治の『春と修羅・序』の一部分が引用されて終わっている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That poem ends with a quotation from a portion of Miyazawa Kenji's 'Spring and Asura -- Preface.'"

strings.text: 「通称『櫻ノ詩』、やつの作品をより難解にしたと言われている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Known as 'Sakura no Uta,' it's said to have made his work all the more impenetrable."

strings.text: 「直哉にはどう聞こえるんだ？　この詩が」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "How does that poem sound to you, Naoya?"

strings.text: 「別に……あの男が残した言葉の意味なんて、俺が考える理由なんてない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's nothing... I've got no reason to sit around thinking about the meaning of words that man left behind..."

strings.text: 「ただ、その詩を聞くと、あいつの口癖を思い出す」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Only, when I hear that poem, it reminds me of his pet phrase."

strings.text: 「口癖？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "His pet phrase?"

strings.text: 「What is mind ?　……心とは何か？　No matter. 物質ではない。What is matter ? 物質とは何か？ Never mind. 決して心ではない。そんなところか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "'What is mind? ...Kokoro to wa nanika? No matter. Busshitsu de wa nai. What is matter? Busshitsu to wa nanika? Never mind. Kesshite kokoro de wa nai.' Something like that?"

strings.text: 「いいや、違う。正しくは――」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that's wrong. The correct version is--"

strings.text: 「What is mind ?　心ってなんだよ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'What is mind?' -- What the hell is 'mind'?"

strings.text: 「No matter. どうでもいいんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'No matter.' -- Doesn't matter."

strings.text: 「What is matter ? 物ってなんだよ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'What is matter?' -- What the hell is 'matter'?"

strings.text: 「Never mind. 気にすんなよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Never mind.' -- Never you mind."

strings.text: 「そういう意味だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's what it meant."

strings.text: 「それと何故さっきの詩が？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "And what's that got to do with the poem from before?"

strings.text: 「さぁな……。よく分からないが、そう思っただけだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who knows... I don't really get it myself. It just came to mind..."

strings.text: 「なるほど、草薙らしいな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I see... that sounds like a Kusanagi thing to say..."

strings.text: 「お互い、あの人には振り回されるなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Both of us really did get jerked around by that man, didn't we..."

strings.text: 振り回されている。
strings.translated: Jerked around.
Huh...

strings.text: 否定したところで……それは事実。
strings.translated: Even if I denied it... it would be the truth.

strings.text: そうとしか言えないか……。
strings.translated: There's no other way to put it...

strings.text: 「たしかに、あのバカ野郎には振り回され続けた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that idiot really did keep jerking me around..."

strings.text: 「なんだ、突然、素直だな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well now, that's honest all of a sudden."

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎とは、それほど長い時間過ごせなかったが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I didn't get to spend all that much time with Kusanagi Ken'ichirou, but..."

strings.text: 「次、会ったらやってやろうと思っていた事があった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There was something I'd meant to do the next time I saw him..."

strings.text: 「やってやろうとした事？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Something you meant to do?"

strings.text: 「ああ、それも出来なくなったしな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, and now I can't do it anymore..."

strings.text: 「健一郎に何をしたかったんだ？　直哉は？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What did you want to do to Ken'ichirou, Naoya?"

strings.text: 「殴っておきたかった。とりあえず顔面をグーで」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I wanted to punch him. Right in the face, with a closed fist."

strings.text: 「あははは、そうか、でもあの人の事だ、殴られたらすぐに反撃するぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hahaha, I see. But knowing him, he'd have hit you right back."

strings.text: 「だったらその分、俺も殴り返す」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then I'd have hit him again, just as many times."

strings.text: 「最後に、俺が一度だけ多く殴る事が出来れば……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If in the end I could get in one more punch than he did..."

strings.text: 拳を握る。
strings.translated: I clench my fist.

strings.text: とても強く。
strings.translated: Very tightly.

strings.text: 「それで満足だったんだがな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That would have been enough for me."

strings.text: 藍はやわらかくほほえむ。
strings.translated: Ai smiled softly.

strings.text: 「それは見てみたかったな。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I'd have liked to see that.

strings.text: 健一郎さんと直哉のタイマン勝負か……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Ken'ichirou-san and Naoya in a one-on-one showdown..."

strings.text: 「いや、そこは止めるところだろ。教師として」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, isn't that the sort of thing you're supposed to stop? As a teacher?"

strings.text: 「あははは、そうだな。もしその場だったら止めなければいけないのだよな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hahaha, that's right. If I were there, I suppose I'd have to break it up..."

strings.text: 「その場があったらだけど……な」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If you were there... yeah."

strings.text: 「永遠に無いけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But that'll never happen now."

strings.text: 「す、すまん。最後に少し湿っぽくなったか」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "S-sorry. I made things a little gloomy at the end there, didn't I?"

strings.text: 「いや、別に」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, not really."

strings.text: 「それ以外にあの男との間にやり残した事はないからな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's nothing else left unfinished between me and that man, so..."

strings.text: 「俺は俺なりに、いろいろな形で整理をつけたからな……あいつとの関係は……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In my own way, I've made peace with things... with my relationship with him..."

strings.text: 「それに、湿っぽいのはあいつが一番嫌ったことだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Besides, gloomy sentiment was the one thing he hated most."

strings.text: 「さすがにエンジョイは出来なかったが、せめて心を湿らせることなくあいつを見送れたと思う……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I couldn't quite bring myself to 'enjoy' it, but at least I saw him off without any soggy sentimentality..."

strings.text: 俺の言葉に、小さく藍が頷く。
strings.translated: At my words, Ai gave a small nod.

strings.text: 「直哉は直哉でいろいろあったんだもんな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You've had a lot going on too, in your own way..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's true..."

strings.text: 「あはは、さてとそろそろ帰るかな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ahaha, well then, I guess I'd better be heading home..."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 「そうだ。さっきの話、ちゃんと考えておいてくれ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Oh, right. Give some serious thought to what I said earlier."

strings.text: 「ああ……夏目の屋敷でやっかいになるって話だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah... about staying at the Natsume estate, right."

strings.text: 「良い返事を待っているぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I'll be waiting for a good answer."

strings.text: 藍の姿が見えなくなり、
strings.translated: Ai vanished from sight,

strings.text: 風が鳴る。
strings.translated: and the wind sang.

strings.text: 遠くで、風が鳴っている。
strings.translated: Far off, the wind was singing.

strings.text: 耳鳴りにも似た、低くうなる音。
strings.translated: A low, groaning sound, almost like ringing in the ears.

strings.text: 別に桜の森の下で、美しい音色など鳴りはしない。
strings.translated: Beneath the cherry forest, no beautiful melody actually rings out.

strings.text: ふわふわの白い花びらは、低くうなる風に無惨にまき散らされるだけ。
strings.translated: The soft white petals are only cruelly scattered by the low, groaning wind.

strings.text: 当たり前な風景。
strings.translated: An ordinary scene.

strings.text: 「ふぅ……俺も帰るか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hah... guess I should head home too..."

strings.text: 誰に聞かせるでもなく独り言をつぶやく。
strings.translated: I muttered to myself, not meaning it for anyone's ears.

strings.text: 薄汚い音色の咆哮、為すがままに舞う桜の花びら。
strings.translated: Only a turbid roar of wind, and cherry petals dancing at its mercy.

strings.text: 桜の咲く日に死んだ父に、俺は最後の別れを告げた。
strings.translated: To my father, who had died on a day when the cherry blossoms bloomed, I had said my last farewell.

strings.text: まっすぐ帰るつもりであったが、足はそのままこの場所に向いていた。
strings.translated: I had meant to go straight home, but my feet carried me here instead.

strings.text: 気が付けば毎日踏みしめる石畳の坂を少しだけ息を切らせて昇っている。
strings.translated: Before I knew it, I was climbing the stone-paved slope I tread every day, a little short of breath.

strings.text: 俺が通う学園に続くこの坂道も親父の葬儀場と同じように桜で埋め尽くされていた。
strings.translated: This slope leading up to the school I attend was, like the funeral hall for my old man, buried in cherry blossoms.

strings.text: “<r ゆめのうきさか>夢浮坂</r>”
strings.translated: "Yume-no-Ukisaka."

strings.text: いかにもな由来がありそうなこの坂の名、だがその由来を俺はそれほど詳しくは知らない。
strings.translated: The name of this slope sounds as though it must have some storied origin, though I don't know the details myself.

strings.text: ただ、多くの伝承が混ざり合って出来た名だと聞いている。
strings.translated: I've only heard that it's a name born from many legends mixed together.

strings.text: この坂道の脇には、神社の境内にある様な小さな社がある。
strings.translated: Beside this slope stands a small shrine, the sort you'd find within a shrine's precincts.

strings.text: いわゆる<r せっしゃ>摂社</r>というやつだ。
strings.translated: One of the so-called subsidiary shrines.

strings.text: 宝船が描かれた絵巻が奉納されている。
strings.translated: A picture scroll depicting a treasure ship is enshrined there.

strings.text: この意味を知る者ならば“夢浮坂”の名の由来も少しは想像がきくかもしれない……。
strings.translated: Those who know the meaning of it might be able to guess a little at the origin of the name "Yume-no-Ukisaka"...

strings.text: 夢浮坂を上っていくと、構内にある礼拝堂のとんがり帽子が徐々に見えてくる。
strings.translated: As you climb Yume-no-Ukisaka, the pointed cap of the chapel on the school grounds gradually comes into view.

strings.text: 尖頭アーチを交差させる事によって作られる独特なシルエット。
strings.translated: A distinctive silhouette formed by intersecting pointed arches.

strings.text: 桜生い茂る弓張の丘に建てられたこの学園の名を弓張学園という。
strings.translated: The name of the school built upon the cherry-covered hill of Yumihari is Yumihari Academy.

strings.text: 階段を上りきった場所で人とすれ違う。
strings.translated: At the top of the stairs, I passed by someone.

strings.text: 人通りが少ない夕日に照らされた坂の上に立つ影は印象的であった。
strings.translated: The silhouette standing atop the sparsely traveled slope, illuminated by the setting sun, was striking.

strings.text: 「今の娘の制服は弓張学園のものじゃないな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That girl's uniform just now wasn't from Yumihari Academy..."

strings.text: 「見学か何かだろうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Maybe she was here for a school visit..."

strings.text: 春休みということもあって弓張の近隣には人の気配がほとんど無い。大半の部活などもおそらく午前中に終えてしまっているのだろう。
strings.translated: With spring break in effect, there was hardly any sign of people near Yumihari. Most club activities had probably finished up in the morning.

strings.text: 俺はやや大股気味に正門を抜けると目的の場所へと急いだ。
strings.translated: I strode through the main gate at a broad pace and hurried to my destination.

strings.text: 戦後しばらくまでカトリック系だった弓張学園は、当時は神学科のみの神学校であった。
strings.translated: Yumihari Academy was Catholic until some time after the war, when it had been a theological seminary consisting only of a theology department.

strings.text: <r けいけん>敬虔</r>な父の子と母の子たちが通う神の加護を受けた学び舎であったという。
strings.translated: It was a school under divine protection, attended by the sons and daughters of pious fathers and mothers.

strings.text: しかし、現在では神学科は廃され、ごくありふれた学校と成り果てている。
strings.translated: But now, the theology department has been abolished, and the school has become perfectly ordinary.

strings.text: それ以前。
strings.translated: Before that.

strings.text: 戦前より遙か先、この学園の立つ土地の歴史はとてつもなく古い。
strings.translated: Far earlier than the prewar era, the history of the land on which this school stands is astonishingly old.

strings.text: 学園自体は明治の頃に渡ってきた外人が作った英学塾がもとである様だが、さらにその系譜をさかのぼる事が出来る。
strings.translated: The school itself seems to have originated as an English school founded by a foreigner who came over during the Meiji era, but its lineage can be traced back further.

strings.text: もちろん、明治以前であるわけだから、近代的な学問所であったわけではない。
strings.translated: Of course, since we're talking about the pre-Meiji era, it wasn't a modern place of learning.

strings.text: それでも江戸時代にはすでにこの地には何かしらの学問的な建造物があったという。
strings.translated: Still, it's said that even in the Edo period, some sort of scholarly structure already stood here.

strings.text: 学問的な建造物と言っても、江戸に一般的にあったと言われる<r しゅせきしなんじょ>手習指南所</r>よりも、極めて神道系の宗教色が強いものであったらしい。
strings.translated: When I say scholarly, though, it apparently had a far stronger Shinto-religious character than the ordinary handwriting-instruction schools that were common in Edo.

strings.text: さらに、大昔……。鎌倉時代初期には修験の地として多くの修験者が籠もったとも言われている。
strings.translated: Further back... in the early Kamakura period, it's said that many ascetics secluded themselves here as a land of mountain asceticism.

strings.text: このように古き土地であるから、“夢浮坂”に見られるような、多くの伝承を持つ。
strings.translated: Because it's such ancient land, it holds many legends, as seen in "Yume-no-Ukisaka."

strings.text: 弓張の名は、一説によると古き伝承が元になっているらしい。
strings.translated: The name Yumihari, according to one theory, seems to be based on an old legend.

strings.text: とは言っても、それは忘れ去られた伝承。
strings.translated: That said, it's a forgotten legend.

strings.text: 多くの者が知る伝承ではない。
strings.translated: Not one that many people know.

strings.text: 「夢張りの地に、夢の浮く坂か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The land where dreams are drawn, and the slope where dreams float, huh..."

strings.text: 桜に囲まれた古色蒼然とした建物に、自らの<r きょうおん>跫音</r>が残されていくかの様だった。
strings.translated: It felt as though the sound of my footsteps were lingering among the timeworn buildings ringed by cherry trees.

strings.text: やや立て付けの悪くなった扉を開き、俺は室内へ入る。
strings.translated: I pulled open the somewhat ill-fitting door and stepped inside.

strings.text: 部屋からは、斜光に焼きつけられたアトリエ特有の香りが立ちこめていた。
strings.translated: Inside, the distinctive scent of an atelier hung thick, baked into the room by the slanting light.

strings.text: 最上階にあるアトリエは外光を良く取り入れて、空と同じ色に染まる。
strings.translated: The top-floor atelier drinks in the light from outside, dyeing itself the color of the sky.

strings.text: 俺は、雑然と並んだ長机と長椅子の間を縫うようにして、美術室の最後尾へと歩み寄った。
strings.translated: Threading my way between the disorderly rows of long tables and benches, I made my way to the very back of the art room.

strings.text: そこには美術部員たちが使用している各種用具が置いてあり、俺の目当てのものもそこに埋もれていた。
strings.translated: There, various tools used by the art club members were stored, and the thing I was after lay buried among them.

strings.text: 夏目圭専用と、マーカーで書かれたイーゼルをどかすと、その下からは、絵の具が幾多にも染み付いた、古ぼけたイーゼルが姿を現した。
strings.translated: When I moved aside an easel with "Property of Natsume Kei" written on it in marker, an old easel appeared beneath it, stained again and again with countless coats of paint.

strings.text: このイーゼル……。
strings.translated: This easel...

strings.text: 老人
strings.translated: Old Man

strings.text: 「春先から、草薙健一郎先生の回顧展を開催するので作品と、できれば氏が使っていた美術用具を貸して頂けないか」
strings.speaker: 老人
strings.translated: "Starting this spring, we're planning to hold a retrospective exhibition of Kusanagi Ken'ichirou-sensei's works. Would you be willing to lend us his pieces, and if possible, the art tools he used?"

strings.text: 父が懇意にしていた美術館の館長から切り出されたのは葬儀の当日。つまり今日の事であった。
strings.translated: The proposal from the director of the art museum my father had been on good terms with came on the day of the funeral. In other words, today.

strings.text: できれば回顧展が終わった後も美術館の１コーナーとして草薙氏の遺品を預からせて欲しい。との事だった。
strings.translated: If possible, even after the retrospective ended, they wanted to keep Kusanagi's belongings as a permanent corner of the museum -- that was the gist of it.

strings.text: 人の良さそうな老館長は、曲がり始めた腰を伸ばすようにしてその提言を俺へと投げかけた。
strings.translated: The kindly-looking old director had made the proposal while straightening a back that had begun to stoop.

strings.text: 別に<r せ>急</r>かされたわけでは無かった。
strings.translated: It wasn't as though he was rushing me.

strings.text: たぶん数週間後ぐらいにでも送れば良いものなのだろう……。
strings.translated: I could probably send it in a few weeks or so...

strings.text: 「これでいいんだよな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This should do it..."

strings.text: ガキの頃に親父からもらったものだ。
strings.translated: It was something my old man had given me when I was a kid.

strings.text: かなり大きめの頑丈なイーゼルで、ガキが使えたもんじゃなかったが、それでも子供の時は背伸びして使ったもんだ。
strings.translated: A pretty large, sturdy easel -- not something a kid could really use, but even so, as a child I used it, stretching to reach.

strings.text: あの謎のギブスとともに……。
strings.translated: Along with that mysterious cast...

strings.text: 「ああ……思い出すだけでムカつく……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ugh... just remembering it pisses me off..."

strings.text: 健一郎関係の記憶はだいたいムカつく事しかない。
strings.translated: Almost every memory involving Ken'ichirou is one that pisses me off.

strings.text: それにしても……。
strings.translated: Even so...

strings.text: 「今見ると、たいして大きくないんだよな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Looking at it now, it's not really all that big..."

strings.text: 使ってみてもちょうど良いぐらいだ。
strings.translated: When I actually try using it, it's just the right size.

strings.text: イーゼルを引っ張り出して肩にかけると、積み上げていた他のイーゼル達が一斉に崩れる。
strings.translated: When I pulled the easel out and slung it over my shoulder, the other easels that had been stacked up all collapsed at once.

strings.text: 窓から差し込む陽光が、舞い散る埃を浮かび上がらせる。
strings.translated: Sunlight streaming in through the window lit up the dust swirling in the air.

strings.text: 「あははは……しまったな……やっぱり後日、美術部員がいる時にやればよかったな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahaha... damn it... I really should have waited and done this on a day when the art club members were around..."

strings.text: 「とは言っても……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That said..."

strings.text: 数日したら、頼まれごとなどだいたい忘れてしまう。
strings.translated: After a few days, I'll forget just about any favor I've been asked to do.

strings.text: 頼まれたら、とっとと終わらせないと気が済まない質なのだ……。
strings.translated: When I'm asked to do something, I can't rest easy until I get it out of the way...

strings.text: 「覆水盆に返らず……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Spilled water doesn't return to the tray..."

strings.text: 崩れてしまったイーゼルは元には戻らない……。
strings.translated: The easels that have fallen won't go back the way they were...

strings.text: 「そんなわけないやんけー！」
strings.translated: "Like hell they won't!"

strings.text: とか突っ込む人もいないので、速やかに退散する。
strings.translated: There's no one here to shoot back a retort like that, so I make my swift escape.

strings.text: 風が、肌を撫でるたびに。
strings.translated: Each time the wind brushes against my skin,

strings.text: 並木の桜たちが静かにざわめき、白桃の欠片を散らす。
strings.translated: the rows of cherry trees stir quietly, scattering pale peach-tinted petals.

strings.text: 「やっぱり重い……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It really is heavy..."

strings.text: このイーゼルは頑丈な分、とてつもなく重い。
strings.translated: This easel, being as sturdy as it is, is unbelievably heavy.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew..."

strings.text: 自然と足が止まる。
strings.translated: My feet came to a stop of their own accord.

strings.text: まるで舞い落ちる花弁が俺の行方を遮っているかのように。
strings.translated: As though the fluttering petals were blocking my path.

strings.text: その時――。
strings.translated: In that moment--.

strings.text: 身体をすり抜けるかのような突風が、夢浮坂を走った。
strings.translated: A sudden gust that felt like it was passing right through my body swept down Yume-no-Ukisaka.

strings.text: この街で生まれて、何百回、いや何千回もこの夢浮の坂を登った。
strings.translated: Born in this town, I've climbed this slope of Yume-no-Uki hundreds -- no, thousands of times.

strings.text: そのどの時とも違う気がした。
strings.translated: But it felt different from any of those times.

strings.text: 桜の旋律。
strings.translated: The melody of the cherry blossoms.

strings.text: まるで何かに共鳴して、すべての桜がざわめいているかの様な――
strings.translated: As if resonating with something, every cherry tree was stirring at once--

strings.text: 重なり合う奇妙な音響。
strings.translated: A strange, overlapping resonance of sound.

strings.text: 巻き上がる桜から目を逸らすように、俺は片腕で眼前を覆う。
strings.translated: As if to avert my eyes from the swirling cherry blossoms, I covered my face with one arm.

strings.text: ふと――。
strings.translated: And then--.

strings.text: 風が、止む。
strings.translated: The wind stops.

strings.text: 木立のざわめきが消え、瞬間、世界に静寂が宿る。
strings.translated: The rustling of the grove vanishes, and for an instant, silence takes hold of the world.

strings.text: だが、すぐにそれが錯覚であると気が付く。
strings.translated: But I realize at once that it's an illusion.

strings.text: 凜とした木々のざわめきが、遠くに聞こえる街の喧騒も――何もかも消しさり、
strings.translated: The crisp rustling of the trees, the distant clamor of the town -- all of it falls away,

strings.text: 視界に舞い散る色だけを際だたせているかの様であった。
strings.translated: as if only the colors dancing through my field of vision were being drawn out in sharp relief.

strings.text: 音の中にある静寂の中。
strings.translated: A silence that exists within sound.

strings.text: 誘われるように、俺は、顔を上げる。
strings.translated: As if beckoned, I lift my face.

strings.text: コンクリートで塗り込められた視界が、広がる。
strings.translated: My field of vision, hemmed in by gray concrete, opens wide.

strings.text: ゆっくりと、ゆっくりと。
strings.translated: Slowly, slowly.

strings.text: 少女……？
strings.translated: A girl...?

strings.text: 誰……だ？
strings.translated: Who... is that?

strings.text: どこかで会った事があるのか……。
strings.translated: Have I met her somewhere before...?

strings.text: 色素をほとんど感じさせない、白磁の肌。距離を置いてもわかるほどに、整った形をした目、鼻。
strings.translated: Skin like white porcelain, scarcely bearing any pigment. Eyes and nose so finely shaped they were clear even from a distance.

strings.text: そして――感情を押し殺すかのように、硬く結ばれた唇。
strings.translated: And -- lips pressed tightly closed, as if to stifle every emotion.

strings.text: 伏せ目がちの表情が、どことなく冷淡な印象を抱かせる……。
strings.translated: Her downcast eyes lent her a faintly aloof air...

strings.text: 少女の視線は、真っ直ぐに、俺へと伸びている。
strings.translated: The girl's gaze extends straight toward me.

strings.text: その瞳を見た瞬間。
strings.translated: The moment I saw those eyes.

strings.text: 俺は彼女の名を口にしそうになる。
strings.translated: I nearly spoke her name aloud.

strings.text: だが――
strings.translated: But--

strings.text: 風の音。
strings.translated: The sound of the wind.

strings.text: 音の均衡がやぶられ、視界が桜で白く染まる。
strings.translated: The balance of sound breaks, and my vision is dyed white with cherry blossoms.

strings.text: 舞い上がる風で視界を失う。
strings.translated: I lose sight of everything in the rising wind.

strings.text: そして――。
strings.translated: And then--.

strings.text: 「消えた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She's gone..."

strings.text: まるで。
strings.translated: As if.

strings.text: 桜の見る夢に――
strings.translated: Into a dream the cherry blossoms were dreaming--

strings.text: <r さら>攫</r>われた様に――。
strings.translated: she had been spirited away--.

strings.text: また、夢張りの丘は静けさを取り戻す。
strings.translated: Once again, the hill of Yumihari regains its stillness.

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「ふぅ、少しは片づいたか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Phew, that's a bit tidier now..."

strings.text: 「それなりに広いマンションだと思っていたが……、
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I thought this was a fairly spacious apartment, but...

strings.text: さすがに親父のモノが少しでも入ってくるとかなり狭いな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: once even a little of my old man's stuff comes in, it gets pretty cramped..."

strings.text: 昨日持ってきたイーゼルを居間に置く。
strings.translated: I set the easel I brought back yesterday down in the living room.

strings.text: もちろんそれだけで部屋が狭くなる事などない。
strings.translated: Of course, that alone doesn't make the room feel smaller.

strings.text: その他、草薙健一郎関連の物体が、何故かこの部屋に集まってくる。
strings.translated: Beyond that, for whatever reason, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou-related objects keep gathering in this room.

strings.text: 相続権を剥奪されているにも関わらず俺の許可無しで、どんどんゴミみたいなものまでが送り込まれてくる。
strings.translated: Even though I've been stripped of my inheritance rights, more and more junk keeps getting sent over without my permission.

strings.text: たぶん遺産相続を拒否した事を知らない関係者が、このマンションに送りつけてくるのだろう。
strings.translated: The people involved probably don't know I refused the inheritance, so they just keep shipping things to this apartment.

strings.text: 迷惑な話だ。
strings.translated: What a nuisance.

strings.text: 間違って送られてくるのは、現金だけで良い！
strings.translated: If they're sending things by mistake, at least let it be cash!

strings.text: 「現金だったら良いのに……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I wish it were cash..."

strings.text: 俺は先ほど送りつけられた、謎の小包を抱きしめてつぶやく。
strings.translated: I hug the mysterious little package that just arrived and mutter to myself.

strings.text: 謎の小包の中は確かめていないので中身は不明だが、現金でない事は確実だった。
strings.translated: I hadn't opened it yet, so the contents were unknown, but it was definitely not cash.

strings.text: 要冷蔵と書いてあるし……。
strings.translated: It was labeled "Refrigerate," after all...

strings.text: 「要冷蔵か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Refrigerate, huh..."

strings.text: 開けてみると、何故かショウガ焼きの豚肉が出てきた。
strings.translated: When I opened it, for some reason, out came pork prepped for ginger stir-fry.

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎の遺産にはこんなものもあるのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's estate includes stuff like this too..."

strings.text: とりあえず冷蔵庫に放り込む。
strings.translated: For now, I toss it into the fridge.

strings.text: 現金でないものなど、何の価値もない。
strings.translated: Anything other than cash has no value.

strings.text: いや、もちろん食材はそれなりに貴重ではあるが……。
strings.translated: No, of course groceries have their own value, but...

strings.text: 草薙健一郎の遺産となったら別だ。
strings.translated: it's a different story when they've become part of Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's estate.

strings.text: 深いため息の後、昨日の美術室からとってきたあのイーゼルを眺める。
strings.translated: After a heavy sigh, I gaze at the easel I hauled off from the art room yesterday.

strings.text: こういう物も売ればいくらかになるんだろうなぁ……。
strings.translated: If I sold something like this, it'd probably fetch a decent price...

strings.text: 価値があるのだろうし……。
strings.translated: It has to be worth something, after all...

strings.text: そんな事を考えながら、ふと昨日の事を思い出した。
strings.translated: As I mused on such things, I suddenly remembered what happened yesterday.

strings.text: このイーゼルを取って、学校の坂を下った時。
strings.translated: When I took this easel and headed down the school hill.

strings.text: 不思議な風景を見た。
strings.translated: I saw a strange sight.

strings.text: 桜の森がざわめいた。
strings.translated: The cherry-blossom grove stirred.

strings.text: そう思った瞬間に少女が現れて、そのまま風と共に消えていた……。
strings.translated: The moment I thought that, a girl appeared, and then vanished along with the wind...

strings.text: まるで桜に<r さら>攫</r>われるかの様に……。
strings.translated: As if she had been spirited away by the cherry blossoms...

strings.text: 「幻か幽霊かＵＦＯだったのだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It was a hallucination or a ghost or a UFO, probably."

strings.text: めんどくさいからそう処理しておく。
strings.translated: Because it's too much trouble, I'll settle it that way.

strings.text: 人の脳は、あらゆる動物の中でもっとも高い率でカロリーを消費しているらしい。
strings.translated: Apparently the human brain burns calories at the highest rate of any animal.

strings.text: 脳の重さは人体の全体重の２％程度だと言われている。
strings.translated: The brain is said to make up about two percent of a person's total body weight.

strings.text: が、しかし、そのカロリー消費量たるや、その重量の１０倍！　２０％近くだ！
strings.translated: And yet its calorie consumption is ten times that -- close to twenty percent!

strings.text: つまり“考える事”とはカロリーを異常消費させる。
strings.translated: In other words, "thinking" abnormally burns calories.

strings.text: “考える”という行為はおなかが減るという事なのだ。
strings.translated: The act of "thinking" means getting hungry.

strings.text: そんなこんなで少し頭を使っただけでもすぐに腹が減る。
strings.translated: And so, even a little brain work quickly leaves me starving.

strings.text: 腹減った。
strings.translated: I'm hungry.

strings.text: 「さてと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "All right then..."

strings.text: 「……だいぶ片付いてきたし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...things are pretty much tidied up."

strings.text: 財布を持ち玄関を出る。
strings.translated: I grab my wallet and head out the front door.

strings.text: 今日はよく働いた。
strings.translated: I've worked hard today.

strings.text: だから贅沢も許されるだろう。
strings.translated: So a little indulgence should be allowed.

strings.text: 金がない身ではあるが、たまに豪遊も許される。
strings.translated: I may be broke, but every now and then a bit of extravagance is permitted.

strings.text: 「今日は豪勢に牛丼だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Today, I'll splurge on a beef bowl."

strings.text: 「さて……どこの牛丼を食べようか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Now then... whose beef bowl should I have..."

strings.text: などといろいろ考えても、所詮は同じ場所に足が向かってしまう。
strings.translated: Even after mulling it over, my feet end up carrying me to the same place after all.

strings.text: 喫茶店のドアに手をかける。
strings.translated: I put my hand on the door of the coffee shop.

strings.text: 側には、墨文字で書かれた看板が、立てかけられている。
strings.translated: Beside it stands a signboard with characters brushed in India ink.

strings.text: 喫茶キマイラ……
strings.translated: Cafe Chimera...

strings.text: 奇妙な店だが、味はうまい。
strings.translated: It's an odd place, but the food is good.

strings.text: そして値段はすごく安い。
strings.translated: And the prices are dirt cheap.

strings.text: さらにメニューが豊富だ。
strings.translated: On top of that, the menu is extensive.

strings.text: 店内は落ち着いた内装でまとめられており、
strings.translated: The interior is tastefully decorated,

strings.text: 併設で、マスターが世界各地から集めている
strings.translated: and attached to it is a space where the master sells

strings.text: コーヒーや器の販売スペースがある。
strings.translated: coffee and vessels she's collected from all over the world.

strings.text: マスター自らがコーヒー豆を仕入れているため、
strings.translated: Because the Master personally sources the coffee beans herself,

strings.text: ほとんど出たきりなのだという。
strings.translated: she's said to be out on the road almost all the time.

strings.text: 真琴
strings.translated: Makoto

strings.text: 「いらっしゃいま……なーんだ。草薙か」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Welcome, welco-- oh, it's just you. Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「鳥谷か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani, huh..."

strings.text: 「また来たの？　ったく、草薙が来たのなら今のお辞儀付きの“いらっしゃいま”を返してほしいぐらいだわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You again? Honestly, if it's you coming in, I want back that 'Welcome' with the bow I just did."

strings.text: 「俺はお客様だ。クラスメイトといえども店員として頭下げて当然だろ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm a customer. Even if we're classmates, of course a staff member should bow.

strings.text: あとせめて最後まで“いらっしゃいませ”を言ってから返還をもとめろよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: And at least finish saying 'Welcome' before demanding it back."

strings.text: 「お客様ねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'Customer,' huh..."

strings.text: 俺が入った瞬間の営業スマイルと同一人物とは思えないほどの横柄な態度。
strings.translated: Her arrogance was so complete it was hard to believe she was the same person who had beamed that customer-service smile the moment I walked in.

strings.text: この女の名は鳥谷真琴。
strings.translated: This woman's name is Toritani Makoto.

strings.text: メイド服風味なものを着ているが、もちろん本職ではない。
strings.translated: She's wearing something maid-uniform-ish, but of course she isn't a professional maid.

strings.text: 俺と同じ弓張学園のクラスメイトだ。
strings.translated: She's my classmate at Yumihari Academy.

strings.text: 喫茶キマイラでバイトをしている。
strings.translated: She works part-time at Cafe Chimera.

strings.text: 「まぁ、ちゃんとお金出してくれるんだったら、いくらでも店員っぽい愛嬌の一つも振りまくけど。施しを受けに来た人間にサービスするほど、私も人間が出来てないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, if you're actually going to pay, I'll happily play the charming waitress. But I'm not saintly enough to wait on someone who's come looking for a handout."

strings.text: 「ほ、<r ほどこ>施</r>しって……きょ、今日は、パンの耳をねだりに来たわけじゃないぞ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-Handout...? T-Today I didn't come here to beg for bread crusts.

strings.text: 今日はちゃんと客として来たんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Today I came as a proper customer."

strings.text: 「あらそうなの？　今日もパンの耳をもらいに来たのかと思った」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh, really? I thought you'd come for bread crusts again."

strings.text: 「最近はもらいに来てなかっただろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I haven't come for those lately, have I?"

strings.text: あまりに生活が苦しい時期にこの店で恵んでもらったのはたしかだが……それほど多くは無かった……様な……。
strings.translated: There was that period when I was really scraping by and this place did throw me some charity... but it wasn't that often... I think...

strings.text: 「パンの耳だって普通のパン屋だったら売り物よ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Bread crusts are actual merchandise at most bakeries, you know.

strings.text: 土台、タダでもらえる事が前提の草薙がおかしいのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: It's you, Kusanagi, who's weird for assuming they come free."

strings.text: 「う……まぁ、それは否定は出来ないが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ugh... well, I can't deny that..."

strings.text: たしかに、鳥谷のバイト先という事で甘えていた部分はあるかもしれない。
strings.translated: Perhaps I had been leaning on the fact that this was Toritani's workplace a bit too much.

strings.text: 「ま、でも、今日はお客さんなのでしょ？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, but today you're a customer, right?

strings.text: だったらサービスしてあげるわよ。笑ってあげようか？　極上のスマイルで」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: In that case, I'll give you special service. Want me to smile for you? A top-grade smile."

strings.text: 「いらねぇよ。お前の心のこもっていない営業スマイルなんぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No thanks. I don't need your heartless customer-service smile."

strings.text: 「そう？　私の営業スマイルは心がこもってるんだけどなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh? My customer-service smile does have heart in it, though..."

strings.text: 「営業スマイルという時点で心はこもってないだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The moment you call it a 'customer-service smile,' the heart's already gone..."

strings.text: 「相手によりけりなんだけどねぇ……。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It depends on who I'm smiling at, you know...

strings.text: まぁいいわ。ねぇ、ねぇ、だったら、草薙は私にどんなサービスを受けてみたい？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Never mind. Hey, hey, so, what kind of service would you like to try?"

strings.text: 「お前のサービスなんてたかが知れている。とっととメニュー出せ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whatever service you offer is bound to be trivial. Just hand over the menu."

strings.text: 「そう？　挨拶にスカートでもたくし上げてあげようかと思ったんだけどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh? I was thinking of hiking up my skirt in greeting for you."

strings.text: 挨拶に？
strings.translated: In greeting?

strings.text: スカートをたくし上げる？
strings.translated: Hiking up her skirt?

strings.text: だと？
strings.translated: She said?

strings.text: 「あら、表情に変化があった？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh, did your expression just change?"

strings.text: 「いや……別段意味は無いが……たくし上げるって何だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No... nothing in particular... but what do you mean, 'hike up'?"

strings.text: 「セルフたくし上げってヤツ？　メイド服だと定番じゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You know, the self-lift thing? It's a maid-outfit classic, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「そ、そんなサービスがある店だったのかよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "S-Since when was this the kind of shop that offered that kind of service?!"

strings.text: 「な、何？　そんな身を乗り出して反応すると思わなかった」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "W-What? I didn't expect you to lean in like that."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、他意はない。ただここの店主はバイトにそんなサービスを強要しているのかと思って……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, I meant nothing by it. I just thought the owner here was forcing that kind of service on her part-timers..."

strings.text: 「無いわよ。キマイラはただの喫茶店だし店長さんは優しいわよ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "She isn't. Chimera is just a normal coffee shop, and the manager is a kind person.

strings.text: でも、まぁ草薙にはいろいろ迷惑かけてるし、なんか今日はサービスしてあげてもいいかなぁ、とね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: But, well, I do cause you trouble in various ways, so I thought today I might offer you some service."

strings.text: 「ほう……そ、そうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ohh... i-is that so..."

strings.text: たしかに鳥谷には迷惑ばかりかけられているが……こいつにそんな自覚があるとは思わなかった……。
strings.translated: It's true that Toritani has caused me nothing but trouble... but I didn't think she was self-aware about it...

strings.text: 「んで？　どうするの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So? What do you say?"

strings.text: 「な、何が？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what do you mean?"

strings.text: 「サービス」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The service."

strings.text: 「え？　さ、サービスって、そのたくし上げか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? S-Service, as in that skirt-lifting thing?"

strings.text: 「うん、そのスカートたくし上げのサービス」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yes, the skirt-hiking service."

strings.text: 「スカートたくし上げのサービスって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Skirt-hiking service'..."

strings.text: たくし上げてパンツを見せるという事だよな。
strings.translated: That means lifting the skirt and showing panties, right?

strings.text: いくら俺だって、そんな破廉恥なサービスをクラスメイトにさせられるわけが――
strings.translated: Even I couldn't let a classmate perform such a shameless service on--

strings.text: 「いらないのなら、やらないけど？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "If you don't want it, I won't do it, though?"

strings.text: 「あ、いややって！　いや、やてれください！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-No, do it! I mean, plizz do it!"

strings.text: おもいっきり噛んだ。
strings.translated: I completely tripped over my tongue.

strings.text: いや、なんだその？
strings.translated: No, I mean, what's up with that?

strings.text: サービスなら受けておいて損はないだろう？
strings.translated: If she's offering service, there's no harm in accepting, right?

strings.text: サービスだし？
strings.translated: It's just a service, right?

strings.text: 「……。い、いつも死にそうなぐらいダルそうにしてるのにすごい勢いね。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "...Y-You're always acting like you're half-dead from exhaustion, but now you've got so much energy.

strings.text: 通常時もその半分ぐらいの元気があればいいんだけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: If only you had half this vigor in your everyday life."

strings.text: 「いつも死にそうなぐらいダルそうではない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I do not always act half-dead from exhaustion!"

strings.text: 「なんかうれしいわね。私のサービスにそんな反応してくれるなんて、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "How nice, though. That you'd react so strongly to my service.

strings.text: んじゃ、他のお客さんもいないみたいだし、一世一代のサービスという事で……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Well, there don't seem to be any other customers, so let's call it a once-in-a-lifetime service..."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Y-Yeah..."

strings.text: 鳥谷がスカートの裾をつかむ。
strings.translated: Toritani grasps the hem of her skirt.

strings.text: これ以上裾が上がれば、スカートで隠された太ももがあらわになり、さらに、さらに、その下の禁断のデルタ地帯が……。
strings.translated: If the hem rises any higher, the thighs hidden beneath the skirt will be bared, and further, further below, the forbidden delta zone will--

strings.text: ふわり。
strings.translated: A soft flutter.

strings.text: 軽やかに。
strings.translated: Lightly.

strings.text: 鳥谷はスカートの裾を少しだけめくり、そのまま笑顔で挨拶する。
strings.translated: Toritani lifts the hem of her skirt just a little, and greets me with a smile.

strings.text: 「いらっしゃいませ。草薙直哉様」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Welcome, Kusanagi Naoya-sama."

strings.text: 不覚にも、
strings.translated: Unwittingly,

strings.text: 少し可愛いとは思った。
strings.translated: I did find it a little cute.

strings.text: 先ほどの俺をぞんざいに扱った態度とは全然違う。
strings.translated: It was completely different from the offhand way she'd been treating me a moment ago.

strings.text: 最初の笑顔とも微妙に違う。
strings.translated: And also subtly different from her initial smile.

strings.text: だがそうじゃない。
strings.translated: But that's not it.

strings.text: そうじゃないだろ！
strings.translated: That's not it, is it!

strings.text: 「どう？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "How is it?"

strings.text: 「どうって言われても」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'How was it,' she asks..."

strings.text: 「あら、私にしては一世一代のサービスだったのだけど？　お気に召さなかった？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh? That was a once-in-a-lifetime service for me, you know? Didn't it strike your fancy?"

strings.text: 「いや、まぁ良かったと言えば良かったが……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, well, if I had to say, it was good, but...

strings.text: たくし上げって……、それ一般的にカーテシーっていわないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: 'Hiking up'... isn't that generally called a curtsy?"

strings.text: 「そうなの？　カーテシーって言うの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Is that so? It's called a curtsy?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、カーテシーは欧州にある挨拶だよな。結構古くからある……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, a curtsy is a European greeting, right? It's been around for a while..."

strings.text: 「だったら問題ないじゃない。何？　何か草薙の想像してたのと違ってた？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then there's no problem, is there? What? Was it different from what you imagined, Kusanagi?"

strings.text: 「い、いや……別に……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-No... not particularly..."

strings.text: 辞書的な意味で「たくしあげ」は別に下着が見えるまで布をたくし上げるわけではない。
strings.translated: In dictionary terms, "hiking up" doesn't necessarily mean lifting cloth until the underwear shows.

strings.text: それこそ「袖をたくし上げる」という用法がすべてを物語っている。
strings.translated: The phrase "rolling up one's sleeves" pretty much tells you all you need to know.

strings.text: ましてや、鳥谷は「挨拶に」と言っていた。
strings.translated: And on top of that, Toritani did say "in greeting."

strings.text: 用法も行動もすべて正しい。
strings.translated: The usage and the action were both perfectly correct.

strings.text: 「これって正式な挨拶なのでしょ？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "This is a formal greeting, isn't it?

strings.text: 最大限まで丁寧に接客したつもりだけど？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: I was trying to serve you as politely as possible."

strings.text: 「う、そ、そうだが……たくしあげと言われたので……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Uh, y-yeah, but... you said 'hike up'..."

strings.text: 「たくしあげと言われたので？　何それ？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Because I said 'hike up'? What's that supposed to mean?

strings.text: ……って、あんたもしかして！！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: ...Wait, could it be...!!"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、そういう事じゃなくてっっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's not like that--"

strings.text: 鳥谷が勢いよくスカートの端を押さえる。
strings.translated: Toritani vigorously pushes down the edges of her skirt.

strings.text: そのまま俯く鳥谷。表情が見えない。
strings.translated: She hangs her head like that. I can't see her expression.

strings.text: キレたか？
strings.translated: Did I set her off?

strings.text: 「鳥谷？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani?"

strings.text: 「ぷっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Pfft."

strings.text: 「ぷっ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Pfft?"

strings.text: 「あははは、ったく、クール系気取っといて、そんなアホみたいな連想するんだ。草薙。少し意外だわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ahahaha, geez, you act all cool and detached, but you come up with such stupid associations. Kusanagi. That's kind of a surprise."

strings.text: 軽蔑の罵倒……。
strings.translated: Contemptuous abuse...

strings.text: そんなものを覚悟していたが……。
strings.translated: That's what I'd braced myself for, but...

strings.text: 鳥谷は大笑いしていた。
strings.translated: Toritani was laughing her head off.

strings.text: 「ちょっと、おかしすぎて涙出てきた。こんな笑ったのひさしぶりだわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wait, this is too funny, I'm tearing up. It's been forever since I've laughed this hard."

strings.text: 「いつも死人みたいな反応しか無いあんたが、どんな形であれ、期待に満ちた目をするのはうれしいけど、そんな事考えてたんだ。あはははは」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You always have that dead-man's reaction to everything, so I'm happy you'd look at me with such expectant eyes, whatever the reason -- but so that's what you were thinking. Ahahahaha."

strings.text: 「草薙の目の前で私がスカートをたくし上げて、パンツを見せてご挨拶。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Me hiking up my skirt right in front of Kusanagi, showing my panties, and greeting him.

strings.text: 何々？　それってどんな感じなのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: So what, what? What sort of feeling is that?"

strings.text: 「ど、どんな感じという事も無く……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's... not a matter of what sort of feeling..."

strings.text: 「スカートたくし上げて、“ご主人さま、真琴のパンツみてください”とかそんな？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hike up the skirt, then, 'Master, please look at Makoto's panties,' something like that?"

strings.text: 「っっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 「どうしたの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What's wrong?"

strings.text: 「いや、お前の今の台詞が……少しエロいな。と」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, just... that line you said now was... a little erotic."

strings.text: 「な、何？　もしかして“ご主人さま、真琴のパンツみてください”って部分？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wh-what? You mean the 'Master, please look at Makoto's panties' part?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな部分にまで反応するかなぁ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Y-You'd react even to a part like that?"

strings.text: 「う、うむ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Y-yeah."

strings.text: 「私としてはその想像力を、そんなくだらない妄想なんかよりもっと創作的なものに使ってほしいわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Personally, I'd like you to use that imagination of yours on something more creative than trashy delusions like that."

strings.text: 恥ずかしいぐらいの正論だ。
strings.translated: An embarrassingly reasonable point.

strings.text: 「まぁ、そういう草薙も悪く無いけどね。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, that Kusanagi isn't so bad either.

strings.text: でも、少し意外だったわ。草薙が私にそんな事を期待するなんてね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: But it was a bit of a surprise. That you'd expect that sort of thing from me."

strings.text: くっ……。
strings.translated: Ngh...

strings.text: 何も言い返せない。
strings.translated: I've got nothing to say back.

strings.text: 不覚にも、「スカートたくし上げ＝パンツを見せる」と勘違いしてしまったのはたしかだ。
strings.translated: It's true that, to my discredit, I mistook "hiking up the skirt" for "showing panties."

strings.text: 「少々、ゲスな勘違いをしてしまったな……すまん。鳥谷」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That was a rather crude misunderstanding on my part... my apologies. Toritani."

strings.text: 「何謝ってるのよ？　まぁいいじゃない。健全な男子学生っぽくてさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Why are you apologizing? Well, it's fine. It's a pretty healthy-male-student thing to do."

strings.text: 「草薙みたいなヤツでも、そんなアホな勘違いするって分かって楽しかった。別に怒ったりしないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It was fun to learn that even a guy like Kusanagi can make such stupid misunderstandings. I'm not mad or anything."

strings.text: 「そ、そうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I see..."

strings.text: 「それより、顔を真っ赤にした草薙が見られた事の方がおもしろかった。草薙があんな顔するなんてさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "More than that, getting to see Kusanagi with his face bright red was even more amusing. That Kusanagi would make a face like that."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな顔を真っ赤になんか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "M-My face isn't bright red or anything..."

strings.text: 「してないと思った？　鏡持って来ようか？　まだ真っ赤だよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You thought it wasn't? Should I bring a mirror? It's still red, you know."

strings.text: 「い、いらん、そんなもん！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I d-don't need that, no way!"

strings.text: 「あははは……。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ahahaha...

strings.text: まぁ、慣れない事するとお互い何となく恥ずかしくなっちゃうからね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Well, doing things we're not used to makes both of us kind of embarrassed."

strings.text: 「お互い？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Both of us?"

strings.text: そう言われてみると、何となく鳥谷の顔がうっすら朱色に染まっている様に見えた。
strings.translated: Now that she mentions it, Toritani's face did seem to be faintly tinged with red.

strings.text: 「草薙が変な事言うから、こっちまで少しドキドキしちゃったわ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Because Kusanagi said something weird, my heart pounded a bit too.

strings.text: って、まぁいいや。ほら、注文、注文。サービスしたんだからとっとと注文しなさいよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: ...But whatever. Come on, your order, your order. I gave you the service, so hurry up and order already."

strings.text: 「注文か、とりあえずメニューをくれないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The order, huh. First, could you hand me a menu?"

strings.text: 「メニュー？　草薙にメニューなんて必要なの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "A menu? Kusanagi needs a menu?"

strings.text: 「ああ、必要だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I need one."

strings.text: 「そう？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Really?"

strings.text: 少しだけ怪訝そうに鳥谷がメニューを手渡す。
strings.translated: Looking a little puzzled, Toritani hands me the menu.

strings.text: 「ありがとう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Thanks."

strings.text: 俺は最初のページからすべてに目を通す。
strings.translated: I look over everything from the first page.

strings.text: そして……。
strings.translated: And then...

strings.text: 「牛丼並」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Regular beef bowl."

strings.text: 「ほら！　やっぱりメニューなんていらないじゃないの。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "See! I knew you didn't need a menu.

strings.text: 草薙ってそれ以外で頼んだ事ないし！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Kusanagi's never ordered anything else!"

strings.text: 「う、うるさい。たまの外食だ。メニューぐらい堪能させろ。俺にはこれだって娯楽だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Q-Quiet. It's a rare meal out. At least let me savor the menu. For me, even this is entertainment."

strings.text: 「なるほど、そういう気持ちは少し分かるかも。でもさ、程度って言うのもあるでしょ？　何を熟読してるのよ。待たされる私の身にもなりなさいって」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I see, I can kind of understand that feeling. But there are limits, right? What are you poring over so intently? Think about how it feels to keep me waiting."

strings.text: 「たしかに、そうかもしれんが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "True, that may be so, but..."

strings.text: 「んじゃ注文は牛丼……っと、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then your order is a beef bowl... and,

strings.text: 今日は私が厨房もやってるから、そこそこ期待しても良いわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: I'm working the kitchen today too, so you can look forward to it."

strings.text: 「マジか？　それは助かる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Seriously? That's a big help."

strings.text: 「うっぷ……少し食い過ぎたか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Urp... maybe I ate a little too much..."

strings.text: 鳥谷が出してくれる牛丼はいつも量が多めだ。
strings.translated: The beef bowls Toritani serves are always on the large side.

strings.text: 俺の食生活を良く知っている鳥谷の精一杯の心遣いなんだろう。
strings.translated: Knowing my dietary habits as well as she does, it's her way of looking out for me.

strings.text: 「まぁ、あいつが俺の食糧事情を良く理解しているのは間違いない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, there's no doubt she understands my food situation pretty well."

strings.text: 憎まれ口をたたくわりには、実際はかなり気が利くし、面倒見も良い。
strings.translated: For all her acid tongue, she's actually quite considerate, and looks after people well.

strings.text: 「実際、だいぶ後からだった……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In truth, it wasn't until much later...

strings.text: パンの耳を俺が頂くという行為が鳥谷にとってどういう事であったのか知ったのは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: that I learned what it actually meant to Toritani when I took those bread crusts from her..."

strings.text: だからあんな態度取られても仕方がないと言えば仕方がないのだが……。
strings.translated: So I can't really blame her for giving me that kind of attitude...

strings.text: 一癖も二癖もある女。鳥谷真琴。
strings.translated: A woman with a peculiarity or two. Toritani Makoto.

strings.text: それは一般的に言われる様な、破天荒でデタラメでわがままという意味じゃない。
strings.translated: That's not "unconventional" or "outrageous" or "selfish" in the usual sense of the word.

strings.text: 鳥谷真琴は態度こそ、あんな感じだが、その本質はまったくの逆だ。
strings.translated: Toritani Makoto's attitude may be like that, but her essence is the complete opposite.

strings.text: 「とは言っても、あいつからの借りはお礼なんかじゃなくて、ちゃんと形で返さないとなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That said, I can't just repay what I owe her with thanks -- I need to return it in a proper form..."

strings.text: 「となると……美術部で今年もいろいろやらされる可能性が高いのか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In which case... there's a high chance I'll get roped into all sorts of things at the art club this year too."

strings.text: あれめんどくさいんだよなぁ。
strings.translated: That stuff's such a pain.

strings.text: 他で返せたら、そっちでチャラにしたいものだ。
strings.translated: If I can repay her in some other way, I'd rather settle it that way.

strings.text: 俺は久しぶりの動物性タンパク質に満足しながら帰宅の途につく。
strings.translated: Satisfied with my first animal protein in a while, I set off on my way home.

strings.text: 自宅のマンションの前まで来ると見慣れた男が立っていた。
strings.translated: When I reached the front of my apartment building, a familiar man was standing there.

strings.text: 毎度の事ながら……ヤツだ。
strings.translated: As always... it's him.

strings.text: 圭
strings.translated: Kei

strings.text: 「お？　直哉だぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Oh? It's Naoya."

strings.text: 「圭、なんでお前、俺のマンションの前にいるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kei, why the hell are you standing in front of my building?"

strings.text: 「お前こそ何でマンションにいないんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why aren't you in your apartment?"

strings.text: 「飯食いに出かけてたところだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I was out getting food."

strings.text: 「お！　俺も飯食べたいと思っていたところだぞ直哉！　一緒に食べに行こう！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Oh! I was just thinking I wanted to eat too, Naoya! Let's go eat together!"

strings.text: 「違う。違う。食べに行ってたところだと言っているだろう。もう食べた後だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No. No. I said I was already out getting food. I've already eaten."

strings.text: 「なぁにぃ！　なんでメシを先に食べてるんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Whaaat! Why did you eat first?!"

strings.text: 「なんで貴様に許可とらなければならない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why the hell do I need to get your permission?"

strings.text: 「許可とってくれよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Get my permission, please."

strings.text: 「いや、とるわけがないだろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, there's no way I would..."

strings.text: 「んで？　何を食べたんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "So? What'd you eat?"

strings.text: 「牛丼の普通盛り風大盛りだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A regular-sized-style large-sized beef bowl."

strings.text: 「普通盛り風大盛り？　なんだそりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Regular-sized-style large-sized? What's that?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、なんだたまにあるキマイラのサービスだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, just one of Chimera's occasional services."

strings.text: 「キマイラ行ったのか？　だったら真琴いたか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You went to Chimera? Then was Makoto there?"

strings.text: 「あいつがあそこでバイトしているなんてめずらしくもないだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not unusual for her to be working there, is it?"

strings.text: 「いや、なんか昨日、真琴は遅くまで美術部の棚卸しやってたけど、“終わらない終わらない”ってぼやいてたからさすがに今日のバイトは休んだのかなぁ……って」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "No, it's just that yesterday, Makoto was doing inventory for the art club until late, grumbling 'it never ends, it never ends,' so I figured she'd take today off from her shift..."

strings.text: 「棚卸し？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Inventory?"

strings.text: 「ああ、なんでも、先代の部長が適当な事やってたんで、備品の数が全然あわなくて大変らしいぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, seems the previous club president did things so haphazardly the numbers of supplies don't match at all -- it's rough."

strings.text: 「先代か……なるほど。あいつの部長時代なら、まぁ数など絶対にあわないだろうな。新部長の鳥谷は大変だろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The previous one, huh... I see. With that guy as president, of course the numbers wouldn't add up. It must be tough on the new president, Toritani."

strings.text: 「そうだなぁ。まぁあいつは弓張美術部のために生きている様な女だから、それほど苦ではないんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I guess. Well, she's the kind of woman who lives for the Yumihari art club, so it probably doesn't feel like that much of a hardship to her, right?"

strings.text: 「いや、さすがに苦だろ。明石部長……。いや、明石前部長はデタラメな人間だったし、その尻ぬぐいとなればさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, come on, it has to be hard. President Akashi... no, ex-president Akashi was an all-over-the-place kind of person, and cleaning up his mess..."

strings.text: 「おまえらも卒業してくれて本当に良かったと思ってるんじゃないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Aren't you guys really glad that man's graduated too?"

strings.text: 「え？　卒業してないよあの人」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? He didn't graduate."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「あの男は留年したのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That guy got held back?"

strings.text: 「留年かは分からないけど、まだ補習受けてたよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I don't know about held back, but he was still taking makeup lessons."

strings.text: 「って……この時期にか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wait... at this time of year?"

strings.text: 「そろそろ、新学期が始まる頃だろうに……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The new term's about to start..."

strings.text: 「んまぁ、その辺りはウチは甘いからね」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, our school's pretty lenient about that stuff."

strings.text: 「はぁ、あの男の襲撃にあわなくてすむと思っていたのに」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hah, and I thought I'd finally be spared that man's raids."

strings.text: 「話戻るけどさ、それにしても直哉は外食ばかりだな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Back to the earlier topic -- still, Naoya, you're always eating out."

strings.text: 「どこがだよ。ひさしぶりの外食だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How so? It's the first time in a while."

strings.text: 「そうか？　俺が聞くとだいたい外食じゃないか」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Really? Whenever I ask, it's always eating out."

strings.text: 「逆に問いたいのだが？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Let me ask the opposite, if I may.

strings.text: お前が俺の食事を聞いた事が、今まで一度でもあったか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Have you ever, even once, asked about what I've eaten?"

strings.text: 「それは良くわからないけど、ちゃんと自炊しなきゃ健康的にダメダメだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I don't really know about that, but if you don't cook for yourself properly, it's bad for your health."

strings.text: バカには会話が成り立たない。
strings.translated: Conversation doesn't work with idiots.

strings.text: 「とりあえず外食とか栄養に偏りが出るからダメだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Anyway, eating out gives you an unbalanced diet, so it's no good."

strings.text: 「ふぅ、何をわかった様な。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hah, listen to you talking like you know.

strings.text: だいたいそんな事言うお前は、自炊なんてしたことあるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: To begin with, have you, who says such things, ever cooked for yourself?"

strings.text: 「あ、馬鹿にしたな……それ挑戦と受け取るぞ。草薙直哉から頂いた挑戦状と受け取るからな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ah, you're mocking me... I'll take that as a challenge. As a letter of challenge from Kusanagi Naoya!"

strings.text: 「何故、今の発言が挑戦になる？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why does what I just said count as a challenge?"

strings.text: 「夏目家ではだな。俺以外はまともに料理を作れる人間がいないんだぞ！　えっへん！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "At the Natsume house, no one except me can cook worth a damn! Ta-da!"

strings.text: 「……そうなのか？　藍とか料理得意じゃないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Really? Isn't Ai good at cooking or something?"

strings.text: 「地獄だぞ。姉貴の料理は」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's hell. My sister's cooking is."

strings.text: 「なぜ？　あいつ先生だろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why? She's a teacher, isn't she?"

strings.text: 「なんで先生だと料理が出来なきゃいけないんだ？
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why would being a teacher mean you have to be able to cook?

strings.text: 先生だって料理が出来ない人間はいるぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: There are teachers who can't cook too, you know."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、そうなんだけど……それでも料理ぐらい出来そうなものだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, well, that's true, but... still, you'd think she could at least cook..."

strings.text: 「夏目家の女子たるもの厨房に立たず！　が暗黙のルールだぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "The women of the Natsume house shall not stand in the kitchen! That's our unspoken rule!"

strings.text: 「なんだ？　その暗黙のルールは」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What? What kind of unspoken rule is that?"

strings.text: 「くくく、料理すると死ぬという意味だぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Heheheh, it means if they cook, they die!"

strings.text: 「いや、そんな事で凄まれてもなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, don't get all intense with me about that."

strings.text: 「そんな事よりさっきの挑戦状の事だぞ！　直哉！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Never mind that, back to that letter of challenge from before! Naoya!"

strings.text: 「まだその話をひっぱるのかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're still going on about that?"

strings.text: 「これから勝負だ！　とりあえず料理を作るからスーパーに行くぞ。貴様に俺のショウガ焼きを食わせてやる」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's a duel from now on! Anyway, I'll cook, so we're going to the supermarket. I'll make you eat my ginger pork."

strings.text: 「食わねぇよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I won't eat it."

strings.text: 「うわん！　いきなり否定か？！　なぜ食わないとかひどい事を言う？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Whaaa?! You're refusing right out of the gate?! Why would you say something so awful, like you won't eat?"

strings.text: 「お前はちゃんと人の話を聞いているのか？　だから俺は今し方、牛丼の大盛りを食ったんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Are you actually listening to what I say? I just told you, I ate a large beef bowl a little while ago."

strings.text: 「そんなもの食うな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Don't eat that!"

strings.text: 「いや、食うだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I'm gonna eat it."

strings.text: 「直哉は俺のショウガ焼きを食べるんだ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya, you're gonna eat my ginger pork!"

strings.text: 「なんで？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why?"

strings.text: 「だからさぁ。腹がいっぱいだって言ってるだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Like I said. I told you I'm full, didn't I?"

strings.text: 「ならいつお腹がいっぱいじゃなくなる？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Then when will you not be full?"

strings.text: 「知らん……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How should I know..."

strings.text: 「知らんじゃないだろ！　お前は自分のお腹タイマーの具合ぐらい自分の身体にお伺い出来ないのか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Don't 'how should I know' me! Can't you even consult your own body about the state of your stomach timer?"

strings.text: 「お伺い出来ん！　んじゃな！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I can't consult it! Later!"

strings.text: 「待って！　なら今夜はどうだ？　夜ならお腹が空くはずだ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wait! Then how about tonight? You've gotta be hungry by nighttime."

strings.text: 「空くかもしれんが……、空いたとしても貴様のショウガ焼きなど食わない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I might be, but... even if I am, I'm not eating your ginger pork."

strings.text: 「かー、なんだこの男は話が通じないなぁ！　お前は黙って食えばいいんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Gah, what is with this guy, you can't reason with him! Just shut up and eat!"

strings.text: 「なんでそうなるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How does that follow?"

strings.text: 「だいたいな。直哉の料理なんて素材の原型をとどめないひどいものばかりだ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Anyway. Your cooking, Naoya, is all these awful things where the original form of the ingredients is nowhere to be found."

strings.text: 「あの粘土みたいな見た目の……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That stuff that looks like clay..."

strings.text: 「粘土って……お前、それ鳥レバーのパテの事か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Clay... you mean the chicken liver pate?"

strings.text: 「あんな得体の知れないものばかり作りやがって！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You're always making stuff that's so unidentifiable!"

strings.text: 「得体が知れないって……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Unidentifiable...

strings.text: 俺が作ったそのパテをパンの耳につけてうまいうまい言って食ってただろうが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Weren't you the one going 'delicious, delicious' while eating the pate I made on top of bread crusts...?"

strings.text: 「うん！　おいしかったぞ！　パンの耳が揚げてあるのがミソだな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah! It was delicious! The trick was that the bread crusts were fried!"

strings.text: 「はぁ、そうですか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh, is that so..."

strings.text: 「でもな、直哉。あんな素材を生かさない料理ばかり作っていい気になるなよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But listen, Naoya. Don't get all smug making dishes that don't bring out the ingredients."

strings.text: 「なぜ、あの料理が素材を生かせてない事になる……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How does that dish not bring out the ingredients..."

strings.text: 「俺のショウガ焼きは、見た目からして肉だぞ！　お前の料理は何がなんだかわからないぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "My ginger pork looks like meat from a glance! Your cooking, you can't tell what anything is!"

strings.text: 「パン耳のガーリックラスクは見たまんまな気がするが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The garlic rusks from bread crusts look exactly like what they are, though..."

strings.text: 「あ、あれってガーリック味なんだな。すごく旨かったぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Oh, so those were garlic-flavored. They were super tasty."

strings.text: その程度の事すら分からないヤツに、なんでこんな難癖つけられなければならないんだ……。
strings.translated: Why do I have to put up with pointless nitpicking from a guy who can't even figure out that much...

strings.text: 「という事で今夜は料理対決だぞ直哉！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "So anyway, tonight we're having a cooking showdown, Naoya!"

strings.text: 「どういう事でそうなる？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How does that follow?"

strings.text: 「俺な直哉。あれが食べたいぞ。この前作ってくれた分厚いピザ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Hey, Naoya. I wanna eat that. That thick pizza you made the other day!"

strings.text: 「ああパン耳お好み焼きか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, the bread crust okonomiyaki..."

strings.text: 「え？　あれお好み焼きだったの？　俺はピザだと思ってたぞ？
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? That was okonomiyaki? I thought it was pizza.

strings.text: というかそれ以前にあれってパンの耳で作ってたのか？　全然気がつかなかったぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: Or rather, before that, you made it with bread crusts? I didn't notice at all."

strings.text: 「あれはどっちでもいける様に出来てるんだよ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's designed to go either way.

strings.text: ソースとマヨネーズをかけるとお好み焼きになるが、とろけるチーズとトマトソースをかけるとピザ風になる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Put sauce and mayo on it and it's okonomiyaki, but put melted cheese and tomato sauce on it and it becomes pizza-style."

strings.text: 「へぇ……パンの耳でそんな事出来るんだ……しかも一種類でピザ風とお好み焼き風になるとは……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Hmm... you can do that with bread crusts... and one dish can become both pizza-style and okonomiyaki-style..."

strings.text: 「いつも同じ具材を使ってるんだから、少しでも違う味にしたい。あれは一つの品でソースを変えただけで違う料理を楽しめる。生活の知恵という感じだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Since I always use the same ingredients, I want to make the flavor different somehow. That one lets you enjoy different dishes just by changing the sauce on a single item. Life wisdom, I guess."

strings.text: 「パンの耳だけでそんなにいろいろ作れるなんて……。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That you can make so many things just with bread crusts...

strings.text: 何かすげぇんだかすごくないんだか分からないな。直哉の料理って」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: I can't tell if your cooking is amazing or not amazing, Naoya."

strings.text: 「うるせぇなぁ。二度と食わせねぇぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shut up. I'm never letting you eat it again."

strings.text: 「うそ、うそ、すごい。すごいぞ。直哉の料理はすごいんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Lie, lie, it's amazing. It's amazing. Naoya's cooking is amazing."

strings.text:
適当なフォロー。
どこの世界にそんなので機嫌直すヤツがいるんだよ。
strings.translated:
A half-assed follow-up.
What kind of world has anyone whose mood improves from that?

strings.text: 「んじゃ、とりあえずおれは今日の夜７時に貴様の家におじゃまするからな。覚悟しろよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Anyway, for now I'll be intruding on your house tonight at 7. Prepare yourself."

strings.text: 「家には入れねぇよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not letting you in."

strings.text: 「ははは。怖じ気づいたか直哉？　でももう遅いぞ！　俺のショウガ焼きを食らわせてやるぜ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Hahaha. Chickening out, Naoya? But it's too late now! I'm gonna serve you my ginger pork!"

strings.text: 「食らわせるって、お前なぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Serve me,' you say..."

strings.text: 「んじゃな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Later!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey, wait..."

strings.text: 圭は俺の反応などまったくお構いなし、その場から走り出す。
strings.translated: Ignoring my reaction entirely, Kei took off running.

strings.text: 「今夜、来ても家なんか入れないからな！　おい！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even if you come tonight, I'm not letting you in! Hey!"

strings.text: 「直哉の料理楽しみにしているぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I'm looking forward to your cooking, Naoya!"

strings.text: 「はぁ……なんであいつのために料理作らなきゃいけないんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sigh... why do I have to cook for that guy..."

strings.text: 「作るわけねぇだろ。馬鹿馬鹿しい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No way I'm cooking. Ridiculous..."

strings.text: 「ふぅ、油モノも久しぶりだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Phew, been a while since I fried anything..."

strings.text: 俺は揚げ物をしている。
strings.translated: I'm deep-frying something.

strings.text: とんかつだ。
strings.translated: Tonkatsu.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There we go..."

strings.text: 出来上がったものに包丁を入れる。
strings.translated: I put a knife to the finished piece.

strings.text: まぁ、中が生でも問題ではないとんかつなのだけど、どうも揚げ物すると最初の一個には包丁を入れて火の通りを見てしまう。
strings.translated: Well, it's tonkatsu, so it wouldn't be a problem even if the inside were raw, but somehow whenever I fry something, I always cut into the first piece to check that it's cooked through.

strings.text: 「……ふむ、なかなかのとんかつだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Hmm, a pretty decent tonkatsu."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Next..."

strings.text: 「ああ、うるせぇ……今開ける……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, shut up... I'm opening it now..."

strings.text: 「おお！　いい匂いだなぁ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ohh! It smells great!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 「ちゃんと作ってくれたんだな！　俺のために！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You properly made it! For me!"

strings.text: 「なんでお前のために作った事になる……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How does it end up being for you..."

strings.text: 「はい、はい、わかった。わかった。さぁて、んじゃ食べるぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yes, yes, got it, got it. Well then, let's eat."

strings.text: 「はぁ？　お前？　ショウガ焼き作るんじゃないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? You? Weren't you making ginger pork?"

strings.text: 「ああ、あれ？　豚肉売ってなかったんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ah, that? They weren't selling pork."

strings.text: 「んなもん売ってないわけないだろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's no way they weren't selling it!"

strings.text: 「不景気だからかなぁ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Maybe it's because of the recession?"

strings.text: 「なんで不景気だと豚肉が買えなくなるんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why would a recession make it so you can't buy pork?"

strings.text: 「ほら、いろいろあるだろ、インフラとかイソフラボンとかさ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You know, there's all sorts of stuff, like infrastructure and isoflavones..."

strings.text: 「インフレと言いたいのか？　このデフレなご時世に……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You mean inflation? In this deflationary age..."

strings.text: 「それ！　インフレ！　インフレで不景気で豚肉はお休みだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That! Inflation! Because of inflation and the recession, pork is on break."

strings.text: 「つまり、忘れていたというわけか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In other words, you forgot..."

strings.text: 「そういう事になるのかな？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I guess that's how it turns out?"

strings.text: 「そういう事になるのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's how it turns out, huh..."

strings.text: 「うん！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah!"

strings.text: 「痛いっっ、直哉が殴ったぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ow! Naoya hit me!"

strings.text: 「殴るわ！　殴りもするわ！　この野郎！　俺だけこんな手間かかる料理作らせておいてだな！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Of course I'll hit you! I'll hit you good! You bastard! You made me go to all this trouble cooking on my own!"

strings.text: 「え？　やっぱり俺のために作ってくれたの？
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? So you really did make it for me?

strings.text: あ、これか！　これとんかつだな？
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: Ah, is this it! This is tonkatsu, right?

strings.text: あ、そうか、俺のショウガ焼きと勝負だから豚料理のとんかつなんだな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: Ah, I see, since it's a competition with my ginger pork, you made the pork dish tonkatsu!"

strings.text: 「ち、違げぇよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-that's not it!"

strings.text: 「とりあえず作ってくれたんだな！　お前は本当にイイやつだな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Anyway, you made it for me! You really are a good guy!"

strings.text: 「な、何を満面の笑みで……このバカは」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what's with that beaming smile... this idiot."

strings.text: 「あうぅぅ……何を手伝えばいいんだ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Uuh... what should I help with..."

strings.text: 「とりあえず冷蔵庫からウィンナーとにんじんときゃべつを取り出せ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For starters, take the sausages and carrots and cabbage out of the fridge."

strings.text: 「暴力反対なんだからな……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I oppose violence, you know..."
