strings.translated: "I get it. That's an amazing stroke of luck, super convenient."

strings.text: 「なんでだよ！　鴨大ピンチだろ！　すげぇ危険だろ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why?! The duck's in huge trouble! It's incredibly dangerous!"

strings.text: そりゃ鴨にとってはそうかもしれんが……普通「鴨葱」って言ったら大変好都合という意味だろうが……。
strings.translated: Well, from the duck's perspective, sure... but normally, "duck-and-leek" means it's incredibly convenient...

strings.text: 「だったら鴨が葱しょって行進するぐらいって言えばどれだけ危険か分かるか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Then how about a duck marching along with a leek on its back -- get how dangerous that is?"

strings.text: 「かわいいじゃねぇかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That sounds cute."

strings.text: 「かわいくねぇよ！　行進だぞ！　鴨葱の行進だ！　鴨の命が行進レベルで危険にさらされてるんだぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's not cute! It's marching! The march of duck-and-leek! The duck's life is in march-level danger!"

strings.text: どんな状況だよ。
strings.translated: What kind of situation is that.

strings.text: 「ああ、なんか分からんが、とりあえずお前が動揺しているのは分かった。なら、妹さんはどうなんだ？　料理の腕？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I don't quite get it, but at any rate, I understand you're rattled. So what about your sister? How's her cooking?"

strings.text: 俺の放ったその一言で――圭の背中がピンと張り詰める。
strings.translated: At those single words of mine -- Kei's back went stiff as a board.

strings.text: 「あいつは……もっとすごい……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "She's... even worse..."

strings.text: 「いや、おみそ汁にマヨネーズよりすごい事はないだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No way, nothing's worse than mayonnaise in miso soup..."

strings.text: 「いや、桁違いだ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "No, she's on a whole different order..."

strings.text: 「この前も、雫が作った煮込みうどんを食べたんだが……その日の夜は、夏目家の便所は朝まで乗車率５３００００％でな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Just the other day, I ate some simmered udon Shizuku made... and that night, the ridership rate for the Natsume-family toilet was five hundred thirty thousand percent till morning."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Five hundred thirty thousand..."

strings.text: まずそんな数値で“％”という単位ではあり得ないが……そんな事よりも……。
strings.translated: First off, a number like that isn't possible with a unit like "percent"... but more importantly...

strings.text: 「５３万って、そりゃ最終形態じゃねぇかよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Five hundred thirty thousand -- that's the final form..."

strings.text: 「そうなんだよ！　雫の料理は最終形態なんだよ！　危険すぎるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Right?! Shizuku's cooking is the final form! It's too dangerous!"

strings.text: 「なるほど……フリーザーの一人称が『わたし』や『わたくし』から『ボク』に変わるぐらいすごいという事だな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see... so it's as amazing as when Frieza's first-person pronoun shifts from 'watashi' or 'watakushi' to 'boku'..."

strings.text: 「なんで冷凍室の話になるんだよ？　意味わかんねぇなぁ、お前茶化してる場合じゃないんだぞ。まじめに考えろよ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why're you talking about freezers now? That makes no sense -- this isn't the time to be joking around, y'know. Think about it seriously..."

strings.text: なるほど……。
strings.translated: I see...

strings.text:
自らのボケをボケ返しされた事実すら気がつかないでいる。
こいつは相当深刻な事態だ……。
strings.translated:
He didn't even notice his own gag getting turned back on him.
This guy is in a seriously dire state...

strings.text: 「だいたいの事は分かった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I've got the gist of it."

strings.text: 「要は、地球がピンチなわけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Basically, the Earth is in danger."

strings.text: 「だから、あの二人が料理を作るのを阻止したいというわけなのだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So what you want is to stop those two from cooking."

strings.text: 「な、なんだ、ちゃんと理解してるじゃん。お前は察しがいいな……そうなんだよ。その通りなんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Y-yeah, you get it! You catch on quick... That's it. That's exactly it..."

strings.text: 「どんな察しの悪いヤツだってそのぐらいは分かるとは思うが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I think anyone would get that much, no matter how slow they were."

strings.text: 「それはそうと料理の件だが俺に考えがある」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyway, about the food -- I've got an idea."

strings.text: 「この場合は歓迎されるのは俺なわけだよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In this case, I'm the one being welcomed, right?"

strings.text: 「そうだけど、どういう事？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Right, but what do you mean?"

strings.text: 「まぁ聞け、俺が歓迎を受けるわけなのだが、そのお返しに俺が料理を作るというのは成り立つよな？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, hear me out. I'm the one being welcomed, so it makes sense for me to make the food in return, doesn't it?"

strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "? ? Meaning?"

strings.text: 「だからな、大義さえ立てば、藍が戻る前に俺が料理を作っちまえば問題ないという事だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As long as I've got the justification, if I finish making the food before Ai gets back, there's no problem."

strings.text: 「え？　やってくれるの？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? You'll actually do it?"

strings.text: 「どうだろうなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I wonder..."

strings.text: 「誰かに言われたのだけど、俺の料理は原型が分からない軟弱な料理らしいからなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Someone told me my cooking is spineless food that doesn't retain its original form, y'know..."

strings.text: 「だ、誰だそんなひどい事言うやつは！　直哉の料理は最高なんだぞ！　すげぇ侠気あふれる男の料理なんだからな！　文句があるやつは俺の<r おとこ>漢</r>の<r こぶし>拳</r>でぐりぐりだ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wh-who said something that horrible?! Naoya's cooking is the best! It's a manly, chivalrous man's dish overflowing with spirit! Anyone with complaints gets a grinding from my manly fist!"

strings.text: 「痛い、痛い、ごめんよ。ぐりぐりしないで……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ow, ow, sorry. Please don't grind..."

strings.text: 「でもな姉貴。歓迎会とかそんな洒落た事やるこたぁー無いだろーって直哉が……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But sis, Naoya was saying we don't need to do something so fancy as a welcome party..."

strings.text: 「ばかっ、今日は家族が一人増える日だぞ。皆が自覚するためにもな、歓迎会はやったほうがいいに決まっているだろう」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Idiot, today's the day our family gains one more member. If only so everyone recognizes it, of course a welcome party's better."

strings.text: 「でも手作り料理って……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But homemade food is..."

strings.text: 「お前はわかっていないぞ！　こういう時は真心優先で手作り料理って相場が決まっている！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You don't get it! At times like this, homemade food from the heart is the rule!"

strings.text: 「そんな、新婚初日みたいなこと言われても」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Please don't say things like it's our first day as newlyweds."

strings.text: 「く、草薙！　新婚初日とか言うな！　だ、だいたいあれだぞ。夏目家の料理の半分は、思いやりで出来ているんだぞ！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "K-Kusanagi! Don't say newlyweds! A-anyway, listen. Half of Natsume-family cooking is made from consideration!"

strings.text: 優しさ半分……。
strings.translated: Half of it, kindness...

strings.text: 残りは、圭の言うところの５３００００％の何かで出来ているのだろうか……。
strings.translated: And the rest is made from whatever it is that Kei called five hundred thirty thousand percent...?

strings.text: 「わかった、わかりました。歓迎会を開くのは俺たちだとしても直哉は何も出来ないじゃん」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Fine, fine. Even if we're the ones throwing the welcome party, Naoya can't do anything about it."

strings.text: 「なぜ直哉が何かしなければならない？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Why does Naoya have to do anything?"

strings.text: 「えっと……あのだな。あれだ、あれだぞっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Um... so, y'know. That's it, that's it!"

strings.text: 圭は俺の方に目で助けを求める。すでにいっぱいいっぱいの表情だ。
strings.translated: Kei's eyes plead with me for help. His expression is already at its limit.

strings.text: このバカ、もう説得しきれずに頭の中がぐちゃぐちゃなのだろう。
strings.translated: This idiot must have run out of arguments -- his head's a total mess now.

strings.text: 「藍、今日は俺にご飯作らせてくれないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ai, would you let me cook tonight?"

strings.text: 「はぁ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「いや、これから当分お世話になるわけだし、料理は俺が作りたいと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I mean, I'm going to be relying on you for a while, so I'd like to cook..."

strings.text: 「ダメだダメだ。今日は草薙が主賓なのだからな。それに元々は圭のせいでこうなったのだろ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "No, no way. You're the guest of honor tonight, Kusanagi. And this whole situation is Kei's fault to begin with, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、そうなんだけど……たまにはどうかな？　教え子が作ったものを食べるというのも良いぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, that's true, but... once in a while, wouldn't it be nice? Eating something a student of yours cooked isn't so bad."

strings.text: 「生徒が先生のために作りたいと言っているのだから、聞いてみてもいいんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A student's saying he wants to cook for his teacher -- couldn't you hear him out?"

strings.text: 「う、うむ……。そう言われてしまうと……反論しづらいじゃないか……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ngh, well... when you put it like that... it's hard to argue back..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、とはいってもすでに料理の仕込みはほぼ終わらせてしまっていてな。あとは調理を終わらせるだけなんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And besides, I've already got most of the prep done. All that's left is the actual cooking."

strings.text: 「って、お前いつの間に？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Wait, when did you --?"

strings.text: 「藍が買い物行っている間に少しだけ、台所を使わせてもらっていた。俺の家と違って食材がたくさんあったので、かなり楽しかったぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "While Ai was out shopping, I used the kitchen for a bit. Unlike at my place, there were tons of ingredients here, so it was pretty fun."

strings.text: 「うむ、仕込みが終わっているというのなら何も言えないではないか」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, if the prep's already done, I can't really object."

strings.text: 「そういう事で、今日は俺に作らせてくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So it's settled -- let me handle it tonight."

strings.text: 「そうだな！　俺もそれがいいと思うぞ！　直哉の料理は最高に男らしい侠気料理だからなぁ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's it! I think that's a great idea too! Naoya's cooking is the manliest, most chivalrous cooking there is!"

strings.text: 「むぅ、なんか策略的なものも感じるが……。まぁ、ここは草薙に甘えるか……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hmm, I sense something scheming here... Well, fine, I'll let Kusanagi have his way this once..."

strings.text: 「甘えてくれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Please do..."

strings.text: 「……ただいま」
strings.translated: "...I'm home."

strings.text: 玄関の方から聞こえる、帰宅を知らせる声。
strings.translated: From the entryway came the voice announcing a homecoming.

strings.text: 決して高い声量ではなかったが、その音はとても良く通るものであった。
strings.translated: It wasn't loud by any means, but the sound carried remarkably well.

strings.text: 「お、ホームドラマのようなナイスなタイミングで帰ってきたぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Oh, she's back with sitcom-perfect timing."

strings.text: 「草薙にも紹介しようじゃないか……。しずくー、ちょっと台所まで来てくれるか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Let's introduce her to Kusanagi... Shizuku, could you come to the kitchen for a minute?"

strings.text: 生徒を職員室に呼び出すような口調で、藍先生が声を上げる。
strings.translated: In the tone of a teacher calling a student to the staff room, Ai-sensei raised her voice.

strings.text: その声に応えるように、廊下からぱたぱたとスリッパの音が鳴る。
strings.translated: As if answering, the pit-pat of slippers came from the hallway.

strings.text: そして、足音は居間の入り口で、ぴたと止んだ。
strings.translated: And the footsteps came to a sudden halt at the living room's entrance.

strings.text: 「こいつが草薙直哉だ。俺の一番の親友で、将来は世界を二分化して争うライバルなんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "This is Kusanagi Naoya. My best friend, and my future rival in dividing the world in two."

strings.text: ったく、妄想に頭を支配されたまま人を紹介するのは勘弁して貰いたい、などと思いつつ、俺は居間の入り口に立っている夏目家の次女へと顔を向ける。
strings.translated: Geez -- I wish he wouldn't introduce people while his head is still ruled by delusions -- and thinking that, I turned my face toward the Natsume family's second daughter, standing in the living room's doorway.

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「え、えっと、その、あれだな！　えっとっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "U-um, that is, uh, yeah! Um --"

strings.text: 「初めまして、夏目雫です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Nice to meet you. I'm Natsume Shizuku."

strings.text: 「えっと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 「あなたは誰ですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Who are you?"

strings.text: はじめて会った時にごく自然に発せられる言葉。
strings.translated: The words that come out perfectly naturally at a first meeting.

strings.text: 「お、俺か、そ、そうだよな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "M-me? R-right, of course.

strings.text: あれだ、俺の名前は草薙直哉だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: So, my name is Kusanagi Naoya."

strings.text: 「あ、あなたが？　草薙直哉！？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Y-you are? Kusanagi Naoya?!"

strings.text: 「え？　ああ、そうだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Yeah, that's right, but..."

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Who?"

strings.text: 「お前ら、ちゃんと説明しているのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You guys, are you actually explaining anything?"

strings.text: 「えっと……雫、嫌だなぁ……。ほら、草薙直哉だよ。いつも話してたじゃん。今日から一緒に住む事になってた」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Um... Shizuku, c'mon, don't be like that. It's Kusanagi Naoya. I've been telling you about him. He's supposed to be living with us from today."

strings.text: 「今日から！？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "From today?!"

strings.text: 「妹さんが大層驚いているぞ。本当に話したのか？　俺がここに住む事を」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Your little sister looks pretty shocked. Did you actually tell her? That I was going to be living here?"

strings.text: 「ふぅ。あのな、雫、お前の冗談は分かりづらいからあまり面識のない人間にやらない方がいいぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sigh. Listen, Shizuku, your jokes are hard to catch, so you shouldn't try them on people you barely know."

strings.text: 「はい、ごめんなさい今のは冗談……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, I'm sorry, that just now was a joke..."

strings.text: 「あ、あははは……、こういうひょうきんな妹なんだよ雫はさ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "A-ahaha... Shizuku's a comical little sister like that."

strings.text: ひょうきん……いつの言葉だ……。
strings.translated: Comical... what era is that word from...

strings.text: 「それで？　妹さんは俺がここに来ることは？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So? Does your sister know I'm coming to stay here?"

strings.text: 「もちろん知っています。だから草薙さんの事は少しだけ知ってます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Of course I know. So I know a little bit about Kusanagi-san."

strings.text: 「少しだけか……、まぁそうだよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just a little bit, huh... well, that figures."

strings.text: 「草薙直哉……身長１８１センチ、体重６９キロ……弓張学園３年……現代文７５点古文５０点英語８０点……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Naoya... height 181 centimeters, weight 69 kilos... third-year at Yumihari Academy... 75 in modern Japanese, 50 in classical, 80 in English..."

strings.text: 「な！　なんでそんな事知っている！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wha--! How do you know all that?!"

strings.text: 「冗談じゃなくて！　全部合っている件について尋ねたいのだが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "All joking aside! How the hell did you get every single one of those right?!"

strings.text: 「あ、あははは……。なぁ、こういうひょうきんな妹なんだよ雫はさ。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "A-ahaha... See, Shizuku's a comical little sister like this.

strings.text: どうだ？　美人だろ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: What do you think? A real beauty, right?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだなぁ。本当にお前らは美人姉妹だな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, sure. You really are a pair of beautiful sisters..."

strings.text: 「直哉……。そんな嫌味ばかり言うと近いうちに俺は泣くぞ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya... if you keep saying snide stuff like that, I'm gonna start crying pretty soon..."

strings.text: 「改めまして夏目雫です。初めまして。いつも草薙さんの事は兄や姉から聞いてます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Let me introduce myself again. I'm Natsume Shizuku. Nice to meet you. I always hear about you from my brother and sister."

strings.text: 「ああ、改めて、俺は草薙直哉。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, let me do the same. I'm Kusanagi Naoya.

strings.text: 今日からこの家に世話になる。ええと、名前は……、
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I'll be imposing on this house starting today. Um, about the name...

strings.text: 雫さんと呼んだ方がいいのかな？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: should I call you Shizuku-san?"

strings.text: 「雫、でいいです。それでは、ごゆっくりしていってください」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Shizuku is fine. Well then, please make yourself at home."

strings.text: 「いや、ごゆっくりというか。これからここにお世話になるんだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, well, 'make myself at home,' but... I'll be imposing on you from here on out..."

strings.text: 「これから！？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "From here on?!"

strings.text: 「それも冗談……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Another joke..."

strings.text: 「だいぶ冗談を言って互いにうち解けた様な気がしてきました。今後ともよろしくお願いします」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I feel like we've broken the ice through all these jokes with each other. I look forward to your company from now on."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

strings.text: 雫は一礼すると、足音をさせずに居間から出て行こうとする。
strings.translated: Shizuku gave a small bow and made to leave the living room without making a footstep.

strings.text: 「ああっ、雫、ちょい待ち。今日の夜は草薙の歓迎会やるから」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, Shizuku, hold on a sec. Tonight we're throwing a welcome party for Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「何か手伝うことは？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Is there anything I can help with?"

strings.text: 「いや、無いぞ！　しなくていいぞ！　なんだか直哉が全部やりたいというからな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Nope, nothing! You don't need to! Somehow Naoya says he wants to do it all!"

strings.text: 「草薙さんは料理がお上手なのですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-san, are you good at cooking?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、出来るというぐらいかな？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, 'good' might be a stretch -- I can manage?"

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事ないぞ、料理に関しては、直哉が包丁をふるえば街が大騒ぎになるぐらいの名人なんだぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "T-that's not true, when it comes to cooking, Naoya's such a master that if he swings a kitchen knife the whole town goes into an uproar!"

strings.text: それまったく違う意味にしか聞こえん。
strings.translated: That sounds like it can only be taken in an entirely different sense.

strings.text: 「それより、雫。お前も俺の事をさん付けしなくていいよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyway, Shizuku. You don't need to attach '-san' to my name either."

strings.text: 「そうですね。直哉がそう言うのなら、直哉に戻します」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "All right. If Naoya says so, then I'll go back to just 'Naoya.'"

strings.text: 「ああ、それでいい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that works."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、今日は俺が全部やるから、雫は料理が出来たら降りてきてくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For now, I'll handle everything tonight, so Shizuku, come down once the food's ready."

strings.text: 「分かりました。料理が出来たら教えてください。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Understood. Please let me know when the food's ready.

strings.text: 私はとても楽しみにしてます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: I'm really looking forward to it."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな。とびっきり旨いものを食わせてやるさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, sure. I'll feed you something incredibly delicious."

strings.text: 「じー」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Staaare..."

strings.text: 「な、なんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-what?"

strings.text: 「直哉、楽しみにしている。ちょーがんばってください」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Naoya, I'm looking forward to it. Please do your super best."

strings.text: 「ああ、まかせておけ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, leave it to me."

strings.text: 雫はそれだけ言うと、楚々とした足取りで、居間を退出していった。
strings.translated: With just that, Shizuku left the living room with graceful, restrained steps.

strings.text: 「なんだか、直哉は雫の扱い慣れているなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Somehow, Naoya, you're already used to handling Shizuku, huh."

strings.text: 「そんな事ないさ。初対面だしさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Not really. We just met for the first time."

strings.text: 「そうか？　俺なんか最初、雫の反応が良く分からなくて、結構戸惑ったぞ。それに比べたら適応が早いなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You think? At first I couldn't quite read Shizuku's reactions and got pretty flustered. Compared to me, you adapted fast."

strings.text: 「そりゃ、お前みたいな珍獣の相手をしていれば、誰に対しても問題ない対応能力もそなわるわな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, dealing with a rare beast like you would give anyone the coping skills to handle anybody, wouldn't it?"

strings.text: 「なんだと！　俺は珍獣じゃないっっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What did you say?! I'm not a rare beast!"

strings.text: 「まぁ、まぁ、いいではないか。とりあえず、パーティーの用意だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Now, now, come on. First, let's get the party ready."

strings.text: 「料理も揃ったことだし、草薙の歓迎会、始めるとするか」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The food's all set, so shall we start Kusanagi's welcome party?"

strings.text: 「イヤッハァ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yahoo!"

strings.text: 「はい、はい。うるさいから奇声をあげるな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "All right, all right. Don't yell weird noises, it's loud."

strings.text: 「なんだよ。せっかく歓迎を奇声で表現したのに」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Aw, come on. I finally expressed my welcome through a weird cry."

strings.text: お前は原始人かよ。
strings.translated: What are you, a caveman?

strings.text: 日没と同時に俺の引越しもほぼ片付き、藍の予告どおり、その日の晩餐はなんとか歓迎会の体を成す宴となった。
strings.translated: By sunset my move was more or less settled, and just as Ai had foretold, that evening's dinner managed to shape itself into something resembling a welcome party.

strings.text: 「いっただきまー！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Itadakima--!"

strings.text: ちゃぶ台の上には、突貫ながら俺が思いつくかぎりの料理が並べられている。
strings.translated: Lined up on the low table were as many dishes as I could think up on short notice.

strings.text: まぁ自分的には、一応は豪奢な盛り付けに見えるといっていい……と思われる。
strings.translated: Well, to me, at least, the spread could pass as lavish... I think.

strings.text: 頑張った甲斐はあったというものか……。
strings.translated: I guess my effort paid off...

strings.text: 口の中でフォークからチキンが切り離され、舌の上をまろやかに滑る。そして、顎を動かすたびに、口内に広がっていくスパイシーな肉汁――。
strings.translated: Inside my mouth the chicken parts from the fork and slides smoothly across my tongue. And with each movement of my jaw, spicy juices spread through my mouth --

strings.text: 鳥の半身の素揚げなど滅多に作るものではなかったが、想像どおりの味。予想と違わぬ味で仕上がっている。
strings.translated: Deep-fried half-chicken isn't something I make often, but it turned out just as I'd hoped -- right on the mark.

strings.text: 「おおぉ、草薙は料理の腕もたいしたものなのだなぁ。これは普通に驚いたぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ooh, Kusanagi, your cooking skills are impressive too. This really surprised me."

strings.text: 「まぁな。俺のライバルだからな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, of course. He's my rival, after all."

strings.text: 「本当にほとんど作らせてしまって申し訳なかったな。草薙」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I really am sorry for making you do almost all of it, Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「いや、料理は好きなので問題ない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I like cooking, so it's fine."

strings.text: 「それにしてもおいしいだろ直哉の作ったご飯は。そうだ直哉これはなんだ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Anyway, isn't Naoya's cooking delicious? Oh, Naoya, what's this?"

strings.text: 「パテだ。鶏レバのな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's pate. Chicken liver."

strings.text: 「おお！　パテだ！　直哉の十八番だ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ooh! Pate! Naoya's signature dish!"

strings.text: 「こっちはなんだ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "And what's this one?"

strings.text: 「リゾットだ。海鮮的な海賊的な何かそういうやつ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Risotto. Something seafood-ish, pirate-ish, that kind of thing."

strings.text: 「本当においしいなぁ。お前、絵だけじゃなくてこんな特技まで、本当になんでも出来るのだなぁ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "This really is delicious. Not just painting, but even skills like this -- you really can do anything, huh."

strings.text: 「いや、そんな大層なもんじゃない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it's nothing so grand.

strings.text: どの料理もネットで調べたレシピだ。ほとんど独学の創作料理みたいなもんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Every one of these is a recipe I looked up online. It's basically all self-taught improvised cooking."

strings.text: 「独学でこれだけ作れるのがすごいではないか」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Being able to make this much self-taught is impressive on its own."

strings.text: 「誰だって長く自炊していればこれぐらい出来る様になるさ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyone who cooks for themselves long enough gets to about this level.

strings.text: 必要となれば人は何でも覚えるもんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: When people need something, they'll learn anything."

strings.text: 「必要となればかぁ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "When people need something, huh."

strings.text: 「姉貴、直哉に料理習ったほうがいいんじゃないのか？　こいつは本物だぜ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Sis, shouldn't you learn cooking from Naoya? This guy's the real deal!"

strings.text: 「うるさい。と言いたいところだが。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "'Quiet, you,' is what I'd like to say, but...

strings.text: 今度、暇な時にでも教えてもらおうかな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: maybe I'll ask him to teach me sometime when I'm free..."

strings.text: 「そんな大層なものでもないけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really, it's nothing so impressive."

strings.text: と、口では言いつつも、本当に美味しそうに料理を口に運ぶ夏目家の面々を見ると、まんざら悪い気もしない。
strings.translated: But saying that with my mouth aside, watching the Natsume family carry the food to their mouths as if they truly found it delicious didn't feel half bad.

strings.text: まぁしかし、俺の腕程度の料理をこんなに喜んで食べてくれるというのは、夏目家の人々、よほど困窮した食卓事情を抱えていたともいえる。
strings.translated: Well, still -- if cooking of only my level makes them this happy, then the Natsume household must have had a pretty grim food situation until now.

strings.text: ご愁傷様だな、まったく……。
strings.translated: My condolences, really...

strings.text: ふと、視線を横にやると、雫もちゃんと食べていた。
strings.translated: When I glanced sideways, Shizuku was eating too, properly.

strings.text: 「し、雫……。どうだ？　味とか問題とか無いか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sh-Shizuku... how is it? Any problems with the taste?"

strings.text: 俺の声を受け、雫は手に持った箸の動きを止めると、長い<r まつげ>睫</r>に彩られた瞳を向ける。
strings.translated: Catching my voice, Shizuku halted the chopsticks in her hand and turned her long-lashed eyes toward me.

strings.text: もきゅもきゅと口を動かしながら、ぽろぽろと涙を流していた。
strings.translated: Her mouth was working in tiny chews, and tears were rolling down in fat drops.

strings.text: 「え？　泣く！？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? You're crying?!

strings.text: だ、だめだった？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: W-was it that bad?"

strings.text: 「おいしひぃ……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It'sh delicioushh..."

strings.text: 「そ、そっか……。良かった。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "O-oh... good.

strings.text: けど、何で泣くんだよ。驚くじゃないか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: But why are you crying? You scared me."

strings.text: 「だって……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Because..."

strings.text: 「それも冗談だったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Was that a joke too?"

strings.text: 「あはははは。雫はおいしいものを食べると泣く習性があるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahahaha. Shizuku has a habit of crying when she eats something delicious."

strings.text: 「習性かよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A habit?!"

strings.text: 「いや、たぶんだけどさ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, probably, anyway."

strings.text: 「適当言うなよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't just make things up..."

strings.text: 「うぐ……おいしい……おいしひ……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Ngh... deliciouss... delicioushh..."

strings.text: 無表情は変わることなく目からぽろぽろと涙を落としながら、雫は再び鶏肉を口に運ぶ。もきゅもきゅ、と、小さい口が可愛らしく動く。
strings.translated: Her expressionless face unchanged, tears kept spilling from her eyes as Shizuku brought another piece of chicken to her mouth. Her small mouth worked adorably in little chews.

strings.text: 「まぁ、気に入ってくれたみたいで良かったよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, glad you liked it."

strings.text: 「あははは。気むずかしい雫も直哉の事気に入った様だな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahahaha. Even the picky Shizuku seems to have taken a liking to you, Naoya."

strings.text: 「よかったなぁ。雫！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Great for you, Shizuku!"

strings.text: 「ひどいはたかれた！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ouch, she smacked me!"

strings.text: 「気むずかしい雫にお前が嫌われてどうする」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you doing getting hated by the picky Shizuku?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、どっちにしても喜んで食べてもらえるのはうれしいさ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, either way, it makes me happy that you're eating it and enjoying it.

strings.text: 俺は、人に食べてもらうために料理をするのが好きだからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I cook because I like cooking for other people to eat."

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 「てな事で約束は果たされたわけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And with that, my promise has been fulfilled."

strings.text: 「いやあ、今後の夏目家のメシ当番は、必然的に決まったって感じだなあオイ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, seems like the future meal-duty of the Natsume household has just been decided, hasn't it, hey!"

strings.text: 「ああ、ここにいる間はそうするつもりだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, as long as I'm staying here, that's my plan."

strings.text: 「あれ？　珍しく直哉が素直じゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? It's rare for Naoya to be so agreeable, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「ただ飯を食わせてもらうわけにもいかない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I can't just be fed for free.

strings.text: そのぐらいの事はした方が良いだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I should at least do this much."

strings.text: 「何を言っている。元々は圭がお前の家を水没させてしまったからであってだな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What are you saying. This started because Kei submerged your apartment in the first place."

strings.text: 「まぁ、そう長い間いるわけじゃない。料理ぐらい俺に作らせろ。ただし食材は用意してくれ。俺には金は無いからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I'm not going to be here for that long. At least let me handle the cooking. Just cover the groceries, though. I don't have any money."

strings.text: 「そうだよ、直哉もこう言ってるわけだしさぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That's right, Naoya's saying so himself, y'know."

strings.text: 「ふう……まったく、どうしても草薙に料理を作らせたいみたいだな……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sigh... honestly, you really want to have Kusanagi cook, don't you...

strings.text: 仕方ないなぁ。とりあえずはわかったそうしよう」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Fine. For now, understood, let's go with that."

strings.text: 「ならば、当分やっかいになる。圭……藍……そして雫」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then I'll be imposing on you for a while. Kei... Ai... and Shizuku."

strings.text: 「うん」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「うおおおおお！　盛り上がって参りました！　今日はあり得ないぐらい盛り上がります。もう壊滅的な盛り上がりでした」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Woooooo! The mood is rising! Today's excitement level is impossible. It's already a devastating level of excitement."

strings.text: 「はぁ……そうですか、うるさいからだまりなさい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sigh... is that so. You're loud, so shut it."

strings.text: 「うおおおおお！　これがだまってられるかー」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Woooooo! Like I could shut up now!"

strings.text: 「明日は何にするかな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What should I make tomorrow..."

strings.text: 明日の料理を考えながら入浴を済ませて自室に戻ると、時計の針は既に１１時を回っていた。
strings.translated: Turning tomorrow's menu over in my head, I finished my bath and returned to my room. The clock's hands had already passed eleven.

strings.text: 就寝するには少し早い時間であったが、今日は引越しで身体を酷使したこともあり、やんわりとした睡魔が身体を蝕みつつあるように感じた。
strings.translated: It was a little early to sleep, but I'd worked my body hard with the move today, and a gentle drowsiness was already creeping into me.

strings.text: ゆっくりと、俺は室内を見渡してみる。
strings.translated: Slowly, I looked around the room.

strings.text: 今日から、この部屋が生活の中心となるのだ。
strings.translated: From today on, this room would be the center of my life.

strings.text: 「いや、そんな長居をする気はない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I don't intend to stay that long..."

strings.text: マンションが直ればまた元の生活に戻る。
strings.translated: Once the apartment building is fixed, I'll go back to my old life.

strings.text: 俺は半渇きの髪をそのままにして、布団に大の字に寝転がる。
strings.translated: Leaving my half-dry hair as it was, I flopped onto the futon and sprawled out.

strings.text: 天井を見上げると複雑な木目が目に入る。そんな事にすら「環境の変化」を感じる。
strings.translated: Looking up at the ceiling, the complicated wood grain caught my eye. Even something like that made me feel the "change in environment."

strings.text: 昨日まで寝るときはかならず、無機質な白い天井が見えた。
strings.translated: Up until yesterday, whenever I went to sleep, what I saw was an inorganic white ceiling.

strings.text: 俺はやおら起き上がると、本棚に手を伸ばし……アルバムをゆっくり取り出した。
strings.translated: I quietly sat up, reached out to the bookshelf... and slowly took down an album.

strings.text: 「この写真の裏……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Behind this photo..."

strings.text: 俺は幼き頃に撮った御桜稟の写真をはがす。
strings.translated: I peel away a photo of Misakura Rin taken when we were small.

strings.text: 下から古びた封筒が出てくる。
strings.translated: From beneath, an old envelope emerges.

strings.text:
今、どうしていますか。
　　　　　何を、してますか。
strings.translated:
How are you now?
What are you doing?

strings.text: 手紙にはそうあった。
strings.translated: That's what the letter said.

strings.text: 「どうしてますか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How am I now..."

strings.text: 「この手紙を受け取った時、俺は何をしてたっけなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "When I received this letter, what was I doing again?"

strings.text: 今、稟とふたたび会う事があったとしたら……なんと言えばいいのだろう。
strings.translated: If I were to meet Rin again now... what on earth would I say?

strings.text: そういえば、そんな話を親父とした事があったな。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, I had a conversation like this with my old man once.

strings.text: ふたたび会う事だってあり得る。と……。
strings.translated: That we might meet again someday. That's what he said...

strings.text: だがおそらく「お久しぶり」の後に続く言葉は出てこないかもしれない。
strings.translated: But probably, after "It's been a while," no other words would come.

strings.text: それでも、もし彼女に再び会うとしたら――笑顔で迎えてやらなければならない。
strings.translated: Even so, if I were to meet her again -- I'd have to greet her with a smile.

strings.text: ごく普通に、自然に……。
strings.translated: Perfectly ordinary, perfectly natural...

strings.text: 出来るだろうか？
strings.translated: Could I manage that?

strings.text: 「どうしようもないな……俺は……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm hopeless... aren't I..."

strings.text: 右手を天井にかざす。
strings.translated: I hold my right hand up toward the ceiling.

strings.text: 「見た目は普通なんだけどな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It looks normal enough, though..."

strings.text: その手で空を<r つか>掴</r>む。
strings.translated: With that hand I grasp at the empty air.

strings.text: 右手は俺の意志通りにちゃんと動いた。
strings.translated: My right hand moved properly, just as I willed it to.

strings.text: 空気をつかむぐらいには、俺の右手は問題ないのだ。
strings.translated: If all I'm grasping is thin air, my right hand works without a hitch.

strings.text: 俺はキッチンに立ち、コーヒーを淹れる。
strings.translated: I stood in the kitchen, brewing coffee.

strings.text: 日本的なキッチンが不似合いな香りに包まれる。
strings.translated: An aroma out of place in this Japanese-style kitchen filled the air.

strings.text: 淹れたてのコーヒーをカップにうつし、それを口にしながら、朝食の用意をする。
strings.translated: I poured the fresh coffee into a cup, sipped it, and set about preparing breakfast.

strings.text: トーストの焼ける香り、スクランブルエッグとベーコンがジュと音を立てて焼ける。
strings.translated: The scent of toasting bread, the sizzle of scrambled eggs and bacon.

strings.text: それはいつもと同じ風景であるはずなのに、まったく違う。
strings.translated: It should have been the same scene as always, and yet it was utterly different.

strings.text: 四人分の料理。
strings.translated: Cooking for four.

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 「おはよう、早起きだな草薙は」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Morning. You're up early, Kusanagi."

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「そうか？　普通だと思うが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Am I? Feels normal to me..."

strings.text: 「おお、すばらしい朝食だな。まるでホテルの朝食みたいだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Oh, what a splendid breakfast. Like something out of a hotel."

strings.text: 「そうか？　喜んでもらえて幸いだ。冷めないうちに食べてくれ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah? Glad you like it. Eat it before it gets cold.

strings.text: そういえば雫と圭は？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Speaking of which, where are Shizuku and Kei?"

strings.text: 「ああ、二人には何度も声はかけたので、そのウチ起きてくると思うぞ……。たぶん」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, I called them a few times. They'll be up eventually... probably."

strings.text: 「……そうか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...I see."

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「おはー」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Mornin'..."

strings.text: 「お、おはー？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "M-mornin'?"

strings.text: 「えっと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 雫は片手をあげて、おはようの挨拶らしきものを繰り返した。
strings.translated: Shizuku raised one hand and repeated something that vaguely resembled a morning greeting.

strings.text: 「お、おはよう。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "M-morning.

strings.text: そ、それはそれとして、早く食べて学校行かないと遅刻するぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Anyway, hurry up and eat, or you'll be late for school."

strings.text: 「はー食べるー」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah, eating..."

strings.text: 「な、なんだ、今の？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what was that just now?"

strings.text: 「夏目家の人間はだいたい朝に弱いからな。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Most of the Natsume family are bad in the mornings.

strings.text: 雫は特に低血圧ぎみだからな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Shizuku especially -- she's got low blood pressure."

strings.text: 「ぐー」
strings.speaker: 雫

strings.text: 「と言っている間に寝てるぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She's already asleep again."

strings.text: 「はぁ……。ほら起きろ！　雫！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sigh... Come on, wake up! Shizuku!"

strings.text: 藍に無理矢理起こされて、雫は洗面所の方に向かった。
strings.translated: Forcibly roused by Ai, Shizuku shuffled off toward the washroom.

strings.text: 「夏目の連中は朝が弱いか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So the Natsume lot are bad in the mornings, huh..."

strings.text: 「それにしても、あいつを無理矢理起こすとこうなるんだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And apparently this is what happens when you force her awake..."

strings.text: 気がつくと、春の休みは終わりを告げていた。
strings.translated: Before I knew it, spring break had come to an end.

strings.text: 夏目の家に世話になって数日。
strings.translated: A few days under the Natsume household's roof.

strings.text: これほど、時間の流れがはやく感じる事もあるのだろうか。
strings.translated: Could time really slip by this quickly?

strings.text: この休暇の間に起こった出来事を、まだ俺は自分の中で消化しきっていない。
strings.translated: I still hadn't fully digested everything that had happened over this break.

strings.text: 数日で、十数年も続けていた生活が一変したのだから。
strings.translated: In the span of a few days, a life I'd lived for over a decade had been turned inside out.

strings.text: 圭
strings.translated: Kei

strings.text: 「うわぁあああ！　大変だぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Waaaah! Big trouble!"

strings.text: 「何がだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is?"

strings.text: 「学校がはじまるぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "School's starting!"

strings.text: 「そうだなぁ。今日から学校だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. School starts today."

strings.text: 「わ！　わわ！　なんでお前すでに着替えているんだ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wha! Whawha! Why are you already dressed?!"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、これから学校行くからだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because we're going to school, obviously."

strings.text: 「俺はパジャマだ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I'm still in my pajamas!"

strings.text: 「バカだからだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because you're an idiot."

strings.text: 「なんでバカだとパジャマなんだよ！　適当な事いうと怒るぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why would being an idiot mean pajamas?! Say random stuff like that and I'll get mad!"

strings.text: 「ほらほら、こんな場所で大はしゃぎしている場合じゃないだろ。早いところ用意しないとまずいぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on, this is no time to be running around like a maniac. Hurry up and get ready or you'll be in trouble."

strings.text: 「うわぁあああ、大変だぁ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Waaaaah, big trouble!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew..."

strings.text: 「本当に生活が一変したな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "My life really has been turned inside out..."

strings.text: 春の短い休みが終われば、当然のごとく新学期が始まる。
strings.translated: Once the short spring break was over, the new term began, as things do.

strings.text: 新しい年度。
strings.translated: A new school year.

strings.text: 今日から俺たちは弓張学園の三年になる。
strings.translated: Starting today, we were third-years at Yumihari Academy.

strings.text: 「何をぼーっとしている？　草薙？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What are you standing around for, Kusanagi?"

strings.text: 「藍か……。いや、ちょっと夏目の屋敷の外観を見ていただけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh, Ai... Just taking a look at the outside of the Natsume mansion."

strings.text: 「大きな屋敷だよな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It's a big place, isn't it."

strings.text: 「ああ、相変わらず巨大な屋敷だよな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, huge as ever.

strings.text: 維持費だけでもバカにならないだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: The upkeep costs alone must be no joke, right?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな。たしかに維持費だけでも大変だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yes, that's true. Just maintaining it is a serious undertaking."

strings.text: 「こんな建物売っぱらって、もう少しこぢんまりした家に引っ越した方がいいんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wouldn't it be smarter to sell a place like this and move somewhere smaller?"

strings.text: 「そんなことするわけないだろ……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "As if we could do that...

strings.text: お前じゃなければ、その発言殴っているところだぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: If it were anyone else, I'd have punched them for saying that."

strings.text: 「言わんとする事も分かる。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I get what you're trying to say.

strings.text: だとしても、こんな大屋敷は必要ないだろ？　すべてが終わったんだからさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: But even so, you don't need a mansion this big anymore, do you? It's all over now."

strings.text: 「たしかにな……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You're right, in a way...

strings.text: でも、それでも、この屋敷を手放す事は出来ないよ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: But still, I can't let go of this house."

strings.text: 「この屋敷にはつらい思い出もたくさんあるが、それ以上に素晴らしい記憶がたくさんある。むしろ私が生きているかぎりはこの屋敷は守り続ける……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "There are painful memories here, sure. But there are far more wonderful ones. As long as I'm alive, I'll keep this house standing..."

strings.text: 「俺は正直もう売っぱらっても良いと思うけどなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Honestly, I think you could just sell it off."

strings.text: 「軽々しく言うな。バカ者が」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Don't say such things so lightly, you fool."

strings.text: 「たぶん、あの男だって同じ事言うぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That man would've said the same thing, you know."

strings.text: 「たしかに健一郎さんならお前と同じ事を言うだろうな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "True. Ken'ichirou-san would probably say exactly what you said."

strings.text: 「だがそれはさ。お前と健一郎さんが、夏目のお婆さまが大の苦手だったからじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "But that's only because you and Ken'ichirou-san couldn't stand Grandmother Natsume, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、あのババァはあんな凶暴だったし……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, that old bat was violent as hell..."

strings.text: 「健一郎さんとお前の意見が唯一一致するのはそこだったな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The one thing you and Ken'ichirou-san ever agreed on."

strings.text: 「あのババァ、女には優しいけど、俺たちには厳しすぎだった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She was kind to the women, but way too hard on us."

strings.text: 「かわいがってたんだろ？　特に直哉は」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "She doted on you, though. Especially you, Naoya."

strings.text: 「とてもそうは見えなかったけどなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You could've fooled me."

strings.text: 「さてと、そろそろ登校しないと間に合わないぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well then, we'd better get moving or we won't make it to school."

strings.text: 「そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's true."

strings.text: 俺が駅に歩きだそうとすると……、
strings.translated: As I started walking toward the station...

strings.text: 藍は逆方向に歩き出す。
strings.translated: Ai set off in the opposite direction.

strings.text: 「あれ？　藍、駅逆方向じゃねぇか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Ai, isn't the station the other way?"

strings.text: 「私はバイクだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I take a bike."

strings.text: 「なんだこれ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is this?"

strings.text: 「マッハⅢというバイクだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "A bike called Mach III."

strings.text: 「速そうな名前だが、とても古そうでショボイバイクだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Fast-sounding name for a really old, sorry-looking bike."

strings.text: 「ショボイときたか、まぁとても古いバイクだからな。速いには速いが問題しかないバイクとして有名だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sorry-looking, huh. Well, it is a very old bike. Famous for being fast, sure, but also for being nothing but trouble."

strings.text: 「問題しかないバイクになぜ乗る」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why ride a bike that's nothing but trouble?"

strings.text: 「そうだな。なぜ問題しかないバイクに乗るか……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Good question. Why ride a bike that's nothing but trouble...

strings.text: 答えは、問題がある！　だがそれがいいんだ！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: The answer: it's got problems! And that's what makes it great!"

strings.text: 「なんだそれ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The hell is that?"

strings.text: 「あはは、すまんな。今のは受け売りだ。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Haha, sorry. That was borrowed from someone else.

strings.text: そんな事よりもお前もあんまりちんたらしていると遅刻するぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: More importantly, if you dawdle any longer, you'll be late."

strings.text: 「なんだこれ！　スゲーうるさいバイクだな！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What the -- what is this?! What an obnoxiously loud bike!"

strings.text: 「２ストの５００ＣＣだからな。特殊な音だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It's a 500cc two-stroke. Distinctive sound."

strings.text: 「なんだそりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The what now?"

strings.text: 「まぁ興味がない人間にはどうでもいいことだな。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, to someone with no interest it doesn't matter.

strings.text: さてとエンジンも暖まったしそろそろいくぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Now then, the engine's warmed up. Off we go."

strings.text: 爆音を残して、藍の姿はすぐに見えなくなる。
strings.translated: Leaving a thunderous roar in her wake, Ai vanished from sight almost instantly.

strings.text: それにしても……、
strings.translated: All the same...

strings.text: 「本当にうるせぇ音だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That is one seriously loud bike."

strings.text: 桜に埋め尽くされた夢浮坂――。
strings.translated: Yume-no-Ukisaka, buried under cherry blossoms --

strings.text: 弓張で新しい学年を迎える生徒達はこの桜の満開の下を通ってその門をくぐる。
strings.translated: The students of Yumihari passed beneath these blossoms in full bloom, through the gate, and into a new school year.

strings.text: 久方ぶりに耳にする、朝の賑わい。
strings.translated: The morning bustle I hadn't heard in a while.

strings.text: この空気を肌で感じると、また新しい学期が始まる事が実感される。
strings.translated: Feeling this air on my skin, I could really sense a new term beginning.

strings.text: 黒板に殴り書きされた「適当な席に着席してください」との指示どおり、教室の後ろ寄りの空席に腰を落ち着けた。
strings.translated: Following the scrawled instruction on the blackboard -- "please take any available seat" -- I settled into an empty spot toward the back of the classroom.

strings.text: ３年次に上がって新しいクラスが編成されたゆえ、まだ席順などが決まっていないための措置であろう。
strings.translated: Since new classes had been assigned for our third year, seating hadn't been decided yet; this was the workaround.

strings.text: 他の生徒たちも、教室に入るなり席をみつくろって腰掛けていく。運良く友人と同じクラスになった者、腐れ縁を確かめ合う者。生徒たちのリアクションは様々だ。
strings.translated: The other students came in and picked their seats too. Some lucky enough to share a class with friends, others reaffirming long-standing acquaintances. Reactions varied.

strings.text: 俺はというと……。
strings.translated: As for me...

strings.text: 「また同じクラスになったなぁ。直哉」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Same class again, huh, Naoya."

strings.text: 「お？　なんだ直哉いけずだぞ。なんでそんな難しい顔している？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Hey? What's the matter, Naoya? Why the sour face?"

strings.text: 「いやな、家で四六時中聞かされる耳障りな声からやっと解放されると思ったのに、今まさにその声に悩まされている事に少しな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I thought I'd finally get a break from that grating voice I hear morning, noon, and night at home, but here I am, being tormented by that very same voice."

strings.text: 「なんだよ。姉ちゃんの事か？　同じ学校だから仕方がないだろ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What are you on about? You mean my sister? Can't be helped, we're at the same school."

strings.text: イヤミの通じないバカだ……。
strings.translated: Sarcasm doesn't land on this idiot...

strings.text: 「そうそう直哉さ。俺昨日から考えてたんだけどさ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Oh yeah, Naoya. I was thinking about it since yesterday --"

strings.text: 「何を？　お前は気ままに話が飛びすぎて疲れるから、前置きをしてから話せ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "About what? You jump between topics so freely it wears me out. At least give me a preamble."

strings.text: 「あのさ、昨日のアルバムの娘」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You know that girl in the album yesterday --"

strings.text: 「なんだロリコン野郎。まだ引っ張るか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You lolicon bastard. Still on that?"

strings.text: 「ロリコン関係ないだろ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "This has nothing to do with lolicon!"

strings.text: 圭は、相当稟の事が気になったのか、昨日に飽きたらず、今日までも稟の話をし始める。
strings.translated: Kei must've really taken an interest in Rin, because he wasn't done with yesterday's conversation -- he was starting it up all over again today.

strings.text: どうにも話に乗れない俺は、適当な相槌を打ちながら圭の話をスルーしていった。
strings.translated: Unable to get into it, I just made noncommittal replies and let Kei's chatter pass right through me.

strings.text: 「なんだよ！　聞いているのかよ直哉！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Hey! Are you even listening, Naoya?!"

strings.text: 「あ？　聞いてた聞いてた。圭が幼○好きの変態という話だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? I was, I was. Something about Kei being a lit*le-girl-loving pervert, right?"

strings.text: 「違う！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wrong!"

strings.text: 窓から空を見上げる。
strings.translated: I gazed up at the sky through the window.

strings.text: ここは三階建て校舎の一階中央に位置する、無駄に日当たりのいい教室。
strings.translated: It was a classroom in the center of the first floor of the three-story school building, unnecessarily well-lit by the sun.

strings.text: この教室においては、春の穏やかな日差しでさえ、少々蒸し暑く感じるほどなので……夏が思いやられる。
strings.translated: In this room, even spring's gentle sunlight already felt a bit stifling... I could only dread the summer.

strings.text: ――それにしても、憎らしいほどに晴れている。
strings.translated: -- All the same, the sky was insufferably clear.

strings.text: こんな青空を見せ付けられても、古めかしい石の壁に囲まれた俺は、どうすることもできないのだが。
strings.translated: Not that I could do anything about it, boxed in as I was by these old stone walls, no matter how much blue sky they flaunted at me.

strings.text: 強い日差しに照らされた桃色の夢浮坂をみつめながらそんな事を考えていた。
strings.translated: I stared at the pink Yume-no-Ukisaka bathed in the strong sunlight and mulled over these things.

strings.text: 「ふぅ……春の陽気というのはどうも憂鬱にさせられるな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sigh... something about spring weather really gets you down."

strings.text: 「何それ？　ちょっと厨二病入った感じか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What's that? Got a bit of chuunibyou going on?"

strings.text: 「あほか。そういうのじゃねぇよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Idiot. It's nothing like that."

strings.text: 「こんな春の陽気の中で、新学期を薄暗い教室で迎えなければならない自分の運命を考えれば……そりゃ憂鬱にもなるってもんだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "When you think about how you have to spend a spring day like this cooped up in a dim classroom to start the new term... of course it puts you in a funk."

strings.text: 「なるほどなぁ、そうだよなぁ。これから夏休みまでずっとずっと学校だからなぁ。なんか面白い事あるといいのになぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, makes sense. From here till summer break, it's nothing but school. Wish something fun would happen."

strings.text: 「そうだ！　転校生とか来ないかなぁ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That's it! Maybe a transfer student will show up?"

strings.text: 「来ないだろ。三年で転入とか普通ない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, they won't. You don't get transfers in your third year."

strings.text: 「そうかなぁ……たとえばさぁ、あの娘とか転校してこないかな？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Really...? Like, what if that girl transferred in?"

strings.text: 「また、その話かよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Not this again."

strings.text: 真琴
strings.translated: Makoto

strings.text: 「朝から二人とも元気ねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You two are lively for this hour of the morning."

strings.text: 「おう真琴か！　元気だぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Oh, Makoto! Yeah, I'm plenty lively!"

strings.text: 「元気なのはそいつだけだろ。どこをどう見たら俺が元気に見えるんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Only he is. Where exactly do I look lively to you?"

strings.text: 「そうかしら？　いつもはもっとダルそうじゃない？　いつ息絶えてもおかしくないぐらいと記憶しているけど？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Really? Aren't you usually way more listless? As I recall, you look like you could keel over any second."

strings.text: 「どんな難病の末期だよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What kind of terminal illness are we talking about..."

strings.text: 「それが草薙直哉じゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But isn't that Kusanagi Naoya for you?"

strings.text: 「はい、はい、そうですねぇ。俺はそんなですねぇ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes, yes, of course. That's just what I'm like."

strings.text: 「おや？　すねた？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh? Are you sulking?"

strings.text: 「めんどくさくなったんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I just can't be bothered anymore."

strings.text: 「圭の<r わずら>煩</r>わしさにお前の煩わしさが加われば、そりゃすべてがめんどくさくもなるだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Add your annoyingness to Kei's annoyingness, and of course everything starts to feel like a pain."

strings.text: 「はぁ、反論すら放棄するとは……まったく、本当に無気力な男ねぇ。本当に明日にでも死ぬ気じゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sheesh, giving up on even arguing back... honestly, what a listless guy. You really do look like you're going to drop dead tomorrow, don't you?"

strings.text: 「なんで死ぬんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why would I be dying..."

strings.text: 「目も死んでるし」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Your eyes are dead, too."

strings.text: 「関係ねぇよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's got nothing to do with it."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、新学期。まぁさ、元気よくとはいかないけど、でもこんな天気もいいし、桜も咲いてるし、もう少しだけ愛想が良くてもいいんじゃないかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Anyway, it's a new term. Well, I can't ask you to be cheerful, but the weather's nice, the cherry blossoms are blooming -- couldn't you stand to be a little friendlier?"

strings.text: 「ああ、善処する」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I'll do what I can."

strings.text: 「あ、そうだ！　今どんなにダルくても、今日はホームルームと始業式が終わり次第、新入生勧誘だからね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh, right! However worn out you are, once homeroom and the opening ceremony are done today, it's time to recruit new club members."

strings.text: 「そうか……がんばれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so... good luck with that."

strings.text: 「あんたもがんばるのよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You've got to work hard too!"

strings.text: 「俺が何をがんばるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is it exactly I have to work hard at?"

strings.text: 「新入生勧誘するって、何度も言ってるじゃないの？　何、その歳で耳が遠くなったの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I said 'recruiting new members,' didn't I? How many times do I have to say it? What, going deaf at your age?"

strings.text: 「耳じゃねぇよ。遠いのはお前の心との距離だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not my ears. What's far is the distance between me and your heart."

strings.text: 「上手いこと言ってるつもり？　全然おもしろくないのだけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Think that was clever? It's not funny at all."

strings.text: 「別にお前を喜ばすために言ってるわけじゃない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not exactly saying it to entertain you."

strings.text: 「だったら、たまには私を喜ばしてくれてもいいんじゃないの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then couldn't you entertain me once in a while?"

strings.text: 「そんなサービスはないな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That service isn't on offer."

strings.text: 「だいたい、鳥谷。お前はあたかも自明の理のごとく言っているが、あえて聞きたい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Also, Toritani. You're talking like it's self-evident, but let me ask you outright."

strings.text: 「なんで貴様らの部活の新入生勧誘を俺がしなければならないんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why do I have to help recruit for you people's club?"

strings.text: 「当たり前じゃないかしら？　草薙は我が栄光ある弓張学園の美術部員なのだから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Isn't it obvious? Kusanagi, you're a member of the glorious Yumihari Academy art club."

strings.text: 「ほう……俺はいつその栄光ある弓張学園の美術部員になったんだ？　俺の記憶ではそんな事実はないのだが？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh? And just when did I become a member of this glorious Yumihari Academy art club? As far as I remember, no such thing ever happened."

strings.text: 「あなたの記憶なんて当てにならないわ。少なくとも私の中では草薙直哉は我が美術部の一員だわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Your memory is not to be trusted. At least in my mind, Kusanagi Naoya is a member of our art club."

strings.text: 「ほう、ならば今日限りで貴様の中の栄光ある美術部とやらから脱退させていただく」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Very well, then as of today, I hereby withdraw from your glorious art club in your mind."

strings.text: 「それはあなたの中だけの事でしょ？　そんなの通用しないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's just something in your mind, right? That doesn't count."

strings.text: 「なんじゃそりゃ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The hell is that supposed to mean!"

strings.text: 「あははは……直哉大変だなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahaha... rough for you, Naoya."

strings.text: 「ってあなたこそ美術部員でしょ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You're an art club member too!"

strings.text: などとやっているウチに、教室を埋める生徒の数が増えていく。
strings.translated: While we were going at it like that, more and more students filed into the classroom.

strings.text: 「鳥谷そろそろ席についた方がいいぞ。ホームルームの時間だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani, you'd better take your seat soon. It's about time for homeroom."

strings.text: 「分かってるわよ！　それよりも、圭も草薙もわかったわね！　今日は新入生勧誘だからね！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I know! More importantly -- Kei, Kusanagi, you got it, right?! Today is new-member recruitment!"

strings.text: 予鈴の音がスピーカーから漏れると、教室の中にはそれまでとは違う空気が漂い始めた。
strings.translated: The warning bell sounded through the speakers, and the atmosphere in the classroom shifted.

strings.text: 「ほらお前ら！　うるさいぞ！　席につけ！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Come on, you lot! Quiet down! Take your seats!"

strings.text: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: Schoolgirl A

strings.text: 「きゃーっ！　藍ちゃん、今日もカワイイー！」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Kyaaa! Ai-chan, you're so cute today, too!"

strings.text: 男子校生Ａ
strings.translated: Schoolboy A

strings.text: 「うおおおっセンセのクラスになってラッキー！」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Yesss, I got sensei's class! Lucky!"

strings.text: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: Schoolgirl B

strings.text: 「やだ、ホントに藍ちゃんってばちっちゃーい！？」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "Oh my gosh, Ai-chan really is tiiiny!"

strings.text: 男子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: Schoolboy B

strings.text: 「愛してるぜ！　藍センセー！！」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "I love you! Ai-sensei!!"

strings.text: 「ふぅ……分かった。でも黙れうるさいからだまれ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sigh... alright. But quiet down, you're too loud, so shut it."

strings.text: 「せんせー、怒った顔もカワイー！」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Sensei, even when you're mad you're cute!"

strings.text: 「先生がラブリーすぎて落ち着けない！」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Sensei's too lovely, I can't calm down!"

strings.text: 「ったく……何でこうなったかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Honestly... how did it end up like this..."

strings.text: 「先生いつもの！　いつもの！」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "Sensei, the usual! The usual!"

strings.text: 「ふぅ……こんな事してたら、私の教員免許が剥奪されてしまうよ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sigh... if I keep doing this, my teaching license is going to get revoked."

strings.text: 「俺をおちつかせてー！」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "Calm me down!"

strings.text: 「あーうるさいっ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Aah, you're loud!"

strings.text: 「いつものあれで、俺達をおちつかせてー！」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Do the usual, calm us down!"

strings.text: 「ふん！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hmph!"

strings.text: 藍の当て身の前に男子学生が床に転がる。
strings.translated: A boy tumbled to the floor from Ai's strike.

strings.text: 女子一同
strings.translated: All the Girls

strings.text: 「「「きゃああああ！　藍先生の当て身きたぁ！」」」
strings.speaker: 女子一同
strings.translated: "Kyaaaaa! Ai-sensei's strike, here it comes!"

strings.text: 男子一同
strings.translated: All the Boys

strings.text: 「「「うおおおおうらやましいぞ！！！」」」
strings.speaker: 男子一同
strings.translated: "Uoooooh, I'm so jealous!!!"

strings.text: 「はぁ……毎年、毎年……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sigh... every year, every year...

strings.text: 何だかなな連中だなぁ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: what a bunch you all are."

strings.text: 藍が困った顔をする。
strings.translated: Ai wore an exasperated look.

strings.text: そりゃ困りもするだろ。
strings.translated: Well, no wonder she was troubled.

strings.text: 藍が男子学生に当て身を決める。
strings.translated: Ai striking down a male student --

strings.text: こんなものが恒例になっているのだ。
strings.translated: this had become a regular ritual.

strings.text: 元々は、藍がはじめてこの学校に教員として訪れた日。
strings.translated: It all started the day Ai first came to this school as a teacher.

strings.text: 生徒の一人が発した「先生の当て身ってどのぐらい力があるの？」という言葉が事の発端らしい。
strings.translated: One of the students apparently asked, "Sensei, how powerful is your strike?" -- and that was the beginning of it all.

strings.text: 小さな藍。武道をやっているらしい。
strings.translated: Tiny Ai, who apparently practiced a martial art.

strings.text: その威力が知りたい。
strings.translated: They wanted to know just how powerful she was.

strings.text: 一度騒ぎ出した男子生徒は止まらず、「当ててください」と生徒達が殺到した。
strings.translated: Once the boys got going, there was no stopping them, and the students swarmed her demanding, "Hit me!"

strings.text: 新任だった藍は焦って言われるがままに、男子生徒に当て身を喰らわしてしまった。
strings.translated: Ai, being new at the time, panicked and did as she was told, laying a strike on one of the boys.

strings.text: 今の藍だったらさすがにそんな焦り方はしなかっただろうが、何せ当時はまだ新任。しかも、まったく男子と無縁だったらしい。
strings.translated: The Ai of today would never let herself get flustered like that, but back then she was fresh out of training. On top of that, she'd apparently had zero experience with boys.

strings.text: 「あの時は、瞬時に懲戒免職を覚悟した」
strings.translated: "In that moment, I was fully prepared to be dismissed for misconduct."

strings.text: というのは藍の談。
strings.translated: Or so Ai tells it.

strings.text: だが、事実はまったくあべこべだった。
strings.translated: But in fact, the situation went the exact opposite way.

strings.text: それを受けた生徒は次の様なコメントを残した。
strings.translated: The student who'd been struck left behind the following comment.

strings.text: 「地獄から天国に昇るような気分」
strings.translated: "It's like ascending from hell into heaven."

strings.text: そのコメントを残して気絶した生徒が、あまりにも幸せそうな顔をしていた事から「俺も藍先生の当て身を喰らいたい」という生徒が殺到。
strings.translated: The student who'd left that remark before passing out looked so blissfully happy that the boys swarmed her again, all demanding, "I want to be struck by Ai-sensei too!"

strings.text: その日は何とか担任の教師のおかげで事なきを得たらしい。
strings.translated: Thanks to the homeroom teacher's intervention, they somehow got through the day without incident.

strings.text: そして、何故かこの当て身事件が、新学年の恒例行事となってしまった。
strings.translated: And for some reason, this strike incident became an annual ritual for the new school year.

strings.text: この当て身をくらえるのは年に一回。
strings.translated: The chance to take one of these strikes came only once a year.

strings.text: 藍が担任を受け持つ教室だけで選ばれる一人。
strings.translated: One student would be chosen, and only in the class Ai took as her homeroom.

strings.text: そんな一人は、弓張の「福男」的な存在ともなっている。
strings.translated: That one lucky student was regarded as a kind of "lucky man" of Yumihari.

strings.text: まったく奇妙な学校だ。
strings.translated: What a strange school.

strings.text: 藍に当て身されるという幸せ（？）を手にした生徒が我に返ると、ようやくクラスが落ち着きを戻す。
strings.translated: Once the student who'd earned the blessing (?) of being struck by Ai came to his senses, the class finally settled down.

strings.text: 藍が困るのも無理からぬ事だが……。
strings.translated: Ai's exasperation was entirely understandable...

strings.text: まぁ、それだけ藍が愛されているという事だろう。
strings.translated: Well, that's just how loved she is.

strings.text: 「こほん……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ahem...

strings.text: え、えっと……このクラスを受け持つことになった、夏目藍だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: E-erm... I'm Natsume Ai, and I'll be in charge of this class."

strings.text: 「何かと至らないところがあるかとは思うが、自分なりに全力を尽くして精一杯努力するつもりなので、皆もよろしくお願いする」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I'm sure I'll fall short in various ways, but I intend to do my very best, so I'd appreciate your cooperation, everyone."

strings.text: 「知っていると思うが、担当は国語だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "As you probably know, I teach Japanese."

strings.text: 「それとバイク、愛車はマッハⅢ！　それと空手！」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "And motorcycles, her beloved ride is a Mach III! And karate!"

strings.text: 「はぁ……。もう行事は終わったのだから、少し静かにしてくれ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sigh... the ceremony's already over, so please quiet down a little."

strings.text: 「今日は重要な発表があるんだぞ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I have an important announcement today..."

strings.text: 「え？　重要発表？　藍先生結婚するの？」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Huh? Important announcement? Ai-sensei, are you getting married?"

strings.text: 「いやぁ……ばれたかぁ……実は俺とね」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "Aw... found out, huh... to me, actually --"

strings.text: 「あのな！　本当に怒るぞ！　私が本当に怒ったら大変なのだからな！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Listen here! I really will get angry! And when I really get angry, it's not going to be pretty!"

strings.text: やや強く机を叩く藍。
strings.translated: Ai slapped the desk fairly hard.

strings.text: 藍の一生懸命さに、一同静かになる。
strings.translated: Everyone fell silent in the face of her earnestness.

strings.text: もちろん、恐怖では無い。
strings.translated: Not out of fear, of course.

strings.text: そのかわいさ故だ。
strings.translated: It was because she was so adorable.

strings.text: 小さな先生が教壇でぷりぷり怒っている姿はかわいい。
strings.translated: A tiny teacher stamping her feet in indignation at the podium was cute.

strings.text: そんな姿を雑音なんかで穢したくない。
strings.translated: No one wanted to sully a sight like that with noise.

strings.text: などと考えているのだろうか？
strings.translated: Or so they were thinking, maybe.

strings.text: 生徒達はほわほわした目で藍を見つめる。
strings.translated: The students gazed at Ai with dreamy eyes.

strings.text: 「な、なんだよ。その顔つきは……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "W-what's with those faces...

strings.text: ま、まぁいい、ホームルームに入る前に、皆に紹介したい生徒がいるんだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: W-well, whatever. Before we get to homeroom, there's a student I'd like to introduce to all of you."

strings.text: 教室の中に、一瞬ざわめきが走る。それもそのはず、藍先生のその言葉は、転校生を紹介する際の常套句なのだから。
strings.translated: A ripple of murmurs ran through the classroom for a moment. And no wonder -- Ai-sensei's phrasing was the standard line used when introducing a transfer student.

strings.text: 俺は教壇の前に位置する、思わせぶりにポツリと空いていた空席に目をやった。
strings.translated: My eyes went to the empty seat sitting suggestively vacant in front of the podium.

strings.text: ……転校生、か。
strings.translated: ...A transfer student, huh.

strings.text: 女子校生Ｃ
strings.translated: Schoolgirl C

strings.text: 「藍ちゃんそれってもしかして」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｃ
strings.translated: "Ai-chan, don't tell me --"

strings.text: 「察しのとおり転校生だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "As you've guessed, it's a transfer student."

strings.text: 「お？！　ぉぉおおお！　直哉！　転校生だ！　転校生がキタぞ！！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Oh?! Oooooh! Naoya! A transfer student! We've got a transfer student!!"

strings.text: 「はぁ、そうだね……。そうだから、圭さんはもっと俺から離れてくださいませんか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sigh, yes, we do... So, Kei-san, would you kindly move a little further away from me?"

strings.text: 「なんでいきなり他人行儀なんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why the sudden formality?!"

strings.text: 「だって……ほら、そうやってツバとか飛ばすじゃないですか？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well... look, you spray spit when you talk, don't you?

strings.text: そういうのキモイじゃないですか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: That kind of thing is gross."

strings.text: 「ひどい事言うな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That's a horrible thing to say!"

strings.text: 「<r みさくら>御桜</r>、入れ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Misakura, come in."

strings.text: 「み、<r みさくら>御桜</r>……？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Mi... Misakura...?"

strings.text: 藍先生が切り出したその言葉を受けて、皆の視線が教室前方の扉に注がれる。
strings.translated: At Ai-sensei's words, everyone's eyes turned toward the door at the front of the classroom.

strings.text: 扉が静かに開き……廊下に待機していたであろうその人物は、教室内におずおずと入ってきた。
strings.translated: The door slid quietly open... and the figure who must have been waiting in the corridor stepped hesitantly into the room.

strings.text: 重力を感じさせないほど、柔らかく揺れる、髪。教室を一瞬見回すように巡らしたその双眸は、深い漆黒を湛えた、大粒の水晶が嵌っているように――見えた。
strings.translated: Hair so soft it seemed to sway weightlessly. As her gaze swept once across the room, her eyes gleamed like great crystals of deep, lacquered black.

strings.text: 彼女は皆に向き直ると、顎を引いて軽く会釈をした。
strings.translated: She turned to face everyone, tucked her chin, and gave a small bow.

strings.text: 藍が背伸びをして、黒板に白墨を擦りつける。秀麗な字で「御桜稟」と書き終えると、手をパンパンと叩いて再び教壇へと戻る。
strings.translated: Ai stretched up to press chalk to the blackboard. Once she'd written "Misakura Rin" in her elegant hand, she clapped her hands clean and returned to the podium.

strings.text: 「御桜稟だ。転入生だが、子供の頃はこの街に住んでたらしい。よろしくしてやってくれ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "This is Misakura Rin. She's a transfer student, but apparently she lived in this town when she was a child. Please make her welcome."

strings.text: さすがにすべての思考が止まる。
strings.translated: All thought came to a complete halt.

strings.text: あまりの馬鹿馬鹿しさに、何も考えられなくなる。
strings.translated: The whole thing was so absurd I couldn't think at all.

strings.text: 「みさくら……りん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Misakura... Rin..."

strings.text: 聞き覚えがある……。
strings.translated: I'd heard that name before...

strings.text: いや、聞き覚えという次元ではなく。
strings.translated: No, it went beyond having heard it.

strings.text: 俺ははっきりと、その名前を知っていた。
strings.translated: I knew that name, and knew it perfectly well.

strings.text: 「あのさ……直哉……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Hey... Naoya..."

strings.text: 「あの娘、写真の娘にそっくりなんだけどさ……まさかこれって……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That girl... she looks exactly like the girl in the photo, doesn't she... don't tell me this is..."

strings.text: 「えっと……あの娘の名前ってさ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Um... her name was..."

strings.text: 「直哉？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya?"

strings.text: 悪質な冗談。
strings.translated: A malicious joke.

strings.text: それか、悪質な必然。
strings.translated: Or else, a malicious inevitability.

strings.text: 昨日の今日。
strings.translated: The very day after yesterday.

strings.text: 昨日まで完全に記憶の彼方にあった彼女が……。
strings.translated: The girl who, until yesterday, had been consigned to the farthest reaches of my memory...

strings.text: 目の前に立っている彼女は、間違いなくあの娘であった……。
strings.translated: The girl standing before me was, without a doubt, that girl...

strings.text: あの頃よりさらに成長して、髪は伸び、顔には歳相応の華やかさを宿してはいるが――その姿は間違いなく御桜稟であった。
strings.translated: She had grown since then -- her hair longer, her features carrying the bloom of her years -- yet the girl before me was unmistakably Misakura Rin.

strings.text: 「ほら、御桜。自己紹介」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Come on, Misakura. Introduce yourself."

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「あ、は、はい」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, y-yes."

strings.text: 「み、みみ、御桜稟です。よろしくお願いします」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I'm... Mi- Misakura Rin. Pleased to meet you."

strings.text: 「緊張しすぎだろ……御桜」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You're too nervous, Misakura..."

strings.text: 「す、すみませんっっ。ひ、久しぶりだったので……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I'm sorry! I-it's been so long, that..."

strings.text: 「久しぶり……そうだな、御桜は幼い頃はこのあたりに住んでいたのだからな。もしかしたらこのクラスにも昔の知り合いがいるかもしれないな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Been a while, hm... that's right, Misakura used to live around here when she was little. So there may be some old acquaintances of hers here in this class..."

strings.text: 「おれ、おれ、おれその娘知っている。幼なじみだぜ」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Me! Me, me -- I know her! I'm her childhood friend!"

strings.text: 「ふぅ、嘘だろ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sigh, you're lying, aren't you?"

strings.text: 「はい、嘘です」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Yes, I'm lying."

strings.text: 「これって、どういう事？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What is going on here?"

strings.text: 圭の顔すら見る事が出来ない。
strings.translated: I couldn't even bring myself to look at Kei's face.

strings.text: 声から圭が興奮しているのは伝わる。
strings.translated: From his voice alone, I could tell he was excited.

strings.text: 無理もないだろう。昨日、アルバムで見てあれだけ興味を示していた少女が目の前にいるのだから。
strings.translated: And no wonder. The girl he'd shown so much interest in when he saw her in the album yesterday was standing right in front of him.

strings.text: だが、俺はというと……。
strings.translated: But as for me...

strings.text: 「あ、あのですね。えっと、この街を離れている間、いろいろと様子が変わってました。帰ってこれて……とても嬉しいです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um, so. While I've been away from this town, a lot has changed. I'm... so happy to be back."

strings.text: 「み、右も左も分からないふつつかものですが、よろしくお願いします」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I'm still inexperienced and don't know my way around, but I hope you'll take good care of me."

strings.text: 自己紹介が終わった後、ドッと教室を笑いが包んだ。
strings.translated: When the self-introduction was over, a wave of laughter swept the classroom.

strings.text: 「御桜……嫁に来たんじゃないんだから、その言葉は正直どうかと思う」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Misakura... you're not coming here as a bride, so honestly, I don't think that's quite the phrase to use."

strings.text: 「あ、あははは……。そ、そうですよね……ごめんなさい……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A-ahaha... Y-you're right... I'm sorry..."

strings.text: ふと、窓から外を見る。
strings.translated: My eyes drifted to the window.

strings.text: 相変わらずの陽気にめまいすらする。
strings.translated: The weather outside was as relentlessly bright as ever -- almost dizzying.

strings.text: 薄暗い教室から、薄紅の花弁が、地に触れては、離れるのを見つめる。
strings.translated: From the dim classroom, I watched pale crimson petals touch the ground, then lift away again.

strings.text: 不規則に舞い降りる花弁を横目で見ながら、俺は静かにまぶたを閉じる。
strings.translated: Watching the petals drift down in their irregular dance out of the corner of my eye, I quietly closed my eyelids.

strings.text: 始終、圭が大騒ぎしていたが、俺は始終無関心であった。
strings.translated: The whole time, Kei was a whirlwind of excitement, and the whole time, I remained indifferent.

strings.text: 切り離さなければいけない過去。
strings.translated: There are pasts one must sever.

strings.text: 忘れてやらなければならない絆。
strings.translated: There are bonds one must let oneself forget.

strings.text: そういうものだってある……。
strings.translated: Such things exist in this world...

strings.text: 「直哉、お前……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya, you..."

strings.text: 鈍そうでありながら、それなりに鋭い圭は、何かに感づいたのか、それとも飽きたのか知らないが、あまり俺に話しかけなくなっていた。
strings.translated: Kei may seem dull, but he's sharp enough in his own way. Whether he'd sensed something or simply lost interest, I don't know, but he stopped trying to talk to me much after that.

strings.text: 結局、ホームルームが終わるまで……。
strings.translated: In the end, until homeroom was over...

strings.text: 俺は、教室の最後尾から、稟の背中以外を見ることは無かった。
strings.translated: from the back row of the classroom, I saw nothing but Rin's back.

strings.text: ホームルームが終わると、即座に放課後となる。
strings.translated: When homeroom ends, it's straight into after-school.

strings.text: 初日など学園生活にとっては顔見せみたいなものだろうか……。
strings.translated: The first day of school is really more of a "meet and greet" for student life, I suppose...

strings.text: 転校生である稟の周りにはクラスの女子が群がり始める。
strings.translated: The girls of the class were already flocking around Rin, the transfer student.

strings.text: その周りにさらに男子が取り巻きはじめる。
strings.translated: And around them, the boys began to gather in turn.

strings.text: 「ね、ね、家はどの辺？」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Hey, hey, where do you live?"

strings.text: 「髪が超綺麗～。シャンプー、どこの使ってる？」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "Your hair's so gorgeous~. What shampoo do you use?"

strings.text: 「携帯番号とメアド教えてー」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｃ
strings.translated: "Give us your number and email~"

strings.text: 「すごいなぁ。人間のバリケードに囲まれて、転校生の姿はすっかり見えなくなってしまったぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Amazing. She's been walled up behind a human barricade -- the transfer student's vanished completely."

strings.text: 「いいのか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Are you sure about this?"

strings.text: 「何が？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Scared of what?"

strings.text: 「知り合いなんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "She's someone you know, right?"

strings.text: 「ああ。そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. She is."

strings.text: 「俺があんなにはしゃいだから、へそ曲げてるのか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You bent out of shape because I got so hyped up?"

strings.text: 「なんでそうなるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How does that follow?"

strings.text: 「だったら挨拶ぐらいした方がいいんじゃないのか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "If not, wouldn't it be better to at least go say hi?"

strings.text: 「これから同じクラスなのだろ。だったら<r いや>否</r>が<r おう>応</r>にもいつか挨拶する事になるだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "We'll be in the same class from here on out. Which means, like it or not, I'll wind up saying hello sooner or later."

strings.text: 「そうだけど……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, but..."

strings.text: 「どっちにしろ、あの人だかりをかき分けてかける言葉とかないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Either way, there's nothing worth saying that I could shout through that crowd."

strings.text: 「もう少し落ち着いてからでいいだろ。あいつに話しかけるのは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It'll be fine once things settle down. Talking to her, I mean..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、たしかにそうだけど……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, yeah, that's true, but..."

strings.text: 「ほら、いつまでも人だかりを見てても仕方がないだろ。いくぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on, no point standing here staring at a crowd forever. Let's go."

strings.text: 「あ、ああ……わかったぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ah, y-yeah... got it."

strings.text: 俺たちは、質問攻めに遭う稟を尻目に二人で教室を後にした。
strings.translated: Leaving Rin to fend off the interrogation, the two of us left the classroom together.

strings.text: 廊下には、新学期特有のざわめきが溢れている。
strings.translated: The corridor was filled with the particular buzz that only comes with a new school term.

strings.text: 早くも各部活の勧誘活動がはじまっており、各教室へのビラ配りや、窓から見える校庭では、運動部のデモンストレーションが行われていた。
strings.translated: Club recruitment was already in full swing -- flyers being pushed at every classroom, and out the windows, the athletic clubs were putting on demonstrations in the schoolyard.

strings.text: 「美食を自負するならこの料理研究会へどうぞ！　料理の腕を上げるだけでなく、夏には中華街グルメツアーもあり！」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "If you consider yourself a connoisseur, come join our Culinary Research Society! Not only will your cooking skills improve -- this summer we're doing a gourmet tour of Chinatown!"

strings.text: 「君も僕らと一緒に限界クロックアップに挑んでみないかっ！？　パソコンから火を吹いてこそ一人前、さあ、来たれ我が電脳部へ！」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Won't you join us in pushing your machines to their absolute clock limits!? A true master makes his PC breathe fire -- come, one and all, to our Cyber Club!"

strings.text: 廊下の端々から、威勢のいい勧誘の声が上がる。どの部も、部員獲得のために趣向を凝らした客引きを行っている。
strings.translated: From every corner of the corridor came spirited pitches. Every club was doing everything it could think of to reel in new members.

strings.text: そういえば美術部も、今日から数日に渡って勧誘を行うとか鳥谷が力説していた。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, Toritani had been going on about how the art club would be running its recruitment drive over the next several days, starting today.

strings.text: という事は……。
strings.translated: Which meant...

strings.text: 「圭……俺は裏口から帰るつもりだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kei... I'm going home through the back gate."

strings.text: 「え？　なんで？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? Why?"

strings.text: 「いや、正門はまずいだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, the front gate's going to be trouble."
