strings.translated: "......For confirmation, I'll ask: Kei's crazy getup is one thing, but what's this on me?"

strings.text: 「タキシードよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "A tuxedo."

strings.text: 「これが美術部勧誘の一環という事になるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And how exactly does this count as part of art club recruitment?"

strings.text:
「なるわよ。リサーチ済みだもの。
それよりも、はい。これっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"It counts. I've done my research.
More importantly, here, take this."

strings.text: 「リサーチ済みって何だよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Done your research'--what does that even mean......?"

strings.text: チラシを受け取りながら、半ば呆れ気味の口調で俺が問うと、鳥谷はいかにもうれしそうに笑う。
strings.translated: As I took the flyers, asking in a half-exasperated tone, Toritani laughed as if genuinely delighted.

strings.text: 「草薙。さすが似合うね。身長高いし、まあまあ顔もいいしね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kusanagi. It really does suit you. You're tall, and your face is passable enough too."

strings.text: 「さいでっか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so."

strings.text: 「利用できるものは何でも利用するってのが、私のモットーであり人類普遍の成功原理なの！　ほら、見てみなさいよ、圭のこの可愛らしさっ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Using every resource available--that's my motto and the universal principle of human success! Look, just look at how cute Kei is!"

strings.text: 「あうー、もう死にたいぞ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Uuu, I really do want to die......"

strings.text: 「仕事してから死ねばいいと思うわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I think you should die after you finish the job."

strings.text: 「お前は鬼畜だなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You really are a demon."

strings.text: 「鬼畜で結構。それより見なさい！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Demon suits me fine. More importantly, look!"

strings.text: 鳥谷は俺の後ろで震えている物体にビシっと指を差し、自信満々に言い放った。
strings.translated: Toritani jabbed her finger dramatically at the object trembling behind me and declared with full confidence.

strings.text: 「女の私から見ても、明らかにセンチメンタル過剰な美少女！　これを客引きに使わない方がおかしいってもんでしょ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Even to me, another girl, she's a beautiful girl clearly overflowing with sentimentality! It'd be crazy NOT to use her to draw in customers!"

strings.text: 「たしかに、その通りだと思います」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Indeed, I think that's exactly right."

strings.text: 「何でお前は肯定する！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why are you agreeing?!"

strings.text: 「事実だからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because it's true."

strings.text: 「素地の愛らしさを存分に活かしたナチュラルメイクに、素朴さがキラリと光るツインテール！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "A natural makeup that makes the most of her innate loveliness, and twintails that shine with rustic charm!"

strings.text:
「ツインテールとはー。
圭はいきなり髪の毛がのびたりするんだなー。
うわー天職だわ。本当にー女装は圭の天職だわー」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Twintails, huh.
So Kei can just suddenly grow his hair out, can he.
Wow, this is a true calling. Cross-dressing really is Kei's true calling."

strings.text:
「んなわけないだろ！　付け毛だ！
いきなりこんな髪の毛が伸びるとか、おれはどんな化け物だ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"There's no way! It's a hairpiece!
What kind of monster would I be if hair just suddenly grew out like this?"

strings.text: 「お菊人形だって伸びるんだから、お前ぐらいの化け物ならそのぐらい伸びるんじゃないのかー」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even the Okiku doll grows hair, so a monster like you should be able to grow that much, right?"

strings.text: 「思わず階段の下から覗き込んでしまいそうなギリギリのスカート丈と、ニーソ属性ならずとも、下っ腹に熱いものを感じてしまうニーソックス！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "A skirt length so borderline you'd unconsciously want to peek up from the bottom of the stairs, and knee-highs that stir something hot in the lower gut, even for those not into the knee-high fetish!"

strings.text: 「そして、羞恥のあまりに小動物のように怯えている、この被虐心をそそる顔！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "And that face, trembling in shame like a small animal, that arouses every sadistic impulse!"

strings.text: 「これで惚れなきゃ男じゃないって感じよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's the kind of look where you're not a man if you don't fall for her!"

strings.text: 「はい、完全に正しいと思います……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes, I think that's completely correct......"

strings.text: 「違うわ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That's wrong!"

strings.text: 「うわん！　うわん！　やっぱやめる！　俺はやんないからな、こんなのおかしい人がやる事だ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Waah! Waah! I quit after all! I'm not doing this, this is something only crazy people do!"

strings.text: 「あら、そういう事を言うですかねぇ。この娘はぁ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "My, my, this girl is going to say things like that......"

strings.text: 「いやぁ～、残念だわ。去年の秋に美術室から忽然と消えたデッサン用の胸像の秘密が、とうとう公になる日が来るというわけねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ohh, what a shame. It looks like the day has finally come when the secret of the dessin bust that vanished from the art room last autumn comes out into the open......"

strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Eh? Ah!? Aaah!!"

strings.text: 鳥谷の口から漏れた言葉を聞いた瞬間、圭の体が雷に打たれたかのごとく硬直した。
strings.translated: The instant he heard the words that slipped from Toritani's mouth, Kei's body stiffened as if struck by lightning.

strings.text: 「何かしでかしたのか？　圭……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Did you do something? Kei......"

strings.text: 両者の間に漂う空気を読みつつ、俺は低い声で質問の言葉を投げかける。
strings.translated: Reading the air drifting between them, I threw the question in a low voice.

strings.text: 「いや……その……。去年……デッサン用の胸像でスパーリングとかしてたら、手を滑らせて……割っちまったんだ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "No...... um...... last year...... I was sparring with the dessin bust and my hand slipped...... and I broke it."

strings.text:
デッサン用の胸像でスパーリングとかするなよ……。
いくら何でもその姿は残念すぎるぞ……圭。
strings.translated:
Don't spar with the dessin bust......
No matter how you slice it, that image is just too pathetic......Kei.

strings.text: 「ふむ、ふむ……私はどうやら体制に組しやすい優等生だからなぁ。言ってしまうしかないのかしら」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hmm, hmm...... I do seem to be an honor student easily corralled into the establishment. I suppose I'll just have to tell them."

strings.text: 「嘘つき、真琴は成績こそ優秀だけど、何かというとすぐに学校側に楯突いてる第一人者……放校寸前のアウトローな学内生活を送っている分際だぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Liar. Your grades might be excellent, Makoto, but at every turn you're the very first one to defy the school......you've got no room to talk when your life here is one step from expulsion, living like an outlaw."

strings.text: 「あら？　そんな事言っていいのかしら？　私にとっては夏目君は大事なお友達だからぁ、今まで先生方には黙ってたけどー、やっぱり、こういうのって良くないと思うんだなぁー」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh? Are you sure you should say that? For me, Natsume-kun is an important friend, so I've kept quiet to the teachers up until now, but...... you know, I really do think this kind of thing isn't good."

strings.text: 「どっしよっかなー。あの胸像、教材のカタログ見たら、１０万超えてたなー。ああ、何か私、先生の前で、これからの正義を語りたい気分だわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Now what should I do? That bust--when I checked the teaching materials catalog, it went for over 100,000 yen. Ahh, somehow I feel like standing before the teachers and speaking of the justice to come."

strings.text:
「わかりました……。
わかったのでした……。
チラシを配りたいと思います……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"Understood......
Understood, indeed......
I'd like to distribute flyers......"

strings.text: 「そうね。喜んでチラシを配るといいと思うわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. I think you should distribute flyers gladly."

strings.text: 「は、はい……ガク」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Y-yes...... *slump*"

strings.text: 「ったくまじめにやりなさいよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Geez, do it properly."

strings.text:
「それにしても、今年は例年よりも熱心だな。
なんでそんなに人数を増やすことに躍起になっているんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Still, you're more fired up than usual this year.
Why are you so frantic about boosting numbers?"

strings.text:
「躍起にもなるわよ。
三月で先輩達が一気に抜けたから、部員が全然足りないのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Of course I'm frantic.
All the seniors graduated in March at once, so we're seriously short on members."

strings.text: 「部員が足りない？　そうなのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Short on members? Really?"

strings.text: 「あんた何も見てないのね……あんだけ美術部に入り浸っているくせに」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You really haven't been paying attention...... even though you loiter around the art room that much."

strings.text:
「本来なら廃部だってあり得るぐらいよ。
まぁ歴史ある部だからさすがに廃部は無いと思うけど、部費がほとんど下りない可能性は高いわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Under normal circumstances, disbandment would even be possible.
Well, it's a club with history, so I don't think we'll actually get disbanded, but the odds are high that our budget will get slashed to nearly nothing."

strings.text: 「そういえば、美術部って今は何人なんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, how many people are in the art club right now?"

strings.text: 「俺と真琴と、あと一応明石先輩だな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Me, Makoto, and technically Akashi-senpai."

strings.text: 「え？　それだけしかいないの！？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Eh? That's all!?"

strings.text:
「もっと言えば明石先輩は暫定よ。留年が決まったわけじゃないんだから、実質的には圭と私の二人。
この人数聞けば、鈍い草薙でもどれだけピンチか分かるでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"To be more accurate, Akashi-senpai is tentative. It hasn't been decided he'll be held back, so effectively it's just me and Kei.
Hearing that number, even a dense guy like you can see how dire it is, right, Kusanagi?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、ピンチなのは分かるが……何で俺までこんな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I get that it's dire......but why do I have to......"

strings.text:
「当たり前でしょ！
文句あるの！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Obviously!
You got a complaint?!"

strings.text:
キマイラでのサービス。
美術室を無断使用。
strings.translated:
My services at Chimera.
Unauthorized use of the art room.

strings.text:
それら、すべてがこういう時のためにある。
文句など言えない……。
strings.translated:
All of those exist for moments like this.
I'm in no position to complain......

strings.text:
「文句は無いが……、
そういえば、二年が一人もいないんだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I've got no complaint, but......
now that you mention it, there's not a single second-year, is there."

strings.text: 「去年は新入部員が入らなかったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No new members joined last year?"

strings.text: 「いたのはいたのよ……。ただ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There were some...... just......"

strings.text: 「明石先輩のセクハラに耐えかねてな。去年の新入生はすぐにやめちゃったんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "They couldn't stand Akashi-senpai's sexual harassment. Last year's new recruits quit almost immediately."

strings.text: 「セクハラ？　明石らしいといえば明石らしいが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sexual harassment? Well, that's Akashi for you......"

strings.text: 「なんか“スカートはパラシュートとなり得るか？”とか何とかいって、スカートめくりに凝ってた時期があってだな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "There was a period when he got obsessed with skirt-flipping, saying stuff like 'Can a skirt function as a parachute?'"

strings.text: 「あー、そうそう、そんな時期があったわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ah, right, right, there was a phase like that."

strings.text: 「どんな時期なんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What kind of phase is that......"

strings.text: 「パラシュートだけじゃなくて、アドバルーンとか、とりあえず空を飛ぶものにやたら凝ってたのよ。理由は良く分からないけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Not just parachutes--hot-air balloons, and basically anything that flies in the sky, he was all into for a while. I don't really know why."

strings.text: 「そういえば、明石先輩って風船いっぱいくくりつけて屋上から空飛んだ事あったよな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, didn't Akashi-senpai once tie a bunch of balloons to himself and try to fly off the roof?"

strings.text:
「飛んだというか、墜落してたけどね。
まぁ、飛びすぎて行方不明になられるよりは良かったかもしれないけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Well, more like crashed than flew.
Still, I guess it was better than him flying so high he'd go missing."

strings.text: 「昔、そんなおっさんが居たなぁ……。風船巻き付けて太平洋を横断するとかいって行方不明になった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There was an old guy like that once......he wrapped himself in balloons trying to cross the Pacific and disappeared."

strings.text: 相変わらずやることが吹っ飛んでるなぁ……明石は。
strings.translated: As always, the things he does are off the wall......Akashi.

strings.text: 「それで？　鳥谷もスカートめくられたのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So? Did Toritani get her skirt flipped too?"

strings.text: 「ん、んなわけないじゃない！　ってなんでそんな事聞くのよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "N-not a chance! And why are you even asking that?!"

strings.text: 別に他意は無いが。
strings.translated: Not that I had any ulterior motive.

strings.text: いや、普通に興味があってだな。
strings.translated: Just genuine curiosity.

strings.text: 「いや、別に他意は無いが。スカートめくられた鳥谷の反応が想像出来なくてな。恥ずかしがるのか、怒るのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no ulterior motive. I just couldn't picture how Toritani would react to having her skirt flipped. Would you be embarrassed, would you get angry......"

strings.text: 「いや、普通に興味があってだな。スカートめくられた鳥谷の反応が想像出来なくてな。恥ずかしがるのか、怒るのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, just genuine curiosity. I couldn't picture how Toritani would react to having her skirt flipped. Would you be embarrassed, would you get angry......"

strings.text:
「どっちもよ！　恥ずかしいし怒りもするわよ！
あと、ついでに殺すわ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Both! I'd be embarrassed AND I'd get angry!
And for good measure, I'd kill him!"

strings.text: 「なるほど、あいつも相手を見てやるのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahh, I see, so even he picks his targets......"

strings.text: 「それどういう意味かしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What is that supposed to mean?"

strings.text: 「別に」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Not really."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、去年までは圭の女装だけである程度は目を惹いてたけど、今年はそれだけじゃ心許ないんで、あんたにタキシード着てもらったわけよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Anyway, up until last year, Kei's crossdressing alone drew enough attention, but this year that alone won't cut it, so I had you put on a tuxedo."

strings.text:
「だから、その判断が全然理解出来ない。
俺のタキシードで新入部員が増えるとは思えないぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Like I said, I can't understand that decision at all.
I don't think my tuxedo is going to bring in new members."

strings.text: 「そんな事ないわよ。だいたい去年の新入部員って全員、あんた目当てだったんだから、そのタキシードは十分効果が見込めるわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's not true. All of last year's new members were there for you, so that tuxedo can be counted on to have plenty of effect."

strings.text: 「はぁ？　去年の新入部員って全員、俺目当て？　そんなバカな事ないだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? All of last year's new members were there for me? That can't be right."

strings.text:
「いやいや、それがあるんだよ。
去年の今頃ってさ、丁度、草薙健一郎が帰国した時期じゃない。そんで世間じゃ、その息子である草薙直哉にも注目が集まってたんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"No, no, it's true.
Around this time last year was exactly when Kusanagi Ken'ichirou came back to Japan. And the world's attention had spread to his son, Kusanagi Naoya, too."

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎の帰国って、それ俺と全然関係ないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Ken'ichirou returning has nothing at all to do with me."

strings.text: 「世間はそうは見てくれないわ。特にあんたは見てくれだけはいいからさ、去年は勘違いした女子達が草薙直哉目当てに入部してきたってわけよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The world doesn't see it that way. Especially since your looks aren't bad, all these mistaken girls joined last year targeting Kusanagi Naoya."

strings.text: 「んなアホな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That can't be..."

strings.text: 「一応、直哉もビラ配り手伝っただろ？　その時にときめいた女子が多かったんだってさ、“あれが今噂の天才芸術家の一人息子なのね！　素敵！”ってさ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You helped hand out flyers back then too, right, Naoya? A lot of girls got swept up seeing you then, saying stuff like 'That's the only son of that genius artist everyone's talking about! Amazing!'"

strings.text: 「そうか……なるほど」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see......so that's how it was."

strings.text: 「理解したか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You get it?"

strings.text: 「ああ、お前がその格好で女言葉使うと、はまりすぎてて怖いなぁと改めて認識させられた。“素敵！”の部分ですごい鳥肌が立った」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I've been made freshly aware that when you use girl-talk in that getup, it fits way too well and it's terrifying. The 'Amazing!' part gave me massive goosebumps."

strings.text: 「なんだよ！　それ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What the hell?! What's that supposed to mean?!"

strings.text: 「しかし、そんな事があったとは全然知らなかった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Still, I had no idea that had been going on."

strings.text: 「あんたは他人に興味が無いからね。とはいっても四月終わるのを待たずに全員やめたけどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's because you have no interest in others. Though every last one of them quit before April was even over."

strings.text: 「明石のセクハラによってか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because of Akashi's sexual harassment?"

strings.text:
「まぁ、私もそんな不純な動機で入られても困るから、たしかに明石先輩の行動は褒められたもんじゃないけど、そこまで責められないんだよねぇ。
微妙に胸をなで下ろした部分もあるって言うか……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Well, I'd have been in trouble too if people joined for such shallow reasons, so while Akashi-senpai's behavior definitely wasn't praiseworthy, I can't quite bring myself to blame him for it.
There's a part of me that was subtly relieved......"

strings.text: 「いや、迷惑な話だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it's still a nuisance."

strings.text: 「そうだよな。直哉は孤高な男だから、そんなミーハーどもに騒がれたら嫌だろうしな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Right, right. Naoya's a solitary man, so being fussed over by fangirls like that would just be annoying."

strings.text: 「何を勘違いしている。俺が迷惑だと思っているのは明石の行動だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You've got the wrong idea. What I find annoying is Akashi's behavior."

strings.text: 「俺としては、ファンの女子に囲まれて生活したかったから非常に残念だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Personally, I wanted to spend my life surrounded by fangirls, so it's extremely regrettable."

strings.text: 「ええ？　マジで？　直哉ってそういうの嫌いだと思ってたぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ehh? Seriously? I thought you'd hate that kind of stuff, Naoya."

strings.text: 「何言っている。自分をちやほやしてくれる人間が嫌いなヤツなどいるわけないだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you talking about. There's no such person as one who hates being fawned over."

strings.text: 「何言ってるんだよ。毎度マスコミとかがちやほやするとキレてたヤツが……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What are YOU talking about. You're the one who always snapped whenever the media fussed over you......"

strings.text: 「商売でちやほやするヤツは怖いから嫌だ。金が絡むと人は恐ろしいから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The ones who fawn over you for business are scary and I hate them. Money makes people terrifying."

strings.text: 「なんか含蓄があるんだか無いんだか分からない台詞だな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That's a line where I can't tell if it's profound or completely empty."

strings.text: 「だったら今年はファンゲットすればいいじゃない。その格好を見たら、あんたのファンなんていくらでも寄ってくるわよ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then why not go get some fangirls this year? If they see you in that getup, plenty of your fans will come flocking, don't you think?"

strings.text:
「なるほど、少しだけモチベーションが上がったかもしれん。
何事も、自分の利益になると思うとやる気は出るものだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I see, my motivation may have risen slightly.
When you think there's something in it for you, you find you can put in the effort no matter what."

strings.text: 「マジで、直哉それでいいのか？　なんか俺の中の草薙直哉像が崩れたぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Seriously, Naoya, are you okay with that? My internal image of Kusanagi Naoya just crumbled."

strings.text: 「そうやって、勝手な俺像作るヤツも嫌いだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I also hate people who go around building their own arbitrary images of me."

strings.text: 「なんで俺を嫌いになるっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why are you hating on me?!"

strings.text: 「まぁ、いいじゃない、それよりも圭はさっき渡したマニュアルあるでしょ？　あの通りしゃべるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, whatever, more importantly, Kei, you have the script I gave you earlier, right? Say it exactly as it's written."

strings.text: 「マジであのマニュアルを使うのですか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You seriously want me to use that script?"

strings.text: 圭はスカートのポケットから一枚のプリントを取り出した。
strings.translated: Kei pulled a printout from his skirt pocket.

strings.text: 「そうそう。そこに書いてある台詞を忘れないようにね♪」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. Don't forget the lines written there, 'kay?"

strings.text: 「えっと……“みんな、学園生活エンジョイしちゃったりしてる？　私、美術部のアイドル・夏目圭！　ナッキーって呼んでネ！（ここで片足上げてウインク）」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Um...... 'Are you all enjoying your school life? I'm the idol of the art club, Natsume Kei! Call me Nakkii! (raise one leg here and wink)"

strings.text: 「みんなの熱いハートをキャンバスにぶつけて、私と一緒に、青春という名の素敵な作品を描いてみ・な・い？（人差し指を唇に添えながら上目遣いで）”」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Slam your burning hearts against the canvas, and together with me, why don't you paint a wonderful masterpiece called youth? (place index finger against lips and look up through lashes)'"

strings.text: 「圭……すごい汗だぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kei......you're sweating buckets......"

strings.text: 「このバカーッ！　お前、惑星破壊爆弾級の馬鹿だぞ！　絶対に脳みそ膿んでる！　もう大変危険な状態だから病院に行け！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You idiot! You're a planet-destroying-bomb-class idiot! Your brain has definitely rotted! You're in a seriously dangerous state, so go to a hospital!"

strings.text: 「ふぅ……。分かってないわね。どう考えても完璧な脚本よ。アカデミー賞脚本部門でも、１００年に一度拝めるか拝めないかの素晴らしい台本じゃないの」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sigh...... You just don't get it. No matter how you look at it, it's a perfect script. It's the kind of magnificent script that even the Academy Awards Best Screenplay category might not see once in a hundred years."

strings.text: 「１００年に一度発生したとしても大問題だと思うぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even if it only appeared once every hundred years, I think it'd still be a major problem......"

strings.text: 「ちなみに草薙用はこっちよ。特別マニュアルが用意してあるわ。この台詞と共にチラシを配るのよっ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "By the way, here's the one for Kusanagi. I've prepared a special manual. Hand out flyers along with these lines!"

strings.text: 食い下がる圭を無視して、鳥谷はマニュアルを懐から取り出すと、俺の手元へと押し付けた。
strings.translated: Ignoring Kei as he pressed his objections, Toritani pulled a manual from her breast pocket and shoved it into my hand.

strings.text: 「何々……“君の素敵な瞳をより輝かせるためには、精神のエステティックが必要なのさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Let's see...... 'To make your lovely eyes shine even brighter, what you need is spiritual aesthetics."

strings.text: 「僕と一緒に、キャンバスに愛の未来予想図を描いて見ないか？　二人の想いを溶かした絵の具で、世界に一枚だけの作品を育もう……”」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Won't you join me and paint a vision of love's future on this canvas? With paint mixed from both our feelings, let's nurture a one-of-a-kind work of art......'"

strings.text: 「はははは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hahaha......"

strings.text: 「どうよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well?"

strings.text: 「精神のエステティックが必要なのはおまえじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Isn't the one who needs spiritual aesthetics you?"

strings.text: 「どういう意味かしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What's that supposed to mean?"

strings.text: 「お前は疲れている……疲れているんだと思うぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're tired......I think you're just tired."

strings.text:
「なるほど……たしかにそれはあるわね。
最近私疲れてるのかもしれないし……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"I see......yeah, that's certainly part of it.
I might be a bit worn out lately......"

strings.text: 「うむ、今日は早く帰って寝ればいいと思う」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Mm, I think you should head home early today and get some sleep."

strings.text: 「いいえ、そんな心配しなくても大丈夫よ！　私はあんた達の仕事見届けないといけないからね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "No, don't worry about me! I have to see your work through to the end, after all."

strings.text: 「今の舌打ち何？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What was that tongue-click just now?"

strings.text: 「風の音じゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wasn't it the sound of the wind?"

strings.text: 「うわん。お願いだから冗談と言ってくれくださいくだされ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wahh. Please, please, pretty please tell me you're joking!"

strings.text: 「あー時間の無駄。無駄だから！　ほらほら、とっととチラシ配ってくる。それ、全部配り終わるまで、美術部の敷居は跨がせない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ahh, waste of time. Total waste! Come on, hurry up and go hand out the flyers. Until every single one is gone, you're not setting foot back inside the art club."

strings.text: 「とりあえず分かった！　俺は、あの部室を俺信者の巣窟にして、俺の好き勝手できる様に変えてやる！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Fine, got it! I'll turn that clubroom into a den of my devotees and remake it into a place where I can do whatever I please!"

strings.text: 「いいんじゃないの？　わりかし本当にそうなるかもしれないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sounds good, doesn't it? That might actually end up being fairly accurate."

strings.text: 「さて、圭くんがんばってビラまきましょうかねっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well then, Kei-kun, shall we go do our best handing out flyers?"

strings.text: 「うわん、お前の動機も不純すぎだぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wahh, your motives are way too impure too!"

strings.text: 「うう、何か股のところがスースーするぞ……悲しい気分だぞ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ugh, my crotch area feels all drafty...... this is making me sad......"

strings.text: 「圭。できれば、俺の半径２ｍ以内に近寄らないようにな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kei. If possible, don't come within a two-meter radius of me."

strings.text: 「なんで！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why?!"

strings.text: 「お前の仲間と思われるのは嫌だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't want to be taken for one of your kind."

strings.text: 「な、なにぃをー！？　お前なぁー」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wh-what did you say?! Why you--"

strings.text: 「ほら、そんな格好で怒るな。そんなぴょんぴょん跳ねてるとスカートめくれそうだぞう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey, don't get mad dressed like that. If you keep bouncing around like that your skirt's gonna flip up."

strings.text: 「うわぁ、ま、マジか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Whoa, s-seriously?"

strings.text: 「それよりも<r アンフィテアトルム>半円形劇場</r>の辺りで一気に配るぞ。とっとと終わらせる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyway, let's hand them all out at once around the amphitheater. Get it over with quick."

strings.text: 「ええっ！？　そんな場所に行ったら人がたくさん来るぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Whaat?! If we go to a place like that, tons of people will show up!"

strings.text: 「いや、だから、人が沢山くるところで配ればあっという間に終わる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's the point. If you hand them out where lots of people are, we'll be done in no time."

strings.text:
「うわん！　直哉は俺に対する<r いたわ>労</r>りなり<r ゆうあい>友愛</r>なり無いのか！
こんな姿を大勢にさらせというのか！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"Wahh! Naoya, do you have no sympathy or friendship for me whatsoever!
Are you telling me to expose myself in this outfit in front of a huge crowd?!"

strings.text: 圭はすでに半ベソである。しかし、いい具合に羞恥心が体中に漲ってきており、マニア受けしそうな雰囲気に仕上がってきているのではないだろうか。
strings.translated: Kei was already half in tears. But in a good way, his embarrassment was surging through his whole body, giving him an aura that would probably appeal to a certain kind of enthusiast.

strings.text: よく見ると、周囲の生徒たちが、カメラ付き携帯で圭の艶姿を次々に収めていたりする。
strings.translated: Looking closely, students around us were snapping shot after shot of Kei's alluring figure with their camera phones.

strings.text: どうやら、毎年のイベントにすでに予測してる連中もいる様で、ご丁寧に一眼レフを用意しているヤツもいる。
strings.translated: It seemed some had already anticipated this annual event -- there were even guys who had thoughtfully brought along DSLRs.

strings.text: しかし、この話題性が、部員獲得にどういう風に繋がるのかは……まったくもって謎である。
strings.translated: But just how this whole spectacle actually translated into gaining new members......was a complete mystery.

strings.text: とりあえず、俺たちは放課後も数多くの生徒が集う、<r アンフィテアトルム>半円形劇場</r>がある中央広場へと足を運んだ。
strings.translated: In any case, we made our way to the central plaza where the amphitheater stood, a place where many students still gathered after school.

strings.text: ……もちろん、圭とは等間隔を保ちながら。
strings.translated: ......Keeping a proper distance from Kei, of course.

strings.text:
「直哉……お前、俺と距離取りすぎだぞ……。
本当に優しさの欠片もないな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"Naoya......you're keeping way too much distance from me......
You really don't have a shred of kindness."

strings.text: 「今更だ。お前になど優しさなど欠片も与えてやるか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Bit late for that. Why would I give someone like you even a shred of kindness......"

strings.text: 「ううう……直哉は本当に俺に厳しいぞ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Uuu......Naoya, you're really harsh with me......"

strings.text: すでに教会前広場には他部の勧誘部員たちが並び立ち、新入生をメインターゲットとした勧誘合戦が始まっている。
strings.translated: In the plaza in front of the chapel, recruiters from other clubs were already lined up, and the battle to recruit new students -- the main targets -- had already begun.

strings.text: この厳しい戦況を踏まえて、勧誘合戦に新規参入をするのは中々に勇気がいりそうだが……。
strings.translated: Given how fierce this battlefield was, it would take considerable courage to enter the recruitment war as a new participant......

strings.text: まさか、手にしたチラシをゴミ箱に突っ込んでバックレるわけには行くまい。
strings.translated: Still, we couldn't very well stuff the flyers into a trash can and ditch out.

strings.text: 俺たちは、軽く溜め息をついて、教会入り口に近い場所に陣取ることにした。
strings.translated: With a small sigh, we staked out a spot near the chapel entrance.

strings.text: 「はぁ……んじゃ、さっさとチラシ配って撤収しましょう」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Haa...... All right, let's hand these out quick and pull back."

strings.text: 「そうだな。看板娘」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. Mascot girl."

strings.text: 「はい、はい……もうどうにでもなれな気分がします」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yes, yes...... I'm getting to the whatever-happens-happens mood."

strings.text: 「まったくこんな事……真琴がやれば一番いいのに」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Seriously, this kind of thing......it'd be way better if Makoto did it."

strings.text: 「そういえば、何であいつはやらないんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, why doesn't she?"

strings.text: 「俺もそれを突っ込んだんだよ、そしたらな“私はいつも仕事でやってるからレア度が低すぎて商品価値がないわ”だってさ。おかしいだろ？　別に学校中がキマイラの常連なわけじゃあるまいし」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I asked her that too, and she said, 'I do this all the time at work, so my rarity value is too low to have any commodity value.' Isn't that weird? It's not like the whole school are regulars at Chimera or anything."

strings.text: 「まぁ、意味不明な言い分ではあるな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, it's certainly incomprehensible reasoning."

strings.text: とは言っても本当のところ、あいつの事だから新部長就任に関する事務処理に追われてるんだろう。
strings.translated: That said, the truth is, knowing her, she's probably swamped with paperwork related to her taking over as the new club president.

strings.text: 廃部の危険は無いと言ってたが、部員が二人となればそんな悠長に事を構えても居られないだろう。目には見えない場所でかなりがんばっているハズだ。
strings.translated: She said there was no danger of the club being shut down, but with only two members left, she can't afford to take things easy either. She must be working hard in ways that aren't visible.

strings.text: まぁ、鳥谷真琴というヤツは基本的にはそういうヤツだ。
strings.translated: Well, that's just the kind of person Toritani Makoto is at heart.

strings.text: 見ると、他の部の大半は、道行く生徒たちに半ば押し付けるようにチラシを配っていた。
strings.translated: Looking around, most of the other clubs were practically forcing flyers onto passing students.

strings.text: 圭もそれに倣うかの如く、眼前を通る生徒に片っ端からチラシを差し出していた。開き直ったかのように、実に堂々と。
strings.translated: As if following their lead, Kei was thrusting flyers at every student who passed in front of him. With utter shamelessness, and quite proudly at that.

strings.text: 「美術部だぞ、入るといいと思う」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's the art club, I think you should join."

strings.text: チラシを差し出された方も、これほどの美少女に渡されたものを受け取らないわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: The people being handed flyers couldn't very well refuse something from such a beautiful girl.

strings.text: 新入生のみならず、２～３年生の生徒もうれしそうに圭のチラシを受け取る。
strings.translated: Not only new students, but second- and third-years happily accepted Kei's flyers as well.

strings.text: 俺もチラシを配る事にする。
strings.translated: I decided to hand out flyers too.

strings.text: 「あははは、君の素敵な瞳をより輝かせるためには、精神のエステティックが必要なのさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahaha, to make your lovely eyes shine even brighter, what you need is spiritual aesthetics."

strings.text: 「僕と一緒に、キャンバスに愛の未来予想図を描いて見ないか？　二人の想いを溶かした絵の具で、世界に一枚だけの作品を育もう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Won't you join me and paint a vision of love's future on this canvas? With paint mixed from both our feelings, let's nurture a one-of-a-kind work of art."

strings.text: 「な、直哉、あんなにバカにしてた台詞言ってるし……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "N-Naoya, you're really saying those lines you were mocking so hard......"

strings.text: 「あ？　これか？　こんなもので俺の信者が集まるのなら、俺は平気でこんな浮ついた呪文でも唱えるぜ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? These? If they'll bring my devotees to me, I don't mind chanting flimsy little incantations like these."

strings.text: 「呪文って……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Incantations, huh......"

strings.text: やや強めの風が、校庭の隅に咲き誇る、桜の木々の花弁を運んでくる。
strings.translated: A somewhat strong wind carried petals from the cherry trees blooming in the corner of the schoolyard.

strings.text: 風は、地面に舞い落ちた櫻をも巻き上げ、視界の端々を薄紅の斑点で彩っていた。
strings.translated: The wind lifted the fallen cherry blossoms from the ground too, dotting the edges of my vision with pale crimson specks.

strings.text: 「わ、わわっ、スカートがっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wa-waah, my skirt--"

strings.text: 横切る風と時を同じくして、スカートの裾を押さえる看板娘。
strings.translated: At the same moment as the wind cut across, the mascot girl was holding down the hem of her skirt.

strings.text: 「あうー、こんなもん履いてよく生活できんなー。女子は偉大だな直哉ぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Uhh, how do girls live wearing this stuff. Girls are amazing, Naoyaa."

strings.text: 「先ほどから、その行動……まさか、下も……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That gesture just now...... don't tell me, underneath......"

strings.text: 「ん？　なんだ直哉？　俺のボクサーパンツに興味があるのか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Hm? What is it, Naoya? Are you interested in my boxer briefs?"

strings.text: 「ははは……貴様コロすぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hahaha...... I'll kill you, you bastard......"

strings.text: ――などと、俺たちがトホホな会話を交わしていた時である。
strings.translated: --It was just as we were exchanging that pathetic sort of banter.

strings.text: 桜が舞い散る広場。
strings.translated: The plaza where cherry blossoms danced and fell.

strings.text: 印象的な髪がその花弁の中に舞う。
strings.translated: That distinctive hair swayed among the petals.

strings.text: 人だかりになっている広場に、ひょっこりと現れたのは、御桜稟であった。
strings.translated: Popping up in the crowded plaza was Misakura Rin.

strings.text: 「稟か、取り巻きに囲まれていたと思ったが？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin, huh. I thought you were surrounded by your entourage?"

strings.text:
「取り巻きなんかじゃないよ。そんな言い方失礼です。
転校生だからみんな優しくしてくれてるだけなんだから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"They're not an entourage. It's rude to call them that.
Everyone's just being kind because I'm the transfer student."

strings.text: いや、いや、やつらのそれは下心満載の優しさだよ。
strings.translated: No, no, that kindness of theirs is loaded up with ulterior motives.

strings.text: 「んで何やってるんだ？　稟」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So, what are you up to, Rin?"

strings.text: 「少し校内を見学させてもらってました。なんかめずらしい建築が多いですからね。弓張学園は」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I was having a look around the school. Yumihari Academy has a lot of unusual architecture, doesn't it."

strings.text: 「そうだな。お前建築とか興味があるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's true. Are you interested in architecture or something?"

strings.text: 「興味ってほどじゃないんですけど、なんか気になるものも多くて……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's not that I'm interested exactly, but there are just a lot of things that catch my eye......"

strings.text: 「気になるもの？　たとえば？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Things that catch your eye? Like what?"

strings.text: 「あ、礼拝堂とかですかね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, the chapel, for instance."

strings.text: 「礼拝堂か、まぁ、たしかに学校に礼拝堂がある場所はめずらしいからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The chapel, huh. Well, it's certainly rare for a school to have a chapel."

strings.text: とは言っても<r アンフィテアトルム>半円形劇場</r>がある方がめずらしいと思うが……。
strings.translated: Though I'd say having an amphitheater is even rarer......

strings.text: 「あの礼拝堂って、内装と外装のギャップがすごくて、見てて感動してました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That chapel -- the gap between its interior and exterior is amazing. I was moved just looking at it."

strings.text: 「内装と外装のギャップ？　そうなの？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The gap between interior and exterior? Is that so?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、すみません。ただの私感です。芸術の素養が無いので、たぶん物珍しいのでしょうね。それより草薙くんは何をされてるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, sorry. That's just my personal impression. I have no education in art, so it's probably just novelty to me. More importantly, what are you doing, Kusanagi-kun?"

strings.text: 「見ての通り……と言いたいところだが……こほん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As you can see......is what I'd like to say, but...... ahem."

strings.text: 「君の素敵な瞳をより輝かせるためには、精神のエステティックが必要なのさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "To make your lovely eyes shine even brighter, what you need is spiritual aesthetics."

strings.text: 「え？　えぇ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Ehh?"

strings.text: 「普通に、稟ちゃんひいてるぞ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naturally, Rin-chan is put off......"

strings.text: 「ふわぁぁん……ぜ、是非……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Fuwaaan...... y-yes, please......"

strings.text: 「って、感動してる？　よ、良かったのかよ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wait, she's moved?! W-was that actually good?!"

strings.text:
「と、まぁ、こんなアホみたいな事をやってるわけだ。
こんな格好してだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"So, well, this is the kind of stupid thing we're doing.
Dressed up like this."

strings.text:
「で、でも草薙くんのタキシードかっこいいよ。
あんな台詞も言われて、私的にはすごく得した気分でしたし、すごくときめきました！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"B-but your tuxedo looks great, Kusanagi-kun.
And being told those lines, personally I felt like I really got a treat, and my heart really fluttered!"

strings.text: 「そうか、まぁ、お世辞でも言われるとうれしいかな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so. Well, even if it's just flattery, it's nice to be told."

strings.text: 「良かったな。直哉。かっこいいってさ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Good for you, Naoya. She said you look cool!"

strings.text: 「あ、あの……よろしいでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um......may I?"

strings.text: 「初めまして。私は御桜稟といいます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nice to meet you. My name is Misakura Rin."

strings.text: 「は、初めまして！？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "N-nice to meet you?!"

strings.text: 「え？　あの……違いましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Um......is that wrong?"

strings.text: 「あははは、違うものか、こっちが美術部の看板娘をなさっている夏目圭子さんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ahaha, of course not. This is Natsume Keiko-san, our art club's mascot girl."

strings.text:
「夏目圭子さん？
え？　それって……あのもしかして……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Natsume Keiko-san?
Eh? Which means......don't tell me......"

strings.text: 「い、いや違うぞ！　それは違う！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "N-no, that's wrong! That's wrong!"

strings.text: 「夏目圭さんの妹さん？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You're Natsume Kei-san's little sister?"

strings.text:
「よく気がついたな！
稟。その通りだ、朝会った夏目圭の妹だ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Sharp of you to notice!
Rin. That's right, this is Natsume Kei's little sister, the one you met this morning!"

strings.text: 「な、直哉、お前何を！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "N-Naoya, what are you--"

strings.text: 「そうなんだ。たしかに圭子さんはお兄さんそっくりだと思ったんですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see. I did think Keiko-san looked just like her brother."

strings.text: 「にゃー！　なんでそうなる！！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Nyaa! How did it turn out like this!!"

strings.text: なにやら言い訳モードに入ろうとした圭を遮るように、俺は稟へとチラシを差し出した。
strings.translated: Cutting off Kei just as he was about to launch into excuse mode, I held a flyer out to Rin.

strings.text: 「これでも持っていくといい。これからの稟の人生に何かの役に立つ事もあるだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Take one of these, at least. It might come in handy at some point in your life going forward, Rin."

strings.text: 「あ、チラシ。ありがとう大切にするよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, a flyer. Thanks, I'll treasure it."

strings.text: 「そうか、そう言ってもらえれば作ったヤツもうれしいだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so. Hearing that would probably make the person who made it happy."

strings.text: 「いや！　そ、その前にだ稟ちゃん……。むぎゅ！　むぎゅぐゅっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "No! B-before that, Rin-chan...... Mgggh! Mmgh-gyu!"

strings.text: 言い訳しようとする圭の前に立ち、稟に見えないように後ろ手でアイアンクローをかけて口封じを敢行する。
strings.translated: Stepping in front of Kei as he tried to make excuses, I reached behind him where Rin couldn't see and clamped an iron claw over his mouth to shut him up.

strings.text: 「っむ、むーむーむー！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Mmgh, mmgh, mmgh!"

strings.text: 「んじゃ、俺たちもこれ配らなきゃいけないからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, we've still got these to hand out too."

strings.text: 「うん、ごめんなさい。時間取らせて……とりあえず私はまだ校内の探索途中なので、失礼します」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Right, sorry for taking your time...... I'm still in the middle of exploring the campus, so if you'll excuse me."

strings.text: 「ああ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 稟はペコリと頭を下げると、チラシを手に人混みに消えていく。
strings.translated: Rin gave a small bow and vanished into the crowd with the flyer in hand.

strings.text: 「な、直哉っ、てめえ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "N-Naoya, you bastard!"

strings.text: 「なんだじゃねぇだろ！！　稟ちゃんが勘違いしたまま行っちまったぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Don't 'what' me!! Rin-chan left with the wrong idea in her head!"

strings.text: 「ほう……ならば、本当の事を言ったほうが良かったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh...... would it have been better to tell her the truth, then?"

strings.text: 「夏目圭は女装好きのヘンタイです。スカートをはいていないと落ち着きません……って？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Natsume Kei is a crossdressing pervert. He can't relax unless he's wearing a skirt......like that?"

strings.text:
「お前は本当に意地悪だなぁ……。
おれが好きでこんなまねしてるんじゃない事ぐらい知ってるだろうに」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You really are mean-spirited...... You know it's not like I'm doing this because I want to."

strings.text: 「どっちにしてもだ。対面二度目でいきなり女装みせられたら、間違いなく稟はお前をヘンタイと思うだろう。それで良かったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Either way. If you show up in girls' clothes the second time you two meet, Rin's going to think you're a pervert for sure. Would you have been okay with that?"

strings.text: 「うう……、それはイヤだなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Uuu......no, I wouldn't want that."

strings.text:
「まぁ、いいじゃないか。
とりあえず残りをとっとと配ってしまおう……帰れなくなるぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Well, it's fine then.
Anyway, let's hurry up and finish handing out the rest...... or we won't be going home."

strings.text: 「そうだな……」
strings.speaker: 圭

strings.text: 「チラシもらえますか」
strings.translated: "Can I have a flyer?"

strings.text:
一人の少女が立ち止まり手を差し出す。
新入生らしかったが、静かなたたずまいであったが、何故か微妙に尊大な態度に思えた。
strings.translated:
A girl stopped and held out her hand.
She seemed to be a new student, and though her bearing was quiet, somehow her attitude felt subtly haughty.

strings.text: 「えっと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 「……セクハラ？」
strings.translated: "......Sexual harassment?"

strings.text: 「セクハラちゃうわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not sexual harassment."

strings.text: 「ならば……なんですか？　それ？」
strings.translated: "Then...... what is it? That?"

strings.text: チラシを手渡した少女はこれ以上ないぐらい怪訝な顔で俺を見つめる。
strings.translated: The girl I'd handed the flyer to stared at me with the most dubious expression imaginable.

strings.text: 「そ、そう改めて聞かれると……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well, when you put it that way......"

strings.text: 「よく分からない事をしないでください。不愉快です」
strings.translated: "Please don't do things I can't understand. It's unpleasant."

strings.text: 「それで、このチラシは弓張の美術部のものですよね……」
strings.translated: "So, this flyer is for Yumihari's art club, correct......?"

strings.text: 「ああそうだ。興味があるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. You interested?"

strings.text:
「という事はあなたは弓張美術部員という事ですよね。
お聞きしたいのですが、市役所に貼られてる絵を描いた人知っていますか？」
strings.translated:
"Which would mean you're a member of Yumihari's art club, right?
I wanted to ask -- do you know who painted the picture on display at the city hall?"

strings.text: 「は？　何それ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? What's that about?"

strings.text: 「弓張市役所に貼られてる大きな桜の絵です。市のパンフレットなんかにも載っているわりかし有名なものなのですが……」
strings.translated: "The large cherry blossom painting displayed at Yumihari City Hall. It's featured in the city's pamphlets and is fairly well known......"

strings.text: 「市役所に貼られている絵の事なんか知らないが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't know anything about paintings displayed at city hall."

strings.text: 「そうですか？　たしかこの学校の生徒だって聞いてましたが、美術部の方では無いという事でしょうか……」
strings.translated: "Is that so? I heard the artist was a student at this school, so I thought......perhaps not from the art club, then?"

strings.text: 「ＯＢじゃないか？　この学校のやつが描いたものが市役所に貼られているなんて聞いた事ないぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "An alumnus, maybe? I've never heard of anyone from this school having their work displayed at city hall."

strings.text: 「たしかに在校生だって聞きました。たしか草薙……」
strings.translated: "I'm certain I was told it was a current student. I believe the name was Kusanagi......"

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎か？　たしかにあいつはここのＯＢではあるが、あいつの絵が市役所なんかに置いてないぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Ken'ichirou? He is an alumnus of this place, but none of his paintings are displayed at any city hall."

strings.text: 「私でも草薙健一郎が故人である事は知ってます。草薙健一郎の作品ではありません」
strings.translated: "Even I know that Kusanagi Ken'ichirou is deceased. It isn't a work by Kusanagi Ken'ichirou."

strings.text: 「だったら聞き間違いだろ。草薙なんて言うやつで、そんな絵描いたやついないぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then you must've heard wrong. There's no one named Kusanagi who painted anything like that."

strings.text: 「草薙直哉よ」
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Naoya."

strings.text: 「直哉？　何？　え？　草薙直哉って？　俺？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Naoya? What? Huh? Kusanagi Naoya, you mean......me?"

strings.text: 「まじめに配っているか偵察しに来たんだけど、まぁまぁ、ちゃんとやっているみたいね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I came to check whether you were handing them out seriously, but well, looks like you're doing the job properly."

strings.text: 「それよりも鳥谷、その市役所の絵の話だが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Never mind that, Toritani -- about this city hall painting......"

strings.text: 「あんたねぇ……。自分の絵がどこに貼られてるかぐらい知っておきなさいよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Really, you...... You should at least know where your own paintings are displayed."

strings.text: 「いや、そもそも何で俺の絵がそんな場所に？　というかどの絵だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, why is my painting in a place like that to begin with? Which one, even?"

strings.text: 「六年前の絵。あなたが描いた最後の作品よ。『櫻日狂想』」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The one from six years ago. The last work you ever painted. 'Sakura Day Rhapsody.'"

strings.text:
「『櫻日狂想』……ああ、あの桜の絵か？
何でそれがそんな場所に貼られてるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"'Sakura Day Rhapsody'......ah, that cherry blossom painting?
Why the hell is that displayed in a place like that......"

strings.text: 「あの時、絵をほしがったおっさんいただろ？　なんかお金出すから買わせてほしいって」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Remember that old guy who wanted the painting back then? Said he'd pay for it and begged you to sell?"

strings.text: 「そうだっけ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Did that happen?"

strings.text: 「うん、お前喜んで売ってたぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, you sold it to him gladly."

strings.text: 「いくらで？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For how much?"

strings.text: 「たしか一万円とか言ってたかな？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I think you said around ten thousand yen?"

strings.text: 「そりゃお得だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's a bargain for him."

strings.text: 「何がお得よ……あれその後転売されて百数十万円になったのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What bargain......after that, it was resold for over a million yen."

strings.text: 「マジで？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For real?"

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎の息子って事もあったんでしょうけど、あの当時マスコミとかでも取り上げられてたじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The fact that you're Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's son probably had something to do with it, but the media made a huge fuss about it at the time, didn't they."

strings.text: 「そうなのか？　全然知らないぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so? I had no idea."

strings.text: 「だって、お前テレビ見ない上に、取材とか全部拒否してたじゃん」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, you don't watch TV, and you refused every interview request."

strings.text: 「取材？　そんなの来た記憶ないが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Interviews? I don't recall anything like that coming......"

strings.text: 「お前、父親の事聞かれていると勘違いして、すげぇ無視してたぞ……何聞かれても“知らない”“親父に聞け”の一点張りで……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You mistook them for asking about your father and totally ignored them...... No matter what they asked, you just kept saying 'I don't know' and 'ask my dad'......"

strings.text: 「そんな事があったのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Something like that happened......?"

strings.text:
むむむ……。
あまり世相の事に興味がないといえども、自分がその世相を騒がしていた時期があった事すら知らなかったとは……。
strings.translated:
Hmmm......
Even if I have no interest in the state of the world, to not even know there was a time when I was making waves in it......

strings.text: というか、何で俺なんかがそんな注目されたのだろう……。意味が分からん。
strings.translated: Then again, why did someone like me get that kind of attention......? It makes no sense.

strings.text: 「その後、市に寄付されたのよ。今も市役所の入り口に貼ってあるわよ。あんたの絵」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "After that, it was donated to the city. It's still on display at the entrance to the city hall. Your painting."

strings.text: 「マジかよ！　恥ずかしいじゃねぇか！　剥がしに行く！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Are you kidding me?! That's embarrassing! I'm going to go tear it down!"

strings.text: 「あほ？　んな事出来るわけないでしょ。百数十万とか払えるの？　だいたい売ったのはあんたよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Are you an idiot? Like you could do that. Can you afford to pay back over a million yen? Besides, you're the one who sold it."

strings.text: 「う……そ、それはそうだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ugh......w-well, that's true, but......"

strings.text: あんな絵、一万円でも高いと思ったのに、百万越えとかになってたとは……。
strings.translated: I'd thought even ten thousand yen was too much for that painting, and yet it had gone for over a million......

strings.text: くそぉ……あの時のジジィだましたな。人が良さそうな顔して、一万で買ったもんを百万越えで転売するとは、なんてあくどいやつなんだ。
strings.translated: Damn it......that old geezer swindled me back then. Putting on that friendly face and then flipping a painting he bought for ten thousand yen for over a million -- what an unscrupulous bastard.

strings.text: 「あの絵を描いたのがあなたなのですか……」
strings.translated: "So you're the one who painted that picture......"

strings.text: 「さぁな。俺自身それを見たわけじゃないから知らないが……、そういう事になっているらしいな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who knows. I've never seen it myself, so I can't say......but apparently that's how it turned out."

strings.text: 「なるほど……あれからだいぶ雰囲気が変わったという事ですか……」
strings.translated: "I see......so you've changed quite a bit in atmosphere since then, is that it......"

strings.text: 「あれから雰囲気が変わった？　何の話だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Changed in atmosphere since then? What are you talking about?"

strings.text: 「いいえ、こちらの話です。よくよく見たら相変わらずのアホ面ですし」
strings.translated: "No, I was talking to myself. Looking more carefully, you still have that same idiotic face as ever."

strings.text: 「アホ面ってなんだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What do you mean, idiotic face!"

strings.text: 「それより、あなた市役所の絵を見て思うところがあったなんて、見込みあるじゃない。名前はなんと言うのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Setting that aside, the fact that you had thoughts about a painting at city hall means you show promise. What's your name?"

strings.text: 優美
strings.translated: Yumi

strings.text: 「川内野優美です」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Kawachino Yumi."

strings.text: 「川内野……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kawachino......"

strings.text:
川内野……。
なんだろう、微妙に聞き覚えがある様な無い様な……。
strings.translated:
Kawachino......
What is it, I feel like I've vaguely heard that name before, or maybe not......

strings.text: ……いや、こんな女は記憶にない。
strings.translated: ......No, I don't remember any girl like this.

strings.text: 「そう、私は鳥谷真琴。美術部の部長よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I see. I'm Toritani Makoto. President of the art club."

strings.text: 「そうなのですか……。草薙直哉が部長ではないのですか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Is that so......? Kusanagi Naoya isn't the president?"

strings.text: 「俺は部長も何も、美術部員ですらない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "President, nothing -- I'm not even a member of the art club."

strings.text: 「そうなのですか？　草薙直哉は美術部ではない。なるほど……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Is that so? Kusanagi Naoya isn't in the art club. I see......"

strings.text: 「納得出来ないと思わない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Don't you find that unacceptable?"

strings.text: 「いいえ、それはそれで良いのですが……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "No, that's fine as it is, but......"

strings.text: 「へ？　いいの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? It is?"

strings.text: 「はい、それよりも私の後ろの女性の方々の対応をした方が良いかと……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Yes. More importantly, I think you should attend to the group of women behind me......"

strings.text: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: Schoolgirl A

strings.text: 「あのー、あのー、今、草薙って聞こえたんですけど、もしかしてそっちのタキシードの方がそうなんですか？」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Um, um, we just heard the name Kusanagi -- could it be that the person in the tuxedo is him?"

strings.text: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: Schoolgirl B

strings.text: 「この前お亡くなりになった世界的芸術家の息子さんの、えっと、えっと草薙直哉さんでしたっけ？」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "The son of that world-renowned artist who passed away recently, um, um, Kusanagi Naoya-san, was it?"

strings.text: 女子校生Ｃ
strings.translated: Schoolgirl C

strings.text: 「テレビで見た草薙健一郎にそっくりだもん。息子さんですよね」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｃ
strings.translated: "He looks exactly like the Kusanagi Ken'ichirou I saw on TV. You're his son, right?"

strings.text: 「あ、ああ、そうだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah, that's right......"

strings.text: 「きゃー、本当に？」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Eeee, really?!"

strings.text: 「すごい、あの市役所の絵描いた人ですよね。この前、朝のテレビでやってました！」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "Amazing, you painted that city hall picture, right? They were showing it on morning TV just recently!"

strings.text: 「お父さん以上に気むずかしいって」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｃ
strings.translated: "They said you were even more difficult than your father."

strings.text: 「あ、ああ、そうなの？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, is that so?"

strings.text: 「でも、全然やさしそうじゃないですかー」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "But you don't seem difficult at all!"

strings.text: 「ああ、わりかし優しいよ……。特に君達みたいな可愛い女の子には……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, I'm fairly kind, you know...... Especially to cute girls like you......"

strings.text: 「きゃー、かわいいって言われたー」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "Eeee, he called me cute!"

strings.text: 「ああ、だから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, so here."

strings.text: 俺は笑顔で彼女達にチラシを配る。
strings.translated: I smiled as I handed them the flyers.

strings.text: 女子一同
strings.translated: All the Girls

strings.text: 「「「きゃー、かっこいいー」」」
strings.speaker: 女子一同
strings.translated: """Eeee, so cool!"""

strings.text:
「ってちょっと待って！
あなたたちは入部希望者なのね？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Wait, hold on!
You girls are here to join the club, right?"

strings.text: 「「「もちろんですっっ」」」
strings.speaker: 女子一同
strings.translated: """Of course we are!!"""

strings.text: 「んじゃ、こっちに来てもらえるかしら、いろいろと選考とかあるから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then, could you come over this way? There are various screening procedures to go through."

strings.text: はしゃいでいた新入生だけじゃなく、鳥谷の後を数人の女生徒が続く。
strings.translated: It wasn't just the excited new students -- several other female students followed after Toritani as well.

strings.text: 「なんだありゃ……どんどん増えていくぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What the hell......they just keep multiplying......"

strings.text: 「だから言っただろ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "See, I told you, didn't I?"

strings.text: 「はぁ……、本当にいるんだな……あんなの」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sigh......so people like that really do exist......"

strings.text:
「ああ、去年よりも多いなぁ。
草薙健一郎さんの葬式があったから連日ワイドショーとか取り上げてたみたいだけど、まさか直哉の絵までテレビ出てたとはなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, more than last year. The daytime shows had been running specials on Kusanagi Ken'ichirou-san because of the funeral, but I never thought your painting would make it onto TV too, Naoya."

strings.text:
「テレビも話題が無いだけだろ。
さてと……帰るか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"TV just has nothing to talk about, that's all.
Well then......shall we head home?"

strings.text: 「え？　帰るの？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Eh? You're going home?"

strings.text: 「ああ、あれだけ人数集めたんだ。もういいだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, we gathered plenty of people. That should be enough."

strings.text: 「人数的には問題ないかもしれないけど……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Numbers-wise it might be fine, but......"

strings.text: 「あくまでも鳥谷は部の存続のための人数がほしいんだろ。だったらあれで十分だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani just wants enough members to keep the club going, right? Then that's plenty."

strings.text: 「そうかもしれないけど……。これから選考やるって言ってたぞ。お前のファンが集まってるんだから、お前も選考に参加した方がいいんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Maybe so, but...... She said they were about to do the selection. Your fans are all gathered, so shouldn't you take part in the selection too?"

strings.text: 「何で？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why?"

strings.text: 「だって、これからお前の取り巻きになるファンの女の子だぞ。可愛い子とか従順な子とかの方がいいだろ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I mean, they're going to be the fan-girls hanging around you from now on, right? Wouldn't it be better if they were cute or obedient ones?"

strings.text: 「そうだな。そうかもしれない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You've got a point. Maybe so."

strings.text: 「だったら」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Then--"

strings.text:
「まぁ、その辺はちゃんと鳥谷が見てくれる。
あいつならちゃんと必要な人材だけを選べるだろう。
なんたって鳥谷は美術部部長なんだからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Well, Toritani will take care of that side of things.
She'll be able to select only the necessary personnel properly.
After all, she's the president of the art club."

strings.text: 「え？　それって……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? That means......"

strings.text: 「さぁ、帰るぞ。あれだけ集まれば、美術部も安泰だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on, let's go. With that many gathered, the art club will be safe."

strings.text: 「もしかしてお前、やっぱりファン取り巻きがほしいとか嘘で、美術部のために！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Don't tell me -- so you didn't actually want a fan following at all, you did it for the art club!"

strings.text: 「いいや、単に少しちやほやされたら飽きただけだ。他意は無いから帰るぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I just got tired after being fawned over a bit. There's no ulterior motive, so let's go."

strings.text: 「うん！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah!"

strings.text: 窓から差し込む夕日の光に紅く焼ける廊下。
strings.translated: The corridor burned crimson in the light of the setting sun spilling in through the windows.

strings.text: だるい気持ちで歩いていく。
strings.translated: I walked along with a listless feeling.

strings.text: さすがに、長時間ビラなど配らせられたので疲労感が体を支配していた。
strings.translated: After being made to hand out flyers for so long, exhaustion had taken over my body.

strings.text: 若田
strings.translated: Wakata

strings.text: 「なんだお前？」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "What are you doing here?"

strings.text: 「なんだお前じゃないだろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's my line......"

strings.text: 「ん？　草薙か……」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Hm? Kusanagi, is that you......"

strings.text: 「酒か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Booze?"

strings.text: 「んだよ……文句か？」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "What...... got a problem with it?"

strings.text: 「別に文句はないが、学校で酒呑んだらまずいんじゃないのか？　まだ勤務中だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No problem in particular, but isn't it a bad idea to drink at school? You're still on the clock, aren't you?"

strings.text: 「だからこうやって隠れながら呑んでいるんだろうが」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "That's why I'm hiding while I drink, isn't it."

strings.text: 「“だから”とかじゃないだろ……昼飯の件だけならまだしも、そんな姿見られたら確実にクビになるぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not the point...... The lunch thing was one thing, but if anyone sees you like this, you'll definitely get fired......"

strings.text: 「別に講義中に酒呑んでるわけじゃねぇからいいだろうに……あれだぞ、俺が学生時代なんかゼミの時間にはかならず酒のみながらやっていたぞ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "It's not like I'm drinking during a lecture, so it's fine...... Look, back in my student days I always used to drink during seminar hours."

strings.text: 「それも全然関係ないだろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's got absolutely nothing to do with anything......"

strings.text: 「そうだ草薙」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "That's right, Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「これやるよ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "You can have this."

strings.text: そう言って若田はウィスキーの瓶を俺に渡す。
strings.translated: With that, Wakata thrust a bottle of whiskey at me.

strings.text: 「バカは休み休み言え！　飲めるかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Give it a rest, idiot! Like I can drink that."

strings.text: 「なんだよ……おつまみだってあるのに……付き合い悪いなぁ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Come on......I've even got snacks with it......you're no fun."

strings.text: 「つまみって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Snacks, you say......"

strings.text: 若田の周りには豚丼が山の様に積み上げられていた。
strings.translated: Piled up around Wakata was a mountain of pork bowls.

strings.text: 「なんだそれは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is all that......"

strings.text: 「ん？　俺的なパーティー……豪華だろ？」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Hm? My own personal party......pretty luxurious, huh?"

strings.text: 「たしかに豪遊ではあるが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's extravagant, all right......"

strings.text: 「キムチ豚丼もあるぞ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "There's kimchi pork bowls too."

strings.text: 「そうか良かったな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, good for you."

strings.text: 「あげねぇからな」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Not sharing though."

strings.text: 「お前がそんな高級品を俺にくれるとは思ってない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I never thought you'd give me such a luxury item......"

strings.text: 「なるほど、正しい判断だな」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "I see. A sound judgment."

strings.text: 「……だいぶ酔っている様だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "......You're pretty drunk, aren't you."

strings.text: 「ん？　そうだな……まぁそういう時もあるって事だよ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Hm? Yeah......well, there are times like that too."

strings.text: 「大人にはとか言いそうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You look about to say something like 'when you're an adult...'"

strings.text: 「ははははは……そういうのに歳は関係ないだろ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Hahahaha......age has nothing to do with that sort of thing."

strings.text: 「そういうものなのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that how it is......"

strings.text: 「それよりも草薙」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "More importantly, Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is it."

strings.text: 「これやるから。持って行け」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "I'm giving this to you, so take it with you."

strings.text: 先ほどの酒瓶をまた俺につきだした。
strings.translated: He shoved the whiskey bottle from before at me again.

strings.text: 「だから何度言わせるんだよ。酒とか飲めないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How many times do I have to tell you? I can't drink alcohol."

strings.text: 「別に、今じゃなくてもいいんだよ。ウィスキーなんていくらでも保存効くからな……」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "You don't have to drink it now. Whiskey keeps for as long as you like......"

strings.text: 「お前が飲みたいと思った時に飲めばいいんだ……」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "You drink it whenever you feel like drinking it......"

strings.text: そう言って、俺にウィスキーの瓶を握らせる。
strings.translated: With that, he pressed the whiskey bottle into my hand.

strings.text:
「いつも金が無い無い、言っておきながら、いいのかよ？
貧乏人のお前にとっては、そんな酒でも高価じゃないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're always going on about how you have no money, and this is fine? For a poor guy like you, isn't a bottle like that expensive?"

strings.text: 「俺じゃなくても高価な酒だよ……見てみろよ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "It's expensive no matter who you are... take a look."

strings.text: 瓶に貼られたラベルを確認する。
strings.translated: I checked the label stuck to the bottle.

strings.text: 「って、これどんだけ年代物の酒だよ。３６年前の酒かよ！　酒の事はよく分からんが高いんだろ？　これ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whoa, how vintage is this stuff? Thirty-six years old? I don't know much about booze, but this must be pricey, right?"

strings.text: 「瓶詰めは１８年もの、ラベルに書かれている樽詰めした年。とりあえずシングルカスクのプレミアものだ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "It was bottled eighteen years ago. The year on the label is when it was put in the cask. In short, it's a premium single cask."

strings.text: ラベルに書かれた年数を見る。
strings.translated: I looked at the years written on the label.

strings.text: そんな俺を若田は表情を変えずに見つめる。
strings.translated: Wakata watched me without changing his expression.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wakata--"

strings.text: 「この酒、何の酒だよ……」
strings.translated: "What kind of booze is this..."

strings.text: と言いかけたが……。
strings.translated: I started to say, but...

strings.text: やめた。
strings.translated: I stopped.

strings.text: 「これで泥酔したわけじゃなさそうだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Doesn't look like this is what got you plastered..."

strings.text: ウィスキーの口は開いていたものの、中身はほとんど減っていない。
strings.translated: The whiskey was uncorked, but the contents had barely gone down.

strings.text: ほんの少しだけ呑んだのだろう……。
strings.translated: He must have had only the tiniest sip...

strings.text: 「今呑んでたのはこっちだ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "This is what I was drinking just now."

strings.text: そう言って若田は４Ｌと書かれたウィスキーのペットボトルを指さす。
strings.translated: With that, Wakata pointed at a four-liter plastic bottle of whiskey.

strings.text: 「お得サイズだな。いかにも身体に悪そうだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Economy size, huh. Looks distinctly bad for you..."

strings.text: 「バカ、身体に悪い酒なんかねぇよ……」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Idiot, there's no such thing as booze that's bad for you..."

strings.text: 「んなわけねぇだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Like hell there isn't..."

strings.text: 「んなわけある。それが真理なんだ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Like hell there is. That's the truth."

strings.text:
「何をめちゃくちゃな事を……、
とりあえずこの酒は預かっておく……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"You're not making any sense...
For now, I'll hold on to this bottle for you..."

strings.text:
「預かっておくじゃねぇよ。
それはもうお前のだ。好きな時に呑めよ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated:
"Don't say 'hold on to.'
That one's yours now. Drink it whenever you feel like it."

strings.text: 「好きな時って……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whenever I feel like it..."

strings.text: 「別に今日飲んだってかまわないぞ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "I don't mind if you drink it today, you know."

strings.text: 「だから学生に酒をすすめるなよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I already told you, don't push booze on a student."

strings.text:
「だったら呑める時が来たら、開ければいい。
……ウィスキーって言うのはそういうもんだ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated:
"Then open it when the time comes that you can drink.
...That's what whiskey is."

strings.text: 「そういうもんだ。幸福と同じなんだよ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "That's what it is. It's the same as happiness."

strings.text: 「意味分からん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't get it."

strings.text: 「ガキには分からんだろうな」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "A kid wouldn't."

strings.text: 「俺もそろそろ帰ろうかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "I guess it's about time I headed home too..."

strings.text: そう言って、若田は豚丼の束を準備室の方に持っていく。
strings.translated: With that, Wakata carried the stack of pork bowls off toward the prep room.

strings.text: 準備室にはこいつが持ち込んだ冷蔵庫があり、食品を備蓄する事が出来る。
strings.translated: In the prep room he had a refrigerator he'd brought in himself, so he could stockpile food there.

strings.text: 当然、コンロや電子レンジ、各種食器も揃えてある。
strings.translated: Naturally, he had a stove, a microwave, and all sorts of dishes too.

strings.text: 今更だが、昼間の悪巧み三人の内の一人がこの男だ。
strings.translated: It's a bit late to mention it, but this man is one of the three schemers from lunchtime.

strings.text: 若田清二郎。
strings.translated: Wakata Seijirou.

strings.text: 独身の非常勤である。
strings.translated: An unmarried part-time teacher.

strings.text: 「そう言えば昼飯。いつもよりうまかったな？　何でだ？」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, lunch was tastier than usual, wasn't it? Why was that?"

strings.text: 「んなもん、タケノコ入ってるからに決まってるだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's obvious, isn't it? There were bamboo shoots in it."

strings.text: 「ああ、あれってタケノコなのか、肉ではないと思ったが……」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Ah, so those were bamboo shoots? I didn't think it was meat, but..."

strings.text: というぐらいの料理などと無縁な独身っぷりである。
strings.translated: That's how utterly divorced from cooking his bachelor life was.

strings.text: 「とりあえず豚丼は食うなよ。俺の貴重な財産」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "For now, don't eat my pork bowls. My precious property."

strings.text: 「ああ、俺は食わない。でもそんなところに置いておくと誰かに食われるぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I'm not going to. But if you leave them there, someone's going to eat them."

strings.text: 「犯人はお前だ！」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "The culprit will be you!"

strings.text: 「なんでやねん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What the hell?!"

strings.text: 「ふふふ、俺の推理を聞きたいか？」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Heh heh heh, want to hear my deduction?"

strings.text: 「どうせ、俺しかその冷蔵庫に豚丼が入ったのを見てないからとか言い出すんだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're going to say something like 'because you were the only one who saw me put pork bowls in that fridge,' aren't you..."

strings.text: 「そうだ！」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "That's right!"

strings.text: 「冷蔵庫があれば誰だって、何か入ってると思うだろ……そんな大事なら鍵でもかけておけよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If there's a fridge, anyone would assume something's inside... if they're that important, put a lock on it."

strings.text:
「バーカ。大切なもんに鍵かけたら、大切な時に取り出せないだろ。
お前はガキだから分からないだろうけど」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated:
"Idiot. If you lock up something precious, you can't get it out when it really matters.
You wouldn't understand though, you're a kid."

strings.text: 「ガキとか関係ねーだろ。それ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Being a kid has nothing to do with it, does it."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、俺は帰るからな！　戸締まりしとけよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyway, I'm heading home! Lock up when you leave."

strings.text: 「ったく、生徒にそんな事いわれたかないわ……」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "Sheesh, I don't want to hear that from a student..."

strings.text: 「だったら、教師がそんな泥酔してるんじゃねぇよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then don't get plastered like this if you're a teacher."

strings.text: 「分かった。分かった。ったく直哉は理屈っぽいなぁ」
strings.speaker: 若田
strings.translated: "All right, all right. Sheesh, Naoya, you're such a stickler."

strings.text: 理屈っぽいとかの問題じゃねぇだろ……。
strings.translated: This isn't about being a stickler...

strings.text: それにしても……めずらしいな。
strings.translated: Still... this is unusual.

strings.text: 若田はちゃらんぽらんな教師ではあるが、美術室で酒をあおる様な性格の人間でもない。
strings.translated: Wakata's a slapdash teacher, but he's not the sort of guy to knock back drinks in the art room.

strings.text: あれは、あれで、生真面目な教師だ。
strings.translated: In his own way, he's a serious teacher.

strings.text: 泥酔する理由……。
strings.translated: His reason for getting plastered...

strings.text: 「ったく、どいつもこいつも……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sheesh, every single one of them..."

strings.text: 辛気くさいのは好きじゃないと言ってるのに……。
strings.translated: I've told them I don't like this gloomy stuff...

strings.text: 俺はバッグから、若田から受け取った瓶を取り出す。
strings.translated: I pulled the bottle Wakata had given me out of my bag.

strings.text:
瓶の中の琥珀色の液体が夕日に照らされる。
琥珀の中にもう一つの太陽がある様に、きらきらと輝く。
strings.translated:
The amber liquid inside the bottle caught the setting sun.
It sparkled as if there were another sun inside the amber.

strings.text: 「その時まで……か」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Until that time... huh."

strings.text: この酒は封が開けられており、そして、ほんの少しだけ量が減っていた。
strings.translated: The seal had been broken, and just a tiny bit was gone from the bottle.

strings.text:
舐める程度……。
そんな感じだった……。
strings.translated:
Just a taste...
That was all it seemed to be...

strings.text: 俺は<r アンフィテアトルム>半円形劇場</r>の脇をこえて、桜の道を歩いていく。
strings.translated: I passed by the side of the amphitheater and walked along the path of cherry trees.

strings.text: ここから夢浮坂まで桜の森が続く。
strings.translated: From here to Yume-no-Ukisaka, the cherry forest continued.

strings.text: 雲がまったく無い西の空には、夕焼けの<r なごり>名残</r>の「赤さ」が残る。
strings.translated: In the cloudless western sky, the crimson afterglow of sunset still lingered.

strings.text: 黄昏時。
strings.translated: Twilight.

strings.text: 誰もが美しい時として認識するであろう。
strings.translated: The time everyone would recognize as beautiful.

strings.text: だが、これがほんの少し刻を刻むと<r まがとき>禍時</r>と呼ばれる時間となる。
strings.translated: Yet let time tick on just a little further, and it becomes the hour known as magatoki.

strings.text: 禍時とは<r おうまがとき>逢魔時</r>の事、その名を聞けば、現代人でも何となく不気味なものを感じるだろう。
strings.translated: Magatoki refers to oumagatoki -- the hour of meeting demons. Just hearing the name, even a modern person would feel a vague eeriness.

strings.text: 俺は再び、手にしたウィスキーを赤が残る空にかざす。
strings.translated: Once again, I held up the whiskey in my hand to the sky where red still lingered.

strings.text: 青に浸食される空がすべて琥珀色に染められる。
strings.translated: The sky, slowly encroached upon by blue, was dyed entirely in amber.

strings.text: その琥珀の先に影を見た。
strings.translated: Beyond that amber, I saw a shadow.

strings.text: 琥珀の液体の奥に人影を見る。
strings.translated: Beyond the amber liquid, I saw a human figure.

strings.text: 黄昏時は、その語源が「<r た>誰</r>そ<rかれ>彼</r>（誰ですかあなたは）」である。
strings.translated: The word tasokare -- twilight -- comes from "ta so kare" -- "who is that person?"

strings.text: まさにその言葉の通り、近づかなければ、それが誰なのか分からない。
strings.translated: Just as those words suggest, unless you draw near, you can't tell who it is.

strings.text: 「寄りてこそ それかとも見め たそかれに ほのぼの見つる 花の夕顔……ってか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Only by drawing close can one tell -- in the twilight, faintly glimpsed, the evening face in flower'... something like that."

strings.text: 意味もなく、古文で習った言葉を口ずさむ。
strings.translated: Without any particular reason, I murmured the words I'd learned in classical literature.

strings.text: 俺は人影に近づく。
strings.translated: I drew closer to the figure.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin."

strings.text: 「あ、なおくん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, Nao-kun."

strings.text: 「どうした？　こんな時間に？　もう下校の時刻だろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you doing here at this hour? School's over already, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「そうですね。今日はいろいろな部活をまわって疲れてしまいました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's true. Today I went around to all sorts of clubs, and I'm tired out."

strings.text: 「疲れたので、読書で休憩か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So you're taking a break with a book?"

strings.text: 稟の片腕には文庫本が収まっている。
strings.translated: In one of Rin's arms was a paperback.

strings.text: 「ああ、ここの桜を見ていたら、何となく読みたくなってしまって……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, looking at the cherry trees here, I somehow felt like reading it..."

strings.text: 表紙に書かれた文字を読む。
strings.translated: I read the letters written on the cover.

strings.text: 有名な童話だ。
strings.translated: A famous fairy tale.

strings.text: 「『幸福な王子』か……。オスカー・ワイルドだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'The Happy Prince,' huh... Oscar Wilde."

strings.text: 「そうです。なおくんはオスカー・ワイルドは読んだ事ありますか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's right. Have you read Oscar Wilde before, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「絵本で『幸福な王子』を読んでもらった事はあったが、そのぐらいだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I had 'The Happy Prince' read to me from a picture book once, that's about it."

strings.text: 「ワイルドってどんな作品があるんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What kind of works did Wilde write?"

strings.text: 「『サロメ』『ドリアン・グレイの肖像』『芸術家としての批評家』『嘘の衰退』……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "'Salome,' 'The Picture of Dorian Gray,' 'The Critic as Artist,' 'The Decay of Lying'..."

strings.text: 「サロメ以外は聞いた事もない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I've never even heard of any of them besides Salome."

strings.text: いや、後ろの二つは聞いた事があった様な気もするが……。
strings.translated: No, I felt like I might have heard of the last two...

strings.text:
「うん、でもそれで良いと思う。
たぶん、なおくんはワイルドの事嫌いだと思うよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Yeah, but I think that's fine.
I think you'd probably dislike Wilde, Nao-kun."

strings.text: 「なんでそう思う？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why do you think that?"

strings.text: 「ワイルドとなおくんが違いすぎるもの」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Because Wilde and you are too different."

strings.text: 「そうなのか？　俺はワイルドを大して知らないし、その思想だって詳しくは知らない。だからそんな事を言われてもピンとこないよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so? I don't know much about Wilde, and I don't know his ideas in detail either. So even if you tell me that, it doesn't really click."

strings.text: 「それでも、おもしろい符合もあったりする」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Even so, there are some interesting coincidences."

strings.text: 「おもしろい符合？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Interesting coincidences?"

strings.text: 「幸福な王子はこんなお話です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The Happy Prince goes like this."

strings.text: 「街のもっとも高い円柱に、幸福な王子の像は立っていました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "On the tallest column in the town, the statue of the Happy Prince stood."

strings.text: 「全身を純金の箔に包まれ、眼には二つの輝くサファイア、そして刀の柄には大きなルビーが輝いておりました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "His whole body was covered in gilding of pure gold, two shining sapphires were his eyes, and a great ruby gleamed on the hilt of his sword."

strings.text: 「この美しい王子は、街の人々の大いなる自慢でもありました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "This beautiful prince was also the great pride of the townspeople."

strings.text: 「ある晩、温かい場所に渡ろうとしていたツバメが、王子の台座で寝ようとすると、真上から大粒の雫が降ってきました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "One night, a swallow who was on his way to migrate to warmer lands went to sleep at the prince's pedestal, when great drops of water fell from directly above."

strings.text: 「驚いたツバメが見上げると、幸福な王子の瞳が涙で溢れていました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The startled swallow looked up, and the eyes of the Happy Prince were overflowing with tears."

strings.text: 「もっとも高い場所に立っていた幸福な王子にはすべてが見えたのです。だから王子は、この街で起きているあらゆる人々の不幸がとても悲しかったのです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Standing at the highest point in town, the Happy Prince could see everything. And so his heart ached for all the misery unfolding across the city."

strings.text: 「王子は小さなツバメさんにお願いをします。不幸な人々に自分の宝石を与えて欲しいと」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The prince made a request of the little swallow. He asked him to give his jewels to the unfortunate people."

strings.text: 「すっかり寒くなっていた街から、すぐにでも南に渡らなければならないツバメでしたが、幸福な王子があまりに悲しそうなので、小さなツバメは気の毒になりました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The town had already grown cold, and the swallow needed to head south as soon as possible, but because the Happy Prince looked so terribly sad, the little swallow took pity on him."

strings.text: 「ツバメは言われた通りに、剣の柄に埋め込まれていたルビーを、病気の小さい子を持つ貧しい母親の元に届けました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "As he was asked, the swallow delivered the ruby set into the hilt of the sword to a poor mother whose small child was ill."

strings.text: 「さらに片方のサファイアをひもじい思いをしている学生の戯曲家に、そしてもう片方のサファイアを小さなマッチ売りの少女に与えて欲しいと王子は頼みます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Next the prince asked him to give one of the sapphires to a starving student playwright, and the other sapphire to a little match-selling girl."

strings.text: 「王子の両目を奪う様な事は出来ないとツバメは泣いてしまいましたが、それでも王子の強い意志に突き動かされ、仕方が無くそれぞれの元に運びました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The swallow wept, saying he couldn't take away both of the prince's eyes, but moved by the prince's strong will, he reluctantly carried them to each of them."

strings.text: 「幸福な王子は小さなツバメに言います。おまえはもう南に行かなければならない」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The Happy Prince said to the little swallow: You must go south now."

strings.text: 「ですがツバメは言います。幸福な王子にはもうすべてを見るための眼がありません。だからわたしはいつまでもあなたのそばにいると決めました」
strings.speaker: 稟
