strings.translated: "That's not it, but this girl was about the only one who actually wanted to do art seriously."

strings.text: 「他は遺産目当てであなたを殺そうとしてましたから」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "The rest were just trying to kill you for the inheritance."

strings.text: 「してねぇよ！　みんないい娘だったよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "They were not! They were all good girls!"

strings.text: 「まともに話もしてないくせによく言うわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You've barely spoken to any of them and yet you say that."

strings.text: 「何言ってるんだよ。短期間でも俺をあれだけちやほやしてくれたんだ。それだけでもあの娘達がいい娘だった事が分かるじゃねぇか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you talking about. Even for a short time, they doted on me that much. That alone is proof enough they were good girls."

strings.text:
「そう、分かった。
あんた、女で失敗するわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Right, I see.
You're going to fail hard with women."

strings.text: 「なんでだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why!"

strings.text: 「それで？　とりあえず川内野さんが紹介してくれる入部希望者なんだから、草薙目的で無いという事でしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So? Anyway, since Kawachino-san is bringing us a prospective member, it means it's not for Kusanagi's sake, right?"

strings.text: 「って……何故、そこで目をそらす」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wait... why are you looking away just now?"

strings.text:
「いいえ、遺産目的では無いのですが……。
でも、草薙先輩と元々知り合いなので……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated:
"No, it's not for the inheritance, but...
She does happen to already be acquainted with Kusanagi-senpai..."

strings.text: 「俺の知り合い……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "An acquaintance of mine..."

strings.text: 「里奈……入って来なよ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Rina... come on in."

strings.text: 「里奈？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rina?"

strings.text: 里奈
strings.translated: Rina

strings.text:
「どうもはじめまして、
私、新入生の氷川里奈と言います」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated:
"Hello, nice to meet you.
I'm the new student Hikawa Rina."

strings.text: ああ、やっぱり氷川かよ。
strings.translated: Ah, so it really is Hikawa.

strings.text: 里奈って……氷川かよ……。
strings.translated: Rina... as in Hikawa...

strings.text: 「ああ、やっぱり氷川かよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, so it really is Hikawa."

strings.text: 「里奈って……氷川かよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rina... as in Hikawa..."

strings.text: 「あら？　草薙と知り合い？　どんな関係なのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh? You know Kusanagi? What sort of relationship?"

strings.text: 「どんな関係と改めて言われると、いわゆる……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "When you put it like that, well, you could call it..."

strings.text:
「草薙に聞いてないわよ。この娘に聞いてるのよ。
これだって、面接みたいなもんなんだから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"I'm not asking Kusanagi. I'm asking her.
Think of this as an interview."

strings.text:
「そうですよね。この場合、答えるのは私です。
あ、あの……草薙先輩とはなんといいましょうか……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated:
"You're right. In this case, I'm the one who should answer.
Um, well... how should I put my relationship with Kusanagi-senpai..."

strings.text:
氷川が言葉を濁している。
さすがにいつものノリで「精神的妹です！」などとは言えないだろう。
strings.translated:
Hikawa is hedging.
She can't very well say "I'm his spiritual little sister!" like she usually does.

strings.text: そんな事言ったら間違いなく落とされる。
strings.translated: If she said that she'd be rejected for sure.

strings.text: まぁ、ここは無難に幼なじみと答えるだろうな。
strings.translated: Well, she'll probably safely answer "childhood friend."

strings.text:
「なんと説明したら良いか分かりませんが、一つだけ言える事は、
私は草薙先輩の精神的妹と言う立ち位置でして……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated:
"I'm not sure how to explain it, but the one thing I can say is
that I stand in the position of Kusanagi-senpai's spiritual little sister..."

strings.text: って、言うのかよ。
strings.translated: Wait, she actually said it.

strings.text: 「精神的妹？　何それ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Spiritual little sister? What's that?"

strings.text:
「血はつながっていないのですが、気持ちは妹という感じです。
すみません、あやふやな説明しか出来ず……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated:
"We aren't related by blood, but in feeling I'm like his little sister.
I'm sorry, I can only give a vague explanation..."

strings.text: 説明のあやふやさとかどうでもいいだろ！
strings.translated: The vagueness of the explanation isn't the point!

strings.text: ただでなくても入部希望者落としまくりの鳥谷に対して、何を言ってるんだか……。
strings.translated: To Toritani, who's been rejecting hopefuls left and right, what is she even saying...

strings.text: 「そう、分かったわ。んじゃ合格ね。これ入部希望の紙だから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I see, understood. Then you pass. Here's the application form."

strings.text: 「って分かったのかよ！　っていうか合格かよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You 'see'?! And she passes?!"

strings.text: 「何よ。不服？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What? Something to complain about?"

strings.text: 「不服というか、そもそもおかしいだろ！　あれだけの入部希望者を落としておいてだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Not complain, just, this is off from the start! After rejecting all those applicants--"

strings.text: 「何ですか？　いちゃもんつけるのなら、遺産目的の殺人者どもより先に私があなたを殺しますよ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "What? If you're going to gripe, I'll kill you before those inheritance-hunting murderers do."

strings.text: 「というか何で俺は多数の殺人者から狙われてる設定になってるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wait, why has it been established that I'm being hunted by multiple murderers?"

strings.text: 「でも里奈がこの部活に入るのに反対するのですよね」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "So you're opposed to Rina joining this club?"

strings.text: 「反対はしねぇよ。ただ、あまりにもツッコミどころ満載なやりとりだったから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not opposed. It's just, the whole exchange had too much to fault."

strings.text:
「草薙とこの娘と昔からの知り合いなのでしょ？　だったら問題ないでしょ。
私は別に美術部のハードルをあげたいわけじゃないんだから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Kusanagi and this girl are old acquaintances, right? Then there's no problem.
I'm not trying to raise the art club's bar or anything."

strings.text:
「そんなに昨日の女子達はダメだったのかよ。
良さそうな娘だらけだったのに……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Were the girls yesterday really that bad?
They all seemed like nice enough girls..."

strings.text: 「あんたの都合に良さそうでしょう」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Nice for your convenience, you mean."

strings.text:
「ああ、そうだよ。それで十分だ。
ったく、川内野といい氷川といい、めんどくさい部員ばかり増やしやがって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Yeah, that's right. That's enough for me.
Seriously, first Kawachino, now Hikawa, you keep adding troublesome members..."

strings.text: 「何言ってるんだか、なんやかんや言って、昨日みたいなミーハー女子を一番嫌ってるのはあなたでしょうに」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What are you saying? For all your talk, you're the one who hates trend-chasing girls like yesterday's the most."

strings.text: 「勝手な解釈を、俺はああいうミーハーな女子どもが大好きだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't interpret things your way. I love trend-chasing girls like that."

strings.text: 「はいはい、それは良かったわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sure, sure, good for you."

strings.text: 「とりあえずは合格という事で良いのですね」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "So, she's accepted, then?"

strings.text: 「それでいいのよね草薙」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's fine with you, right, Kusanagi?"

strings.text: 「なんで俺に確認するんだよ。鳥谷がいいのならいいに決まってるだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why are you asking me. If Toritani's fine with it then obviously it's fine."

strings.text: 「だってさー、そんなこんなで氷川さん合格！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well then, with all that said, Hikawa-san, you pass!"

strings.text: 「やったね。里奈」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "You did it, Rina."

strings.text:
「えっと……お世話になります。
でも、本当にいいのでしょうか。ずいぶん高倍率な部活だと聞いてましたが……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated:
"Um... I look forward to being here.
But, is this really alright? I heard this club had incredible competition..."

strings.text: 「いいも何も無いって、別に入部が難しいわけじゃないし、コネで入ったわけでもないんだから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There's no 'is it alright.' It's not that hard to join, and it's not like you got in through connections."

strings.text: 「そうですか、でも、先輩がそう仰るのならがんばらせていただきます」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I see. Well, if you say so, senpai, I'll do my best."

strings.text: 「おーす！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yo!"

strings.text:
かなり遅れて圭まで登場する。
圭の手には購買部の袋がぶら下がっている。
strings.translated:
Well behind everyone, Kei finally shows up.
A bag from the school store dangles from his hand.

strings.text: 「あれ？　なんで氷川がいるの？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? Why is Hikawa here?"

strings.text: 「あ、入部しました！」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Oh, I joined!"

strings.text:
「そうなんだ。氷川が入るのかぁ。
まぁ氷川は入るとは思ってたけど……
これでますますこの部活のレベルが上がるなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"I see. So Hikawa's joining.
Well, I figured Hikawa would join, but...
This is really going to raise the level of this club."

strings.text: 「え？　そうなの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? Really?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうか真琴は知らないのか。氷川は展覧会とかに出さないけど、作品は結構なもんだぞ。たまに俺とかでも驚くレベルのものがある」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ah, right, Makoto doesn't know. Hikawa doesn't submit to exhibitions, but her work is pretty impressive. Sometimes there are pieces that even surprise me."

strings.text: 「そうだったんだ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I had no idea."

strings.text: 「そうですね。里奈はすごくすごく絵うまいですよ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "That's right. Rina is really, really good at art."

strings.text: 「あれ？　お前って見慣れない顔だけど新入生？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? I don't recognize your face -- are you a new student?"

strings.text: 「新入生の川内野さんよ。一応昨日会っているでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's Kawachino-san, a new student. You met her yesterday, at least."

strings.text: 「おお、そうか。俺の名前は夏目圭だ。天才だから覚えておくと良いぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Oh, right. My name is Natsume Kei. I'm a genius, so you'd best remember it."

strings.text: 「女装のですか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "A genius at crossdressing?"

strings.text: 「女装の天才って何だよ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What kind of thing is 'a genius at crossdressing'!"

strings.text: 「でも、昨日の女装、天才的に似合ってました」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "But yesterday's crossdressing suited you with genius flair."

strings.text: 「そんな事で天才的と言われてもうれしくない！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I'm not happy about being called a genius for that!"

strings.text: 「でも、ああいうのは天賦の才でほぼ決まるから、あながち天才的という言葉も間違いではないかもな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But that sort of thing is largely determined by innate talent, so 'genius' isn't necessarily off the mark."

strings.text: 「なんだそりゃ！　いろいろおかしいだろ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What the hell! That's wrong in so many ways!"

strings.text: 「まぁまぁ、たしかに女装も大したものだけど、でもね。圭の絵はすごいわよ。いろいろと教わる事も多いわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Now, now. It's true your crossdressing is impressive, but really, Kei's art is amazing. There's a lot to learn from him."

strings.text: 「そうですね。夏目先輩は絵に関しては天才的です」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That's true. Natsume-senpai is a genius when it comes to art."

strings.text: 「えっへん！　という事だぞ。新入生。俺の事はそういう目で見ると良いからな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahem! So there it is, new student. That's the way you should look at me."

strings.text: 「里奈が言うのであれば正しいのでしょう。そういう目で見ます……ジト」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "If Rina says so, it must be true. I'll look at you that way... (staaare)."

strings.text: 「う……、何か、視線違う……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ugh... that gaze feels off somehow..."

strings.text: 「それより、何でお前は購買部の袋を持っているんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "More importantly, why do you have a bag from the school store?"

strings.text: 「なんだよ。なんで俺が購買部の袋持ってちゃいけないんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What? Why can't I have a bag from the school store!"

strings.text: 「今朝お前にもちゃんと弁当を持たせたはずだが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I made sure you had a proper bento this morning."

strings.text: 「デザートが無いと寂しいじゃない。お前も食う？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's lonely without dessert, isn't it. Want some too?"

strings.text:
と言いながら袋から菓子パンを取り出す。
こいつ的に、あれらはデザート扱いなのだろうか？
strings.translated:
As he says this, he pulls a sweet bread out of the bag.
Are those things counted as dessert in his mind?

strings.text: 「いや、クリームドーナツとハニードーナツの様な甘ったるいものなど興味ない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No thanks. I have no interest in sickly-sweet stuff like cream doughnuts or honey doughnuts."

strings.text: 「ふう、ったくお子ちゃま舌ね。そんなもんばかり食べて」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sheesh, what a childish palate. Eating nothing but stuff like that."

strings.text: 「な、なんだって！　俺のことを馬鹿にするのは良いとしてもクリームドーナツとハニードーナツのことを馬鹿にするのは許さないんだからな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wha-- what did you say! Mocking me is fine, but I will not forgive mockery of cream doughnuts and honey doughnuts!"

strings.text: 圭自身の序列はドーナツ以下なのか……。
strings.translated: So Kei himself ranks below doughnuts...

strings.text: つつがなく、午後の授業が終わる。
strings.translated: Without incident, the afternoon classes end.

strings.text:
昼飯後からの授業は比較的短く感じる。
あと少しだと思うと、気が楽になるからだろう。
strings.translated:
Classes after lunch feel comparatively short.
Probably because knowing there's only a little left puts you at ease.

strings.text: 「さてと帰るか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Alright, time to head home..."

strings.text: 廊下に出ようとした瞬間に何者かに手を捕まれる。
strings.translated: The instant I try to step into the hallway, someone grabs my hand.

strings.text: 「あれ？　鳥谷さん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Toritani-san."

strings.text: 「なにスムーズに帰ろうとしてるのかしら？　昼休みに言ったわよね。まだ新入部員勧誘は終わってないって」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Trying to smoothly slip off home, are you? I told you at lunch, didn't I. New member recruitment isn't over yet."

strings.text: 「いや、やり方を変えると言ってたから、もう俺は必要ないのかと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, you said you were changing your approach, so I figured you didn't need me anymore..."

strings.text:
「タキシードはもういいけど、勧誘の手伝いはしてもらうわ。
一人一殺が基本よ。あなたが一人連れてこないと終わらないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"The tuxedo isn't needed anymore, but you're still helping with recruitment.
One kill per person is the rule. Until you bring in one, you're not done."

strings.text: 「昨日、川内野を捕まえたじゃないか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I caught Kawachino yesterday, didn't I?"

strings.text: 「美術部まで連れてきたのは私でしょうが、それにあんたはあの後すぐに帰ったじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I was the one who brought her all the way to the art club, and besides, you went home right after that."

strings.text: なんであの後すぐに帰ったのがバレてるんだよ。
strings.translated: Why does she know I went home right after that?

strings.text: 「だって、あれだけの人数がいたんだから普通は終わりだと思うだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I mean, with that many people there, you'd normally think we were done, right?"

strings.text: 「量より質。とりあえず一人がノルマだから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Quality over quantity. For now, one is the quota."

strings.text: 「分かった。分かった。んで？　一人一殺って、とりあえず俺は誰を殺せばいいんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Fine, fine. So? One kill per person -- who exactly am I supposed to kill?"

strings.text: 「本当に殺してどうするのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What good would actually killing someone do?"

strings.text: 「分かってるよ。比喩だろ？　半殺しって事だよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I know. It's a metaphor, right? Beating them half to death, then?"

strings.text: 「違うわよ……。もうあんたはどれだけ適当に人の話を聞いてるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's not it either... how sloppily do you listen to people?"

strings.text: 「殺す、殺すって……お前達は何を殺伐とした会話をしてるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Kill, kill... what kind of bloodthirsty conversation are you two having..."

strings.text: 男子生徒Ａ
strings.translated: Male Student A

strings.text: 「こらぁああああ！　草薙ぃぃぃいいい！」
strings.speaker: 男子生徒Ａ
strings.translated: "Heeeyyyy! Kusanagiiiii!"

strings.text: 「お？　おお？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Oh?"

strings.text: 「うぎゃあ！」
strings.speaker: 男子生徒Ａ
strings.translated: "Guhh!"

strings.text: 「ど、どうした……男子生徒Ａ、なぜ俺をいきなり襲う。思わず蹴ってしまったではないか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what's this... Male Student A, why are you suddenly attacking me. You made me kick you on reflex."

strings.text: 「だ、男子生徒Ａとか……そ、そういう言い方やめろ」
strings.speaker: 男子生徒Ａ
strings.translated: "M-Male Student A... c-cut it out with that kind of talk."

strings.text: 中里
strings.translated: Nakazato

strings.text: 「俺の名は中里だ……」
strings.speaker: 中里
strings.translated: "My name is Nakazato..."

strings.text: 「ガクリ」
strings.speaker: 中里
strings.translated: "(collapses)"

strings.text: 「なんだこりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is this?"

strings.text:
「なにやったんだよ……。
直哉、囲まれてるぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"What did you do...
Naoya, we're surrounded."

strings.text:
気がつくと、
なんか知らんが、俺たちは無数の男子生徒に囲まれている。
strings.translated:
Before I know it,
for some reason, we're surrounded by a horde of male students.

strings.text: 「どういう事だ？　男子生徒ＢやらＣやらＤやらがわらわらと俺たちを取り囲んでるが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's going on? Male Students B, C, and D are swarming around us..."

strings.text: 「しかもそのＢやらＣやらＤやらはかなり殺気立っているではないかぁ……ＢやらＣやらＤやらは今にも襲いかかりそうであったぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And what's more, those B and C and D are seriously bloodthirsty... B and C and D look ready to attack any moment..."

strings.text: 男子生徒Ｄ
strings.translated: Male Student D

strings.text: 「ＢやらＣやらＤやら<r つ>突</r>っ<r けんどん>慳貪</r>な事言うなぁ！」
strings.speaker: 男子生徒Ｄ
strings.translated: "Quit talking about us like curt little Bs and Cs and Ds!"

strings.text: 東浪見
strings.translated: Tonami

strings.text: 「俺の名は東浪見だ！」
strings.speaker: 東浪見
strings.translated: "My name is Tonami!"

strings.text: 男子生徒Ｂ
strings.translated: Male Student B

strings.text:
「ってなんでそんなに棒読みなんだよ……本当にイヤミなヤツだな草薙。
だいたい俺たちは同じクラスだろ」
strings.speaker: 男子生徒Ｂ
strings.translated:
"Why are you reading it off so flatly... you really are a nasty piece of work, Kusanagi.
Besides, we're in the same class."

strings.text: 一宮
strings.translated: Ichinomiya

strings.text: 「俺は一宮だ！」
strings.speaker: 一宮
strings.translated: "I'm Ichinomiya!"

strings.text: 男子生徒Ｃ
strings.translated: Male Student C

strings.text: 「俺も同じクラスの片貝だ！」
strings.speaker: 男子生徒Ｃ
strings.translated: "I'm Katagai, also in the same class!"

strings.text: 「んで？　ＢやらＣやらＤやらが何の用だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So? What do B and C and D want?"

strings.text: 「まだ言うか！」
strings.speaker: 東浪見
strings.translated: "You're still doing it!"

strings.text: 片貝
strings.translated: Katagai

strings.text: 「もう、俺たちの事はいい。話が進まない」
strings.speaker: 片貝
strings.translated: "Enough about us. We're not making any progress."

strings.text: 「り、稟ちゃんをどこに隠した」
strings.speaker: 一宮
strings.translated: "Wh-where did you hide Rin-chan?!"

strings.text: 「この裏切り者！」
strings.speaker: 一宮
strings.translated: "You traitor!"

strings.text: 「裏切り者も何も、お前らの仲間になった記憶もないのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Traitor or not, I don't recall ever being your ally to begin with..."

strings.text: 「うるさい。うるさい！　貴様に何がわかる！」
strings.speaker: 一宮
strings.translated: "Shut up. Shut up! What would you know!"

strings.text: 「そうだ、俺はお前は仲間だと思っていたぞ」
strings.speaker: 片貝
strings.translated: "That's right. I thought you were one of us!"

strings.text: 「彼女いない連合の！」
strings.speaker: 片貝
strings.translated: "One of the No-Girlfriend Alliance!"

strings.text: 「ほう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oho."

strings.text: 「鳥谷、こいつらでいいか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani, will these guys do?"

strings.text: 「何度も言うけど、一殺って勧誘しろって意味だからね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I keep telling you, 'one kill' means one recruit."

strings.text: 「俺たちは、かっこいいくせに、モテるくせに、才能があるくせに、彼女イナイ歴を年齢と同じく積み重ねていく、孤高なお前に少し憧れていたんだ！」
strings.speaker: 片貝
strings.translated: "Even though you're cool, even though you're popular, even though you've got talent, you've racked up a years-without-a-girlfriend record equal to your age -- we kind of looked up to that lofty, solitary you!"

strings.text: 「あら？　褒められてるじゃない。草薙。かっこよくて孤高なあんたに憧れていたんだって」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh my? Sounds like praise to me, Kusanagi. They admired the cool, lofty you."

strings.text: 「彼女が一度たりともいなかった部分をぬかして言うと！　たしかに褒めてる様に聞こえるな！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If you leave out the part about never once having had a girlfriend! Then yes, it certainly does sound like praise!"

strings.text: 「別にいいじゃない。彼女がいなくたって、褒められてるんだからさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What's the harm? Even without a girlfriend, you're being praised."

strings.text: 「いいわけないよな。バカにされているのと同義だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Of course there's harm. It's the same as being mocked."

strings.text: 「今日な、稟ちゃんから聞いたんだ！　俺たち！」
strings.speaker: 中里
strings.translated: "Today, Rin-chan told us! We heard it!"

strings.text: 「何をだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Heard what?"

strings.text: 「草薙と昔っから知り合いだって聞いたんだけど、それは嘘だよね」
strings.speaker: 一宮
strings.translated: "'I heard you've known Kusanagi since way back, but that's a lie, right?'"

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「あ、いいえ……本当ですけど」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no... it's true, actually."

strings.text: 「まじですか……」
strings.speaker: 一宮
strings.translated: "'For real...?'"

strings.text: 「昔この街に住んでまして、引っ越しといいますか……、自分的には“帰ってきた”って感じでして」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I used to live in this town. So rather than 'moving here,' for me it feels more like 'coming home.'"

strings.text: 「でも、そんな仲良くなかったんですよね」
strings.speaker: 中里
strings.translated: "'But you weren't that close, right?'"

strings.text: 「えっと一応は、草薙君は引っ越す前に良くしていただきました……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, at least, Kusanagi-kun was very good to me before he moved..."

strings.text: 「もしかして、草薙の幼なじみとか……？」
strings.speaker: 一宮
strings.translated: "'Wait, could it be that you're Kusanagi's childhood friend...?'"

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ……草薙くんがそう思ってくださるのであれば……うれしい話ですよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "W-well... if Kusanagi-kun would think of me that way... I'd be very happy."

strings.text: 「と言われた俺たちの気持ちが分かるか！」
strings.speaker: 中里
strings.translated: "Can you understand how we felt hearing that?!"

strings.text: 「全然分からん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Not at all."

strings.text: 「殺す！」
strings.speaker: 片貝
strings.translated: "I'll kill you!"

strings.text: 「うおおおおおおお！」
strings.speaker: 東浪見
strings.translated: "Uoooooooohhh!"

strings.text: 「おい、鳥谷」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey, Toritani."

strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「一人一殺どころか四人も殺したんで、俺のノルマ達成かな？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I killed four instead of one, so I've cleared my quota, right?"

strings.text: 「誰も本当に殺れとは言っていない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Nobody said actually kill anyone."

strings.text: 一同
strings.translated: Everyone

strings.text: 「「「「って死んでねぇよ！」」」」
strings.speaker: 一同
strings.translated: """"We're not dead!""""

strings.text:
「しかし、人として小さいな。
そんな事だから男子生徒ＡやらＢやらＣやらＤやら適当な表記されるんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"But really, you're all so petty as human beings.
That's exactly why you get lazily labeled Male Student A or B or C or D."

strings.text: 「うるさい！　ＡやらＢやらＣやらＤやらは言うな！」
strings.speaker: 一宮
strings.translated: "Shut up! Don't call us A or B or C or D!"

strings.text: 「草薙！　それだけじゃない！　貴様の罪はそれだけじゃないんだ！　稟ちゃんが言った事はそれだけじゃない！」
strings.speaker: 片貝
strings.translated: "Kusanagi! That's not all! Your crimes don't end there! That's not the only thing Rin-chan said!"

strings.text: 「何を言ったんだ……あいつは」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What did she say... that girl."

strings.text: 「幼なじみって言葉から連想するようなロマンチックな展開はないですよね」
strings.speaker: 一宮
strings.translated: "'There's no romantic development like what the word childhood friend brings to mind, right?'"

strings.text: 「あ、当たり前です！　昔知り合いというだけでそんな素晴らしい展開になってたら、私はもう死んでてもいいぐらいです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "O-of course not! If just having known each other long ago led to such a wonderful development, I'd be fine dying on the spot."

strings.text: 「と言われた俺たちの気持ちが分かるかぁぁあ！」
strings.speaker: 東浪見
strings.translated: "Can you understand how we felt hearing thaaaaat?!"

strings.text: 「あんた達の気持ちなんて知らないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I couldn't care less how you felt."

strings.speaker: 一同
strings.translated: """"What did you say!""""

strings.text: 「あんた達の気持ちなんて知りもしないけど、とりあえず、彼女の秘めた告白を、無神経に廊下で大声で吹聴するあんた達の最低さは分かったわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I don't know or care how you felt, but at any rate, I now know how utterly awful you all are, insensitively broadcasting a girl's private confession in the hallway at the top of your lungs."

strings.text: 「え？　俺たちが最低？」
strings.speaker: 一宮
strings.translated: "Huh? We're awful?"

strings.text: 「最低ね。その娘。稟さんだっけ？　思わず口走ってしまった秘めたる思いを、こんな場所で大声で言いふらされて、絶対イイ気分じゃないわよね！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The worst. That girl -- Rin-san, was it? Having the private feelings that slipped out of her mouth blared around in a place like this -- there's no way she'd feel good about it!"

strings.text: 「う、そう言われると、たしかに……」
strings.speaker: 東浪見
strings.translated: "Ugh, now that you say it, that's true..."

strings.text: 「秘めたる思いって……そんな簡単に言うなら秘めてないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Private feelings... if she said them that easily, they weren't exactly private."

strings.text: 鳥谷が俺を睨む。あきれた様な、少し怒っている様な、そんな顔。
strings.translated: Toritani glares at me. A look that's half exasperated, half a little angry.

strings.text: 「なんだよ。稟の言った事は冗談のたぐいだろ？　じゃなきゃ、初対面のやつに言わないだろうが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What? What Rin said was some kind of joke, right? Otherwise she wouldn't say something like that to people she just met..."

strings.text: 「だから、思わず口走ってしまったって言ってるのよ。女心に対する鈍感さは相変わらずね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's what 'they slipped out of her mouth' means. You're as dense as ever when it comes to a girl's heart."

strings.text: 男子生徒どもは、自分たちが「最悪である」という事実に呆然として、立ち去っていった。
strings.translated: The boys, dumbfounded by the fact that they were "the worst," drifted away.

strings.text: 相当ショックであったのだろう。まるで魂が抜けてしまったかの様であった……。
strings.translated: They must have been pretty shocked. They looked like their souls had been sucked out of them......

strings.text: 「それにしても、その転校生ってすごい人気なのね。たしかに自己紹介の時にちら見したかぎり相当可愛かったけど……そんな事になってたんだ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Still, that transfer student's really popular, isn't she. From the glimpse I caught at her self-introduction she was quite cute, but... I had no idea things had gotten like that."

strings.text: 「同じクラスでお前は今まで何を見てるんだ？　あの人だかりだぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're in the same class -- what have you been looking at all this time? That was a huge crowd."

strings.text: 「興味無かったので気がつかなかったわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I wasn't interested, so I didn't notice."

strings.text:
「あの娘は相当性格が良いぞ。人当たりもよくてなぁ。
誰かと大違いだなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"That girl's personality is really something. She's so easy to get along with.
Quite different from a certain someone."

strings.text: 「んで？　なんで圭は私を見つめるのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well? Why is it that Kei is staring at me?"

strings.text: 「べ、別に、他意は無いけど……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "N-no reason, I don't mean anything by it..."

strings.text: 「あいつは、昔から人に気を遣うからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She's always been considerate of others, from way back."

strings.text: 「なんでも、可愛いだけじゃないみたいだぞ。相当頭が良いという話も聞くぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Apparently she's not just cute, either. I heard she's really smart."

strings.text: 「前行ってた学校が相当有名な進学校らしいぞ。偏差値が１００突破してるとか」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "The school she went to before is apparently a really famous prep school. Her deviation score's over 100, they say."

strings.text:
「偏差値１００を突破している学校って……。
お前、その脳みそで良くこの学校入れたな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"A school where the deviation score tops 100...
How did you manage to get into this school with that brain of yours?"

strings.text: 「なんで稟ちゃんの頭の良さの話が、俺の脳みその話になる？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "How did a conversation about Rin-chan's smarts turn into a conversation about my brain?"

strings.text: それが分からないから、お前の頭が心配なんだろうが……。
strings.translated: Because you can't tell, that's exactly why I worry about your head......

strings.text: 「欲しいわね……それ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I want that... I really do."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Want what..."

strings.text: 「その戦力よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That combat power."

strings.text: 「どの戦力だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Which combat power?"

strings.text: 「あなたの幼なじみよ。美人で秀才なんでしょ！　そんなのウチに入らなきゃどこに入るって言うのよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Your childhood friend. A beautiful genius, right?! If someone like that doesn't join us, then who will!"

strings.text: 「なんだ、いつものお前らしく元気になったと思ったら、とてつもなくデタラメな事を言い出すんだなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Great -- just when I thought you were back to your usual energetic self, you start spouting utter nonsense."

strings.text: 「そう？　まぁ、聞くだけならタダじゃない。打診して、是非ウチに入ってもらおうよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You think? Well, asking costs nothing. Let's sound her out and get her to join us, come on."

strings.text: 「どうかなぁ。あいつ絵なんか描かないと思うけどなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I dunno. I don't think she paints or anything."

strings.text:
「別にいいじゃない。初心者大歓迎よ。
うちには二人も天才絵描きがいるじゃない。その二人がかりで教えれば全然問題ないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"So what? Beginners are more than welcome.
We've got two genius painters here, don't we. If the two of them teach her, there's no problem at all."

strings.text: 「稟に絵を教えるのか、絵をねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Teaching Rin to paint, huh... painting..."

strings.text: 「何よ。その持って回った言い方。なんか問題があるの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What's with that roundabout way of talking. Is there some problem?"

strings.text:
「問題があるわけじゃないんだけどな……。
まぁ、いろいろと思うところがあってだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"It's not that there's a problem, exactly...
Well, there are various things on my mind."

strings.text: 「思うところって何？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What sort of things?"

strings.text: 「うーん。どっちにしろ、俺は正式な部員ではない。最終的には鳥谷が判断する事だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hmm. Either way, I'm not an official club member. In the end it's for Toritani to decide."

strings.text: 「だから、何か問題があるの？　それを聞いてるの！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So is there a problem or not? That's what I'm asking!"

strings.text: 「問題があるわけじゃない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not that there's a problem."

strings.text: 「とりあえず言える事は、あいつは昨日束で来た連中とは全然違うし、川内野や氷川とも違う。たぶん圭とも鳥谷とも明石とも違う。当然俺とは違う」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The one thing I can say is that she's completely different from the crowd that came in a lump yesterday, and different from Kawachino or Hikawa. Probably different from Kei and Toritani and Akashi. Obviously different from me."

strings.text: 「まぁ、あくまでも伝聞形なんだがな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, this is all just hearsay, mind you."

strings.text: 「伝聞形？　誰から聞いたの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hearsay? From whom?"

strings.text: 「いや、戯れだ。忘れてくれ。とりあえず御桜稟については良く話しあって決めるのだな。俺が言える事はそれだけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, just idle chatter. Forget it. For now, discuss Misakura Rin thoroughly and decide. That's all I can say."

strings.text: 「さっきからあんたは何が言いたいわけ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What have you been trying to say this whole time?"

strings.text: 「言いたいというか……。うむ、強いて忠告するのであれば、圧倒的な才能の差は、場を壊す理由にもなりかねないって事ぐらいか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not so much a point I'm trying to make... Hmm, if I had to offer a warning, it's that an overwhelming gap in talent can end up tearing a place apart......"

strings.text:
「だから、別にこの部はそんなにレベルの高い場所じゃないわよ。
初心者大歓迎だって言ってるでしょ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Like I said, this club isn't such a high-level place.
I've told you, beginners are more than welcome."

strings.text: 「そうか、なら大丈夫じゃないか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. Then it should be fine, shouldn't it."

strings.text: 「俺は、稟ちゃんが入ってくれるのならうれしいなぁ。あの娘ってすげぇいい娘だし」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I'd be happy if Rin-chan joined us. That girl's a really good kid."

strings.text: 「いいですよね。御桜先輩。本当に理想的な女性ですし」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "It'd be great, wouldn't it. Misakura-senpai. She really is the ideal woman."

strings.text: 「里奈だって十分素敵な女の子だよ。うん」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Rina, you're plenty wonderful yourself. Yep."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、そんな事、いきなり真顔で言われても困りますがな」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ah, uh, don't just say something like that with a straight face, it makes it hard to respond."

strings.text:
「冗談だよ。
とりあえず里奈がそれだけ絶賛する女性、少し興味があります。
まぁ、どんな素晴らしい女性が目の前に現れても、私の心は不動ですが」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated:
"I'm kidding.
At any rate, a woman that Rina praises this much -- I'm a little curious.
Although no matter how wonderful a woman appears before me, my heart will not waver."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、早速勧誘！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right then, let's recruit her right away!"

strings.text: 何を思って鳥谷は、いきなり稟を美術部に入れようとか考えたのだろう。
strings.translated: What on earth had gotten into Toritani to suddenly want Rin in the art club?

strings.text: 同じクラスなのだから、今までだってずっと稟を見てきただろうに、なんでこのタイミングなんだか……。
strings.translated: They're in the same class -- she's been seeing Rin all this time -- so why the timing now......

strings.text: 「という事で連れてきたわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "And so I brought her along!"

strings.text: 「あ、ど、どうも、みなさまこんにちわ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, h-hello everyone, nice to meet you..."

strings.text:
「という事でって……いきなりすぎだろ。
あれから５分も経ってないし……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"'And so'... that's way too sudden.
It hasn't even been five minutes since then..."

strings.text: 「また、拉致か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Another abduction?"

strings.text: 「してないわよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I did not!"

strings.text: 「違うよ。私が鳥谷さんを発見して声かけたんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's not true. I spotted Toritani-san and called out to her myself."

strings.text: 「そうか？　嘘くせぇなぁ。稟はすぐに人をたてるからなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really? Sounds fishy. Rin always defers to people."

strings.text: 「むしろ、そうやって言う様に命令されてるのかもしれないし……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Or maybe she was ordered to say that..."

strings.text: 「あんた達ねぇ。殴られたいのかしら……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You two... do you want to get hit......"

strings.text: 「ようこそ御桜先輩」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Welcome, Misakura-senpai."

strings.text: 「あ、里奈ちゃんだ。美術部だったんだね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, Rina-chan. So you were in the art club."

strings.text: 「はいっ。と言いましても、つい先ほど、今日の昼休みからですけど」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Yes. Though only since lunch break today."

strings.text: 「そうなんだ。んじゃ里奈ちゃんは三時間ぐらい先輩だね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see. Then Rina-chan is my senior by about three hours."

strings.text:
「はじめまして、御桜先輩。私は一年生の川内野優美です。
よろしくお願いします」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated:
"Nice to meet you, Misakura-senpai. I'm Kawachino Yumi, a first-year.
Pleased to make your acquaintance."

strings.text:
川内野は丁寧にお辞儀をする。
俺たちに対する態度と大違いだ……。
strings.translated:
Kawachino bows politely.
Her attitude toward us is completely different......

strings.text: 「こちらこそよろしくお願いします。御桜稟と言います。今学期から転校してきた三年生です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The pleasure is mine. I'm Misakura Rin. I'm a third-year who transferred in this term."

strings.text: 「他に卒業出来てない明石って人もいるんだけど、だいたいウチの美術部はこのメンツで全部よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There's also this person Akashi who hasn't managed to graduate, but this is basically the whole art club roster."

strings.text: 「全部？　あれ？　そうなんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The whole roster? Huh? Really?"

strings.text: 「何で？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Why?"

strings.text: 「あの、草薙くん……圭くんの妹さんは？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, Kusanagi-kun... What about Kei-kun's little sister?"

strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「圭の妹？　何それ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kei's little sister? What's that?"

strings.text:
「え？　昨日、妹さんが美術部さんのチラシを配ってましたよね。
すごく可愛い方で、メイド服とても似合ってました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Huh? Yesterday, wasn't his little sister handing out art club flyers?
Such a cute girl -- the maid outfit really suited her."

strings.text: 一瞬、時間が止まる。
strings.translated: For an instant, time stops.

strings.text: 室内にフラットな空気が流れ、奇妙な間というか、稟の言葉が脳に届くまでのタイムラグというか……。
strings.translated: A flat air spread through the room -- an odd pause, or rather the time lag before Rin's words reached the brain......

strings.text: 最初にその奇妙な間を破ったのは、当然の様に……鳥谷の笑い声であった。
strings.translated: The first to break that strange silence was, of course...... Toritani's laughter.

strings.text: 「ぶっ……く、くくく、にゃははははははは！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Pfft...... k-kukuku, nyahahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 俺はというと苦笑い。
strings.translated: As for me, a wry smile.

strings.text: まぁ、笑ってもいいのだが。その種をまいたのは俺なので、ここで大笑いでもした日には、圭に何をされたかわかったものではない。
strings.translated: Well, I could laugh too, but I was the one who planted that seed, so if I burst out laughing here, there's no telling what Kei might do to me.

strings.text: 稟はというと、突如笑い出した鳥谷と、気まずさのあまり俯き加減で笑いを堪え、肩を震わせている俺を、キョトンとした表情で交互に見やっていた。
strings.translated: As for Rin, she looked back and forth between the suddenly laughing Toritani and me -- head lowered from awkwardness, stifling laughter with shaking shoulders -- with a bewildered expression.

strings.text: 「あ、あの、す、すみません何か私おかしな事いいましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um, s-sorry, did I say something strange?"

strings.text: 「あはははははは……妹ね。あれ、うん、そうね。妹に見えるわね。あはははは」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ahahahahaha...... little sister, huh. That, yeah, right. She does look like a little sister. Ahahahaha."

strings.text: 「え？　あの？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Um?"

strings.text: 全く状況を理解できずに、稟は頭上に“？”マークを点滅させて、一人で立ち尽くしている様である。
strings.translated: Unable to grasp the situation at all, Rin stood there alone, a "?" mark blinking above her head.

strings.text: 「す、すみません。も、もしかして私、ものすごく変な事を言ってますか？　言ってますね！　ごめんなさい！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-sorry. D-did I say something really weird? I did, didn't I! I'm so sorry!"

strings.text: 「あ、いやこの場合、稟ちゃんは悪くないぞ……たぶん。悪いのは！　お前だ！　直哉！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ah, no, in this case Rin-chan isn't at fault... probably. The one at fault -- is you! Naoya!"

strings.text: 「仕方がないだろ。それともあの時、お前が女装趣味の変態と正直に言えば良かったか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It couldn't be helped. Or would you have preferred I honestly said you were a cross-dressing pervert?"

strings.text: 「女装趣味の変態ってなんだ！　というか！　今それ言ってどうするんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What do you mean cross-dressing pervert! And besides -- what's the point of saying that now!"

strings.text: 「ち、違う！　そんな趣味じゃない！　あれは真琴に無理矢理やられてだな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "N-no, it's not! I don't have that kind of hobby! Makoto forced me into it!"

strings.text: 「あ、はいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, right."

strings.text: 完全に稟は固まっている。ただ立ち尽くすだけだった。
strings.translated: Rin was completely frozen. She just stood there.

strings.text: 「って！　めっちゃ引いてるじゃん！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "See! She's totally weirded out!"

strings.text: 「あ、違います。引いてるんじゃなくて、驚いてるんです。すごく可愛かったから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no, I'm not weirded out, I'm surprised. Because you were so cute......"

strings.text: 「褒め言葉のつもりかもしれんが、あまり言ってやるな。圭は女に見られる事を結構気にしているんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That might be meant as a compliment, but don't push it. Kei is pretty self-conscious about being taken for a girl."

strings.text: 「こんな時だけフォロー入れるな！　余計惨めだバカっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Don't cover for me only at times like this! It just makes it more miserable, idiot!"

strings.text: 「ご、ごめんなさいっ。わ、私が……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I'm sorry. I-I......"

strings.text: 「いいのよ。いつものことだから、あまり気にしないでよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's fine. It's a regular occurrence, so don't worry about it too much."

strings.text: 「いつもの事だからいいって事はないぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Just because it's a regular occurrence doesn't make it fine."

strings.text: 「すみません……。本当にすみません。知らなかったとはいえ、圭さんが気にしている事を……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm sorry... I'm truly sorry. Even if I didn't know, to bring up something Kei-san is sensitive about..."

strings.text: 「あ、ああ、稟ちゃんは良いんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "A-ah, Rin-chan, you're fine."

strings.text: 稟は申し訳なさそうに謝る。
strings.translated: Rin apologizes as though she feels terrible about it.

strings.text: それに対して圭は、脱力しきった表情で笑う。
strings.translated: In response, Kei laughs with a completely deflated expression.

strings.text: 「んでさ、美術部の話なんだけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Anyway, back to the art club thing."

strings.text: 「はい、是非とも入部させてください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, please, by all means let me join."

strings.text: 「ってマジかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wait, seriously?"

strings.text: 「稟ちゃん、何か真琴に弱味を握られたのか？　気を確かにもたないといけないぞ。一瞬でも弱味を見せたら真琴に骨まで食い尽くされるぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Rin-chan, does Makoto have some kind of leverage on you? You need to keep your wits about you. Show even a moment's weakness and Makoto will devour you down to the bone."

strings.text:
「あんた達ねぇ。まったく好き勝手言うわね。
いい事、聞きなさい！　御桜さんは自分の意志で我が弓張学園美術部に入りたいって言ったの！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"You two, honestly. Saying whatever you like.
Listen up! Misakura-san said of her own free will that she wants to join our Yumihari Academy art club!"

strings.text: 「そうですよ。一通り弓張学園の部活を見させて頂いて、美術部が一番良いかなぁ……って思いました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's right. I took a look at all the clubs at Yumihari Academy, and I thought the art club seemed the best..."

strings.text:
「何、むずかしい顔してるのよ。草薙。
まだ疑っているの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Why the sour face, Kusanagi?
Still suspicious?"

strings.text:
「あ、いや、そういうわけじゃない。
ただ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Ah, no, it's not that.
It's just......"

strings.text: 「ただ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Just?"

strings.text: 「稟、絵を描くのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin, you paint?"

strings.text: 「え？　はい。だ、だめでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Yes. I-is that no good?"

strings.text: 「いや、良いと思う。たぶん、問題ないと思うんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I think it's fine. I don't think there'll be any problem, probably......"

strings.text: 「何？　それ？　変な言い方ね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What? What's that? Strange way to put it."

strings.text:
「いや、まぁ気にしてくれるな。
とりあえず鳥谷が望んだ人材が入ってくれたんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"No, well, don't mind me.
Anyway, the person Toritani wanted has joined us."

strings.text: 「そうね。人数不足でサークル格下げされるかもって、冷や冷やしてたけど、質を落とさずちゃんと人数を集められた」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. I was on edge that we might get downgraded to a circle for lack of members, but we've gathered the numbers without sacrificing quality."

strings.text: 「そういえば、これでやっと五人目か」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, that finally makes five."

strings.text: 「これで安心という事だ。なんやかんや鳥谷はそわそわしてたからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's a relief. Toritani was fidgety about it one way or another."

strings.text:
「そこまではしてないわよ。
でも良かったわ。今年で最後だし、やりたい事もあるし……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"I wasn't that bad.
But still, I'm glad. This is my last year, and there are things I want to do......"

strings.text: 「やりたい事？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Things you want to do?"

strings.text: 「そうね。私が部長になったらやり遂げたいと思った事」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. Things I decided I wanted to accomplish once I became club president."

strings.text: 「そんなものがあったのか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You had things like that?"

strings.text:
「まぁ、いいじゃない。とりあえず、これで新入部員三人。今日から新生弓張美術部の始まりよ！
まずは、一年の川内野優美さん」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Well, whatever. For now, that's three new members. Starting today, the new Yumihari art club begins!
First, first-year Kawachino Yumi-san."

strings.text: 「よろしくお願いします」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "It's a pleasure."

strings.text: 「同じく一年の氷川里奈さん。草薙と圭とは知り合いだったみたいね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Also first-year, Hikawa Rina-san. Seems she already knew Kusanagi and Kei."

strings.text: 「はい、先輩達とはちょっとしたきっかけから知り合わせて頂いてます」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Yes, I got to know the senpai through a certain incident."

strings.text: 「新入生最後は御桜稟さん。草薙とは幼なじみ。長らくこの街から離れていたみたいだけど、今年からここに戻ってきた」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Last of the new members is Misakura Rin-san. Kusanagi's childhood friend. She was away from this town for a long time, but she came back this year."

strings.text: 「よろしくお願いしますっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Pleased to meet you!"

strings.text: 「そしてこっちが三年生の夏目圭。子供の時から絵画展の賞あらしと恐れられてた存在よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "And over here is third-year Natsume Kei. Since childhood he's been feared as the terror of art prize competitions."

strings.text: 「おう、受賞の数だったら直哉より上だぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, if it's number of awards, I'm ahead of Naoya."

strings.text: 「そして今年から我が美術部の部長になった、わたくし鳥谷真琴」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "And starting this year, the president of our art club, myself, Toritani Makoto."

strings.text: 「今年からなのですか？　普通、部長って夏あたりに引退しませんか？　先代の部長さんは卒業ギリギリまでやられていたのですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Starting this year? Doesn't the president usually retire around summer? Did the previous president stay on until just before graduation?"

strings.text: 「そうね。まぁだいたいは夏までよね。でも弓張美術部は代々秋の終わりまで続けるのが伝統になってるの」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. Usually it's until summer. But it's tradition in the Yumihari art club, passed down through the generations, to stay on until the end of autumn."

strings.text: 「何故秋の終わりまでなのでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Why until the end of autumn?"

strings.text: 「それは、追々分かるわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You'll come to understand that in time."

strings.text: 「あの……草薙くんは美術部員ではないのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um... Kusanagi-kun, aren't you an art club member?"

strings.text: 「ああ、違う」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no."

strings.text: 「まぁ、部員みたいなもんよね。いつもここにいるんだからさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, he's practically a member. He's always in here, after all."

strings.text: 「だったら籍は置かず、ここで絵は描かれているという事でしょうか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then you don't have your name on the roster, but you paint here?"

strings.text: 「いや、絵を描くのはずっと前にやめた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I stopped painting a long time ago......"

strings.text: 「え？　そうなんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Really?"

strings.text: 「ああ、やめたんだ。もう絵は描いてない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. I quit. I don't paint anymore."

strings.text: 「今はな。なんかいろいろあったみたいで、描いてないんだよ。でもそのうち――」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "For now, that is. Something happened, apparently, and he isn't painting. But eventually--"

strings.text: 「いや！　描かない！　やめたんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No! I won't! I quit."

strings.text: 和やかだった雰囲気が、俺の一言で静まりかえる。
strings.translated: The warm atmosphere is silenced by that single word from me.

strings.text: 「そう？　そのうち描くかも？　なんてたまに言ってたじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Really? 'Maybe someday I'll paint again' -- you'd say that now and then, wouldn't you?"

strings.text: 「それは戯れだ。俺が絵を描く事は二度とない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That was just banter. I will never paint again."

strings.text: 「ど、どうしたの？　草薙？　いつもそこまで意固地じゃないのに……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "W-what's the matter, Kusanagi? You're not usually this stubborn......"

strings.text: 「いや、すまん。別にたいした事ではないんだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, sorry. It's really nothing......"

strings.text: 「絵、描くのいつぐらいにやめたのですか？　草薙くん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "When did you stop painting, Kusanagi-kun?"

strings.text: 「だいぶ前だよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Quite a while ago......"

strings.text: 「今からだいたい六年前だよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "About six years ago."

strings.text: 「六年前？　ですか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Six years ago...... I see."

strings.text: 「なんだよ。そんな顔で睨みやがって……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What? Don't give me that look......"

strings.text: 「いや、何でもない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it's nothing......"

strings.text: 「文句があるのか？　直哉」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You got something to say, Naoya?"

strings.text: 「……いや、何でもない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "......No. Nothing."

strings.text: 「……分かったわ。この話はやめましょう」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "......All right. Let's drop this topic."

strings.text: 「そ、そうですね……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "R-right......"

strings.text: 「草薙の事は草薙が決める事だし、それより部活をはじめましょうか」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Whatever Kusanagi does is up to Kusanagi. More importantly, let's get club activities started."

strings.text:
「何でいきなり描かなくなったのか……、
俺はまだ理由を聞いてないぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"Why did you suddenly stop painting......
I still haven't heard the reason."

strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kei!"

strings.text:
「理由なんて無い！
ただやめただけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"There's no reason!
I just quit."

strings.text: 「草薙ももういいから！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kusanagi, that's enough from you too!"

strings.text:
「ただやめた？
そんなわけないだろ。
お前が理由も無く絵をやめるわけないだろ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"You just quit?
No way.
There's no way you'd quit painting without a reason!"

strings.text: 「やめるさ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I would......"

strings.text: 「全然変わらないな直哉！　六年前からそうやって、この話になると目を逸らして！　何なんだよ。何で描かなくなった理由を教えてくれないんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You haven't changed at all, Naoya! Six years now, every time this comes up you look away! What the hell? Why won't you tell me why you stopped painting!"

strings.text: 「理由なんて無い。だから話す事なんて無い！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's no reason. So there's nothing to tell!"

strings.text: 「んだと……直哉、てめぇ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why you...... Naoya, you bastard......"

strings.text: 圭は俺を睨み付ける。
strings.translated: Kei glares at me.

strings.text:
いつもの冗談めいた怒り方ではない。
圭は本気で怒っている。
strings.translated:
Not his usual joke-tinged anger.
Kei is genuinely furious.

strings.text:
こんな目で俺を睨む圭を見たのはこれで二度目。
今にも殴りかかりそうな瞳。
strings.translated:
This is the second time I've seen Kei look at me with these eyes.
Eyes that look ready to throw a punch any second.

strings.text: あの時とまったく同じだ。
strings.translated: Exactly the same as that time.

strings.text: 最初に「絵をやめる」と言った時と同じ。
strings.translated: The same as when I first said "I'm quitting painting."

strings.text: 「まるで納得してない様だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Doesn't look like you're going to accept it."

strings.text: 「当たり前だろ！　当たり前じゃないか！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Of course not! Of course I won't!"

strings.text:
「だが、俺の事情なんて、お前が知る必要なんかない。
お前が納得しようがしまいが関係ない事だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"But my circumstances -- you have no need to know them.
Whether you accept it or not doesn't matter."

strings.text: 「しょせん、お前と俺は他人だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In the end, you and I are strangers."

strings.text: 「んだとぉ！　てめぇ！　どの口で――」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You bastard! Where do you get off--"

strings.text: 肌が大きく叩かれる破裂音。
strings.translated: A sharp burst of sound, like flesh being struck.

strings.text: あまりの見事な音に俺と圭は思わず身を引いてしまう。
strings.translated: The sound was so perfect that Kei and I both flinched back.

strings.text: そこに居合わせた人間すべてが、俺が圭に叩かれた音かと思っただろう。
strings.translated: Everyone present must have thought Kei had struck me.

strings.text: だが、事実は違った。
strings.translated: But that wasn't what had happened.

strings.text: 俺と圭の間で鳥谷が自分の両手をあわせている。
strings.translated: Between Kei and me, Toritani had clapped her own hands together.

strings.text: 「っっ～」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ngh~"

strings.text: 「と、鳥谷さん！？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "T-Toritani-san!?"

strings.text: どうやら、今の見事なほどの破裂音は鳥谷が両手を大きく広げて掌を合わせて出したものであった様だ。
strings.translated: Apparently the magnificent clap just now was made by Toritani spreading her hands wide and slapping her palms together.

strings.text: 相撲で言うところの“猫だまし”。
strings.translated: In sumo terms, a "nekodamashi."

strings.text:
相当無理して叩いたのだろう。
音を出した鳥谷自身が涙目である。
strings.translated:
She must have really overdone it.
Toritani herself, who made the sound, had tears in her eyes.

strings.text: 「あ、あのさ。草薙、稟ちゃんに絵とか教えてくれないかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "U-um. Kusanagi, could you teach Rin-chan how to paint or something?"

strings.text:
涙目のまま鳥谷が俺に申し出た。
相当、痛かったんだろう。
strings.translated:
Still teary-eyed, Toritani made her request to me.
It must have hurt like hell.

strings.text: 「お、お前、どういう流れで……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-how did you get to that......"

strings.text: 「おかしくないでしょ？　あんたは絵を描かないってだけでしょ？　絵を教える事なら出来るんじゃないかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's not strange, is it? You just don't paint anymore, right? You can still teach painting, can't you?"

strings.text: 相変わらず圭は俺を睨んでいる。
strings.translated: Kei is still glaring at me.

strings.text: 半笑いで涙目の鳥谷も俺を見つめている。
strings.translated: Toritani, half-smiling, teary-eyed, is also looking at me.

strings.text: どいつもこいつも……何を考えてるんだか……。
strings.translated: Every one of them...... what are they thinking......

strings.text:
「わ、私からもお願いします。
厚かましいお願いなのは分かってますが、それでも草薙くんが良かったら是非……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"P-please, I'd like to ask too.
I know it's a presumptuous request, but if it's all right with you, Kusanagi-kun, I'd really like......"

strings.text: 空気を読んで稟まで頼んでくる。
strings.translated: Reading the mood, even Rin joined in the request.

strings.text: それで、この場がすべて収まる事をすぐに直感したのだろう。
strings.translated: She must have instantly sensed that this would settle the whole situation.

strings.text: 「稟が俺に絵を教えてくれか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin wants me to teach her painting......"

strings.text: 「どうなってるんだよ。草薙健一郎」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's going on here, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou."

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Ken'ichirou?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、何でもない。分かった。分かった。なんか知らんが分かった！　鳥谷の言う通りにする」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's nothing. Fine. Fine. I don't know what's going on, but fine! I'll do as Toritani says."

strings.text: 「そ、そう、当たり前よね！　あんたは美術部を好き勝手に使ってるんだから、そのぐらいの事はしてくれるよね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Y-yes, of course you will! You use the art room however you please, so at least do that much."

strings.text: 昨日、新入生の勧誘と文化祭だけ手伝えば良いって言ってたくせに……この女。
strings.translated: Yesterday she'd said all I had to help with was recruiting new students and the culture festival...... this woman.

strings.text: 「鳥谷さん、手大丈夫ですか？　見せてください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Toritani-san, is your hand okay? Please let me see it."

strings.text: 「な、何が？　あ、ああ、手を叩いたこと？　あれは良いアイディアが浮かんだから思わず叩いただけよ。あ、そうだ草薙が稟ちゃんに教えればいいんだ！　ってね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "W-what? Ah, right, the clap? I just clapped without thinking because a good idea came to me. Ah, right, if Kusanagi teaches Rin-chan, that solves it! Like that."

strings.text: どこの世界にアイディアが浮かんだからと言って、涙目になるぐらい派手に手を叩くやつがいるんだろう……。
strings.translated: What kind of person in the world claps hard enough to bring tears to their eyes just because they got an idea......

strings.text: それ以前に、俺や圭が稟に教えればいいとか、連れてくる前からお前自身が言ってた事だろうが……。
strings.translated: Not to mention, before you even brought her here, you yourself were saying Kei or I should teach her......

strings.text:
鳥谷は相変わらずだ……。
本当に不器用で……、
まじめで……そして、
strings.translated:
Toritani hasn't changed......
Truly clumsy......
Earnest...... and,

strings.text: 「あんな手のたたき方したら手首を捻挫しますよ。私、調理室から氷を持ってきます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "If you clap like that, you'll sprain your wrist. I'll go get some ice from the cooking room."

strings.text: 「大丈夫だって……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I'm telling you it's fine......"

strings.text: 「ここに冷蔵庫があるから氷なら取ってくるが？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's a fridge over here, so I can grab ice if you want?"

strings.text: 「大げさだなぁ。本当に大丈夫なのに」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You're overreacting. I'm really fine."

strings.text: 「絵とか描いてるのですから、こういう炎症が腱鞘炎になったら事ですよ。すみません草薙くん、とりあえず氷用意していただけますか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You paint and everything, so if inflammation like this turns into tendinitis it'll be terrible. Sorry, Kusanagi-kun, could you get some ice ready for now?"

strings.text: 稟は氷をビニール袋に入れ、さらにハンカチでくるみ、鳥谷の患部に当てる。
strings.translated: Rin puts ice into a plastic bag, wraps it further in a handkerchief, and presses it to Toritani's affected area.

strings.text: 始終「大げさだなぁ」と鳥谷は笑っていたが、稟はまったく取り合わなかった。
strings.translated: Toritani laughed the whole time, saying "You're overreacting," but Rin paid her no mind.

strings.text: 「でも……俺は納得してないからな……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But...... I still don't accept it......"

strings.text: 先ほどよりはやや穏やかに圭はつぶやいた。
strings.translated: Kei muttered, a bit more calmly than before.

strings.text:
「はい、はい、圭もいつまでもぐちぐち言ってるんじゃないわよ。
んで、稟ちゃん何やってみたい？　油絵？　陶芸？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"All right, all right, Kei, don't keep grumbling about it forever.
So, Rin-chan, what would you like to try? Oil painting? Pottery?"

strings.text: まだ納得してない……。
strings.translated: Still not accepting it......

strings.text: それを先日、俺に対して口にしたのは他ならぬ鳥谷だ。
strings.translated: Those were the very words Toritani herself said to me the other day.

strings.text: それでも鳥谷はこの場を<ｒ おさ>収</r>めようと努力した。
strings.translated: Even so, Toritani made the effort to settle the situation here.

strings.text: 鳥谷も俺に対しては圭と同じ思いであるだろうに……。
strings.translated: Toritani surely feels the same way as Kei about me......

strings.text: 我ながら情けない話だ。
strings.translated: It's a pathetic thing to say about myself.

strings.text: いっそ圭に殴られていれば気も楽になっただろうが……。
strings.translated: If anything, I'd have felt lighter if Kei had just hit me......

strings.text: 「ほら、草薙！　何ぼさってしてるのよ！　美術室の用具室まで稟ちゃん連れて行きなさい！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Come on, Kusanagi! What are you standing around for! Take Rin-chan to the storeroom in the art room!"

strings.text: 「草薙くん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-kun."

strings.text: 「あぁ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah?"

strings.text: 勢いよくお辞儀をする稟。
strings.translated: Rin bows vigorously.

strings.text: 「ああ、よろしく」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, right, nice to have you."

strings.text: 「さぁ、行くぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "All right, let's go."

strings.text: 「なんだお前来るのかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What, you're coming too?"

strings.text: 「行くよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I'm coming."

strings.text: さっきまで殴りかかりそうなぐらい不機嫌だったくせに……。
strings.translated: Even though just a moment ago he was in a mood foul enough to throw a punch......

strings.text: 「す、すごいですね……。美術室の奥にさらに美術室があるのですか？　この学校……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-this is amazing...... There's another art room beyond the art room? This school......"

strings.text: 「ここが本当の美術部の部室……というか草薙とかがたむろしている場所、本当はね。先生のアトリエなんだけど、先生があまりやる気のない人でね。結構使い放題」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "This is the real art club room...... or rather, the place where Kusanagi and the others hang out. Actually, it's the teacher's atelier, but the teacher isn't very motivated, so we get pretty free use of it."

strings.text: 「この部屋ねロフトがあるのよ。そこ見てみる？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "This room has a loft, you know. Want to see it?"

strings.text: 「ロフトですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A loft?"

strings.text: 「そう、ロフトがあるアトリエなんか他の学校じゃ、あまり無いんじゃないかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yes, an atelier with a loft -- there probably aren't many at other schools, are there?"

strings.text: 「すごい道具の数ですね……。あとすごいキャンバスの数……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "So many tools...... and so many canvases......"

strings.text: 「歴代の美術部員が残していった絵なのよ。私も完全には把握していないけど……すごい数よね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "They're paintings left behind by generations of art club members. Even I don't have a complete grasp of them all... but there's a staggering number."

strings.text: 「まぁ、歴代の絵描きなんて、俺や直哉の足元にも及ばないけどな。束でかかってきても負ける気がしない」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, generations of painters or not, none of them come close to me or Naoya. I don't feel like I'd lose even if they all came at me in a bundle."

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎の絵もあるかもしれないぞ。お前はあれに勝てるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There might be a Kusanagi Ken'ichirou painting in there. Think you could beat that?"

strings.text: 「マジで？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "For real?"

strings.text: 「今は無いわよ。そのぐらいちゃんと調べたわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There isn't one now. I've checked that much thoroughly."

strings.text:
うんざりした様子で鳥谷が答える。
彼女からしたら、当たり前の反応だ。
strings.translated:
Toritani answered with a fed-up look.
From her standpoint, it was only natural.

strings.text:
鳥谷は、「完全には把握していない」と言ったのだ。
完全ではないとしても、だいたいどんな絵があるかはすべて確認しているだろう。
strings.translated:
Toritani had said "I don't have a complete grasp."
Even if not completely, she'd probably confirmed roughly what sort of paintings were there.

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎さんって、あの草薙くんのお父さんの……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Ken'ichirou-san... that's Kusanagi-kun's father, isn't he...?"

strings.text: 「そ、草薙健一郎はこの学校の出身なの。それと、少しの間だけど、この学校の美術教師もやってたみたいよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "R-right, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou is a graduate of this school. And apparently, for a short while, he was also an art teacher here."

strings.text: 「そのあたりは若田が詳しく知ってるだろうな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wakata would know that sort of thing in detail."

strings.text: 「若田さんって……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wakata-san is..."

strings.text:
「稟ちゃんはまだ知らないかもね。ウチの学校の美術教師よ。
草薙健一郎が教師だった時の教え子なんだってさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"You wouldn't know yet, Rin-chan. He's our school's art teacher.
Apparently he was one of Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's students back when he was a teacher."

strings.text: 「あ、そ、そうなんですか。そんな有名人が恩師の美術の先生なんてすごいですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "O-oh, is that so. Having such a famous person as one's mentor -- that's amazing for an art teacher."

strings.text: 「そんな事言ったら、草薙なんてその有名人の息子じゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "If you're going to say that, Kusanagi here is that famous person's son, isn't he?"

strings.text: 「健一郎が有名なのは山師的な意味だろ。今時芸術家で有名になるなんて相当うさんくさい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ken'ichirou is famous in a charlatan sort of way. For an artist to become famous these days, you'd have to be pretty suspicious."

strings.text:
「何よ。素直じゃないわね。
だいたい、さっき草薙健一郎の絵があったら、圭もあんたも敵わない様な言い方だったじゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"What's with that. You're not being honest.
Besides, just now, weren't you talking as if neither Kei nor you could match a Kusanagi Ken'ichirou painting if there were one?"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、一応、あれでもプロだし……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, technically, he is a professional after all..."

strings.text: 「相手が誰だろうと俺は負けないね。絶対！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "No matter who the opponent is, I won't lose. Absolutely!"

strings.text: 「どこからその自信が出てくるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Where does that confidence even come from..."

strings.text: あいつが俺たちと同い年で描いた絵とか鬼だぞ。
strings.translated: The paintings that man produced at our age were nothing short of monstrous.

strings.text: 基礎デッサン力はたしかに半端ない。
strings.translated: His fundamental drawing skill was undeniably absurd.

strings.text: あと表現力も……。
strings.translated: And his expressive power too...

strings.text: 「何、難しい顔してるの？　何？　お父さんに勝てるかどうか考えてたとか？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What are you making that difficult face for? What? Thinking about whether you could beat your father?"

strings.text: 「んな事考えてねぇよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I wasn't thinking that."

strings.text: 「嘘ばっかり、だって草薙健一郎の絵を思い出してたんでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Liar, you were remembering Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's paintings, weren't you?"

strings.text: 「私たちと同い年の頃の絵だけど……あれ、鬼よね。あんな絵描くとか恐ろしいわ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The paintings from when he was our age... those were monstrous. It's terrifying that someone could paint like that..."

strings.text: 「見た事あるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You've seen them?"

strings.text: あいつがプロになる前の絵など未発表なはずだ。
strings.translated: His paintings from before he became a professional should be unpublished.

strings.text: 数点、俺の家に残っていたが……。
strings.translated: A few were left in my house, but...

strings.text: 「あんた知らないだろうけど、実はこの作品の山に埋もれてたのよ。弓張学園の生徒だった頃の草薙健一郎の絵が」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You wouldn't know, but actually, they were buried in this mountain of works. Paintings by Kusanagi Ken'ichirou from when he was a Yumihari Academy student."

strings.text: 「さっき無いって」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You just said there weren't any."

strings.text: 「今は無いって言ったでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I said there aren't any now, didn't I?"

strings.text: 「ほ、本当か？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "R-really?"

strings.text:
「本当よ。見つけたの私だし。
入部して三ヶ月で見つけ出したわ。
私ってば宝探しの才能まであるんじゃないかしらねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Really. I'm the one who found them.
Dug them up three months after joining the club.
I wonder if I don't have a talent for treasure hunting on top of everything else."

strings.text: 「何だよ。それ大ニュースじゃないか。何で大騒ぎにならなかったんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What?! That's huge news! Why didn't it make a stir?"

strings.text: 「若田先生が直接草薙健一郎に連絡つけて、ニューヨークに送っちゃったからねぇ。騒ぎにもならなかった」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wakata-sensei contacted Kusanagi Ken'ichirou directly and shipped them off to New York. There wasn't any fuss."

strings.text: 「死後だったら、大騒ぎにもなっただろうが、若田と健一郎は仲が良かったからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If it had been after his death, it would've been a huge commotion, but Wakata and Ken'ichirou were on good terms."

strings.text: 「それにしても学校にも知らせなかったのか？　学校に知らせてたら、うわさ話程度にはなりそうなもんだが？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even so, he didn't inform the school? If he had, it would've at least become gossip material, wouldn't it?"

strings.text: 「うん、そうかもね。でもあまり騒ぎにしたくなかったんじゃないの？　秘密裏に送られちゃったわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yeah, maybe. But I guess he didn't want to make a big deal of it? They were shipped off in secret."

strings.text:
さらりと言う鳥谷。
公にすれば得をするのは鳥谷自身だったろうに……。
strings.translated:
Toritani said it lightly.
And yet, if it had been made public, Toritani herself would've been the one to benefit...

strings.text: 「見返りとか無かったのか？　草薙健一郎の絵を見つけたんだから何かあっただろ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wasn't there any reward or anything? You found Kusanagi Ken'ichirou paintings -- there had to be something."

strings.text: 「そうね。見返りと言えば、数週間だけ私に預からせてもらったわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Let's see. As for a reward, I got to keep them in my possession for a few weeks."

strings.text: 「預かっただけ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Just kept them?"

strings.text: 「そうよ。草薙健一郎が私たちと同い年の時、どんな絵を描いてたか研究したかったから、毎日、それこそ絵に穴が空くんじゃないかってぐらい見たわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. I wanted to study what kind of paintings Kusanagi Ken'ichirou did when he was our age, so every day, I stared at them hard enough to burn holes through them."

strings.text: 「んで？　研究結果は？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And? The research results?"

strings.text: 「いやぁ、やっぱり天才って言われる人は違うわ。なんか見てて、感心する事ばかりだったけど、自分で参考に出来る事なんかなかったかなぁ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, the people called geniuses really are different. I found so much to be impressed by looking at them, but there wasn't really anything I could take as reference for myself."

strings.text: 「自画自賛激しい真琴がそんな謙虚になるぐらい、草薙健一郎の絵はすごいのか……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "For Makoto -- who's usually so eager to pat herself on the back -- to get that humble, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's paintings must really be something..."

strings.text: 「うん、すごいわね。あといろいろな事が分かったわ……特に後期の草薙健一郎の絵がなぜ、あの様な筆さばきで描かれたのか……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yeah, they're incredible. And they made a lot of things clear to me... especially why Kusanagi Ken'ichirou painted with that particular brushwork in his later years..."

strings.text: そう言うと、鳥谷は俺の右手をちらりと見る。
strings.translated: Having said that, Toritani glanced at my right hand.

strings.text: 俺は不自然にその手を隠してしまう。
strings.translated: I hid the hand unnaturally.

strings.text: 「どんなだ？　どんな筆さばきで描かれたか、分かったんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What was it like? You figured out what kind of brushwork he used, right?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、圭には関係ないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, it has nothing to do with you, Kei."

strings.text: 「何だよ！　何で俺に関係ないんだよ！　俺をバカにしてるからなのか！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What?! Why doesn't it have anything to do with me?! Is it because you're looking down on me?!"

strings.text: 「違う。お前の技法には必要ないんだよ。草薙健一郎の技法なんて……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No. It's not necessary for your technique. Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's technique, that is..."

strings.text: 「どういう事だそれ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What's that supposed to mean?"

strings.text: 「圭は、人の絵なんか気にせずに自由気ままに描けばいいのよ。だってあんたは自称天才でしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kei, you should just paint freely as you please without worrying about others' paintings. You're a self-proclaimed genius, aren't you?"

strings.text: 「自称って何だよ。俺は天才だぞ。それと草薙直哉だって天才だぞ。健一郎とかに劣る部分が無いぐらいだ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What do you mean, self-proclaimed. I am a genius. And Kusanagi Naoya's a genius too. There's nothing about him that's inferior to Ken'ichirou or whoever."

strings.text: 「そりゃ、お前の目が節穴だからだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's just because your eyes are useless..."

strings.text: 「なんでだよ！　お前だって負ける気なんかしないだろ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why?! You don't feel like you'd lose either, do you?!"

strings.text:
「くす、そうね。そのぐらいじゃないと困るわね。
そういえば、稟ちゃんって絵の経験って」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Hehe, right. It'd be a problem if he didn't have at least that much confidence.
Come to think of it, Rin-chan, do you have any experience with painting?"

strings.text: 「はい、授業で少しというぐらいでしょうか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, only a little bit in class, I suppose."

strings.text: 「それで？　絵とか描くの好き？　嫌い？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "And? Do you like painting? Or dislike it?"

strings.text:
「美術部に入りたいと思ったぐらいですから、好きです。
と言いたいところなのですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Well, since I wanted to join the art club, I like it.
Or so I'd like to say, but..."

strings.text:
「でも、正直に言いますと、好きって言えるのかまだ分かりません。
ちゃんと向き合って絵を描いた事ありませんから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"To be honest, I don't know yet if I can say I like it.
I've never really faced a canvas and painted properly."

strings.text: 「まじめなのね。でもそんな難しく考える事ないと思うよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You're serious about it. But I don't think you need to overthink it."

strings.text: 「はい、とりあえずがんばって描いてみます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, for now I'll do my best and try painting."

strings.text: 「そうだね。とりあえず描いてみる事、そこからだね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. For now, just try painting -- that's where it starts."

strings.text: 鳥谷はまっさらのキャンバスを持ち上げる。
strings.translated: Toritani lifted a blank canvas.

strings.text: 「さぁ、これが御桜稟最初の油絵作品となるキャンバスよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There, this is the canvas that will be Misakura Rin's first oil painting."

strings.text: 新品のキャンバスを稟に手渡す。
strings.translated: She handed the new canvas to Rin.

strings.text: 稟はそれを受け取った。
strings.translated: Rin took it.

strings.text: 「えっと……これは……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um... this is..."

strings.text: 「木炭だぞ。通称は木炭だ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's charcoal. Commonly called mokutan."

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Charcoal..."

strings.text: 圭から渡された木炭を見つめる稟。
strings.translated: Rin stared at the charcoal Kei had handed her.

strings.text: 「稟ちゃん？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Rin-chan?"

strings.text: 「え？　あ、はい」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Ah, yes."

strings.text: 「どうしたの？　木炭握るなりいきなり黙り込んで……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What's wrong? You went silent the moment you took the charcoal..."

strings.text: 「あ、いいえ、何でも無いです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's nothing."

strings.text: 「それより圭、イーゼルと対象物との位置関係を、顔を動かさなくても大丈夫なようにしないと、手伝って……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "More importantly, Kei, we've got to arrange the easel and the subject so she doesn't have to move her head. Help me..."

strings.text: 「おう！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Right!"

strings.text:
慌ただしく二人が、稟のためにセッティングする。
俺はゆっくりイーゼルと対象物を確認してから、
strings.translated:
The two of them bustled about setting things up for Rin.
I checked the easel and the subject at my own pace, and then,

strings.text: 「二人とも少しどいてろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You two, move aside for a second..."

strings.text: 「これでどうだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How's this?"

strings.text: 「あ、ちょうどいいです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, that's just right."

strings.text: 「くだらぬ事を考える必要はないから、適当に描いてみればいい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No need to think about anything foolish -- just try painting however you like."

strings.text: 「はいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes!"

strings.text: 「それより、それでいいのか？　鉛筆もあるぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "More to the point, are you okay with that? We have pencils too."

strings.text: 「あ、だ、大丈夫です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, i-it's fine."

strings.text: 「そうか、だったらとりあえず描いてみろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. Then for now, try drawing."

strings.text: 稟は相変わらずもてあますように木炭を指の中でこねている。
strings.translated: Rin was still kneading the charcoal awkwardly between her fingers.

strings.text: 「教えるの<r さま>様</r>になってるじゃないのっ、セッティングの手際の良さから指示まですべて！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You've really got the teaching bit down pat, haven't you! From the smooth setup to the instructions, all of it!"

strings.text: 「<r さま>様</r>だけじゃダメだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just 'down pat' isn't enough, is it..."

strings.text: 「えっと……」
strings.speaker: 稟
稟
strings.translated: "Nngh..."

strings.text: 「あ、あれ？　あれれ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wh-what? Huh?"

strings.text: 「力入れすぎだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're gripping too hard."

strings.text: 「もっと柔らかく持て」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hold it more softly."

strings.text: 「っ…っ……っっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nn... nn... nngh..."

strings.text: 「あ、あのさ……草薙……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "H-hey... Kusanagi..."

strings.text: 「なんだ鳥谷」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is it, Toritani."

strings.text: 「もしかして……稟ちゃんって不器用？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Could it be... Rin-chan is clumsy with her hands?"

strings.text: 「そうだな。あれを見る限り、不器用だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. From the looks of it, she is."

strings.text: 「ご、ごめんなさい。また折ってしまいました……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I'm sorry. I snapped it again..."

strings.text:
「気にするな。木炭など消耗品だ。
それより……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Don't worry about it. Charcoal is a consumable.
More importantly..."

strings.text: 俺はペン入れから数本の鉛筆を取り出す。
strings.translated: I pulled a few pencils out of my pen case.

strings.text: 何種かの鉛筆の中から適当に選んだものを俺は稟に手渡す。
strings.translated: From among several kinds of pencils, I picked one at random and handed it to Rin.

strings.text: 「とりあえずこの鉛筆を使え、削り具合も色の濃さもお前の筆圧に丁度良いはずだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For now, use this pencil. The sharpening and the darkness of the color should suit your grip pressure just right."

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, yes..."

strings.text: 「あれ？　不器用と思ったけど、なんか結構精密なデッサンじゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? I thought she was clumsy, but this is actually a pretty precise drawing, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「その様だな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Seems that way..."

strings.text: 「うーん。なんだか草薙は、鉛筆持たせるとデッサンが変わるのを最初から分かっていたみたい」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hmm. It's like Kusanagi knew from the start that her drawing would change once she had a pencil in hand."

strings.text: 「いいや、分かっていたわけじゃないさ。ただどう見ても木炭をもてあましていたからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I didn't know. It's just that no matter how you looked at it, she was struggling with the charcoal."

strings.text: 「そうね。たしかに初心者が木炭って少しハードル高いかもね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. Charcoal really is a bit high a hurdle for a beginner..."

strings.text: 初心者という事が原因ならば別に問題は無いのだが……。
strings.translated: If it were simply a matter of being a beginner, there'd be no problem, but...

strings.text: 木炭はまさに炭そのもの、燃えた後のものを連想させる……。
strings.translated: Charcoal is literally charred wood -- it calls to mind things reduced to ash...

strings.text: 「……すっかり日が落ちてます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "...The sun's completely down."

strings.text: 「あははは、集中してたからな！　稟ちゃんも直哉も……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahaha, well, you were concentrating! Both you and Naoya, Rin-chan..."

strings.text: 「どれ、見せてみろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Let's see, show me."

strings.text: 「あ、全然へたくそだけど……お願いしますっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, it's terrible, but... please."

strings.text: 「どれどれ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Let's see, let's see."

strings.text: 「私も見る」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I'll look too."

strings.text: 「初心者ならだいぶ上手いんじゃないの？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "For a beginner, isn't this pretty good?"

strings.text: 「そうね。良く描けてるじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yeah. It's well done."

strings.text: 「そうだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: たしかに良く描けている。
strings.translated: Certainly, it was well done.

strings.text: そういうレベルのものだ。
strings.translated: At precisely that level -- no more, no less.

strings.text: そういえば、あの男はこう言っていたな。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, that man had said this.

strings.text: 「もし仮に稟と再び出会う事があっても、恐れる事はないさ。たぶん彼女はお前が知っているただの穏和な女の子だ」
strings.translated: "Even if you happen to meet Rin again, you needn't fear. She's probably just the gentle girl you've always known."

strings.text: まぁ、当たり前と言えば当たり前か……。
strings.translated: Well, I suppose that much goes without saying...

strings.text: 「あ、あの、だ、ダメでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um, i-is it no good?"

strings.text: 「え？　何が？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Eh? For what?"

strings.text:
「何がもなにも、あんな難しい顔して見られたら、誰だって嫌なもんよ。
んで、草薙先生としてはどうなの？　この絵？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"'What is' nothing. Anyone would hate to be stared at with such a difficult expression.
So, Kusanagi-sensei, what do you say? This drawing?"

strings.text: 「いいんじゃないか。良く描けてる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's fine, isn't it. Well done."

strings.text: 「本当ですか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really?"

strings.text: 「ああ、普通に良く描けているさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's well done in an ordinary way."

strings.text: 「良かったっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Thank goodness."

strings.text: 「そうか！　よかったな！　んじゃ、本格的に帰りの用意だ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Right! Good for you! All right then, time to get ready to head home for real!"

strings.text: 「ああ。今日は疲れたな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. Today was tiring..."

strings.text: 「そうか？　楽しそうに見えたけど？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Really? You looked like you were having fun."

strings.text: 「いや、相当疲れた。ふぅ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
