strings.translated: "No, I'm quite tired. Whew."

strings.text: 俺はため息と共に席に座り込む。
strings.translated: With a sigh, I sank into a seat.

strings.text: 「ごめんなさい……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm sorry..."

strings.text: 「問題ないぞ。直哉はこう言っているが、本当に嫌な事は絶対にやらないヤツだからな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "No worries. Naoya says this, but he's the type who absolutely refuses to do anything he really dislikes."

strings.text: 「人の気持ちを勝手に代弁するな。疲れたのは本当だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't go speaking for people's feelings on your own. I really am tired."

strings.text: 「でも、楽しかったんでしょ？　だったらイイじゃないの」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But you had fun, right? Then that's fine, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「百歩譲ってそうだとしても、なるべくつらそうにしておいた方が、貸しっぽくなる。だから勝手な代弁は無用だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even granting that a hundred times over, it's better to look like it was a chore -- that way it feels like she owes me one. So don't go speaking for me."

strings.text: 「そんな事しなくても感謝してるよ。出来たら形を変えてお礼しなきゃいけないと思っているぐらいだし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Even without that, I'm grateful. If I could, I'd want to repay you in some form..."

strings.text: 「あー、そういうの必要ないから。草薙が楽しかったんだから、貸しも借りも無し！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ah, there's no need for that. Kusanagi had fun, so there's no debt either way!"

strings.text: 「稟ちゃんは草薙のご厚意に甘えておきなさい。これは部長命令よ！　いい？　命令だからね！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Rin-chan, you should just accept Kusanagi's kindness. This is a club president's order! Got it? It's an order!"

strings.text: 「め、命令ですか。あ、は、はい……わかりました。とりあえず、ご厚意に甘えてそう考えさせていただきましょう」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A-an order. Ah, y-yes... understood. For now, I'll accept the kindness and think about it that way."

strings.text: 「どいつもこいつも勝手な……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Every last one of you does whatever you please..."

strings.text: 「ふーん、そうですか」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Hmm, is that so."

strings.text: 始終、何故か絵も描かずに俺を見つめていた川内野が突然声を出す。
strings.translated: Kawachino, who for some reason had been staring at me the whole time without even drawing, suddenly spoke up.

strings.text: 「どうしたの？　川内野さん？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What is it, Kawachino-san?"

strings.text: 「いいえ、草薙直哉って、人に絵を教えるのだなぁ……と」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "No, just... Kusanagi Naoya actually teaches people to draw, huh..."

strings.text: 「そりゃ、人に教えるぐらいはするんじゃないかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, teaching people that much isn't out of the question, is it?"

strings.text: 「……そうですね」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "...I suppose."

strings.text: 何故か、川内野は氷川の事を見つめる。
strings.translated: For some reason, Kawachino looked over at Hikawa.

strings.text: 氷川は小さく頷く。
strings.translated: Hikawa gave a small nod.

strings.text: 「ふぅ……、まぁ、納得しているのであれば、仕方ありませんが……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Fuu... well, if you're satisfied with it, then it can't be helped..."

strings.text: 「何の話かしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What's this about?"

strings.text: 「知らん。それよりもとりあえず川内野にも教えるぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No idea. More importantly, I'll teach Kawachino too for now."

strings.text: 「私に？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Me?"

strings.text: 「俺は弟子は取らないが、初心者に油絵のいろはを教える程度の事なら出来る」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't take on disciples, but I can teach a beginner the basics of oil painting."

strings.text: 「なるほど……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: ため息をついた後に、川内野が小さく笑う。
strings.translated: After a sigh, Kawachino gave a small laugh.

strings.text: 「そうですね。だったら初心者の私は教えていただけたらと思います」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "All right, then. As a beginner, I'd be grateful if you'd teach me."

strings.text: 「そろそろ帰らないと、学校が閉まるわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "We'd better head home soon, or the school'll close on us."

strings.text: 「そうだな。とっとと帰るか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Right. Let's get going."

strings.text: 「うん。帰るぞ。稟ちゃんも急ぐといいぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah. Time to head out. Rin-chan, you'd better hurry too."

strings.text: 鳥谷は最後の点検と戸締まりをするから少しだけ残るとの事だった。
strings.translated: Toritani said she'd stay behind a bit longer to do the final check and lock up.

strings.text: 鳥谷を残して俺たちは美術室を後にする。
strings.translated: Leaving Toritani behind, we left the art room.

strings.text: 「さてと帰るか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "All right, home we go."

strings.text: 「俺腹減ったぞ。家帰ったら楽しみだな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I'm starving. Something to look forward to when I get home."

strings.text: 「楽しみも何も、俺がここにいる限りにおいてメシの用意なんてされていないぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Look forward to' nothing -- so long as I'm the one there, no meal's been prepared."

strings.text: 「なんだと！　家に帰っても何もないのか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What!? There's nothing at home?"

strings.text: 「当たり前だろ。誰がいつも料理を作ってると思ってるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Obviously. Who do you think does the cooking all the time..."

strings.text: 「稟は今は桜ヶ原じゃないんだよな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin, you're not living in Sakuragahara now, are you..."

strings.text: 「あれ？　そうだけど、何で草薙くん知ってるの？　まだ草薙くんには言ってなかったと思ったけど……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? That's right, but how do you know, Kusanagi-kun? I don't think I've told you yet..."

strings.text: 「え？　あ、ああ……そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Eh? Ah, yeah... you're right."

strings.text: 「桜ヶ原って、この辺りだろ。直哉のマンションとか近くだな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Sakuragahara -- that's around here, right? Close to Naoya's apartment."

strings.text: 「あ、ああ、そうだな……、それより稟、今はどこなんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah, that's right... So, Rin, where are you now?"

strings.text: 「うん、今はね小音羽なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Mm, right now I'm in Kootoha."

strings.text: 「小音羽……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kootoha..."

strings.text: 「どうしましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is something the matter?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、何でも無い。そういえば小音羽にも昔住んでたな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's nothing. Come to think of it, I used to live in Kootoha too, long ago..."

strings.text: 「うん、そうだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, that's right."

strings.text: 「……そうだよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Yeah, that's right."

strings.text: 「小音羽なら俺の家の近くじゃないか？　なら稟ちゃんも電車か？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Kootoha's near my place, isn't it? Then Rin-chan, you're on the train too?"

strings.text: 「そうですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's right."

strings.text: 「なら直哉と一緒に帰るといいぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Then you should go home together with Naoya."

strings.text: 「え？　でも草薙くんは桜ヶ原のマンションじゃなかった？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? But Kusanagi-kun, weren't you at the apartment in Sakuragahara?"

strings.text: 「今は、小音羽のおれんちに住んでるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Right now he's living at my place in Kootoha."

strings.text: 「そ、そうなんですか？　でも何で？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-is that so? But why?"

strings.text: 「直哉って、男独り身だろ？　なんかいろいろ出来ない事も多いからウチに居候してるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya's a single guy living alone, right? There are a lot of things he can't do, so he's been staying at our place as a boarder."

strings.text: 「い　ろ　い　ろ　出　来　な　い　の　は　夏　目　の　人　間　だ　ろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "T h e   o n e   w h o   c a n' t   d o   t h i n g s   i s   t h e   N a t s u m e."

strings.text: 「んじゃ俺はバイクで帰るから！　二人はゆっくり電車に揺られながら帰ってくると良いぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, I'll be heading back by bike! You two enjoy the leisurely train ride home."

strings.text: 「はい、それではお疲れ様でした」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, thanks for the hard work today."

strings.text: 圭はにっこり笑うと、大きく手を振りながら駐輪場に走り出す。
strings.translated: Kei smiled brightly and, waving broadly, ran off toward the bike lot.

strings.text: 俺たちは圭とは逆方向の坂道、夢浮坂を下っていった。
strings.translated: We took the opposite direction from Kei, heading down the slope of Yume-no-Ukisaka.

strings.text: 「今日はごめんなさい……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm sorry about today..."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、なんだか無理矢理、絵とか教えてもらってしまって……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, I mean, I sort of forced you into teaching me to draw and all..."

strings.text: 「いや、別に、俺も楽しかったし。問題ない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, really, I had fun too. It's fine."

strings.text: 「貸しとか冗談だから、真に受けるな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That stuff about owing me one was a joke, don't take it seriously."

strings.text: 「実際、絵に接する機会がほとんど無かったからな。普通に楽しかった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In fact, I've hardly had any chances to be around art lately. I genuinely enjoyed it."

strings.text:
「そうですか、だったら良かったです。でも疲れたのは本当ですよね。
始終、私のためにいろいろしてくれてましたから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Is that so. Then I'm glad. But you really were tired, weren't you.
You were doing all sorts of things for me from start to finish."

strings.text:
「慣れない環境だからな、いろいろしてやるのも当然だ。だが楽しかった。
圭が言う通り俺は楽しくなかったら教えなどしない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"It's an unfamiliar environment for you, so it's only natural to do things for you. But it was fun.
Like Kei said, I wouldn't teach if I weren't enjoying it."

strings.text: 「それより、お前はどうだったんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "More importantly, how was it for you?"

strings.text: 「私ですか？　私はもちろん楽しかったです。私が楽しくないわけないです！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Me? Of course I had fun. There's no way it wouldn't have been fun for me!"

strings.text: 「そうか。正直、お前は空気を読んで部活に入るとか言い出したと思った」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. Honestly, I thought you might've said you'd join the club just to read the room."

strings.text: 「空気を読んで……ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "To read the room...?"

strings.text: 「ああ、鳥谷の様子を察してな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I was just picking up on Toritani's mood."

strings.text: 「そんな事ありませんよ。元々は私から入部したいと話しかけたのですから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's not the case. I was the one who asked to join in the first place."

strings.text: 「そうか？　だったらいいのだけど……流されてだったら少し不憫だな。と」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really? Well, if that's true, then good... I just thought it'd be a bit sad if you were only going along with the flow."

strings.text:
「草薙くんの記憶の中の私って、そんな子なのですか？
でも、私は人に流されてそういう事は決めたりしません」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Is that the kind of girl I am in your memory, Kusanagi-kun?
But I don't decide things like that just because I'm swept along by others."

strings.text: 「弓張に帰ってきたら、ずっと絵を描いてみたいと思ってました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ever since I came back to Yumihari, I've been wanting to try drawing."

strings.text: 「弓張に帰ってきたら？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ever since you came back to Yumihari?"

strings.text: 「はい、良く分からないのですが。この街を離れてから、ずっとそう思ってきた……。この街で筆を握ってみたいって」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes. I don't really understand it myself. But ever since I left this town, I've felt that way... that I wanted to hold a brush in this town."

strings.text: この街で筆を握ってみたい……か。
strings.translated: To hold a brush in this town... huh.

strings.text: 「……そっか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...I see."

strings.text: 俺を見つめる瞳は、昔と同じ。
strings.translated: The eyes gazing at me were the same as they had been long ago.

strings.text: 彼女は物腰が柔らかく、優しくて、そして誰よりも意志が強い。
strings.translated: Soft-mannered, gentle, and yet stronger of will than anyone.

strings.text: そんな瞳をしている。
strings.translated: Those were the eyes she had.

strings.text: 「変わらないな。そりゃそうだよな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You haven't changed. Well, of course you haven't..."

strings.text: 「え？　何がですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「いや、なんでも無いさ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it's nothing..."

strings.text: そろそろ電車が小音羽の最寄りの駅である歌木に着く。
strings.translated: Any moment now the train would pull into Utagi, the station nearest Kootoha.

strings.text: 夜の道を二人で歩いていく。
strings.translated: The two of us walked along the night road.

strings.text:
会話は少ない。
と言うよりもほとんどない。
strings.translated:
There was little conversation.
Or rather, almost none.

strings.text: 二人で夜の道を歩いていく。
strings.translated: The two of us walked along the night road.

strings.text: すると稟が突然立ち止まった。
strings.translated: Then, all at once, Rin stopped.

strings.text: 「どうした？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's wrong?"

strings.text: 「この公園ってまだあるんだなぁ……と思いました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I was just thinking -- this park is still here."

strings.text: 「公園？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Park?"

strings.text: 「ほら、この樫の木公園」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "See -- the Oak Tree Park."

strings.text: 「樫の木公園？　ああ、そんな風に呼ばれていた時期もあったな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The Oak Tree Park? Ah, right, there was a time when people called it that."

strings.text: 「今は違うのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's different now?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだ。あの樫の木は切られて無いんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. That oak tree got cut down."

strings.text: 「そう言われてみればあの木無くなってしまったのですね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Now that you mention it, that tree really is gone..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな。お前が居なくなってすぐに、切られてしまったな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. It was cut down right after you left."

strings.text: 「そうだったのですか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 俺は今まで気にもしなかった入り口の表札を見つめる。
strings.translated: I stared at the sign at the entrance -- a sign I'd never even bothered to notice before.

strings.text: 公園の入り口の表札にははっきりと小音羽児童公園と書かれている。
strings.translated: The nameplate at the park's entrance clearly read "Kootoha Children's Park."

strings.text: 俺は無言でそのまま公園に入る。
strings.translated: Without a word, I walked into the park.

strings.text: すぐに俺のあとを稟が追って入る。
strings.translated: Rin followed after me at once.

strings.text: 「ブランコですね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "There are swings..."

strings.text: 「ああ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「腰掛けますか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Shall we sit?"

strings.text: 「そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's true."

strings.text: 夜のブランコに二人は腰掛ける。
strings.translated: The two of us sat down on the swings at night.

strings.text: 「きれいになったんだね。この公園」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's become pretty. This park."

strings.text: 古くからある公園だが、今では一新されている。
strings.translated: It was an old park, but now it had been refurbished.

strings.text: 「変わるんだね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Things change, don't they."

strings.text: 「あれから結構な時間が経ったんだから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's been a fair amount of time since then, after all."

strings.text: 「不思議だね。街って時間が経つと新しくなっていっちゃうんだよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's strange. As time passes, towns just keep getting newer."

strings.text: 「住んでると分からないが、言われてみれば、いろいろ新しくなっている事に気がつく」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You don't notice when you're living there, but now that you mention it, I can see all kinds of things have been renewed."

strings.text: 「私とか、そこに住んでた人間とかは年をとっていくのに、街はどんどん新しくなっていく」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Even though I -- and the people who used to live there -- keep growing older, the town just keeps getting newer."

strings.text: 「変わっていくのに、変わっていない……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It changes, and yet it hasn't changed..."

strings.text:
「変わらなければいいのに……と思う。でも変わっていく。
同じ風景なのに違う風景」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"I wish it wouldn't change... but it does.
The same scenery, and yet a different scenery."

strings.text: 「記憶にある場所と違うのに、でもここがあの場所だって分かる」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's different from the place in my memory, but even so, I can tell this is that place."

strings.text: 「そこまで変わったわけじゃない。分かるに決まってるだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It hasn't changed that much. Of course you'd recognize it."

strings.text: 「そうでしょうか。私的には結構がらりと変わっちゃった感じがします」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You think so? To me, it feels like quite a lot has changed."

strings.text: 「そうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 「ずっとこの街の事を思い続けてたから……ただそれだけの事かもしれません」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I've been thinking about this town all this time... maybe that's all it is."

strings.text: 「思い出は美化されるというわけか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You mean memories get romanticized?"

strings.text: 「そんな事ないよ。弓張は思い出に負けないぐらい良い場所だよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's not it. Yumihari is a place good enough to match my memories of it."

strings.text: 「思い出に負けないぐらい……か」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Good enough to match your memories... huh."

strings.text: ブランコから夜空を見上げる。
strings.translated: From the swing, I looked up at the night sky.

strings.text: 街灯りに照らされた夜空の星々は弱々しい。
strings.translated: The stars in the night sky, washed out by the streetlights, were faint.

strings.text: こんな風景も変わったのだろうか。
strings.translated: Perhaps even scenery like this had changed.

strings.text: あの時と同じなのだろうか。
strings.translated: Or perhaps it was the same as it was back then.

strings.text: 「そういえば、木炭を持った瞬間、少し戸惑っていたな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, the moment you picked up the charcoal, you looked a little lost."

strings.text:
「え？　そ、そう見えました？
そんな気は無かったのですが……やはり変に見えましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Eh? D-did it look that way?
I didn't mean to seem that way... did it really look strange?"

strings.text: 「変というか、木炭を持って感じた事でもあった様に見えた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Not strange, exactly -- it looked like there was something you felt when you held the charcoal."

strings.text: 「なるほど、鋭い観察力ですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see. What a sharp eye you have."

strings.text: 「あったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So there was something?"

strings.text: 「正直分かりません。あった様な、なかった様な、ただ何となく木炭を触った感触が独特で……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Honestly, I'm not sure. It felt like there was, and yet like there wasn't. It's just that the sensation of touching charcoal was unusual..."

strings.text: 「木炭なんて触ったのはじめてのハズなのですが」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Even though it should have been my first time ever touching charcoal."

strings.text:
「そうか。だったらいい。今後は鉛筆を使え。
あの鉛筆とは相性がよさそうだからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I see. Well, that's fine. From now on, use pencil.
That pencil seems to suit you well."

strings.text: 「はい、３Ｂの鉛筆なんてはじめて使いました。なんか美術って感じがします」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes -- it was my first time using a 3B pencil. It really feels like art."

strings.text: 「まぁ、普通の生活ならＨＢ、濃くてもＢ止まりだろうからな。あんな濃さの鉛筆などデッサンにしか使わない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, in everyday life people use HB, or B at the darkest. Pencils that soft are only ever used for sketching."

strings.text: 「そうですね。いかにもデッサンという感じでした」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's true. It really did feel like a proper sketch."

strings.text: 「うれしそうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You look happy."

strings.text: 「そりゃうれしいですよ。だって新しくはじめる事は楽しいですもの」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Of course I'm happy. Starting something new is fun, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「そっか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see."

strings.text: 新しくはじめる事は楽しいか……。
strings.translated: Starting something new is fun, huh...

strings.text: そうかもしれないな。
strings.translated: Maybe that's true.

strings.text: 俺は稟を見つめる。
strings.translated: I gazed at Rin.

strings.text: 二人のブランコは静止したままだ。
strings.translated: The two swings remained still.

strings.text: 「そういえば、お前は昔、そのブランコに乗れなかったんだよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, you used to not be able to ride that swing, didn't you."

strings.text: 「え？　と、突然ですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? T-that's rather sudden."

strings.text: 「昔の事を思いだしてた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I was just remembering old times."

strings.text: 「う、えっと……、秘密、です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, well... it's a secret."

strings.text: 「秘密？　なんだそりゃ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A secret? What's that supposed to mean..."

strings.text: 「えっと、あははは……、面目ありません。まだ乗れませんよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, ahaha... I'm ashamed to say -- I still can't ride them."

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 「なるほど、未だに乗れないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. So you still can't, huh?"

strings.text: 「えへへ……不器用ですからね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ehehe... it's because I'm clumsy."

strings.text: 「不器用というか、義理堅いというんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "More like earnest than clumsy, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「そうなのでしょうか……ね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is that so... I wonder."

strings.text: 「お前はブランコを教えてくれって頼んだ事があった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You once asked me to teach you the swing."

strings.text: 「覚えてますか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Do you remember?"

strings.text: 「ああ、覚えてるとも、お前は口をとがらせて言っていた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I remember. You said it with your lips all pouted out."

strings.text: 「最初に地面を蹴るでしょ。そのままにしてたら止まるんだもん。いくら強く蹴っても止まるんだもん、ってな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'You kick off the ground at first, right? But if you just leave it, it stops. No matter how hard I kick, it stops,' you said."

strings.text: 「そんなバカっぽかったでしょうか……。あはははお恥ずかしいかぎりです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Was I really that silly...? Ahahaha, how embarrassing."

strings.text: 「俺は、いつか教えてやるよ。って言った」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And I said, someday I'll teach you."

strings.text: 「そうですね。いつか教えてくれると言ってました……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's right. You said you'd teach me someday..."

strings.text: 「待ってたのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Were you waiting?"

strings.text:
「あ、いいえ、そんな事はないですよ。
ただ、これはいつかなおくんに教えてもらえばいいや。
ぐらいな感じで」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Ah, no, nothing like that.
Just, this is something I can have Nao-kun teach me someday.
Something like that."

strings.text:
「でも、数少ない残された約束……。
そんな風には考えてました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"But it was one of the few promises left...
That's how I thought of it."

strings.text: 「今のお前なら簡単に分かりそうなもんだけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The you of now ought to figure it out easily, though."

strings.text:
「いいえ、分かりません。
揺れている物はいつか止まるものだし、今でもその疑問はあまり変わりません」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"No, I don't understand.
Things that sway eventually stop, and even now that question hasn't really changed for me."

strings.text: 「力が加え続けられるならば揺れ続ける」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If force keeps being applied, it keeps swinging."

strings.text: 「でも、空に地面はありませんよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But there's no ground in the sky."

strings.text:
「地面は関係無い。空に何も無くてもいいんだよ。
ただ何も考えずに動かせばいい。深くは考えない事だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"The ground has nothing to do with it. It's fine even if there's nothing in the sky.
Just move without thinking. Don't think about it deeply."

strings.text: 「深くは考えない事……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Don't think about it deeply..."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、いつもみたいに動かしてみろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For now, try to move it like you always do..."

strings.text: 「いつもみたいにって……あれから一度もブランコなんか乗ってないけどね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Like I always do... I haven't ridden a swing once since back then, you know."

strings.text:
「なら、昔みたいに……。
ブランコに乗ってみろよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Then, like you did long ago...
Try riding the swing."

strings.text: 「分かりました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Understood."

strings.text:
稟はその一蹴りをはじめる。
その姿はまるで、
strings.translated:
Rin began with that first kick.
Her figure was just like --

strings.text:
歩き出す時の様に、
走り出す時の様に、
飛び上がる時の様に、
strings.translated:
like when someone takes their first step,
like when someone breaks into a run,
like when someone leaps up --

strings.text: 稟は地面を蹴る……。
strings.translated: Rin kicked the ground...

strings.text: 「んっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nn."

strings.text: 俺の声に合わせて、稟が地面を大きく蹴る。
strings.translated: In time with my voice, Rin kicked the ground hard.

strings.text: 稟はトンという音を立てて地面を蹴る。
strings.translated: Rin kicked the ground with a soft thud.

strings.text: 勢いよくブランコが動き始める。
strings.translated: The swing began to move with force.

strings.text: そのまま、勢いをうしなっていき……だんだんその動きが鈍くなる。
strings.translated: Just like that, it lost momentum... and gradually the motion dulled.

strings.text: ゆらゆらと揺れた後に、元の位置で静止する。
strings.translated: After swaying a while, it came to a rest at its original position.

strings.text: 「止まってしまいました……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It stopped..."

strings.text: 「ダメですね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's no good..."

strings.text: 「ダメじゃないさ。いい筋している」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not no good. You've got a knack for it."

strings.text: 「そうでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really?"

strings.text: 「ああ、問題ない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, no problem."

strings.text: 「でも止まりました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But it stopped."

strings.text: 「止まったな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It stopped."

strings.text: 「幼稚園児でも止まらないのに、こんな大人になった私はブランコすら漕げないんですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Even kindergarteners don't let it stop, but I've become an adult and I can't even work a swing."

strings.text: 「今、漕げないって言ったよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You just said 'work,' didn't you."

strings.text: 「こげないんじゃない。稟は漕いでないんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not that you can't work it. Rin, you aren't working it."

strings.text: 稟はブランコは空中を蹴っても、動かないとか信じていた……。
strings.translated: Rin had believed that even if you kicked at the air on a swing, it wouldn't move...

strings.text: たしかに、空を蹴る事で加速するなんて少し考えたらおかしな話だ。
strings.translated: Granted, if you stop to think about it, accelerating by kicking at empty air sounds absurd.

strings.text: でも、普通ならば考えない。
strings.translated: But normally, one doesn't think about it.

strings.text: 普通のガキは何も考えずにブランコに乗る。
strings.translated: Normal kids ride swings without thinking about anything.

strings.text:
ブランコがどの様な力学を持ってして力を得るかなど関係無い、
ただ、感じたままに身体を動かす。
strings.translated:
It doesn't matter what mechanics allow a swing to gain force --
you just move your body as you feel it.

strings.text: 「空を蹴れば、空に向かって加速していく」
strings.translated: "If you kick the air, you accelerate toward the sky."

strings.text: そんな摩訶不思議な現象を、いとも簡単に誰しも受け入れていく。
strings.translated: Such a mystifying phenomenon, everyone accepts with ease.

strings.text: 「もう一度やってみろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Try it one more time."

strings.text: 「はい」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes."

strings.text: 空では人は無力だ。
strings.translated: In the air, a person is powerless.

strings.text: だからこそ身体は知っている。
strings.translated: That's exactly why the body knows.

strings.text: そこで何をすべきか。
strings.translated: What to do there.

strings.text: 「そこだ！　そこで思いっきり宙を蹴るんだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There! Right there, kick the air with everything you've got!"

strings.text: 「あ、は、はいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, y-yes!"

strings.text: 稟は宙を蹴る。
strings.translated: Rin kicked the air.

strings.text: その一振りで加速がはじまる。
strings.translated: With that one swing, she began to accelerate.

strings.text: 「つぎは、そのタイミング！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Next, that timing!"

strings.text: 「え？　は、はいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Y-yes!"

strings.text: 稟はブランコをこぎ始めた。
strings.translated: Rin began to work the swing.

strings.text: 宙を蹴る事で彼女の身体は加速をはじめる。
strings.translated: By kicking the air, her body began to accelerate.

strings.text: 「すごい！　どんどん速くなっていきます！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Amazing! I'm going faster and faster!"

strings.text:
「ああ、後は身体で分かるだろ？
ブランコっていうのはそういうもんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Yeah, from here on your body will know, right?
That's what a swing is."

strings.text: 「はい！　すごい。すごいです！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes! Amazing. It's amazing!"

strings.text: 「良かったな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Glad to hear it."

strings.text: 「なおくん！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nao-kun!"

strings.text: 「なんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「ありがとう！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Thank you!"

strings.text: 「ブランコ教えてくれて！　絵を教えてくれて！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "For teaching me the swing! For teaching me painting!"

strings.text: 「ばか、声でけぇよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Idiot, your voice is too loud..."

strings.text: 月明かりの下。
strings.translated: Beneath the moonlight.

strings.text: 動き出した振り子時計の様に、稟はブランコにのる。
strings.translated: Like a pendulum clock set in motion, Rin rode the swing.

strings.text: うれしそうに、夜空を加速してゆく。
strings.translated: Joyfully, she soared higher and faster into the night sky.

strings.text: 今にも空に飛び出しそうな勢いだ。
strings.translated: It felt like any moment now, she would launch off into the sky.

strings.text: 「きゃわっ」
strings.translated: "Kyah!"

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「な、何だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what the...?"

strings.text:
早朝。
女性の悲鳴と除夜の鐘が鳴り響く。
strings.translated:
Early morning.
A woman's scream and the tolling of a New Year's bell rang out.

strings.text: 否、四月の早朝に除夜の鐘が鳴るわけもない。
strings.translated: No, of course a New Year's bell wouldn't ring on an early April morning.

strings.text: 鐘の様な金物がけたたましく響く音と、女の悲鳴で目が覚める。
strings.translated: The clangorous sound of something bell-like being struck, together with a woman's scream, jolted me awake.

strings.text: 「悲鳴？　あの声は……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A scream? That voice was..."

strings.text: 俺は急いで自室を飛び出す。
strings.translated: I bolted out of my room.

strings.text:
悲鳴が聞こえた方向は藍の部屋。
あの声も藍に違いない。
strings.translated:
The scream had come from Ai's room.
And that voice had to be Ai's, too.

strings.text: 「藍大丈夫か？　今の何だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ai, you okay?! What just happened?"

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 「あ、あ、ああ……だ、大丈夫……痛っっ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, ah, ahh... I-I'm fine... ow..."

strings.text: とてもじゃないが大丈夫そうでは無い。
strings.translated: It really didn't look like she was fine.

strings.text: 「入るぞ。いいな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm coming in. All right?"

strings.text: 「あ、ま、待って……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, w-wait..."

strings.text: 「な、なんだ……この状況……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what is... this situation..."

strings.text: 布団の上で涙目で頭を抱えている藍。
strings.translated: Ai was on top of her futon, teary-eyed, clutching her head.

strings.text: それはいい。
strings.translated: That much was fine.

strings.text: 問題はその横で転がる金だらいだ。
strings.translated: The problem was the metal washbasin lying beside her.

strings.text: 「だ、だから大丈夫だって言ったのに……何故、開けるかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "L-like I said, I'm fine... Why did you have to open the door..."

strings.text: 「いや、普通開けるだろ。大きな音と悲鳴がしたんだから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, of course I'd open the door. There was a huge crash and a scream."

strings.text: 「心配はない……痛っっ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "There's nothing to worry about... ow..."

strings.text: 「心配ないって、思いっきり涙目じゃないか、お前」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Nothing to worry about,' my ass -- you're totally on the verge of tears."

strings.text: 「ああ、久しぶりだったからな。ちょっと張り切りすぎて大きくしすぎた」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ahh, it's been a while, you see. I got a little too enthusiastic and made it too big."

strings.text: 「大きくしすぎたってなぁ……お前」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Made it too big, huh..."

strings.text:
転がる金だらいは、一カ所だけ大きくへっこんでいる。
ちょうど藍の頭が入るぐらいのサイズだ。
strings.translated:
The washbasin on the floor had a single large dent in it.
About the size of Ai's head, in fact.

strings.text: 「もしかして、俺が来る以前って、そんな方法で起きてたのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't tell me... before I came here, this was how you'd been waking up?"

strings.text: 「あはは……。普通の目覚ましで起きる時もあるんだよ。お前が来た数日はちゃんと目覚ましで起きていただろ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ahaha... There are times I wake up with a normal alarm, too. During the first few days after you got here, I was waking up properly with an alarm, wasn't I?"

strings.text: 「これが藍専用の目覚ましなのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So this is your custom Ai-only alarm clock?"

strings.text: よく見ると、金だらいには紐がついており、天井にはフックがついている。
strings.translated: Looking closer, there was a string tied to the washbasin, and a hook fixed into the ceiling.

strings.text: 目覚まし時計の両面にはガムテープが貼ってある。
strings.translated: Both sides of the alarm clock had packing tape stuck to them.

strings.text: 一目見ただけで、だいたいの構造が理解出来るぐらい、単純な仕掛けであった。
strings.translated: It was a simple enough contraption that one look was all it took to grasp the general idea.

strings.text: 目覚まし時計は、ボタンを押せば一時的になら音は止まるには止まる。だがそれで完全に目覚ましが解除されるわけではない。
strings.translated: Pressing the button on an alarm clock will silence it temporarily, sure -- but that doesn't shut the alarm off completely.

strings.text: 目覚まし時計を解除する時は、だいたい無意識で本体を持ち上げてしまう。
strings.translated: When people go to turn off an alarm, they'll usually pick the clock up without thinking.

strings.text: 目覚まし時計を持ち上げたら、ガムテープで止めていた紐が外れ……、つるされていた金だらいが藍の頭上に落ちてくるという仕組みだ。
strings.translated: Lift the clock, and the string held down by the packing tape comes free... and the washbasin suspended overhead crashes down onto Ai's head. That was the mechanism.

strings.text: 「そこまでしないと起きられないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You have to go that far just to get up?"

strings.text:
「そんな哀れむような目で見つめるな！
悲しくなってくるっ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated:
"Don't look at me with such pitying eyes!
It's going to make me sad!"

strings.text: 「というか、お前、もしかして俺が来る前はずっとやってたのか？　これ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I mean, don't tell me you were doing this the whole time before I got here? This?"

strings.text: 「夏目の一族は目覚めが悪いからな……。だいたい私も遅刻したら大変だし」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The Natsume family are terrible at waking up, you see... And it'd be a real problem if I overslept."

strings.text: 「だからって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even so..."

strings.text: 「言わんとすることは分かる。だけど、恥ずかしい話だが、こんな装置でも作らないと起きれないのだよ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I know what you're trying to say. But it's embarrassing to admit -- without a device like this, I really can't get up..."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew..."

strings.text: 俺は深くため息をつく。
strings.translated: I let out a deep sigh.

strings.text: 「また、そんな顔するっ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "There, you're making that face again!"

strings.text: 「そんな顔もするわ、ボケが！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Of course I'm making this face, you idiot!"

strings.text:
「うわん、先生の事をボケとか言うな！
あ、あとがんばってる人にボケとかも駄目なんだぞっ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated:
"Waah, don't call your teacher an idiot!
A-and you shouldn't call someone who's doing her best an idiot either!"

strings.text:
「夏目の一族は目覚めが悪いのはわかりきっている。
だが、少なくとも俺は目覚めは良い方だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I know full well the Natsume clan is bad at waking up.
But at the very least, I'm one of the ones who wakes up easily."

strings.text: 「実際、藍の悲鳴で飛び起きたのは俺だけだったみたいだしな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In fact, it looked like I was the only one who came running at your scream..."

strings.text: 「すまん。悲鳴で起こしてしまうなど、あまり良い目覚めではなかったと思う……。明日は絶対に悲鳴をあげないようにがんばる……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I'm sorry. Waking you up with a scream isn't much of a way to greet the morning... I'll do my best to absolutely not scream tomorrow..."

strings.text: 「そんながんばりはいらない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You don't need to do your best at that."

strings.text: 「それだけがんばらないと起きられないんだよっ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "But if I don't try that hard, I can't wake up!"

strings.text: 「そんな事しなくても俺が起こしてやるって言ってるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm telling you, you don't need to do any of this -- I'll wake you up."

strings.text: 「で、でも、そんなの迷惑だし……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "B-but that would be an imposition..."

strings.text: 「俺を家族のように迎えたいって、あれは嘘だったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You said you wanted to welcome me like family. Was that a lie?"

strings.text: 「な、何を突然！　そ、そんなわけないだろ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Wh-what, all of a sudden?! Of course it wasn't!"

strings.text: 「だったら、迷惑なんて考えるな。今後、お前らを起こすのは俺の仕事だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then don't think of it as an imposition. From now on, waking you all up is my job."

strings.text: 「そ、それでは、直哉にばかり負担をかけてしまうではないか……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "B-but then all the burden would fall on you, Naoya..."

strings.text: 「バカ、飯代と宿代だけで十分だ。それに一人だと作り甲斐もないが、大人数だと料理も十分作り甲斐がある」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Dummy, food and lodging is more than enough. Besides, cooking for one isn't much fun, but cooking for a lot of people is worth the effort."

strings.text: 「直哉ぁ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Naoya..."

strings.text: 「なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is it."

strings.text: 「うわん。なんでお前はそんなに出来た子なんだよぉ！　お姉さんにも少しはがんばらせてくれよぉ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Waah, why do you have to be such a well-put-together kid?! At least let your big sister do her part too!"

strings.text: 「何言ってるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you talking about..."

strings.text: 「藍はずっと、この家を守ってきたんだろ。すげぇがんばってるじゃないか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You've been protecting this house all this time, Ai. That's plenty hard work already..."

strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Naoya..."

strings.text: 「さぁ、とっとと着替えろよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Now come on, hurry up and get dressed."

strings.text: 「あと、次に会うときからは、いつも通りのしっかりお姉さん風になってろよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And by the time we meet again, be back to your usual solid big-sister self, all right?"

strings.text: 「なんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「ありがとう……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Thank you..."

strings.text: 「何、言ってる。バカ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you saying, dummy."

strings.text: 俺はなんだか気恥ずかしくなって、逃げる様に藍の部屋を後にした。
strings.translated: Somehow feeling embarrassed, I fled Ai's room.

strings.text: 藍のおかげで、いつもより少し早めに目が覚めた。
strings.translated: Thanks to Ai, I'd woken up a little earlier than usual.

strings.text: 今日はゆっくりと朝食が作れるな。
strings.translated: Today I could take my time making breakfast.

strings.text: 「コーヒーの香ばしい香り」
strings.translated: "The rich aroma of coffee."

strings.text: 「目玉焼きが油の上で焼かれる音」
strings.translated: "The sound of an egg sizzling in oil."

strings.text: 「トーストに溶けるバターの香り」
strings.translated: "The scent of butter melting into toast."

strings.text: 「って！　あじの開きを焼きながら、油揚げの味噌汁を作ってる人間の横で、意味不明なナレーションするのやめろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey! Don't do some incomprehensible narration next to the guy who's grilling dried horse mackerel and making miso soup with fried tofu!"

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「はー」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Haaah..."

strings.text: 「ほら、急がないと遅刻するぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on, hurry up or you'll be late."

strings.text: 「わかりましたー」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Okaaay..."

strings.text: 「あれは本当に分かっているのだろうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I wonder if she really gets it..."

strings.text: 「洗面器で溺死とかしていなければ良いのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I hope she hasn't drowned in the washbasin or anything..."

strings.text: 「お、今日もうまそうだな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Oh, smells good again today."

strings.text: 「ああ、今日はあじの開きに油揚げのみそ汁だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. Dried horse mackerel and miso soup with fried tofu."

strings.text: 「あじの開きと油揚げのみそ汁とは日本の朝だなぁ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Dried horse mackerel and fried-tofu miso soup -- now that's a Japanese breakfast."

strings.text: 「あれ？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「お？　雫もいい加減目が覚めたのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh? Shizuku, you finally awake?"

strings.text: 「直哉……料理が変わっている……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Naoya... the food has changed..."

strings.text: 「はぁ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「料理が違う……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's different food..."

strings.text: 「違くなどない、料理など変わっていない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It hasn't changed. The food is exactly the same."

strings.text: 「でも、さっきまでトーストに目玉焼き……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But just now it was toast and fried eggs..."

strings.text: 「それはお前のナレーションが生んだ幻だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That was an illusion your narration created."

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "An illusion?"

strings.text:
「そうだ、幻の朝食だ。
とっとと食べて学校に行け」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"That's right, a phantom breakfast.
Eat up and get to school."

strings.text: 「じー」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Staaare..."

strings.text: 「まだ寝ぼけているのか？　雫？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Are you still half-asleep, Shizuku?"

strings.text: 「そうかもしれない……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Maybe I am..."

strings.text: 「そうかもしれないって、どうみても起きてる様に見えるが？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Maybe I am' -- you look plenty awake to me."

strings.text: 「だって、ここにあるものが幻に見えない」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's just, what's here doesn't look like an illusion."

strings.text: 「うん、このあじの開きと油揚げのみそ汁、幻にはみえない……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah, this dried horse mackerel and fried-tofu miso soup, they don't look like illusions..."

strings.text: 「幻じゃなくて、本物なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "They're not illusions -- they're the real thing."

strings.text: 「え？　でも、さっき直哉が……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Huh? But just now you said..."

strings.text: 「はぁ、そんな不安そうな顔で人を見るな。幻と言ったのはトーストと目玉焼きの事だ。あじの開きと味噌汁は現実だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sheesh, don't look at me with such an anxious face. What I called an illusion was the toast and fried eggs. The mackerel and miso soup are real."

strings.text: 不思議そうにしていた雫だが、あじの開きをゆっくりと食べ始める。
strings.translated: Shizuku still looked puzzled, but she slowly began eating the mackerel.

strings.text: 「なんだかよく分からないけど……このあじの開きはおいしい……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I don't really get it, but... this dried horse mackerel is delicious..."

strings.text: 「そうか良かったな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's good to hear..."

strings.text:
<r おもむろ>徐</r>に咀嚼してゆく雫。骨ごと……バリバリと。
優雅なのか豪快なのか分からん食べ方だ。
strings.translated:
Shizuku chewed away deliberately. Bones and all... crunch, crunch.
I couldn't tell if the way she ate was elegant or just bold.

strings.text: いつもより早めに起きてしまった俺は、必然、登校時間も早くなってしまった。
strings.translated: Since I'd woken up earlier than usual, naturally I ended up heading to school earlier too.

strings.text: 授業まで時間があったので、俺は美術室に向かった。
strings.translated: There was still time before class, so I made for the art room.

strings.text: 鍵が掛かっていないのを確認し、やや滑りの悪いドアを無造作に横に滑らせる。
strings.translated: Confirming the door wasn't locked, I casually slid the somewhat sticky door aside.

strings.text:
登校時間にはまだ早い薄暗い美術室。
かすかに<r うごめ>蠢</r>く影が視界に入った。
strings.translated:
The dim art room, still too early for most students to have arrived.
A faintly stirring shadow caught my eye.

strings.text: 「誰かいるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Someone in here?"

strings.text: やや大きめの声で、俺は影へと質問を投げかけた。
strings.translated: In a slightly loud voice, I tossed the question toward the shadow.

strings.text:
床と何かが擦れる乾いた音がした後――。
人影があらわれる。
strings.translated:
After the dry sound of something scraping against the floor--
A figure emerged.

strings.text: 真琴
strings.translated: Makoto

strings.text: 「私だけど……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's just me..."

strings.text: 「ああ、やっぱり鳥谷か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, thought so -- Toritani."

strings.text: 「やっぱりって何？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'Thought so'? What do you mean?"

strings.text:
「あ、いや、こんな時間にいるのお前しかいないだろ。
おまえはまじめだからさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Ah, no, you're the only one who'd be here at this hour.
You're the serious type, after all."

strings.text: 「まじめって何よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'Serious type'? What is that supposed to mean?"

strings.text: 俺の答えが不満なのか、鳥谷が口をとがらせる。
strings.translated: Displeased with my answer, apparently, Toritani pursed her lips.

strings.text:
「早朝から遊びに来ているわけじゃないよな。
もちろん絵を描きに来ている様には見えない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"You're not here to hang out at this hour, obviously.
And you don't look like you came to paint, either."

strings.text: 「だいたいお前が手にしているのは筆にしては大きすぎるしな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Besides, what you're holding is way too big to be a brush."

strings.text:
鳥谷は<r ほうき>箒</r>を手にしている。
誰がどう見ても絵を描きに来てる姿ではない。
strings.translated:
Toritani was holding a broom.
No matter who you asked, she didn't look like she'd come to paint.

strings.text:
「くだらない冗談ね……。
ついでに“掃除＝まじめ”というのも、草薙のまじめ基準の低さを思い知るわ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"What a stupid joke...
And on top of that, 'cleaning = serious'? I'm starting to realize just how low Kusanagi's bar for 'serious' is..."

strings.text:
「たまの掃除だったらそうかもな。
でも毎朝一人で掃除してたらまじめと言わないか。
あと放課後、みんなが帰った後の片付けとかもな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"If it were only an occasional cleaning, sure.
But when you clean by yourself every morning, isn't that serious?
And tidying up after everyone leaves in the afternoon, too."

strings.text: 「って、な、何の話？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "H-hey, what are you talking about?"

strings.text: 「お前の日常の話だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "About your daily routine."

strings.text:
「ま、毎朝って……休日と日曜日はやってないわよ！
だ、だいたいなんでそんな事を知ってるのよ！　あんたなんかいつも遅刻寸前に登校してる分際で！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"'Every morning'?! I don't do it on holidays or Sundays!
A-and how do you even know about that?! You, who show up right before the bell every single day!"

strings.text: 「なんで知ってるって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How do I know...?"

strings.text: 「毎朝って！　何を基準にそんな事言ってるのかしら！？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'Every morning'?! What are you even basing that on?!"

strings.text:
あまり触れられたくない事だったのだろうか。
思いの外大きな声で、顔を真っ赤にして俺に詰問してくる。
strings.translated:
Maybe it was something she didn't want brought up.
Her voice rose louder than expected, her face bright red as she pressed me for answers.

strings.text: 「いや、すまん、すまん。毎朝は適当だ。別に監視していたわけじゃないからさ。でも、毎度遅刻寸前だからって、登校時間が遅いとは限らないんだぜ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, sorry, sorry. 'Every morning' was just off-the-cuff. It's not like I've been watching you or anything. But just because I'm always cutting it close doesn't mean I always arrive late, you know."

strings.text: 「早く登校するたびに美術室で見かけた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whenever I showed up early, I'd see you in the art room."

strings.text: 「あんたが早く登校する事があるなんてねぇ。不覚だわ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That there were times you came to school early... I hadn't caught that. My mistake..."

strings.text:
「別にいいじゃん。何でこそこそとするんだよ。良い事なのにさ。
俺だったら言いまくるぜ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"It's fine, isn't it? Why be so secretive? It's a good thing.
If it were me, I'd be bragging about it."

strings.text: 「あんたとは根本的に性格が違うのよ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You and I are fundamentally different in personality..."

strings.text: 「性格ねぇ……なるほど」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Personality, huh... I see."

strings.text: 「何？　含みのある言い方ねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What? That's a loaded way of putting it."

strings.text: 「鳥谷はやたらこの部に愛着があるよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You've got quite the attachment to this club, don't you, Toritani."

strings.text: 「愛着って。部長だから当然でしょ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Attachment? Well, I'm the club president, so of course."

strings.text: 「部長になる前からだろ、その掃除は、たしか入学した日から掃除してた様な気が……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It goes back before you became president. The cleaning, I mean -- I feel like you've been at it since your first day here..."

strings.text: 「なっ、なんでその事まで？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wh-- how do you even know about that?!"

strings.text: 「見てたから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because I saw you."

strings.text: 「な、なんで！　あの頃は草薙と私は言葉すら交わしたことないでしょ！　なんであんたが入学時の私なんか見てたのよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "H-how?! Back then, you and I hadn't even exchanged a single word! Why would you have been watching me as a first-year on day one?!"

strings.text: 「まぁ、少しこの美術部に興味があってな……入学早々偵察に来たんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I had a bit of interest in this art club, you see... So I came to scout it out right after enrolling."

strings.text: 「弓張は草薙健一郎の母校であり、その美術部といえば結構有名だったからな、絵をやめたといえども気になってな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yumihari was Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's alma mater, and its art club was pretty well known. Even though I'd quit painting, I was curious."

strings.text: 「それで入学早々に美術部をのぞきに来たわけだ。あの日も早朝だった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So right after enrolling, I came to peek in on the art club. That day, too, was early in the morning."

strings.text:
「あの頃はまだお前の髪の毛短かったっけなぁ……。
今より身体も小さく感じたな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Back then your hair was still short, huh...
You felt smaller in build than you do now, too..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、そんな成長するわけないから、雰囲気だったんだろうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, no one grows that much, so maybe it was just the air about you..."

strings.text:
いや……一箇所だけ大きく成長した場所もあるが……。
その事には触れないでおく。
strings.translated:
No... there is one spot that's grown quite a bit larger...
But I'll refrain from touching on that.

strings.text: 「あまりに丹念に床掃除してるから、この部活では体育会系並に上下関係が厳しいかと思ったよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You were scrubbing the floor so meticulously, I thought maybe the pecking order in this club was strict like a sports team."

strings.text: 「でもさ、よく見たら、なんかその娘はうれしそうにやってるのな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But look closer, and the girl seemed to actually be enjoying herself."

strings.text: 「そんで、俺は“この部活に愛着のある先輩”なんだろうなぁ……とか思ってたら、よくよく見ていたら入部すらしてない新入生でさ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So I figured, ah, she must be a senpai attached to this club... but when I looked closer she was a new student who hadn't even joined yet..."

strings.text: 「な、なんで私が入部する前だって分かるのよ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "H-how do you know that was before I joined...?"

strings.text: 「だって、あの時期って入部届とか出す前じゃん。お前一年生の名札つけてたし……そりゃ入部はすんでないだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because that period was before the club application deadline. You were still wearing your first-year name tag... so obviously you hadn't joined yet."

strings.text: 「く、くだらない事見ているのね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You've been noticing such silly things..."

strings.text: 「あれから、気になってな、何度か見かけたんだが、毎朝ちゃんときれいに掃除してて……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "After that I got curious and saw you a few more times -- every morning cleaning so carefully..."

strings.text:
「とっても良い性格の娘なんだろうなぁ……とか勝手に想像してたよ。
一人で毎朝床掃除なんて出来るもんじゃないからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I thought to myself she must be a really good-natured girl...
Cleaning the floor alone every morning isn't something you can just do."

strings.text: 「うれしそうに雑巾で床ごしごししてさ。あんな四つん這いでやったら、膝とかソックスとか汚れるだろうに……うれしそうな笑顔だったしな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Scrubbing away happily with a rag. On all fours like that, you'd get your knees and socks all dirty... and yet you had such a happy smile."

strings.text: 「まぁ、直に話したら全然違って驚いたけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, when I actually spoke to you it was so totally different I was shocked."

strings.text: 「いきなり会うなり“あなたが草薙直哉？　あなた！　何故、美術部に入らないとか意味不明な行動をとるのかしら！”ってさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "First thing out of your mouth: 'You're Kusanagi Naoya? You! What is this incomprehensible behavior -- refusing to join the art club?!'"

strings.text: 「意味不明はお前だろ……って心底思った」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'You're the incomprehensible one,' I thought from the bottom of my heart."

strings.text: 「わっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wah!"

strings.text:
鳥谷が突然箒で攻撃してくる。
すんでの所で俺はそれを避ける。
strings.translated:
Toritani suddenly attacked with the broom.
I dodged it at the last possible moment.

strings.text: 「わ、忘れなさい……今すぐ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "F-forget it... right now..."

strings.text: 「え？　何でだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Why?"

strings.text: 「何でもよ！　あんたずっと見てたとか、考えてただけで虫ずが走る！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Just because! Even the idea that you'd been watching, thinking about it, makes my skin crawl!"

strings.text: 「何でだよ。別にいいだろ。なんだ？　実はまじめキャラなのがばれてて恥ずかしいのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why? What's the harm? What is it -- embarrassed that your secret 'serious character' has been outed?"

strings.text: 「うぉ、そ、そんなに箒を振り回したら、石膏とか誤って倒すぞ！　高いんだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-- if you swing that broom around like that, you'll knock over the plaster busts! Those are expensive!"

strings.text: 「なんだよ……。それほどの秘密だったのかよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on... was it really that big a secret...?"

strings.text:
「ひ、秘密ってほどではないけど……。
掃除している姿をずっと見られていたなんてっっ！　ああもう！！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"I-it's not exactly a secret, but...
the idea that you'd been watching me clean the whole time! Aaargh!!"

strings.text: 「わ、ま、まて、振り回すと本当に何か壊すぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wa- w-wait, if you swing that around, you really will break something."

strings.text: 「忘れなさい。とりあえず、あの時の光景すべてを」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Forget it. Everything you saw that day, forget all of it."

strings.text: 忘れるなんてもったいない。
strings.translated: Forgetting it would be a waste.

strings.text: おもしろくて忘れられない。
strings.translated: It's too funny to forget.

strings.text: 「何だよ。あんな素直な笑顔で掃除する鳥谷の姿、忘れるなんてもったいないだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What? Toritani, cleaning with that honest smile -- forgetting that would be a waste..."

strings.text: 「何だよ。あんな素直な笑顔で掃除する鳥谷の姿、おもしろくて忘れられない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What? Toritani, cleaning with that honest smile -- it's too funny to forget..."

strings.text: 「ぬぅ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ngh!"

strings.text:
振り下ろされる箒！
俺は瞬間に真剣白刃取りを試みる。
strings.translated:
The broom came swinging down!
In that instant I attempted the shinken shirahadori catch.

strings.text: 「ぬぉっ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ngoh..."

strings.text: 抜群の動体視力を持っている（自称）、俺をもってもそんな技など出来るわけもなく、箒は俺のおでこに見事にクリーンヒットした。
strings.translated: But of course, even with my (self-proclaimed) exceptional dynamic vision, no such technique was possible, and the broom scored a clean hit right on my forehead.

strings.text: 「痛っっ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 「こうやって物理的に頭の中からデリートしてあげようかしら……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Maybe I'll just physically delete it from your head this way..."

strings.text:
「わ、分かった。分かった。忘れる。忘れる努力する。
大丈夫だ。もう思い出したり、口にしたりしない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I-I got it, I got it. I'll forget. I'll make an effort to forget.
It's fine. I won't bring it up or say it again!"

strings.text:
「ふんっ。
ったく、あんたは油断も隙もあったもんじゃないわね。
とりあえず、あの時の事は忘れなさい。あと他言無用だからね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Hmph.
Honestly, there's not a moment I can let my guard down around you.
At any rate, forget what happened back then. And don't tell anyone else."

strings.text: 「他言無用も何も、二年前から知ってて誰にも言ってないぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't tell anyone -- I've known for two years and haven't told a soul..."

strings.text: 「だったらその状態を維持しなさい！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then keep it that way!"

strings.text: 「分かった。分かった。というか誰にも言うつもりなんかない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Fine, fine. I've got no intention of telling anyone anyway."

strings.text:
「それにしても、何でそんな事を隠そうとするんだ？
別に恥ずかしい事じゃないだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Still, why try so hard to hide it?
It's nothing to be embarrassed about."

strings.text: 「別に秘密にしているわけではないけど……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's not that I'm keeping it a secret in particular..."

strings.text: 「十分秘密にしてるだろ。秘密保持しろとか命令するぐらいなんだから……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You clearly are. Going as far as ordering me to maintain confidentiality..."

strings.text:
「あんたの説明なんて適当そうだからよ！
あんたのいい加減な話し方で、尾ひれがついて変な風に他人に伝わるのが嫌なだけよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"It's because your explanations sound so slapdash!
I just hate the idea of it getting distorted and passed around wrong because of your careless way of talking."

strings.text: 嘘くさ……。
strings.translated: What a suspicious excuse...

strings.text: お前、他人からどう勘違いされようとあまり気にしないタイプだろうが……。
strings.translated: You're the type who doesn't care how others misunderstand you...

strings.text: 「ははん？　逆に、あれが素だったりするんじゃないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Aha? Or maybe that was actually your true self?"

strings.text: 「ああいう健気な姿が本来の鳥谷で、そんな自分の本性がみんなにバレるのが恥ずかしいとかな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That earnest, dutiful figure -- the real Toritani -- and you're embarrassed that everyone might find out your true nature..."

strings.text: 「な、何をバカな事を……そ、そんな事ないわよ！　わ、私は傍若無人でっ！　ってまだ殴られ足りないのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "W-what stupid nonsense... th-that's not it! I-I am arrogant and unruly! Or haven't you been hit enough yet?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、もう痛いのはいいです……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, I've had my fill of pain, thanks..."

strings.text: 自覚的に“傍若無人”という言葉を言うやつが、果たして本当に傍若無人なのであろうか？
strings.translated: Someone who consciously calls themselves "arrogant and unruly" -- can they really be arrogant and unruly at all?

strings.text: まぁ、これ以上言うともっと殴られそうだから言わないが……。
strings.translated: Well, if I say any more I'll get hit again, so I won't...

strings.text: とは言っても……。
strings.translated: Even so...

strings.text: 入学早々、あんな丹念に掃除するなんて、素が真面目じゃなきゃ出来ないだろうな……。
strings.translated: To be cleaning that carefully right after enrolling -- you'd have to be genuinely earnest at your core to do that...

strings.text: 鳥谷はいつも傍若無人を装っているが、実際は装いきれない部分だらけだ。
strings.translated: Toritani always puts on the arrogant act, but there are plenty of places where the act doesn't quite hold.

strings.text: 変にまじめだし、気を遣うし……。
strings.translated: She's oddly serious, and considerate...

strings.text: 長く付き合ってると思いの外優しいって事にも気がつく……。
strings.translated: Spend enough time around her and you realize she's unexpectedly kind, too...

strings.text: 「な、何よ……今、なんかくだらない事考えてたんじゃないでしょうね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wh-what... you weren't just now thinking something stupid, were you...?"

strings.text: 「い、いや……そんな事はないぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no... nothing like that."

strings.text:
なんか凄まれてる。
今にも殴りかかりそうなぐらい……。
strings.translated:
I'm being glared at.
Enough that she looks ready to swing at me any second.

strings.text:
「優しい」は違うかもしれん。
実際、今も箒で殴られたし。
strings.translated:
Maybe "kind" isn't the right word.
Case in point, I just got hit with a broom.

strings.text: 「んで？　今日はなんでこんな朝早くから登校してるの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So? Why are you at school this early today?"

strings.text: 「別に、とりあえずいつもより起きた時間が早かったからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No reason -- I just woke up earlier than usual, that's all."

strings.text: 「そんな理由なの？　だったら絵でも描けばいいのに、早朝に美術室に来てるんだから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's your reason? Then you could at least be painting, if you're going to come to the art room in the early morning."

strings.text: 「まぁ、そうなんだけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, yeah, I suppose."

strings.text: もっともな意見に、俺は苦笑いで答える。
strings.translated: To such a reasonable remark, I responded with a wry smile.

strings.text: 普通ならそうするだろう。
strings.translated: Normally that's what one would do.

strings.text:
だが、俺はしない。
出来ない。
strings.translated:
But I don't.
I can't.

strings.text: そんな滑稽さに少し笑えてしまったのだ。
strings.translated: The absurdity of that made me laugh a little.

strings.text: 何故か、鳥谷があらたまった顔つきで俺を見つめる。
strings.translated: For some reason, Toritani looked at me with a suddenly composed expression.

strings.text: 「ねぇ、草薙」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hey, Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「少し聞きたいんだけど……いいかしら」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There's something I'd like to ask you... would that be all right?"

strings.text:
俺を見つめる鳥谷の視線。
俺は少しだけ嫌な予感がした。
strings.translated:
Toritani's gaze on me.
I had the faintest bad feeling about it.

strings.text: 何も答えない俺に、鳥谷はそのまま話を続ける。
strings.translated: When I said nothing, Toritani simply continued.

strings.text:
「絵を描かない理由……。
描けない理由ってさ……。あのさ、もしかして――」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"The reason you don't paint...
The reason you can't paint... Um, is it maybe--"

strings.text: 「もしかして、稟ちゃんが関係しているとかあるの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Is it maybe something to do with Rin-chan?"

strings.text:
あまりの突然の言葉に何も答えられない。
否定も肯定も出来ずに、俺はただ、そのまま固まる事しか出来なかった。
strings.translated:
The words came so suddenly I couldn't answer.
Unable to deny or affirm, all I could do was stand there frozen.

strings.text: そんな俺を見て、少しすまなそうに鳥谷が言葉を続けた。
strings.translated: Seeing me like that, Toritani continued, sounding a little apologetic.

strings.text:
「ごめん。なんか突然変な事聞いて……。
答えられないのなら別に答えなくてもいいから……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Sorry. I know it was sudden and strange to ask...
If you can't answer, you don't have to..."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、そういうわけじゃないが、その……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's not that, um..."

strings.text:
俺はしどろもどろで答える。
これじゃ何が「そういうわけじゃない」んだかさっぱりの態度だ。
strings.translated:
I stammered out my reply.
With an attitude like that, it wasn't clear what wasn't "that" at all.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani..."

strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「何でそう思ったんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What made you think so?"

strings.text: 「別に、ただの勘」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Nothing, just a hunch."

strings.text: 「勘って」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A hunch..."

strings.text: 「だからごめん、適当な事言って、ただ何となく聞きたかっただけだから……うん、忘れて」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So, sorry, I was just saying whatever, I just kind of wanted to ask... yeah, forget it."

strings.text: そう言うと鳥谷は俺に背中を向けて掃除をはじめる。
strings.translated: With that, Toritani turned her back to me and began cleaning.

strings.text: 会話をそのまま終わりにする様に……。
strings.translated: As if to end the conversation right there...

strings.text: 「違うぞ……鳥谷」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not that, Toritani..."

strings.text: 「俺が絵を描かないのは誰かのせいなんかじゃない。俺自身の問題だ。だから！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The reason I don't paint isn't anyone's fault. It's my own problem. So!"

strings.text: 鳥谷は少し困った様な顔でため息をつく。
strings.translated: Toritani sighed with a slightly troubled look on her face.

strings.text: 「今更よ。分かってるわ。あんたがそういう人間だって事もね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's a bit late for that. I know. I know that's the kind of person you are, too."

strings.text: 「そういう人間ってどういう事だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The kind of person? What's that supposed to mean?"

strings.text:
「そのままの意味よ。
ただね。言っておきたいけど、あんたが思ってるほど、私は鈍感じゃないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Exactly what it sounds like.
But just so you know -- I'm not as dense as you seem to think."

strings.text: 「圭だって、薄々は感づいてるわ。なぜ、あんたが筆をとらなくなったかぐらい……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Even Kei has a vague sense of it. About why you stopped picking up a brush..."

strings.text: 「とは言っても……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That said..."

strings.text: 鳥谷はイーゼルの山を見つめ、そのまま無言になる。
strings.translated: Toritani stared at the pile of easels and fell silent.

strings.text: 「とは言っても何だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Even so,' what?"

strings.text: 鳥谷は一呼吸置いてから話を続ける。
strings.translated: Toritani took a breath before continuing.

strings.text: 「冬頃にさ、あんた絵描いたでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Around wintertime, you painted something, didn't you?"

strings.text: 「なんでそれを……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How did you know..."

strings.text: 「だから、何度も言うけど、私はそんなに鈍感ではないわ。もちろん、すべてがわかるほど鋭くはないけど……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Like I said, over and over -- I'm not that dense. Not that I'm sharp enough to see everything, of course..."

strings.text: 「俺が絵描いた事しゃべったの、まさか明石のやつか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who told you I'd painted -- was it Akashi?"

strings.text: 「明石先輩からは何も聞いてないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I heard nothing from Akashi-senpai."

strings.text: 「だったらなぜ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then how..."

strings.text: 「なぜって……。そんなの分かるわよ。染みついた絵の具のにおい。日常の雰囲気……絵を描いている時特有の雰囲気……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "How? That kind of thing I can tell. The smell of paint clinging to you. Your everyday air... the particular atmosphere someone has when they're painting..."

strings.text: 「構図を考えてる顔。使う顔料を考えてる顔。特殊なのよ。絵描いてる人間の行動は……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The face of someone working out a composition. The face of someone deciding which pigments to use. It's distinctive. The way a painter behaves..."

strings.text: 「たまに宙で筆を動かす仕草なんかもしてたし……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sometimes you'd make the motion of moving a brush in midair, too..."

strings.text:
「でも理由は、聞かないわよ。
あんたが自分の絵を描かない本当の理由も、
あんたが突然絵を描いた理由も」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"But I won't ask why.
Neither the real reason you don't paint your own work,
nor the reason you suddenly painted."

strings.text: 「聞いたところでどうにかなる問題じゃなさそうだし……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It doesn't seem like the sort of thing asking would solve anyway..."

strings.text:
「ただ、私はあんたが絵を描いてくれるのを楽しみにしてるから、この前描いたヤツを見られなかったのは残念だけど……。
たぶん見せる絵ではなかったのでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"I'm just looking forward to you painting again, so it was a shame I didn't get to see the one you did the other day...
Probably it wasn't a painting to be shown, was it?"

strings.text: 「あるいは、人に見せてはいけない絵だったから、こそこそ隠れて完成させたのかもね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Or maybe it was a painting that couldn't be shown to anyone, so you finished it in secret."

strings.text: 「ふぅ……名推理だな。何故そう思った？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew... fine deduction. What made you think so?"

strings.text: 「だって、桜ヶ原の画材屋で顔料探してたでしょ。店主に口止めしながら」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Because you were shopping for pigments at the art supply store in Sakuragahara. Telling the owner to keep quiet about it."

strings.text: 「桜ヶ原画材のジジィから漏れたのか……あのおっさん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So it leaked from that geezer at Sakuragahara Art Supplies... that old man..."

strings.text: 「しょうがないじゃない。あの人もあんたの絵好きなんだからさ。そりゃあんたが顔料探してたらうれしくて、私にだって言ってしまうわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Can't be helped. He loves your paintings too. Of course he'd be so happy hearing you were searching for pigments that he'd blab even to me."

strings.text: 「なんでうれしいとお前に言うんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why would he be happy telling you?"

strings.text: 「当たり前じゃない。私はあんたの絵が大好きだからさ。あのおじさん以上に、誰よりも、私はあんたの絵が好きよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Isn't it obvious? Because I love your paintings. More than that old man, more than anyone -- I love your paintings."

strings.text: あまりにストレートに言われたので、何も言い返せない。
strings.translated: Said so straight to my face, I couldn't come back with anything.

strings.text:
「だから、いつかはまた、あんたが描いた絵をみたいわ……。
私はずっとそれだけを考えてる。あんたがちゃんと描いた自分の絵、自分の作品を発表する日を、楽しみにしているわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"So, one day, I want to see paintings by you again...
That's the only thing I've been thinking about. I'm looking forward to the day you properly paint your own work, and put your own pieces out into the world."

strings.text: 「過大評価だ……。そんな大層な絵描きじゃない。俺は……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're overrating me... I'm not that grand of a painter. Not me..."

strings.text: 「過大評価かどうかなんて、あんたが決める事じゃないわ。あんたが何を言おうと、私はずっとあんたの絵を待ってる。いつまでも待ってるんだからね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Whether it's overrating or not isn't for you to decide. No matter what you say, I'll keep waiting for your paintings. Forever, if I have to."

strings.text: 「描かないって言ってるやつの作品なんか待つな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't wait for works from someone who says he won't paint."

strings.text:
「描かないね……。
それずっと言ってるよね。草薙」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Won't paint, huh...
You've been saying that a long time, Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

strings.text: 「でも、言葉の有効期限なんて、永遠じゃないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But words don't keep forever, you know."

strings.text: 「何だそりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's that supposed to mean?"

strings.text: 「草薙、覚えておきなさい。言葉には有効期限があるから価値があるの。無限に効力がある言葉なんて何の意味もないわ。存在しないのと同じ事」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Remember this, Kusanagi: words only have value because they have an expiration date. Words that hold their power forever mean nothing -- it's the same as if they never existed."

strings.text: 「意味分からん……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't get it..."

strings.text:
「言葉なんて、また新しく生み出されるって事よ。
だから、約束って価値を持つのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"It means new words are constantly being born.
That's why a promise has value."

strings.text: 「俺が絵を描かないのは“約束”などではないし……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "My not painting isn't a 'promise' or anything..."

strings.text: 「別に、あんたが絵を描かない理由が約束だかどうだかなんて知らないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I don't care whether the reason you don't paint is a promise or whatever."

strings.text: 「私が言いたいのはただ、あんたの“描かない”なんて言葉は絶対じゃないって事！　それだけよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "All I'm saying is, your 'I won't paint' is not absolute! That's all!"

strings.text: 「あんたはまた絵を描くわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You will paint again."

strings.text: 「何を勝手な事を……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just deciding that on your own..."

strings.text: 「だいたい、今後、絵を描くかどうかなんて俺の問題だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For starters, whether I paint from here on is my problem..."

strings.text: 「……そうね。誰の問題でもなく、たしかにあんたの問題よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "...Right. It's no one else's problem, it certainly is yours."

strings.text: 「あら、予鈴だわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh, that's the warning bell."

strings.text: 「ああ、そろそろ移動しないと遅刻する」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, we should get moving or we'll be late."

strings.text: 「いつも遅刻なんて気にしない草薙がどうしたのよ。そんなにこの会話を中断させたいのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kusanagi, who never cares about being late, what's gotten into you? Do you want to end this conversation that badly?"

strings.text: 「違げぇよ。ただ朝早く起きたのに遅刻するのはさすがにもったいないだろうが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not it. It'd just be a waste to be late when I got up so early, that's all."

strings.text: 「そうね。そういわれてみればそうかも」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. Now that you mention it, maybe so."

strings.text: 鳥谷は優しく笑った。
strings.translated: Toritani smiled gently.

strings.text: 圭
strings.translated: Kei

strings.text: 「ふぅ、間に合った」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Phew, made it in time."

strings.text: 「どこが間に合っただよ……。次は三時限目だぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How is that 'in time'...? Next is third period, you know."

strings.text: 「だってだって！　直哉が起こしてくれないんだもん！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But but! Naoya, you didn't wake me up!"

strings.text: 「起こしたわ！　起こして朝飯も食わせたわ！　“あ、少し忘れ物取りに行く”とか言って、また部屋に戻ったきり帰って来なかったのはお前だろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I did wake you up! Woke you up and fed you breakfast! You're the one who said, 'Oh, I forgot something,' went back to your room, and never came back out!"

strings.text: 「だってぇ、今日はいつもより早かったからさぁ。部屋戻ったら時間が結構あったからさぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But you see, today was earlier than usual. When I went back to my room, I had a fair bit of time..."

strings.text: 「二度も起こす気にはならんわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not about to wake you up twice."

strings.text: 「うう……なんか直哉って口がうまいから言いくるめられるよぅ。なんか知らんが論破される」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ugh... Naoya, you're a smooth talker, so you always talk me into a corner. Somehow I always get out-argued."

strings.text: 「違うわ！　お前が完全に間違った行動しているから、言い逃れ出来なくなるだけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No! It's just that your behavior is so completely wrong that you can't weasel out of it."

strings.text: 「まぁ、いいんじゃないの？　明石先輩みたいにもう一年やれば」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, isn't it fine? Just do another year, like Akashi-senpai."

strings.text: 「何？　という事は、あいつの留年は決定したのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What? Meaning it's confirmed the guy's being held back?"

strings.text: 「まぁ十中八九だけど。次の追試で駄目なら留年決定らしいからさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Nine times out of ten. If he flunks the next makeup exam, he's officially being held back."

strings.text: 「そうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 一応はまだ決定ではないのか……。
strings.translated: So it's not quite decided yet, huh...

strings.text: あの男がもう一年、この学校にいるのは厄介きわまりないな。
strings.translated: Having that guy at this school for another year would be endlessly troublesome.

strings.text: 「でも籠もって勉強してるって聞いてるけど？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But I heard he's holed up studying?"

strings.text:
「籠もって、というかご家族に監禁されてるみたいよ。
私も、明石先輩が脱走して遊んでいるところを見かけたら即、連絡入れる様に言われてるし……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Holed up, or rather being confined by his family, more like.
I've been told to contact them the instant I spot Akashi-senpai on the loose playing around..."

strings.text: 「なるほど、お前が監禁していたわけじゃないのか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see -- so you weren't the one holding him captive after all."

strings.text: 「そうね。学校来て遊んでたり、街で遊んでたりを見たら、速攻拘束して拷問してから、ご家族の方に回収してもらう感じ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. If I see him showing up at school to slack off, or messing around in town, I nab him on the spot, torture him a bit, then have his family come collect him. Something like that?"

strings.text: 「何か拘束と回収の間に変なもん入ってなかったか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wasn't there something weird slipped in between 'nab' and 'collect'?"

strings.text: 「拷問？　ああ、ちょっとねぇ。あはは」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Torture? Ah, just a little. Ahaha."

strings.text: 「そんな笑顔で言われたら普通に怖いぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You saying that with such a smile is honestly terrifying."

strings.text: 「拷問ってほどじゃないんだけどねぇ。法律が許すのなら去勢ぐらいしたいかなぁ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Not that it's torture on that scale. If the law allowed it, I'd probably castrate him."

strings.text: 「去勢って……あいつは何をしたんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Castrate...? What the hell did he do?"

strings.text: 「うん、まぁ、常識では考えられないぐらい悪い事かな？　とりあえず理由を突き止めないとね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, something bad on a scale you can't really conceive of by common sense. First off, I need to pin down the reason."

strings.text: 「理由ねぇ。あいつの行動に理由なんてあるのかね」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The reason, huh. Does that guy's behavior even have reasons?"

strings.text: 「そうね。草薙と同レベルではあるんじゃない。二人とも端から見れば意味不明な事しかしてないけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "True. He's about on your level, Kusanagi. From the outside, both of you only do things that make no sense."

strings.text: 「微妙な言われ方だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's a delicate way to put it."

strings.text: 「まぁ、実家から脱走したらすぐに私の情報網にひっかかるわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Anyway, the moment he escapes his house, my info network will pick him up."

strings.text:
「たしかに真琴の情報網ってバカにならないからなぁ。
俺とかも新入生の部活勧誘とか逃げようとしても、すぐ捕まるからなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated:
"Makoto's info network really is no joke.
Whenever I've tried to duck out of the new-student club recruitment stuff, I get caught right away."

strings.text: それはお前が間抜けだからだ……。
strings.translated: That's because you're a dolt...

strings.text: 「あんたも明石先輩みたいになりたくなかったら、ちゃんと授業でなさいよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "If you don't want to end up like Akashi-senpai, you'd better attend your classes properly."

strings.text: 「わ、分かった。明日からがんばるっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "G-got it. I'll do my best starting tomorrow."

strings.text: つつがなく午前の授業が終わる。
strings.translated: The morning classes ended without incident.

strings.text: 俺は弁当を手にすると、飯を食いに美術室にいく。
strings.translated: I picked up my bento and headed to the art room to eat.

strings.text: 「今日は自分で弁当作ったからな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I made my own bento today, after all..."

strings.text: 自分の分と藍の分、そして雫の分の弁当を作った。
strings.translated: I made one for myself, one for Ai, and one for Shizuku.

strings.text: だが……。
strings.translated: But...

strings.text: 「なんで俺の弁当だけないんだ？　いじめか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why is mine the only one missing? Is this bullying?"

strings.text: 「あー、おまえがずっと寝てたんでなぁ。おまえの存在を忘れてた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, well, you were asleep the whole time. I forgot you existed."

strings.text: 「寝坊しただけで人の存在そのものを忘れるなっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Don't forget my very existence just because I slept in!"

strings.text: 「うるせぇなぁ。そんな事言うと、何故か二つ作ってきた弁当を両方とも食うぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shut it. Keep talking like that and I'll eat both of the two bentos I somehow ended up making."

strings.text: そう言って包みの中の二つの弁当箱を圭に見せつける。
strings.translated: Saying that, I showed Kei the two bento boxes inside the wrapping.

strings.text: 「やっぱり優しいな！　直哉！　俺の分作ってきてくれたのか！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You really are kind after all, Naoya! You made mine too!"

strings.text: 「だから、単に二つ作っただけで、お前の分だとは言ってない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Like I said, I just happened to make two. I never said one was for you."

strings.text: 「だったら私に頂戴よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then give it to me."

strings.text: 「あ、別にいいけど」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, sure, that's fine."

strings.text: 「いいけどじゃない！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "'Fine' my ass!"

strings.text: 「ほれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Here."

strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 俺はさらに鞄から小さな弁当箱を取り出す。
strings.translated: Then I pulled a small bento box out of my bag as well.

strings.text: 「な、何これ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wh-what's this?"

strings.text:
「具材が余ってなー。さらにもう一つ作っておいた。
放課後、小腹が減った時用なんで小さめだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I had leftover ingredients, so I made one more.
It's on the small side, for when I get a little hungry after school."

strings.text: 「小さめって……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "On the small side...?"

strings.text:
いかにも女の子が持っていそうな弁当箱。
昨日、夕飯食った後に１００円ショップで買ってきたものだ。
strings.translated:
The kind of bento box a girl would carry.
I bought it at the hundred-yen shop after dinner yesterday.

strings.text: 「だ、だから借りは……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "S-so about paying you back..."

strings.text: 「くれと言ったのお前だろ。受け取っておけよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're the one who asked for it. Just take it."

strings.text: 「俺にもくれ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Gimme one too!"

strings.text: 「嫌だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No."

strings.text: 「何でそうなる！？　流れ的にもう一つは俺にくれるフラグだろ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why?! By the flow of things that second one is a flag for giving it to me!"

strings.text: 「だから、さっきのは放課後に小腹が減った時のために作ったもんだからさぁ。これ無くなったら放課後に俺が何も食えないじゃん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Like I said, that one was made in case I got peckish after school. If it's gone, I'll have nothing to eat then."
