strings.translated: "Nah... I'm okay. You might not know this since you're a rich girl, Yumi, but even if you can't get to heaven, you can pay at the Sanzu River and get to paradise instead."

strings.text: 「地獄の沙汰も銭しだいって言ってね。お金があれば私は極楽にいけるから問題ないのよ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "They say even the judgments of hell go by cash. So long as I have money, I can get to paradise. No problem."

strings.text: 「そうなの？　私が天国で里奈が極楽なの」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Really? So I go to heaven and you go to paradise?"

strings.text: 「そうねぇ。まぁ天国は優美にあげるから私は極楽をもらっておくよ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That's right. Well, I'll leave heaven to you, and I'll take paradise for myself."

strings.text: 「でも、それじゃ会えない……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "But then... we won't be able to meet..."

strings.text: 「そんなこんなでお金を貸してくださいっっ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "So anyway, please lend me the money!"

strings.text: 「最初っからお金貸してって言えばいいのに……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "You could've just said 'lend me money' from the start..."

strings.text: 「う、うう……ごめんねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "U-uu... I'm sorry..."

strings.text: 「そうだ。お金貸すから里奈に少し聞きたいことがある……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Right. I'll lend you the money, so there's something I want to ask you, Rina..."

strings.text: 「ん？　なに？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Hm? What?"

strings.text: 「里奈、セックスした事ある？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Rina, have you ever had sex?"

strings.text: 「ブッ！」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Bffh!"

strings.text: 「せ、セックスって……直接表現だな……乙女がそんなん言ったらだめだめだよ！」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "S-sex is... that's a really direct way to put it... A maiden shouldn't say things like that, no way no way!"

strings.text: 「なら交尾？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Then, copulation?"

strings.text: 「それはもっとだめだめなやつだ！」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That's even worse!"

strings.text: 「今日の優美は過激だなぁ。過激派すぎておばはん顔から火吹くところやで……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "You're being pretty extreme today, Yumi. So extreme this old lady's just about to breathe fire out of her face..."

strings.text: 「だからそれつまらないからやめた方がいいよ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I said, that's not funny, you should really give it up."

strings.text: 「つまらないとかはっきり言わない。私は悲しい気持ちになります」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Don't just come out and say it's not funny. It makes me sad."

strings.text: 「ごめん……でも里奈がおばさんのまねとか……嫌だもの……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Sorry... but you doing an old lady impression, Rina... I don't like it..."

strings.text: 「って……そんなにすまなそうに謝ると、それはそれで傷つくなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "H-hey... when you apologize that sincerely, it hurts in a different way..."

strings.text: 「なんであんな事みんなするんだろう……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Why does everyone do that sort of thing..."

strings.text: 「あんな事って……そのあれですか？　うーん。なんでだろうねー」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That sort of thing... you mean that? Hmm. Why, I wonder..."

strings.text: 「しなきゃいいのに……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "They shouldn't bother..."

strings.text: 「してもいいんじゃないのー」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "It's fine to do it, isn't it..."

strings.text: 「なんで？！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Why?!"

strings.text: 「男女は肌を重ねて愛を確かめ合うんじゃないのかなーとか」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Men and women lay their skin together to affirm their love, or something like that."

strings.text: 「人間なんて細菌の固まりだよ……なんでそんなリスクを負うのか分からない……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Humans are just clumps of bacteria... I don't get why anyone would take that kind of risk..."

strings.text: 「細菌の固まりって……優美はあいかわらずだなー」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Clumps of bacteria... you're as you always are, Yumi."

strings.text: 「だって、そうなんだもん。他人と肌を合わせるなんて……私はそういう事しないから、このだるさは無くしてもらいたい」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Because it's true. Pressing skin against another person's... I don't do that kind of thing, so I want somebody to get rid of this dull feeling."

strings.text: 「またまたそうやって……優美はそんな事ばかり言ってると膜に蜘蛛の巣がかかるぞ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "There you go again... Yumi, if you keep talking like that, spider webs are gonna grow on your hymen."

strings.text: 「いいもん……というか里奈っちだって使った事ない、膜アリま○このくせに……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "That's fine... besides, Rina-cchi, you've got a hymen-intact pu**y you've never used yourself..."

strings.text: 「だからー、そういう恥ずかしい事を平然というと焦るからやめなさいって……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I told you, stop saying embarrassing things like that with a straight face, it flusters me..."

strings.text: 「ったくこの娘は涼しい顔して、そういう恥ずかしい事ばかり言って……おばちゃん悲しいわ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Sheesh, this girl -- keeping such a cool face while saying embarrassing things... auntie's sad..."

strings.text: 「って……あれ里奈？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Wait... huh, Rina?"

strings.text: 「んー？　どうした？　私は里奈ですよー」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Hmm? What's up? Yes, I'm Rina."

strings.text: 「んじゃなくてさ……里奈引いてるよ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Not that... Rina, you've got a bite."

strings.text: 「え？　引いてる？　って？　え！」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Eh? A bite? What? Eh!"

strings.text: 小さく浮きが動く。
strings.translated: The float bobs slightly.

strings.text: 氷川が一気に引こうとする、すぐに川内野もそれを助ける。
strings.translated: Hikawa tries to yank the line in all at once, and Kawachino immediately helps her.

strings.text: いきなり力が増えたせいで、勢いよく水中のものが飛び出し、二人は倒れてしまう。
strings.translated: With the sudden burst of force, the thing in the water flies out, and the two of them topple over.

strings.text: 氷川は川内野の上に倒れる形となる。
strings.translated: Hikawa ends up falling on top of Kawachino.

strings.text: 「何釣れたのかな？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "What did we catch?"

strings.text: 「車のホイール」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "A car wheel."

strings.text: つり上げられたホイール……というかホイールキャップを川内野は持ち上げる。
strings.translated: Kawachino lifts up the pulled-out wheel... or rather, wheel cap.

strings.text: 「これ……楽しい？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Is this... fun?"

strings.text: 「微妙」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Sort of."

strings.text: 「やっぱり」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Thought so."

strings.text: 「なんだよ。今日はやたら絡むなぁ優美……このまま犯すぞ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "What. You're being unusually clingy today, Yumi... I'm gonna ravish you right here."

strings.text: 「ぽっ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "*blush*"

strings.text: 「いや、そこ赤くなるところじゃないから……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "No, that's not the part you're supposed to blush at..."

strings.text: 「里奈ぁ。こんな日差しの強い場所にいて大丈夫なの……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Rina, are you okay staying out in such strong sunlight...?"

strings.text: 「麦わら帽子があるから大丈夫なのだよ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I've got a straw hat, so I'm fine..."

strings.text: 「でも、日傘つかった方がいいよ……倒れちゃうよ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "But you really should use a parasol... you'll collapse."

strings.text: 「あ、そっちは……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ah, that's over on the..."

strings.text: 日傘を取りに来た川内野と目が合う。
strings.translated: My eyes meet Kawachino's as she comes to fetch the parasol.

strings.text: だがそれ以上に衝撃的だったのは……、
strings.translated: But what was more shocking than that...

strings.text: 川内野と俺の位置関係が位置関係だから……川内野の下着が丸見えになっている。
strings.translated: was that from the position Kawachino and I were in relative to each other... Kawachino's underwear was in full view.

strings.text: なんて事がばれたら殺される……。
strings.translated: If she found out about that, I'd be killed...

strings.text: 俺はその事に気が付かない様に（見ないよう）川内野の顔だけを見る事を心がけた。
strings.translated: I made a point of keeping my eyes strictly on Kawachino's face (and looking nowhere else) so she wouldn't notice.

strings.text: 川内野の顔がいつもの無表情に変わる。
strings.translated: Kawachino's face returns to her usual expressionless mask.

strings.text: 「あ、あの……こんにちは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "U-um... hello..."

strings.text: 川内野の姿が消える。
strings.translated: Kawachino vanishes from sight.

strings.text: え？　恥ずかしくて逃げた？　とか？
strings.translated: Huh? Did she run off out of embarrassment? Something like that?

strings.text: と思った次の瞬間。
strings.translated: Just as I thought that, the next moment.

strings.text: 「う、うわぁっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-whoaaa!"

strings.text: 「プール脇に何か生えてたのでぇ……水をあげましょう……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Something was growing by the poolside... let's water it..."

strings.text: 「み、水ってプールの水じゃねぇかっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-water?! That's pool water!"

strings.text: 「はい、塩素ふんだんで大きくなーれ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Yes, grow up big and strong on all this chlorine."

strings.text: 「ならないわ！！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not gonna happen!"

strings.text: 「草薙先輩はいつから居たのですか……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-senpai, since when have you been here..."

strings.text: 「いや、俺が一番最初にここにいたんだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I was actually here first..."

strings.text: 「なぜ隠れる様なまねをしていたのか聞いているのでーす」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I'm asking why you were hiding like that."

strings.text: 「あははは……先輩に黙っていてくださいって言ったの私なんだよ。ごめん優美」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ahaha... I'm the one who told her to keep quiet about it to you, senpai. Sorry, Yumi."

strings.text: 「……ふぅ、そう」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "...Hmph, I see."

strings.text: 「ごめんねぇ。なんかいろいろと男の人に聞かれたくない話とか聞かれたから怒ってるよね……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Sorry. You're mad because he overheard a bunch of things you didn't want a guy to hear, right..."

strings.text: 「別に……、どうでもいい人に何を聞かれてもどうでもいい……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Not really... I don't care what someone I don't care about hears..."

strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "It's just..."

strings.text: 「ま、まてっ、おいっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-wait, hey!"

strings.text: 最後に川内野は……。
strings.translated: In the end, Kawachino...

strings.text: 水を運ぶために手にしていたホイールキャップを放り投げた。
strings.translated: hurled the wheel cap she'd been holding to carry the water.

strings.text: ホイールキャップは金網を超えて、鋭角な放物線を描き、俺の顔に激突した。
strings.translated: The wheel cap flew over the chain-link fence, traced a sharp parabola, and slammed straight into my face.

strings.text: しかし……この位置からだと川内野の下着が見えてしまっていたのだが……、
strings.translated: However... from this position, Kawachino's underwear was in full view...,

strings.text: それには気が付かれなかった様だ。
strings.translated: but it seems she didn't notice.

strings.text: 良かった良かった……。
strings.translated: Thank goodness, thank goodness...

strings.text: それがもしばれていたら……。
strings.translated: If she had realized...

strings.text: 「殺されていただろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'd have been killed..."

strings.text: し、しまった、思わず声を出してしまった……。
strings.translated: Cr-crap, I said it out loud without meaning to...

strings.text: 川内野の視線が自分のスカートに向けられる。
strings.translated: Kawachino's gaze drops toward her own skirt.

strings.text: その後、俺の顔を見つめる。
strings.translated: Then she stares at my face.

strings.text: 「く、草薙……先輩」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "K-Kusanagi... senpai."

strings.text: 「い、いや待て……川内野っ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no, wait... Kawachino!"

strings.text: 「な、何も見ていない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I didn't see anything!"

strings.text: 「……嘘つき……今日は白だから良く見えたはずです……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "...Liar... today they're white, so you should have gotten a good look..."

strings.text: 「え？　黒のレースじゃない？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Weren't they black lace?"

strings.text: 「完全に見えていたわけですね」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "So you saw them perfectly."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「ってぇええええええええええ！　それ落としたら死ぬっっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whoooooooaaaaa! If you drop that, I'm dead!"

strings.text: 川内野はどこから取り出したのかブロック塀を持ち上げていた。
strings.translated: Kawachino had hoisted up a cinder block from who knows where.

strings.text: 「なんで草薙まで日傘に入ってきてるのですか……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Why are you crawling under my parasol too, Kusanagi..."

strings.text: 「いや、なんかプール脇の影が小さくなりすぎてな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, well, the shade by the pool got too small..."

strings.text: 「いやぁ……みんなでここにいる意味自体がないんじゃないかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ummm... isn't there kind of no point in all of us being here in the first place..."

strings.text: 「ふぅ、別に私と里奈がいる分には問題はないと思う……。
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "*sigh* I don't think there's any problem with just me and Rina here...

strings.text: ただ、このいらない人が！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: It's just this unnecessary person!"

strings.text: 「痛いなぁ。つねるなよ……。あと俺は先輩なんだからいらない人とか言うな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ow. Don't pinch me... And don't call me an unnecessary person -- I'm your senpai."

strings.text: 「あまり関わってこなければいくらでも先輩と呼びますよ？　関わってくるかぎりはいらない人です」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "If you didn't get involved so much, I'd call you senpai as much as you like. But as long as you keep butting in, you're an unnecessary person."

strings.text: 「うーん、なんだかなぁ……。だいたい本当にブロック塀なんか投げるやつがいるか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ugh, what is with you... Anyway, who actually throws a cinder block?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、無傷だったからいいじゃないですか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Well, you weren't hurt, so what's the problem?"

strings.text: 「当たってたら死んでたわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If it had hit me, I'd be dead."

strings.text: 「そうですか、それは残念ですね……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Is that so, what a pity..."

strings.text: 「それより……なんで草薙先輩はこんな場所にいるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "More importantly... what is Kusanagi-senpai even doing in a place like this?"

strings.text: 「そうですね。なんで先輩は学校に居るのですか？　今は夏休みですよね？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That's right. Why are you at school, senpai? It's summer vacation, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「ああ、野暮用があってな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, a bit of tedious business."

strings.text: 「野暮用ですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Tedious business?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、野暮用だな。まさに」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, tedious business. Truly."

strings.text: 「てな事で、そろそろ野暮用に呼ばれるかな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Which reminds me -- I should probably get going to attend to that tedious business..."

strings.text: 「そうですね。こんな場所にいたら私たちまで本当に熱中症になってしまいますね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Right. If we stay in a place like this, we really will get heatstroke too."

strings.text: 「どうしましたか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Is something the matter?"

strings.text: 「何が？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Scared of what?"

strings.text: 「なぜ先輩が里奈と同じ方向に歩き出すのでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Why is senpai walking off in the same direction as Rina?"

strings.text: 「同じ方向だからだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because it's the same direction..."

strings.text: 「そうなんですか？　三年生だと階自体違うじゃないですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Is that so? Third-years are on a different floor entirely, aren't they?"

strings.text: 「いや、授業受けるわけじゃないんだから、三年の教室に行くわけじゃない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I'm not going to class, so I'm not headed to the third-year classroom."

strings.text: 「そういえば野暮用だと言ってましたね。何なんですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Oh, you did say tedious business. What is it, exactly?"

strings.text: 「だいたい、この時期の野暮用なんて決まってる……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Well, 'tedious business' at this time of year is pretty obvious..."

strings.text: 「と、というかっ、お前らだって教室と逆方向じゃないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-hey, wait, aren't you two headed the opposite direction from the classrooms too?"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、私たちは部活ですから」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Well, that's because we have club activities."

strings.text: 「部活か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Club activities, huh..."

strings.text: 「美術部か天文部なのかは知らんが、夏休み早々大変だなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't know whether it's the art club or the astronomy club, but tough luck having club right at the start of summer break."

strings.text: 「先輩こそ、夏休み早々大変ですね。バカなせいで」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "You're the one having a tough time right at the start of summer break, senpai. Because you're an idiot."

strings.text: 「バカのせいじゃない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not because I'm an idiot!"

strings.text: 「なんか、こうやって同じ方向に歩く事ってめずらしいですね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "You know, it's rare for us to walk in the same direction like this."

strings.text: 「そうか？　そんなもんか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really? Is that so?"

strings.text: 「昔は一緒の方向に歩いたりする事もありましたが、大人になっていくと学年が違うだけで、一緒の方向に歩く事が無くなります……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "In the past we would sometimes walk the same way, but as we grow up, just being in different grades means we stop walking in the same direction..."

strings.text: そう言われると、そんな気がする。
strings.translated: Now that she mentions it, that does seem true.

strings.text: 「ちょっとした事なんですけど、なんかひさしぶりです。こうやって歩くの……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "It's a small thing, but it's been a while. Walking like this..."

strings.text: 「そうだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 「帰り道が同じだったら、一緒に帰ったりも出来るのですけどね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "If our routes home were the same, we could even walk home together."

strings.text: 「一緒に帰るか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wanna walk home together?"

strings.text: 「ぎゃうっっ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Gyaah!

strings.text: 川内野！　足踏んでる！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Kawachino! You're stepping on my foot!"

strings.text: 「あ、すみません。わざとです」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Ah, sorry. On purpose."

strings.text: 「言い訳する気すらない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're not even trying to make an excuse!"

strings.text: 「それはそうと、里奈はこれから私と部活です」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "In any case, Rina has club with me now."

strings.text: 「部活？　あ、そうか、美術部があるのか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Club? Ah, right, the art club."

strings.text: 「そうです！　故に、部員ではない草薙先輩はとっとと帰ってください！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "That's right! Therefore, since Kusanagi-senpai isn't a member, please go home this instant!"

strings.text: 「そんな剣幕で言わなくても……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You don't have to say it with such ferocity..."

strings.text: 部活か……、
strings.translated: Club activities, huh...

strings.text: そういえば、稟に絵を教え途中だったなぁ。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, I was in the middle of teaching Rin how to paint.

strings.text: そろそろあの絵も完成する頃だろうか……。
strings.translated: Her painting should be about finished around now...

strings.text: とりあえず、野暮用を済ませてから美術部に顔でも出してみるか……。
strings.translated: For now, let me take care of my tedious business and then stop by the art club...

strings.text: 「俺も野暮用済ませたら、美術部に顔出すわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Once I'm done with my tedious business, I'll drop by the art club too."

strings.text: 「何でですか……」
strings.speaker: 優美

strings.text: 「稟に教えてる絵がそろそろ完成する頃だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The painting I've been teaching Rin ought to be about done."

strings.text: 「そうですね。稟先輩の絵、そろそろ終わる時期ですよね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Right. Rin-senpai's painting is about ready to be finished, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「なるほど、とりあえず野暮用をサボるのはやめという事でしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I see. So it means you're at least not skipping the tedious business?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

strings.text: 「野暮用も大事だからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Tedious business matters too, you know."

strings.text: 「そうですね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That's right."

strings.text: 「野暮用が終わったらとっとと一人で帰ればいいと思います！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Once your tedious business is done, I think you should just hurry home alone!"

strings.text: 「先輩を邪険にするな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't treat your senpai so coldly."

strings.text: 「はぁ、そうですか……めんどくさい」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Haa, I see... what a pain."

strings.text: 桜が散り、さらに時間が過ぎる……。
strings.translated: The cherry blossoms scatter, and still more time passes...

strings.text: 時が過ぎるのは不思議なものだ……。
strings.translated: The passage of time is a strange thing...

strings.text: なぜならば、誰も時が過ぎるのを目撃などしない。
strings.translated: After all, no one ever witnesses time passing.

strings.text: にもかかわらず……
strings.translated: And yet...

strings.text: そこにあった風景は失われ、眼前の風景は新しいものへと更新されていく。
strings.translated: The landscape that once was fades away, and the scene before our eyes is continually made anew.

strings.text: 失われた風景はどこにいくのであろうか？
strings.translated: Where does the lost scenery go?

strings.text: 失われた風景は過去とよばれ、目の前の風景は現在とよばれる……。
strings.translated: The lost scenery is called the past, and the scenery before us is called the present...

strings.text: 街を染め上げていた春の雪はどこに消えたのであろうか。
strings.translated: Where did the spring snow that had painted the town disappear to?

strings.text: 今眼前に広がる景色はまったく違うもの……。
strings.translated: The scene stretching out before me now is something utterly different...

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「強い日差し」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The harsh sunlight."

strings.text: 「生い茂る青」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The overgrown green."

strings.text: 「植物の香り」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The scent of plants."

strings.text: 「夏の空の下」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Beneath the summer sky."

strings.text: 「季節は静かに、だけど確実に過ぎていく様だな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The seasons pass by -- quietly, yet unmistakably..."

strings.text: 真琴
strings.translated: Makoto

strings.text: 「なんて悦に入るのはいいんだけどさぁ……。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's all well and good, waxing poetic like that, but...

strings.text: 草薙ってバカだったんだね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Kusanagi, you really are an idiot, aren't you?"

strings.text: 「うるさいっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shut up."

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「まぁ、まぁ、まこちゃんもそんな事言ったら草薙くんが可哀想だよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Now, now, Mako-chan, if you say things like that, poor Kusanagi-kun will feel bad."

strings.text: 「だってさぁ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But still."

strings.text: 世の学生どもが浮かれる。突き抜けるような青空に、湧き上がるような入道雲の季節。
strings.translated: The students of the world grow giddy. It's the season of piercing blue skies and towering thunderheads.

strings.text: 俺たちはクーラーの効いていない教室で補習を受けている。
strings.translated: And here we are, taking supplementary lessons in a classroom without air conditioning.

strings.text: 俺は、地理の試験を赤点で乗り切りいまここにいる。
strings.translated: I'm here because I failed my geography exam with a red mark.

strings.text: のりきってない……のか。
strings.translated: Or rather... I haven't gotten through it at all.

strings.text: 「草薙くんも落ち着いて、とりあえず今は一問でも多く問題を解きましょう」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-kun, please calm down and for now, let's just solve one more problem."

strings.text: 「何を言ってる。どう考えても鳥谷から喧嘩を売ってきたんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you talking about? Any way you slice it, Toritani picked this fight."

strings.text: 圭
strings.translated: Kei

strings.text: 「そうだぞ。人の事をバカとか言うのはダメだぞ真琴」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That's right. It's not okay to call people idiots, Makoto."

strings.text: 「あんたもでしょ……というかあんたの方がひどかったって話じゃない？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That goes for you too... actually, aren't you the one who did way worse?

strings.text: ほぼ全滅だったって聞いてるわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: I heard you failed just about everything."

strings.text: 俺の横にいる、見るからにアレなこの生き物は、情報処理、生物、英語Ｗ、英語Ｒ、現代文、地歴公演習、数学、日本史Ｂ、政治経済、倫理で赤点という弓張史上、類を見ない成績を収め。
strings.translated: This blatantly idiotic creature beside me pulled off the unprecedented feat in Yumihari history of failing Info Processing, Biology, English Comp & Reading, Modern Japanese, Geo-History, Math, JP History B, Pol-Econ, and Ethics.

strings.text: めでたく、一学期終了時点で卒業は絶望的という状況に陥っている。
strings.translated: And so, splendidly, by the end of the first term, his prospects of graduation had plunged into hopelessness.

strings.text: それでも彼は。
strings.translated: And yet, he...

strings.text: 「あははははは……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahahahahaha..."

strings.text: 持ち前の明るさで、まったく未来の不安など気にすることなく、元気に補習を受けている。
strings.translated: ...with his trademark cheerfulness, without worrying about the anxieties of the future in the slightest, was energetically taking his supplementary lessons.

strings.text: 「あははははは、この石川豚木って人すげぇ名前だなぁ。ブタキだってさぁ。あはははは。親とかこの名前つける時に何か思わなかったのかよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahahahaha, this Ishikawa Butaki person has such an incredible name. Butaki, seriously. Ahahaha. Didn't the parents think anything when they named him this?"

strings.text: お前みたいな生き物を産み落とした親にこそ言いたい事だ……。
strings.translated: That's exactly what I want to say to the parents who spawned a creature like you...

strings.text: 「草薙、あんただって圭の事バカに出来ないんだからね。赤点とかとって……恥ずかしくないのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kusanagi, you're in no position to look down on Kei either. Getting a red mark... aren't you ashamed?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hah...

strings.text: 試験前に指を負傷しなければ、こんな事にならなかったのにな……負傷が恨めしいぜ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: If I hadn't injured my finger before the exam, this never would have happened... damn that injury..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうね。あのとき草薙、すっごい深爪して、痛い痛いうるさかったからねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh, right. Back then, Kusanagi, you clipped your nail way too short and wouldn't shut up about how it hurt."

strings.text: 「そうだ……運が悪かった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's right... it was bad luck."

strings.text: 「草薙、私が嫌味を言ってるの分からないのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kusanagi, do you not understand that I'm being sarcastic?"

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ、痛い場所があったら気が散るのはたしかですし、とりあえず自習続けましょうよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "W-well, it's true that pain can be distracting, so for now let's just continue with our self-study."

strings.text: 「あははは、お前みたいなクール系キャラが頭悪かったら、もうなんかダメダメだな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahahaha, if a cool-type character like you has a bad brain, you're just totally hopeless."

strings.text: 「貴様みたいな、見た目も中身もバカバカにいわれたくない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't want to hear that from someone as stupid as you, inside and out."

strings.text: 「おれの見た目のどこがバカバカだぁ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Where about my looks is stupid?!"

strings.text: 「とりあえず、落ち着きましょうよ！　ほら、問題解きましょう！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "For now, let's just calm down! Come on, let's solve the problems!"

strings.text: 「そうよ。ったく文句は私が言いたいわよ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Exactly. Honestly, I'm the one who should be complaining.

strings.text: なんで私と稟ちゃんが監視役なんかつとめなきゃいけないのよ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Why do Rin-chan and I have to be the supervisors..."

strings.text: 「それはいいじゃないですか。この二人が補習終わらないと、美術部の活動出来ないわけですし、それに私は楽しいよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Isn't that fine? If these two don't finish their supplementary lessons, we can't have art club activities, and besides, I'm having fun."

strings.text: 本当に楽しそうな笑顔で、ポンっと稟が手を叩く。
strings.translated: Rin claps her hands together with a truly delighted smile.

strings.text: 「俺は楽しくない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not having fun!"

strings.text: 「うるさいわね！　ほら手止まってる！　とっととその問題集を終わらせなさいよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Quiet! Your hand's stopped! Hurry up and finish that workbook!"

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 「ちゃんと自習してるか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You lot studying properly?"

strings.text: 「ああ、完璧だ。もう補習の必要など無いぐらいの仕上がりだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, perfectly. So polished I don't even need supplementary lessons anymore."

strings.text: 「文句ばかりで全然進んでません……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's nothing but complaints, we haven't made any progress at all..."

strings.text: 「鳥谷、お前！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani, you--!"

strings.text: 「草薙くん、さすがにそんな嘘ついたってバレちゃうよ。問題全然解けてないし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-kun, even you can't get away with a lie like that. You haven't solved any of the problems..."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nngh..."

strings.text: 「補習終わらせないと夏休みは来ないんだからな、まじめにやれ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Summer vacation isn't coming until you finish supplementary lessons, so get serious."

strings.text: 「あはははは。そうだぞ直哉」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahahahaha. That's right, Naoya."

strings.text: 「あほ、特にお前だ。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Idiot, that especially goes for you.

strings.text: 何度も逃走を企てただろうが……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: You've attempted to escape how many times now..."

strings.text: 「なんで逃走と言うかなぁ？
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why do you call it escape?

strings.text: あれは戦略的撤退なんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: Those were strategic retreats."

strings.text: 「ほう、戦略的にあそこで撤退するのは、どういう意味があるのだ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Oh? And what strategic meaning does retreating right at that moment have?"

strings.text: 「戦いには、地の理、天の理、人の理があってだな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "In battle, there are the principles of terrain, heaven, and man!"

strings.text: 「無駄口叩かないでとっとと終わらせなさいよ……ったく、本当に絵以外何も取り柄無いのねぇ……圭は」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Stop running your mouth and just finish already... honestly, you really have no talents besides painting, do you, Kei..."

strings.text: 「何だと！　俺なんか取り柄の塊みたいな存在だぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What did you say?! I'm practically a lump of talent!"

strings.text: どんな塊の存在だよ。
strings.translated: What kind of lump of an existence is that?

strings.text: 「あ、長い時間すまなかった。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, sorry for taking so long.

strings.text: 二人とも、後は私が見ているから大丈夫だぞ。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: You two, I'll watch them from here, so it's fine.

strings.text: 美術部に出るのだろ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Aren't you heading to art club?"

strings.text: 「あ、私は大丈夫ですよ。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, I'm fine.

strings.text: あと少しで終わりそうなんで、最後まで待ってますよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: It looks like they're almost done, so I'll wait until the end."

strings.text: 「以下同文。ここまで時間つぶされたんですから、最後まで付き合います」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ditto. Since I've had my time used up until now, I'll stick with them to the end."

strings.text: 「あはははは、今気が付いたんだけどさ！
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahahahaha, I just noticed something!

strings.text: 地の理と血糊って似ているぞ。そっくりだ。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: 'Chi no ri' -- principle of terrain -- and 'chinori' -- fake blood -- sound alike. They're identical.

strings.text: なんか俺ドキっとしたぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: I actually got a little startled."

strings.text: 「お前なぁ……みんながお前らのために時間とっているのに、血糊じゃなくて血まみれにしてやろうか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You... everyone's making time for you two, and you want me to make it real blood instead of fake?"

strings.text: 「しかし、良くあれだけ赤点とって、弓張に入れたわね。ここって結構、偏差値が高いじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But still, it's impressive he got into Yumihari with that many failing grades. This place has a pretty high deviation score, doesn't it?"

strings.text: 「ああ、恥ずかしい話だが、圭は特別推薦で入ってきているから学力に問題があるんだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, it's an embarrassing story, but Kei got in on a special recommendation, so he has issues with academic ability."

strings.text: 「なるほどねぇ。という事は草薙もか……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I see. Which means the same is true for Kusanagi..."

strings.text: 「俺は違うぞ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not true for me!"

strings.text: 「たしかに草薙は違う。というよりも成績はまぁ良い部類と言っても良い。ムラはあるが……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Indeed, Kusanagi is different. Or rather, his grades could even be called good. Though they're uneven..."

strings.text: 「そ、そうだぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-that's right."

strings.text: 「だったらなんで補習なんて受けてるのよ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then why are you taking supplementary lessons..."

strings.text: 「ほとんどの成績は優秀なのだが、殊、嫌いな科目に関しての取り組む気力の無さは異常だ。なぜ地理だけ１０点とかなのだお前は？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Most of his grades are excellent, but his utter lack of motivation regarding subjects he dislikes is abnormal. Why do you get 10 points on geography and only geography?"

strings.text: 「１０点？　なにそれ？　どうやったらそんな点数取れるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "10 points? What's that? How do you even get a score like that?"

strings.text: 「そ、それは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-that's..."

strings.text: 「あははは、それは直哉が方向音痴だからだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahahaha, that's because Naoya has no sense of direction."

strings.text: 「方向音痴？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "No sense of direction?"

strings.text: 「直哉は、子供の時から方向音痴でな。それをバカにされたから一生地図なんて見ないとかほざいてたら、本当に地図が読めない身体になったんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya's had no sense of direction since he was a kid. He got teased for it, and when he swore he'd never look at a map for the rest of his life, his body actually became incapable of reading maps."

strings.text: 「い、いくら何でもそんな事はないと思うよ。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no matter what, I don't think that's really the case.

strings.text: 昔の草薙くんはそんな事なかったし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Kusanagi-kun wasn't like that back in the day..."

strings.text: 「バカにされるまでは、そんなでも無かったらしいぞ。でもバカにされてからは方向音痴に拍車がかかって、ついには弓張市の外に出られない設定になったんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Until he got teased, apparently he wasn't so bad. But after being teased, his lack of direction went into overdrive, and eventually he became a character who can't leave Yumihari City."

strings.text: 「まじで？　何そのおもしろ設定？　バグを残したＲＰＧじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Seriously? What kind of hilarious setting is that? It's like an RPG with a bug left in it."

strings.text: 「そうなんだ……、草薙くんって昔から何でも出来ると思ってたのに、なんだか意外な一面があるんだ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see... I always thought Kusanagi-kun could do anything since way back, but there's this unexpected side to him too..."

strings.text: 「なんで、そこでうれしそうな顔して笑う？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why are you smiling so happily about that?"

strings.text: 「あ、ごめんなさい。ごめんなさい。他意はないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, sorry, sorry. I don't mean anything by it."

strings.text: 「だいたいだな、三年になったら地理など選択制だろ普通、なぜこの学校は理系選択者まで地理があるんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyway, in third year geography is normally an elective, so why does this school make even science-track students take geography?"

strings.text: 「それは仕方がないだろ、そういう方針なんだから」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That can't be helped, it's just the policy."

strings.text: 「ちぃ。他の成績が問題ないのだから一科目ぐらい赤点を見逃せ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Tch. My other grades are fine, so overlook one failing subject."

strings.text: 「しかしなぁ。お前の地理の知識は、幼○園よりひどいからなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "But your geography knowledge is worse than a kinderg*rtener's..."

strings.text: 「そんなひどいの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That bad?"

strings.text: 「ああ……試しに草薙、世界図を描いて見ろ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah... Kusanagi, try drawing a map of the world."

strings.text: 「何故そんな事しなければならないっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why do I have to do that?"

strings.text: 「ならば、それを再試としてやろう！　出来たら補講は終了としてやる」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Then I'll make it your retake exam! If you can do it, I'll end your supplementary lessons."

strings.text: 「藍が地理の担当教員ではないのに良いのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that okay when Ai isn't even the geography teacher?"

strings.text: 「ああ、いいだろう。私がすべて責任を持とう」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yes, it's fine. I'll take full responsibility."

strings.text: 「ぅ……それならばやってやろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ngh... in that case, I'll do it."

strings.text: 「貴様ら俺をバカにしすぎだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You lot are making too much of a fool of me..."

strings.text: 「あははははは、何よこれっっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ahahahahaha, what is this?!"

strings.text: 「だ、だめだろっっこれはっっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Th-this is no good!"

strings.text: 「な、何がだめなんだっ、ふざけるなっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what's no good, don't mess with me!"

strings.text: 「だ、だってお前……なんで千葉が島なんだよっっ。なんで千葉がアメリカぐらいの大きさなんだよっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "B-because... why is Chiba an island? Why is Chiba the size of America?"

strings.text: 「え？　千葉って島じゃないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Chiba isn't an island?"

strings.text: 「きゃははははは、なんでそうなるのよ。千葉人に殺されるわよっっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kyahahahaha, how does that happen? Chiba residents will kill you!"

strings.text: 「いや、しかし……千葉に行くときにはかならず海を渡るじゃないか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, but... whenever you go to Chiba, you always cross the sea, don't you..."

strings.text: 「ぎゃはははははは、それは河だぞっっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Gyahahahahaha, that's a river!"

strings.text: 「なるほど、千葉って利根川と江戸川に囲まれてるからねっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I see, Chiba is surrounded by the Tone and Edo Rivers!"

strings.text: 「な、なんだバカにしすぎだぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what, you're making way too much fun of me."

strings.text: 「あはははは、しかしお前の世界には、日本と千葉とアメリカのニューヨークとヨーロッパと中国と中東しかないのかっっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahahaha, but in your world, is it really just Japan, Chiba, New York in America, Europe, China, and the Middle East?"

strings.text: 「ふぅ……。まずは……世界地図を覚えさせるところから始めないとだめみたいだな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hah... First... it seems we have to start by making you memorize the world map..."

strings.text: 「これじゃなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "With this..."

strings.text: 「なんで、中東がこんな場所なんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Why is the Middle East in this location?"

strings.text: 「え？　だって東の真ん中だろ？　だったら中国の下かなぁ……と」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Well, it's the middle of the east, right? So I figured it'd be below China..."

strings.text: 「これは相当な重症ね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "This is a pretty severe case..."

strings.text: 「しかし、草薙はそんなので良く他の教科とか出来るわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But still, Kusanagi, it's amazing you can do the other subjects with this."

strings.text: 「草薙は社会全般良くない……地理音痴のせいだろうが」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Kusanagi is bad at social studies in general... probably because of his geographical illiteracy."

strings.text: 「この地図理解じゃ、少なくとも日本史と世界史は絶望的だわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "With this understanding of maps, at the very least Japanese and world history are hopeless."

strings.text: 「直哉は嫌いな事を意地でもしないからぁ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya stubbornly refuses to do anything he doesn't like..."

strings.text: 「ああ、まぁ、その辺りは反省しているよ。せめて中学ぐらいの時に気がついて、気を入れ直して地理をやってれば良かったが……今となってはすべてが手遅れだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, well, I do reflect on that a bit. If only I'd noticed back in junior high and gotten serious about geography... but by now it's all too late..."

strings.text: 「手遅れなものか！　今がんばれ！　今こそがんばれ！　大人になってからでは本当に手遅れだぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It's not too late! Work hard now! Now is precisely when you should work hard! Once you're an adult, it really is too late!"

strings.text: 「お、大人になって地理が不得意なぐらい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "B-being bad at geography as an adult is..."

strings.text: 「千葉が島だと思ってる様なやつは苦労すると思うわよ。仕事で地方なんて行ったら、一生弓張市には帰ってこれないんじゃないかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Someone who thinks Chiba is an island is going to have a hard time. If your job sends you to the provinces, you might never make it back to Yumihari City for the rest of your life."

strings.text: スルーしてくれると思ったのに、正論で返された。
strings.translated: I thought she'd let it slide, but I got a sound argument back instead.

strings.text: 「うん。好き嫌いはダメだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah. Playing favorites is no good."

strings.text: 「お前など、好き嫌い関係なくすべての科目が壊滅的だろうが……良くこの学校入れたなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Someone like you, whose grades are catastrophic in every subject regardless of preference... it's amazing you got into this school."

strings.text: 「だいたい、さっき藍が言ってた特別推薦ってなんだ？　推薦と言ってもそれなりにテストはあるんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyway, what was that 'special recommendation' Ai mentioned earlier? Even for recommendations, there's still some kind of test, right?"

strings.text: 「そんなもんないぞ！　特別推薦は一芸入学だ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "There's no such thing! Special recommendation is entry by single talent!"

strings.text: 「……一芸、入試」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...single talent entrance exam."

strings.text: なんか悪い予感しかしない……。
strings.translated: I have nothing but a bad feeling about this...

strings.text: 一芸入試って、あの一芸入試だよな。
strings.translated: Single talent entrance exam, that's the single talent entrance exam we're talking about, right?

strings.text: 「この学校は、もしかしてけん玉とかで入れたりしないであろうな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You can't tell me this school lets people in for stuff like kendama, can you?"

strings.text: 「けん玉なんかで学校入れるわけないだろ？
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Like hell they'd let you into a school for kendama!

strings.text: お前はバカか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: Are you stupid?"

strings.text: 「そうか……良かった。そこまでのバカではないんだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see... good. So you're not that stupid."

strings.text: 「といっても、こいつは面接の時に、特技でしりとりを持ち出したのだがな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That said, when it was his interview, he brought up shiritori as his special skill..."

strings.text: 「め、面接で、し、しりとりっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sh-shiritori, in the interview?!"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだ……思い出すだけで恥ずかしい……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right... just remembering it is embarrassing..."

strings.text: 教師
strings.translated: Teacher

strings.text: 「はい、それではお名前は？」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "Alright, and your name?"

strings.text: 「おう、夏目圭。趣味と特技は絵画だ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yo, Natsume Kei. Hobbies and specialties: painting."

strings.text: 「はははは……君、敬語つかいたまえ……。
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "Hahaha... young man, please use polite speech...

strings.text: これは面接だよ？」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: This is an interview, you know?"

strings.text: 「あ、そうだった……すまない……のでした」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ah, right... my apologies... it was."

strings.text: 「それで？　君は特別推薦の対象が絵画となっているんだが、他に特技とかはあるのかね？」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "So? Your special recommendation is for painting, but do you have any other skills?"

strings.text: 「あ、それな。俺なぁ、しりとりが得意だって、街中で噂だったぞ……です」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ah, that. I'm pretty famous around town for being good at shiritori... sir."

strings.text: 「しりとり？」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "Shiritori?"

strings.text: 「そうだ。しりとりをやらせたら右に出る者はすべて殺してしまう勢いだ……です」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah. When it comes to shiritori, I'll murder anyone who tries to top me... sir."

strings.text: 「（苦笑）……しりとりねぇ」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "Heh... Shiritori, huh."

strings.text: 「では私とやってみるかい？」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "Well then, shall we try a round?"

strings.text: 「あはははは……。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahahaha.

strings.text: 先生死ぬぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: Teacher, you're gonna die."

strings.text: 「一芸入試といえども、なんでこの学校はそんな危ない人間を入学させるんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even for single-talent admissions, why would this school let in someone that dangerous?"

strings.text: 「いや、もちろん、合格理由は絵の実績だ。さすがにしりとりで受かったわけではないぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "No, of course, the reason for his acceptance was his track record with painting. He didn't actually pass with shiritori."

strings.text: 「だとしても、その面接を聞く限りにおいて卒業出来る様には見えないだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even so, just from that interview, it doesn't sound like he'd manage to graduate, right?"

strings.text: 「うーん、弓張は長い歴史の中で多くの文化人や芸術家を輩出してきたからなぁ。芸術的な素質に対して甘いというのはある……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hmm, Yumihari has produced many cultured people and artists over its long history. So there is a certain leniency toward artistic aptitude..."

strings.text: 「ふぅ、けっこうな難関を越えて入学した連中が本当に浮かばれない話だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sigh, that's a pretty rough deal for the folks who cleared some serious hurdles to get in..."

strings.text: 「しかも、圭は、面接の教師にしりとりで負けてなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What's more, Kei even lost the shiritori match to the interviewing teacher..."

strings.text: 「ち、違うぞ、あれは違う。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "N-no, that's wrong, that's wrong.

strings.text: あれは先生が勝手にルール変更してな！
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: That teacher changed the rules on his own!

strings.text: それで負けたんだぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: That's why I lost!"

strings.text: 「というか、ああいうのはローカルルールがありすぎでまったくダメダメだ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I mean, that kind of stuff has way too many local rules; it's totally no good."

strings.text: 「どんなだったんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How did it go..."

strings.text: 「それでは、“しりとり”からはじめるかな？　では君、“り”からだよ」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "Well then, shall we begin with 'shiritori'? So, young man, you start with 'ri'."

strings.text: 「おう、リストラ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yo, 'risutora' -- restructuring."

strings.text: 「雷鳴」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "'Raimei' -- thunderclap."

strings.text: 「イカ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "'Ika' -- squid."

strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "'Kame' -- turtle."

strings.text: 「メﾎﾞﾗｰ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "'Mebora.'"

strings.text: 「えっと……発音の問題ではないよ」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "Uh... it's not a matter of pronunciation."

strings.text: 「いや聞こえてはいるんだよ。
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "No, I heard you clearly.

strings.text: それでそれは何だ？」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: What is that?"

strings.text: 「おう、すごい人だぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yo, he's an amazing guy."

strings.text: 「それは人なのかね？」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "That's a person?"

strings.text: 「そうだ、魔法が使えるんだ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, he can use magic."

strings.text: 「なるほど……それは小説か何かの登場人物なのかな？」
strings.speaker: 教師
strings.translated: "I see... is he a character from a novel or something?"

strings.text: 「小説なんかじゃないぞ。俺が考えた妖精でだな。いつも姉ちゃんの鼻の穴の中に住んでいるんだ。七つの封印の守護者でもあり刑事でもあるんだ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's not a novel or anything. He's a fairy I came up with. He always lives inside my sister's nostril. He's the guardian of the seven seals, and also a detective."

strings.text: 「ああ、すまない。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, sorry.

strings.text: これに関しては本当に悪いと思ってる……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: I really do feel bad about that one..."

strings.text: 「ん？　なんで姉貴が直哉に謝るんだ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Hmm? Why is my sister apologizing to Naoya?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、そんな事言っても二人とも赤点組だから、あんまり変わらないわよ！　さぁとっとと問題解きなさい！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, no matter what you say, both of you failed, so it doesn't really change anything! Come on, hurry up and solve the problems!"

strings.text: 「そんな、圭とひと<r くく>括</r>りにされる俺の身にもなれ！　俺は今回の試験、数学と物理はお前より点数は上だったぞ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey, put yourself in my shoes, getting lumped in with Kei! On this last exam, my scores in math and physics were higher than yours!"

strings.text: 「そうなんですか？　草薙くん芸術家血族なのに、意外です。理数系が得意なんだ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Oh, really? That's surprising, since Kusanagi-kun comes from a family of artists. So you're good at math and science?"

strings.text: 「とは言っても、稟に一教科すら敵わなかったがな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That said, I couldn't beat Rin in a single subject.

strings.text: どうやったらあんなに満点を連発出来るんだ？　子供のテストじゃないんだからさ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: How do you keep scoring perfect on all of them? These aren't grade-school tests, you know..."

strings.text: 「そんな、満点だらけだったんだ？　すごいわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wow, you got perfect scores on nearly everything? That's amazing."

strings.text: 「ああ、毎年、弘瀬が学年トップだったのだが、今年の期末はそれが入れ替わった。弓張始まって以来の好成績者の集まりだよ。今年の三年は」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah, every year Hirose has been top of the grade, but on this term's finals that changed. This third-year class has the strongest lineup of high scorers in Yumihari's history."

strings.text: 「弘瀬？　あの秀才よりも頭いいのか？　稟」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hirose? You're smarter than that prodigy, Rin?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、たまたまですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it was just a fluke."

strings.text: 「ったく、稟ちゃんや弘瀬みたいなチートがいなければ、私だって一度ぐらいは学年トップになれたかもしれないのに……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Geez, if there weren't cheats like Rin-chan and Hirose around, maybe I could've been top of the grade at least once..."

strings.text: 「そうだな。鳥谷もがんばっているからな。ただ、もう三年だからなかなかトップはとれないぞ、みんな相当勉強がんばってるみたいだからな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Indeed. Toritani has been working hard too. But you're already in third year, so taking top is going to be difficult. Everyone seems to be studying really seriously."

strings.text: 「あー、嫌だ、嫌だ、成績強者の会話は……ったく、つまらない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Aah, I hate this, I hate this, listening to the top scorers talk... damn, this is boring..."

strings.text: 「成績弱者はとっとと問題解きなさいよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The bottom scorers should shut up and solve their problems!"

strings.text: 「ははは、まるで鳥谷が教師みたいだな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hahaha, Toritani, you sound like a teacher."

strings.text: 「だって、こいつらが終わらないと美術部始められないんですよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Because if these guys don't finish, art club can't start."

strings.text: 「でも、私たちも草薙くん達の無駄話にのってしまったわけですし……すみません。とりあえず少し静かにしましょう」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But we were the ones going along with Kusanagi-kun's chatter, so... sorry. Let's be quiet for a bit."

strings.text: 「さぁ、そんな事でばりばり進めていくぞ！　ほらいそげ二人ともっ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Alright then, on that note, let's power through! Come on, hurry up, both of you!"

strings.text: 「ふぅ……終わった終わった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew... done, done..."

strings.text: 「楽しかったなっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That was fun!"

strings.text: 「お前、頭の構造がおかしいのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is there something wrong with the way your head's put together?"

strings.text: 「んじゃ部室行くわよ！　草薙も行くんだからね！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well then, off to the clubroom! You're coming too, Kusanagi!"

strings.text: 「ああ、分かってる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I know."

strings.text: 「あら？　なんか素直ね。夏休みに登校して来たから、即刻帰るとか言うと思ってた」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh? You're pretty agreeable. I figured you'd say something like 'I came in during summer break, so I'm going straight home.'"

strings.text: 「そう思うのなら、無理矢理俺を部活に連れて行こうとする発想をやめろよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If you thought that, then stop trying to drag me to club by force in the first place."

strings.text: 「今日は特別よ。大事な話があるからよんでるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Today's special. I'm calling everyone in because there's something important to discuss."

strings.text: 「大事な話？　この時期にか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Important discussion? At this time of year?"

strings.text: 「そういう事」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Exactly."

strings.text: 「どっちにしろ、今日は部活に顔を出す予定だった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Either way, I was already planning to drop by club today."

strings.text: 「あ、そうか！　そういえばそろそろ稟ちゃんの油絵も完成に近づいてるからか……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ah, that's right! Come to think of it, Rin-chan's oil painting is nearly finished, isn't it..."

strings.text: 「そういう事だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's the reason..."

strings.text: 「すみません。お手数をおかけしてしまって」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm sorry. I've caused you so much trouble."

strings.text: 「いや、補習が無ければさすがに部活に顔なんか出さない。あくまでもついでだから気にするな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, if there weren't supplementary lessons, I wouldn't have shown up to the club anyway. This is just a stopover, so don't worry about it."

strings.text: 「何かお返しする事が出来れば良いですが」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I wish there were some way I could pay you back."

strings.text: 「あんまり気にする事ないって、稟ちゃんは相変わらず気を遣いすぎよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Don't worry about it. Rin-chan, you always fuss too much."

strings.text: 「そうかな？　実際まこちゃんにもいろいろしてもらったし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You think so? Actually, Mako-chan, you've done a lot for me too..."

strings.text: 「その分いろいろ巻き込んだし、新歓の時とかさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "And I've dragged you into all kinds of things in return -- like the new-member welcome and all that."

strings.text: 「あれは不可抗力だよ。まこちゃんが悪いわけじゃないし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That was unavoidable. It's not your fault, Mako-chan."

strings.text: 稟と鳥谷はあれから、相当仲が良くなった。
strings.translated: Since then, Rin and Toritani had grown quite close.

strings.text: まぁ、稟も鳥谷も人付き合いが良いのだから、当然と言えば当然なのだけど、今ではまるで二人は昔からの付き合いの様だ。
strings.translated: Well, given that both Rin and Toritani are personable, it's only natural, but by now the two of them seem like they've been friends forever.

strings.text: 明石
strings.translated: Akashi

strings.text: 「おー、補習組のご登場か。けっ！　このバカどもがっ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Ohh, the supplementary lessons crew has arrived. Ha! You idiots!"

strings.text: 「痛っ。なぜ殴るっっ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Ow. Why're you hitting me?!"

strings.text: 「あぁ？　なぜだと？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? 'Why', you ask?

strings.text: どう考えても、俺に喧嘩売ってきたのお前だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: However you look at it, you're the one who picked a fight with me."

strings.text: 「ふん！　事実じゃろ。だいたい、ワシは補習なんぞ無しだったぞ。このバカが！」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Hmph! It's the truth, ain't it? Anyway, I didn't have any supplementary lessons. Idiot!"

strings.text: 「まぁ、二回も同じ授業受けてれば補習もないでしょうねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, if you've sat through the same class twice, of course you wouldn't need supplementary lessons..."

strings.text: 優美
strings.translated: Yumi

strings.text: 「野暮用とか言って、やっぱり補習だったんですね。草薙先輩……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "So the 'trivial business' turned out to be supplementary lessons after all, Kusanagi-senpai..."

strings.text: 「それよりも鳥谷先輩。なぜ全員がここに呼ばれたのでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "More importantly, Toritani-senpai. Why has everyone been called here?"

strings.text: 「呼ばれた？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Called?"

strings.text: 里奈
strings.translated: Rina

strings.text: 「なんか今日は大事なお話が鳥谷先輩の方からあるって聞いてましたが？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I was told there was something important Toritani-senpai wanted to discuss with us today?"

strings.text: 「という事で、ワシまで来てやったんじゃ！」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "And that's why I came all this way too!"

strings.text: 「先輩はよんでないです！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I didn't call you, senpai!"

strings.text: 「でも来てやったわい！」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "But I came anyway!"

strings.text: 「そういえば大事な話があるとか言ってたな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, you did say there was something important."

strings.text: トーマス
strings.translated: Thomas

strings.text: 「イエース。大事な部分なお話デース。すごくすごく大事な部分、ナイーブな女性の部分のお話デース」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Yes. It ees a talk about important parts. A very very important part, ze naive parts of a woman."

strings.text: 「アー、目ー目ーアーアーアー」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Aah, my eye-my eye-aa-ah-aah."

strings.text: セクハラ発言をさりげなくかましたトーマスであったが、すぐに気がつかれて川内野の制裁を受ける。
strings.translated: Thomas had casually slipped in a sexual harassment remark, but he was noticed immediately and received Kawachino's punishment.

strings.text: 最近、川内野はアルコール除菌スプレーを持ち歩いている。
strings.translated: Lately, Kawachino has been carrying around a bottle of alcohol disinfectant spray.

strings.text: 使用用途は主にトーマス攻撃になっている。
strings.translated: Its primary use has become attacking Thomas.

strings.text: それはそうと、いろいろと大騒ぎな新勧ではあったが、最終的にこの外人モドキも美術部の新入部員となった。
strings.translated: Be that as it may, though the new-member welcome had been quite the uproar, in the end this pseudo-foreigner became a new member of the art club too.

strings.text: 美術部員としてはトーマスはかなり出席率は高い。
strings.translated: As an art club member, Thomas actually has an unusually high attendance rate.

strings.text: とは言ってもトーマスがこの部活に入って、絵を描いている姿など見たことがない。
strings.translated: That said, since Thomas joined the club, I've never once seen him painting.

strings.text:
こいつは、いつもキャンバスの前で鉛筆を持っている。
そして、その先っぽをしこしこして女子を見つめている……。
strings.translated:
He's always in front of a canvas, holding a pencil.
And stroking the tip of it, over and over, while staring at the girls...

strings.text: 一番早く来て、一番最後までずっと同じ事をしている。
strings.translated: He shows up first and stays till last, doing the very same thing the whole time.

strings.text: 鉛筆の先を、ただひたすらに、しこしこ、しこしこ、しこしこ、しこしこ……。
strings.translated: Just relentlessly stroking the tip of his pencil, stroke, stroke, stroke, stroke...

strings.text: 大半の人間がその隠喩する事が分からないので無反応だが、トーマスの視線が氷川に向かうと、瞬時、川内野によってアルコールが噴霧される。
strings.translated: Most people don't catch the implication, so there's no reaction, but the moment Thomas's gaze turns toward Hikawa, Kawachino instantly sprays him with alcohol.

strings.text: あまりに長くやっているので、中間試験が終わったぐらいから、こいつの意味不明な行為を見かけるたびに俺が殴り倒していた。
strings.translated: Because he's been doing it for so long, ever since around the end of midterms, I've been knocking him down every time I catch him doing that meaningless act.

strings.text: 女を見てる時ばかり殴っていたので、そのうち圭を見てしこしこしだした。
strings.translated: Since I only hit him when he was looking at girls, before long he started stroking his pencil while looking at Kei.

strings.text: もうとりあえず気色悪いしむかつくので、殴りまくった。
strings.translated: It was just too gross and infuriating, so I beat him bloody.

strings.text: だからか、最近は隠れてえんぴつをしこしこしている。
strings.translated: Maybe because of that, lately he's been stroking his pencil in secret.

strings.text: こ　い　つ　を　ど　う　に　か　し　て　く　れ　！
strings.translated: S-o-m-e-b-o-d-y d-o s-o-m-e-t-h-i-n-g a-b-o-u-t t-h-i-s g-u-y!

strings.text: 「とりあえず！　今日は大事な話があるから全員に集まってもらったの！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Anyway! Today I've gathered everyone because there's something important to discuss!"

strings.text: 一同
strings.translated: Everyone

strings.speaker: 一同
strings.translated: """"A training camp?""""

strings.text: 「へぇ、めずらしいなぁ。弓張学園美術部で合宿なんてはじめてじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh, that's unusual. Isn't this the first time the Yumihari Academy art club has ever done a training camp?"

strings.text: 「今年は私が部長だからね。気合いの入り方が違うわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I'm the club president this year, after all. My enthusiasm's on a different level."

strings.text: 「気合いねぇ。甲子園に行くわけじゃあるまいし、なんで合宿なんだよ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Enthusiasm, huh. It's not like we're going to Koshien; why a training camp?

strings.text: だいたい俺たちは三年だぞ。そんな時間もないだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Besides, we're third-years. There's no time for that sort of thing, is there?"

strings.text: 「三年だからするのよ。これが最後の夏でしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's because we're third-years that we're doing it. This is our last summer, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「最後の夏ねぇ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Our last summer, huh."

strings.text: 甲子園じゃあるまいし、普通は夏は受験の天王山とか言わないか？
strings.translated: It's not like we're going to Koshien. Normally, isn't summer supposed to be called the make-or-break moment for entrance exams?

strings.text: 「それでどこで合宿するんですか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "So, where are we doing this training camp?"

strings.text: 「フィレンツェよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Florence."

strings.text: 「私にはそんなお金無いのですが……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I don't have that kind of money..."

strings.text: 「私にもそんなお金はありません」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Nor do I."

strings.text: 「お金じゃないわよ。心が大事なのよ。行きたいって思う心が大事なのっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's not about money. What matters is the heart. The heart that wants to go, that's what matters!"

strings.text: 「心に乗ってヨーロッパはいけないし、心に泊まる事も、心で買い物する事もできないぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You can't ride your heart to Europe, and you can't lodge in your heart, or shop with your heart either."

strings.text: 「かーっ。嫌ねぇ。金、金、金、金って、あんた少しは心を磨きなさいよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ugh. Awful. Money, money, money, money -- how about you polish your heart a little!"

strings.text: 「何だ？　俺が心を磨けば、心でヨーロッパまで移動出来て、心で泊まって、心で買い物も出来るのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's that? If I polish my heart, will I be able to travel to Europe by heart, stay by heart, and shop by heart?"

strings.text: 「そうよ！　鰯の頭も信心からと言うじゃない！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Exactly! They say even a sardine's head can be sacred with enough faith!"

strings.text: 全然ダメな意味だろ。その言葉の使い方じゃ……。
strings.translated: That's a completely wrong usage of the phrase...

strings.text: 「海外なんて、受験が終わったら卒業旅行ででも行けばいい場所だろうが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Overseas is the sort of place you go on a graduation trip once entrance exams are over."

strings.text: 「どだい、なんで合宿なんてするのか意味が分からん。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In the first place, I don't get why we'd do a training camp at all.

strings.text: 集団で絵なんぞ描かなくてもいいだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: There's no need to paint as a group, is there?"

strings.text: 「……私も草薙先輩と同じ意見です」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "...I share Kusanagi-senpai's opinion."

strings.text: 「おっ、珍しく意見が合うな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh, it's rare for us to agree."

strings.text: 川内野はあからさまに嫌そうな顔して舌打ちする。
strings.translated: Kawachino made an openly displeased face and clicked her tongue.

strings.text: いろいろひどい。
strings.translated: In all sorts of terrible ways.

strings.text: 「それぞれが違うジャンルの作品に向かい合っているのに、場所を移動させて合同で生活する意図が分かりません」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Each of us is working on pieces in different genres, so I don't understand the point of moving somewhere else and living together as a group."

strings.text: 「お金もないしね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "And we don't have the money, either."

strings.text: 「お金の問題だけではなく、なぜ作品に打ち込む創作活動を集団行動で行うのか分かりません……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "It's not just a matter of money -- I don't understand why creative activity, of all things, where you throw yourself into a work, needs to be done as a group..."

strings.text: 「そうかな？　あれとかあるじゃん、アルルの芸術家村」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Really? There's stuff like that artists' village in Arles, isn't there?"

strings.text: 「それはうまくいかなかっただろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That didn't work out, though."

strings.text: 「芸術家村？　うまくいかなかったって、誰かそれをやられたのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Artists' village? What do you mean it didn't work out -- someone actually tried it?"

strings.text: 「ああ、ごっほさんという人がいてな、芸術家の集まった村を作ろうとしたんだよ。貧乏な芸術家が多かったからなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, there was this guy called Mister Gogh who tried to make a village where artists gathered together. There were a lot of poor artists, after all."

strings.text: 「それで失敗したんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "And it failed?"

strings.text: 「ごっほさんが自分の耳を切っちゃったりしてみんなびびっちまってご破算になった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Mister Gogh went and cut off his own ear, and everyone freaked out, and the whole thing fell apart."

strings.text: 「あ！　耳切ったって、ごっほさんって、あのヴィンセント・ヴァン・ゴッホの事ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah! Cut off his ear -- Mister Gogh, you mean that Vincent van Gogh?"

strings.text: 「誰の事だと思ったんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who did you think I meant?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、“さん”付けされると、途端に違う人みたいに思えて……ごっほさんってあだ名の……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, when you put '-san' on it, it suddenly sounds like a different person... like it's someone with the nickname 'Mister Gogh'..."

strings.text: 「モンマルトルだってモンパルナスだっていってしまえば芸術家の共同生活の場よ。孤独な芸術活動だからこそ、共同生活が大事なのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Whether you're talking about Montmartre or Montparnasse, those were communal living spaces for artists. It's precisely because artistic activity is solitary that communal living matters."

strings.text: 「そんなもんでしょうか……理解しがたいです」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Is that really so...? It's hard for me to understand."

strings.text: 「……合宿デスか……」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "...A training camp, ees eet..."

strings.text: 「なんだ？　トーマス？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What is it, Thomas?"

strings.text: 「合宿する場所、それなりに心当たりがありましてデスなー」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "As for a place for ze camp, I have a suitable idea in mind, yes."

strings.text: 「却下！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Rejected!"

strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Why!?"

strings.text: 「あんたの提案なんて恐ろしくて乗れないわよ。また何を企んでるか分かったもんじゃない！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Anything you propose is too terrifying to go along with. Who knows what you're scheming this time!"

strings.text: 「まぁ、懸命な判断だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, that's a wise call."

strings.text: 「ワイはフランス人やで、それこそこてこてのフランスっ子どす。
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "But I am French, ze true French born and bred.

strings.text: モンマルトルかてモンパルナスかて、それこそアルルかてフランスやで！
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: Montmartre, Montparnasse, and Arles too, all of them are France!

strings.text: それをあんたら！　何故否定するんデスか！」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: And you people -- why do you deny it?!"

strings.text: フランスどころか、お前の言語はどこの地域のものだ。
strings.translated: Never mind France, what region does your language even come from?

strings.text: 「んじゃ、あんたが私達をフランスに連れて行ってくれるのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So then, are you going to take us to France yourself?"

strings.text: 「クルーズ旅行になるかて？」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "It'll be a cruise trip, how about that?"

strings.text: 「クルーズ？　お前が船を？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A cruise? You, with a ship?"

strings.text: 「あい」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Yep."

strings.text: トーマスはごそごそと鞄をあさる。
strings.translated: Thomas started rummaging through his bag.

strings.text: 「イエス！　イエス！　イエス！　イエース！」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Yes! Yes! Yes! Yeees!"

strings.text: この似非外人は本当に上下運動が好きだなぁ……。
strings.translated: This pseudo-foreigner really does love an up-and-down motion...

strings.text: 一生懸命、空気入れを上下させている。
strings.translated: He was pumping the air pump up and down with all his might.

strings.text: 「クルーズって……。この前自慢げに広げてたゴムボートじゃないでしょうねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "By cruise you mean... not that rubber boat you were bragging about spreading out the other day, right?"

strings.text: 「はっ？　トリタニはゴム無しが好き！？　 そういうコト」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Huh? Toritani likes it without ze rubber!? So zat's how it ees."

strings.text: 「そんな事は言ってねぇ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I never said anything of the sort!"

strings.text: 「あうちっ！」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Ouchie!"

strings.text: 「見事な上段蹴りだが、そんな足あげてるとパンツ見えるぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A magnificent high kick, but if you're going to raise your leg like that, your panties are going to show..."

strings.text: 「見ないでよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Don't look!"

strings.text: 知らんがな。
strings.translated: Not my problem.

strings.text: 「冗談はここまでにして、それで？　何かしら考えがあっての事じゃろ？　どうなんじゃ鳥谷」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Enough joking around. So? You've got some plan in mind, don't you? What's the deal, Toritani?"

strings.text: 「考えってほどじゃないんですけど……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, it's not really a 'plan'..."

strings.text: 「実は私の父の実家が、島根県でして」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Actually, my father's hometown is in Shimane Prefecture."

strings.text: 「島根？　出雲大社がある場所か？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Shimane? The place where Izumo Taisha is?"

strings.text: 「出雲市ではないのですが……、もっと無名な過疎化した所なんですけど、空気が綺麗な場所です。海もすぐ近くにありますし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's not in Izumo City... it's a much more obscure, depopulated area, but the air is clean. And the sea is right nearby, too."

strings.text: 「それで？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "And?"

strings.text: 「そこで合宿するのはどうかと思いまして、私からまこちゃんに提案したんです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I thought we could do the training camp there, so I proposed it to Mako-chan."

strings.text: 「稟の父親の実家か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin's father's hometown, huh..."

strings.text: 「稟先輩のお言葉を否定する様な事はしたくないのですが……どちらにしても宿代とかかかりますよね。これだけの人数を稟先輩の実家に泊まらせるというわけにもいかないでしょうし」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I don't want to reject what Rin-senpai is saying, but... either way, there will be lodging costs, won't there. And we can't very well have this many people stay at Rin-senpai's family home."

strings.text: 「あ、それなら大丈夫だよ。前に教会だった場所が今は寄合所になってて、その場所ならば事前に知らせておけば宿として使えるんだって」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, that's fine. There's a place that used to be a church, and now it's used as a community hall. If we let them know in advance, we can use it as lodging."

strings.text: 「教会だった場所が寄合所ねぇ。変な場所だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A former church now used as a community hall, huh. Strange place."

strings.text: 「それと、移動費……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "And also, the transportation costs..."

strings.text: 「そんなの１日乗り放題の青○１８きっぷよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "For that, we've got the all-day unlimited Seish*n 18 ticket!"

strings.text: 「ここから島根県まで普通列車ですか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "You mean local trains from here all the way to Shimane?"

strings.text: 「調べたけど、１６時間ほどで着くわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I looked it up. It'll take about sixteen hours."

strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Sixteen hours... I don't even have words."

strings.text: 「でもみんな一緒ならそんな移動も楽しいかも。それに合宿先には海もあるし山もあるし、そうそう向日葵畑が綺麗なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But if everyone's together, even a trip like that could be fun. And where we're staying, there's a sea and mountains, and oh yes, there's a beautiful sunflower field."

strings.text: 「うぬる！　稟先輩がおっしゃるのならば……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Ngh! Well, if Rin-senpai says so..."

strings.text: 「向日葵か。そういえば向日葵畑とか見た事ないな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sunflowers, huh. Come to think of it, I've never seen a sunflower field."

strings.text: 「そうだな。向日葵ならその辺に生えてるけど、向日葵畑ってあんまり見ないよな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah. Sunflowers grow all over the place, but you don't often see a whole field of them."

strings.text: 「向日葵に囲まれたのどかな田舎なんて、美術部の合宿にうってつけだと思うのだけど？　どうかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "A peaceful countryside surrounded by sunflowers -- doesn't that sound perfect for an art club training camp? What do you think?"

strings.text: 「最初のフィレンツェって前振りは何だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then what was that whole Florence lead-in for?"

strings.text: 「私が単に行ってみたい場所を言っただけよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I was just saying a place I'd like to visit, that's all."

strings.text: それだけかよ、まぎらわしいなぁ。
strings.translated: That was all? So misleading.

strings.text: 「まぁ、いいのではないか。自然の中で合宿！　我が美術部にふさわしい舞台じゃな」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Well, isn't that fine? A training camp in nature! A stage befitting our art club, indeed."

strings.text: 「先輩も来るのでしょうか……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Is senpai going to come too...?"

strings.text: 「何じゃ、そのあからさまな不快感は？
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "What's with that blatant look of displeasure?

strings.text: だが安心しろ、ワシは用事があるので、合宿とやらにつきあう事は出来ん」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: But rest easy -- I have other business, so I won't be able to accompany you on this camp of yours."

strings.text: 「あれ？　明石先輩は来ないのですか？　こういう事、一番喜んで参加するタイプだと思っていましたが」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Huh? Akashi-senpai isn't coming? I would have thought you'd be the type to jump at something like this."

strings.text: 「一番ならアレがいるじゃろ？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "If we're talking about the type to jump at it, there's already that guy, isn't there?"

strings.text: 「イエース！　合宿！　合宿と合体は少し似ていて、少しチガウ！」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Yeees! Training camp! Training camp and coupling are a little alike, and a little different!"

strings.text: 「イエース！　合体！」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Yeees! Coupling!"

strings.text: まったく意味不明な事を言いながら、似非外人は大はしゃぎだ。
strings.translated: Spouting utter nonsense, the pseudo-foreigner was in high spirits.

strings.text: 「私も一度は自然の中で絵を描いてみたいと思ってました。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I've always wanted to try painting outdoors, in nature, at least once.

strings.text: アトリエを出て、自然の中で、まるで印象派の画家みたいに……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Leaving the atelier, out in nature, just like the Impressionist painters..."

strings.text: 「！？　外で絵をカク！？
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "!? Painting outside!?

strings.text: イエース、それもう一度……言ってくださーい」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: Yees, please say zat one more... time."

strings.text: トーマスが勢いよく立ち上がる。
strings.translated: Thomas sprang to his feet.

strings.text: これ、もう殴っておいた方がいいのだろうか……。
strings.translated: Maybe I should just deck him now to be safe...

strings.text: どうせろくな事にならないだろうし……。
strings.translated: Nothing good is going to come of this anyway...

strings.text: 「カク言うーてください！」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Please say 'painting' again!"

strings.text: 「え？　そ、外で描く？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? P-painting outside?"

strings.text: 「そ、外でかく……イ、イエース。
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "P-painting outside... y-yees.

strings.text: 私は外でカキます。カキまくります。と言ってくださアウチ」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: I will do it outside. I will do it and do it. Say those words -- ouchie."

strings.text: 「死ね」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Die."

strings.text: 「え？　ど、どうしたの？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? W-what's wrong?"

strings.text: 「いや、何でもない、話を続けてくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it's nothing. Please, continue."

strings.text: 「稟先輩、アトリエを出て絵描くのと、印象派の画家って関係があるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Rin-senpai, is there some connection between leaving the atelier to paint and the Impressionist painters?"

strings.text: 「え、えっと……それはですねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh, um... well, that's..."

strings.text: 「ふふふ、印象派の成立にはチューブ入り絵の具の発明が深く関わっているの。この意味分かるかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Fufufu. The establishment of Impressionism is deeply tied to the invention of paint in tubes. Do you understand what this means?"

strings.text: 「チューブ入りの絵の具の発明？　それって、印象派以前はチューブ入りの絵の具ではないものを使ってたという事ですよね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "The invention of paint in tubes? So before Impressionism, they were using something other than tube paint, right?"

strings.text: 「そう。チューブ入りの絵の具は19世紀に入ってから、それ以前はアトリエで顔料と乾性油などを練成して絵の具を作っていたらしいわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Exactly. Paint in tubes only appeared in the 19th century. Before that, artists apparently made their own paints in the atelier by mixing pigments with drying oils and the like."

strings.text: 「なるほど、チューブで絵の具を外に持ち出せる様になった事、外でそのまま絵を描く事が印象派の成立に関係しているというわけですか」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I see -- so being able to carry paint outside in tubes, and thus being able to paint outdoors on the spot, is what tied into the establishment of Impressionism, is that it?"

strings.text: 「半分正解。でも理由はそれだけじゃないの。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Half right. But that's not the only reason.

strings.text: もう一つ大きな理由としては、写真の発明ね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Another major reason is the invention of photography."

strings.text: 「それ以外にも、チューブ絵の具の登場で写実的な技法が没個性化してしまった事があげられるわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Beyond that, the arrival of tube paint stripped realist techniques of their individuality."

strings.text: 「チューブ絵の具発明以前というのは、顔料と乾性油というのは練成自体がそれぞれの工房の秘伝の技だったわけ、それがチューブ入りで全部同じになったわけだからさ。そりゃ没個性にもなるわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Before tube paint was invented, the mixing of pigment and drying oil was a secret art unique to each workshop. But with tubes, everything became the same. Of course individuality was lost."

strings.text: 「発明が一つの芸術運動を生んだという事ですか……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "So an invention gave birth to an entire art movement..."

strings.text: 「そういう事、チューブ入りの絵の具と写真の発明が芸術の流れを変えた」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. The invention of paint in tubes and photography changed the flow of art."

strings.text: 「なるほど、チューブ入り絵の具と写真ですか。
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I see, tube paint and photography, huh.

strings.text: たしかに、写真が発明されたら、正確に描写するという意味での絵の価値は低くなりますよね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: It's true, once photography was invented, the value of painting in the sense of accurate depiction dropped."

strings.text: 「そうね。実際、写真の登場で多くの写実主義の画家が職にあぶれたというし」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. In fact, with the arrival of photography, many realist painters lost their livelihoods."

strings.text: 「そうなんだ。印象派のあの荒々しい筆使いってそういう意味があったんですね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I see. So the rough, wild brushwork of the Impressionists had that kind of meaning behind it."

strings.text: 「自然の中で、瞬間、瞬間、目で見えたそのものをキャンバスに刻み込んでいく様に……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Out in nature, moment by moment, etching whatever the eye beholds straight onto the canvas..."

strings.text: 「って草薙くんからの受け売りで言ってるだけなんですけどね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "...is what I'm saying, but I'm just parroting what Kusanagi-kun told me."

strings.text: 「そんな事だと思った。質問されて稟ちゃん少し焦ってたから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I thought as much. Rin-chan was starting to look a little panicked when she got asked."

strings.text: 「あはは、さすが部長。良く人を見てますね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahaha, as expected of the club president. You really do watch people."

strings.text: 「どちらにしても、自然が多い田舎で絵を描くのも悪くないじゃろ。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "In any case, painting in the countryside surrounded by nature isn't a bad idea.

strings.text: 特にみんなで行けるのなら行った方がいい、川内野が嫌なのなら、女子だけの参加でもいいではないか」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: Especially if everyone can go, you should. If Kawachino doesn't want to, an all-girls trip would work too."

strings.text: 「俺も行きたいぞ！　なぁ直哉！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I want to go too! Right, Naoya!"

strings.text: 「なんで俺もなんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why me too?"

strings.text: 「行けるのなら行っておいた方がいいぞ。お前も今年で卒業じゃろ。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "If you can go, you should. This is your graduation year, isn't it?

strings.text: 全員が集まって何かするなんて、もう何回もない」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: Chances for everyone to gather and do something together aren't going to come around many more times."

strings.text: 「お前みたいに、もう一年いるって手もあるぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I could always do like you and stick around another year."

strings.text: 「だとしても、級友は全員卒業しておる。あれはなかなか堪える。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Even so, all your classmates will have graduated. That hits harder than you'd think.

strings.text: 最後の三年は一回しかない。お前にとってはそれが今年だ」
strings.speaker: 明石
