strings.translated: Your real third year only comes once. For you, that year is this one."

strings.text: なんか、嫌味を言ったのにまともにかえされた。
strings.translated: Somehow, my snide remark got answered in earnest.

strings.text: 「外で、外で、外で、カク、カク、カク、シャセイ、シャセイ、シャセイ、シャセイ、シャセイ、シャセイ、シャセイ、シャセイ、外でシャセイ、んーんーヤ、ヤラシイー、んーんーヤラシー外でシャセイィィ」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Outside, outside, outside, drawing, drawing, drawing, sketching, sketching, sketching, sketching, sketching, sketching, sketching, sketching, sketching outside, mmm mmm naughty, naughty, mmm mmm naughty sketching outsiiide."

strings.text: 殴られて倒れていたトーマスが地面でくねくねしている。
strings.translated: Thomas, who'd been knocked down and left lying there, was squirming on the ground.

strings.text: んーんーんーヤラシーんー
strings.translated: Mmm, mmm, mmm, naughtyy, mmm

strings.text: 稟ちゃんが、真琴ちゃんが、里奈ちゃんが……」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: Rin-chan, Makoto-chan, Rina-chan..."

strings.text: 氷川の名が出た瞬間、豪快にトーマスを踏みつける川内野。
strings.translated: The instant Hikawa's name came up, Kawachino stomped Thomas thoroughly.

strings.text: 「んっ！」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Nngh!"

strings.text: 「んーんーんーっっっ……びくっ、びくっ、びくっっぅぅぅ……」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Nnn, nnn, nnnn... twitch, twitch, twitch, twiiitch..."

strings.text: 川内野が踏みつけた瞬間、打ち上げられた魚の様にびくびくするトーマス。
strings.translated: The moment Kawachino stomped him, Thomas started twitching like a fish washed up on shore.

strings.text: めずらしく川内野が怯んだ。
strings.translated: Unusually, Kawachino recoiled.

strings.text: そりゃ怯みもするだろう。
strings.translated: Well, of course she would.

strings.text: この変態。川内野に踏みつけられた瞬間に、果てたのだから……。
strings.translated: This pervert. The moment Kawachino stomped him, he'd finished...

strings.text: 性的に……。
strings.translated: Sexually...

strings.text: どんだけ頭の中がエロで出来てるんだ……この外人もどき……。
strings.translated: Just how much of this guy's head is made of lewdness... this pseudo-foreigner...

strings.text: 「あ、あの……こ、これ……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "U-um... th-this..."

strings.text: すごく不安そうに俺を見つめる川内野。
strings.translated: Kawachino was staring at me with a terribly uneasy expression.

strings.text: こんな顔の川内野など見た事がない。
strings.translated: I'd never seen Kawachino make a face like that before.

strings.text: 俺はとりあえずうなずいておく。
strings.translated: For now, I gave her a nod.

strings.text: 「これの後始末は俺がしておく、安心しろ……女が触ると妊娠しかねないからな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'll clean up after this thing. Don't worry... if a woman touched it, she might get pregnant, after all..."

strings.text: 「あ、ありがとうございます……。
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Th-thank you very much...

strings.text: と、とりあえず、今回はご厚意に甘えます……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: F-for now, I'll take you up on your kindness..."

strings.text: 「どうした？　何かあったの？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "What's wrong? Did something happen?"

strings.text: 「な、何でもないっ。里奈は気にしなくて良いから！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "N-nothing. You don't need to worry about it, Rina!"

strings.text: 「気にするな、何か漏れただけだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't mind it, something just leaked out is all..."

strings.text: 「漏らしたのですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "He wet himself?"

strings.text: 「そうだな。そんなところだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. Something like that..."

strings.text: 俺は雑巾を持ってくる。
strings.translated: I went to fetch a rag.

strings.text: その後、簡単な日取りを決めた様だ。
strings.translated: Afterward, it seemed they roughly settled on the dates.

strings.text: 俺は行く気が無いので関係ないのだが、
strings.translated: I had no intention of going, so it didn't concern me, but

strings.text: 何故か圭と俺の補習が終わってからの日取りという事になってしまった。
strings.translated: for some reason the dates ended up being set for after Kei's and my supplementary lessons ended.

strings.text: 何度も言うが行く気はない。
strings.translated: I'll say it again: I have no intention of going.

strings.text: 稟の絵を久しぶりに見てやる。
strings.translated: It had been a while since I'd properly looked at Rin's painting.

strings.text: 実際、試験があり、試験休みがあり、ここのところ絵を描く時間も無かった。
strings.translated: Between exams and the exam break, I hadn't had time to paint lately.

strings.text: だいたい、本来ならば、この時期は受験勉強をがっつりしなければならない。
strings.translated: Which is to say, by rights, this is the season I should be cramming hard for entrance exams.

strings.text: 夏こそ、受験の天王山だ。
strings.translated: Summer is the make-or-break period for exam prep.

strings.text: 稟や鳥谷の様に、一年生の頃からこつこつと勉強している様な連中なら問題ないが、俺の様に今日の今日まで遊び続けてきた様な輩が遊んでいて良い時期ではない。
strings.translated: It's not a problem for people like Rin or Toritani, who've been studying diligently since their first year, but for someone like me who's been playing around right up until today, this is no time to be goofing off.

strings.text: ではあるが、相変わらず遊び続けている。
strings.translated: And yet, I'm goofing off as ever.

strings.text: まぁ、それでも今年になってからはそれなりには勉強している。
strings.translated: Well, at least this year I've been studying to some degree.

strings.text: あくまでも前に比べてといったぐらいでしか無いが……。
strings.translated: Only relatively speaking, compared to before, though...

strings.text: 「ん……んん……あれ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hm... hnn... huh?"

strings.text: 描きづらそうにキャンバスと格闘している。
strings.translated: She was wrestling with the canvas, having a hard time painting.

strings.text: 「何してるんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you doing?"

strings.text: 「あ、ここの部分を塗り直したいなぁ、と思ったんだけど、なんか完全に固まってしまって……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, I was thinking I wanted to repaint this section, but it's completely hardened somehow..."

strings.text: 「なるほど」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see."

strings.text: 油絵は結構乾きが遅い。
strings.translated: Oil paint takes quite a while to dry.

strings.text: キャンバス上で完全に乾くのには数日の時間を必要とする。
strings.translated: Fully drying on the canvas takes a few days.

strings.text: 試験前まで毎日のように描いていた稟であるが、試験前、そして試験休み、今日に至るまで結構、絵を放置する事が多かった。
strings.translated: Rin had been painting almost daily until the exams, but from before the exams, through the exam break, up until today, she'd left the painting sitting for a good while.

strings.text: 場所によってはすでに完全に固まっている様だった。
strings.translated: In some spots it seemed to have already hardened completely.

strings.text: 「この部分、完全に剥離する形になるがいいか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This section is going to have to be stripped off entirely. That okay?"

strings.text: 「あ、はい」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, right."

strings.text: 「分かった。俺が固まった部分をとってやる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Got it. I'll take care of removing the hardened part."

strings.text: 俺は剥離剤を手にする。
strings.translated: I picked up the paint stripper.

strings.text: テレピン油で溶けない様な絵の具はこれで落とすにかぎる。
strings.translated: For paint that won't dissolve in turpentine, this is the best way to get it off.

strings.text: 「これで……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "With this..."

strings.text: 剥離剤を塗った後、俺は雑巾でその部分を拭き取る。
strings.translated: After applying the stripper, I wiped the section with a rag.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hm?"

strings.text: 「なんだこれ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is this?"

strings.text: 「なんか、微妙に落ちてませんね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's not really coming off, is it?"

strings.text: 「どうなってるんだ？　普通なら剥離剤で簡単に落ちるはずなのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's going on here? Normally the stripper takes it off easily..."

strings.text: 俺は何度か剥離剤を用いて絵の具の固まりを溶かそうとするが、なかなか落ちない。
strings.translated: I tried the stripper a few more times to dissolve the hardened paint, but it wasn't budging.

strings.text: 「んー」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hmm."

strings.text: 剥離剤で落ちないなんて無いんだけどなぁ。
strings.translated: Paint not coming off with stripper -- that shouldn't happen.

strings.text: この絵の具、変な成分入ってるんじゃないか？
strings.translated: Doesn't this paint have some weird ingredient in it?

strings.text: 「稟、お前、この絵の具どこで買った？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin, where'd you buy this paint?"

strings.text: 「え？　あ、あの、草薙くんがくれたやつで……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Um, it was the paint Kusanagi-kun gave me..."

strings.text: ああ、俺が適当に美術室に放置されていた絵の具を集めたやつか。
strings.translated: Ah, right, that was the paint I'd cobbled together from what had been left lying around the art room.

strings.text: 素性もまったく分からない、あべこべの絵の具の詰め合わせでこいつは描いていたのか（俺のせいだが……）。
strings.translated: So she'd been painting with an odd assortment of paints of completely unknown origin (my fault, though...).

strings.text: 「うむ……分かった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Right... got it."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、その部分は気にせずにそのまま仕上げろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For now, don't worry about that section. Just finish the piece as is."

strings.text: 「え？　ちゅ、中途半端に溶けて、でこぼこになってるよ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? B-but it's half-dissolved and gone all bumpy..."

strings.text: 「ああ、問題ない。今日はその部分には触れるな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no problem. Just don't touch that section today.

strings.text: 後でどうにかしてやるから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I'll figure something out later."

strings.text: 「うん……分かった。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Okay... got it.

strings.text: とりあえず続きを描いてみるね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: For now I'll try to keep working on the rest."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 稟はふたたび筆を取る。
strings.translated: Rin picked up her brush again.

strings.text: 「へぇ、絵の具使う姿もだいぶ様になってきたじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Heh, you've really started to look the part with paints, haven't you?"

strings.text: 「そ、そうかなぁ？　でもね、絵は全然なんですけどね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "R-really? But my painting isn't up to anything, though."

strings.text: 「そう？　わりかし筋良いんじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You think? Seems like you've got a pretty decent knack for it."

strings.text: 「まこちゃんにそう言ってもらえると、うれしいかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hearing that from Mako-chan makes me happy, I guess..."

strings.text: 「どうしたの草薙？　難しい顔して？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What's up, Kusanagi? Making a difficult face like that?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、鳥谷にも稟の絵はわりかし筋良いレベルに見えるんだなぁ……と」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's just... to Toritani too, Rin's painting looks like it's at a 'pretty decent knack' level, huh..."

strings.text: 「うん、そうだけど、違うの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yeah, it does. That's not right?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、その通りなんだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's exactly right, but..."

strings.text: “わりかし筋が良い”
strings.translated: "A pretty decent knack."

strings.text: たしかにその通りなのだけど……違和感もある。
strings.translated: It certainly was as she said... but something felt off.

strings.text: その違和感が何に起因しているものなのか分からないが……。
strings.translated: I couldn't pin down what was causing that sense of unease...

strings.text: ただ、俺が「そう聞かされた」からなのだろうか？
strings.translated: Or was it just because I'd been "told so"?

strings.text: 「草薙先輩、少しよろしいでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-senpai, could I have a moment?"

strings.text: 「ああ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、稟以外にも教えなきゃいかんので、また後でな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For now, I've got to teach people besides Rin, so later."

strings.text: 「いや、別にこれ以上広がる会話でもないけど……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, this isn't really a conversation that'd go anywhere from here anyway..."

strings.text: 「そうだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 「さてと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "All right then..."

strings.text: 時計を見る。
strings.translated: I checked the clock.

strings.text: この辺りが切り上げ時だろう。
strings.translated: This was about time to wrap up.

strings.text: 「終わりですかね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Are we done for the day?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そろそろ帰りの時間だ。夕食も作らなきゃならないしな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's about time to head home. I've got to make dinner too."

strings.text: 「夕食……ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Dinner...?"

strings.text: 「ああ、夏目家に厄介になっているんでな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I'm imposing on the Natsume household these days.

strings.text: 居候の身、料理ぐらいしなければ肩身が狭い」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: As a freeloader, cooking at the very least keeps me from feeling out of place."

strings.text: 「まぁ、そんな気にする事じゃないんだけどな。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, it's not really something you need to worry about.

strings.text: でも直哉の料理はすごくおいしいので助かっているぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: But Naoya's cooking is really good, so it's a big help."

strings.text: 「そんなこんなで帰宅の時間だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And with all that, it's time to head home."

strings.text: 「そうね。そろそろ上がりでいいんじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. About time to call it a day."

strings.text: 「そうだな。そろそろ帰るか」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah. Shall we head back?"

strings.text: 「そうだ！　たまにはみんなで帰るってどうかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh! How about we all go home together for once?"

strings.text: 「たまにはいいな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Once in a while's nice."

strings.text: 「でも私達は電車が逆方向ですけど」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "But our trains go the opposite direction."

strings.text: 「でも、駅までは同じ方向じゃないですか。良かったらどうかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But we're going the same way to the station, aren't we? If it's okay, how about it?"

strings.text: 「どうでしょうかねぇ。どうする里奈？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "How about it, I wonder. What'll you do, Rina?"

strings.text: 「うん、それがいいと思うよ。みんなで帰るって言うのもなかなか新鮮じゃない」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Yeah, I think that'd be nice. Going home together is kind of a fresh change, isn't it?"

strings.text: 桜ヶ原駅のホームから電車が出る。
strings.translated: The train pulled out of the Sakuragahara station platform.

strings.text: もちろん、逆方向の川内野と氷川の姿はすでに無い。
strings.translated: Of course, Kawachino and Hikawa, who went the opposite way, were already gone.

strings.text: 電車に乗ったのは俺と稟と鳥谷、そしてめずらしく圭。
strings.translated: On the train were me, Rin, Toritani, and unusually, Kei.

strings.text: 圭のバイクは絶賛絶不調らしく、今日は電車らしい。
strings.translated: Kei's bike was apparently in top-tier terrible shape, so today it was the train.

strings.text: 「今日のメシは何かなぁ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What's for dinner today, I wonder?"

strings.text: 「ああ、豚肉の肉じゃがとか考えてるんだが、どうだろうか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, I was thinking nikujaga with pork -- what do you think?"

strings.text: 「いいな！　豚の肉じゃが！　いいぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Sweet! Pork nikujaga! Nice."

strings.text: 「ふーん。豚肉の肉じゃがって言ってるって事は、牛の肉じゃがの時もあるの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh. If you're specifying pork nikujaga, does that mean sometimes you make it with beef?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな。基本的に牛と豚の違いは生姜を入れるか入れないかの差ぐらいだが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Basically the only difference between beef and pork is whether you put ginger in or not."

strings.text: 「肉じゃがってさ、それぞれの家庭で決まった具材があるって言うじゃない。ウチは豚だ！　牛だ！　とか」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "They say every household has its own set ingredients for nikujaga, right? Like, ours is pork! Ours is beef!"

strings.text: 「そうなのか？　どっちも違う味でおいしいのに、もったいない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really? They both taste different and good in their own way -- seems like a waste to pick just one."

strings.text: 「どっちも違って、どっちも良いだな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Each one different, each one fine, huh."

strings.text: 「草薙って料理得意なんだよね。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kusanagi, you're good at cooking, right?

strings.text: やっぱり、男の料理的な豪勢なヤツとか作っちゃったりするの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: So do you make those kinda lavish 'man's cooking' type dishes and all?"

strings.text: 「男の料理的？　豪勢なヤツ？　なんだそりゃ？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Man's cooking'? Lavish? What's that supposed to mean?

strings.text: 普通、男の料理っておおざっぱって意味じゃないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Normally doesn't 'man's cooking' mean rough and slapdash?"

strings.text: 「いやいや、それは昔の話よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Nope, nope, that's an old-fashioned idea."

strings.text: 「最近は趣味で料理する男も増えたじゃない？　そうするとあり得ないぐらい調味料を揃えて、あり得ないぐらい凝った料理を作るんだってさ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Lately there are more men who cook as a hobby, right? And apparently they collect ridiculous amounts of seasonings and make ridiculously elaborate dishes.

strings.text: まぁ雑誌の受け売りなんだけどさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Well, I'm just parroting a magazine."

strings.text: 「そういうのは料理が趣味なヤツだろ。俺は趣味じゃない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That sort of thing's for people whose hobby is cooking. It's not my hobby.

strings.text: 自炊が長いだけだから、凝ったものは作れない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I've just been cooking for myself a long time, so I can't make elaborate stuff."

strings.text: 「でもパテとか作れるじゃん」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But you can make pate and stuff, right?"

strings.text: 「だってレバが安いんだもん。ずっとレバニラとか飽きるだろ？　だったらすりつぶしてパテにもする」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because liver's cheap. You'd get sick of eating leek-and-liver stir-fry all the time, right? So I mash it up and turn it into pate too."

strings.text: 「なんと言ってもガーリックパンの耳との相性が抜群だ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "More than anything, it goes brilliantly with garlic bread crusts.

strings.text: 米が買えない時に重宝するのが鶏レバのパテだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Chicken liver pate is a lifesaver when you can't afford rice."

strings.text: 「なんかパテという優雅な響きと真逆な発想ね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's kind of the exact opposite of the elegant image the word 'pate' conjures up."

strings.text: 「そう言えば、パテとかウチに来てから作ってないな。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Now that you mention it, you haven't made pate since coming to my place.

strings.text: なんか和食っぽいのが増えた」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: There's been more Japanese-style stuff."

strings.text: 「米があるからな。パンの耳との相性を考えなくて良いなら自然と和食になる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because there's rice. If you don't have to think about pairing with bread crusts, it naturally becomes Japanese food."

strings.text: 「そういうもんなの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Is that how it works?"

strings.text: 「ああ、単に今まで俺が食べられなかったからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's just that I couldn't eat it much before."

strings.text: 「でも、和食って結構難しいですよね。煮物とか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But Japanese cooking is pretty difficult, isn't it? Like simmered dishes?"

strings.text: 「煮物が難しいって良く言われるが、俺は実感として分からん。俺は揚げ物の方がよっぽど難しいと思う」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "People often say simmered dishes are hard, but I don't really feel that. I think deep-frying is way harder."

strings.text: 「ああ、分かるわ。貧乏だと揚げ物って、豪勢に油使うのためらって失敗するわよね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ah, I get that. When you're broke, you hesitate to use the oil lavishly for deep-frying and mess it up."

strings.text: 「あと一人暮らしだと、揚げ物は外食の方が絶対コスパが良いんだよ。だから絶対的に経験数が少ない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Also, when you live alone, eating out is definitely more cost-effective for fried food. So I've got very little experience with it."

strings.text: 「でも、結構揚げ物も作ってくれるじゃないか」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But you make quite a lot of fried food too, don't you?"

strings.text: 「それも俺が食いたいからだ。一人暮らしじゃ油がもったいなくてあまり出来なかったからな。大人数になったので揚げ物もやりほうだいだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's because I want to eat it. Living alone, oil felt like a waste and I couldn't do it much. Now that there's a bunch of people, I can fry to my heart's content."

strings.text: 「そうだったのか。でも苦手だと知らなかったぞ。普通に旨いし」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "So that's how it was. But I never knew you weren't good at it. It tastes plenty good."

strings.text: 「最近は良い揚げ粉が多いんだよ。唐揚げとかサクッと揚がるやつ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There are a lot of good frying mixes these days. Karaage powder that fries up nice and crispy.

strings.text: あと天ぷらの衣には水の代わりに炭酸水を使うとわりかしごまかしがきく事を最近知った」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Also, I recently learned that using carbonated water instead of regular water for tempura batter covers up a lot."

strings.text: 「それって、揚げ物も上手に作れるって事じゃないかなぁ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Doesn't that mean you're good at fried food too?"

strings.text: 「いやいや、天ぷらの衣に炭酸水使ったり、唐揚げに唐揚げの粉使うヤツは上手いとは言わないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, a guy who uses carbonated water for tempura batter and karaage powder for karaage doesn't count as being good."

strings.text: 「そうかなぁ。食べる人がおいしいって事が一番大事だと思うんだけど」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really? I think the most important thing is that it tastes good to the person eating it."

strings.text: 「ふーん、天ぷらに炭酸水か、今度やってみよう。他に何かないの？　煮物のコツは？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh, carbonated water for tempura? I'll try that next time. Anything else? Any tips for simmered dishes?"

strings.text: 「別に特別な事なんてしてねぇよ。“さしすせそ”の基礎と、甘露煮でもない場合、魚は長く煮ない。煮立った状態で強火でなるべく素早く火を通す。まぁこれも基本だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't do anything special. Just the 'sa-shi-su-se-so' basics, and unless it's kanroni, don't simmer fish for long. Once it's boiling, get it cooked through as quickly as possible on high heat. Well, that's basic stuff too."

strings.text: 「なんだ“さしすせそ”の基礎って？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What's this 'sa-shi-su-se-so' basics?"

strings.text: 「調味料を入れる順番よ。“さ”は砂糖、“し”は塩、“す”は酢、“せ”は醤油、“そ”は……なんだっけ？　ソース？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The order you add seasonings. 'Sa' is sugar, 'shi' is salt, 'su' is vinegar, 'se' is soy sauce, and 'so' is... what was it? Sauce?"

strings.text: 「味噌だと思いますよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's miso, I think."

strings.text: 「なんでいきなり最後にソース入れるんだよ。味めちゃくちゃだろ。それ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why would you throw sauce in at the very end all of a sudden? That would wreck the flavor completely."

strings.text: 「だって、別に煮物に味噌いれないでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, you don't really put miso in simmered dishes, do you?"

strings.text: 「煮物は入れないが、入れる料理だってあるだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Not in simmered dishes, but there are dishes you do put it in."

strings.text: 「まぁ、でも基本的には砂糖と塩の順番だけが重要みたいだよ。あとはケースバイケースで良いんだって」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, but apparently only the order of sugar and salt is really important. The rest is case by case."

strings.text: 「そうなのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so?"

strings.text: 「そうだね。とは言っても聞きかじりなんだけどね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Right. Though I'm just repeating what I've heard."

strings.text: 「なんでも、砂糖は塩よりも遙かに大きい分子なので、逆にしてしまうと味が染み込みにくいらしいんだよ。あと塩って素材を固くしてしまうので、甘みが染みこまないという話もあったりして……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Apparently sugar molecules are way bigger than salt molecules, so if you reverse them the flavor doesn't soak in well. Also, salt hardens the ingredients, so sweetness doesn't penetrate afterward, or something like that..."

strings.text: 「へぇ、詳しいんだ。なんか稟ちゃんとかも料理上手そう」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wow, you know your stuff. Rin-chan, you seem like you'd be good at cooking too."

strings.text: 「あ、そんな事ないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, that's not really true."

strings.text: 「でも作るんでしょ？　お弁当とかいつも自作じゃない？　あの結構大きな重箱みたいなやつ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But you do cook, right? You always make your own bento, don't you? Those fairly big jubako-style ones."

strings.text: 「そうだねぇ。たしかにそうだけど、うーん、でもだいたい草薙くんと同じ様な感じだから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's true. That's certainly the case, but hmm, mostly it's about the same as Kusanagi-kun..."

strings.text: 「直哉と同じ？　何だそれ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Same as Naoya? What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「私も自炊しているといいますか……その……なんと言いますか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I mean, I also cook for myself... um... how should I put it..."

strings.text: 「どうしたの？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What's wrong?"

strings.text: 「一人暮らしなので、自分で料理しないといけないので……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Since I live alone, I have to cook for myself..."

strings.text: 「え？　何で？　三年になってわざわざ弓張に引っ越してるのに、何で一人で暮らしてるの？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? Why? You went to the trouble of moving to Yumihari for third year, so why are you living alone?"

strings.text: 「ふーん。だったら稟ちゃんも料理は相当な腕じゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh. Then Rin-chan, aren't you pretty skilled at cooking too?"

strings.text: 圭を無視して、鳥谷は普通に会話を続ける。
strings.translated: Ignoring Kei, Toritani carried on the conversation as though nothing were amiss.

strings.text: 一人で暮らす少女。
strings.translated: A girl who lives alone.

strings.text: その理由を語るのに躊躇するのであれば、この会話は自然に避けるべきだろう。
strings.translated: If she'd hesitate to explain the reason, then this was a conversation to naturally steer clear of.

strings.text: 察しの良い鳥谷はすぐにそのことを悟った。
strings.translated: Perceptive as ever, Toritani caught on immediately.

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事ないって、まこちゃん、そんなハードルあげちゃだめだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no, that's not true. Mako-chan, don't set the bar so high."

strings.text: 「でも独学ではないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But it's not self-taught, is it?"

strings.text: 「うん。料理のイロハはおばあちゃんに教わりました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No. Grandma taught me the basics of cooking."

strings.text: 「それなら稟の方が料理は上手いと思うぞ。誰かに教わる事は大事だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In that case, I bet Rin is better at cooking than me. Having someone teach you matters."

strings.text: 「だったらさ、今日、料理作りに行くってどうよ。稟ちゃんに作ってもらうの！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then, how about we go cook today? Have Rin-chan make us food!"

strings.text: 「“だったら”からの流れが分からない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't follow the 'then' part of that logic.

strings.text: だいたい、そりゃまずいだろ。稟が作らないと稟のお父さん食べるもの無いだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: And besides, that would be bad, wouldn't it? If Rin doesn't cook, her father won't have anything to eat."

strings.text: 「あ、それは大丈夫です。お父さんとは全然会いませんから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, that's fine. I hardly ever see my father..."

strings.text: 「え？　あ、そ、そうなのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Ah, i-is that so..."

strings.text: 別暮らしとは言っても会うぐらいはしていると思っていた。
strings.translated: Even living apart, I'd assumed they at least met from time to time.

strings.text: たぶん、この街にあの人がいるのはたしかだろうし……。
strings.translated: Well, I was almost certain that person was somewhere in this town...

strings.text: 「まぁ、イイじゃない。みんなで夏目の家に行こうよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, whatever. Let's all go to Natsume's place."

strings.text: 「でも、圭くんの家に行くのならば、藍先生に許可も取らなくちゃだめだと思うよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But if we're going to Kei-kun's house, I think we need to get Ai-sensei's permission."

strings.text: 「あ、今メールしたら、“問題ない”って返ってきたぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ah, I just texted her, and she wrote back 'no problem.'"

strings.text: 「もう？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Already?

strings.text: なんかお前、メール打つの速いなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Man, you type fast..."

strings.text: 「そうか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Really?"

strings.text: あんな速度で携帯メール打てるのって、女子だけかと思ってた。
strings.translated: I'd thought only girls could type texts at that kind of speed.

strings.text: まぁ、偏見かもしれんが。
strings.translated: Well, maybe that's prejudice.

strings.text: 男はだいたい携帯メール打つの遅い気がする。
strings.translated: But I get the feeling guys are generally slow at texting.

strings.text: 「そうですか、私はうれしいぐらいだけど、草薙くんは迷惑じゃないですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is that so. I'd be happy about it, but Kusanagi-kun, isn't it a bother for you?"

strings.text: 「何で迷惑なんだよ。俺は趣味で料理をしているわけじゃない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why would it be a bother? I don't cook as a hobby.

strings.text: 他の人間が作ってくれるのなら喜んで食べる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: If someone else is willing to make it, I'll happily eat it."

strings.text: 「そうよ。ついでに勉強も教えてあげたら」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. And while you're at it, you should have her tutor you too."

strings.text: 「ああ、それは助かるなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, that would be a huge help."

strings.text: 「勉強ですか？　私でいいのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Studying? Are you sure I'll do?"

strings.text: 「いいに決まっているだろ、弓張始まって以来の成績って言われてるヤツが何を言っている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Of course you will. The girl said to have the best grades since Yumihari was founded -- what are you talking about?"

strings.text: 「これで地理もばっちしね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "This way you'll be all set on geography, too."

strings.text: 「ああ、それはいらない。地理は受験科目にしないから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, that one I don't need. I'm not taking geography for the entrance exams."

strings.text: 「地理もちゃんと勉強します！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'll study geography properly too!"

strings.text: 「って、いつも自己主張をしない稟が！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whoa, Rin, who never asserts herself--!"

strings.text: 「だって、今日見た感じ、草薙くんが地理嫌いだっていうのは食わず嫌いな気がしました。すぐに成績は上がると思いますよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Because, from what I saw today, I got the feeling your dislike of geography is just a matter of not giving it a chance, Kusanagi-kun. I think your grades will come up quickly."

strings.text: 「ああ、それは分かるわ。たしかに、あれだけの絵を描けるヤツが、空間把握能力である地図が読めないって、何か腑に落ちないもの。基本的に同じ能力じゃない、絵の空間把握と地図の空間把握ってさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ah, I get that. Honestly, it doesn't sit right with me that a guy who can paint the way you do can't read a map -- spatial awareness and all. They're basically the same skill, aren't they? Spatial grasp in painting and spatial grasp on a map."

strings.text: 「いや、そうとも限らない。絵がうまくて方向音痴だっている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that's not necessarily true. There are people who are good at painting and have no sense of direction."

strings.text: 「そういう人もいるかも知れませんが、草薙くんは違います」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "There may be people like that, but you're not one of them, Kusanagi-kun."

strings.text: 「なんだ、いつになく厳しいなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Man, you're being unusually strict."

strings.text: 「そうですね。でも留年の可能性があるとなれば、厳しくもなります。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes. But when there's a possibility of being held back a year, I have to be strict.

strings.text: 申し訳ないですけど、そこは譲れません」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: I'm sorry, but I can't give ground on that."

strings.text: 「うむぅ……地理か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ugh... geography, huh..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、いいじゃないか。稟ちゃんなら優しく教えてくれるさ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, whatever. Rin-chan'll teach you kindly."

strings.text: 「教えるのは圭くんもですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You're being taught too, Kei-kun."

strings.text: 「え？　俺？　俺はいいよぉ……地理とか」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? Me? I'm fine... with geography and stuff..."

strings.text: 「圭くんは全教科です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "For you, Kei-kun, it's every subject."

strings.text: 「ええ！　全教科！？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Whaaat! Every subject!?"

strings.text: 「相変わらず夏目の屋敷は大きいわねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The Natsume mansion is as huge as ever."

strings.text: 「すごいですね……こんなお屋敷はじめて見ました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's incredible... I've never seen a mansion like this."

strings.text: 「だろうな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I'd imagine so."

strings.text: 「そうなのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 「稟は夏目の屋敷って見た事無かったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin, you've never seen the Natsume estate?"

strings.text: 「え？　何でですか？
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Why do you ask?

strings.text: だってはじめてお邪魔するわけですし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: I mean, this is my first time visiting..."

strings.text: 「そうか、そうだよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Right, of course."

strings.text: 「だと思うのですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I think so, at least..."

strings.text: 「何、難しい顔してるのよ草薙」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What's with the difficult look, Kusanagi?"

strings.text: 「へ？　そんな顔してたか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Was I making that kind of face?"

strings.text: 「いいから、とりあえず入る入る」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Never mind, just get inside, get inside."

strings.text: 「ただいま！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I'm home!"

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「お帰りなさい」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Welcome home."

strings.text: 「今日はたくさんお客さんが来たぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "We've got a lot of guests today."

strings.text: 「お客さんですか」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Guests?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだ。雫にも紹介しないとな。美術部の連中で……、
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I have to introduce you to them, Shizuku. They're from the art club, and...

strings.text: えっととりあえず全員入ってくれ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: um, come on in, everyone."

strings.text: 「お邪魔します」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Pardon the intrusion."

strings.text: 「どうも、こんばんは」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hello, good evening."

strings.text: 「ただいま」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm home."

strings.text: 「あれ？　雫？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? Shizuku?"

strings.text: 「なんか雫が逃げる様に消えたぞ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "She kinda vanished like she was running away."

strings.text: 「あれ？　な、なんかいきなり私達、粗相したかなぁ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? D-did we do something rude right off the bat?"

strings.text: 「い、いや、そういうのじゃない。雫は少し人見知りが強くてな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no, it's not that. Shizuku's just really shy with strangers."

strings.text: 「そ、そうなんだよ。少し恥ずかしがり屋というかさ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Y-yeah, that's it. She's a bit bashful, you could say..."

strings.text: 「……そうなんですか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "...Is that so."

strings.text: 「ん？　どうしたの？　稟ちゃん」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hm? What is it, Rin-chan?"

strings.text: 「あ、いえ？　思い違いだと思うんだけど……。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no? I'm sure I'm mistaken, but...

strings.text: 何か知っている顔だなぁ……と」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: that was a face I feel I've seen somewhere."

strings.text: 「へへへ。それ思い違いじゃないぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Heheheh. That's not a mistake."

strings.text: 「どういう事ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「雫はなぁ。芸能人なんだ。テレビとか雑誌とかにもたくさん出てるんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Shizuku's an entertainer, you see. She's been on TV and in magazines a bunch."

strings.text: 「あ、そうなんですか！　どうりで美人なわけだ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, is that so! No wonder she's so beautiful."

strings.text: 「話には聞いてたけど、実物はやっぱり可愛いわね。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I'd heard about her, but she really is cute in person.

strings.text: 顔もすごく小さかったし」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: And her face is so small."

strings.text: 「それはそうと、いつまで玄関で立ち話させるんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That aside, how long are you going to keep us standing around in the entryway?"

strings.text: 「ああ、すまん。とりあえず、まだ姉ちゃん帰ってないけど、上がってよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ah, sorry. Anyway, my sister isn't back yet, but come on up."

strings.text: 「それでは失礼します」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then, excuse me."

strings.text: 「失礼しまーす」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Excuse us~"

strings.text: 「すごいね。ネギの輪切り速いです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wow. You're fast at slicing leeks."

strings.text: ネギを輪切りにしていると、稟が横から顔を出す。
strings.translated: As I was slicing leeks, Rin peered in from the side.

strings.text: 「そうか？　ネギは比較的簡単だろ。ストロークが短いし、それよりもキャベツの千切りとかの方が難しい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You think? Leeks are relatively easy. The stroke is short. Julienning cabbage is way harder."

strings.text: 「あ、ネギより高さがある分、ストローク長いですからねぇ。でもあれってキャベツの芯は使わないから抜き取ってしまうと結構低くなるんですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, since cabbage is taller than leeks, the stroke is longer, isn't it. But you don't use the core, so once you cut that out it gets quite a bit shorter."

strings.text: 「はい、あとネギの輪切りと違ってちょっとしたコツなんかもあるのですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Right. And, unlike slicing leeks into rounds, there's a little knack to it..."

strings.text: 「どんな？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Like what?"

strings.text: 「コツといいますか、長めの包丁を使用するんです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's less a knack than a matter of using a longer knife."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうか……そういえばそうだよな。キャベツってあんだけ広い範囲なんだから、包丁も長い方が楽そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh, I see... come to think of it, that makes sense. Cabbage covers such a wide area, so a longer knife would be easier."

strings.text: 「二人とも仲良さそうだな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You two seem to get along well."

strings.text: 「そうね。さすがは幼なじみって感じね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yeah. Childhood friends, and it shows."

strings.text: 「良かった……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Thank goodness..."

strings.text: 「良かった……か。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'Thank goodness,' huh.

strings.text: なるほどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: I see."

strings.text: 「なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What is it."

strings.text: 「いやさ、圭って、昔から鈍感なふりして結構敏感だからさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I mean, Kei, you've always been perceptive underneath that oblivious act of yours."

strings.text: 「どういう意味だよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What's that supposed to mean?"

strings.text: 「あの時、何であんなに怒ったの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Why were you so angry that time?"

strings.text: 「あの時？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That time?"

strings.text: 「稟ちゃんがはじめて部活に来た日。草薙が二度と絵を描かないって言った時よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The day Rin-chan came to the club for the first time. When Kusanagi said he'd never paint again."

strings.text: 「“何でいきなり描かなくなったのか、俺はまだ理由を聞いてないぞ”って凄んでたじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You snapped at him, 'I still haven't heard why you suddenly quit painting,' remember?"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、俺はまだ理由を聞いてないし……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, I still hadn't heard the reason..."

strings.text: 「そうかしら？　何度かあんなやりとりはあったけど、でもあんなに圭が声を荒げたのはあれがはじめてよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Is that so? There've been exchanges like that a few times, but that was the first time you raised your voice like that."

strings.text: 「最初にあいつが断筆するって聞いた時も同じぐらいキレたよ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I lost my temper just as much the first time I heard he was giving up the brush..."

strings.text: 「それってすごく前の話でしょ？　何で今更あんなキレ方したの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That was ages ago, wasn't it? Why did you flip out like that now, of all times?"

strings.text: 「機嫌が悪かったんじゃないか……。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Maybe I was just in a bad mood...

strings.text: どうでもいいじゃんか」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: Who cares."

strings.text: 「私よりさ、圭は草薙の事を良く知っている」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You know Kusanagi better than I do, Kei."

strings.text: 「だからこそ圭は、あいつがちゃらんぽらんな理由で筆を折ったわけじゃない事ぐらい良く分かっている」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Which is exactly why you know full well he didn't put down his brush for some flippant reason."

strings.text: 「草薙って男はさ。ああ見えて、普通じゃ考えられない様な強い意志の持ち主じゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That Kusanagi -- he doesn't look it, but he's got a will stronger than you'd ever imagine."

strings.text: 「当たり前だ。それぐらいの強い意志がなければ描けない絵だ。草薙の絵は」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Of course. You need that kind of iron will to paint the paintings Kusanagi paints."

strings.text: 「だったら、ずっと描き続けてた絵。あれほどの高みまで達した絵を、草薙が捨てた理由。それが、あいつの自分勝手な理由じゃないって分かってるでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then the paintings he kept working on, the reason he threw away work that reached those heights -- you know it wasn't out of some selfish whim of his, right?"

strings.text: 「世の中には、ある程度で“こんなもんか”って、知った気になってやめるような才能もあるけど、草薙はそうじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "In this world there are talents who quit once they hit a certain point, thinking they've got the measure of it, but Kusanagi isn't one of them."

strings.text: 「あいつは、そういう中途半端な才能の連中とは無縁なヤツ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "He has nothing to do with those half-baked talents.

strings.text: たぶん、誰よりもその先の高みを知っていて、その先に行きたくて、それでもそれ以上歩く事を、自ら禁じた」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: He probably knows the heights beyond, better than anyone, and he wants to reach them -- and even so, he's forbidden himself from taking another step."

strings.text: 「禁じたか……。その表現は正しいと思う」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Forbidden, huh... I think that's exactly the right word."

strings.text: 「草薙直哉って男はさ。バカみたいに義理堅くて、バカみたいにお人好しでさ。誰にも知られる事無く、いろいろな事に首を突っ込んで、自らいろいろなものを失っていく」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "That man Kusanagi Naoya -- stupidly loyal, stupidly good-natured. Without anyone ever knowing, he sticks his neck into all sorts of things, and loses all sorts of things of his own."

strings.text: 「くやしいけど、俺が出来なかった様な事、本来ならば俺がやらなければいけなかった事すら、あいつがやってくれた……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It's frustrating, but the things I couldn't do, even the things I should've been the one to do -- he did them for me..."

strings.text: 「でもさ、それは既に気がついてはダメだし、無かった事にしなきゃいけない。くやしいけど、俺にはそうする事しか出来ない」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But you can't allow yourself to notice, and you have to act like it never happened. It's frustrating, but that's all I can do."

strings.text: 「あいつは、本当に漫画に出てくるヒーローみたいなヤツでさ。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "He really is like a hero out of a manga.

strings.text: 絵だけじゃないんだよ。才能とかそういうものだけじゃないんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: It's not just about the paintings. It's not just about talent and stuff like that."

strings.text: 「だから、分かってしまった」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's why I figured it out."

strings.text: 「あの時に、たぶん、草薙が絵を描かなくなった理由を……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Back then, probably -- the reason Kusanagi stopped painting..."

strings.text: 「でも、本当は理由にはすでに気がついてたんだと思う。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But actually, I think I'd already realized the reason.

strings.text: 絵を描いてる人間なら分かるわよね。あいつの不自然な行動」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Anyone who paints could tell. His unnatural behavior."

strings.text: 「ただ、その理由が何に起因するか。それが今まで私達には分からなかった」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's just, what that reason stemmed from -- that's what we couldn't figure out until now."

strings.text: 「テレビの特撮とか見てるとさ、ヒーローはよばれもしないのに、どこからともなくあらわれて、困った人を助けるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You know how in the TV tokusatsu shows, the hero shows up without being called, out of nowhere, to save people in trouble?"

strings.text: 「突然話変わるのね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's a sudden change of subject."

strings.text: 「ああ、でもさ、あれって不思議だろ？
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, but it's strange, right?

strings.text: なんでどこからともなくあらわれるんだろう」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: Why do they show up out of nowhere?"

strings.text: 「なんでだろう」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I wonder why."

strings.text: 「あれはさ、ヒーローには誰かの悲鳴が聞こえるんだと思う」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I think it's because heroes can hear someone's cry."

strings.text: 「誰かの悲鳴が聞こえる……か」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "They can hear someone's cry, huh."

strings.text: 「そいつがどんな孤独で、どれだけ遠くにあったとしても、悲鳴を聞く事が出来る。誰かの声を聞くことが出来る」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "No matter how alone that person is, no matter how far away, they can hear the cry. They can hear someone's voice."

strings.text: 「さすがに草薙はそんなではないでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Surely Kusanagi isn't like that, though?"

strings.text: 「そうかな？　当たらずといえども遠からず。だと思うけど」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You think? Not exactly on the mark, but not far off, is what I'd say."

strings.text: 「そう。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I see.

strings.text: なるほどね。あんたがそう言うのならそうかもね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Right. If you say so, then maybe that's how it is."

strings.text: 「まぁな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「そうだ。真琴。天才の条件って知ってるか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Right. Makoto. Do you know the conditions for genius?"

strings.text: 「そんな漠然としたもん無いわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There's no such vague thing."

strings.text: 「そうかもな。俺も良く分からないけど。好きな言葉があるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You may be right. I don't really know either. But there's a saying I like."

strings.text: 「薄っぺらな天才は、才能が透けて見える。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "With a shallow genius, you can see right through to the talent.

strings.text: 天才は、才能を忘れさせる」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: True geniuses make you forget the talent."

strings.text: 「誰の言葉？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Whose words are those?"

strings.text: 「さぁ、聞きかじった言葉だから知らない」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Beats me, it's just something I picked up somewhere."

strings.text: 「悪く無い言葉ね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Not bad words."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな。悪く無い言葉だ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah. Not bad at all."

strings.text: 「……なんかこうやってまじめな話するのも久しぶりね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "...It's been a while since we talked seriously like this, huh."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうかも……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah, maybe..."

strings.text: 「昔はさ……。二人ともガキのくせに陰気な事ばかり話してた」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Back in the day... the two of us were just brats, but all we ever talked about was gloomy stuff."

strings.text: 「そうだったかもな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Maybe we did."

strings.text: 「でも、圭は元気そうでなによりよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Still, I'm just glad you seem to be doing well, Kei."

strings.text: 「何を今更」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why bring that up now?"

strings.text: 「この三年間、あんたを見続けて得た結論よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's the conclusion I've reached after watching you for the past three years."

strings.text: 「俺は、夏目圭として幸せにやってるよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I'm living happily as Natsume Kei."

strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 「私はさ、まだいろいろと整理がついてないんだけどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "As for me, there's still a lot I haven't sorted out."

strings.text: 「まぁ、時間がかかってもいいんじゃないか？　俺はいつか二人が仲直りしてくれると思ってる」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, it's fine if it takes time, isn't it? I believe you two will make up someday."

strings.text: 「……そうかしら」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "...I wonder."

strings.text: 「ほーら！　出来たぞ！　お前らも配膳ぐらい手伝え！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Heeey! It's ready! You lot, at least help set the table!"

strings.text: 「おう！　分かったぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah! Got it!"

strings.text: 「はい、はい、そんな大声出さなくても聞こえるわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yes, yes, we can hear you without you yelling like that."

strings.text:
食事を終えた後、約束通り、稟は勉強を教えてくれた。
当然、知りたくもない地理も。
strings.translated:
After we finished eating, Rin taught me, as promised.
Geography included, whether I wanted it or not.

strings.text: 少々ありがた迷惑ではあったが、まぁ、全面的に稟が言っている事の方が正しい。
strings.translated: It was a bit of an unwelcome kindness, but on the whole what Rin was saying was right.

strings.text: この極端な方向音痴は直せたら直すべきだし、常識の範囲では覚えた方がいい。
strings.translated: This ridiculous sense of direction of mine should be fixed if it can be, and I ought to memorize at least the commonsense stuff.

strings.text: 「今日はこんなところでしょうかねぇ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I suppose that's enough for today."

strings.text: 「うひぃ……つ、疲れたぞ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ughhh... I-I'm beat..."

strings.text: 「終わったの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Are you done?"

strings.text: 「うん、ごめんね。まこちゃんまで付き合わせちゃって……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, sorry. Dragging you into it too, Mako-chan..."

strings.text: 「ああ、別に、私もどうせ家帰っても一人だし、ここで勉強しても同じだもの」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ah, it's fine. I'd just be alone at home anyway, so studying here amounts to the same thing."

strings.text: 「まこちゃんって一人暮らしだったの？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Mako-chan, you live alone?"

strings.text: 「そうか。言ってなかったっけ？　でも稟ちゃんも分かるでしょ？　一人だと気軽だし、まぁ、私の部屋何もないけどさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. Did I not mention it? But you understand, don't you, Rin-chan? It's easy being alone, though my place has nothing in it."

strings.text: 「それじゃ、今度遊びに行っていいかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then, can I come visit sometime?"

strings.text: 「逆にこっちから頼みたいぐらいよ。休みの日とか結構暇だし、稟ちゃんの家とか行っていい？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I'd rather be asking you the same thing. I'm pretty free on days off -- mind if I come over to your place, Rin-chan?"

strings.text: 「もちろんだよ。そうだ。今度二人で勉強会やらない？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Of course. Oh, I know. Let's have a study session together sometime."

strings.text: 「いいわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sounds good."

strings.text: 二人で勉強。
strings.translated: Studying together.

strings.text: いいわね。
strings.translated: Sounds good.

strings.text: 休日暇だから、わざわざ一人暮らしの家に行ってまで勉強。
strings.translated: Because they're free on days off, they'd deliberately go to someone's place who lives alone, just to study.

strings.text: まったく俺には理解出来ない。
strings.translated: I really can't understand it.

strings.text: 「それじゃ。そろそろおいとましますか」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well then. Guess I'll be heading off soon."

strings.text: 「はいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes!"

strings.text: 俺と圭は二人を見送った。
strings.translated: Kei and I saw the two of them off.

strings.text: 家まで送ろうか？
strings.translated: Want us to walk you home?

strings.text: と提案したが、すぐ近所であるし、稟がいるから問題ないとの事だ。
strings.translated: I offered, but since it was right in the neighborhood and Rin was with her, it was no problem, apparently.

strings.text: それでも圭は送るといってバイクを取りに行った。
strings.translated: Even so, Kei insisted on seeing her home and went to get his bike.

strings.text: あんなもので併走されるのもかなり迷惑な気もするが……。
strings.translated: Being escorted by that thing running alongside seems like it'd be more of a nuisance, though...

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nn... the phone?"

strings.text: 日曜日のまどろみがけたたましい音でかき消される。
strings.translated: Sunday's drowsiness is shattered by a shrill sound.

strings.text: 独特でけたたましい音。
strings.translated: A distinctive, shrill sound.

strings.text: なんと、この夏目の家では廊下に昔懐かしい黒電話がいまだに鎮座しているのだ。
strings.translated: Believe it or not, in the Natsume household, an old-fashioned black rotary phone still sits enshrined in the hallway.

strings.text: 「んぐぅ……ちきしょう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nnrgh... dammit..."

strings.text: 時計を見る、まだ時間は午前八時前……。
strings.translated: I glance at the clock -- it's not even eight in the morning yet...

strings.text: 「日曜日に……何なんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "On a Sunday... what the hell..."

strings.text: 夏目にかかってきた電話だろうけど、ここの人間が電話の音で起きるとは思えないからな……。
strings.translated: It's probably a call for Natsume, but I can't imagine anyone in this house waking up to the phone ringing...

strings.text: 「めんどくさい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What a pain..."

strings.text: 「はい、夏目ですけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hello, Natsume residence..."

strings.text: 「あら？　いきなり草薙が出た……」
strings.translated: "Oh? Kusanagi picked up right away..."

strings.text: 「誰だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who is this?"

strings.text: 「声だけで分かりなさいよ。
strings.translated: "Figure it out from my voice alone.

strings.text: 私は夏目の家にかけて、草薙が出たって一発で分かったんだからさ！」
strings.translated: I called the Natsume house and knew instantly it was Kusanagi who answered!"

strings.text: 「その傲慢な言い方……鳥谷か明石？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That arrogant way of speaking... Toritani or Akashi?"

strings.text: 真琴
strings.translated: Makoto

strings.text: 「何よその二択！　ありえないでしょ！
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What kind of two choices is that?! There's no way!

strings.text: なんで私か明石先輩なのよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Why is it either me or Akashi-senpai!"

strings.text: 「なんだ？　こんな朝から……今日は日曜日だぞ。鳥谷……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is it? This early in the morning... today's Sunday, you know. Toritani..."

strings.text: 「ちゃんと、分かってるじゃないの……ったく、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "See, you got it right... geez.

strings.text: それはそうと、少し相談したい事があってさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Anyway, there's something I want to consult you about."

strings.text: 「相談？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Consult me?"

strings.text: 「そうね相談よ。まぁ正確に言えば相談と言うより、あなたに聞きたい事があるといったところだけど……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yes, consult. Well, to be precise, more than consulting, there's something I want to ask you..."

strings.text: 「聞きたい事ねぇ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Something to ask, huh.

strings.text: なんだ？　電話じゃダメなのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: What is it? Won't the phone do?"

strings.text: 「出来たら会ってもらいたいわね。少し込み入った内容だし……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "If possible, I'd like to meet in person. It's a little complicated..."

strings.text: 「なるほど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 電話で出来ない話か……、
strings.translated: Something that can't be done over the phone, huh...

strings.text: あまり良い予感はしない。
strings.translated: I don't have a good feeling about this.

strings.text: とは言っても、鳥谷に相談と言われて</r むげ>無碍</r>にも出来ない。
strings.translated: That said, when Toritani says she wants to consult me, I can't very well brush her off.

strings.text: 「とりあえず、今から着替えて出るから……、そうだなぁ十時には着く様にする」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For now, I'll change and head out... let's see, I'll try to be there by ten."

strings.text: 「そう、感謝するわ。とりあえず美術室で待ってるから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right, I appreciate it. I'll be waiting in the art room."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 「聞きたい事か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Something to ask me, huh..."

strings.text: まったく身に覚えがないが……。
strings.translated: I have absolutely no idea what it could be...

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 「誰から電話だ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Who was on the phone?"

strings.text: 「お？　藍？　寝ぼけてないんだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh? Ai? You're not half-asleep?"

strings.text: 「あのなぁ。私だっていつでも朝は寝ぼけているわけじゃないぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hey now. It's not like I'm always groggy in the mornings."

strings.text: 「そう願いたいな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'd like to think so.

strings.text: とりあえず今の電話は俺にだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Anyway, that call was for me."

strings.text: 「草薙に？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "For you, Kusanagi?"

strings.text: 「ああ、なんでも美術部の鳥谷が俺に用があるらしくてな、これから学校までいってくる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, apparently Toritani from the art club has something she wants from me, so I'm heading out to school."

strings.text: 「そうなのか？　日曜日に大変だなぁ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Is that so? Rough having to go on a Sunday."

strings.text: 「ああ、俺は週明けにはふたたび補習だから、今日がせっかくの休みなのに」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, and starting next week I'm back in remedial classes, so today was supposed to be my one day off."

strings.text: 「そうだな。おかげさまで私も補習の準備のために今日は学校に行かなければならない。そういった意味では私も相当不憫だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Indeed. Thanks to that, I have to go to school today too to prepare for the remedial classes. In that sense, I'm quite pitiable myself."

strings.text: 「というのは冗談だ。今日は他に用事があってな。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Just kidding. I've got other business today.

strings.text: せっかくだから私と一緒に行くか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Since we're both going, want to come along with me?"

strings.text: 「いや、藍のバイクは勘弁してほしい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No thanks, spare me your bike..."

strings.text: 「ははは……残念ながら今日は私も電車だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hahaha... unfortunately I'm taking the train today too."

strings.text: 「そういえば最近はずっと電車だが、どうしたんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, you've been taking the train lately -- what's up?"

strings.text: 「古いバイクだからな、いろいろと大変なんだよ。特に湿気が多い時期に乗らないとな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It's an old bike, so it's high-maintenance. Especially if you don't ride it during the humid season."

strings.text: そういえば梅雨時はバイクは倉庫に入りっぱなしだったな。
strings.translated: Now that she mentions it, during the rainy season her bike stayed shut up in the garage.

strings.text: とはいえ、雨の日にバイクで登校なんて出来たもんじゃないだろうが……。
strings.translated: Then again, you couldn't really commute to school on a bike on rainy days anyway...

strings.text: 「なるほど、電車か……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see, the train, huh...

strings.text: だったら一緒に行くか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: In that case, want to go together?"

strings.text: 「ああ、それじゃ今から私が朝食を作ろう。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sure, then I'll make breakfast right now.

strings.text: 草薙も、朝食まだだろ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: You haven't eaten yet, right, Kusanagi?"

strings.text: 「え？　あ、藍が料理！？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Ah, Ai's going to cook!?"

strings.text: 「なんだ、その態度……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hey, what's with that attitude...

strings.text: どうせ圭から私の料理がひどいとか聞いているのだろう。だがそれは言いがかりだぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: I bet Kei's been telling you my cooking is awful. But that's just slander."

strings.text: 「そ、そうなのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "R-really?"

strings.text: 言いがかりと言った感じでは無かったが……。
strings.translated: It didn't really seem like slander though...

strings.text: 「当然であろう。私は教師だぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Of course I can cook. I'm a teacher."

strings.text: 「いや、教師だからって料理がうまいとはかぎらないだろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, being a teacher doesn't necessarily mean you're a good cook..."

strings.text: 「むっ……その言葉、私に対する挑戦と受け取るぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Mgh... I'll take those words as a challenge to me."

strings.text: 「別に挑戦とかではないんだけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not really a challenge or anything..."

strings.text: 「どうした草薙。さぁ遠慮無く食べるがいいぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What's wrong, Kusanagi. Come on, eat up, don't hold back."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

strings.text: これが、圭の言うところの街が大騒ぎになる料理というやつか……。
strings.translated: So this is what Kei was talking about -- the cooking that throws the whole town into uproar...

strings.text: 見た感じ……。
strings.translated: From the look of it...

strings.text: あまりヤバそうな感じはしない……。
strings.translated: It doesn't seem particularly dangerous...

strings.text: とは言っても料理は、外見で味の判断が出来るわけではない。
strings.translated: Then again, you can't judge the taste of food by its appearance.

strings.text: たとえば、暗殺者の外見が見るからに暗殺者なわけがない。
strings.translated: For instance, an assassin doesn't look like an assassin from the outside.

strings.text: たぶん暗殺者は一般人と同じ格好だろう。
strings.translated: An assassin probably dresses just like an ordinary person.

strings.text: わざわざ目立つ格好であるわけがない。
strings.translated: There's no way they'd deliberately stand out.

strings.text: だとしたら……。
strings.translated: In that case...

strings.text: この暗殺料理だって……。
strings.translated: This assassin-cuisine too...

strings.text: 「おい……何をさっきからブツブツと、
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hey... what've you been muttering about,

strings.text: だいたいなんだその暗殺者というのは……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: and what's this 'assassin' talk anyway..."

strings.text: 「ああ、気にしないでくれ。料理の感想を述べたまでだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, don't mind me. I was merely voicing my impression of the food."

strings.text: 「それが料理の感想とか、失礼にもほどがあるだろう」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "If that's your impression of my cooking, that's rude beyond belief."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、それは比喩表現であってだな。別に藍の料理の殺傷性を保証する言葉ではない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, that was a figure of speech. It wasn't meant to guarantee the lethality of your cooking or anything."

strings.text: 「本っ当に失礼だな、お前は」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You are truly rude, you know."

strings.text: 「まぁ、いい、とりあえず“あいうえ”と言ってみろ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, fine, for now try saying 'a-i-u-e'."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「ほら言ってみろ！　早く！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Come on, say it! Quickly!"

strings.text: 「あいうえ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A-i-u-e?"

strings.text: 「早すぎる！　もっとゆっくり大きく」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Too fast! Slower and bigger!"

strings.text: 何言ってるんだ？
strings.translated: What's she going on about?

strings.text: 早く言え！　とか早すぎる！　とか……。
strings.translated: Say it fast, no, too fast...

strings.text: 「えっと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
直哉
strings.translated: "Ahh--"

strings.text: 藍は、口が開いた瞬間に料理を放り込む。
strings.translated: The instant my mouth opens, Ai shoves the food in.

strings.text: 「んっっ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Mmph?"

strings.text: 口に入ったのは藍の料理だ。
strings.translated: What entered my mouth is Ai's cooking.

strings.text: 口の中に料理の味が広がる……それは……。
strings.translated: The flavor spreads through my mouth... and it's...

strings.text: 「食える……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Edible..."

strings.text: 「ふぅ……本当に失礼なヤツだな……ほら」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Sigh... you really are a rude one... here."

strings.text: 「食えるというよりはむしろ……美味い」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "More than edible, actually... it's good."

strings.text: 「ふふ……当たり前だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Heh heh... obviously."

strings.text: 「でも、圭が……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But Kei said..."

strings.text: 「だから言ってるだろう、圭のは言いがかりだと」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Like I told you, Kei's talk is slander."

strings.text: 「うむ……たしかにうまい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Mm... it really is good..."

strings.text: 藍は笑いながら俺を見つめている。
strings.translated: Ai watches me with a smile.

strings.text: 「何を笑いながら俺を見ている。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why are you watching me with that smile?

strings.text: 藍は食べないのか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Aren't you going to eat, Ai?"

strings.text: 「ああ、す、少しな……すまない……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, y-yes, a little... sorry..."

strings.text: 「はははは、私も食べるさ。一緒に食べよう」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hahaha, of course I'll eat. Let's eat together."

strings.text: 「お？　ひさしぶりに作ったが、なかなかだな。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Oh? It's been a while since I made this, but not bad.

strings.text: これはなかなかの出来だよ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: This came out pretty well."

strings.text: 「ひさしぶりだったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's been a while?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

strings.text: ひさしぶりとは思えないぐらい、良く出来てるな……。
strings.translated: It's so well made you'd never guess it's been a while...

strings.text: 料理はチャーハン。
strings.translated: The dish is fried rice.

strings.text: 簡単そうでありながら、奥が深い料理だ。
strings.translated: Deceptively simple, but a deep dish to master.

strings.text: あれだけパラパラした感じに仕上げるには、それなりの腕が必要だ。
strings.translated: Getting it that fluffy and separated takes real skill.

strings.text: かなり熱したフライパン。
strings.translated: A thoroughly heated pan.

strings.text: 多めの油。
strings.translated: A generous amount of oil.

strings.text: 基本、チャーハンは炒めるというよりは、気持ち、油で揚げる様なものだ。
strings.translated: Basically, fried rice isn't so much stir-fried as -- in feel -- lightly deep-fried in oil.

strings.text: とは言っても多すぎてもだめ。
strings.translated: That said, too much is no good either.

strings.text: 素早さがもっとも必要な料理であり、一度でも失敗したら、やり直しが利かない料理でもある。
strings.translated: It's a dish that demands speed above all, and one where a single misstep leaves no room for a redo.

strings.text: 簡単ではない。
strings.translated: It isn't easy.

strings.text: 「うまいな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's good..."

strings.text: それが、他人が作ってくれたものなら、<r なおさら>尚更</r>だ。
strings.translated: And when it's something someone else has made for you, all the more so.

strings.text: 「それは良かった。たまにはお姉さんらしい事もしてやれないとな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Glad to hear it. Every now and then I have to do something big-sister-like for you."

strings.text: 「そういえば藍は学校に何用だ？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "By the way, what's your business at school, Ai?

strings.text: 野暮用とか言ってたが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: You said something about errands..."

strings.text: 「名前だけとは言え、私は部活の顧問をやっているからな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "In name only, but I am the advisor for a club."

strings.text: 「部活の顧問？　ああ、美術部か」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Club advisor? Ah, the art club."

strings.text: 「本来なら若田先生がやってくれれば良いのだが……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It would be nice if Wakata-sensei would handle it, really..."

strings.text: 「あいつ美術部の顧問じゃなかったのか？　あいつ自分の事を顧問だって言ってたぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wasn't he the art club advisor? He said himself that he was the advisor."

strings.text: 「まぁ、仕方がない理由が若田先生にもあるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, there are unavoidable reasons on Wakata-sensei's side..."

strings.text: 「理由？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Reasons?"

strings.text: 「なんと言うか、非常勤だと部の顧問になれないとか、まぁ大人の事情だな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "How to put it -- part-time teachers can't be club advisors, or something like that. It's grown-up circumstances..."

strings.text: 「そんなもんあるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's such a rule?"

strings.text: 「非常勤はいつでも首が切られるからな。そういう事だよ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Part-timers can be let go at any time. That's the reason..."

strings.text: 「教育現場なのに、なんて世知辛い話だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even in an educational setting -- what a harsh world."

strings.text: 「それにしても、何であいつは美術部の顧問みたいな面してるんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Still, why does he go around acting like he's the art club advisor?"

strings.text: 「健一郎さんが、あそこの顧問だったからな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Because Ken'ichirou-san was the advisor there."

strings.text: 「そういえば、あの男は弓張の教師だったな……でもたしかあいつも非常勤じゃなかったか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Now that you mention it, that man was a teacher at Yumihari... but wasn't he also a part-timer?"

strings.text: 「ああ、健一郎さんも非常勤だった。まぁ、それも非常勤が部の顧問が出来なくなった理由ではあるらしいが……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yes, Ken'ichirou-san was part-time too. And apparently that's one of the reasons part-timers can no longer serve as club advisors..."

strings.text: 「はぁ、またあいつが何かやらかしたのかよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sigh, did that guy pull something again..."

strings.text: 「やらかした、というかな。まぁ、学園側からしたらたしかに“やらかした”という事になるんだろうけどな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Pulled something -- well, from the school's point of view, I suppose it does count as 'pulling something.'"

strings.text: 「藍もその当時の事は知ってるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Do you know about what happened back then, Ai?"

strings.text: 「さぁな。正直詳しい事は知らん。当時はまだ子供だったしな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Who knows. Honestly, I don't know the details. I was still a child at the time."

strings.text: 「藍が子供か……ふむ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ai as a child... hmm."

strings.text: 「そうだが……何だ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I was, yes... what of it?"

strings.text: 「今と変わらないなぁ……と」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No different from now, I was thinking..."

strings.text: 「お前は……いちいち一言多い」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You... always have one word too many."

strings.text: 「それにしても、藍の子供の頃か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Still, Ai as a child, huh..."

strings.text: 「なんだ……またつまらない事を言う気か？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What... are you about to say something dull again?"

strings.text: 「つまらない事か……そうだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Something dull, huh... yeah..."

strings.text: 「つまらない事かもしれない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Maybe it is dull..."

strings.text: 「お前は一度も聞いた事が無いな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You've never once asked, have you."

strings.text: 「何を？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「健一郎さん。この家に住んでたんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ken'ichirou-san. He lived in this house, you know."

strings.text: 「でも、藍はその頃は子供だったんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But you were a kid back then, weren't you, Ai?"

strings.text: 「たしかに、子供だったから、学校での事は良く分からないが、家での健一郎さんは良く覚えてる」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "True, I was a child, so I don't really know what went on at school, but I remember Ken'ichirou-san at home well."

strings.text: 「そうか、だとしても、俺はあまり興味ない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. Even so, I'm not that interested."

strings.text: 「はははは、お前はなにがなんでも健一郎さんに興味を示さないふりをするんだなぁ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hahaha, no matter what, you always pretend to have no interest in Ken'ichirou-san."

strings.text: 「いや、ふりとかじゃなくて、本当に興味がない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it's not pretense. I really am not interested."

strings.text: 「そうなのか？　だったら、健一郎さんの事は抜きにして、水菜さんの事だけ聞きたいのか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Is that so? Then leaving Ken'ichirou-san aside, do you want to hear only about Mizuna-san?"

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事はないっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "T-that's not it!"

strings.text: 「ははは……冗談だよ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Haha... I'm joking."

strings.text: 「あの頃の話か、あの人がいて、そして水菜さんがいて、はははそういえば若田先生も遊びに来てたなぁ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Stories from back then, huh. That man was there, and Mizuna-san was there, and -- haha, come to think of it, Wakata-sensei used to come over too."

strings.text: 「若田が？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wakata did?"

strings.text: 「元々は健一郎さんの教え子だからな、でも大学入った後も良く健一郎さんに呼び出されてたよ。一応同じ大学だったから今度はＯＢとしてな。あの人は死ぬほどわがままだったからなぁ、若田先生も大変だったろうな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "He was originally Ken'ichirou-san's student, and even in university Ken'ichirou-san constantly called him out--as a fellow alumnus of the same school. That man was impossibly selfish, so Wakata-sensei must've had it rough."

strings.text: 「……ああ、死ぬほどわがままでそして最高に最悪な男だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Yeah, impossibly selfish -- the absolute worst, and the greatest, of men..."

strings.text: 「最高に最悪か……、まぁ、ある意味ではあの人を良く言い当ててる。的を射た言い方だな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The greatest of the worst, huh... well, in a way, that pins him down quite well. It hits the mark."

strings.text: 「草薙はもう絵を描かないのか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Are you not going to paint anymore, Kusanagi?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Painting, huh..."

strings.text: 「何でそんな事をいまさら聞く？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why bring that up now?"

strings.text: 「いまさらか……でも、以前はずっと描いてただろ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Now, huh... but you used to paint all the time, didn't you?"

strings.text: 「そうだな。昔はそればかりやっていた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's right. Back then, that was all I did..."

strings.text: 「もう描かないのか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You won't paint again?"

strings.text: 「さあな。別に深い考えがあって描いてないわけではない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who knows. It's not like I have some deep reason for not painting."

strings.text: 「そうか……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I see...

strings.text: だったら絵を描く時があったら言ってくれ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Then whenever the time comes that you paint, tell me..."

strings.text: 「絵を描く時があったら？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whenever I paint?"

strings.text: 「その時が来たら話してやろう……。私の子供の頃、健一郎さんがここに住んでいた頃の話……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "When that time comes, I'll tell you the story... of my childhood, of when Ken'ichirou-san lived here..."

strings.text: 「その時か……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "When that time comes, huh...

strings.text: 下手すると一生藍の子供の頃の話は聞けないかもな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Worst case, I might never hear about your childhood in my whole life, Ai."

strings.text: 「私の話がメインではないぞ。あくまでも健一郎さんの話だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I'm not the main subject. It's Ken'ichirou-san's story, first and foremost."

strings.text: 「それじゃ、それこそ一生、絵なんて描く必然性がない事になる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then there really is no necessity for me to ever paint again, for the rest of my life."

strings.text: 「あはは、私の子供の時の話こそなんの価値も無いだろう。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ahaha, stories from my own childhood have no value at all.

strings.text: まぁいい。さぁ、せっかくの私の料理が冷めてしまうぞ。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Well, never mind. Come on, my hard-earned cooking is going cold.

strings.text: とっとと食べてしまえ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Hurry up and eat."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Yeah."

strings.text: いつでも藍だけはこんな感じだ。
strings.translated: Only Ai has always been like this.

strings.text: 最初に俺が絵を描かないと言った時も、彼女だけは普通に聞いてくれた……。
strings.translated: When I first said I wouldn't paint anymore, she was the only one who simply listened to me...

strings.text: そう扱ってくれたのは藍だけだった。
strings.translated: The only one who treated it that way was Ai.

strings.text: 料理にスプーンをつけたまま、藍は相変わらず俺をみつめる。
strings.translated: Spoon still resting in her food, Ai keeps her eyes on me as always.

strings.text: 「お前こそ食べないのか？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're the one not eating.

strings.text: それこそ料理が冷めてしまうぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Now your food is really going to get cold."

strings.text: 「あ、ああ……そうだな……くす、すまない」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Ah, y-yeah... you're right... heh, sorry."

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: すげぇ暑ちぃ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Damn, it's hot......"

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 「すっかり夏だな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It's fully summer now."

strings.text: 「ああ、あり得ないぐらい夏だな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's unbelievably summer......"

strings.text: 「お前は夏は嫌いか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You don't like summer?"

strings.text: 「好きなやつなんていないだろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nobody likes it......"

strings.text: 「いや……夏が好きな人間だっているだろう。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "No... surely there are people who like summer.

strings.text: なんでお前はそんなに気持ちよく断定出来るんだ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: How can you declare it so cheerfully like that......"

strings.text: 「夏が好きな人間の気が知れないと言う意味だ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I mean I can't fathom the mind of anyone who does.

strings.text: だいたい夏は暑いわ、じめじめしてるわ、いいところなど見当たらない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Summer's hot, humid -- I can't find a single thing going for it......"

strings.text: 「お前はそんなに夏が嫌いなのか。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You hate summer that much, huh.

strings.text: ならどの季節がお好みだ？　冬か？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Then which season do you prefer? Winter?"

strings.text: 「……冬は寒いからダメだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "......Winter's out. It's cold."

strings.text: 「暑いのも寒いのもダメとか……単なるわがままとしか言わないぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hot's no good, cold's no good... that's just being spoiled."

strings.text: 「うーん……強いて言えば、秋は過ごしやすいかもしれないなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hmm... if I had to pick, autumn's probably the easiest to get through."

strings.text: 「なるほど。どこまでいっても、お前にとって季節は過ごしやすいかどうかなのだな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I see. In the end, for you, seasons are only about whether they're easy to get through."

strings.text: 「普通そんなもんだろう？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Isn't that normal?"

strings.text: 「他にもあるだろう、夏の青空とか、冬の雪景色とか、秋の紅葉とか……そうだ春はどうなんだ？　春は秋と同じぐらい過ごしやすいじゃないか」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "There's more to them, right? The blue skies of summer, the snowy scenery of winter, the autumn leaves... oh, and what about spring? Spring's just as easy to get through as autumn, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「春かぁ。春は一番嫌いだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Spring, huh. I hate spring the most......"

strings.text: 「春が一番嫌い？　なぜだ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You hate spring the most? Why?"

strings.text: 「春は憂鬱だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Spring is depressing......"

strings.text: 「春が憂鬱か……、くす、お前らしいな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Spring is depressing... heh, that's just like you......"

strings.text: 「俺らしいって、なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What do you mean, just like me?"

strings.text: 「春が憂鬱なんて言い方するのはお前ぐらいだよ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You're about the only person who puts it that way -- 'spring is depressing.'"

strings.text: 「そんな事はない。花粉症のヤツは良く言うぞ、春は憂鬱だと」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not true. People with hay fever say it all the time -- spring is depressing."

strings.text: 「お前が花粉症なんて聞いた事ないぞ？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I've never heard that you have hay fever."

strings.text: 「そりゃそうだ。俺は花粉症ではない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's because I don't."

strings.text: 「それでも……春は嫌いだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even so...... I hate spring."

strings.text: 「すっかり緑になってしまったんだな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Everything's turned so green......"

strings.text: 「なに言ってるんだ。あたりまえだ、もう七月も終わり近くだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you talking about. Of course it has -- it's already nearly the end of July."

strings.text: 「それはそうだな。この季節にはすべての桜の木が緑に覆われている……当たり前の事だ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That's true. In this season, every cherry tree is covered in green... it's only natural......"

strings.text: 「ははは……そんな当たり前の事でも忘れてしまうんだよ。忙しいとな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Haha... but even something that natural, you forget about it. When you're busy......"

strings.text: 「忙しい？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Busy?"

strings.text: 「ああ、教師というのはいつも一学期は忙しいんだぞ……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah, teachers are always busy through the first term......

strings.text: だから、それが学期の節目にあって分かる。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: So you notice it at the breaks between terms.

strings.text: 立ち止まった時に、初めてどれだけ時間が経ったのか分かるものだ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: It's only when you stop that you realize how much time has passed......"

strings.text: 「もう夏なんだなぁ……と」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "'Oh, it's summer already,' and so on."

strings.text: 「そりゃそうだ。教師なんて夏はほとんど夏休みだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, obviously. Teachers get most of the summer off, don't they?"

strings.text: 「アホ、夏休みだって教師は忙しいんだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Idiot, teachers are busy over summer break too."

strings.text: 「そういえば、今年の夏は美術部が合宿も行う気らしいぞ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Speaking of which, the art club's apparently doing a training camp this summer.

strings.text: 何かどっかの田舎に行くとか何とか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Somewhere out in the countryside, I hear."

strings.text: 「ああ、聞いてる。この時期に合宿とはなぁ。まぁ秋の公募展があるからだろうけど」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Yeah, I've heard. A camp at this time of year, huh. Well, it's probably for the fall Open Exhibition."

strings.text: 「秋の公募展？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The fall Open Exhibition?"

strings.text: 「お前は知らないか？　何でも海外の財団法人が出資している公募展らしいぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You don't know? Apparently it's an Open Exhibition funded by some overseas foundation."

strings.text: 「ああ、あれか、ムーア公募展だろ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, that one -- the Moore Open Exhibition, right?

strings.text: 大昔に草薙健一郎が最高賞であるプラティヌ・エポラールを受賞したっていうやつだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: The one where ages ago Kusanagi Ken'ichirou won the top prize, the Platine Epaulard."

strings.text: 「そうそう、最近では官展よりも名誉な賞だと聞いてる」
strings.speaker: 藍
