strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But your taste really is nasty, you know.

strings.text: お前、俺が教会を調べているのを知ってるのって、お前自身があの教会に何かある事を知っていたからだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: The reason you knew I was investigating the church was because you already knew there was something at that church yourself, right?"

strings.text: 「微妙に正解」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sort of correct."

strings.text: 「あの教会に何があるかは知らないわ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I don't know what's at that church.

strings.text: ただ、私は明石先輩の行動を監視していた。明石先輩もあんたみたいに教会を行き来してたからね。尾行してたら、たまたまあんたの姿を見た。ってだけよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: I've just been watching Akashi-senpai's movements. He was going back and forth to that church, same as you. While I was tailing him, I happened to spot you. That's all."

strings.text: 「なるほど、明石を尾行していたのか、まぁ、正攻法だろうな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see, so you were tailing Akashi -- well, that's the orthodox approach, I suppose."

strings.text: 「そんな正攻法じゃ、あの人はしっぽなんか出さないけどね。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That kind of orthodox approach won't get him to slip up, though.

strings.text: たぶん尾行もばれてたと思うし……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: I'm pretty sure he knew he was being followed, too..."

strings.text: 「勘が良いんだよな。あいつは……
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "He's got sharp instincts. That guy...

strings.text: 動物的というか何というか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Animal-like, or something..."

strings.text: 「だいぶ前から、明石先輩はあの教会の事を調べていた。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Akashi-senpai has been investigating that church for quite a while.

strings.text: さっき話に出てた、風船の話あるでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Remember the balloon story that came up earlier?"

strings.text: 「ああ、ダッチワイフ風船で空を飛んだってやつか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that one about flying into the sky with a sex doll balloon?"

strings.text: 「それこそダッチワイフなんて飾りよ。いかにも先輩らしい“本来の目的”を誤魔化すための“<r けれんみ>外連味</r>”ってやつ、本当の目的は風船で空を飛ぶ事だったわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The sex doll was just decoration. It's classic senpai -- a bit of showy flair to distract from his 'real purpose.' The real purpose was to fly through the sky by balloon."

strings.text: 「なんだ本当に風船おじさんみたいに風船で太平洋でも横断しようとしてたのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What, was he actually trying to cross the Pacific by balloon like that balloon man?"

strings.text: 「そんなわけないでしょ。あの飛行は、教会の全体像。特によく見えない上部構造を上から観察するためにやったものよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Of course not. That flight was to observe the church as a whole -- especially the upper structure, which is hard to see from below."

strings.text: 「観察？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Observe?"

strings.text: 「着地に失敗して骨折したけど、滞空時間は結構あったというわ。かれこれ一時間ぐらい浮遊してたって話だし」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "He botched the landing and broke a bone, but they say he stayed airborne for quite some time. He was apparently floating for about an hour."

strings.text: 「そんな長時間浮遊してたのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "He was up there that long?"

strings.text: 「だから大騒ぎになったのよ。数分だったら目撃だってされないわよ。相当空の上で粘ったみたいよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's why it became such a huge fuss. If it had only been a few minutes, no one would have even spotted him. Sounds like he really hung on up there in the sky."

strings.text: 「なるほど、それを聞く限り、アンカーを打って一定の場所でとどまっていたという事か」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. From that, it sounds like he anchored himself and held station in one spot."

strings.text: 「だからといって、ヤツが教会を上から見るためにダッチワイフにヘリウムつめて空飛んだという証拠にはならん。あくまでも可能性だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even so, that's not proof he filled a sex doll with helium and flew just to look at the church from above. It's still only a possibility."

strings.text: 「確証が無くて言ってるわけではないわ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I'm not saying this without evidence.

strings.text: 普通ならそんな事はありえない。でも明石先輩ならやりかねない。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Ordinarily it would be unthinkable. But Akashi-senpai is the type who would do it.

strings.text: ほら、これ見て……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Here, look at this..."

strings.text: 「これは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This is......"

strings.text: 「明石先輩が撮った写真と写生、そしてメモ書きよ。細かな構造的な分析もしているわ。だからあれは上空から建築の構造を調べるためにやった事だと言ってるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "These are photos and sketches Akashi-senpai took, along with his notes. He's done detailed structural analysis too. That's why I'm saying he did it to study the building's structure from above."

strings.text: 「たしかに、これは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, this really is..."

strings.text: 飛行して上から観察しないかぎり絶対に描けない様なメモであった。
strings.translated: They were notes of a kind impossible to produce without observing from above in flight.

strings.text: 鳥谷の言う通り、あいつは教会の構造を知るために空を飛んだとしか考えられない、決定的な証拠。
strings.translated: Just as Toritani said, decisive proof -- there's no explanation but that he flew through the sky to learn the church's structure.

strings.text: 「それにしても、何でお前が明石が撮った写真なんて持ってるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Still, why do you have photos that Akashi took?"

strings.text: 「明石先輩が持ってたものは全部学校に没収されたのよ。当たり前でしょ。あんな騒ぎ起こしたんだから、こんなもん全部没収されるわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Everything Akashi-senpai had was confiscated by the school. Of course it was. After causing a commotion like that, all of this was bound to be seized."

strings.text: 「でも何でお前が持ってるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So then why do you have it..."

strings.text: 「それはいろいろとね。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's a matter of various things.

strings.text: 蛇の道は蛇って言うじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: There's a saying, isn't there -- 'set a snake to catch a snake.'"

strings.text: なるほど、若田あたりからだろうな……。
strings.translated: Right -- probably from Wakata, then.

strings.text: 草薙健一郎のラフが見つかった時といい、若田と鳥谷のパイプは生徒と教師という関係とも少し違う様な気がする。
strings.translated: Same as when Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's rough sketches turned up. The pipeline between Wakata and Toritani seems just slightly different from the usual student-and-teacher relationship.

strings.text: 「なるほど、そこまで調べていたのか。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see -- so you'd investigated that far.

strings.text: それで？　そこまで知っているお前は、明石がこれから何をすると予測する？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: So? Knowing all that, what do you predict Akashi is going to do next?"

strings.text: 「つい最近、それと同じ事を私に言われて、あんたは何て答えたかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Just recently, when I said the exact same thing to you, how did you answer?"

strings.text: 「“いや、別に断定出来るものがあるわけじゃないが……。それよりお前は明石が何か企んでるといまだに疑ってるのか？”
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'No, it's not that I have anything I can say for certain... more importantly, you still suspect Akashi is plotting something?'

strings.text: ったく、どの口が言うんだか……だいたい分かってるじゃないのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Honestly, listen to yourself... you've mostly worked it out already, haven't you?"

strings.text: 「いや、あの時点では断定出来る材料は無かった。本当に何となくの予感でしか無かった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, at that point I really had nothing to go on for a definite conclusion. It was truly just a vague hunch..."

strings.text: 「今の私も同じよ。いまだ断定出来る材料は無いわ……
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's the same for me now. I still have nothing that would let me say for sure...

strings.text: ただ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Only..."

strings.text: 「ただ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just?"

strings.text: 「いや、何でもないわ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "No, never mind..."

strings.text: 「さて、さて、こんな無駄話してる場合でもないわ。なんと言っても３日後には合宿だからね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Anyway, this isn't the time for pointless chatter. Three days from now is the camp, after all."

strings.text: 「そうみたいだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Seems that way..."

strings.text: 「あんたは行かないの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Aren't you coming?"

strings.text: 「川内野が嫌がるだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kawachino would hate that, wouldn't she?"

strings.text: 「そんな事ないわよ。あれで優美は、あんたの事結構気に入ってるんだからさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's not true. Yumi actually rather likes you, believe it or not."

strings.text: 「川内野が？　いや、そりゃ無いだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kawachino? No, that can't be right."

strings.text: 「まぁ、そうでしょうね。あんたから見たら、そう見えても仕方がないわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, I suppose so. From where you're standing, it can't be helped that you'd see it that way."

strings.text: 「でも、優美だってみんなで行きたいと思ってるわ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But Yumi does want everyone to go together.

strings.text: 美術部全員。あんたも圭ももちろん明石先輩もトーマスまで含めて、全員で合宿に行きたいと思っている」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: The whole art club. You, Kei, Akashi-senpai of course, and even Thomas -- she wants us all to go to the camp together."

strings.text: 「みんなで？　いや、それはマジで無いだろ。特にトーマスの事すげぇ嫌ってるじゃねぇかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "All of us? No, seriously, no way. She absolutely can't stand Thomas, for one."

strings.text: 「まったく人を見る目ないわね。あの娘は結構、部活思いなのよ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You've got no eye for people at all. That girl actually cares a lot about the club.

strings.text: みんな一緒で弓張美術部って事を良く理解しているわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: She understands well that it's all of us together that makes the Yumihari art club."

strings.text: 「そんなもんかねぇ……良くわからんが、
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so... I really don't get it,

strings.text: とりあえず、お前らだけで楽しんできてくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: but anyway, you all just enjoy yourselves without me."

strings.text: 「これだけ言っても、あんた参加しないの？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "After all this, you're still not coming?

strings.text: ったく薄情ね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Honestly, so cold-hearted."

strings.text: 「薄情ならいいじゃないか……
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Cold-hearted's fine, isn't it...

strings.text: 無情なら、“情け無い”なわけだから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Heartless would be 'without heart,' after all."

strings.text: 「どんな親父ギャグよ……バカみたい」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What kind of dad joke is that... how idiotic."

strings.text: 「そうだな。たしかに親父ギャグだった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're right. That really was a dad joke..."

strings.text: 「さてと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "All right then..."

strings.text: 「戻るの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Heading back?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, guess so.

strings.text: 稟や川内野の絵を見てやらないといけないしな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I still need to take a look at Rin and Kawachino's paintings."

strings.text: 「ふっ、嘘が下手ね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Heh, you're a bad liar..."

strings.text: 「なんか言ったか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Did you say something?"

strings.text: 「何でも？　とっとと行ったら？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Not at all. Why don't you get going already?

strings.text: 夏といえどもちんたらしてたら日なんか暮れるわよ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: It may be summer, but if you dawdle, the sun will set on you.

strings.text: あんまり暗いと調べようがないでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: If it's too dark, you won't be able to investigate, will you?"

strings.text: 「はい、はい、鳥谷は何でもお見通しだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, yeah, Toritani sees through everything..."

strings.text: 「何でもお見通しだったら、ここまで苦戦しなかったわよ……。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "If I saw through everything, I wouldn't have struggled this much...

strings.text: ったく……何で４月の時点で気がつかなかったんだか……
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Honestly... why didn't I notice back in April..."

strings.text: 鳥谷が苦々しくつぶやく。
strings.translated: Toritani muttered bitterly.

strings.text: 「とりあえず行ってくる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'll be off, then."

strings.text: 「はい、はい、行ってらっしゃい」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yes, yes, take care."

strings.text: 「あれは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's..."

strings.text: 俺は思わず身を隠してしまう。
strings.translated: I found myself instinctively hiding.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Akashi..."

strings.text: 明石がまた教会の壁の前に立っていた。
strings.translated: Akashi was standing before the church wall again.

strings.text: ただし、今日は、壁に向いてでは無く、壁に背を向けている。
strings.translated: Only today he wasn't facing the wall; his back was to it.

strings.text: 「何を見ている……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is he looking at..."

strings.text: 明石は間違いなく、何かを見つめていた。
strings.translated: Akashi was, without any doubt, staring at something.

strings.text: 「何を見つめているんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is he staring at..."

strings.text: 数十分、突っ立ってるだけならかなり長い時間だ。
strings.translated: Standing stock still for tens of minutes is a very long time.

strings.text: 何かを見つめて、真剣に考えている。
strings.translated: He was staring at something and thinking seriously.

strings.text: で、なければ、あんな視線で一点だけを見つめる事など出来ない。
strings.translated: Otherwise, no one could keep their eyes fixed on a single point with a gaze like that.

strings.text: 俺はやつが立っていた場所に同じ様に立つ。
strings.translated: I positioned myself in the same spot where he had been standing.

strings.text: あいつが見ていた方向、見ていたものを見つめようとする……。
strings.translated: I tried to look in the direction he had been looking, at what he had been looking at...

strings.text: 「何が見えるんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What can be seen from here..."

strings.text: いくら見つめても、そこには学校を囲む植木と、町並みしか見えない。
strings.translated: No matter how hard I looked, all I could see was the hedge surrounding the school and the townscape beyond.

strings.text: 「特に目立つ物はないか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nothing especially conspicuous..."

strings.text: 小さな公園が見える。多数のマンションが見える。他、何かビルの様なものが見える。なんの建物かは良く分からないが、まぁめずらしいものではなさそうだ。
strings.translated: There's a small park. Clusters of apartment buildings. Beyond them, something that looks like an office building -- I can't tell what kind, though it hardly seems unusual.

strings.text: つまり、ごく当たり前の風景が見えるだけだ……。
strings.translated: In other words, all I could see was an utterly ordinary landscape...

strings.text: 「何を見ていたんだ……あの男……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What was he looking at... that man..."

strings.text: 明石亘。
strings.translated: Akashi Wataru.

strings.text: その付き合いは、この学校に入った時から……、
strings.translated: My association with him began when I entered this school......

strings.text: 丸々二年以上の付き合いとなる。
strings.translated: a full two years and more of acquaintance now.

strings.text: 「宇宙人か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "An alien, huh......"

strings.text: 予想の斜め上をいく天才。
strings.translated: A genius whose thinking always went sideways of what you'd predict.

strings.text: 伊達に弓張の美術部の部長をやっていたわけではない。
strings.translated: He hadn't been made head of Yumihari's art club for nothing.

strings.text: 変則的な思考回路、すべての事がデタラメの様に見えて、あいつの中ではすべてが一本につながっている。
strings.translated: His erratic train of thought -- everything he did looked like sheer nonsense, yet in his own mind it all connected along a single thread.

strings.text: 普通の連中に見えない連関が見え、逆に普通の人間が見える関連性が見えなかったりもする。
strings.translated: He saw connections that ordinary people couldn't see, and conversely failed to see the connections that ordinary people did.

strings.text: 世界的な天才画家、草薙健一郎とも違う。
strings.translated: Different from that world-class genius of a painter, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou.

strings.text: 絶対的美術の素養に恵まれた夏目圭とも違う……。
strings.translated: And different from Natsume Kei, blessed with absolute artistic aptitude......

strings.text: むしろ彼らに比べれば、純粋な芸術的な才能は劣っている。
strings.translated: If anything, in terms of raw artistic talent, he was inferior to them.

strings.text: だが明石にも違った天性があった。
strings.translated: But Akashi had a gift of a different kind.

strings.text: 「正直……この弓張学園に入った時は驚いた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Honestly...... when I entered Yumihari Academy, I was floored......"

strings.text: それまでの俺の人生で知っていたのは、草薙健一郎と夏目圭という二人の天才。
strings.translated: Up until then, the geniuses I had known in my life were the two named Kusanagi Ken'ichirou and Natsume Kei.

strings.text: その二人の天才ですら、俺には驚異的だった。
strings.translated: Even those two alone were staggering to me.

strings.text: 世の中にはこんな連中もいるのかと……。
strings.translated: To think there were people like that in the world......

strings.text: だが、弓張学園。
strings.translated: And yet, at Yumihari Academy...

strings.text: その美術部界隈の才能の濃度は異常だ。
strings.translated: the density of talent in and around its art club was abnormal.

strings.text: なんでこんな連中が集まったのだろう。
strings.translated: Why had this crowd all gathered here?

strings.text: 「こんな狭い場所に、才能がひしめき合うとはな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For talent to be packed together in such a narrow space......"

strings.text: それがこの学園の歴史、伝統と言うやつなのだろうか。
strings.translated: Was that what people meant by this school's history, its tradition?

strings.text: いや、長い歴史の中でもこれほど濃度が高かった時代もないだろう……。
strings.translated: No, even across its long history, there could hardly have been an era with a concentration this high......

strings.text: 「そういうものなんだろうな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I guess that's just how it is......"

strings.text: 偉人の自伝やらを読むと、才能がある人間の周りには、何故か才能のある人間が集まる、ということがよくある。
strings.translated: When you read the autobiographies of great figures, you often find that, for some reason, talented people cluster around other talented people.

strings.text: しかも、それが同じ時期の同じ地域に固まったりする。
strings.translated: And on top of that, they get clumped together in the same region during the same period.

strings.text: それが偶然なのか、必然なのか分からないが……。
strings.translated: Whether that's coincidence or necessity, I don't know......

strings.text: 「しかし……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even so......"

strings.text: やつの思考がまったくトレス出来ない。
strings.translated: I can't trace his thinking at all.

strings.text: 「いや、材料はすべて揃っているんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, the materials are all here."

strings.text: 「たぶん、ほとんどの材料は揃っている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Probably, most of the materials are in place."

strings.text: だが、あいつの思考には追いつけない……。
strings.translated: But I can't catch up with his thoughts......

strings.text: 「天才どもめ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Damn geniuses......"

strings.text: 俺は明石が見つめていた先を見つめる。
strings.translated: I stared out in the same direction Akashi had been staring.

strings.text: その先に何が見えていたのかさっぱりだ。
strings.translated: What he saw out there, I hadn't the faintest idea.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew..."

strings.text: こんな事やってたら日が暮れてしまう。
strings.translated: If I kept at this, the sun would set.

strings.text: 夜になったら、すべてが見えなくなる。
strings.translated: Once night came, I wouldn't be able to see anything.

strings.text: 俺は何かを探そうとするが、見つからない。
strings.translated: I tried to search for something, but couldn't find it.

strings.text: 一人で立っているといろいろな考えが浮かんでは消えていく。
strings.translated: Standing alone, various thoughts float up in my mind and vanish again.

strings.text: 「明石が休学か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So Akashi's taking a leave of absence......"

strings.text: 留年とばかり思っていた。
strings.translated: I'd been sure he was being held back a year.

strings.text: 実際、あいつは授業をさぼってばかりいたし……。
strings.translated: And in truth, he was always skipping class......

strings.text: 留年する理由なんていくらでもありそうだ。
strings.translated: reasons for being held back seemed endless.

strings.text: 「だが実際は違った。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But that wasn't the case.

strings.text: あいつがいつか言ってた通りだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: It was just as he said once......"

strings.text: 「だから、ワシは少しだけ、卒業するタイミングを見計らっていただけと言っとるじゃろうが……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Like I said, I was just biding my time a bit, waiting for the right moment to graduate......"

strings.text: 「待っていた……たしかに何かのために先延ばししていた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "He was waiting...... he really was putting it off for the sake of something......"

strings.text: 「あいつの言ってることは、何がマジで、何が冗談なんだかさっぱりだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "With that guy, I can never tell what's serious and what's a joke......"

strings.text: 「やつは何を待っていた？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What was he waiting for?"

strings.text: 夏まで待っていた……。
strings.translated: He was waiting until summer......

strings.text: その理由はある程度は分かる。
strings.translated: That much I can guess to some extent.

strings.text: 溶けやすい上履き。
strings.translated: Indoor slippers, easy to melt down.

strings.text: ストーブで熱するといえども、真冬ではすぐに固まってしまう。
strings.translated: Even heated on a stove, in midwinter they'd harden right up again.

strings.text: 真夏に作業した方が絶対に効率が良いだろう。
strings.translated: Working in the peak of summer would be far more efficient.

strings.text: たぶん、そのための業務用扇風機でもある。
strings.translated: That's probably what the industrial fan is for, too.

strings.text: 溶けたゴムを、手早く乾燥させて、巨大なキャンバスに定着させる。
strings.translated: Melt the rubber, dry it out quickly, and fix it onto that enormous canvas.

strings.text: だからやつは夏を待っていた。
strings.translated: That's why he was waiting for summer.

strings.text: だが、それだけなのだろうか？
strings.translated: But is that all there is to it?

strings.text: もし、それだけが理由なら、すでに実行にうつすチャンスは何度もあった。
strings.translated: If that were the only reason, he'd already had plenty of chances to actually go through with it.

strings.text: 今日も暑かった……。
strings.translated: Today too was hot......

strings.text: 今月だけでも何度も３０℃を越えた日がある。
strings.translated: Just this month there have been any number of days over 30 degrees.

strings.text: ３５℃越えの日だってあったはずだ……。
strings.translated: There must have been days that topped 35, too......

strings.text: ただの夏を待っていたのじゃない。
strings.translated: He wasn't just waiting for summer.

strings.text: たぶん、夏のある日、特定の日を狙っているはずだ……。
strings.translated: Most likely, he was aiming at a specific day, some particular day in summer......

strings.text: 「あいつが待っている。特定の日って何だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "He's waiting. What is this particular day?"

strings.text: 「のぞきですか？」
strings.translated: "Peeping, are we?"

strings.text: 「なんだ、お前か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh, it's you......"

strings.text: 小沙智
strings.translated: Kosachi

strings.text: 「最近、良く教会に来るわね。小牧が目的なの？
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "You've been showing up at the church a lot lately. Is Komaki your target?

strings.text: だったら無駄よ。あの娘はあんたなんか相手にしないわ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: If so, you're wasting your time. That girl wouldn't give you the time of day."

strings.text: 「いや、結構話相手はしてくれる様な気がするが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, she actually keeps me company in conversation pretty well, or so it feels......"

strings.text: 「ふぅ、小牧も何であんたみたいなやつと言葉を交わすのかしらね……」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Hmph, I wonder why Komaki even bothers exchanging words with someone like you......"

strings.text: 「ひどい言われようだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's a harsh thing to say......"

strings.text: 「なんか似てるのよね……だから私は気に入らない」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "You resemble him, somehow...... that's why I don't like you."

strings.text: 「何と？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who?"

strings.text: 「亘とあんたよ。兄とあんたは何となく似てるわ……」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Wataru and you. You and my brother -- there's something similar about the two of you......"

strings.text: 「いや、それマジで勘弁してくれ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, seriously, spare me that.

strings.text: あいつに似てるとか、どんな罰ゲームなんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Being told I'm like him -- what kind of punishment game is that?"

strings.text: 「似てるわよ……あんたらは」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "You're alike...... the two of you."

strings.text: 「ひどい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's cruel......"

strings.text: 「今日も亘来てたわね」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Wataru came by again today."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうみたいだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, so it seems."

strings.text: 「今までほとんど教会なんか来た事なかったのに……まったく何を考えてるんだか……」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "He hardly ever came to the church before...... honestly, what on earth is he thinking......"

strings.text: 「という事は、明石が何を考えてるか、お前にも分からないという事か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Meaning, even you have no idea what Akashi's thinking?"

strings.text: 「当たり前でしょ。何で私にあの人の考えなんて分かるのよ。いつでも予想の斜め上なんだからさ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Obviously. How would I ever know what that man's thinking? He's always sideways of anything you'd predict."

strings.text: 「そうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 妹も明石の行動は分からないか……。
strings.translated: So even his sister can't read Akashi's actions, huh......

strings.text: 「今まで明石は教会にほとんど来た事なかったって言ってたよな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You just said Akashi almost never came to the church before.

strings.text: あいつが教会に頻繁に足を運ぶ様になったのはいつぐらいからだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: When did he start visiting it so often?"

strings.text: 「さぁねぇ……。良く分からないわ。
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Beats me...... I really don't know.

strings.text: あ、でも、私達が入学する前、何でも亘が一年の時には良くこの教会を見にきていたって聞いたわ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: Ah, but before we started here, apparently, back when Wataru was in his first year, he used to come see this church a lot -- so I heard."

strings.text: 「聞いた？　誰に？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Heard? From who?"

strings.text: 「神父さまよ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "The Father."

strings.text: 「ああ、今いないって神父か」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, the Father who's not here right now."

strings.text: 「いないわけじゃないわ。ただお休みになっているだけ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "It's not that he's not here. He's just on leave."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうらしいな。また復帰するためにお前らががんばっているらしいが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, so I've heard. And you're all working hard to bring him back, apparently."

strings.text: 「当たり前。神父さまはかならず良くなって帰ってくるわ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Of course. The Father will definitely get better and come back."

strings.text: なるほど、本当に神父思いなんだな。こいつ。
strings.translated: I see -- she really does care about the Father, this one.

strings.text: いやこいつら姉妹か……。
strings.translated: Or rather, these sisters do......

strings.text: 「神父の事が好きか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Do you like the Father?"

strings.text: 「当たり前でしょ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Obviously."

strings.text: 「まぁそうだな。じゃなきゃ、シスターなんてやってないよな。めんどくさそうな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, sure. Otherwise you wouldn't be doing something as bothersome as being a sister."

strings.text: 「あんたみたいに信仰心が無い人にはめんどくさそうに思えるかもしれないけど、これはこれで充実感があるのよ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "To someone with no faith like you it may seem like a bother, but this has its own kind of fulfillment."

strings.text: 「んな、ものかねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that how it is, I wonder......"

strings.text: 「神父さまにはね。小牧が世話になったのよ。昔の話だけど……」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "You see, Komaki was helped by the Father. It's a story from long ago......"

strings.text: 「世話？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Helped?"

strings.text: 「そう、子供の時にね……。まぁ今から考えたらつまらない事かもしれないし、みんなに言ったら笑われるかもしれないけど……
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Yes, when we were children...... Well, thinking back on it now, it may seem trivial, and if I told everyone they might laugh......

strings.text: でも小牧は、そして私も、神父さまの言葉に救われた」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: But Komaki, and I too, were saved by the Father's words."

strings.text: 今から考えたらつまらない事……。
strings.translated: Something that seems trivial in hindsight......

strings.text: 子供の時に精神的に、ここの神父に救われたという事だろうか……。
strings.translated: So as a child, she'd been saved mentally by the priest here......

strings.text: しかし、ガキの頃に精神的に神父に救われなければならないって……どんな悩みを抱えたガキだよ。
strings.translated: But needing to be saved mentally by a priest as a kid...... what kind of troubles was she carrying as a little kid?

strings.text: 「ま、だから、私なんて本当は信仰心が厚いんじゃなくて、小牧を救ってくれた神父さまが好きなだけかもしれないのだけどね……」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "So, you know, maybe I'm not really so devout after all -- maybe I just love the Father who saved Komaki......"

strings.text: 「明石と神父との接点は？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's the connection between Akashi and the Father?"

strings.text: 「いや、あんまり無いんじゃないかな？　私も良く分からないけど……」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Well, there isn't much of one, is there? Though I don't really know......"

strings.text: 「神父との接点は無い……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No connection with the Father......"

strings.text: 「そんな事もないみたいですよ」
strings.translated: "That doesn't quite seem to be the case."

strings.text: 「小牧」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Komaki."

strings.text: 小牧
strings.translated: Komaki

strings.text: 「楽しそうな話し声が聞こえてきましたので、思わず来てしまいました」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "I could hear the sound of a lively conversation, so I couldn't help coming over."

strings.text: 「た、楽しそうなんかじゃないっ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "It, it wasn't anything lively!"

strings.text: 「神父と明石の接点はあるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is there a connection between the Father and Akashi?"

strings.text: 「はい、私達が入学する前、ちょうどお兄ちゃんが一年生だった時に、良く神父様とお話をしたそうです」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Yes. Before we entered the school -- right when my brother was in his first year -- he apparently spoke often with the Father."

strings.text: 「え？　神父さまと亘が？　何の話するのよ。あの二人じゃ会話なんて成立しないでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Huh? The Father and Wataru? What would they even talk about? A conversation wouldn't hold together between those two, would it?"

strings.text: 「建築についてだったみたいですよ。あれでお兄ちゃん、建築関係の知識があるみたいで、良く神父さまとお話をしていたみたいです」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "It seems to have been about architecture. My brother, believe it or not, has knowledge of architectural matters, and apparently he often spoke with the Father about it."

strings.text: 「建築の……話……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "About architecture......"

strings.text: 「どうしましたか？」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Is something the matter?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、何でも無い、話を続けてくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, never mind. Go on."

strings.text: 「何でも、この教会の建築様式がすごくおもしろいものだと言うことで、お話が弾んだみたいですよ」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Apparently the architectural style of this church is exceedingly interesting, and their conversations really took off from there."

strings.text: 「まぁ、すごくめずらしい建築様式だがな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, it is an extremely unusual architectural style......"

strings.text: 「元々、誰がいつ設計して、それでいつ頃内装が改装されたのか、誰がしたのかとか、それこそいろいろなお話をされたと聞きます」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Who originally designed it and when, when the interior was renovated, who did it -- all sorts of things like that, I hear they talked about."

strings.text: 「そうなんだ。一年の時に教会に良く足を運んでいたってそういう事なんだ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "I see. So that's why he was coming to the church so often in his first year."

strings.text: 「はい、なんでもそのときに神父さまからいろいろなものももらったと言う話を聞きました」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Yes, and I hear that at the time the Father gave him various things as well."

strings.text: 「いろいろなもの？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Various things?"

strings.text: 「私も良くは分からないのですが……、なんか当時すごく興奮していたのを覚えてます。お兄ちゃんがあんな喜び方するなんてめずらしくて……」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "I don't really know either...... but I remember he was terribly excited about it back then. It's rare for my brother to show that kind of joy......"

strings.text: 「あいつが喜んでいるのなんかめずらしくないだろ。せんべい一つで大はしゃぎだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not rare for him to get excited. He'll go wild over a single rice cracker."

strings.text: 「それ、そうでもないんだよ。亘はさ、家だと外みたいなはしゃぎ方しないんだよ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "That, well, not really. At home Wataru doesn't get carried away the way he does outside."

strings.text: 「そうなのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 「愛想が悪いというわけではないのですが、いつも考え事をしている感じはありますね。特にここ最近は」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "He isn't unfriendly or anything, but he does always seem to be lost in thought. Especially lately."

strings.text: 「その考え事ってのが、高尚な事ならいいのだけど、だいたいろくでもない事ばかりだからね……ったく、何で大まじめでふざけた行動取るのか……」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "It'd be one thing if his thoughts were lofty, but they're mostly worthless...... honestly, why does he play the fool with such a straight face......"

strings.text: そういうのは、俺も人のこと言えないかもしれないな……。
strings.translated: In that respect, maybe I'm in no position to talk......

strings.text: 「とりあえず、明石は神父からいろいろな話を聞き、そして何かを受け取ったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So then, Akashi heard various things from the Father and received something from him?"

strings.text: 「はい、図版の様な設計図の様な……詳しくは良く分からないのですが……」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Yes, something like plans, or blueprints...... I don't know the details......"

strings.text: 「図版？　設計図？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Plans? Blueprints?"

strings.text: 「はい、ちゃんと見せてもらったわけではないので、ただそれを見て興奮しているお兄ちゃんの姿を覚えています……」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Yes, I wasn't actually shown them properly. I just remember my brother getting excited over them......"

strings.text: 図版……。
strings.translated: Plans......

strings.text: 設計図……。
strings.translated: Blueprints......

strings.text: あいつが大喜びする様な図版と設計図……。
strings.translated: Plans and blueprints that would delight that guy......

strings.text: 「そういえば、小牧言ってたな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, Komaki said something."

strings.text: 「何をですか？」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "About what?"

strings.text: 「教会の内装を改装したやつは、ここの教員だって」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The one who renovated the church's interior was a teacher here, right?"

strings.text: 「はい」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Yes."

strings.text: 「そいつ、非常勤だっただろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That guy was a part-timer, wasn't he?"

strings.text: 「へ？　よ、良く分かりませんが……」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Huh? I, I don't really know......"

strings.text: 「先輩！」
strings.translated: "Senpai!"

strings.text: 校舎から大声が聞こえる。
strings.translated: A loud voice came from the school building.

strings.text: 氷川の声だ。
strings.translated: It's Hikawa's voice.

strings.text: 「そんなところで何やってるんでしょうか！」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "What are you doing over there?!"

strings.text: 声の方向を見ると、美術室の窓をいっぱいにあけて叫んでいる。
strings.translated: Looking toward the voice, I saw her shouting with the art room window flung wide open.

strings.text: 「何を外で見知らぬ女性と油を売ってるのですかー！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Why are you slacking off outside with some unfamiliar woman?!"

strings.text: 「やれやれうるさい連中だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Good grief, what a noisy bunch......"

strings.text: 「お仲間が呼んでるわよ。早くいきなさいよ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Your companions are calling you. Hurry up and go."

strings.text: 「あれを仲間というか…ねぇ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whether you'd call those 'companions'...... well."

strings.text: 「仲間じゃないですか、私は美術部員さん達がうらやましいですよ。みなさん本当に仲良さそうで」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "They are companions, aren't they? I envy the art club members. Everyone really does seem so close."

strings.text: 「はしゃぎすぎて、大問題起こさなければだけどね……」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "So long as they don't cause any major trouble getting too carried away......"

strings.text: 「あはははは……。そこまで大問題起こしてないじゃないですか……」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Ahahahaha...... They haven't caused any trouble that big, have they......"

strings.text: 「起こしてるわよ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "They have."

strings.text: 「まぁまぁ、退学になる様な事は無かったわけですし……」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Now, now, at least nothing that would get anyone expelled......"

strings.text: 「あったら清清するわね！　亘が退学なんて！」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "If there had been, I'd be relieved! Wataru getting expelled!"

strings.text: 「呼んでるのが聞こえないのですかー！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Can't you hear us calling you?!"

strings.text: 「ああ、うるせぇなぁ……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, yeah, so noisy......

strings.text: まぁ、いいや、貴重な情報ありがとな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Well, whatever. Thanks for the valuable information."

strings.text: 「貴重な情報？　何それ？」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Valuable information? What's that?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、こっちの話だ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, that's on my end.

strings.text: んじゃ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Well then......"

strings.text: 「何やってるのですか……。炎天下でまた新たなる女生徒といちゃついて……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "What are you doing......? Flirting with yet another new female student under the blazing sun......"

strings.text: 「新たな女生徒といちゃつくって何だよ？　どんな目してるんだお前」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'Flirting with a new female student,' huh? What kind of eyes do you have?"

strings.text: 「狼の様な鋭き眼光」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Sharp eyes like a wolf's."

strings.text: 「んであんな大声出してどこが分からないんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And yelling that loud, how could I not know where you were?"

strings.text: 「ほう、無視ですか……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Oh, so you were ignoring us......"

strings.text: 「無視もするわ。それでどこを教えてほしいか聞いてるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Of course I ignored you. So what did you want me to help with?"

strings.text: 「私はいいですから、稟先輩のこの部分見てあげてください」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "It's fine for me, but please look at this part for Rin-senpai."

strings.text: 「え？　お前じゃないの？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? It wasn't you?"

strings.text: 「ご、ごめんね……。草薙くん用事あったんだよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-sorry...... Kusanagi-kun, you had something to do, right?"

strings.text: 「用事と言うのでしょうかねぇ。教会の前で知らない女子と楽しそうに会話してただけですし……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I don't know if you'd call it 'something to do.' You were just chatting cheerfully with some girl you don't know in front of the church......"

strings.text: 「そ、そうなんだ。いやぁ、本当に草薙くんは女の子に人気だねぇ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Oh, r-really. Wow, Kusanagi-kun really is popular with the girls, huh."

strings.text: 「なんで、そうなるんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How does it come to that?!"

strings.text: 「これだけ女子豊富な美術部のコミュニケーションだけでは飽きたらず、外で新しい女性とお話とは、さすがは草薙先輩ですなぁ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Not content with just communicating in an art club overflowing with girls, chatting up new women outside too -- as expected of Kusanagi-senpai."

strings.text: 「あほ、生徒会長の明石小牧と副生徒会長の明石小沙智だよ。ちょっと世間話をしていただけだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Idiot, that was Akashi Komaki, the student council president, and Akashi Kosachi, the vice-president. We were just making a little small talk......"

strings.text: 「え？　それって、明石先輩の妹さん達ですよね。
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Huh? Those are Akashi-senpai's sisters, right?

strings.text: めずらしいですね。彼女達と世間話なんて……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: That's rare. Small talk with them, of all people......"

strings.text: 「まぁ、俺もいろいろあるんだよ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I've got my own things going on.

strings.text: んで？　どこだ？　どの部分が分からない？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: So? Where is it? Which part don't you get?"

strings.text: 「え、えっとですね……」
strings.speaker: 稟

strings.text: 「ふぅ……疲れた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew...... I'm tired."

strings.text: 「すみません。毎日、毎日教えてもらって……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm sorry. Making you teach me day after day......"

strings.text: 「いや、教える事自体は別にそんな疲れる事ではないさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, teaching itself isn't particularly tiring."

strings.text: 「補習ですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Supplementary lessons?"

strings.text: 「まぁな、明日で終わりだが、んー。その後再試もあるんだけどさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, they end tomorrow, but, hmm, then there are the make-up exams after that."

strings.text: 「終わったら合宿だからね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Once those are done, it's the training camp."

strings.text: 「俺には関係ないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's got nothing to do with me, right?"

strings.text: 「何で関係ないのでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Why is it nothing to do with you?"

strings.text: 「はぁ？　俺は美術部員じゃないし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? I'm not an art club member."

strings.text: 「なんで美術部員じゃない人が、いつも美術室にいるのでしょう。
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Then why is someone who isn't an art club member always in the art room?

strings.text: 書類上は知りませんが、草薙先輩は誰がどう見ても弓張美術部員だと思います」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: I don't know about the paperwork, but any way you look at it, Kusanagi-senpai is a Yumihari art club member."

strings.text: 「そうだとして、お前、俺たちが行くの嫌なんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even if that were so, you don't want us going, right?"

strings.text: 「そうですね……」

strings.translated: I got complained at for some reason.

strings.text: 「ぷっ……。ぷぷぷ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Pfft...... pfpfpf......"

strings.text: 突然、鳥谷が笑い出す。
strings.translated: Suddenly, Toritani burst out laughing.

strings.text: 先ほどの不機嫌な表情などすでに欠片もなかった。
strings.translated: Not a scrap remained of that sullen expression from before.

strings.text: 「分かったわよ。分かった。これ以上、稟ちゃんにしゃべらせたら、どんどんいろんな<r こ>娘</r>のボロが出そうだから。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "All right, all right, I get it. If I let Rin-chan talk any more, various girls' secrets are going to keep spilling out.

strings.text: 行くわよ。ついて行くわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Let's go. I'll come along."

strings.text: 「うん。まこちゃんも私と新しい水着選ぼう」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes. Mako-chan, let's pick out a new swimsuit together too."

strings.text: 「ふぅ、なんか稟ちゃんってすごいねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Whew, you're really something, Rin-chan."

strings.text: 「何がですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「ライバルが増える様な事を自らするなんて」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Deliberately doing things that will increase your rivals."

strings.text: 「あれ？　その言い方ってやっぱりまこちゃんも……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Oh? The way you put it, does that mean you also......"

strings.text: 「ち、違うわよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "N-no, that's not it!"

strings.text: 「冗談ですよ。ライバルとか良く分かりませんが、私ただ、今、みんなで楽しく過ごせたらなぁ。と思ってます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm joking. I don't really understand this rival business, but right now I just want us all to enjoy ourselves together."

strings.text: 「私にとっては弓張学園での最初で最後の夏ですし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "For me, this is the first and last summer at Yumihari Academy......"

strings.text: 「……なるほどね。
strings.speaker: 真琴

strings.text: まぁあんたらしいわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Well, that's just like you."

strings.text: 「わかった。んじゃ、草薙と圭をつれてみんなで水着買いに行きましょうか」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Got it. Then let's bring Kusanagi and Kei along and go buy swimsuits together."

strings.text: 「さすがにアンタの参加は却下よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You're not invited, though, obviously."

strings.text: 「ノォー！」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Noooo!"

strings.text: 夕方のショッピングモール。
strings.translated: The shopping mall in the evening.

strings.text: 俺はここに来る事自体滅多にない。
strings.translated: I hardly ever come to a place like this to begin with.

strings.text: だからいつもより人が多いのか少ないのかすら分からないが、
strings.translated: So I can't even tell whether there are more or fewer people than usual,

strings.text: ショッピングモールという場所は、こんなに人が多いのだろうか？
strings.translated: but are shopping malls always this crowded?

strings.text: 「夕方なのに人が多いな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even though it's evening, there's a lot of people......"

strings.text: 「夏休みに入っているためか、子供連れも多いのかもしれませんねぇ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Since we're on summer break, there are probably more families with kids too."

strings.text: 「圭さん遅いですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kei-san is late, isn't he?"

strings.text: 「バイクで合流って事になっているが、道にでも迷っているんだろうか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "He's supposed to meet up with us on his bike, but maybe he got lost."

strings.text: 「そうねぇ。ま、着いたら携帯電話に連絡してくれる予定だから、いいんじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I guess. Well, he said he'd call our cell phones once he arrives, so it should be fine."

strings.text: 「さぁ、行きましょうかねっ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "All right, shall we get going?"

strings.text: 「って、先に走り出したりして、優美は店知ってるの？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Hey, running off ahead like that -- Yumi, do you even know the store?"

strings.text: 「知るとか知らないとかいいから、とりあえず里奈は私と早くどこかの更衣室に潜り込む！　そして二人で密室で密室で密室ハァハァ……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Knowing or not knowing doesn't matter -- Rina, hurry up and sneak into some fitting room with me! And then, just the two of us, in a closed room, in a closed room, in a closed room, huff huff......"

strings.text: 「あはは、あんたと付き合い長いけど、引くわー」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ahaha, we've been friends a long time, but you creep me out."

strings.text: 「稟先輩！　早く！　早く更衣室で服を脱いでください！　選ぶのはそれからです！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Rin-senpai! Hurry! Hurry and take off your clothes in the fitting room! Choosing comes after that!"

strings.text: 「そ、それ違う様な……水着選んでからだよ。普通」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-that seems wrong...... you pick out the swimsuit first. Normally."

strings.text: なんか川内野に手を引かれて稟と氷川はお店の中に入っていった。
strings.translated: Somehow, Kawachino dragged Rin and Hikawa by the hand into the store.

strings.text: 「乗り気じゃなかった優美もショッピングは楽しそうじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yumi wasn't keen on this either, but doesn't she look like she's enjoying the shopping?"

strings.text: 「いや、あれはショッピングを楽しむ様子ではないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that doesn't look like enjoying shopping."

strings.text: 「そう？　あれって優美の照れ隠しじゃないの？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Really? Isn't that just Yumi hiding her embarrassment?

strings.text: あの娘って、結構ああやってみんなでわいわいするの好きじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: That girl actually likes making a fuss together like this."

strings.text: 「そうか？　いつもウザそうだが？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so? She always looks annoyed."

strings.text: 「そんなわけないじゃない。だったら今日だって一緒に来てないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "No way. If that were true, she wouldn't have come along today."

strings.text: 「そんなもんか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So that's how it is......"

strings.text: 「という事はお前もまんざらではないって事か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Which means you're not entirely against this either?"

strings.text: 「何言ってるのよ。あれだけ無理矢理誘われて断り切れるわけないでしょ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What are you talking about? Being dragged along that forcefully, of course I couldn't refuse."

strings.text: 「だったら楽しくないのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then you're not enjoying it?"

strings.text: 「楽しいわよ。そりゃ、みんなが嬉しそうだったら。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I'm enjoying it. Sure, when everyone else is happy.

strings.text: でもお金が無いからショッピングは乗り気ではないけどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: But since I don't have money, I'm not enthusiastic about shopping."

strings.text: 「本当にそうか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that really the truth?"

strings.text: 「何が？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Scared of what?"

strings.text: 「みんなが帰った後に、お前だけで明石の事を調べようとしてたんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Weren't you planning to look into Akashi on your own after everyone went home?"

strings.text: 「う……いちいち鋭いわねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ugh...... you're always so sharp......"

strings.text: 「でも、あんな楽しそうな後輩に水を差すような真似はしたくないじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But I didn't want to spoil the mood when the underclassmen are having so much fun, you know."

strings.text: 「なるほど、後輩思いだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. Caring for your juniors, huh."

strings.text: 俺たちはゆっくりと歩き出す。
strings.translated: We start walking slowly.

strings.text: 「奇遇ですね……」
strings.translated: "What a coincidence......"

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「食材の買い出しをこんな場所でもやるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Do you do your grocery shopping in a place like this too?"

strings.text: 「お前こそ、何でこんな場所に？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're the one to talk -- what are you doing in a place like this?"

strings.text: 「このショッピングモールは聖ルーアンのすぐ近くだから、帰りに良く寄ります」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "This shopping mall is right near St. Rouen, so I often stop by on my way home."

strings.text: 「あれ？　この娘……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? This girl......"

strings.text: 「こほん……。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Ahem...

strings.text: ご挨拶が遅れました。わたくし、夏目家の次女で雫と申します」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Forgive my late introduction. I am the second daughter of the Natsume family, Shizuku."

strings.text: 「って！　藍先生のところの？　妹さん？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wait! Ai-sensei's? Her little sister?"

strings.text: 「この前は取り乱してお見苦しい姿をお見せして申し訳ありませんでした」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I'm sorry for the unseemly display of losing my composure the other day."

strings.text: 「あ、あれ？　いいって、いいって、いきなり押しかけた私達が悪いんだからさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh, that? It's fine, it's fine, we were the ones at fault for suddenly barging in."

strings.text: 「それにしてもテレビで見る人を直に見るって、やっぱり感慨深いわねぇ。草薙<r くすか>葛佳</r>って言ったら有名人だもんね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Even so, seeing someone I've seen on TV in person really is moving. Kusanagi Kusuka is a celebrity, after all."

strings.text: 「ぶっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Pfft--"

strings.text: 「どうしましたか？　直哉？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "What's wrong, Naoya?"

strings.text: 「いま、草薙葛とか言ってたか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Did you just say Kusanagi Kuzu?"

strings.text: 「そうよ。草薙葛佳。ＣＭとかバリバリ流れてるじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. Kusanagi Kusuka. Her commercials are running everywhere."

strings.text: 「お、お前……そんな芸名でやってたのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Y-you...... that was the stage name you were using?"

strings.text: 「はい、そんな芸名でやってましたが……どうしましたか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, that's the stage name I was using...... is something wrong?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや……いやな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no...... it's nothing......"

strings.text: お前の偽名は、そんなにバリエーションが少ないのかよ。
strings.translated: Just how little variation is there in your aliases?

strings.text: 「どうしたの？　何？　あんた今まで雫さんの芸名も知らずにいたの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What is it? What? You didn't even know Shizuku-san's stage name until now?"

strings.text: 「いつぞやなど、私の写真を凝視していましたから、当然芸名も知っていると思ってましたが……他の場所が気になりすぎて文字が目に入りませんでしたか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That time, you were staring intently at my photos, so I assumed you naturally knew my stage name...... were you too busy staring at other places to notice the letters?"

strings.text: 「どんな写真見てたのよ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What kind of photos were you looking at......"

strings.text: 「水着写真でした……特に白の水着を一番好まれていた様です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Swimsuit photos...... he seemed to particularly favor the white swimsuit."

strings.text: 「違う、違う。雑誌に付箋が貼ってあったんだよ。それをたまたま開いてだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no. There was a sticky note on the magazine. I just happened to open to it."

strings.text: 「でも１０分以上見てました。あれほど見ててなぜ気がつかなかったのでしょうか」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But you were looking at it for over ten minutes. Staring that long, how could you not have noticed?"

strings.text: 「いや、付箋に“雫”って書いてあったからさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Look, the sticky note said 'Shizuku' on it."

strings.text: 「そりゃ、姉さんが貼ったのですから、実の名前で付箋も貼りましょう。だとしてもあんなでかでかと書かれてた文字すら見えてないとは……。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Well, since my sister put it there, of course she'd write my real name on the sticky note. Even so, to not even see letters written that large......

strings.text: そんなに白の水着の写真がお気に入りでしたか……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: you must have really liked the white swimsuit photo......"

strings.text: 「１０分も水着の写真をねぇ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ten whole minutes on swimsuit photos.

strings.text: なんか冗談でなく、草薙ってエロ汚染が一番ひどいんじゃない？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Joking aside, isn't Kusanagi's mind the most hopelessly in the gutter out of all of us?

strings.text: 本当に、みんなの水着選びなんて連れてきて良かったのかしらねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Really, was it a good idea to bring him along to pick out everyone's swimsuits?"

strings.text: 「みなさんの水着を？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Everyone's swimsuits?"

strings.text: 「あ、合宿でね。海がある場所に行くから、みんなで水着買いに行く事になったのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ah, for the training camp. We're going somewhere with a beach, so we decided to go buy swimsuits together."

strings.text: 「ほう……それで直哉がふらりとついてきてしまったと……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Oh...... and so Naoya just wandered along with you......"

strings.text: 「違う。ちゃんと誘われて来たんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No. I was properly invited."

strings.text: 「エロ汚染が一番ひどいという理由だけどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Only because his mind is the most in the gutter, though."

strings.text: 「うぐぅ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 否定出来ない。
strings.translated: I can't deny it.

strings.text: 「……稟来てる？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "...... Is Rin here?"

strings.text: 雫が小声で聞いてくる。
strings.translated: Shizuku asks in a low voice.

strings.text: 「ああ、来てるぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, she is."

strings.text: 俺は小声で答える。
strings.translated: I answer in a low voice.

strings.text: 「直哉……私も行っていい？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Naoya...... may I come along too?"

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「大丈夫なのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Are you going to be okay?"

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「大丈夫。今度は取り乱したりしない……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I'll be fine. I won't lose my composure this time..."

strings.text: 「直哉と出来た様に、ちゃんと初対面、出来ると思う」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I think I can handle a proper first meeting, the way I did with you, Naoya."

strings.text: 「そうか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see."

strings.text: 真琴
strings.translated: Makoto

strings.text: 「なに、こそこそ話してるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What are you two whispering about?"

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「鳥谷、雫も連れて行っていいか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani, mind if we bring Shizuku along?"

strings.text: 「はぁ？　雫さんの水着を見るために何を吹き込んだのよ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? What kind of nonsense did you feed her just to see Shizuku-san in a swimsuit?"

strings.text: 「なんでそうなるんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How does it come out to that?!"

strings.text: 「なんか雫さんの耳元でささやいてたから、よからぬ事を言って誘ったのかと思ったのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You were whispering in her ear, so I figured you were trying to lure her into something improper."

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「大丈夫です。直哉はたしかに鬼畜陵辱エロ汚染主人公ですが、私は彼の意見に左右されるほど弱い意志ではありません……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's all right. Naoya is indeed a fiendish, ravishing, ero-tainted protagonist, but my will is not so weak as to be swayed by his opinions..."

strings.text: 俺は、エロ汚染から、鬼畜陵辱エロ汚染主人公に格上げされた。
strings.translated: I've been upgraded from ero-tainted to fiendish-ravishing-ero-tainted protagonist.

strings.text: 今日一日ですごい進化だな。おい。
strings.translated: Quite the evolution in a single day. Come on.

strings.text: 優美
strings.translated: Yumi

strings.text: 「何やってるんですか！！　鳥谷先輩も早く！　早く更衣室に！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "What are you doing?! Toritani-senpai, hurry up too! To the changing room, quickly!"

strings.text: 遠くから声がする。
strings.translated: A voice calls from the distance.

strings.text: 「油売りすぎたかしら、合流してあげないと」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Guess we've dawdled too long. Better go join them."

strings.text: 「あ、そうだ。私の自己紹介が終わってなかったわね。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh, right. I never finished introducing myself.

strings.text: 私は鳥谷真琴。弓張学園美術部の部長よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: I'm Toritani Makoto. President of the Yumihari Academy art club."

strings.text: 「噂はかねがね。わたしは夏目雫です。芸名は先ほど鳥谷さんが言われた様に草薙葛佳と名乗っております」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I've heard much about you. I'm Natsume Shizuku. As Toritani-san mentioned earlier, I go by the stage name Kusanagi Kusuka."

strings.text: 「んじゃ、とりあえず一緒に行きますか」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well then, shall we head over together?"

strings.text: 「はい、是非」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, by all means."

strings.text: 「さぁ、二人にはどんな水着が良いでしょうかねぇ。ハァハァハァ……ゴクリ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Now then, what kind of swimsuits shall we pick for you two? Huff, huff, huff... gulp."

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「優美ちゃん、自分のも選ぼうよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yumi-chan, pick out one for yourself too."

strings.text: 「あ、私？　あ、これでいいや。これで決定」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Oh, me? Ah, this'll do. Decided."

strings.text: 里奈
strings.translated: Rina

strings.text: 「確認もしないでワゴンからつかむな……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Don't just grab one from the bin without even checking it..."

strings.text: 「ワゴンに良いのがあったのだから問題ない。
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "There was a good one in the bin, so no problem.

strings.text: それよりも、里奈、里奈こそ、この、えぐい食い込みが入ったハイレグ水着をですな！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: More importantly, Rina -- Rina, you should wear this high-cut swimsuit with the vicious ride-up right here!"

strings.text: 「そんなお勧めならあんたがはいてろ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "If you recommend it that much, you wear it yourself."

strings.text: 「私が？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Me?"

strings.text: 「そう、優美のお勧めなんでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Yes, it's your recommendation, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「うん、だったら私がはいたらはくの？　ねぇはくの？　たとえばこのヒモっぽい、むしろヒモでしかない、これでもはく？　里奈ははいてくれるの？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Sure, if I wear it, will you wear it? Hey, will you? Say, this stringy thing here -- no, it's really just string -- would you wear even this? Will you wear it for me, Rina?"

strings.text: 「あんたは、どんだけ一生懸命なんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Just how invested are you in this...?"

strings.text: 「白がいいらしいわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Apparently white is the way to go."

strings.text: 「鳥谷先輩なかなか良いところをついてますね。だが残念、白の水着の大半は濡れても透けません！　透けない対策が万全すぎて全然透けないのです！　だからこっちのヒモ的な水着の方がお勧めかと」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Toritani-senpai, that's a decent angle. But sadly, most white swimsuits don't turn see-through even when wet! Their anti-transparency measures are so thorough they don't show a thing! Which is why I recommend a string-style one like this."

strings.text: 「いや、そういう意味じゃなくて……草薙が白の水着が趣味らしいわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "No, that's not what I meant... apparently Kusanagi has a thing for white swimsuits."

strings.text: 「はぁ！　草薙がですか？　素人ですね！　濡れても透けない事を知らないので、勝手な想像で興奮していやがるのですね。これだから童貞は！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Ha! Kusanagi does?! Amateur! He doesn't know they don't go see-through when wet, and he's getting excited on nothing but his own imagination. This is why virgins are hopeless!"

strings.text: 「違げぇよ。白水着はそんな不純な理由で好きなわけじゃない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not it. I don't like white swimsuits for such an impure reason."

strings.text: 「だったらどんな理由ですか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Then what's the reason?"

strings.text: 「うーん。パンツに見える？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hmm. They look like panties?"

strings.text: 「十分、十分すぎるぐらい不純です！」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That's plenty impure, more than plenty!"

strings.text: 「いや、冗談だ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it's a joke.

strings.text: そもそも論として白水着が好きなんて勝手にねつ造された事だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: To begin with, the whole 'I like white swimsuits' thing was just something you all made up on your own."

strings.text: 「まぁ、たしかに、雑誌で私が着ていた水着がたまたま白だったというだけかもしれませんが、だったら直哉はどんな水着が好みなのでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Well, it's true that the swimsuit I happened to be wearing in that magazine was white, but if that's the case, what kind of swimsuit does Naoya actually prefer?"

strings.text: 「どんなのかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What kind, hmm..."

strings.text: 「ちょっと草薙どいてください！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Kusanagi, move aside for a second!"

strings.text: 「うわっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whoa!"

strings.text: 「え？　こ、この人」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Huh? Th-this person..."

strings.text: 「こ、この方は……もしかして……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Th-this lady is... could it be...?"

strings.text: 「そうよ。驚いた」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. Surprised?"

strings.text: 「お、驚いたも何も……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "S-surprised doesn't begin to cover it..."

strings.text: 「圭先輩の妹さんって芸能人だって聞いてたけど、本当だったんだ。しかも草薙葛佳だったとはねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I'd heard Kei-senpai's little sister was a celebrity, so the rumors really were true. And to think she's Kusanagi Kusuka, of all people..."

strings.text: 「初めまして、夏目圭の妹の夏目雫です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Pleased to meet you. I'm Natsume Shizuku, Natsume Kei's younger sister."

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「はじめまして、雫ちゃん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nice to meet you, Shizuku-chan."

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 雫は一瞬、稟の顔を見て止まってしまう。
strings.translated: Shizuku froze for a moment, staring at Rin's face.

strings.text: だが――
strings.translated: But then--

strings.text: 「はじめまして、御桜稟さん」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Nice to meet you, Misakura Rin-san."

strings.text: 「え？　なんで私の名前を？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? How do you know my name?"

strings.text: 「圭兄さんや直哉から聞いてます……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I've heard about you from Kei-niisan and Naoya..."

strings.text: 「そうなんだ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Oh, I see."

strings.text: 二人はそのまま見つめ合う。
strings.translated: The two of them kept gazing at each other.

strings.text: 何かを言いかけたと思った瞬間
strings.translated: Just as it seemed she was about to say something,

strings.text: 雫が稟に抱きついていた。
strings.translated: Shizuku threw her arms around Rin.

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wah? W-what?"

strings.text: 「うわさ通りに可愛い人ですね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You're every bit as cute as the rumors said."

strings.text: 「そんな、雫ちゃんの方が可愛いに決まっているよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No way, Shizuku-chan is way cuter."

strings.text: 「そんな事ありません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That's not true at all."

strings.text: 「えい」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Take that."

strings.text: 稟も抱き返す。
strings.translated: Rin hugged her back.

strings.text: 「な、なんか、はじめまして、って感じと違うね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-somehow, this doesn't really feel like a 'nice to meet you,' does it?"

strings.text: 「うん……そうだね……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah... you're right..."

strings.text: 優美
strings.translated: Yumi

strings.text: 「ぬぬぬ……し、雫さん」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Nnnh... Sh-Shizuku-san."

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「はい？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes?"

strings.text: 「一緒に更衣室に入りませんか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Won't you come into the changing room with me?"

strings.text: 「はい、嫌です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No, I'd rather not."

strings.text: 「がーん」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Gyaaah."

strings.text: 里奈
strings.translated: Rina

strings.text: 「って、初対面でそんな事言って、断られて普通ショック受けるか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Wait, you'd normally be shocked by getting turned down after saying something like that to someone you just met?"

strings.text: 「今のテンションなら言えると思った」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I figured with the current mood I could pull it off."

strings.text: 「稟とだったらいいけど？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But if it's with Rin, that's fine?"

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「え？　一緒に更衣室ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? The changing room together?"

strings.text: 「うん」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「な、なっ、そ、それって！　それってどういう事ですか！　稟先輩！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Wh-wha, th-that... what's that supposed to mean?! Rin-senpai!"

strings.text: 「え？　どういう事って？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? What do you mean 'what's it supposed to mean'?"

strings.text: お？　女好きの川内野にライバル出現で、雫に敵対視でもするのか？
strings.translated: Oh? Is this Kawachino, our resident lady-killer, spotting a rival and about to treat Shizuku as an enemy?

strings.text: 「二人はとても仲良しという事で良いのですよね！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "It's just that you two are very close, right?! Right?!"

strings.text: 「うん、私は稟が大好き」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah, I love Rin."

strings.text: 「きゅんっ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "*Swoon*"

strings.text: 「あ、ああ……稟先輩と雫さんの組み合わせ！　すごい。すごいいいですぶはぁっっ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Ahh, aah... Rin-senpai and Shizuku-san as a pairing! Amazing. It's amazing, so amaziiiing--bwuh!"

strings.text: 「うわぁ……興奮して鼻血とか出すかなぁ。さすが百合脳だねぇ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ugh... She's so worked up she might get a nosebleed. Truly the mind of a yuri fanatic."

strings.text: 「も、申し訳ない。あまりに可憐な組み合わせに興奮の限度を超えました」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "M-my apologies. Such an exquisite pairing pushed me past my limit of arousal."

strings.text: 「優美の頭の中は本当に百合なんだな」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Yumi's head really is packed full of yuri."

strings.text: 「うん、男とかいらない。地上の男なんて、男だけに感染するレトロウイルスが発生して全滅してしまえばいい」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Yep, men are unnecessary. Every man on earth ought to be wiped out by a retrovirus that only infects males."

strings.text: 物騒な願望だ。
strings.translated: What a dangerous wish.

strings.text: 「むしろ将来、私がそのレトロウイルスを作る」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Actually, in the future, I'll be the one to make that retrovirus."

strings.text: 「人類が滅亡するがな」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Humanity would go extinct."

strings.text: 物騒な願望というか、物騒な目標であった。
strings.translated: Not so much a dangerous wish as a dangerous goal.

strings.text: 「ふむ、とりあえず気を取り直して、水着選びなのですが、そろそろ試着をしてみてはいかがでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Well, pulling myself together, on the matter of picking out swimsuits -- how about we try some on now?"

strings.text: 「優美……さっきまでの異常テンションの後で、突然落ち着かれても、信用出来ないよ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Yumi... after the way you were freaking out just now, suddenly settling down doesn't make you any more trustworthy..."

strings.text: 「下心なんてありません。何でしたら私から着替えましょう！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I have no ulterior motives. If you insist, I'll change first!"

strings.text: そう言うと川内野は直ぐさま更衣室のカーテンを閉める。
strings.translated: With that, Kawachino immediately drew the curtain of the changing room.

strings.text: 「優美、本当に適当な水着選んでるし……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Yumi, she's really just grabbing swimsuits at random too..."

strings.text: 真琴
strings.translated: Makoto

strings.text: 「まぁいいじゃない。私達もせっかくだから試着する？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, it's fine. Since we're here, want to try some on too?"

strings.text: 「そうですねぇ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Sure, why not."

strings.text: 「御桜先輩、試着するのですか！　写メの用意は出来てます！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Misakura-senpai, you're trying some on?! I've got my phone camera ready!"

strings.text: 「早っ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That was fast."

strings.text: 「どんだけ着替えるの早いのよ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "How on earth did you change that quickly...?"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、皆さんの水着を写メ撮るのが目的ですし」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Well, my whole purpose is to snap pictures of everyone's swimsuits."

strings.text: 「い、いや、わりかし意味わかんないから……優美ちゃん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no, I really don't get what you mean by that... Yumi-chan."

strings.text: 「さてと、んで草薙先輩はどの水着が好みなのですか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "So then, Kusanagi-senpai, which swimsuit do you like?"

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「何で突然俺なんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why are you suddenly asking me...?"

strings.text: 「私の意見は皆さんに伝えましたから、とりあえずエロ汚染が激しい草薙先輩の意見も聞きましょう。元々そういう趣旨だったはずですし」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I've already told everyone my opinion, so let's hear from Kusanagi-senpai, who's severely contaminated with lewdness. That was the whole point to begin with."

strings.text: 「うーん。そうだなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hmm. Let's see..."

strings.text: 「良く分からんが、川内野の水着姿かなり可愛いぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't really know, but Kawachino looks pretty cute in a swimsuit."

strings.text: 「っっ」
strings.speaker: 優美

strings.text: 川内野がカーテンを閉める。
strings.translated: Kawachino shut the curtain.

strings.text: 「何を言ってるのですか！　私の事など良いのです！　というかむしろ私の事は見るな！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "What are you saying?! Don't worry about me! Actually, don't even look at me!"

strings.text: 「そうか？　やっぱり川内野はスタイル良いぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really? Kawachino, you really do have a nice figure."

strings.text: 「うるさいです。とりあえず黙れセクハラ先輩」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Shut up. Just shut up, sexual-harassment-senpai."

strings.text: 「あんたが言うかねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "You're one to talk..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、まぁ、着替えたらいいじゃない。うん、着替えよう！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Now, now, let's just change. Yeah, let's change!"

strings.text: 「そうですね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That's right."

strings.text: 「雫さんまで！？　これまたうれしい誤算っぶはっ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Even Shizuku-san?! What a happy miscalcula--bwuh!"

strings.text: 「何か鼻から出てますよ。大丈夫ですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Something's coming out of your nose. Are you okay?"

strings.text: 「これは心の汗ですからお気遣い無く、さぁ着替えると良いでしょう。
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "This is just the sweat of my soul, so don't worry about it. Now go on and change.

strings.text: みんな水着になると良いでしょう」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: Everyone should put on their swimsuits."

strings.text: 汗にしては赤すぎるけどな……。
strings.translated: It's way too red to be sweat, though...

strings.text: 「稟先輩まだですかー？　そろそろいいですよねー」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Rin-senpai, are you ready yet? It should be about time, right?"

strings.text: 「えっと、あの……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, well..."

strings.text: 「あけますよー」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I'm opening it!"

strings.text: 「わ！　わわ！　待ってくださいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah! W-wait, please!"

strings.text: 「ちゃんと着替え終わってるじゃないですか」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "You've finished changing just fine, haven't you?"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、まぁ……、
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, yes, but...

strings.text: でもいきなり開けるとかひどいよ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: opening it out of nowhere is awful..."

strings.text: 「んで、どう草薙？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "So? What do you think, Kusanagi?"

strings.text: 「ど、どうって言われても……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what do I think..."

strings.text: 「えっと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 「あ、あの、そんな近くで見なくても良いかと……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um, you don't have to look from that close..."

strings.text: 「いや、そんな近くで見てるつもりは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I didn't mean to look from that close..."

strings.text: 「それで？　感想は？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Well? Your impression?"

strings.text: 「こういうスポーティなのもいいんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Something sporty like this is nice too, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「そうですね。稟先輩はもっと可愛らしい水着選ぶと思ったのですが、これはこれで超ありですね」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Right? I thought Rin-senpai would pick something cuter, but this is definitely a big yes."

strings.text: たしかに、もっとヒラヒラがある水着というイメージだったが……。
strings.translated: It's true, I'd imagined her in something with more frills...

strings.text: 「んで？　そろそろ、里奈はどう？　里奈はどうなの？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "So? How about Rina now? What about Rina?"

strings.text: 「こんな感じでしょうか」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Something like this, I guess."

strings.text: 「ブッ。意表つかれて雫さんの水着ががががっ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Bwuh. Caught off guard, Shizuku-san's swimsuit is g-g-guh--"

strings.text: 「大丈夫？　さっきから本当に鼻血出てるみたいだけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Are you okay? You really do seem to be having nosebleeds this whole time."

strings.text: 「おやおや、鳥谷先輩はさすがに胸が大きいですね。いやぁ眼福眼福。カシャカシャ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "My my, Toritani-senpai truly has large breasts. Ahh, a feast for the eyes, a feast for the eyes. *click, click*"

strings.text: 「って、何で写メで撮ってるのよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hey, why are you taking pictures?!"

strings.text: 「記念。記念。問題ないです。私までで止めておきますから！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "For the memories, for the memories. No problem at all. I'll stop with just me!"

strings.text: 「当たり前よ！　というか優美止めだって許さないわよ！　返しなさい」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Of course you will! Actually, I won't allow you to just stop, Yumi! Give it back!"

strings.text: 「嫌です！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "No way!"

strings.text: 「んで？　私はどうですか？　直哉」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "So? How do I look? Naoya."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Uh, yeah..."

strings.text: 「目泳いでますよ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Your eyes are wandering."

strings.text: 「え？　お、おおう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Uh, y-yeah..."

strings.text: とは言っても、正視する事が出来ない。
strings.translated: Even so, I couldn't bring myself to look straight at her.

strings.text: これは雫に限らず、川内野、稟、鳥谷。
strings.translated: It wasn't just Shizuku -- Kawachino, Rin, Toritani...

strings.text: これだけの水着を見せられると、だんだん下半身的に不安になってくる。
strings.translated: Being paraded with this many swimsuits was starting to put me on edge -- in a distinctly lower-body sort of way.

strings.text: ここで下半身が反応したらしゃれにならない。
strings.translated: If my lower body reacted here, it'd be no laughing matter.

strings.text: 本当にセクハラ野郎になってしまう。
strings.translated: I'd become a genuine sexual harasser.

strings.text: 俺はだんだん生返事しか出来なくなっていく。
strings.translated: Gradually all I could manage were half-hearted responses.

strings.text: 「何ですか？　さっきから自分の下半身を気にしてますね……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "What is it? You've been fussing over your own lower body for a while now..."

strings.text: 「ち、違っ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-that's not it--"

strings.text: 「まぁ、これだけ可愛い水着の娘達に囲まれれば、そんな事にもなるでしょう」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Well, surrounded by girls in such cute swimsuits, that's bound to happen."

strings.text: 「こういう時男は残念ですね。興奮しているのが一目瞭然で！
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Men really do have it rough at times like this. It's obvious at a glance when they're aroused!

strings.text: 私はいくら見ても問題なし！　カシャカシャ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: I can look as much as I want with no problem! *click, click*"

strings.text: 「カシャカシャ言いながら写メ撮らないでください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Please stop saying 'click click' while taking pictures."

strings.text: 「って、無言だともっと怖いですっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wait, doing it silently is even scarier!"

strings.text: 「えーと」
strings.speaker: 里奈

strings.text: 「えい」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Take that."

strings.text: さらにカーテンが開く音がする。
strings.translated: Another curtain slid open.

strings.text: 「本命！　里奈キター」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "The main event! Rina has arrived!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-Hikawa..."

strings.text: 「どうですか？　草薙お兄ちゃん♪」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "How do I look? Kusanagi-oniichan~"

strings.text: 「って！　そこで！　久しぶりの自称妹設定かよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey! Right now?! You're breaking out the self-proclaimed little-sister setting again, for the first time in ages?!"

strings.text: 「いや、まぁ、そんな事でも言ってないと恥ずかしいじゃないですか……。あはは」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Well, I mean, if I don't say something like that it's embarrassing... ahaha."

strings.text: 「うわぁ……、前から大きいと思ってたけど……里奈ってとてつもなく巨乳じゃないの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Wow... I thought they were big before, but Rina, aren't your boobs ridiculously huge?"

strings.text: 「そうですかねぇ。あまり気にした事ないのですけど……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Really? I've never really given it much thought..."

strings.text: 「可愛いですね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You're cute."

strings.text: 「ありがとうございます」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Thank you very much."

strings.text: 「胸をください」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Give me your chest."

strings.text: 「そ、それは、む、無理かなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Th-that's, uh, kind of impossible..."

strings.text: 「うわー。なんか無言で写メ撮ってる！」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Whoa! Now she's silently taking pictures!"

strings.text: 「安心して、里奈。私だけの宝物にしておくから」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Don't worry, Rina. I'll keep them as a treasure just for myself."

strings.text: 「意味分からんわー。何でお前が私の写メを宝物にするっ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That makes no sense. Why are you turning pictures of me into a treasure?!"

strings.text: 「気にしないで、宝物は人それぞれだというわ。気にしたら負けよ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Don't worry about it -- treasures are different for everyone. You lose the moment you start caring."

strings.text: 「負けでいいわ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Fine, I lose."

strings.text: 「ふぅ……どうですか？　草薙先輩的には？
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Whew... What do you think, Kusanagi-senpai?

strings.text: 私的には、雫さんは綺麗さ。稟先輩は可愛さ。鳥谷先輩は胸。そして一番は里奈です」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: In my view, Shizuku-san is beauty. Rin-senpai is cuteness. Toritani-senpai is boobs. And the number one is Rina."

strings.text: 「私は胸って、相当失礼だな優美。だいたい里奈の方がでかいぞ、たぶん」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I'm 'boobs'? That's pretty rude, Yumi. Besides, Rina's are bigger than mine, probably."

strings.text: 「あはは、そうなのかな。あんまり言われた事ないのでうれしいですなぁ。
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ahaha, is that so. I've hardly ever been told that, so it's kind of nice to hear.

strings.text: でも、こんな肌露出させた水着なんて着られないんですけどね……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: But I really can't wear a swimsuit this revealing, though..."

strings.text: 「え？　何で？　もしかして極度の恥ずかしがり屋とか？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? Why? Are you unbelievably shy or something?"

strings.text: 「いや、そういうのではないのですが、少し病気でして……日光があまり良く無いんですよ。私」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "No, it's not that, but I've got a bit of a condition... sunlight isn't really good for me."

strings.text: 「そうなんだ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 「だから、もし海に行くのであればもっと肌が隠れたヤツじゃないとパラソルから出られませんねぇ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "So if we're going to the beach, it'd have to be something that covers more skin, or I couldn't leave the parasol."

strings.text: 「それにしても、徐々に草薙先輩は目線を逸らしてますねぇ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Even so, Kusanagi-senpai keeps averting his eyes little by little."

strings.text: 「い、いいだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sh-shut up."

strings.text: 「大変ですねぇ。男性というのは、肉体的に膨張するものがありますからねぇ。心だけ勃起させるなんて器用な真似は出来ませんから」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "It must be tough. Men have parts that physically expand, after all. It's not like you can pull off the clever trick of only your heart getting an erection."

strings.text: 「心だけ勃起って何だよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
