strings.translated: "From that expression, it looks like you noticed too......"

strings.text: 「お前こそ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're one to talk......"

strings.text: 「なるほど……そういう事だったのか……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "I see...... so that's what it was......"

strings.text: 「そうだな……最初っから、こうやれば良かったんだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah...... we should have done it this way from the start."

strings.text: 「何、辛気くさい顔して話してるのよ！　ほらあんた達もキリキリ働きなさい！　夜明けはもうすぐよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What are you talking about with such gloomy faces! Come on, you two, get back to work! Dawn is almost here!"

strings.text: 「ひぃ、さっきまでワシはふらふらだったのじゃから、もう少し優しく扱っても良いんじゃよ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Eek, I was staggering just a moment ago, you could be a little gentler with me..."

strings.text: 「そんな台詞言うぐらいなら、私にその作業やらせれば良かったんです！
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "If you're going to say things like that, you should have just let me do that work!

strings.text: ほら、どんどん溶かしていってくださいっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Come on, keep melting them, one after another."

strings.text: この作品のもう一つのテーマ。
strings.translated: Another theme of this work.

strings.text: それはここにあるもの『笑顔』だ。
strings.translated: It's what's here now -- "smiles."

strings.text: 「こいつは、子供達と神父が一緒に楽しく作れる様に設計されておったんじゃな……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "This thing was designed so that the children and the priest could enjoy making it together......"

strings.text: 「ああ、これは大人数でやるもんだ。考えてみれば当たり前だ。こんなもん一人で作れるわけがない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, this is meant to be done with a lot of people. Come to think of it, it's obvious. There's no way one person could make something like this."

strings.text: 「最初っから大人数でわいわいやりながら制作するためのものだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "From the very start, it was meant to be created by many people together, all having fun......"

strings.text: 「そうみたいじゃな……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "So it seems......"

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎の遺産か……まさに遺産って感じだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The legacy of Kusanagi Ken'ichirou, huh...... it really does feel like a legacy......"

strings.text: 子供達と神父が、お遊戯をする様に、ゲームをする感覚で、楽しめる作品……それがこの『櫻達の足跡』だ。
strings.translated: A work the children and the priest could enjoy together, like a playtime activity, like a game...... that is "The Footprints of the Sakura."

strings.text: 「次は？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "What's next?"

strings.text: 「次の上履きは？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Where does the next shoe go?"

strings.text: 「次の上履きって……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The next shoe, huh......"

strings.text: 「みんな私の位置まで来てごらんなさい……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Everyone, come over to where I'm standing......"

strings.text: 鳥谷に促されて、作業をやめた部員がその場所に集まる。
strings.translated: Urged by Toritani, the club members stopped their work and gathered in that spot.

strings.text: 壁から少し離れた場所。
strings.translated: A place a little away from the wall.

strings.text: 日が昇る。
strings.translated: The sun rose.

strings.text: 日光を背に浴びるキャンバス。
strings.translated: The canvas bathed in the sunlight from behind.

strings.text: そこには――。
strings.translated: And there--.

strings.text: 「完成よ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's complete!"

strings.text: 「っっ」
strings.speaker: 稟

strings.text: 「わぁっ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Wow."

strings.text: 「すげぇなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Amazing......"

strings.text: 「ふぅ……すごい迫力ですね」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Whew...... what incredible power it has."

strings.text: 作り手を楽しませ、そして完成したものがこれ……。
strings.translated: It delights those who make it, and what's completed is this......

strings.text: あいつはどんな脳みそをしていたんだ？
strings.translated: What kind of brain did that guy have?

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎の遺作が……完成か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's posthumous work...... is complete......"

strings.text: 一同
strings.translated: Everyone

strings.text: 「オーノー」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Oh no."

strings.text: 「一度もチャンスがありませんでしたー。
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "I never got a single chance.

strings.text: 無情デース。この世は無常しかないのデース」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: It is heartless-u. This world is nothing but impermanence-u."

strings.text: 座標として使っていた墨を水で洗い落とす。
strings.translated: We washed away with water the ink we had used as coordinates.

strings.text: すると作品は完全な姿をあらわす。
strings.translated: And the work revealed its complete form.

strings.text: 桜の花びらは、子供達の足跡。
strings.translated: The cherry blossom petals are the children's footprints.

strings.text: 全体の花びらを生かすために下地にうっすらと赤みがかった白をのせる。
strings.translated: To bring out all the petals, a faintly reddish white was laid down as the base.

strings.text: そのうっすらとした桜色に染められたバックのため足跡達は、
strings.translated: Against that faintly cherry-tinted background, the footprints

strings.text: まるで幻影の様に浮き立つ桜の花びらの様に見える。
strings.translated: rise like phantom cherry petals drifting through the air.

strings.text: 遠くから見ると、奥行きを感じさせ、あたかも定着した花びら以上に多くの花びらがある様に錯覚させる。
strings.translated: Seen from a distance, it gives a sense of depth, creating the illusion that there are far more petals than those actually fixed to the wall.

strings.text: そしてステンドグラス。
strings.translated: And then the stained glass.

strings.text: ステンドグラスの中はまるで無限に続く様な青空が広がっている。
strings.translated: Within the stained glass stretches a blue sky that seems to go on infinitely.

strings.text: その無限の空にもまた桜の花びらは吸い込まれていく。
strings.translated: The cherry blossom petals are drawn into that infinite sky as well.

strings.text: ただし、その花びらは、空の中で羽根へと変わっている。
strings.translated: Only, within the sky, those petals have transformed into wings.

strings.text: 子供の足跡から、桜の花びらへ、そしてそれは虚空に舞う事によって天使の羽根に姿を変える。
strings.translated: From children's footprints into cherry petals -- and as they soar into the void, they transform into the wings of angels.

strings.text: 見事な構成。
strings.translated: A magnificent composition.

strings.text: 見事なデザイン。
strings.translated: A magnificent design.

strings.text: そして見事すぎるテーマ性。
strings.translated: And an all too magnificent thematic depth.

strings.text: 「そろそろ神父が目覚める時間かな？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's about time the priest woke up, huh?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's true..."

strings.text: 「悔いは無いのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Any regrets?"

strings.text: 「愚問だな……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "A foolish question......"

strings.text: 校舎の方から怒鳴り声が聞こえる。
strings.translated: Shouting could be heard from the direction of the school building.

strings.text: 宿直の教師が目覚めたのだろうか？
strings.translated: Had the teacher on night duty woken up?

strings.text: とりあえずすごい勢いで誰かが走って来る。
strings.translated: In any case, someone was running toward us at tremendous speed.

strings.text: 「退学だぞ。これ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This means expulsion."

strings.text: 「警察に捕まらなければもうけもんじゃろ……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "If we don't get arrested by the police, we can count ourselves lucky......"

strings.text: 俺と明石は笑いあった。
strings.translated: Akashi and I laughed together.

strings.text: 見てくれてるだろうか？　神父は。
strings.translated: I wonder if he's watching. The priest.

strings.text: そして草薙健一郎は……。
strings.translated: And Kusanagi Ken'ichirou......

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「暑ちぃなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's hot..."

strings.text: 真琴
strings.translated: Makoto

strings.text: 「うっさいわね。キリキリ働きなさいよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Shut it. Work faster, chop chop!"

strings.text: 里奈
strings.translated: Rina

strings.text: 「ふぅ……しかし暑いですねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Phew... it really is hot, though..."

strings.text: 優美
strings.translated: Yumi

strings.text: 「里奈大丈夫？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Rina, you okay?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、優美がわざわざ日傘さしてくれてるから大丈夫だけど」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Well, since Yumi's kindly holding a parasol over me, I'm fine."

strings.text: 「温度的には、あの作業の方がよっぽど熱かったはずだけど……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Temperature-wise, that other job should have been way hotter..."

strings.text: 「あれですかねぇ。ランナーズハイといいますか、トランス状態といいますか……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I guess it was one of those things. A runner's high, or a trance state, or..."

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「はい、あれは楽しかったです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, that was fun."

strings.text: 「ほら無駄口はいいから掃除しなさいっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Enough chitchat, get cleaning!"

strings.text: 「夕方までにあらっておくのよ。ちゃちゃちゃちゃっと！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "We're washing this down by evening. Chop, chop, chop, chop!"

strings.text: 「はいはい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, yeah..."

strings.text: 「あんたらのせいで合宿が学校でやるはめになったんだからね！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's your fault the training camp ended up being held at school!"

strings.text: 「俺たちのせいかよ……首突っ込んだのはお前らだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Our fault? You guys were the ones who stuck your noses in."

strings.text: 「でも、こそこそと何か裏でやってたのは草薙先輩と明石先輩ですよね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "But the ones sneaking around behind the scenes were you and Akashi-senpai, right, Kusanagi-senpai?"

strings.text: 「違う！　俺は別にあの計画の首謀者でもなければ計画の手助けをしたのではない！　ただ制作に関わっただけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wrong! I wasn't the mastermind of that plan, nor did I help plan it! I just took part in the actual work."

strings.text: 「そうですか？　でも、表向きは先輩が首謀者ですよねぇ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Is that so? But on the surface, you're the mastermind, aren't you, senpai?"

strings.text: 「だから、俺だってそれは迷惑してる！　正直不愉快だ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's exactly what's giving me trouble! Frankly, it's obnoxious!"

strings.text: ８月の終わり。
strings.translated: The end of August.

strings.text: 俺たちは合宿を行っている。
strings.translated: We're holding our training camp.

strings.text: 本来なら緑に囲まれて、海風に吹かれているはずだったのに……、
strings.translated: By rights we should be surrounded by greenery with the sea breeze in our hair...

strings.text: 何故か塩素臭いプールを掃除させられている。
strings.translated: and yet for some reason we're being made to clean a chlorine-reeking pool.

strings.text: あの日……行けなかった合宿を弓張学園で行っている。
strings.translated: That day... the camp we couldn't go on, we're now holding at Yumihari Academy.

strings.text: よりにもよって学校でやる事はないだろ。
strings.translated: Of all places, did it really have to be at school?

strings.text: 残念にもほどがある……。
strings.translated: There are limits to how disappointing a thing can be...

strings.text: 「なんか、今ぁ。“よりにもよって何故この学校で行うのだ～。残念にもほどがある～”とか考えてませんでしたか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Just now, weren't you thinking something like, 'Of all places, why does it have to be at this school? There are limits to how disappointing a thing can be'?"

strings.text: 「う、そ、そんな事っ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Uh, n-no, of course not."

strings.text: 図星すぎだった。
strings.translated: Bullseye.

strings.text: それほど、顔に出ていたのか？
strings.translated: Was it that obvious on my face?

strings.text: 「何それ！　それが本当なら殺します！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "What?! If that's true, I'll kill you!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no, that's not..."

strings.text: 「そうですよね。そんな事は絶対に思ってはいけませんよねぇ。
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "That's right. You must never, ever think such a thing.

strings.text: 水着まで買って楽しみにしていた合宿。
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: The training camp we were all looking forward to, even bought swimsuits for.

strings.text: 草薙先輩と明石先輩が台無しにしたのですからねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: The one you and Akashi-senpai ruined..."

strings.text: 「あははは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: さすがに、合宿が中止になった話になると殺気立つなぁ。
strings.translated: Sure enough, when the topic turns to the camp being canceled, the air turns murderous.

strings.text: 当たり前と言えば当たり前だが……。
strings.translated: Which, well, is only natural...

strings.text: 圭
strings.translated: Kei

strings.text: 「まぁ、いいじゃん。こうやって合宿出来るんだしさ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Come on, it's fine. We're getting to hold a camp like this, aren't we?"

strings.text: 「いいわけないじゃないですか……。
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "How is it fine...?

strings.text: 海で海水浴とプール掃除じゃ、だいぶ違いますよ？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: Swimming in the sea versus cleaning a pool -- those are pretty different, you know?"

strings.text: 「自然の中で写生とか少し楽しみだったんだけどね。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I was kind of looking forward to sketching out in nature, though.

strings.text: でも、こういうのも楽しいですよね。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: But this is fun too, isn't it?

strings.text: みんなでプールの掃除なんてはじめてですから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: It's my first time cleaning a pool with everyone."

strings.text: トーマス
strings.translated: Thomas

strings.text: 「オー、イエー、シャセイ……自然の中でシャセイを楽しむ……オー、イェー」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Oh, yeah, shasei... enjoying shasei out in nature... oh, yeah."

strings.text: 「そこ！　モップのさきっぽしこしこしてるんじゃないわよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hey! Don't go stroking the tip of the mop like that!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew..."

strings.text: プールからは教会の壁が見える。
strings.translated: From the pool, the wall of the chapel is visible.

strings.text: 当たり前といえば当たり前。
strings.translated: Of course it is.

strings.text: 俺がプールの脇で寝ていて、明石を発見した時から始まった事だ。
strings.translated: All this started when I was napping by the pool and discovered Akashi.

strings.text: ここから教会が見えるのは当然だ。
strings.translated: The chapel being visible from here is only natural.

strings.text: 「いやぁ、しかしなんと言いますか……すごいですねぇ。
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Well, how should I put it... it really is amazing.

strings.text: ここから見る教会もなかなか乙なものです」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: Seeing the chapel from here has a certain elegance to it."

strings.text: 「そうね。あれを完成させた時は全てを覚悟したのだけどね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It does. When we finished that, I was prepared for anything..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、覚悟しなければならない様な事ではありますが……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Well, it was the kind of thing one has to be prepared for..."

strings.text: 「でも結果オーライだったな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But it all worked out in the end."

strings.text: 「あんたが脳天気に言うとむかつくけどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hearing you say it so blithely gets on my nerves, though."

strings.text: 「何でだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why?"

strings.text: 教会の壁絵を完成させたあの日からいろいろあった。
strings.translated: A lot has happened since the day we completed the mural on the chapel wall.

strings.text: それこそ、普通の夏休みでは考えられないほどいろいろだ。
strings.translated: Truly, more than you'd ever expect in a normal summer vacation.

strings.text: 結果だけ言えば、
strings.translated: To speak only of the outcome:

strings.text: あの絵は残され、
strings.translated: the painting was allowed to remain,

strings.text: 俺も美術部も存続を許された。
strings.translated: and I -- and the art club -- were allowed to continue.

strings.text: ただし例外を除いて……。
strings.translated: With one exception, however...

strings.text: ７月最後の日。
strings.translated: The last day of July.

strings.text: というよりは８月最初の日の朝。
strings.translated: Or rather, the morning of the first day of August.

strings.text: あの作品は完成した。
strings.translated: That work was completed.

strings.text: 真夏に突如狂い咲いた桜の様に、教会の壁に突如その姿をあらわした。
strings.translated: Like a cherry tree suddenly blooming out of season in high summer, it appeared on the chapel wall without warning.

strings.text: 草薙健一郎作『櫻達の足跡』。
strings.translated: Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's "The Footprints of the Sakura."

strings.text: 子供を彷彿させる、小さな足跡を絵の具代わりに、満開に咲く桜を表現し、
strings.translated: Using small footprints reminiscent of a child's in place of paint, it depicts a cherry tree in full bloom,

strings.text: さらに、その花びらが水面を模したステンドグラスに降り注ぐといった造形になっている。
strings.translated: and further, its petals scatter down onto a stained glass window fashioned to resemble a water's surface.

strings.text: 教会内部から見たステンドグラスはもちろん美しい。
strings.translated: The stained glass, seen from inside the chapel, is of course beautiful.

strings.text: 外部から多くの光を取り込んだ、青を基調としたそれは、真っ白に磨かれた大理石を美しく染め上げる。
strings.translated: With abundant light drawn in from outside, the blue-toned glass dyes the polished white marble in exquisite hues.

strings.text: だがそれだけで終わらない。
strings.translated: But it doesn't end there.

strings.text: 外から見たステンドグラスは、内部で見た輝く青ではなく、仄暗くも美しくも透明な水面となる。
strings.translated: Seen from outside, the stained glass is no longer the radiant blue of the interior, but the dim, pellucid surface of darkened water.

strings.text: それは壁に「桜」を描く事によって、はじめて成立する。
strings.translated: That effect is only realized by painting the "cherry blossoms" on the wall.

strings.text: 空に舞う桜を壁画として、水面をステンドグラスとして、二つの素材を組み合わせることによって、その仄暗さが引き立つ。
strings.translated: Swirling cherry blossoms in mural above, the water's surface in stained glass below -- only by uniting the two mediums does that quiet, shadowed beauty come alive.

strings.text: 草薙健一郎の完成品としての桜作品としては、習作などを除いた場合『横たわる櫻』が唯一のものである。
strings.translated: Among Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's completed works featuring cherry blossoms, setting aside preliminary studies, "The Reclining Sakura" was the only one.

strings.text: というのが美術業界の常識だった。
strings.translated: Or so common knowledge in the art world had it.

strings.text: だからこそ、ヤツが生前に図案として完成させていた『櫻達の足跡』は、美術業界のみならず、あらゆる方面の人間から反響を呼ぶだろう。
strings.translated: Which is precisely why "The Footprints of the Sakura," which he had left finished as a design during his lifetime, is bound to elicit reactions not just from the art world but from every quarter.

strings.text: 俺自身がこの図案を見た最初に受けた衝撃と同じ様に……いや、それ以上だろう。
strings.translated: The same shock I myself felt when I first saw the design... no, even greater than that.

strings.text: 俺が見たのは図案だ。
strings.translated: What I saw was a design.

strings.text: だがみんなが見たのは、真夏の夜に突如現れた“完成品”なのだから。
strings.translated: But what everyone else saw was a "completed work" that appeared without warning on a midsummer night.

strings.text: 草薙健一郎に関わった人間ならば、誰しも「桜」というモチーフは彼にとって特別な物であると考えていたし、それを証明する様に、それまでは『横たわる櫻』以外、草薙健一郎は「桜」の作品を発表していない。
strings.translated: Anyone who had anything to do with Kusanagi Ken'ichirou believed that the motif of "cherry blossoms" held some special meaning for him, and as if to prove it, until then Kusanagi Ken'ichirou had not released any work featuring "cherry blossoms" other than "The Reclining Sakura."

strings.text: だからこそ俺は、この計画はありだと思った。
strings.translated: That is precisely why I thought this plan had a chance.

strings.text: この作品を完成させるのは、決して負け戦などでは無い。
strings.translated: Completing this work was by no means a losing battle.

strings.text: そういった意味では、この結果はある意味では織り込み済みだったとも言える。
strings.translated: In that sense, this outcome was, in a way, already factored in.

strings.text: いや、さすがにそれは言い過ぎか……。
strings.translated: No, that would be overstating it...

strings.text: そうなれば良い。
strings.translated: It would be nice if it turned out that way.

strings.text: そうなってくれればもうけ物ぐらいで考えていた。
strings.translated: If it did, we'd count ourselves lucky -- that was more or less how I was thinking.

strings.text: かもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe.

strings.text: どちらにしても完成の出来によって、俺たちの運命はまったく違ったものになっていたかもしれない。
strings.translated: Either way, depending on the quality of the finished work, our fates could have turned out completely different.

strings.text: 草薙健一郎の作品を台無しにするどころか、建築そのものを台無しにするような出来ならば、退学ではすまなかっただろう。
strings.translated: If we had ruined not just Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's work but the building itself, expulsion wouldn't have been the end of it.

strings.text: 危険な橋ではあった。
strings.translated: It was a dangerous bridge to cross.

strings.text: だが、この作品を完璧な物として完成させれば十分に勝算もあった。
strings.translated: But if we completed this work as a perfect piece, we had a real chance of winning.

strings.text: 罰せらるべき罪が一転して、賞賛されるべき名誉に変わる可能性。
strings.translated: The chance that a punishable offense might turn, in a single stroke, into a triumph worthy of praise.

strings.text: あの日。
strings.translated: That day.

strings.text: 完成とほぼ同時に守衛に見つかった。
strings.translated: Almost the moment it was finished, we were spotted by the security guard.

strings.text: たぶん、完成の時に俺たちが大はしゃぎしたからだろう。
strings.translated: Probably because we made such a huge fuss when we finished.

strings.text: 完成した後に、こそこそと逃げていれば、あるいは捕まらなかったかもしれない。
strings.translated: If we had quietly slipped away after finishing, we might not have been caught.

strings.text: だが、あれを完成させて、こそこそ逃げるなど考えられない。
strings.translated: But having completed that piece, sneaking off quietly was unthinkable.

strings.text: 俺たちは完成と共に大騒ぎした。
strings.translated: We celebrated with a huge racket the moment it was done.

strings.text: 当然、守衛が駆けつける。
strings.translated: Naturally, the guard came running.

strings.text: 深夜無断で侵入し、なおかつ教会の壁に大きな落書きをしたのである。
strings.translated: We had trespassed at night without permission, and on top of that scrawled a massive piece of graffiti on the chapel wall.

strings.text: それは大変な騒ぎであった。
strings.translated: It was a serious commotion.

strings.text: それこそ当初は警察でも呼ばれる様な勢い。
strings.translated: At first there was even talk of calling the police.

strings.text: 早朝にも関わらず連絡を受けて集まる教師達。
strings.translated: Despite the early hour, teachers gathered in response to the call.

strings.text: 学校始まって以来の不祥事のごとき騒ぎであった。
strings.translated: The uproar was on the scale of the greatest scandal since the school's founding.

strings.text: もちろん中には藍もいた。
strings.translated: Ai, of course, was among them.

strings.text: 他の教師がうろたえたり怒鳴ったり騒ぎ立てる中で、
strings.translated: While the other teachers panicked, shouted, and raged,

strings.text: 藍はただ草薙健一郎の残した桜の絵を見ていた。
strings.translated: Ai simply stood looking at the cherry blossom painting Kusanagi Ken'ichirou had left behind.

strings.text: ずっと、ずっと、喧噪の中で、まるで美術館にいる客の様に落ち着いた様子で、その絵を見つめていた。
strings.translated: For a long, long time, amid the clamor, calm as a visitor at a museum, she gazed at that painting.

strings.text: ゆっくりと鑑賞した後に、
strings.translated: After taking her time to appreciate it,

strings.text: 藍は俺の方を見て笑った……そして、
strings.translated: Ai turned toward me and smiled... and then,

strings.text: ……殴られた。
strings.translated: ...I got punched.

strings.text: 時間差で明石姉妹がやってきた。
strings.translated: With a slight delay, the Akashi sisters arrived.

strings.text: 彼女達は泣いていた。
strings.translated: They were crying.

strings.text: 病院からこの光景を見て、急いでやってきたらしい。
strings.translated: Apparently they had seen this scene from the hospital and come rushing over.

strings.text: そりゃ、そうだ。
strings.translated: Well, of course.

strings.text: あの病院が一番の特等席なのだから。
strings.translated: That hospital had the best seat in the house, after all.

strings.text: さぞかし驚いただろう。
strings.translated: They must have been utterly astonished.

strings.text: 昨日まで無かった桜の絵が突然現れたのだ。
strings.translated: A cherry blossom painting that hadn't been there yesterday had suddenly appeared.

strings.text: 明石
strings.translated: Akashi

strings.text: 「それで？　喜んでいたか？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Well? Were they happy?"

strings.text: 小沙智
strings.translated: Kosachi

strings.text: 「よ、喜んだって？
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "H-happy?

strings.text: こ、このバカ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: Y-you idiot."

strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 明石の頬を叩いたと思われた小沙智が驚いていた。
strings.translated: Kosachi, whom I'd thought had struck Akashi's cheek, looked shocked.

strings.text: 小沙智を遮って、明石の頬を叩いたのは小牧であったからだ。
strings.translated: Because the one who had cut Kosachi off and slapped Akashi's cheek was Komaki.

strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "...Komaki."

strings.text: 小牧
strings.translated: Komaki

strings.text: 「こんな事許されると思っているのですか……お兄ちゃん」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Do you really think this is something that can be forgiven... nii-chan?"

strings.text: 「許されるかどうかなんて知ったこっちゃ無い……。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Whether it can be forgiven or not, I don't give a damn...

strings.text: 俺が興味ある事は、神父が喜び……そして――」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: What I care about is whether the priest was happy... and then--"

strings.text: 「お前達が喜んでくれたかどうかだ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Whether the two of you were happy."

strings.text: はい、神父様、喜んでましたよ……、
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: Yes, the Father was overjoyed...

strings.text: そして……私達もうれしかったです……」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: And... we were happy too..."

strings.text: 「そうか、少しはお前が見た千年桜を彷彿させる出来だったか？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "I see. Was it enough to bring to mind the thousand-year cherry you saw?"

strings.text: 「はい、もちろんです」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Yes, of course."

strings.text: 小牧は泣きながらにっこり笑う。
strings.translated: Komaki smiled brightly through her tears.

strings.text: 「千年桜……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The thousand-year cherry..."

strings.text: 明石小牧が夏の夜に見たという幻の桜。
strings.translated: The phantom cherry tree Akashi Komaki said she had seen on a summer night.

strings.text: どんな季節でも美しい花を咲かせると言われる桜。
strings.translated: The cherry, said to bloom beautifully in any season.

strings.text: これが、その桜をモチーフとしているかどうか分からないが……。
strings.translated: Whether this piece takes that cherry as its motif or not, I couldn't say...

strings.text: ただ、これにはたしかに人を引きつける何かがある。
strings.translated: But there is, without doubt, something in it that captivates people.

strings.text: たぶん、それは草薙健一郎だけの力ではない。
strings.translated: And that is probably not the power of Kusanagi Ken'ichirou alone.

strings.text: たしかにヤツの天才的な発想と美術センスがあるからこその作品ではある。
strings.translated: Sure, it's a work made possible only by his genius conception and artistic sense.

strings.text: だが最後まで完成させたのは草薙健一郎では無い。
strings.translated: But the one who saw it through to completion wasn't Kusanagi Ken'ichirou.

strings.text: この桜の絵が人を引きつけるのは、明石の想い。
strings.translated: What draws people to this cherry blossom painting is Akashi's feelings.

strings.text: 小牧への、小沙智への、そして神父への想い。
strings.translated: His feelings for Komaki, for Kosachi, and for the priest.

strings.text: そしてそんな作品を完成させようとした、こいつらの熱意があってこそのものであろう……。
strings.translated: And it exists because of the passion of these people, who were determined to complete such a work...

strings.text: “仏作って魂入れず”という言葉があるが、この図案が草薙健一郎のものだとしても、それを完成させた人間に魂が籠もってなければ、ここまで人を引きつける作品にはならなかったはずだ。
strings.translated: There's a saying, "to make the Buddha and forget the soul." Even if the design was Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's, if the people who completed it had no soul in them, it never would have become a work capable of drawing people in like this.

strings.text: ここにいる連中すべての熱意。
strings.translated: The passion of everyone gathered here.

strings.text: そして技術が、草薙健一郎の遺作を形とした。
strings.translated: And their skill -- that is what gave form to Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's final work.

strings.text: だからこそこの作品は……、
strings.translated: Which is exactly why this piece...,

strings.text: 「素晴らしいです……本当に……」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "It's magnificent... truly..."

strings.text: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: Teacher A

strings.text: 「それで、首謀者は誰だ！
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "So, who's the ringleader?!

strings.text: お前ら美術部だよな！　部長は誰だ！　鳥谷か？」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: You're all art club members, right?! Who's the club president?! Toritani?!"

strings.text: 「あー、ぴーちくぱーちくうるさいわ！
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Ahh, stop your chirping and squawking!

strings.text: 感傷に浸っている暇すら与えないのか？　これほどの作品が出来たのに！
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: Won't you even let us have a moment to indulge in sentiment? With a work this magnificent completed!

strings.text: 教師というのは本当に無粋な連中しかおらんのだな！」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: Teachers really are nothing but a bunch of tasteless philistines!"

strings.text: 「ワシじゃ！　すべての責任はワシ、明石亘にある。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "It was me! All responsibility lies with me, Akashi Wataru.

strings.text: ワシがこいつらを<r たぶら>誑</r>かしてやった！
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: I was the one who lured these kids into it!

strings.text: さぁ俺を連れて行くが良い！」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: So take me away, if you please!"

strings.text: 「アホか、そんなで済むわけないだろ！　全員来い！」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Idiot, you think it ends there?! All of you, come with me!"

strings.text: 「そいつらは関係ない！　手荒に扱うな！」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "They have nothing to do with it! Don't be so rough with them!"

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 「この子達は、抵抗はしません。あまり手荒な事は控えてください」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "These children will not resist. Please refrain from being too rough with them."

strings.text: 「夏目先生……」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Natsume-sensei..."

strings.text: 「美術部の顧問は私です。これは私の責任でもあります。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I am the art club's faculty adviser. This is also my responsibility.

strings.text: 処罰は私が受けます……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: I will accept the punishment..."

strings.text: 「ちょ、ちょっと待ってくださいよ。藍先生は名義だけの顧問ではないですか……、実質顧問は若田先生だという事をみんな知っているわけですし……。
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "H-hold on a moment. Ai-sensei, you're the adviser in name only, aren't you...? Everyone knows that Wakata-sensei is the de facto adviser...

strings.text: だいたい、何で若田先生は来ないんだ？」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: And in the first place, why isn't Wakata-sensei here?"

strings.text: 「あの人は朝が弱いですからね。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That man is not a morning person.

strings.text: こんな休みの日に電話に出るとは思いませんが」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: I doubt he'd answer his phone on a day off like this."

strings.text: 「あの、ちゃらんぽらんがっ」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "That good-for-nothing..."

strings.text: 明石だけが連れて行かれる……。
strings.translated: Only Akashi being hauled away...

strings.text: なんて都合の良い事などにはならない。
strings.translated: things wouldn't turn out that conveniently.

strings.text: その場に居た全員が、それぞれが別の教室に呼び出され、尋問の様な質問攻めをされた。
strings.translated: Every single person present was called into a separate classroom and subjected to a barrage of questions that felt like an interrogation.

strings.text: その尋問はかなり長く続くと思われたが、あっけなく終わった。
strings.translated: The interrogations seemed like they'd drag on a long while, but they ended abruptly.

strings.text: 俺の一言がきっかけになり。
strings.translated: Sparked by a single remark of mine.

strings.text: 「どういうつもりだ！」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Just what were you thinking?!"

strings.text: 「どういうつもりも何も、あんたに言っても分からんと思うが？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even if I told you what I was thinking, I don't think you'd get it."

strings.text: 「あんただと？　貴様、教師を何だと思ってる」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "'You'?! Bastard, who do you think you're talking to -- a teacher!"

strings.text: 「さぁな。少なくとも、あれを見ても何も感じないとんちんかんな事だけは分かったが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who knows. All I know is you're clueless enough to look at that and feel nothing..."

strings.text: 「貴様！　教師に向かって！　た、<r タダ>只</r>ですむと思うなよ！」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "You brat! To a teacher, no less! D-don't think you'll get off scot-free!"

strings.text: 「<r タダ>只</r>？　バカか？　あれが只に見えるのか？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Scot-free? Are you stupid? Does that look free to you?

strings.text: 時価総額で数百万。いや。今だったら数千万だってつきかねない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: In market value, it's worth several million. No -- these days it could easily go for tens of millions."

strings.text: 「な、何だそりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Wh-what are you talking about?"

strings.text: 「これを、この学校の一番偉いやつに見せるんだな？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You'll show this to the top brass at this school, won't you?

strings.text: 草薙健一郎の遺作だと言ってな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Tell them it's Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's final work..."

strings.text: そう言うと、俺はあの設計図、図案の束を机の上に置く。
strings.translated: As I said this, I set that stack of blueprints and designs down on the desk.

strings.text: 「なんだお前？　あのな！」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "What the hell are you? Listen here!"

strings.text: 「ぐふぉ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Guhf."

strings.text: 「なんだその態度は、貴様……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What's with that attitude of yours, you..."

strings.text: 「ぐはっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Gwahh!"

strings.text: 「藍では無い。夏目先生だ。何度言えば分かるんだ？
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Not 'Ai.' Natsume-sensei. How many times do I have to tell you before you get it?

strings.text: このバカは……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: This idiot..."

strings.text: 「夏目先生」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Natsume-sensei."

strings.text: 「後は任せてください。こいつを黙らせておきますから……、
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Please leave the rest to me. I'll keep this one quiet...

strings.text: それと、草薙が渡した、その書類大事に扱ってください。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: And please handle those documents Kusanagi gave you with care.

strings.text: 金額にして数百万の価値があるものです」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: In monetary terms, they're worth several million yen."

strings.text: 「数百万？　夏目先生まで何を世迷い言を……
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Several million? Not you too, Natsume-sensei, spouting such nonsense...

strings.text: こんな紙切れがそんな価値があるわけないでしょう」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: There's no way scraps of paper like these are worth that much."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、校長先生に渡してください。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "For now, please deliver them to the headmaster.

strings.text: 校長には連絡しておきましたから、そろそろ登校されると思いますので、
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: I've already contacted her, and she should be arriving at the school shortly,

strings.text: それとこれが“草薙健一郎の遺作”である事を忘れずにお伝えください」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: and please don't forget to tell her these are 'Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's final work.'"

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎の遺作って……」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's final work, you say..."

strings.text: 「それではお願いします」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I leave it to you, then."

strings.text: 「あ、あの夏目先生……」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "U-um, Natsume-sensei..."

strings.text: 「お願いします」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I leave it to you."

strings.text: やや高圧的に藍が言い放つ。
strings.translated: Ai declared it with a somewhat overbearing tone.

strings.text: 「分かりました」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Understood."

strings.text: 「あの作品を前にしても、生徒にどう罰を与えるかしか考えないとはな……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "To think that even facing a work like that, all he could think about was how to punish his students...

strings.text: どれだけ感性が枯れてるんだよ……アホが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Just how withered can a person's sensibilities get... moron."

strings.text: 「げふっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Guff."

strings.text: 「アホはお前だ！　何をバカな事を言っておる！
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You're the moron! What idiotic thing are you saying now?!

strings.text: 貴様は何をしたか分かっているのか！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Do you even understand what you've done?!"

strings.text: 「分かってる……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I understand...

strings.text: 分かってやったに決まってるだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Of course I did it knowing full well..."

strings.text: 「本当に分かってるのか？
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You really understand?

strings.text: お前がやった事は、不法侵入、器物破損、立派な犯罪だぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: What you did was trespassing, property destruction -- a full-fledged crime."

strings.text: 「ああ、分かってる。すべて分かってやった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I know. I did it all knowing that."

strings.text: 「ふぅ……なるほど、
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hah... I see.

strings.text: ならばその態度は虚勢という事になるのか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: So that attitude of yours is a bluff, then?"

strings.text: 「当たり前だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, of course..."

strings.text: 俺だけじゃなくて、全員、退学覚悟でやった事だ。
strings.translated: It wasn't just me -- every one of us did it prepared to be expelled.

strings.text: 自分たちが何をしているのか、理解出来てないヤツなんていなかっただろう……。たぶん……（トーマスは怪しいが）。
strings.translated: There wasn't a single one of us who didn't understand what we were doing... probably... (Thomas is questionable, though).

strings.text: 「だがこれは、必要な虚勢でもある。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But it's a necessary bluff.

strings.text: ここで俺が怯えて挙動不審だったら、誰もあれが価値あるものだとは信じない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: If I flinched and acted suspicious here, no one would believe that thing has any value."

strings.text: 「最低限、相手にのみ込まれないぐらいの虚勢は必要だし、
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "At the very least, you need enough bravado not to let the other side intimidate you --

strings.text: 出来たら逆に相手がのみ込まれるぐらいの虚勢が必要だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: and better yet, enough to overwhelm them instead."

strings.text: 「あの教師に預けた草薙健一郎の図案が、そのままゴミ箱に捨てられないともかぎらないからな。少なくともあいつにはあのぐらい言わないと危険だった。あの図案の価値をまったく理解してなかったからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's no guarantee that Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's designs I entrusted to that teacher wouldn't just be tossed straight in the trash. At the very least, I had to speak to him like that or it was too dangerous. He didn't grasp the value of those designs at all."

strings.text: 「だからって、先生をあいつ呼ばわりするやつがあるか。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Even so, who refers to a teacher as 'that guy'?

strings.text: ったくお前は、どこまで非常識なんだか……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Honestly, just how far does your lack of common sense go..."

strings.text: 「とりあえずは、あれは交渉術としての虚勢という事か……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "For now, I suppose it was a bluff as a negotiation tactic...

strings.text: だったら、これぐらいで許してやろう。無意にあんな事言ってるのなら、足腰立たないぐらい殴っているところだが」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: In that case, I'll let you off with this much. If you'd said something like that thoughtlessly, I'd have beaten you until you couldn't stand."

strings.text: 「あのなぁ。そんな体罰したら懲戒免職ものだぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on. If you did that kind of corporal punishment, you'd be dismissed."

strings.text: 「体罰では無い。肉体言語だ。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "It's not corporal punishment. It's physical language.

strings.text: 口で言っても分からんのなら、身体で覚えさせるまでだ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: If you can't understand words, I'll just have to teach your body."

strings.text: 「どんだけ原始的なんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How primitive can you get..."

strings.text: 「それで済むのなら良いだろ……。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "If that's all it takes, so much the better...

strings.text: 全部めちゃくちゃになるよりは、ずっと……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Far better than everything falling apart..."

strings.text: 校長室に呼ばれたのはそれから１時間後だった。
strings.translated: It was an hour later that I was summoned to the headmaster's office.

strings.text: 「失礼いたします……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Pardon the intrusion..."

strings.text: ノックをして頭をさげて入ると、先客がいた。
strings.translated: When I knocked, bowed, and entered, someone was already there.

strings.text: 明石だ。
strings.translated: Akashi.

strings.text: 「明石だけか？　他の連中は？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just Akashi? Where are the others?"

strings.text: 「ほら、お前、無駄口を叩くな」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Hey, you, don't run your mouth."

strings.text: 校長
strings.translated: Headmaster

strings.text: 「それで話の続きなのだけど……」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "So, to continue the discussion..."

strings.text: 「この退学届け？　これはどういう事かしら？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "This letter of withdrawal? What is the meaning of this?"

strings.text: 「全責任はワシにあった。だからその罰を受けるのはワシ一人で十分だと考えた……。それがその退学届けじゃ……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "All responsibility lay with me. So I concluded that it was enough for me alone to bear the punishment... That's what that withdrawal notice is..."

strings.text: 「お前、校長の前でその口調やめろ」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Hey, drop that manner of speaking in front of the headmaster."

strings.text: 「責任ねぇ……。あれは君が総責任者という事かしら？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Responsibility, hmm... So does that mean you're the one in overall charge?"

strings.text: 「いいや、違う。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that's not right.

strings.text: いや、違います……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I mean, no, that's not the case..."

strings.text: 「ふーん、君はたしか……」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Hmm, you're... let me see..."

strings.text:
「はい、草薙直哉。
この作品の設計と図案、そして内装まで完成させた画家草薙健一郎の息子です」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Yes, Kusanagi Naoya.
The son of the painter Kusanagi Ken'ichirou, who completed the design, the drafts, and even the interior of this work."

strings.text: 「ああ、覚えているわ。草薙健一郎さんのご葬儀で君を見ました」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Ah, I remember. I saw you at Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's funeral."

strings.text: 俺は覚えてないが……。
strings.translated: I didn't remember, though...

strings.text: 「それよりも、君は今言った。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "More to the point, you just said something.

strings.text: “違う”と、それはどういう意味かしら？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: 'That's not the case' -- what did you mean by that?"

strings.text: 「見ましたか？　その書類」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Did you look at them? Those documents."

strings.text: 俺は校長の机の上に置かれた書類を指さす。
strings.translated: I pointed at the papers placed on the headmaster's desk.

strings.text: 「ああ、見たわ。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Yes, I looked.

strings.text: これは草薙健一郎さんご本人による設計図の様ね」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: These appear to be blueprints drawn by Kusanagi Ken'ichirou himself."

strings.text: 一応は草薙健一郎のサインはある。
strings.translated: There is a Kusanagi Ken'ichirou signature on them, to be sure.

strings.text: だとしても、この校長、あまりにもすんなりとこの設計図を本物だと受け入れるのだな。
strings.translated: Still, this headmaster accepts the authenticity of these blueprints far too readily.

strings.text: それに、あれほどの事件を起こした生徒を前にして、まったく動じない。
strings.translated: And in front of a student who caused such an enormous incident, she wasn't the least bit shaken.

strings.text: あの教師と同じ様に、まずは金切り声で怒鳴ってくると思っていたが……。
strings.translated: I'd expected her, like that other teacher, to start by shrieking at me...

strings.text: 校長といえども、別にこの学校のオーナーでは無いはずだ。
strings.translated: Even a headmaster isn't the owner of this school.

strings.text: 校長本人だって責任を取らされるかもしれないのに……、
strings.translated: The headmaster herself could be held responsible...,

strings.text: どういう余裕だ。
strings.translated: so where does that composure come from?

strings.text: こいつ……。
strings.translated: This girl......

strings.text: 「それは、あの教会の全改装をするために必要なすべての書類です。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Those are all the documents necessary for a full renovation of that chapel.

strings.text: すでに内装の改装は、今から十数年前に終わっていましたが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: The interior renovation was already completed over ten years ago, but..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうね。覚えているわ。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Yes, that's right. I remember.

strings.text: あの時も、今日の様に何の許可も無く進められていた……」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: That time, too, it was carried out without any authorization, just like today..."

strings.text: 「とは言っても、さすがに今日の様に、一日で完成というわけにはいかなかったけど、秘密裏に進めるといった感じだったわ……」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Though of course, unlike today, it couldn't be finished in a single day -- it was more like something done in secret..."

strings.text: 「なるほど、その時も許可も無くですか。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see, so no permission that time either.

strings.text: だから学校側はその教師を解雇した。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: That's why the school fired the teacher in charge.

strings.text: 責任を取らせて」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Made him take responsibility."

strings.text: 「お、おい、草薙！　何の話か知らんが！
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "H-hey, Kusanagi! I don't know what you're talking about, but!

strings.text: 滅多な事を言うな！
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: Don't say anything reckless!

strings.text: 校長先生の前なんだぞ！　オマエ！」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: You're in front of the headmaster, you know! You!"

strings.text: 「滅多な事？　いいや、これは単なる事実だ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Reckless? No, this is simply fact.

strings.text: 誰の前であろうと、事実は変わらない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: No matter who I'm in front of, the facts don't change."

strings.text: 「じ、事実かどうかなんて知らん。
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "H-how would I know if it's true or not.

strings.text: だいたいそんな昔の事を何でお前が事実と断言出来る！」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: And besides, how can you declare something from that long ago as fact!"

strings.text: 「事実です。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "It is fact.

strings.text: 草薙健一郎氏を解雇したのは私です。私自身ですから」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: The one who dismissed Kusanagi Ken'ichirou was me. I did it myself."

strings.text: この校長が？
strings.translated: This headmaster?

strings.text: その答えに少し俺は驚いた。
strings.translated: Her answer surprised me a little.

strings.text: 草薙健一郎がここで教師をしていたのは、かなり昔の話なはずだ……。
strings.translated: Kusanagi Ken'ichirou teaching here was something from quite a long time ago...

strings.text: 年齢は健一郎と同じぐらい……いやそれ以上に若く見えるが、当時からそんな権限があったのか？
strings.translated: She looks about the same age as Ken'ichirou... no, even younger, but did she have that kind of authority back then?

strings.text: 「どうしたのかしら？　君が言った事を肯定しただけだが、何を唖然としているの？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "What's the matter? I merely affirmed what you said -- why are you so dumbfounded?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no..."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、草薙健一郎は学校側によって解雇された。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For starters, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou was dismissed by the school.

strings.text: だからこそ、あの教会を改装したのが草薙健一郎である事実は伏せられた。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: That's precisely why the fact that Kusanagi Ken'ichirou was the one who renovated that chapel was concealed.

strings.text: 不都合となるからだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Because it would have been inconvenient."

strings.text: 「とは言っても当時なら仕方がない。あの時代、草薙健一郎など単なる無名な一教員でしかない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That said, back then it couldn't be helped. In that era, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou was just an unknown teacher, nothing more."

strings.text: 「だが、昔ならいざ知らず、今は違う。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But it's one thing back then -- now it's different.

strings.text: “草薙健一郎作”である事は名誉以外の何物でもない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: To be a 'work by Kusanagi Ken'ichirou' is nothing short of an honor."

strings.text: 「死してなお、いや死んだ今だからこそ、この国にちょっとした美術ブームを起こすぐらいに有名になっている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even in death -- no, precisely because he's dead now, he's become famous enough to spark a minor art boom in this country."

strings.text: 「当然だ。戦後、世界的に成功した芸術家など数えるほどしかいない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Naturally. Postwar, artists who achieved worldwide success can be counted on one hand.

strings.text: ましてや、この時代、どんな分野だろうが世界で成功した者はスーパースターだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Moreover, in this era, no matter the field, anyone who's succeeded on the world stage is a superstar."

strings.text: 「にも関わらず、あの教会が草薙健一郎作である事実は伏せられた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And yet, the fact that that chapel is a work by Kusanagi Ken'ichirou was concealed."

strings.text: 「それは何故か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why is that?"

strings.text: 「何故だと思う？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Why do you think?"

strings.text: 「学校側は草薙健一郎を罰した。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The school punished Kusanagi Ken'ichirou.

strings.text: そして世界的な画家の作品を未完成とさせてしまった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: And in doing so, left a world-class painter's work unfinished."

strings.text: 「普通の学校ならいざ知らず、芸術家を多く輩出してきたこの学校にとっては不名誉きわまりない。そんな事実など公に出来るものでも無い」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For an ordinary school it would be one thing, but for this school, which has produced so many artists, it's dishonor of the highest order. Not something that can be made public."

strings.text: 「そりゃ隠したくもなるな。自分たちの審美眼がまったく無い事を露呈させる事件だからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Of course you'd want to hide it. It's an incident that exposes the total absence of your eye for beauty."

strings.text: 「草薙ぃ！」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Kusanagiii!"

strings.text: 「田村先生は席を外していただけますか……教頭」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Could you have Tamura-sensei step outside... Vice Principal."

strings.text: 教頭
strings.translated: Vice Principal

strings.text: 「はい」
strings.speaker: 教頭
strings.translated: "Yes."

strings.text: 「草薙くんと明石くん以外は席を外してもらえるか」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Could you have everyone besides Kusanagi-kun and Akashi-kun step outside."

strings.text: 「こ、この二人だけ残すのですか？」
strings.speaker: 教師Ａ
strings.translated: "Y-you're leaving just these two?"

strings.text: 「はいはい、田村先生行きますよ……」
strings.speaker: 教頭
strings.translated: "Yes, yes, Tamura-sensei, let's go..."

strings.text: ずっと黙っていた教頭と、大声ばかり出していた教師が席を外す。
strings.translated: The vice principal who had been silent all along and the teacher who had done nothing but shout stepped out.

strings.text: 今まで騒がしかった校長室に沈黙が流れる。
strings.translated: Silence fell over the headmaster's office, which had been so noisy until now.

strings.text: 先ほどよりも、若干空気が重い様な気すらする……。
strings.translated: If anything, the air felt slightly heavier than before...

strings.text: 「さてと、話の続きよ。草薙くん」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Now then, back to the discussion, Kusanagi-kun."

strings.text: 「私が草薙健一郎氏をクビにした事について何か質問でもあるのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Do you have any questions about my dismissing Kusanagi Ken'ichirou?"

strings.text: 「いいえ、その事自体は問題ではありません。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that itself isn't the issue.

strings.text: 要はあの作品が未完であったからこそ、公表出来なかった。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: The point is that because that work was left unfinished, it couldn't be made public.

strings.text: 俺はそれだけを確認したかった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: That's all I wanted to confirm."

strings.text: 「草薙くんが言う通りよ。我々が彼を解雇し作品を未完にしてしまったからこそ、あれを公に発表する事が出来なかった」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Just as you say, Kusanagi-kun. Precisely because we dismissed him and left the work unfinished, we couldn't announce it to the world."

strings.text: 「君が言う通り、この学校が普通の学校ならば問題なかったかもしれないけど、まぁ弓張の伝統がそれを許さなかったというところかしら」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "As you said, if this were an ordinary school there might have been no issue, but well, Yumihari's traditions wouldn't allow it, I suppose."

strings.text: 「だからこそ、草薙健一郎の作品は未完のまま闇へと葬り去られた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And that's why Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's work was buried in darkness, left unfinished."

strings.text: 「大半正解、だけどところどころ違う部分もある」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Mostly correct, but there are places where you're off."

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎氏は解雇では無く、自主退職という事になっているわ」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's departure is on the books as a voluntary resignation, not a dismissal."

strings.text: 「自主退職？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Voluntary resignation?"

strings.text: 「辞表も受け取っているわ……。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "We received his letter of resignation, too...

strings.text: とは言っても、君の言う通りに実質的にはクビを切ったのは私よ。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: That said, as you say, in substance the one who fired him was me.

strings.text: 私があの作品を未完にした。それは事実」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: I'm the one who left that work unfinished. That's fact."

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎は……自主退職している……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Ken'ichirou... resigned voluntarily..."

strings.text: 「この意味が分かるかしら？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Do you understand what this means?"

strings.text: 「なるほど……つまりは……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "I see... in other words..."

strings.text: 「そちらの生徒は分かった様だね」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "The student over there seems to have grasped it."

strings.text: 「どういう事だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「事実は知らんが、とりあえず書類上は草薙健一郎は“自主退職”という形になっている。つまり学校側が無理矢理解雇して“草薙健一郎の作品を完成させなかった”という事にはならなくなる」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "The truth is one thing, but on paper Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's departure is filed as a 'voluntary resignation.' Which means it doesn't come out as the school forcibly firing him and thus 'leaving Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's work unfinished.'"

strings.text: 「そういう事。今となっては、あの作品が完成して世に出たとしても私達に不都合は無いの」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Exactly. As things stand now, even if that work were completed and released to the world, there's no inconvenience to us."

strings.text: 校長は明石の顔を見つめる。
strings.translated: The headmaster gazed at Akashi's face.

strings.text: 「我々にとって不都合な事実だからこそ、君はそこをついて交渉した。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Because it was an inconvenient truth for us, you seized on that point and negotiated.

strings.text: 自分が責任者だと言い張って、他の生徒を守るために」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: Insisting you were the one responsible, in order to protect the other students."

strings.text: 「校長！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Headmaster!"

strings.text: 俺の方を向いて校長は笑う。
strings.translated: The headmaster turned toward me and smiled.

strings.text:
「だけど、そんな事ちらつかさなくても問題ないわ。
草薙くん、大人というのは、君が思うより頭が良く。
そして狡猾だから」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated:
"But there's no need to dangle such threats.
Kusanagi-kun, adults are smarter than you think -- and far more cunning."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Cunning?"

strings.text: 「まったく私が気づいてないとでも思ったのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Did you honestly believe I hadn't noticed at all?"

strings.text: 「ど、どういう事でしょうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-what do you mean...?"

strings.text: 「私だって正田神父とは交友があるわ」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "I too am on friendly terms with Father Shouda."

strings.text: 「さすがに入院中の正田神父は、君達があの作品を完成させようと思っていたとは想像してなかった様だけど、まぁ、私は役職柄ね。いろいろな事を見てなければならないの」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "As you'd expect, Father Shouda, being hospitalized, didn't imagine you all were planning to complete that work. But well, my position requires me to keep an eye on all sorts of things."

strings.text: 「この納品書に身に覚えが無いかしら？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Doesn't this delivery slip look familiar?"

strings.text: これは鳥谷が持っていたもの……。
strings.translated: This is what Toritani had...

strings.text: 「まぁ、娘とは絶縁状態なのだけど……。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Well, my daughter and I are estranged, but...

strings.text: それでも親としてあの娘が調べている事を把握しておかなければならない」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: Even so, as a parent I have to keep track of what that girl is looking into."

strings.text: 「当然といえば……当然ですか……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "I suppose that's... only natural..."

strings.text: 「ど、どういう事だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what does that mean?"

strings.text: 「おや、おや、君は知らなかったのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Oh my, oh my, you didn't know?"

strings.text: 「何を？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「そうか知らなかったのか？
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "So you didn't know?

strings.text: だが、少し考えれば、分かるのではなかったのか？　何故、昔からこの学校の世話になっている小牧や小沙智が鳥谷と仲が良いか」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: Still, with a little thought, wouldn't you have figured it out? Why Komaki and Kosachi, who've been taken care of by this school for so long, are so close with Toritani."

strings.text: 「前に言ってただろ。鳥谷、明石の家と鳥谷の家は家族ぐるみで付き合いがあると……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "I told you before, didn't I? That the Akashi family and the Toritani family have been on close terms as families..."

strings.text: 「と、鳥谷って……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "T-Toritani is...?"

strings.text: 「そうよ。鳥谷真琴は私の娘」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "That's right. Toritani Makoto is my daughter."

strings.text: 「あいつこの学校の校長の娘だったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She was the headmaster of this school's daughter?"

strings.text: 「その通りよ。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Exactly.

strings.text: まぁ、何度も言うけど、現在は絶縁中だけど」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: Well, as I keep saying, we're currently estranged."

strings.text: 「今の話しぶりを聞くかぎり、ある程度分かっていた……、
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Judging from how you're talking, you had understood things to some extent...

strings.text: という事ですか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: is that what you're saying?"

strings.text: 「そういう事ね。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "That's right.

strings.text: 何度も言うけど、草薙くんが考えるより大人は頭がいい。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: As I keep saying, adults are smarter than you think, Kusanagi-kun.

strings.text: 狡猾だし、人を騙したりもする」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: Cunning, and capable of deceiving people."

strings.text: 「特に、私の様に利益のためなら何でもする人間となれば尚更。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Especially someone like me, who will do anything for the sake of profit.

strings.text: 私は君達を止める事だって出来たし、そのままやらせる事も出来た。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: I could have stopped you, and I could have let you carry on.

strings.text: そして後者を選んだ。なぜだか分かるかしら？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: I chose the latter. Do you understand why?"

strings.text: 「あの作品を完成させるため」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "To have that work completed."

strings.text: 「正解。その通りよ」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Correct. Exactly right."

strings.text: 「だ、だったら正式に俺たちに頼めば！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-then you should have asked us officially!"

strings.text: 「だから、大人にはいろいろな事情があるの。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "As I said, adults have all sorts of circumstances.

strings.text: そう、簡単なものじゃない。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: It isn't so simple.

strings.text: だから、私は君達を騙すようなやり方で、あの作品を完成させた」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: So I completed that work by a method that amounted to deceiving you."

strings.text: 「いや、さすがに騙すようなやり方って事はないのでは……。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "No, I wouldn't quite call it deceiving us...

strings.text: あれをやったのはワシらなわけだし……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: The ones who did it were us, after all..."

strings.text: 「そうね。あれを完成させたのは君達の自由意志よ。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "That's true. Completing it was your own free will.

strings.text: 君達がやろうとして努力した結果だわ」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: It was the result of your own effort and intention."

strings.text: 「だけど、それを続けさせる事も、やめさせる事も出来たのはたしかな事実よ」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "But it's an undeniable fact that I could have let it continue, or put a stop to it."

strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Headmaster..."

strings.text: 「前置きの話はこれで終わり。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "That's the end of the preliminaries.

strings.text: さて、今後の事を話そうかしら？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: Now then, shall we talk about what happens from here?"

strings.text: 「今後の事？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "What happens from here?"

strings.text: 「ああ、あの作品をどのような形で発表するかという話よ……」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Yes -- in what form we're going to announce that work..."

strings.text: 一癖も二癖もある校長だった。
strings.translated: She was a shrewd customer, this headmaster.

strings.text: こんな人物が校長だと、今の今まで知らなかった。
strings.translated: Until this very moment, I hadn't known someone like her was headmaster here.

strings.text: それまでは、女性校長でめずらしい、ぐらいなイメージしか無かった。
strings.translated: Before now, I'd had only the vague impression that it was rare to have a female headmaster.

strings.text: 校長は、「草薙健一郎の遺作を完成させたのは息子である草薙直哉である事、それに協力したのが、明石亘を中心とした弓張学園美術部である事、一部の学校関係者と部員しか知らされてなかった事」を提案した。
strings.translated: The headmaster proposed that only select school staff and club members be told that Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's final work was completed by his son Naoya, with the help of the Yumihari Academy art club led by Akashi Wataru.

strings.text: これを受け入れた場合。
strings.translated: Should we accept this.

strings.text: すべての罰は免除。
strings.translated: All punishments waived.

strings.text: 明石は退学どころか、最終試験をパスしてそのまま卒業。
strings.translated: Akashi, far from being expelled, would pass his final exams and graduate as scheduled.

strings.text: 他全員がおとがめ無し。
strings.translated: Everyone else would be off the hook.

strings.text: ただし、この要求を受け入れない場合。
strings.translated: However, should we refuse this demand.

strings.text: 美術部員、全員の退学。
strings.translated: Every member of the art club expelled.

strings.text: 教会を破損させた賠償金。
strings.translated: Compensation for the damages to the chapel.

strings.text: 考えられる罰としては最悪なレベルのものであった。
strings.translated: As punishments go, it was the worst that could be imagined.

strings.text: この二つを天秤にかけられる人間などいない。
strings.translated: No one could weigh these two options against each other.

strings.text: だが……。
strings.translated: But...

strings.text: 「受け入れる事は出来ません」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I cannot accept."

strings.text: 「草薙くん……」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-kun..."

strings.text: 「決して悪い取引ではないと思うのだけど……」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "It's not at all a bad deal, I think..."

strings.text: 「あれは明石がやった事です。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That was Akashi's doing.

strings.text: 俺はあくまでも手伝ったに過ぎない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I merely helped, nothing more.

strings.text: あれを完成させたのは俺ではない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I am not the one who completed it."

strings.text: 「事実は、草薙健一郎の遺作を完成させたのは美術部前部長明石亘であり、それに協力したのが、俺と弓張学園美術部員」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The truth is that the one who completed Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's posthumous work was Akashi Wataru, former president of the art club, and those who cooperated with him were me and the members of the Yumihari Academy art club."

strings.text: 「あたかも俺が完成させた様な言い方、俺が作者の様な言い方、そんな事は出来ない。そこを曲げてしまったら何が何だか分からない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "To present it as if I completed it -- as if I were the creator -- I can't accept that. If we compromise on that, what was any of this even for?!"

strings.text: 「……ならば全員退学の道を選ぶのかしら」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "...Then will you choose the path of expulsion for everyone?"

strings.text: 「俺だけを退学にすればいい。俺が首謀者ならそうなる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You should just expel me. If I'm the ringleader, that's how it should be."

strings.text: 「君はおかしな事を言うのね。君が首謀者ならおとがめ無し。
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "You say strange things. If you're the ringleader, there'll be no punishment.

strings.text: 首謀者である事を否定してる君だけが退学になる理屈はおかしいわ」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: It's illogical that you alone, who deny being the ringleader, would be expelled."

strings.text: 「おかしいのはお前らだ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The ones being strange are you people.

strings.text: 芸術を愚弄するのもいい加減にしろ！
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Cut it out with the mockery of art!

strings.text: あれを作ったのは明石だ！　俺じゃない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: The one who made that was Akashi! Not me!"

strings.text: 「あれは、神父のために、小牧のために小沙智のために明石が作ったものだ！　俺が心血を注いだものじゃない！　明石が心血を注いで作った物だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That was made by Akashi for the sake of the Father, for Komaki, for Kosachi! It's not something I poured my heart's blood into! It's what Akashi poured his heart's blood into."

strings.text: 「そこを曲げられるか！　ふざけるんじゃねぇよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Can you bend that? Don't screw with me!"

strings.text: 「……そうですか……なら」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "...Is that so... Then --"

strings.text: 一瞬何が起きたか分からなかった。
strings.translated: For a moment I couldn't tell what had happened.

strings.text: 鈍い音と共に目がチカチカする。
strings.translated: Along with a dull sound, my eyes flashed with sparks.

strings.text: その後、頬が熱くなっていった。
strings.translated: Then my cheek grew hot.

strings.text: 「明石……てめぇ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Akashi... you bastard."

strings.text: 「何トチ狂ってるんじゃ？　草薙ぃ？　お前、そうやって人に罪をかぶせる気なのかにゃー？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "What are ya raving about, Kusanagi? Trying to pin the blame on someone else now, are ya?"

strings.text: 「すみません。こいつ、自分があんな大それた事やった事実に恐ろしくなって、俺に罪をかぶせようとしておるんですよー。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "I'm terribly sorry! This guy got cold feet over pulling off something so audacious, and now he's trying to pin the blame on me!

strings.text: 元々から、あれを計画したのはこの男でしてにゃー」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: This fella right here is the one who planned the whole thing from the start, see."

strings.text: 「明石、お前何言ってるんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Akashi, what are you saying?!"

strings.text: 「うるせぇ！　チキン野郎！　てめぇは黙ってろ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Shut up! You chicken bastard! You keep your mouth shut."

strings.text: 「何だと！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What did you say!"

strings.text: 「だいたいてめぇだって、自分の作品を偽って発表してるじゃねぇかよ！」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Besides, you're the one who's been passing off works of your own under a false name too, aren't ya?!"

strings.text: 「あんなもんと、これは桁が違うだろ！
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's on a whole different scale from this!

strings.text: この作品にどれだけお前は時間と労力を削ったと思っているんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Do you have any idea how much time and effort you poured into this piece?!"

strings.text: 「ふぅ……、さすがに校長の前で暴力沙汰は勘弁してくれないかしら？
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Whew... You could at least spare me from a brawl in front of the headmaster, couldn't you?

strings.text: 私でも庇いきれないわ」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: Even I couldn't cover for that."

strings.text: 「すみませんにゃー。校長にこんなお手間かけさしてしまって、この件はすべてこの草薙直哉の一存によって進んだものです。それは間違いありません。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "My deepest apologies, ma'am, making the headmaster go to all this trouble. This whole matter proceeded entirely on the sole judgment of this man, Kusanagi Naoya. There is no mistake about that.

strings.text: 何でしたら、部員全員に言質を取っておきましょうか？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: If you like, shall I get testimony from every member of the club?"

strings.text: 「言質というのは当事者が取るものじゃないと思うけど？」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "I don't think 'testimony' is something the parties involved are supposed to gather themselves, is it?"

strings.text: 「お前はそれでいいのか！　あれはお前が三年間使って完成させた作品だぞ！　それがお前の作品じゃなくなっていいのかよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Are you really okay with that?! That's a work you spent three years bringing to completion! Is it really okay for it to no longer be your work?!"

strings.text: 「何言ってるんじゃよぉ。それをやったのはお前じゃろ？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "What are you sayin'? The one who did that was you, wasn't it?"

strings.text: 「ふざけるなお前、お前なぁ！　作品を作るって意味分かってるのかよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't screw with me! Do you even understand what it means to create a work?!"

strings.text: 「お前こそ何を分かってるって言うんだ！！」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "You're the one -- what do you understand?!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A-Akashi..."

strings.text: 明石が声を荒げる。
strings.translated: Akashi raised his voice.

strings.text: 「筆をずっと折っていたお前に……何が分かる……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "What could you possibly understand... when you've left your brush broken all this time..."

strings.text: 「作品を作るという意味の、何が分かるって言う……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "What do you know about what it means to create?!"

strings.text: 「お前にとっては、多くの人間に認知されるための作品か？　マスコミに騒がれるための作品か？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "For you, is a work something made to be recognized by lots of people? Something made to be talked about by the media?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Akashi..."

strings.text: 「あれが、何のために作られたか……。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "For what that piece was made...

strings.text: 俺が、あの作品を誰のために完成させたか……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: For whose sake I completed that work..."

strings.text: 「作品が何であるか？
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "What is a work?

strings.text: その言葉、そのままお前に返してやる。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: Those very words, I'll throw them right back at you.

strings.text: お前はその意味を本当に分かって言ってるのか？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: Do you truly understand what they mean when you say them?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Akashi."

strings.text: 「あれは他の誰かではない。遠くの誰かのために描いたものではない……。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "That wasn't for someone else. It wasn't painted for someone far away...

strings.text: あれは、小牧、小沙智、そしてあいつらを救ってくれた正田神父のために作り上げたものだ……他の何でも無い」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: That was made for Komaki, for Kosachi, and for Father Shouda who saved them... nothing else."

strings.text: 「だからこそ、もう俺が作者である必要は無い。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "That's precisely why there's no need for me to be the author anymore.

strings.text: 俺の名前が残る必要は無い」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: There's no need for my name to remain."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "B-but..."

strings.text: 「腑に落ちないか？
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Can't accept it?

strings.text: だとしたら、お前は芸術家としては三流以下だ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: If that's the case, you're worse than a third-rate artist."

strings.text: 「作品が何のために生まれたのか、何のために作られたのか……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Why a work is born, why it is created..."

strings.text: 「我々が何のために作品を作るのか……それさえ見失わなければ問題無い……。そこに刻まれる名が、自分の名前では無いとしてもだ……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Why we create works at all... so long as we don't lose sight of that, there is no problem... even if the name carved into it is not our own..."

strings.text: 「校長。よろしいですか」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Headmaster. If I may."

strings.text: 「ああ、素晴らしい答えだわ」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Ah, a splendid answer."

strings.text: 「あの作品、『櫻達の足跡』の設計は草薙健一郎。製作者は草薙直哉。そしてそれをサポートしたのは我々弓張美術部です」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "That work, 'The Footprints of the Sakura,' was designed by Kusanagi Ken'ichirou. Its creator is Kusanagi Naoya. And the ones who supported him were us, the Yumihari art club."

strings.text: 「あと、校長の許しを得てが必要ね」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Also, you need to add 'with the headmaster's permission.'"

strings.text: 「よし、すべて了解した……」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Very well, I acknowledge everything..."

strings.text: 「ありがとうございます」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Thank you very much."

strings.text: 「ありがとうございます……か」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "'Thank you very much'... is it..."

strings.text: 「ふぅ……何年越しの言葉だろう……」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "Whew... how many years has it been since those words..."

strings.text: 「どうしましたか？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Is something the matter?"

strings.text: 「いや、何でもない……何でもないわ……」
strings.speaker: 校長
strings.translated: "No, it's nothing... nothing at all..."

strings.text: 俺はそのまま何も言えなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't say anything after that.

strings.text: 作品が何のために作られるか……、
strings.translated: What is a work made for...

strings.text: 何のために作られるか……。
strings.translated: What is it made for...

strings.text: その意味……。
strings.translated: Its meaning...

strings.text: そんなものを突きつけられて、答えられるはずなど無かった……。
strings.translated: Something like that thrust at me -- there was no way I could answer...

strings.text: ただ、下を向く事しか出来なかった。
strings.translated: All I could do was hang my head.

strings.text: 「何ぼんやりしてるんですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "What are you spacing out for?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、別に……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, nothing..."

strings.text: 「ほら、そろそろ掃除終わりますよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Come on, cleaning's about to be done."

strings.text: 「ふーい。暑かったですねぇ。水浴びしたいぐらい」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Phew. It was hot, wasn't it? I feel like taking a dip in some water."

strings.text: 「水浴びしたいですねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I really do want to take a dip..."

strings.text: 「せっかく水着を買ったのに使ってませんからね」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "We went to the trouble of buying swimsuits, and we haven't even used them."

strings.text: 「だったら、水着で掃除すりゃ良かっただろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then you should've cleaned in your swimsuits."

strings.text: 「すかたん！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Idiot!"

strings.text: 「痛っ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ow."

strings.text: 「なんで、買いたての水着をプール掃除に使わなきゃいけないのですか！
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Why would we use brand-new swimsuits for pool cleaning?!

strings.text: だいたいですね。水着をつかわなくなった理由はっ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: And you know, the reason we stopped using the swimsuits was --"

strings.text: 「分かった。分かった。ごめん、ごめん……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Got it, got it. Sorry, sorry..."

strings.text: 「そういえば、今日は花火大会があるらしいわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, there's a fireworks festival today, I hear."

strings.text: 「花火大会？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A fireworks festival?"

strings.text: 「海岸公園で行われるみたいだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's being held at the coastal park, apparently."

strings.text: 「知ってた？　ここから良く見えるの」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Did you know? You can see them well from here."

strings.text: 「え？　ここからって、花火が見えるんですか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Huh? From here, you mean you can see the fireworks?"

strings.text: 「弓張は丘の上に建っている学校だからね。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yumihari is a school built on top of a hill, after all.

strings.text: 特にここから良く見えるって話よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: They say you can see them especially well from here."

strings.text: 「良くそんな事知ってますね。本当なんですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "You sure know a lot about that. Is it really true?"

strings.text: 「明石先輩から聞いたから本当じゃない？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I heard it from Akashi-senpai, so it must be, right?

strings.text: あの人、教会の改装を完成させるために、深夜の学校にも相当忍び込んでたみたいだからさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: He apparently snuck into the school late at night quite a lot in order to finish the chapel renovations."

strings.text: 「そういえば？　明石は？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, where is Akashi?"

strings.text: 「明石先輩ですか？　何か勉強してましたよ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Akashi-senpai? He was studying something."

strings.text: 「勉強？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Studying?"

strings.text: あいつ今更進学とか考えてるのか？
strings.translated: Is that guy actually thinking about going to college now?

strings.text: というか、俺たちだって受験を控えてるのに、何故あいつだけ勉強して、俺たちはこんな事をさせられているんだ。
strings.translated: More to the point, we've got entrance exams coming up too -- so why is he the only one studying while we're stuck doing this?

strings.text: 「何で、俺らだけがプールの掃除してて、あいつが勉強している。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why are only we cleaning the pool while he's studying?

strings.text: 勉強はそれこそ俺たちに必要なものだろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Studying is exactly what we need to be doing!"

strings.text: 「俺なんか本当は、こんな事してる場合じゃなくて、徹夜してでも勉強しなきゃいけないのに！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Guys like me really shouldn't be doing this stuff -- I should be pulling all-nighters to study!"

strings.text: 「何言ってるのよ。１年の時から毎日少しでもやってればそんな台詞なんて出ないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What are you saying? If you'd just done a little bit every day since your first year, that line wouldn't come out of your mouth."

strings.text: 「そりゃそうかもしれんが……だいたいお前のやっている少しって何時間だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, that may be true, but... just how many hours a day is the 'little bit' you do?"

strings.text: 「１年の時からだと、だいたい３時間ぐらいじゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Starting from first year, it'd be about three hours, wouldn't it?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-three hours..."

strings.text: 今の俺の一日の勉強量だよ……。
strings.translated: That's my current daily study amount...

strings.text: １年の時から毎日３時間やってれば、たしかに受験勉強なんて必要無いかもしれん……。
strings.translated: If you'd been doing three hours a day since your first year, then sure, maybe you wouldn't need cram-study for entrance exams...

strings.text: 「一日は２４時間なんだから３時間ぐらい勉強しておきなさいよ。２１時間は残るんだからさ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "A day is twenty-four hours long, so at least study for three. That still leaves you twenty-one."

strings.text: 「いや、学校もあるし、睡眠時間もあるし……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, there's school, and I need to sleep, and..."

strings.text: 「そうよ。睡眠時間が必要。だから一気に勉強しても効率が良くないんじゃない。知らないの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. You need sleep. That's why cramming it all in at once isn't efficient. Didn't you know?"

strings.text: 「どういう事だ？　知らないも何も言ってる意味すら分からん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What do you mean? I don't even understand what you're saying, forget knowing about it."

strings.text: 「記憶を定着させるためには睡眠が欠かせないのよ。そんな事も知らないの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sleep is essential to consolidate memories. You don't even know that?"

strings.text: 「いや、普通知らないと思うけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I don't think that's something people normally know..."

strings.text: 「だったら覚えておきなさい。もっとも効率が悪いのが“徹夜”、さらに言えば複数の科目を取っ替え引っ替えやるやり方。能率を上げるのなら同じ科目を一日やって、ちゃんと睡眠を取る事。これ大事だから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then remember it. The least efficient method is 'all-nighters' -- and even worse, switching between multiple subjects. To raise your efficiency, spend a day on the same subject and get proper sleep. This is important."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "R-right..."

strings.text: 「だから、試験とかの科目が多いのなら、かなり前から少しずつ勉強をしておかないと効果薄いんだからね。あんたとか一夜漬けとか多くない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So if the exam has a lot of subjects, if you don't start studying little by little well in advance, it won't have much effect. Don't you cram the night before a lot?"

strings.text: 「多いです……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A lot..."

strings.text: 「それ全然ダメだからね。記憶させるには睡眠だって大事なんだから、仮に短期間で記憶させるなら、一科目勉強して、レム睡眠とノンレム睡眠の両方を取って、再び起きて違う科目を勉強するとかするのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's completely no good. Sleep is essential for memorization, so if you're going to memorize in a short period, you study one subject, take both REM and non-REM sleep, then wake up and study a different subject."

strings.text: 「う、うう……詳しいですね……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Uh, uh... you're very knowledgeable..."

strings.text: 「勉強の効率化よ。こういう事だって知っておいて損は無いでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's about making studying efficient. There's no harm in knowing things like this, right?"

strings.text: 「はい、何か知らんがその通りだと思います……すみません……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes, I don't know why, but I think you're right... I'm sorry..."

strings.text: 良く分からんが、正論すぎて何も言えない。
strings.translated: I don't really get it, but it's too sound an argument for me to say anything.

strings.text: 「稟とかも同じぐらいやってるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is Rin doing about the same amount?"

strings.text: 「あ、いいえ、１年の時からはさすがにそんなやってないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, I haven't quite been doing that much since first year."

strings.text: 「そ、そうだよな。どのぐらいやってる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "R-right? How much are you doing?"

strings.text: 「え？　じ、時間ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? T-time-wise?"

strings.text: 「そうだ、実質時間を教えろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes, tell me the actual hours."

strings.text: 「うん、そうだねぇ。１年の時は２時間ぐらいかなぁ。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, let's see. In first year it was about two hours, I guess.

strings.text: ２年になってからやっと鳥谷さんより少し上で４時間ぐらい、今はだいたい６時間ぐらいを目安にしてるかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Once I got into second year, I finally overtook Toritani-san slightly, at about four hours; now I aim for around six hours, I think..."

strings.text: 「待って！　お前らどんだけ勉強してるの？　というか６時間ってお前いつ寝てるんだよ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wait! Just how much are you all studying?! Actually, six hours -- when do you even sleep?!"

strings.text: 「え？　別に普通に寝てるよ……。だいたい６時前に帰宅して、ご飯たべてから勉強して、お風呂入って……夜の２時ぐらいに寝る感じかな？
strings.speaker: 稟
