strings.translated: "Huh? I sleep normally... I usually get home around six, eat dinner, then study, take a bath... and go to bed around two in the morning, I guess?

strings.text: でも部活とかで帰宅が遅くなる事も多いから４時間しか出来ない時もあるよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: But there are often days when I'm late coming home because of club, so there are times I can only do four hours."

strings.text: 「家に帰った後に、ほ、ほとんど勉強だと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "After coming home, y-you're basically studying..."

strings.text: 「そりゃ、すごいわね。私だって休日でもないと６時間なんて勉強しないわ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's really impressive. Even I don't study six hours unless it's a day off.

strings.text: 普通に成績の差もつくというものね……。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Of course there'd be a difference in grades...

strings.text: 休日とかもっとやってるんでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: I bet you do even more on days off, right?"

strings.text: 「そんな事ないよ。全然やってないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's not true at all. I don't do anything."

strings.text: 出た。必殺「全然やってない」。
strings.translated: There it is. The killer phrase: "I don't do anything."

strings.text: 平日で６時間やってるやつが休日にやってないわけがない。
strings.translated: There's no way someone doing six hours on a weekday isn't doing it on a day off.

strings.text: だいたい１年の時からそんな勉強やってるとか、こいつら何考えてるんだ？
strings.translated: Also, studying that much since first year -- what are these people thinking?

strings.text: 普通、バイトして、適当に遊んでたら、勉強なんてしてる時間など無いはずだ！
strings.translated: Normally, if you're working a part-time job and messing around, there shouldn't be any time to study!

strings.text: だめだ……こんなちゃんとしてる連中と一緒にバカやってたのか……。
strings.translated: This is bad... I've been fooling around alongside people this diligent...

strings.text: 俺は、家帰ったら、飯作って、飯食って、パソコンしてたら夜中の２時とか３時だ……。
strings.translated: When I get home, I cook dinner, eat, mess around on the computer, and before I know it it's two or three in the morning...

strings.text: 試験前でもなければ勉強なんてまったくしない……。
strings.translated: Unless it's right before an exam, I don't study at all...

strings.text: むしろ、１年と２年の時など試験前でも勉強なんてしなかった……。
strings.translated: Rather, in first and second year, I didn't study even before exams...

strings.text: 「アリとキリギリスか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The Ant and the Grasshopper, huh..."

strings.text: 「キリギリスなんてちゃんと芸術活動にいそしんでたじゃないの。あんたは何をやっていたの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The grasshopper was diligently devoted to artistic activities, wasn't he? What were you doing?"

strings.text: 「すみません……。主にネットとかゲームとかです……もしもしゲーなんかもやったりしてます。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm sorry... Mainly the internet and games... I play mobage too.

strings.text: 誇れる事は腹筋と腕立てぐらいでしょうか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: The only things I can boast about are my sit-ups and push-ups, I suppose."

strings.text: 「筋トレ？　だったら体育系の学校行ったら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Muscle training? Then why not go to a sports school?"

strings.text: 「推薦とれる様な素晴らしい成績を学生時代に残してません……しかもたぶん残せません……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't have the kind of splendid record from my school years to get me a recommendation... and I probably couldn't build one either..."

strings.text: 「そういえば、草薙って、美術部の他にも体育会系の部活にも誘われてたわねぇ。体格良いし」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, Kusanagi, you were also invited to athletic clubs besides the art club, weren't you? Since you're well-built."

strings.text: 「ああ、俺は身体を鍛えるのは好きだが、基本的に上下関係がまったく苦手でな、体育会系部活なんていったら先輩に殺される。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, I do like training my body, but I'm fundamentally terrible with hierarchical relationships -- if I went into an athletic club, the seniors would kill me.

strings.text: 俺は上下関係が無い世界が大好きだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I love a world with no seniority."

strings.text: 「完全な社会不適合者じゃないですか……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "You're a complete social misfit, aren't you..."

strings.text: 「正直困っている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's a real problem, honestly."

strings.text: 「そんな事はどうでもいい！　とりあえず明石だけ勉強して、ヤツがプール掃除を免除されるなど許せん！　あいつをつぶしに行く！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyway, that doesn't matter! I cannot forgive that Akashi alone gets to study and be exempted from pool cleaning! I'm going to crush him!"

strings.text: 「あんた……どこまでいっても人の足を引っ張る事しか考えて無いのね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You... all you ever think about is dragging other people down, huh..."

strings.text: 「明石先輩はもう卒業されているのですから、別にプール掃除免除されててもおかしくないですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Akashi-senpai has already graduated, so it's not strange that he'd be exempted from pool cleaning."

strings.text: 「いいや、あいつも合宿に参加しているのなら、プール掃除をすべきだ！
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, if he's participating in the training camp, he should be cleaning the pool too!

strings.text: プール掃除が合宿への参加条件だったではないか！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Pool cleaning was the condition for participating in the camp, wasn't it?!"

strings.text: 「だから、一応は明石先輩は合宿参加してないじゃないですか。
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Like I said, technically Akashi-senpai isn't participating in the camp.

strings.text: 夕方になると自宅帰ってますよ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: He goes home in the evening."

strings.text: 「そんなもん関係ない！　俺みたいに無理矢理参加させられている人間がいる中で不条理きわまりない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That doesn't matter! When there are people being forced to participate like me, this is the height of unreasonableness!"

strings.text: 「まぁ、勉強の邪魔しても無駄だとは思うけどね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, I think interrupting his studying would be pointless, though..."

strings.text: 「明石来てるのか！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Akashi's here!"

strings.text: 「なんじゃー。おちこぼれ草薙くんかー」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Whaaat. If it isn't the failing student, Kusanagi-kun."

strings.text: 「なんだとー。俺を出し抜いて勉強するとかゆるさんぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What was that. Getting a jump on me by studying -- unforgivable."

strings.text: 「最悪な足の引っ張り合いです……
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "This is the worst kind of dragging each other down......

strings.text: ああいう風にはなってはいけない」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: You must never end up like that."

strings.text: 「まぁ、めずらしく優美の言う事に異論ないわー」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Well, for once I have no objection to what Yumi's saying."

strings.text: 「わ、じゃ、邪魔するな。ワシは勉強してるんじゃー」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Wha, d-don't get in my way. I'm studying, I am."

strings.text: 「俺がプール掃除してる間に進めてるんじゃねぇ。てめぇも掃除手伝えや」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't get a head start while I'm cleaning the pool. You help clean too."

strings.text: 「知らん。ワシは知らんぞ！」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Don't know. I know nothing!"

strings.text: 「それで、どの科目を勉強されてるんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "So, which subject are you studying?"

strings.text: 「科目というか、資格を取るんじゃ。
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "It's not a subject exactly, I'm getting a certification.

strings.text: 今は勉強よりも資格の時代じゃからなー。やっぱり資格は大事よ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: These days it's the age of qualifications rather than studies. Qualifications really are important."

strings.text: 「資格……だと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Qualifications... you say......"

strings.text: こいつにしてはかなりまともな事を言う。
strings.translated: Coming from him, that's a surprisingly sensible thing to say.

strings.text: たしかに資格はありだ。無いよりあった方がいい。
strings.translated: Certifications are definitely a good idea. Better to have them than not.

strings.text: 「へー。資格ですか。資格ってどんな勉強するのでしょう」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ohh. A qualification. What kind of studying is that?"

strings.text: 「こんなんじゃよ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "It's like this."

strings.text: ほほえみながら、明石の勉強内容を覗く稟。
strings.translated: Smiling, Rin peered at what Akashi was studying.

strings.text: 笑顔が数秒で凍る。
strings.translated: Her smile froze within seconds.

strings.text: 「あ、あの……これって……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um... this is......"

strings.text: 「なんの勉強してるんだ！　お前の事だから、何か裏技的なものを見つけただろう！　見せろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you studying?! Knowing you, you've found some sort of cheat trick! Show me!"

strings.text: 「わ、わわ、ワシの教科書を奪うにゃー」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "H-hey, hey, don't snatch my textbook awaaay!"

strings.text: 「さぁ、どんな……ど、ん……な」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Now then, what kind of...... w-hat... kind of......"

strings.text: 明石から奪った本にはこう書かれていた。
strings.translated: In the book I'd snatched from Akashi, it was written:

strings.text: 『殺しの手帳』
strings.translated: 'The Killer's Handbook'

strings.text: 「な、なんだこれ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-what is this?"

strings.text: 「殺しの手帳？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The Killer's Handbook?"

strings.text: 「うわ……。なんでしょう、この科目……。
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ugh...... What is this subject even......

strings.text: どんな学部の科目でこんなもん勉強してるんでしょうかね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: What kind of department has you studying this stuff?"

strings.text: 「だから学部じゃないって、資格だって」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Like I said, it's not a department, it's a certification."

strings.text: 「『殺しの手帳』が必要な資格って何だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What kind of certification requires 'The Killer's Handbook'?"

strings.text: 「殺しのライセンスじゃよ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "A license to kill, that's what."

strings.text: 「殺しのライセンスじゃよ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A license to kill, that's what.

strings.text: じゃねーだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Yeah, no."

strings.text: 「必修科目で『愛の手帳』もあるんじゃぞー。『愛のライセンス』も『殺しのライセンス』には不可欠じゃからのー」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "There's also a required course called 'The Love Handbook.' A 'License of Love' is indispensable for a 'License to Kill,' after all."

strings.text: 「ほう、そうか。それは良かった。良かったなー」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ohh, is that so. That's wonderful. How wonderful."

strings.text: 俺はため息をついていすに座る。
strings.translated: I sighed and sat down in a chair.

strings.text: 「何か相当安心してますねぇ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "You seem really relieved somehow."

strings.text: 「明石先輩がちゃんと勉強してなかったからって、あんたが勉強しなくていいわけじゃないんだけどねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Just because Akashi-senpai wasn't studying properly doesn't mean you don't have to study, you know."

strings.text: 「うるせぇ。ちゃんとやる。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shut up. I'll do it properly.

strings.text: 明日から！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Starting tomorrow!"

strings.text: 「典型的なダメな人発言じゃないですか……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That's a textbook line from a hopeless person......"

strings.text: 「明日からやるんだったらダメじゃないだろ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If I'm doing it starting tomorrow, then it's fine, isn't it.

strings.text: だいたい今日は炎天下でプール掃除させられてだな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Besides, today I was made to clean the pool under the scorching sun.

strings.text: さらに今から料理作らされるんだぞ。勉強なんて出来るか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: And now I'm being made to cook. Like I can study on top of that."

strings.text: 「大丈夫。しますから。させますから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's fine. You will. I'll make you."

strings.text: 「……なんか笑顔が怖いぞ。稟……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Your smile is kind of scary, Rin......"

strings.text: 「でも、だめだよ。草薙くん。本当に大変な事になるよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But no, Kusanagi-kun. Things will really turn out badly."

strings.text: 「どうせ今年合格じゃなくてもいい。とか思ってるんでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You're probably thinking it's fine if you don't pass this year, aren't you?"

strings.text: 「んなわけないだろ。金ないんだから。一発合格じゃないと破産する」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No way. I have no money. If I don't pass on the first try, I'm bankrupt."

strings.text: 「だったら何で遊んでるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then why are you goofing off?"

strings.text: 「お前だって一緒に今までバカみたいな事やってたじゃないかっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You were doing the same stupid stuff with me up till now, weren't you!"

strings.text: 「でも私は勉強してた」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But I was studying."

strings.text: 俺はしてなかった……。
strings.translated: I wasn't......

strings.text: 「でも草薙くんは得意科目だけは点数が高いのですから、教科を選べばどうにかなりますよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But Kusanagi-kun, you get high scores in your best subjects, so you'll manage if you pick the right ones."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、ご飯の後で勉強をみんなでやるっていうのはどうかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "For now, how about we all study together after dinner?"

strings.text: 「え？　私達もですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Huh? Us too?"

strings.text: 「まさか、３年だけよ。あんた達は遊んでていいわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Of course not, just the third-years. You lot can play."

strings.text: 「勉強かよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Studying, huh......"

strings.text: 「まぁ、真ん中で休み時間入れるけどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, we'll take a break in the middle, though."

strings.text: 「真ん中で休み時間？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A break in the middle?"

strings.text: 「こっちの話、んじゃ、とっとと夕ご飯作るわよ。５時には食べるからね。５時までに料理完成させるからね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Nothing, never mind. Anyway, let's hurry and make dinner. We're eating at five. So we've got to finish cooking by five."

strings.text: 「早えよ。夕方ですら無いだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's too early. It's not even evening."

strings.text: 「私はいつも夕ご飯なんて食べないのよ。とりあえずどんな事があっても寝る６時間前に食べ物なんか口にしないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I never eat dinner as such. Anyway, no matter what, I don't put anything in my mouth within six hours of going to sleep."

strings.text: 「とりあえず料理作るわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Anyway, let's make the food."

strings.text: 「んで、料理は何だ？　この具材を見るかぎり、定番のカレーか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So what are we making? Judging by these ingredients, the standard curry?"

strings.text: 「あら、肉じゃがだって出来るわよ。ビーフシチューも作れるし」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh, I can make nikujaga too. Or beef stew."

strings.text: 「鶏肉でどうやって肉じゃがやビーフシチューなんか作るんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How the hell are you going to make nikujaga or beef stew with chicken?"

strings.text: 「草薙ならそれぐらいの事やってくれると思ったのに……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I thought you'd manage even that much, Kusanagi......"

strings.text: 「どうやって鶏肉で作るんだよ。牛肉が必要だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How am I supposed to make it with chicken? You need beef."

strings.text: 「一番近いスーパーに行くのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Go to the nearest supermarket."

strings.text: 「買いに行かせるのかよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're making me go buy it?!"

strings.text: 「アホらしい、さぁ、とっととカレーを作るぞ！　ったく勉強しろとか買い出しに行けとかデタラメだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ridiculous. Come on, let's just make curry already! Geez, telling me to study, telling me to go shopping -- absurd."

strings.text: 「カレーかぁ。カレーは難しいんですよねぇ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Curry, huh. Curry's actually difficult."

strings.text: 「え？　カレーが難しい？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? Curry's difficult?"

strings.text: 「うん、小麦粉を焦げない様に炒めるのって結構難しいんだよ。小麦粉ってすぐに焦げちゃうから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, stir-frying flour without burning it is pretty hard. Flour burns really easily."

strings.text: 「小麦粉？　え？　タマネギじゃなくて？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Flour? Huh? Not onions?"

strings.text: 「アホか。ブラウンソースからカレーなんか作るわけねぇだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Idiot. Nobody makes curry from a brown sauce base."

strings.text: 「何それ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What's that?"

strings.text: 「ブラウンソースって小麦粉とバターを炒めるんだよ。カレー粉そのものを調合する様なヤツが使うもんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Brown sauce is made by frying flour and butter. It's what people who blend their own curry powder use."

strings.text: 「カレー粉って調合するもんなの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You blend curry powder?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、自分好みの味にする事は出来るから、やるヤツもいるが、まぁ道楽だよ。あんなもんは」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, since you can tune the flavor to your own taste, some people do, but it's a hobby thing. That kind of stuff."

strings.text: 「でも、香辛料挽き立てだから香り良いですよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But the spices are freshly ground, so the aroma's wonderful."

strings.text: 「へぇ、それ作ってよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh, then make that one."

strings.text: 「だめだだめだ！　んなめんどくさい事するか！　だいたい香辛料はどうするんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No no no! Like I'd do something so troublesome! Where would we even get the spices?"

strings.text: 「俺がひとっ走り行って来るけど？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I could run and get them?"

strings.text: 「そうね。圭のバイクだったらすぐでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. On Kei's bike it wouldn't take long, right?"

strings.text: 「おいおい、勘弁してくれよ。めんどくさい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on, cut me a break. It's a pain."

strings.text: 「いいじゃないですか。カレー粉の調合は私がしますから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's fine. I'll do the curry powder blending."

strings.text: 「いや、それは俺がやる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I'll do that."

strings.text: 「え？　いいよ。私がやるから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? It's fine. I'll do it......"

strings.text: 「いや、お前はタマネギを炒めてろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, you fry the onions."

strings.text: 「さっき、めんどくさいって言ってたのにぃ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You were just saying it was a pain, though."

strings.text: 「そうよ。何でさっきまでめんどくさそうだったのに」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. Why were you acting like it was a hassle just now?"

strings.text: 「あ、それはですね。カレー粉の調合ってまさに自分好みのカレーが作れるので、作った事がある人は、とりあえず自分でやりたくなるのですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, that's because. Blending your own curry powder lets you make curry exactly how you like it, so anyone who's done it before wants to do it themselves."

strings.text: 「市販のカレー粉はうまいにはうまいが、誰でもうまい普通のカレーだからな。自家製の自分好みはそういうものと少し違う」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Store-bought curry powder is tasty, sure, but it's a normal curry that anyone would find tasty. Homemade to-your-taste stuff is a little different from that."

strings.text: 「へぇ、つまり、稟ちゃんと草薙で作るものが変わるんだ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ohh, so what Rin-chan and Kusanagi make will be different."

strings.text: 「そういう事になりますね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's about right."

strings.text: 「んじゃ二種類作ったら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then why not make two kinds?"

strings.text: 「料理対決ですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A cooking showdown."

strings.text: 「おお、燃えるなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ooh, I'm fired up."

strings.text: 「いやいや、稟には敵わないさ……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, I'm no match for Rin......

strings.text: さてと、圭、これが買ってくるスパイスなのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Alright, Kei, here are the spices you need to buy......"

strings.text: 「って！　やる気満々！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hey! You're fully into it!"

strings.text: 「か、買ってきたぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I-I got them!"

strings.text: 「では、はじめるか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well then, shall we begin?"

strings.text: 「んじゃ、私はじゃがいもの皮むきでもやろうかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then, I guess I'll peel the potatoes?"

strings.text: 「量がいっぱいありますよ？　私がやろうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "There's a lot, though? Want me to do it?"

strings.text: 「いいから、いいから、稟ちゃんはスパイス調合してよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's fine, it's fine. Rin-chan, you blend the spices."

strings.text: 「私も野菜剥きます」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I'll peel vegetables too."

strings.text: 「タマネギのみじん切りは誰がやるんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who's mincing the onions?"

strings.text: 「それはあんたでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's your job, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「俺かよ！　一番嫌な仕事だろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Me?! That's the worst job!"

strings.text: 「タマネギのみじん切りって、こうトントントンってテンポ良く出来ないとダメでしょ？　そんな事出来る男ってあんたぐらいでしょ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You have to mince onions with a nice tempo, right, chop chop chop? You're about the only guy who can do that."

strings.text: 「なんで男限定なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why is it limited to guys?"

strings.text: 「だって、あんな大量なタマネギなんてみじん切りにしたら涙止まらないでしょ？　そんな作業女の子にさせられないわよ。男がやるべきじゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, if you mince that many onions, the tears won't stop, right? You can't make a girl do that kind of work. Shouldn't a man do it?"

strings.text: 「ああ、たしかに、そんな様な事を、教会の改装の時に言ってました。女にさせられるか！　とか」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Ah, come to think of it, they said something like that at the church renovation. 'Like I'd make a woman do this!' or something."

strings.text: 「いや、あれはな。体力的な問題で、女が出来るものじゃないという話でだな、基本的には、タマネギが目にしみるのに男と女関係ないから。痛さも別に変わらないから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that was, physically speaking, not something women could do -- that was the point. Fundamentally, when it comes to onions stinging your eyes, gender has nothing to do with it. The pain is the same."

strings.text: 「いや、そんな作業は女がやるべきでは無い。痛みを一心に引き受けろ！　それが男じゃろ！　草薙」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "No, work like this shouldn't be done by women. Take the pain upon yourself with a single heart! That's what a man does! Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「だったらお前がやれよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then you do it!"

strings.text: 「だめよ。明石先輩がやったら、どうせゴロ切りのタマネギを出す気だから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "No good. If Akashi-senpai does it, he'll definitely serve up onions cut into big chunks."

strings.text: 「ゴロ切りのタマネギでいいじゃないか。だいたい何でカレーのタマネギがみじん切りなんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Big chunks of onion are fine. Why do the onions in curry have to be minced anyway?"

strings.text: 「はーい。私がタマネギ嫌いだからでーす」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Yes! Because I don't like onions!"

strings.text: 「そんなわがまま聞くかボケが！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Like I'd listen to that kind of selfish demand, moron!"

strings.text: 「私もゴロ切りのタマネギは嫌いよ。細かく刻んだ方がおいしいわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I hate big chunks of onion too. Finely chopped tastes better."

strings.text: 「あのな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Listen......"

strings.text: 「あはは、ちなみに俺もタマネギはみじん切りじゃなきゃ食べられないぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahaha, incidentally, I can't eat onions unless they're minced, either."

strings.text: 「それは、俺がいつも殴ってでも食わせてるだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's why I always beat you into eating them."

strings.text: 「私が切ろうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Shall I cut them?"

strings.text: 「私が野菜切り班ですし、私達がやりますよ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I'm on the vegetable-cutting team, we'll do it."

strings.text: 「分かった。分かった。やる。やってやるよ！　くそぉ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Fine, fine. I'll do it. I'll do it, okay! Damn it."

strings.text: 「草薙くん？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-kun?"

strings.text: くそ……、氷川がやると言い出した時の川内野の眼光の恐ろしさたるや……。
strings.translated: Damn it...... The terrifying glare in Kawachino's eye when Hikawa offered to do it......

strings.text: 「まぁいい。タマネギは俺が切る」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, whatever. I'll cut the onions."

strings.text: こうして、めでたく俺がタマネギを切る事になった。
strings.translated: And so, happily, I ended up cutting the onions.

strings.text: なるべく水にタマネギを浸しておく。
strings.translated: Soak the onions in water as much as possible.

strings.text: こうすれば出来る限りは、タマネギの催涙成分は水に溶けて出づらくなる。
strings.translated: This way, the tear-inducing compounds in the onions dissolve into the water and are less likely to come out.

strings.text: だがこの量……。
strings.translated: But this quantity......

strings.text: 「なんかすごく痛いわよ！　草薙！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "This really hurts! Kusanagi!"

strings.text: 「涙止まんねぇよぉ……」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "The tears won't stop......"

strings.text: 「すごい目がしみるよぉ……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "My eyes sting so bad......"

strings.text: 「当たり前だ！　こんな分量のタマネギなんかみじん切りにしたらこんな事にもなるわ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Of course they do! Mince this amount of onions and this is what happens!"

strings.text: 「お前らは貧弱やのぉ。何でそんな涙なんじゃ？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "You lot are so frail. Why are you crying like that?"

strings.text: 「って！　お前みたいにゴーグルみたいなサングラスつけてるやつに言われたくない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey! I don't want to hear that from someone wearing goggle-like sunglasses!"

strings.text: 「へたれ！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Wimp!"

strings.text: 「って！　お前はどこから、その防毒マスクを持ってきた！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey! Where did you pull that gas mask from!"

strings.text: 「自宅からです。薬物を使うには必要ですからねぇ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "From home. It's necessary for handling chemicals, after all."

strings.text: 「そんなものを必要とする薬物なんかの扱いを美術部でやるな！
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't handle anything that requires that kind of gear in the art club!

strings.text: そんなもんやりたかったら化学部に鞍替えしろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: If you want to do that stuff, transfer to the chemistry club!"

strings.text: 「嫌ですよ。あんな毎日水質検査しかやらない様な部活……地味すぎてやる意味が分かりません」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "No thanks. A club that only does water-quality tests every day...... It's too dull, I don't see the point."

strings.text: 「そんな事言うな！　全国の化学部に謝れ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't say things like that! Apologize to every chemistry club in the country!"

strings.text: 「さすがにしみますねぇ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It really does sting."

strings.text: 「これだけのタマネギですからねぇ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "It's this many onions, after all."

strings.text: 「はい、里奈。これは里奈の分の防毒マスク」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Here, Rina. This is your gas mask."

strings.text: 「いや、あのね。こんなものつけたら野菜の皮剥けないからね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "No, uh. If I put something like this on, I can't peel vegetables."

strings.text: 「いや、これが、これが、結構視界が広くてね。ほらつけてみて、結構良くない？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "No, this, this actually has a pretty wide field of view. Come on, try it on, it's pretty good, right?"

strings.text: 「おお、本当だ。結構視界が広いわ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Oh, you're right. The visibility's actually pretty wide."

strings.text: 「横で意味不明な事で盛り上がるな！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't get excited about something incomprehensible next to me!"

strings.text: 「意味不明とは失礼な！　里奈の目を、あなたが出している邪悪なガスから守っているのですっ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "How rude to call it incomprehensible! I'm protecting Rina's eyes from the evil gas you're releasing!"

strings.text: 「俺が出してるんじゃねーよ。しかも邪悪なガスじゃねーよ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not the one releasing it. And it's not evil gas.

strings.text: だいたい、俺が一番痛いんだよ！　一番しみるんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Besides, I'm the one hurting the most! I'm the one it stings the worst!"

strings.text: 「無駄口はいいからとっとと刻みなさいよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Enough idle chatter -- hurry up and mince!"

strings.text: 「分かってるわ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I got it!"

strings.text: とりあえず山盛りのタマネギのみじん切りができあがる。
strings.translated: For the time being, a heaping pile of minced onions was complete.

strings.text: 涙も涸れ果てて……という言葉があるけど、あれは嘘だな。
strings.translated: "Even my tears have run dry......" -- there's a phrase like that, but it's a lie.

strings.text: 涙なんて枯れるわけない。
strings.translated: Tears don't just run dry.

strings.text: いくらでも出てくる。
strings.translated: They keep coming, endlessly.

strings.text: あと鼻水なのか涙なのか分からない事にもなっていく。
strings.translated: And on top of that, it gets to the point where you can't tell if it's tears or snot.

strings.text: 「ふぅ……とりあえず終わったぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Phew...... Anyway, I'm done......"

strings.text: 「お疲れ様でした。がんばりましたねぇ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Good work. You really tried your best."

strings.text: 「すごいですねぇ。私も涙が止まりません」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Amazing. I can't stop crying either."

strings.text: 「お前らの言葉だけ聞くと、何か感動的な事でもやり遂げた感じに聞こえるが、やったのはタマネギをみじん切りにしただけだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Listening to just your words, it sounds like I accomplished something moving, but all I did was mince onions......"

strings.text: 「んで？　俺が刻んだこの大量のタマネギ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So? This huge pile of onions I chopped.

strings.text: 誰がこれ炒めるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Who's going to saute them......?"

strings.text: 「んなの草薙に決まってるじゃないの」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Obviously that'd be Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「って！　お前この量のタマネギ炒めるのがどれだけ大変か！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey! Do you know how tough it is to saute this much onion?!"

strings.text: 「私がやるよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'll do it."

strings.text: 「却下。これだけのタマネギを炒めたら、切るときと同じぐらい目にしみるわよ。そんな作業させられないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Denied. If you saute this many onions, your eyes will sting just as much as when cutting them. I can't let you do that kind of work."

strings.text: 「この防毒マスクがあります！」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "We have this gas mask!"

strings.text: 「そんな視界が狭まるものをつけて出来るわけないでしょ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There's no way you can do it with something that narrows your vision like that on......"

strings.text: 「いや、これがですねぇ。結構、視界が広くて……ほら」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "No, this thing, you see. The field of view is actually pretty wide...... Look."

strings.text: 「あらやだ。本当に広い。これだったらいろいろな作業が出来るわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh my. It really is wide. With this you could do all sorts of tasks."

strings.text: 「はい、はい、くっだらない事やってるんだったら俺が炒めるからな……。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes, yes, if you're going to do such stupid things, I'll saute them......

strings.text: ったく、この量のタマネギなんか炒める事出来るやつなんてほとんどいないだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Geez, there's hardly anyone who can saute this quantity of onions......"

strings.text: 俺はタマネギを喫茶店に置いてあるナプキンで包む。
strings.translated: I wrapped the onions in napkins from the coffee shop.

strings.text: 貧乏性の若田がティッシュの代わりに持ってくるらしい。
strings.translated: Apparently the miserly Wakata brings them along as a substitute for tissues.

strings.text: ひどい教師だ。
strings.translated: What a terrible teacher.

strings.text: 「ちょっと、ちょっと、何やってるのよ。炒めるのよ。何でそんなもんに包んでるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hey, hey, what are you doing? We're supposed to saute them. Why are you wrapping them in that?"

strings.text: 「一回じゃ、出来ないから、こうやって分割してチンしてくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It can't be done in one go, so divide them up like this and microwave them."

strings.text: 「チン？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Microwave?"

strings.text: 「ショートカットおよび催涙防止だ。電子レンジで先に火を通しておくと飴色になりやすいんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's a shortcut and it prevents the tearing. If you heat them in the microwave first, they caramelize to an amber color more easily."

strings.text: 「電子レンジ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Microwave?"

strings.text: 「ああ、３分半ぐらいレンジにかけてくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, run them for about three and a half minutes."

strings.text: タマネギの催涙成分は揮発、分解しやすいので加熱すると失われていく。
strings.translated: The tear-inducing compounds in onions are volatile and break down easily, so they're lost when heated.

strings.text: これに対して糖質は加熱で揮発、分解されづらい。
strings.translated: Sugars, on the other hand, don't volatilize or break down easily when heated.

strings.text: タマネギを炒めたときに甘くなるのはこのためだ。
strings.translated: That's why onions become sweet when sauteed.

strings.text: 「どんどん、電子レンジで熱してくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Keep heating them in the microwave, one after another."

strings.text: 「あと、そっちのフライパンで肉炒めてくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Also, saute the meat in that other frying pan."

strings.text: 「え？　別のフライパンで焼くのですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Huh? We're cooking it in a separate pan?"

strings.text: 「ああ、肉は煮るよりも焼く方がうまい。同じフライパンでにんじんとキノコ類を焼いてくれ、それらが終わった後に使ったフライパンに水を注ぎ、肉汁ごと大鍋に戻す」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, meat tastes better seared than boiled. Cook the carrots and mushrooms in the same pan, then when they're done, pour water into the used frying pan and return it to the big pot, meat juices and all."

strings.text: 「何か特殊な作り方ですね」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "That's a pretty unique way of making it."

strings.text: 「これだけの量だ。手順を簡略化した方がいいだろ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's this much food. Better to simplify the procedure.

strings.text: それに大人数だから。なるべく作業を並列で処理した方がいい。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Plus there are a lot of us. It's better to process the work in parallel as much as possible.

strings.text: 明石と圭も米炊いてるか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Akashi, Kei, are you cooking the rice?"

strings.text: 「うむ……ブンカ鍋でご飯炊くことが本当に出来るかどうか不安じゃが……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Hmm...... I'm anxious whether we can really cook rice in a bunka pot......"

strings.text: 「言われた通り、時間を計ってやってれば大丈夫だ。最後に強火にするからそれだけ俺がやる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just do it timed like I told you and it'll be fine. I'll turn up the heat at the end, so I'll handle that part."

strings.text: 「さすが草薙くんは手際がいいね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "As expected, Kusanagi-kun, you're really efficient."

strings.text: 「手際がいいんじゃなくて、手抜きが得意なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not that I'm efficient, I'm just good at cutting corners."

strings.text: 「うめぇ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Delicious!"

strings.text: 「どっちもおいしいわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "They're both good."

strings.text: 「よかった」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm glad."

strings.text: 「草薙先輩のは少し辛いですが……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-senpai's is a little spicy, though......"

strings.text: 「かもしれないな。俺のカレーは辛めかもしれん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Maybe so. My curry might be on the spicier side."

strings.text: 「里奈は辛いの嫌いだからね。はい、冷たいミルクティー」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Rina doesn't like spicy food, after all. Here, cold milk tea."

strings.text: 「なんでそんなもん用意してる？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why did you prepare something like that?"

strings.text: 「辛さ対策です」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "A countermeasure for the spice."

strings.text: 何でそれがミルクティー？
strings.translated: Why milk tea for that?

strings.text: 「でも稟ちゃんのはかなりマイルドだね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But Rin-chan's is pretty mild."

strings.text: 「はい、私はこっちの方が好きです」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Yes, I like this one better."

strings.text: 「そうですね。私のカレーはあまり辛くないかもしれません。ミルクとか入ってるぐらいですし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see. My curry might not be very spicy. It has milk and things in it, after all."

strings.text: 「あ、だから少し白いんですね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ah, so that's why it's a little whitish."

strings.text: 「カボチャとかも入ってるよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It has pumpkin and stuff in it too."

strings.text: 「俺は直哉のカレーの方が好きかなぁ。稟ちゃんのカレーはカレーというよりはカレースープっぽいぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I think I prefer Naoya's curry. Rin-chan's curry is more like curry soup than curry."

strings.text: 「かもしれませんね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That might be true."

strings.text: 「直哉！　すげぇうめぇぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Naoya! It's super delicious!"

strings.text: 「あー、ありがとうよ。いつもいつも同じ反応で、作り甲斐があるというものだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, thanks. Always the same reaction -- it makes it worth cooking......"

strings.text: 「だってすっごくうまいんだもん！　うまいぞ。あははは」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But it's really tasty! It's delicious. Ahaha."

strings.text: 「うまいな……ふむふむ……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Delicious...... Mm-hmm......"

strings.text: 「お前も、本読みながら食うな！
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You too, don't eat while reading a book!

strings.text: どういう教育されてるんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: What kind of upbringing did you have?!"

strings.text: 「なんかさ、三年間一緒にいて……、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You know, we've been together for three years......,

strings.text: みんなで料理を作るのははじめてだねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: and this is the first time we've all cooked together."

strings.text: 「そうなんですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Really?"

strings.text: 「そう言われてみればそうだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Now that you mention it, you're right......"

strings.text: 「まぁ、合宿自体がはじめてだしなぁ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Well, this is our first training camp, after all."

strings.text: 「だからこそ、合宿は何処か遠くでやってみたかったんだけどね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's precisely why I wanted to hold the camp somewhere far away......"

strings.text: 「行けば良かったのに……」
strings.translated: "You should have gone......"

strings.text: 「小沙智？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kosachi?"

strings.text: 「行けば、あんなバカな騒ぎを起こさなくてすんだのに……」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "If you'd gone, you wouldn't have had to cause that stupid ruckus......"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、無理でしょ。私達がいなくても明石先輩と草薙がやったと思うわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, that would've been impossible. Even without us, I think Akashi-senpai and Kusanagi would have done it."

strings.text: 「でも完成はしませんでしたよ。
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "But it wouldn't have been completed.

strings.text: 皆さんがいなければ、あの作品は完成しませんでした」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: Without all of you, that piece would never have been finished."

strings.text: 「そしたら、単なる落書きで終わってたわ。それで良かったの小沙智？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then it would have ended as mere graffiti. Would that have been fine with you, Kosachi?"

strings.text: 「なんだよ……今更、喧嘩売りに来たのか？　お前？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is it...... Now, of all times, you've come to pick a fight? You?"

strings.text: 「カレー出しなさいよ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Serve up the curry."

strings.text: 「カレー出しなさいよ！　小牧にも！
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Serve up the curry! For Komaki too!

strings.text: あと私のは大盛りね！」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: And make mine a large!"

strings.text: 「私は小盛りでお願いします」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Mine small, please."

strings.text: 「もちろん二色よ！　二色カレーにしてよ！」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Two-color, of course! Make it a two-color curry!"

strings.text: 「カレー食べに来たのかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You came here to eat curry?"

strings.text: 「はい、真琴」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Here, Makoto."

strings.text: 小沙智は鍵を出す。
strings.translated: Kosachi held out a key.

strings.text: その鍵には見覚えがある。
strings.translated: I recognized that key.

strings.text: さっき掃除していた……。
strings.translated: We were cleaning it earlier......

strings.text: 「プールの鍵ですよね。それ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's the key to the pool, right?"

strings.text: 「そうよ。真琴に頼まれたのよ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "That's right. Makoto asked me for it."

strings.text: 「頼まれたって？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Asked you?"

strings.text: 「だから急いだのよ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's why we hurried.

strings.text: 花火、あのプールから見えるでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: You can see the fireworks from that pool, right?"

strings.text: 「という事は……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Which means......"

strings.text: 「はい、プール掃除の報酬です。先生からプールを使う許可、ちゃんと下りましたよ」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Yes, it's the reward for cleaning the pool. We got proper permission from the teacher to use the pool."

strings.text: 「本当ですか！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Really?!"

strings.text: 「だから、水着持参って言ってたんですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "So that's why you told us to bring swimsuits?"

strings.text: 「俺、そんなの聞いてないぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I didn't hear anything about that."

strings.text: 「おまえなんぞ、下着で泳げばいいだろ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Someone like you can just swim in your underwear.

strings.text: どうせ、お子様なんだから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: You're a child anyway."

strings.text: 「なんだそれ！　キレるぞ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What's that?! I'll snap!"

strings.text: 「ワシも聞いてなかったが、草薙は用意があるのか？」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "I hadn't heard about it either, but does Kusanagi have something prepared?"

strings.text: 「体操着のズボンでいいだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Gym shorts will do."

strings.text: 「だったらワシは制服で良いかのぉ」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Then would my uniform be alright?"

strings.text: 「それでいいんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That'd be fine, wouldn't it?"

strings.text: 「いいわけないでしょ！　ほら、真琴に言われたから亘の水着持ってきてやったわよ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "It would not be fine! Here, Makoto asked me, so I brought Wataru's swimsuit for you."

strings.text: 「おお、感謝」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Oh, my thanks."

strings.text: 「どうするんだよぉ。俺は体操着も持ってきてないぞ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What am I gonna do? I didn't even bring my gym clothes."

strings.text: 「だからパンツでいいだろ。お子様なんだから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So I said, your underwear's fine. You're a child."

strings.text: 「何でそうなるんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Why does that follow?!"

strings.text: 「それもおもしろいかも……」
strings.translated: "That might be interesting, too......"

strings.text: 「早かったじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That was quick."

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「仕事を速攻終わらせて来ました」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I finished work in record time and came right over."

strings.text: 「っ、あ、あなたっ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Nn, y-you--"

strings.text: 「あー、テレビで良くみる葛佳さんですね。本当にお会い出来るなんて光栄です」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Ah, it's Kusuka-san, the one I see on TV a lot. It's an honor to actually meet you."

strings.text: 「あ、あのっ、は、初めましてっ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "U-um, n-nice to meet you."

strings.text: 「初めまして」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Nice to meet you."

strings.text: 「す、すごい……本当に美人だ……こんな美人いるんだ……」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "A-amazing...... She really is beautiful...... There really are people this beautiful......"

strings.text: 「それはそれはうれしい言葉です。ありがとうございます。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Such kind words. Thank you very much.

strings.text: それはそうと、まだ来客はあります」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: By the way, there are more guests."

strings.text: 「来客？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Guests?"

strings.text: ルリヲ
strings.translated: Rurio

strings.text: 「ほわぁ、草薙ちゃんひさしぶりー」
strings.speaker: ルリヲ
strings.translated: "Hewwo, Kusanagi-chan, long time no see!"

strings.text: 鈴菜
strings.translated: Suzuna

strings.text: 「結構、最近お会いしましたよね……」
strings.speaker: 鈴菜
strings.translated: "We met fairly recently, didn't we......"

strings.text: 「って、氷川の妹と川内野の妹っ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey, it's Hikawa's little sister and Kawachino's little sister!"

strings.text: 「その、妹って言い方やめてくんないかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: ルリヲ
strings.translated: "Um, could you stop with the 'little sister' thing......"

strings.text: 「まぁ、良いではないですか、それより雫様、用事を済ませてしまいましょう」
strings.speaker: 鈴菜
strings.translated: "Well, that's fine, isn't it. More importantly, Shizuku-sama, let's finish our errand."

strings.text: 「そうそう、忘れるところだった。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Right, right, I almost forgot.

strings.text: それはそうと、二人の水着です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: By the way, here are swimsuits for the two of you."

strings.text: 「え？　水着？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? Swimsuits?"

strings.text: 「え？　俺のも？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Mine too?"

strings.text: 「はい、必要になると鳥谷さんからお聞きしましたので」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, I heard from Toritani-san that they would be necessary."

strings.text: 「そのために来たのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that what you came for?"

strings.text: 「いいえ？　これです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No? It's this."

strings.text: 「ちょ、お、お前」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-hey, y-you--"

strings.text: 「お、おい、はしたないぞ。何で自分のスカートめくるんだよっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "H-hey, that's indecent. Why are you flipping up your own skirt?!"

strings.text: 「オーイエース」
strings.speaker: トーマス
strings.translated: "Oh yes."

strings.text: 「お前、今までいなかったくせにどこに隠れてた！
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You! You weren't here till now--where were you hiding?!

strings.text: こら！　見るな！　見るなぁ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: Hey! Don't look! Don't look!"

strings.text: 「今、ロッカーの隙間から出てきたわよ。こいつ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "He just crawled out from between the lockers. This guy..."

strings.text: 「大丈夫です。下は水着です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's fine. I'm wearing a swimsuit underneath."

strings.text: 「だ、だからって、はしたないぞ。ダメなんだからな！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "E-even so, it's indecent. You can't do that!"

strings.text: 「ああ、水着といってもそうやられると少し……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, even if it is a swimsuit, having you do that is a little..."

strings.text: 「ダメでしたか……こういうの直哉は嫌いですか……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Was it bad...? Do you dislike this sort of thing, Naoya...?"

strings.text: 「いや、嫌いとかでは無いんだが……むしろ好きなのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it's not that I dislike it... if anything, I like it..."

strings.text: 「もう一度やりましょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Shall I do it once more?"

strings.text: 「いや！　いい！　こんな場所でやられるのつらいっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No! It's fine! Having it done in a place like this is rough!"

strings.text: 「場所の問題なの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's a matter of location?"

strings.text: 「いや、そういうことじゃない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that's not what I mean..."

strings.text: 「だったら、家でやりましょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Then, shall we do it at home?"

strings.text: ガタッ
strings.translated: Clatter.

strings.text: 「……何でいきなり立つの？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "......Why did you two suddenly stand up?

strings.text: 二人とも……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Both of you..."

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Ah... um..."

strings.text: 「た、たまたまです……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "I-it just happened..."

strings.text: 「そう？　でも草薙の水着趣味は変態的ですらあるのよ？
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Really? But Kusanagi's swimsuit tastes are downright perverted, you know?

strings.text: 白い水着が好きなのだって、こうやってめくった時に下着に見えて、二倍うれしいとか、かもしれないじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: His preference for white swimsuits might even be because when they get flipped up like that, they look like underwear, so it's doubly exciting or something."

strings.text: 「その二倍うれしいって何だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is that 'doubly exciting' supposed to mean?"

strings.text: 「パンツの良さと水着の良さは違う。そういう事？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "The appeal of panties and the appeal of swimsuits are different. Something like that?"

strings.text: 「それに近い……って、そういう問題じゃない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's close to it... wait, that's not the issue!"

strings.text: 「どうしたの？　二人とも？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What's wrong, you two?"

strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「え？　何がですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「ふぅ、私もカレー食べても良いですか？」
strings.speaker: 鈴菜
strings.translated: "Whew, is it okay if I have some curry too?"

strings.text: 呆れた様に鈴菜がつぶやく。
strings.translated: Suzuna murmured, exasperated.

strings.text: 「あー、私も食べたい」
strings.speaker: ルリヲ
strings.translated: "Ah, I want some too."

strings.text: 「右に同じく」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Same here."

strings.text: 「あれ？　雫まで飯食ったら、家にいる藍はどうするんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? If even Shizuku eats here, then what about Ai back at the house?"

strings.text: 「どうするもこうするも、顧問無しで深夜のプール貸し出しがＯＫになるわけないだろうが……」
strings.translated: "What about her, indeed. There's no way they'd approve of lending out the pool late at night without a supervisor..."

strings.text: 「って、藍？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wait, Ai?"

strings.text: 「だから藍先生だと何度言わせる！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "How many times do I have to tell you, it's Ai-sensei!"

strings.text: 「なんだ、姉ちゃんまで来たのか？　意地汚いなぁ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What, even your sister came? So greedy."

strings.text: 「なんで、私が意地汚い事になるぅぅ～」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Why does that make me the greedy oneeee~"

strings.text: 「痛い、痛いって、マジで痛いっ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ow, ow, that seriously hurts!"

strings.text: 「もちろん、生徒会が許しを出したわけではありませんから、顧問の先生に来て頂きました」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Of course, the student council alone couldn't authorize it, so we had our club advisor come along."

strings.text: 「逆に、良くそんなもん許可が出たな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "On the flip side, it's amazing that permission was granted at all."

strings.text: 「許可を出したのは校長先生です」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "The one who gave permission was the principal."

strings.text: 「え？　そうなの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? Really?"

strings.text: 「当たり前でしょ……。あんた先生に頼めばOKなレベルだと思ってるの？」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Obviously... Did you think it was the sort of thing a teacher's approval could clear?"

strings.text: 「そういう事だ。校長先生の許しでプールは使っても良いという事だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "That's how it is. With the principal's permission, we're allowed to use the pool."

strings.text: 「不服そうね？」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "You look dissatisfied?"

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事ないけど……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "N-no, not really..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、いいではないか、とりあえず花火をプールから眺めるのがお前の望みだろ？　それでいいじゃないか」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, whatever. Watching the fireworks from the pool is what you wanted, right? Isn't that enough?"

strings.text: 「そういう事よ。そんなこんなでとっととご飯を食べて、プール行きましょう」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "That's right. So let's hurry up and finish eating, then head to the pool."

strings.text: 「そうですね」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "That's right."

strings.text: 「私にも出してくれ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Give me some too."

strings.text: 「私もください。肉多めで、野菜抜きで」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Me too, please. Extra meat, no vegetables."

strings.text: 「そういうのダメだからな。雫」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You can't have it like that, Shizuku."

strings.text: 「ぷはー、食べたー。結構おいしかったわ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Phew, all done. That was pretty good."

strings.text: 「そうですね。ウチのカレーと味は違いましたが」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "It was. Though the flavor was different from our house's curry."

strings.text: 「そうですね。草薙くんのカレーおいしいなぁ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Right. Kusanagi-kun's curry is delicious."

strings.text: そう言うと、稟はさらにカレーをよそっている。
strings.translated: Saying so, Rin was helping herself to more curry.

strings.text: 前々から思っていたが、あの重箱みたいな弁当箱といい。こいつはとんでもない大食なのかもしれない。
strings.translated: I'd thought so for a while, but between this and that jubako-like bento box of hers, she might be an absurdly big eater.

strings.text: 「直哉は料理が得意ですからね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Naoya is skilled at cooking, after all."

strings.text: 「ま、あんたみたいに何の取り柄も無い人が、料理ぐらいの取り柄があってもいいわよね」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Well, for someone as talentless as you, at least having cooking as your one skill is something."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事ありませんよ。草薙くんは他にも得意分野がたくさんあります」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-that's not true. Kusanagi-kun has plenty of other things he's good at."

strings.text: 「はい、主立った業績としてはエロ方面で……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, his primary accomplishments are in the erotic field..."

strings.text: 「草薙ぃ！　貴様！　雫に何をした！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Kusanagiii! You bastard! What did you do to Shizuku?!"

strings.text: 「だ、だから！　藍！　そのネタで取り乱すのやめろ！　そんな事実は無い！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "L-like I said! Ai! Stop losing it over that topic! There's no such fact!"

strings.text: 「ま、直哉はエロ方面では俺の師匠みたいなもんだからな。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Well, Naoya's basically my master when it comes to erotic matters.

strings.text: これだけは敵わないや」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: This one thing I just can't beat him at."

strings.text: 「うむ、ワシもその方面では、こいつの能力を認めるしかない……」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Mm, in that department, I too must acknowledge his ability..."

strings.text: 「勝手な事言ってるな！　俺はいつからそんなキャラになったんだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Stop making things up! When did I become that kind of character?!"

strings.text: 「まー、まー、とりあえずそろそろ着替えませんか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "There, there, for now shall we go get changed?"

strings.text: 「あ、もうプール入れるんですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ah, can we go in the pool already?"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、そのために水入れたんだからさ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, that's why we filled it with water.

strings.text: ただの掃除だったら水は入れないでそのまま乾かしておくでしょ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: If it were just cleaning, we wouldn't fill it, we'd just leave it to dry."

strings.text: 「んじゃ、入れるんですね！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Then we can get in!"

strings.text: 「んじゃ、行くか！」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "Well then, shall we?"

strings.text: 「行こうぜ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Let's go!"

strings.text: 「さてと、行くか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Alright then, let's go..."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hm?"

strings.text: 立ち上がろうとしたが、何かに引っ張られる。
strings.translated: As I tried to stand up, something tugged at me.

strings.text: よく見ると、鳥谷が俺の服の裾をつかんでいる。
strings.translated: Looking closer, Toritani had grabbed the hem of my clothes.

strings.text: 「何をする、服が伸びるだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you doing? You'll stretch it out."

strings.text: 「制服なんか伸びやしないわよ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "A uniform's not gonna stretch.

strings.text: それより約束じゃないの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: More importantly, what about your promise?"

strings.text: 「何が？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Scared of what?"

strings.text: 「勉強するって」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "To study."

strings.text: 「花火開始までは１時間以上あるわ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There's over an hour until the fireworks start.

strings.text: それまで、あんたは勉強よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Until then, you're studying."

strings.text: 「なんで？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why?"

strings.text: 「さっき約束したでしょうが、ご飯食べ終わったら勉強だって」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You promised earlier, right? That you'd study after we finished eating."

strings.text: 「プール入れるとか聞いてない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I didn't hear anything about getting into the pool!"

strings.text: 「だから、真ん中に休み時間入れるって言ったじゃない。ほらほら勉強するわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So I told you, we'd have a break in the middle. Come on, come on, we're studying."

strings.text: 「草薙先輩来ないのですか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-senpai isn't coming?"

strings.text: 「大丈夫よ。花火までに一段落つけるから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's fine. We'll wrap up a section before the fireworks."

strings.text: 「勉強したければいいだろう。青春時代に勉強しなくていつするのか？　って話じゃしな。勉強大いにすればいい」
strings.speaker: 明石
strings.translated: "If he wants to study, let him. When else are you supposed to study, if not in your youth? Study to your heart's content."

strings.text: 「ちょ……マジで俺だけなの？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey... seriously, just me?"

strings.text: 「大丈夫よ……私も付き合ってあげるから……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's fine... I'll keep you company..."

strings.text: 付き合うも何も、誰もいなかったら勉強なんかするかよ……。
strings.translated: Company or not, if no one else were around, would I even bother studying...?

strings.text: 「なぁ、鳥谷……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey, Toritani..."

strings.text: 「なによ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What...?"

strings.text: 「何で俺だけなんだよ……圭だっているだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why is it just me...? Kei's here too."

strings.text: 「圭は美大に行くでしょ？　実技だけでどこか余裕で受かるわよ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kei's going to art school, right? He'll pass somewhere easily on practical skills alone.

strings.text: でもあんたは普通の大学行く気なんでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: But you're planning on going to a regular university, right?"

strings.text: 「そうだが……でもそんなに成績が悪いわけじゃないし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's true... but my grades aren't that bad."

strings.text: 「得意教科と不得意教科の差が激しすぎるのよ。どんな勉強法してるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The gap between your strong and weak subjects is way too wide. What kind of study method are you using?"

strings.text: 「あまり勉強らしい勉強は……ただ得意な科目は得意だから……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Not really any real studying... it's just that the subjects I'm good at, I'm good at..."

strings.text: 「何となくでも勉強が出来るんでしょ？　たぶん単一教科だったら、私より勉強してるかもよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So you can just kind of study by feel? For a single subject, you might be studying more than I do."

strings.text: 「そんな事ないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not true."

strings.text: 「私より数学の成績良かったじゃない。こんなんでもトップクラスの成績なのよ、私は。それこそ天文部の弘瀬や稟ちゃんほどじゃないけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Your math grades were better than mine. Even so, my grades are top-tier, you know. Not as much as Hirose or Rin-chan from the astronomy club, but still."

strings.text: 「それもたまたまでだなぁ。いつもそれほど成績が良いわけじゃない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That was just a fluke. My grades aren't always that good."

strings.text: 「だったら、尚更、それを安定させないとね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then, all the more reason you need to stabilize them..."

strings.text: 鳥谷も共に勉強をしている。
strings.translated: Toritani was studying alongside me too.

strings.text: 分からないところがあったら聞いてくれとの話だった。
strings.translated: She said if there was anything I didn't understand, to ask her.

strings.text: 分からないところねぇ……。
strings.translated: Anything I didn't understand, huh...

strings.text: 俺は分からないところだらけの問題集を開きながら、聞くべき分からない事を探していた。
strings.translated: Opening a workbook full of things I didn't understand, I searched for a question worth asking.

strings.text: 「そういえばさ……鳥谷」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it... Toritani."

strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「なんで、そんな俺の面倒見るんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why do you go so far to look after me?"

strings.text: 「別に……、なんでもクビ突っ込むの趣味なのよ。私も……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "No reason... it's my hobby to stick my nose into everything. That's all..."

strings.text: 「そんなもんか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that how it is?"

strings.text: 「さぁね……ほら、手止まってるわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Who knows... hey, your hand's stopped."

strings.text: 「でもさ……ありがとう」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But... thank you."

strings.text: 「明石先輩の事よ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "For the thing with Akashi-senpai..."

strings.text: 「何故、お前が礼を言う」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why are you the one thanking me?"

strings.text: 「私は明石姉妹と仲が良いし……まぁ明石先輩は、前任の部長でもあるわけだし……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I'm close with the Akashi sisters... and well, Akashi-senpai was the club's previous president too..."

strings.text: 「だからと言って、お前がお礼を言う理由にはならないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even so, that's no reason for you to thank me."

strings.text: 「……私が持った疑問に、最後まで付き合ってくれたでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "......You stayed with me to the end on the question I raised, didn't you?"

strings.text: 「お前がもった疑問に？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The question you raised?

strings.text: いや、別に俺が興味があったから明石の件は調べただけだし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: No, I only looked into the Akashi matter because I was interested in it myself."

strings.text: 「まぁ、そうなんだけど……でも最初に私があんたを巻き込む様な事を言ったのはたしかでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, that's true... but it's a fact that I was the one who first said something that dragged you into it, right?"

strings.text: 「その前から、何か怪しいとは思ってたよ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'd been thinking something was suspicious even before that.

strings.text: それこそ、お前らの合宿をふいにしてしまってすまなかったな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: If anything, I'm sorry for ruining your camp trip like that."

strings.text: 「バーカ。それだったらみんな納得してるわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Idiot. Everyone's fine with that."

strings.text: 「実際、あれは楽しかったしね。あんな経験出来ないわ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It was actually fun. It's not an experience you get every day.

strings.text: たしかに田舎で合宿も魅力的だけど、世界的な芸術家の遺作を私達で完成させるなんて、一夏の思い出としてはすごくロマンチックじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Certainly a camp in the countryside is appealing, but for us to complete the final work of a world-renowned artist--as a summer memory, isn't that incredibly romantic?"

strings.text: 「そんなもんかねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so......"

strings.text: 「そんなしらけた態度取ったって、あんたがあの時大興奮してた事ぐらい、私はお見通しよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You can act all detached, but I can see right through you. You were beyond excited back then."

strings.text: 「まぁ、そりゃ、俺だって興奮はしたさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, sure, I was excited too."

strings.text: 「あら、素直」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh, how honest."

strings.text: 「何を勘違いしてるか知らんが、俺は草薙健一郎が嫌いなわけじゃないぞ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't know what you're misunderstanding, but it's not that I dislike Kusanagi Ken'ichirou.

strings.text: ただ、親と言えるほどの接点が無かっただけだ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: It's just that we had so little contact you couldn't really call him a parent.

strings.text: あいつの作品は好きだし、まぁ実力だって誰よりも認めてるつもりだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I like his works, and as for his talent, I think I acknowledge it more than anyone."

strings.text: 「そりゃ、そうかもね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That may be so."

strings.text: 「あの、お邪魔しても良いですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, is it okay if I come in?"

strings.text: 「あれ？　稟ちゃん、プール行ったんじゃないの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? Rin-chan, didn't you go to the pool?"

strings.text: 「あ、私も勉強しようかなぁ……って、
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, I thought I'd study too...

strings.text: いつもだいたい勉強してる時間ですしね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: It's about my usual study time anyway."

strings.text: 「ふーん、そうなんだ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hmm, is that so..."

strings.text: 「座ってもいいかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is it okay if I sit down?"

strings.text: 「ストップ！　そのまま！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Stop! Just like that!"

strings.text: 「動かないで……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Don't move..."

strings.text: 徐に立ち上がると素早く稟の背後に回り。
strings.translated: Getting up slowly, she quickly circled around behind Rin.

strings.text: 「きゃっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eek!"

strings.text: 鳥谷が稟のスカートをめくる。
strings.translated: Toritani flipped up Rin's skirt.

strings.text: すると稟の水着が姿をあらわす。
strings.translated: Rin's swimsuit came into view.

strings.text: 「おおっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oho."

strings.text: 「何するんですかっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What are you doing?!"

strings.text: 「えー、これのために水着に着替えてきたんじゃないのー」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ehh, isn't that why you changed into a swimsuit?"

strings.text: 「そ、そんなわけないよっ。というか、そんなの意味が分からないし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-that's not why! I mean, that doesn't even make any sense."

strings.text: 「さっき雫ちゃんがやってて、草薙がうれしそうだったからさぁ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Earlier when Shizuku-chan did it, Kusanagi looked so happy."

strings.text: 「俺はそんなうれしそうな顔してない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I did not look happy!"

strings.text: 「何断言してるのよ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Why are you so sure of that?

strings.text: あの時は、端から見れば相当うれしそうだったわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: From the sidelines back then, you looked pretty pleased."

strings.text: 「え？　マジで？　嘘だろ？　なぁ稟」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Seriously? You're kidding, right? Hey, Rin."

strings.text: 稟は目を背けて首を横に振る。
strings.translated: Rin looked away and shook her head.

strings.text: 「嘘。そんなうれしそうだったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're lying. Did I really look that happy?"

strings.text: 「だから里奈も来てるんじゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's why Rina came too, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「いや、私はそういう理由ではありませんので、スカートめくる等のプレイは無用ですので、そこのところよろしく」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "No, that's not my reason at all, so no need for any skirt-flipping plays. Please keep that in mind."

strings.text: 「だったら、こういうのは」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "In that case, how about this."

strings.text: 「ぎゃわっ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Gyah!"

strings.text: 川内野が氷川の後ろに立ったと思った瞬間、氷川のスカートが地面に落ちる。
strings.translated: The moment I thought Kawachino had stepped behind Hikawa, Hikawa's skirt dropped to the ground.

strings.text: 「な、何するの優美！　というかスカート返せっ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "W-what are you doing, Yumi! Also, give my skirt back!"

strings.text: 「大丈夫。里奈のスカートは私が責任を持って管理する」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "It's fine. I'll take responsibility for managing Rina's skirt."

strings.text: 「何が大丈夫なのですか！？ 返しなさいっ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "What's fine about that?! Give it back!"

strings.text: 氷川は川内野からスカートを取り返して履き直した。
strings.translated: Hikawa snatched the skirt back from Kawachino and put it on again.

strings.text: 少々残念である。
strings.translated: A bit of a shame.

strings.text: 「それはそうと……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Anyway..."

strings.text: 「ぎゃっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Gyah!"

strings.text: 「何をじろじろ見ている。目をつぶしますよ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "What are you staring at? I'll gouge your eyes out."

strings.text: 「な、何言ってる。お前らが俺が勉強しているところに入ってきて勝手にはじめた事だろうが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-what are you saying. You lot were the ones who barged in while I was studying and started this on your own..."

strings.text: 「何しに来たのよ。二人とも、稟ちゃんは受験があるから分かるけど、あんた達はどんな理由を考えてきたのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What did you come for? I get that Rin-chan has entrance exams, but you two -- what excuse have you thought up?"

strings.text: 「り、理由を考えるも何もですね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Th-there's not really any excuse to think of..."

strings.text: 「普通に、トーマスがいる場所で水着になるのが嫌なだけです」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "It's simply that we didn't want to be in swimsuits with Thomas around."

strings.text: 「あら、でも最終的にはトーマスも一緒になるのよ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh my, but Thomas is going to join us eventually, you know?"

strings.text: 「問題ありません。すでに金網にくくりつけていますので」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "No problem. We've already tied him to the fence."

strings.text: 「さすがにそこまでしなくても……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You really didn't have to go that far..."

strings.text: 「いや、あいつは油断すると何しでかすか分からないわよ。それこそ稟ちゃんなんて水着取られて全裸とかなりかねない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "No, if you let your guard down with that guy, who knows what he'll do. He might well strip Rin-chan of her swimsuit and leave her stark naked."

strings.text: 「大丈夫だよ。そんな事になる前に、出足払いかけてから、腕挫十字固で片腕を粉砕骨折させるから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's fine. Before something like that happens, I'll sweep his leg, then shatter his arm with an armbar."

strings.text: 笑顔で恐ろしい事言う稟であった。
strings.translated: Rin said terrifying things with a smile.

strings.text: 「ふーん、だったら勉強でもする？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hmm, then how about you study too?"

strings.text: 「い、いやぁ……あのお皿を洗おうかなぁ……とか思いまして」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "N-nah... I was thinking maybe I'd wash those dishes..."

strings.text: 「浸け置きしてるから大丈夫よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "They're soaking, so it's fine."

strings.text: 「でも、そろそろ浸け置きもいいじゃないですか。それに水着だったら水洗いで濡れても問題ないですし……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "But isn't the soaking about done? And since we're in swimsuits, getting wet from washing isn't a problem..."

strings.text: 「なるほど……そう言われるとそうかも……。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I see... now that you mention it, maybe so...

strings.text: だったら水着で食器洗いをするって事かしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: So you mean you'll wash the dishes in your swimsuits?"

strings.text: 「……そうなりますかね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "...I suppose it comes to that."

strings.text: 「んじゃいいんじゃないの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well then, isn't that fine?"

strings.text: 「んじゃ、洗おうか優美」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Well then, let's wash them, Yumi."

strings.text: 「ふむ……あまり気が進みませんが、まぁ里奈が水着にエプロンを着けるというのなら手伝いましょうか？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Hmm... I'm not really keen on it, but well, if Rina's going to put an apron over her swimsuit, I suppose I could help?"

strings.text: 「水着にエプロン！？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "An apron over a swimsuit?!"

strings.text: 「素直に反応するんだ……草薙」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You reacted so honestly there... Kusanagi."

strings.text: 「ち、違う。あれだ。何だ。何かめずらしいなぁ……的な驚きでな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no, that's not it. It's just, you know, that would be an unusual sight... surprise like that."

strings.text: 「ちっ、草薙を喜ばせるのならやめるか……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Tch, if it's going to please Kusanagi, maybe I'll pass..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、まぁ、そんな事言わずに、洗い物しようよ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Now, now, don't say that -- let's do the dishes."

strings.text: 「んじゃ、エプロンね」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Well then, aprons it is."

strings.text: 「優美ももちろん水着エプロンなのよね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yumi's wearing a swimsuit apron too, of course."

strings.text: 「まさか、私は水着すら持ってきてませんよ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "No way, I didn't even bring a swimsuit."

strings.text: 「そうなの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Is that so?"

strings.text: 「私は女子の水着を見に来たので、別に自分が着る必要などないでしょう。だから水着無しです」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I came to look at the girls' swimsuits, so I don't really need to wear one myself. Hence, no swimsuit."

strings.text: 「本当に持ってこなかったの？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "You really didn't bring one?"

strings.text: 「本当に持ってこなかった」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Really didn't bring one."

strings.text: 「せっかくだから一緒に入ればいいじゃん。なんだったら水着貸そうか？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Come on, why not get in with us? If you want, I could lend you a swimsuit?"

strings.text: 「里奈の水着を？　私にくれるの？」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Rina's swimsuit? You're giving it to me?"

strings.text: 「違う、違う。貸すの。あげないからね」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "No, no. Lending it. I'm not giving it to you."

strings.text: 「そう。残念ね。くれるのだと思って、思わずぬか喜びしてしまったわ」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I see. What a shame. I thought you were giving it to me, so I got my hopes up for nothing."

strings.text: 「今、一瞬笑ったのって……ぬか喜びだったのか……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "That little smile just now... was hope for nothing..."

strings.text: 「そうね。ぬか喜びだったわ。里奈の水着がもらえるとか素晴らしいから」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "That's right. It was hope for nothing. Getting Rina's swimsuit would've been wonderful."

strings.text: 「貸すのじゃだめなの？」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Lending it wouldn't do?"

strings.text: 「私が着ないで良くて、さらに小一時間ぐらい私を放置してくれるなら大喜びだわ。その間私を捜さないで、たぶんトイレにいるけど」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "If I don't have to wear it, and if you'd leave me alone for about an hour, I'd be overjoyed. During that time, don't look for me -- I'll probably be in the bathroom."

strings.text: 「わー。なんか正直ひくわー」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Whoa. Honestly, that's kind of gross."

strings.text: 「そう。里奈がひくならそういう事はしない」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I see. If Rina finds it gross, I won't do such things."

strings.text: 「いや、普通、話した瞬間にひくから、行動に移さなくても十分にね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "No, normally people are grossed out the moment you say it -- you don't even need to act on it."

strings.text: 「あ、それは大丈夫です。優美は昔からこんなんでしたから」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ah, it's fine. Yumi's always been like this."

strings.text: 「昔から、里奈の下着を盗んではトイレに籠もってました」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I've been stealing Rina's underwear and holing up in the bathroom for ages."

strings.text: 「ぎゃー。そんな事してたんかー」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Gyahh! You've been doing that?!"

strings.text: 「安心してよ。嘘よ。純粋ではないけど」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Rest easy. It's a lie. Though not a pure one."

strings.text: 「純粋な嘘じゃない場合って、どの程度本当が混ざっているのかしら……」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "When it's not a pure lie, I wonder how much truth is mixed in..."

strings.text: 「真実は里奈の心の中にしまっておいて」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Keep the truth locked away in Rina's heart."

strings.text: 「あんたの胸じゃないのか」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Isn't it in your chest?"

strings.text: 「ったく、いつまでも漫才やってるんじゃないわよ。勉強の邪魔よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Honestly, will you two knock off the comedy routine? You're interrupting our studying."

strings.text: 「では、氷川里奈と」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "So then, Hikawa Rina and..."

strings.text: 「川内野優美が」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Kawachino Yumi..."

strings.text: 里奈＆優美
strings.translated: Rina & Yumi

strings.text: 「「洗い物をしたいと思います」」
strings.speaker: 里奈＆優美
strings.translated: "We'd like to do the dishes."

strings.text: 「あと、稟ちゃん！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Also, Rin-chan!"

strings.text: 「は、はい！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yes!"

strings.text: 「今の通りだから、水着エプロンだからね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Same deal for you, so swimsuit apron it is."

strings.text: 「私は勉強を……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm going to study..."

strings.text: 「後輩二人が水着エプロンなんだから、稟ちゃんも水着エプロンがいいんじゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Your two juniors are doing swimsuit aprons, so wouldn't a swimsuit apron be nice for you too, Rin-chan?"

strings.text: 「別に私はいいよ。だいたいエプロンなんてそんな数ないし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm fine, really. Besides, there aren't that many aprons to go around."

strings.text: 「本当だ。エプロン一つしかない」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "You're right. There's only one apron."

strings.text: 「それでは！　それは里奈が！」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "In that case! It goes to Rina!"

strings.text: 「いや、よくよく考えて見たら水着なんだからエプロンはいらないと思う」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "No, thinking about it carefully, since we're in swimsuits, we don't really need aprons."

strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Staaare..."

strings.text: 「……そんな私を凝視しないでくれる？　優美」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "...Would you mind not staring at me like that? Yumi."

strings.text: 「えっと、ここは変数の連続関数が……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, here, the continuous function of the variable is..."

strings.text: なんだかな自習だな……。
strings.translated: What kind of self-study is this...

strings.text: 水着を持って来てないと言っていた川内野ではあるが、どうやら妹さんが持って来ていたらしい。
strings.translated: Kawachino had said she didn't bring a swimsuit, but it turned out her sister had brought one for her.

strings.text: 氷川が着るのであれば、としぶしぶ自分も水着に着替えた。
strings.translated: If Hikawa was going to wear one, then reluctantly she changed into hers too.

strings.text: 二人は水着になった。
strings.translated: The two of them were in swimsuits.

strings.text: 水着で洗い物をする後輩。
strings.translated: Juniors doing dishes in swimsuits.

strings.text: そして水着で勉強する幼なじみ。
strings.translated: And a childhood friend studying in a swimsuit.

strings.text: まぁ、正直……。
strings.translated: Well, honestly...

strings.text: 悪くは無い……。
strings.translated: It wasn't bad...

strings.text: うむ……。
strings.translated: Yeah...

strings.text: 「んで？　何で私を見てるの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So? Why are you staring at me?"

strings.text: 「周りが水着で私だけ制服なのが不満？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Dissatisfied that everyone's in swimsuits and only I'm in uniform?"

strings.text: 「そ、そういうわけではないが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no, that's not it..."

strings.text: 「私は下着なんだから、あんな真似は出来ないの。ほらほら勉強の続きするわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I'm in my underwear, so I can't pull that stunt. Come on, come on, back to studying."

strings.text: 「なんか、暗闇の中でプール入るって不思議だね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's kind of strange getting into a pool in the dark, huh."

strings.text: 「電灯はあえて落としてもらってるわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I had them turn off the lights on purpose."

strings.text: 「何故だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why?"

strings.text: 「あ、それ、時間が経つと徐々に分かるぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ah, that -- you'll gradually understand as time passes."

strings.text: 「そうね。あなたたちもあと数分で分かると思うわ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "Right. I think you'll all understand in a few more minutes."

strings.text: 「時間？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Time?"

strings.text: 俺は鳥谷の事を見る。
strings.translated: I looked at Toritani.

strings.text: 鳥谷は水の上に浮かびながら、空を見ている。
strings.translated: Toritani was floating on the water, looking up at the sky.

strings.text: 「そろそろじゃないですか？」
strings.speaker: 小牧
strings.translated: "Isn't it about time?"

strings.text: 「私みたいに水に浮かんで空を見るといいわよ」
strings.speaker: 小沙智
strings.translated: "You should float on the water like me and look at the sky."

strings.text: 「水に浮かんで……空を？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Float on the water... and look at the sky?"

strings.text: 俺も指示通り、水に浮かぶ。
strings.translated: As instructed, I too floated on the water.

strings.text: 徐々に闇に目が慣れていく。
strings.translated: My eyes gradually adjusted to the darkness.

strings.text: すると……。
strings.translated: And then...

strings.text: 「うわぁ」
strings.speaker: 稟

strings.text: 「あ、すごい」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ah, amazing."

strings.text: 「なるほど……目が暗闇になれるのを待ってたんですね……」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "I see... you were waiting for our eyes to adjust to the dark..."

strings.text: 水に浮かんで空を見上げると、それまでまったく気がつかなかったにも関わらず、満天の星空で埋め尽くされていた。
strings.translated: Floating on the water and looking up, I saw that the heavens -- unnoticed until now -- were brimming with stars.

strings.text: 「どうせなら、星眺めるのもいいんじゃないかなぁ……ってさ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Since we're at it, I thought stargazing would be nice too...

strings.text: まぁ、たぶん稟ちゃんの田舎ほどではないだろうけどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Well, it's probably nothing compared to Rin-chan's countryside."

strings.text: 「そんな事ないよ。これだけ星が見えるのはすごいよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's not true. Being able to see this many stars is amazing."

strings.text: なるほど、これがあえて電灯を落としてもらっていた理由か……。
strings.translated: I see, so this is why she had the lights turned off on purpose...

strings.text: いくら教会の改修に対しての報酬だとしても、豪勢すぎじゃないか？
strings.translated: Even as compensation for the church renovation, isn't this too extravagant?

strings.text: まったくの暗闇のプールで、星を見る。
strings.translated: Stargazing in a pitch-dark pool.

strings.text: こんな贅沢を学校が生徒にさせていいのか？
strings.translated: Is it really okay for a school to let its students indulge in such luxury?

strings.text: 「そんなわけで、プールに入りながら星を眺められる様に電灯を落としてもらってたわけよ。まぁ花火もこの方が見やすいだろうしね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So that's why I had the lights turned down, so we could stargaze while in the pool. Well, the fireworks will be easier to see this way too."

strings.text: 「ふぅ、まったくおかげで私は残業だ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Whew, thanks to that I'm stuck working overtime."

strings.text: 「藍先生も入れば良いじゃないですかー」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Ai-sensei, why don't you get in too?"

strings.text: 「私はお前らの監視係だ。こんな暗闇でもしもの事があったら大変だからな。
strings.speaker: 藍
