strings.translated: "I'm your supervisor. If something happened in the dark, it'd be a big deal.

strings.text: よーく見える場所から見張っておく」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: I'll keep watch from a spot where I can see clearly."

strings.text: 「にしても水着でも良かったんじゃないですか？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Still, you could've worn a swimsuit, couldn't you?"

strings.text: 「鳥谷……私に喧嘩でも売ってるのかな？
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Toritani... are you picking a fight with me?

strings.text: この私がそんなもの持っていると思うか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Do you think someone like me owns such a thing?"

strings.text: 「でも知らせたの昨日ですよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But you only told us yesterday."

strings.text: 「鳥谷、もう一度言うぞ。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Toritani, I'll say it again.

strings.text: 私みたいな独り身で、兄妹を養う教師が、そんなもんいきなり言われて用意出来るとでも思ったか？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Do you think a single teacher supporting her siblings could scrounge up something like that on such short notice?"

strings.text: 「……あははは。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "...Ahaha.

strings.text: すんません……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Sorry..."

strings.text: 「ルリヲちゃんと鈴菜ちゃんは入らないのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Aren't Rurio-chan and Suzuna-chan getting in?"

strings.text: 「深い！」
strings.speaker: ルリヲ
strings.translated: "It's deep!"

strings.text: 「私達には少々深すぎる様ですね……」
strings.speaker: 鈴菜
strings.translated: "It seems to be a bit too deep for us..."

strings.text: 「そっか、そういわれれば、子供用は少し浅いのか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Oh, right, come to think of it, the children's pool is a little shallow."

strings.text: 「それにしても良く見えますねぇ」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "Even so, we can see them so clearly."

strings.text: 「まぁ、天体観測って寝っ転がりながら見たりするものですしね。
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "Well, stargazing is something you do while lying down, after all.

strings.text: あながちプールで浮かびながら見るというアイディアも悪くは無いと思いますよ……聞いた事はありませんが」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: So the idea of watching them while floating in a pool isn't half bad... though I've never heard of it."

strings.text: 「そうだね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You're right..."

strings.text: みんなが空を見上げる。
strings.translated: Everyone looked up at the sky.

strings.text: みんなが無音になると、
strings.translated: When everyone fell silent,

strings.text: 耳には水の音しか聞こえない。
strings.translated: all that reached my ears was the sound of the water.

strings.text: 「静かだね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's quiet..."

strings.text: 「結構山奥だからねぇ……弓張学園は」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yumihari Academy is pretty deep in the mountains, after all..."

strings.text: 「山奥って言うよりは丘の上な。一応近くにマンションなんかも建ってるんだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "More on top of a hill than in the mountains. There are even apartment buildings nearby, technically..."

strings.text: 「でもここは奥まっていますし……やはり音はあまり聞こえませんよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But we're tucked away here... so the sounds really don't carry."

strings.text: 「今日が新月で良かった……さらに星が良く見える」
strings.speaker: 優美
strings.translated: "It's a good thing tonight is a new moon... makes the stars stand out even more."

strings.text: 「あ、そうか、お月様が欠けてる方が光りが少なくなるから、星がよく見えるのか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, right, when the moon is more waned, there's less light, so the stars show up better..."

strings.text: 「あまり出来ない経験なので堪能しておいた方が良いですよ。結構レアですから」
strings.speaker: 里奈
strings.translated: "It's not something you get to experience often, so you'd better savor it. It's pretty rare."

strings.text: 「そうだな。夏休みももう終わるしな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. Summer break's almost over, too..."

strings.text: 特に俺たちは最後の夏休みだ。
strings.translated: And for us in particular, this was our last summer break.

strings.text: 「もう、終わるんだね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It really is ending, huh..."

strings.text: 「私達の夏がね……終わるだけだよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's just our summer... that's ending."

strings.text: 「そうだな……俺たちの夏が終わる……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah... our summer is coming to an end..."

strings.text: 「すごい……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Amazing..."

strings.text: 「わぁ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wow."

strings.text: 花火が上がる。
strings.translated: Fireworks went up.

strings.text: その後も連続で上がる。
strings.translated: And then more, one after another.

strings.text: 暗闇で光っていた星達が、花火の音に驚いて逃げたかの様に、一瞬で見えなくなる。
strings.translated: The stars that had been shining in the darkness vanished in an instant, as if startled by the sound of the fireworks and fleeing.

strings.text: 暗闇のプールから見える空で輝く花火。
strings.translated: Fireworks blazing in the sky, seen from a pitch-dark pool.

strings.text: 空をまぶしく照らしては、消えて、また打ち上がる。
strings.translated: They lit up the sky dazzlingly, faded, and were launched again.

strings.text: そのうちだれも言葉を発さなくなる。
strings.translated: Before long, no one spoke a word.

strings.text: 暗闇の中、あるのは花火があがる音とその光だけ。
strings.translated: In the darkness, all that existed were the sounds and lights of the fireworks going up.

strings.text: 他はすべてかき消されてしまう。
strings.translated: Everything else was drowned out.

strings.text: 真夏の夜、その終わりを告げる花火。
strings.translated: Fireworks announcing the end of a midsummer's night.

strings.text: それは永遠に続くかとすら思われた……。
strings.translated: It felt as though they might go on forever...

strings.text: 「終わったのは私達の夏だから……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Because what's ending is our summer..."

strings.text: 「鳥谷？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani?"

strings.text: 「私達の最後は、ここじゃないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Our finale isn't here."

strings.text: 鳥谷は花火を見ながらそうつぶやいた。
strings.translated: Toritani murmured that as she watched the fireworks.

strings.text: いや、違う。
strings.translated: No, that wasn't it.

strings.text: もっと言えば、花火よりも遠く。
strings.translated: To put it more precisely, she was looking farther than the fireworks.

strings.text: 夏の終わりの先を見つめていた。
strings.translated: She was gazing beyond the end of summer.

strings.text: なるほど……と思った。
strings.translated: Ah, I see... I thought.

strings.text: こいつが１年生の頃から欠かさず勉強をする理由。
strings.translated: The reason she had studied without fail ever since her first year.

strings.text: 俺の勉強に付き合おうとする理由。
strings.translated: The reason she was trying to keep me company as I studied.

strings.text: ただその一つしかないだろう。
strings.translated: It could only be that one thing.

strings.text: 「よもや……マジで狙ってるとはな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So you really... are seriously aiming for it..."

strings.text: 「当たり前じゃない……。これが最後の挑戦なんだから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Of course I am. This is my last chance."

strings.text: 「お前が弓張在学中にこだわる理由は何だ？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why are you so fixated on doing it while you're still at Yumihari?

strings.text: あんな賞、プロだって取れないんだぞ。俺たちみたいな学生風情が取れるとでも思ってるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Not even pros can win that prize. You really think mere students like us can pull it off?"

strings.text: 「思ってるからやるんじゃない……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's because I think we can that I'm doing it..."

strings.text: 花火があがる。
strings.translated: Fireworks went up.

strings.text: その光が鳥谷の顔をうつす。
strings.translated: Their light illuminated Toritani's face.

strings.text: その視線は力強かった。
strings.translated: Her gaze was full of strength.

strings.text: 「でも今は……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But for now..."

strings.text: 「最後の夏を満喫するべきか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "We should make the most of our last summer, huh..."

strings.text: 「そうね……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 永遠なんてものは無い。
strings.translated: There's no such thing as forever.

strings.text: 当たり前の様に、始まりがあって終わりがある。
strings.translated: As a matter of course, there's a beginning and there's an end.

strings.text: その中身がどんなに輝いていたとしても、どんなに美しいとしても……それは終わる。
strings.translated: No matter how brilliantly its contents shine, no matter how beautiful they are... it ends.

strings.text: 花火も終わる。
strings.translated: The fireworks end too.

strings.text: あと数発。
strings.translated: Just a few more shots.

strings.text: あと数分。
strings.translated: Just a few more minutes.

strings.text: 力強く空を染める花火も、
strings.translated: Even the fireworks powerfully dyeing the sky

strings.text: 無音の空の中に消えてゆく。
strings.translated: faded away into the silent heavens.

strings.text: だから今だけは……。
strings.translated: So, just for now...

strings.text: その終わりの事など考えずに、ただ素直に、
strings.translated: Without thinking about the end, simply, honestly,

strings.text: 俺たちは花火を楽しんだ。
strings.translated: we enjoyed the fireworks.

strings.text: 夏の終わりに……。
strings.translated: At the end of summer...

strings.text: ただ……。
strings.translated: It's just...

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「夏になってから、あいつ相当忙しそうなんだよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ever since summer started, she's been pretty busy."

strings.text: 受験勉強もやっている様だが、部活関連の仕事も多い。
strings.translated: She seems to be studying for entrance exams too, but she has a lot of club-related work as well.

strings.text: 今、誰よりも働いているのは鳥谷ではないだろうか……。
strings.translated: Right now, isn't Toritani working harder than anyone?

strings.text: 「合宿なんて、また手間のかかる事を計画してるしな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Planning a training camp on top of everything -- another troublesome undertaking."

strings.text: 次に明石。
strings.translated: Next, Akashi.

strings.text: これは論外。
strings.translated: Out of the question.

strings.text: 氷川はそれなりに有力な候補としてあげられる。
strings.translated: Hikawa could be considered a fairly strong candidate.

strings.text: ヤツも弓張に長く住んでいる。土地勘もあるだろう。
strings.translated: She's lived in Yumihari a long time. She should know the area.

strings.text: 鳥谷同様、それなりに察しが良く、頭も回る。
strings.translated: Like Toritani, she's fairly perceptive and quick-witted.

strings.text: 「氷川も悪くはないのだが……うむむ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hikawa wouldn't be bad either, but... hmm."

strings.text: 「氷川を呼び出した事が、優美にバレると何か怒られそうで怖いしなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If Yumi found out I called Hikawa out, she might get angry, and that's a scary thought..."

strings.text: 「鳥谷、氷川……、あともう一人は……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani, Hikawa... and one more..."

strings.text: 稟である。
strings.translated: Rin.

strings.text: 彼女は、この土地に戻って間もないのだが、弓張に思い入れも深そうだ。
strings.translated: She hasn't been back in this town long, but she seems to have strong feelings about Yumihari.

strings.text: もっといえば、勉強でもそうだったが、一番懇切丁寧に教えてくれそう。
strings.translated: Besides, judging from our study sessions, she'd be the most patient and thorough at explaining the way.

strings.text: 「とは言っても、そもそも稟にそれほどの土地勘があったかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That said, does Rin even know her way around here that well...?"

strings.text: どうしたもんか……。
strings.translated: What to do...

strings.text: などと歩き続けていく。
strings.translated: Such were my thoughts as I kept walking.

strings.text: ずんずん歩き続けていく。
strings.translated: Trudging onward.

strings.text: 歩けば歩くほど、不安感が増していく。
strings.translated: The more I walked, the more my unease grew.

strings.text: 「これは悩んでばかりもいられない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I can't just keep worrying about this."

strings.text: とりあえず、俺は稟に電話をする。
strings.translated: For now, I called Rin.

strings.text: 「出ないなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She's not picking up..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、いろいろ考えてみれば、友人に頼むというのもどうかと思うな……ここは普通に……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, thinking it over, maybe asking a friend isn't the right move... I should just do this the normal way..."

strings.text: 自宅に電話する事にした。
strings.translated: I decided to call home.

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「はい、夏目ですけど」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, this is the Natsume residence."

strings.text: 「あ、その声は雫か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, that voice -- Shizuku?"

strings.text: 「雫ですが、雫ではご満足いただけませんでしたか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It is Shizuku, but does Shizuku not meet with your satisfaction?"

strings.text: 「いや、そういうわけじゃないが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that's not it..."

strings.text: あからさまに声のトーンが低くなってしまったのが、伝わったのだろう……。
strings.translated: She must have picked up on how obviously my tone dropped...

strings.text: 「道に迷ってだな……だが雫は、弓張の土地勘なんてないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm lost... but you don't know your way around Yumihari, do you, Shizuku?"

strings.text: 「見くびって頂いては困ります。雫は結構万能です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You underestimate me. Shizuku is quite the jack-of-all-trades."

strings.text: 「いや、だってさぁ。雫って、つい最近まで」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I mean, you were... up until recently--"

strings.text: 「最近まで？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Until recently?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、それは違った」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, that wasn't it."

strings.text: 「ふぅ、まだ、雫と直哉が出会ったばかりだという事が分かってないのですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Sigh. Do you still not understand that Shizuku and Naoya have only just met?"

strings.text: 「分かってないわけじゃないのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not that I don't understand, but..."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、正面から見える物、右手に見える物、左手に見える物を教えてください。それを30メートルごとに教えてください」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "For starters, please tell me what you see in front of you, on your right, and on your left. Report it every thirty meters."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Ah, okay..."

strings.text: 「分かりました……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Understood..."

strings.text: 「え？　分かったの？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? You figured it out?"

strings.text: 「はい、直哉が仰った物を、ネットで検索しながら、ネット地図を見ておりましたら、だいたい場所の検討がつきました」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes. While searching the things you mentioned online and checking a web map, I was able to roughly determine your location."

strings.text: 「マジで？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For real?"

strings.text: 「マジです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Seriously."

strings.text: 「どうしたものだろうか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So what should I do?"

strings.text: 「はい、その場所をそのまま歩いていってください、すると飲み屋街に出るハズです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, just keep walking straight along that street. You should come out into a bar district."

strings.text: 「飲み屋街？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A bar district?"

strings.text: 「はい、たしかにあるハズですので、そこに向かって歩いていてください」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, it should definitely be there, so head toward it."

strings.text: 「分かった。では雫の言う通りにしよう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Got it. I'll do as you say, then."

strings.text: 「では、しばしお待ちを……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Well then, please wait a while..."

strings.text: 「しばしお待ち？　なんだそりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wait a while? What's that supposed to mean?"

strings.text: よく分からんが、俺はとりあえず雫の指示通りに歩いて行く。
strings.translated: I didn't quite get it, but for the moment I walked in the direction Shizuku had told me.

strings.text: 「お？　電話だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh? A call..."

strings.text: 電話が鳴ったので着信を見ると……。
strings.translated: My phone rang and I checked the caller ID...

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin."

strings.text: 「あ、さっきの着歴を見て、電話してきたのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, she must have seen my missed call and called back..."

strings.text: とりあえず俺は通話ボタンを押す。
strings.translated: I pressed the answer button.

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「もしもしなおくんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hello? Is that you, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「ああ、俺だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's me."

strings.text: 「なんか電話頂いたみたいなのですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It looks like you called me..."

strings.text: 「うむ、道に迷ってなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Right. I got lost."

strings.text: 「そ、そうなんですか？　それで私に電話してくださったのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "R-really? And that's why you called me?"

strings.text: 「だったのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's how it was, but..."

strings.text: 「すでに自宅に電話して、なんとかしてもらう事になった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I already called home and got them to help me out."

strings.text: 「という事は解決済みという事でしょうか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Which means it's already resolved...?"

strings.text: 「いや、そういうわけではない。指示をもらって歩いているのだが……、なんだか見た事もない飲み屋街に出てきた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, not exactly. I got directions and I'm walking, but... somehow I've ended up in a bar district I've never seen before..."

strings.text: 電話をしながら、雫の指示通り歩くと、見た事もない場所に出てきた。
strings.translated: As I talked on the phone and followed Shizuku's directions, I emerged into a place I'd never seen before.

strings.text: 「こんな場所があるのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is there really a place like this...?"

strings.text: 「飲み屋街……、あ、そこに商店街の看板とかありません？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A bar district... ah, is there a shopping district sign anywhere?"

strings.text: 「商店街の看板？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A shopping district sign?"

strings.text: 「はい、たぶん、この辺りで飲み屋街というと泪川商店街だと思うのですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes. If we're talking about a bar district around here, I think it'd probably be the Namidagawa shopping district..."

strings.text: 「あ、本当だ。泪川と書いてある。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, you're right. It says Namidagawa.

strings.text: というか、良く分かるなぁ。お前」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Man, you really know your stuff."

strings.text: 「この辺りって桜ヶ原駅前の商店街以外だと、泪川ぐらいしか無いので。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Around here, aside from the shopping district in front of Sakuragahara Station, Namidagawa is pretty much the only one.

strings.text: 桜ヶ原駅前はさすがのなおくんも知ってますものね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: And even you know the one in front of Sakuragahara Station, right, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「ああ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「そうか、良かったです。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see. That's a relief.

strings.text: んじゃ、とりあえず、これでっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Well then, that's all for now."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「なんだ？　一方的に切られたぞ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? She just hung up on me?"

strings.text: 「うーん、なんなんだか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ugh, what was that about..."

strings.text: 雫も稟もいまいち良く分からん。
strings.translated: Neither Shizuku nor Rin really made much sense.

strings.text: もう少し、丁寧に教えてもらえないものだろうか……。
strings.translated: Couldn't they explain things a little more thoroughly...?

strings.text: つまるところ、まったく良く分からない。
strings.translated: In the end, I had no idea what was going on.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hm?"

strings.text: 甲高い自転車のブレーキ音がする。
strings.translated: There was the high-pitched squeal of a bicycle brake.

strings.text: 俺が振り向くと、そこにはママチャリと雫の姿があった。
strings.translated: When I turned around, there was Shizuku on a mamachari.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sh-Shizuku... you..."

strings.text: 「お、お前、汗だらけだぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-hey, you're drenched in sweat..."

strings.text: 「はい、でも顔は涼しげでしょう」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, but my face looks cool, doesn't it?"

strings.text: 「いや、たしかに顔はいつも通りだけど、まさか、ここまで来てくれるとは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, sure, your face is the same as always, but I never expected you to actually come out here..."

strings.text: 「ハイケイデンスで回してきたので、私は少々お疲れです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I pedaled here at a high cadence, so I'm a little tired."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな、急がなくて良かったのに」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Y-you didn't have to rush like that."

strings.text: 「直哉が、私を必要としてくれるのですから、急ぎもします」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Since Naoya needed me, of course I hurried."

strings.text: 「……、だとしてもだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Still."

strings.text: 「これをどうぞ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Here you go."

strings.text: そう言うと雫は俺にタオルを渡してくれる。
strings.translated: Shizuku handed me a towel.

strings.text: 「冷たっ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Cold...!"

strings.text: 「氷水に浸してきました。たぶん熱いだろうなぁ。と思いまして」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I soaked it in ice water. I thought you would probably be hot."

strings.text: 「気が利くなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You really think of everything..."

strings.text: 「そうですか、それはありがとうございます。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Is that so? Then thank you very much.

strings.text: 私も失礼して……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: If you'll excuse me, I'll do the same..."

strings.text: そう言いながら雫は乾いた手ぬぐいで汗をぬぐった。
strings.translated: And with that, Shizuku wiped her sweat with a dry hand towel.

strings.text: その姿が少し色っぽかった。
strings.translated: The sight was somehow a little alluring.

strings.text: 「何を見ているのでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "What are you looking at?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no..."

strings.text: 「はっ？　もしかして、あまりにも喉が渇きすぎて、私の汗をご所望ですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Oh? Could it be that you're so parched you'd like to drink my sweat?"

strings.text: 「そんなヤツはいねぇよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As if anyone would want that!"

strings.text: 「それは安心しました。せっかく飲み物をご用意したのに、汗を所望されて、対応出来ずに恥をかくところでした」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That's a relief. I went to the trouble of preparing drinks -- if you'd requested my sweat, I'd have been unable to comply and terribly embarrassed."

strings.text: 「いやいや、恥じゃないだろ。そんなの対応出来なくても」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, it wouldn't be embarrassing. Even if you couldn't do it."

strings.text: 「そうですか？　とりあえず良かったです。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Really? Well, that's a relief anyway.

strings.text: 直に胸元を舐めてよこせと言われると思って、私は密かに興奮してました……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: I was secretly getting excited, thinking you'd tell me to hand it over by licking me directly on the chest..."

strings.text: 「興奮してたのかよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You were getting excited?!"

strings.text: 「冗談です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I'm joking."

strings.text: 「冗談かよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So it was a joke."

strings.text: 「でも、直哉がやれと言ったら、速攻でパンツ染みます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But if Naoya told me to do it, my panties would get wet in an instant."

strings.text: 「パンツ染みるのか！？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Your panties would get wet?!"

strings.text: 「やってみましょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Shall we try it?"

strings.text: 「やるって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Try it, meaning...?"

strings.text: 「路地裏で私の胸元を直哉が舐めてみて、
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You lick my chest here in the back alley,

strings.text: その後、私のパンツがちゃんと染みているかどうか確認するという……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: and then afterward we check whether my panties are properly wet or not..."

strings.text: 「いろいろ問題ありすぎだろ！？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's way too many problems with that!"

strings.text: 「そうですか？　私は想像しただけで興奮して染みそうですけど？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Really? Just imagining it, I'm getting excited enough that I feel like I'm getting wet..."

strings.text: 「そこまでいくと、いつもの冗談だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That far, and it's obviously your usual joking around."

strings.text: 「さて、それが冗談かどうかはお試しあれ、といったところでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Well now, whether or not it's a joke -- shall we put it to the test?"

strings.text: 「相変わらずだなぁ……葛」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Same as ever, huh... Kuzu."

strings.text: 「はて？　葛とは誰の事でしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Oh my? Who is this Kuzu?"

strings.text: 「は？　ご、ごめんっ。間違った」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? S-sorry. My mistake."

strings.text: 「まぁ、二人っきりの時はそれでもよろしいですよ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Well, when it's just the two of us, that's fine."

strings.text: 「いや、そんな事してると、みんなでいるときに油断して葛って呼びそうだからダメだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, if I do that, I'll let my guard down when everyone's around and end up calling you Kuzu. That's no good."

strings.text: 「たしかに、雫が本名ではあります」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's true that Shizuku is my real name."

strings.text: 「ああ、お前は夏目雫だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. You're Natsume Shizuku."

strings.text: 「はい、そうですね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, that's right."

strings.text: 少しだけうれしそうに雫が笑った。
strings.translated: Shizuku smiled, looking a little pleased.

strings.text: また後方で自転車のブレーキ音がする。
strings.translated: Then there was another squeal of bicycle brakes behind us.

strings.text: 「どうした？　雫？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's wrong, Shizuku?"

strings.text: 雫は何かを見て固まっている。
strings.translated: Shizuku had frozen, staring at something.

strings.text: 俺も、雫の目の先に視線を向ける。
strings.translated: I followed her gaze.

strings.text: 「あ、あれ？　な、なおくん一人じゃなかった……んだ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "H-huh? Y-you weren't alone... Nao-kun?"

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "R-Rin..."

strings.text: 雫が稟を見て、一歩下がる。
strings.translated: Shizuku took a step back at the sight of Rin.

strings.text: 「あ、いや、ご、ごめんっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, I-I'm sorry."

strings.text: その表情を見た稟が頭を下げて謝る。
strings.translated: Seeing that expression, Rin bowed her head in apology.

strings.text: 「ご、ごめんね。まさか雫さんがお迎えに来られてるとは思わなくて……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I'm sorry. I didn't think Shizuku-san would be the one coming to meet you..."

strings.text: 稟は夏目家で一瞬だけ見た、雫の顔を覚えていた様だ。
strings.translated: It seemed Rin remembered Shizuku's face from the brief glimpse she'd caught at the Natsume house.

strings.text: 「いや、俺も思ってなかったから……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I didn't expect it either..."

strings.text: 「んじゃ、わ、私はお邪魔だよね。うん、ごめんっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-then, I-I'm in the way, right. Yeah, sorry!"

strings.text: 稟が自転車に乗ろうとする。
strings.translated: Rin moved to get back on her bicycle.

strings.text: その時に、雫が稟の袖を掴む。
strings.translated: At that moment, Shizuku grabbed Rin's sleeve.

strings.text: 雫も思わず手を出してしまったのだろう。
strings.translated: Shizuku had probably reached out without thinking.

strings.text: 稟と同じ様に驚いた顔をしていた。
strings.translated: She wore the same startled expression as Rin.

strings.text: だが、雫はそのまま言葉を発する。
strings.translated: But still, Shizuku spoke.

strings.text: 「こ、この前はごめんなさい……。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I-I'm sorry about the other day......

strings.text: な、夏目家に来てくれたのに、挨拶も出来なくて……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Y-you came all the way to the Natsume house, and I couldn't even greet you..."

strings.text: 「あ、ううん。だっていきなり押しかけたのって、私達だし……
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no. We were the ones who showed up out of nowhere......

strings.text: 驚くよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Of course you'd be startled."

strings.text: 「違う」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That's not it."

strings.text: 「あのね。稟」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Listen. Rin."

strings.text: 「え？　わ、私の名前をご存じなのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Y-you know my name?"

strings.text: 「あ、その……兄さんから聞いてます。あと直哉にも……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Ah, um...... I heard it from my brother. And from Naoya too......"

strings.text: 「そ、そっか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
雫
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 雫は稟の袖を掴んだまま立ち止まってしまう。
strings.translated: Shizuku stood frozen, still clutching Rin's sleeve.

strings.text: 「あ、あのね。雫さん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um. Shizuku-san."

strings.text: 「なに？　稟？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "What? Rin?"

strings.text: 「えっと……改めて自己紹介させてもらっても良いかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um...... Could I introduce myself again, properly?"

strings.text: 「うん」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「私は御桜稟。昔、この街に住んでいました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm Misakura Rin. I used to live in this town, long ago."

strings.text: 「うん……知ってる……」
strings.speaker: 雫

strings.text: 「え？　そうなの？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Really?"

strings.text: 「あ、直哉から聞いてる……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Ah, I heard it from Naoya......"

strings.text: また二人に無言が訪れる。
strings.translated: Silence fell between them once more.

strings.text: 「私は夏目雫。夏目家の次女です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I'm Natsume Shizuku. The second daughter of the Natsume family."

strings.text: 「うん、聞いてるよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, I know."

strings.text: 「よろしくお願いします……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's nice to meet you......"

strings.text: 「うん、こちらこそだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, likewise."

strings.text: 稟は雫の手を取る。
strings.translated: Rin took Shizuku's hand.

strings.text: 「なんというか、芸能人さんに少しおこがましいかなぁ……と思ったりもするのですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "How to put it... it might be a little presumptuous of me to say this to a celebrity, but......"

strings.text: 「雫さん、私とお友達になりませんか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Shizuku-san, would you be my friend?"

strings.text: 「あ、も、もちろん、無理だったら大丈夫です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, o-of course, if it's too much, that's all right."

strings.text: 「無理なわけなんかない！」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "There's no way it would be too much!"

strings.text: 雫とは思えない声で答える。
strings.translated: The voice that came out didn't sound like Shizuku's at all.

strings.text: 「わ、私でよければ、稟のお友達になりたい……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I-if someone like me is okay, I want to be Rin's friend......"

strings.text: 「うん、そう言っていただけるのであればっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, if you'd say that for me!"

strings.text: 「はい、稟です……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Right, I'm Rin......"

strings.text: 「はじめまして……稟」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Nice to meet you...... Rin."

strings.text: 「はじめまして、雫さん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nice to meet you, Shizuku-san."

strings.text: 「稟、この街に戻ってきたんだね……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Rin, you came back to this town......"

strings.text: 「そっか……そうなんだ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I see...... so that's how it is."

strings.text: 雫が稟に抱きつく。
strings.translated: Shizuku threw her arms around Rin.

strings.text: 稟は一瞬だけ驚いた顔をしたが、雫を優しく抱き返した。
strings.translated: Rin looked startled for just a moment, then gently returned the embrace.

strings.text: 「おかえり……稟」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Welcome home...... Rin."

strings.text: 「ただいま……雫さん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm home...... Shizuku-san."

strings.text: はじめましての後の、おかえり。そして、ただいま。
strings.translated: "Welcome home" and "I'm home," right after "nice to meet you."

strings.text: まったく奇妙な挨拶だが、二人の関係では、これが正しいのだろう……。
strings.translated: A strange sort of greeting, but for the two of them, this was probably the right one......

strings.text: 「雫さんって本当に美人だね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Shizuku-san, you really are beautiful."

strings.text: 「稟、私の事はさん付けしなくて良い」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Rin, you don't need to add -san when you talk to me."

strings.text: 「呼び捨ては微妙だよ。だったら雫ちゃんじゃだめかな」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Just calling you by name feels weird. Then would Shizuku-chan be all right?"

strings.text: 「うん、それなら大丈夫。稟にそう言われるの好きだから」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's fine. I like being called that by you, Rin."

strings.text: 「そっか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see."

strings.text: 稟がふたたび雫を抱きしめる。
strings.translated: Rin embraced Shizuku once more.

strings.text: 雫もそっと稟を抱きしめる……と思わせて――
strings.translated: Shizuku gently returned her embrace...... or so it seemed --

strings.text: 「ひゃあっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eeek!"

strings.text: 「むー、稟、こんな胸が大きくなっている……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Mmm, Rin, your chest has gotten this big......"

strings.text: 「わ、わわ、なんか揉まれてる」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "W-wawa, I'm being groped."

strings.text: 「うむ、揉む」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Mmhm, groping."

strings.text: 「そんな事すると、雫ちゃんも、こうやって揉んじゃうぞぉ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "If you do that, then I'll grope you like this too, Shizuku-chan."

strings.text: 「ひゃっ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Eek!"

strings.text: 「うわ、すごいスレンダー……なんだこのくびれ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wow, so slender...... what is with this waistline......"

strings.text: 二人はドヤ街のまん中で抱き合う。
strings.translated: The two of them embraced right in the middle of the skid row.

strings.text: 当然。
strings.translated: Naturally.

strings.text: おっさんＡ
strings.translated: Old Geezer A

strings.text: 「おー、なんだなんだ？」
strings.speaker: おっさんＡ
strings.translated: "Ohhh, what's this, what's this?"

strings.text: おっさんどもが一人、また一人増えてくる。
strings.translated: Old geezers began gathering, one by one.

strings.text: 当たり前だ。こんな場所でうら若き女の子が抱き合って、互いの身体をまさぐっていれば、おっさんどもも集まってくるだろう。
strings.translated: Of course they would. Young girls hugging each other and pawing at each other's bodies in a place like this -- of course the old geezers would come crowding around.

strings.text: おっさんＢ
strings.translated: Old Geezer B

strings.text: 「おいおい、こんな場所で、女の子達がそんな事してちゃいかんぞぉ」
strings.speaker: おっさんＢ
strings.translated: "Hey hey, little girls shouldn't be doing that kind of thing in a place like this."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、ちょっと感動な対面がありまして……
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, we just had a bit of a touching reunion......

strings.text: おい、稟と雫！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Hey, Rin, Shizuku!"

strings.text: 「は、はい？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yes?"

strings.text: 「とりあえず、歩くぞ。自己紹介はそこまでだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For now, let's walk. Introductions end here!"

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Riiin~"

strings.text: 「ほらほら！　もういいから、歩く歩く！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on, come on! Enough already, walk, walk!"

strings.text: 俺は二人を引き離して、とりあえずその場を離れる。
strings.translated: I pulled the two apart and got us out of there for the time being.

strings.text: 「ふぅ……やれやれだぜ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Phew...... good grief......"

strings.text: 「恥ずかしいったらありゃしない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You've got no idea how embarrassing that was."

strings.text: 「面目ない」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I have no excuse."

strings.text: 「うむ、私も少し、我を見失っていた」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Mm, I lost myself for a moment there too."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、稟まで来てくれると思わなかった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyway, I didn't think you'd come too, Rin."

strings.text: 「あ、電話の時に、瞬間的に場所が分かったから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, when you were on the phone, I figured out the place in a flash......"

strings.text: 稟も雫同様に汗だくだ。
strings.translated: Rin was drenched in sweat, same as Shizuku.

strings.text: まったく、この二人ときた日には……。
strings.translated: Honestly, when it comes to these two......

strings.text: 「稟は何を持って来たの？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "What did you bring, Rin?"

strings.text: 「あ？　これ？　あ、でも大半は雫ちゃんが持って来たものと同じだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? This? Ah, but most of it is the same stuff you brought, Shizuku-chan."

strings.text: 「でも、保冷剤がある……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But there are ice packs......"

strings.text: 「あ、なんかに使えるかなぁ……とか思って持って来たのですが……
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, I thought maybe they'd be useful for something...... so I brought them along......

strings.text: 何かに使えますかね？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Do you think they'll be of any use?"

strings.text: 「あ、それ助かるかも。生もの持って結構歩いたから、保冷剤とかあると助かる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, that might really help. We walked quite a while carrying perishables, so ice packs would be a lifesaver."

strings.text: 「そうですか、それは良かった。元々はタオルに巻いて使っていただけたらと思っていたのですが」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really? That's good. Originally I was thinking you could wrap them in a towel and use them that way."

strings.text: 俺は稟が持って来た保冷剤を買い物袋につめる。
strings.translated: I packed the ice packs Rin had brought into the shopping bag.

strings.text: 「他にも沢山ありますね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "There's a lot of other stuff too."

strings.text: 「あ、麦茶とかね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, barley tea and things like that."

strings.text: 「重かったんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wasn't it heavy?"

strings.text: 「そのための自転車ですもの。全然重くないです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's what the bicycle is for. It wasn't heavy at all."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、せっかく稟が持って来てくれたので、直哉は飲み物を取った方が良いです。熱中症になる可能性があります」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "For now, since Rin went to the trouble of bringing them, Naoya, you should have something to drink. There's a chance you'll get heatstroke."

strings.text: 「うん、それが良いね。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's a good idea.

strings.text: なおくんとか麦茶嫌い？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Nao-kun, do you dislike barley tea?"

strings.text: 「嫌いなわけないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's no way I'd dislike it."

strings.text: 「良かった」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's good."

strings.text: そう言うと稟は水筒から麦茶を出してくれる。
strings.translated: With that, Rin poured out some barley tea from her thermos for me.

strings.text: 「ああ、ありがとう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, thanks."

strings.text: 俺はごきゅごきゅと喉を鳴らして飲み干す。
strings.translated: I downed it in loud gulps.

strings.text: 「ぷはぁ……生き返る」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Pwaah...... I'm coming back to life."

strings.text: 「それでは移動しましょう」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "All right, let's get moving."

strings.text: 「あ、そうか。だったらこれで私は……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, right. In that case, I'll be......"

strings.text: 「稟も一緒……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Rin, come with us......"

strings.text: 雫は稟の袖を掴む。
strings.translated: Shizuku grabbed Rin's sleeve.

strings.text: 「もともと、そのつもりだったのでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That's what you meant to do from the start, wasn't it?"

strings.text: 「あ、うん……、だけど雫ちゃんが来てくれたんだから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah...... but since you came all the way here, Shizuku-chan......"

strings.text: 「そうだけど……稟」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That's true, but...... Rin."

strings.text: 「うん、私はこれで！　とりあえずお暇します」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, I'll be off! I'll take my leave for now."

strings.text: 「でも、稟」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But, Rin."

strings.text: 「ううん。これは雫ちゃんが最後まで責任を持って、なおくんを家まで送るべきだよ。私は勝手に来ただけだし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No. You should take responsibility to the end and see Nao-kun home yourself, Shizuku-chan. I just came on my own."

strings.text: 「それを言ったら、私だって……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "If that's how it is, then I'm also......"

strings.text: 「ううん。そんな事ないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No. That's not true."

strings.text: そう言うと稟は雫の頭を抱く。
strings.translated: With that, Rin cradled Shizuku's head.

strings.text: 「良く分からないんだけどね……。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I don't really understand it myself, but......

strings.text: なんか、雫ちゃんって懐かしい感じがするんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Somehow, Shizuku-chan, you feel nostalgic to me."

strings.text: 「そんな雫ちゃんだからさ……。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's why, since it's you, Shizuku-chan......

strings.text: ううん。何でも無い。とりあえず私は帰るね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: No. Never mind. Anyway, I'll be heading home."

strings.text: 「稟、私はもう少し一緒にいたい……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Rin, I want to stay together a little longer......"

strings.text: 「あははは、なんかそう言ってもらえるとうれしいね。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahaha, it makes me happy to hear you say that.

strings.text: でも、これで私の用事は終わったから。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: But my errand here is done.

strings.text: うん、なおくんもバイバイ。また明日っ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Yeah, bye-bye, Nao-kun. See you tomorrow!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

strings.text: そう言うと、稟は自転車に乗り、街の中に消えていった。
strings.translated: And with that, Rin got on her bicycle and vanished into the town.

strings.text: 「なんだ、あいつ……一緒に来ればいいものを……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What the heck, that girl...... she could've just come with us......"

strings.text: 「ううん。稟は優しいから……たぶん、いろいろ気を遣ってくれたんだと思う……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No. Rin is kind...... I think she was probably being considerate in various ways......"

strings.text: 「優しい？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kind?"

strings.text: 「とりあえず、今日は、稟のご厚意に甘えましょう。さてと家に帰りますよ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "For now, let's take Rin up on her kindness for today. Well then, let's head home."

strings.text: そう言うと雫は歩き出す。
strings.translated: With that, Shizuku started walking.

strings.text: 「それにしても雫、お前ってずっとここにいなかったのに、なんでこんな場所を知っているんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Still, Shizuku, you weren't around here for ages -- how do you know a place like this?"

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎が愛用していた場所だから……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Because it was a favorite spot of Kusanagi Ken'ichirou......"

strings.text: 「あいつが？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That guy?"

strings.text: 「逆に、直哉が知らなかった事に驚いたぐらい」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "If anything, I was surprised you didn't know about it, Naoya."

strings.text: 「いや、俺は本当にあいつのプライベートの事は良く分かってないからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I really don't know much about that guy's private life."

strings.text: 「二人はとても良く似ているのに……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "And yet the two of you are so alike......"

strings.text: 「言うほど似てるかねぇ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Are we really that alike?"

strings.text: 「うん、そっくり……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah, exactly alike......"

strings.text: 「この店、安いので、昔、健一郎さんが良く通ってたと聞いている」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "This shop is cheap, so I've heard Ken'ichirou-san used to come here often long ago."

strings.text: 「へぇ、この店がねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh, this shop, really......"

strings.text: 「いらっしゃーい」
strings.translated: "Welcome~"

strings.text: 店を覗いていたら、やけにちんまい子が店から出てくる。
strings.translated: As I peered into the shop, a strikingly tiny child came out from within.

strings.text: 「いやいや、俺たちは客じゃないよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, we're not customers."

strings.text: 「そうなの？　たしかに見かけない顔だけど」
strings.translated: "Really? You do look like faces I haven't seen before, though."

strings.text: 「お嬢ちゃんは、お母さんか誰かの手伝いなのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Little missy, are you helping out your mom or something?"

strings.text: 「いやいや、ノノ未はちゃんとバイトだよ」
strings.translated: "No, no, Nonomi's a proper part-timer."

strings.text: 「バイト？　その歳で」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Part-timer? At that age?"

strings.text: ノノ未
strings.translated: Nonomi

strings.text: 「この界隈では私は長いのです」
strings.speaker: ノノ未
strings.translated: "I've been in this neighborhood a long time."

strings.text: ちびっこは胸を張る。
strings.translated: The little kid puffed out her chest.

strings.text: 「そっか……、とりあえず、酒が飲める年齢になったら、また来るよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see...... well, once we're old enough to drink, we'll come back."

strings.text: 「そっか、まだお兄ちゃん達は飲める年齢ではないんだね。
strings.speaker: ノノ未
strings.translated: "Oh, so you big brothers aren't old enough to drink yet.

strings.text: それでは、またのおこしを～」
strings.speaker: ノノ未
strings.translated: Well then, please come again~"

strings.text: ちびっこはお辞儀をする。
strings.translated: The little kid bowed.

strings.text: 「話しかけられたよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She actually talked to us."

strings.text: 「ここの人達はみんな愛想が良いですから……、それにしても小さくてかわいい娘さんでしたね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Everyone around here is friendly...... Still, what a tiny, adorable girl."

strings.text: 「そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's true."

strings.text: 俺たちは泪川商店街を通り抜けていく。
strings.translated: We passed through the Namidagawa shopping district.

strings.text: すると……。
strings.translated: And then...

strings.text: 見慣れぬ住宅街を左に曲がると、突然見慣れた風景に変わる。
strings.translated: Turning left through an unfamiliar residential street, the scenery abruptly shifted into something I knew well.

strings.text: 「ああ、ここか。ここに出るのか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, so this is where it comes out."

strings.text: 「はい、これで直哉も大人になったら、気楽に泪川商店街でお酒を飲みに行けますね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes. Now when you grow up, Naoya, you'll be able to go drinking at the Namidagawa shopping district whenever you like."

strings.text: 「この年齢で、将来の飲み屋とか決まるのもなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kind of weird to have my future watering hole decided at this age......"

strings.text: 俺は雫に先導されて、家路につく事が出来た。
strings.translated: Led by Shizuku, I was able to make my way home.

strings.text: 学校の勉強が一段落してから夕食の後片付けをはじめる。
strings.translated: After my schoolwork wound down, I set about cleaning up from dinner.

strings.text: 数時間ほど浸け置きしておいたが、それでも今日の洗い物は少々やっかいだった。
strings.translated: I'd left everything to soak for a few hours, but even so, tonight's dishes were a bit of a chore.

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「がんばりすぎたな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I went a little overboard..."

strings.text: あれだけ遠出して買い物をしたからな、料理もがんばってしまって当然か。
strings.translated: Well, we did go all the way out to shop, so I suppose it's only natural I got carried away with the cooking too.

strings.text: 大勢の食事は楽しい。
strings.translated: Meals with a crowd are fun.

strings.text: それに、夏は旬の野菜が多い。
strings.translated: And summer brings plenty of vegetables in season.

strings.text: 当然夏場は野菜の値段が安くなる。
strings.translated: Naturally, in summer, vegetable prices drop.

strings.text: 安ければ、いつもより料理を豪勢にする事が出来る。
strings.translated: When things are cheap, you can make dishes a bit more lavish than usual.

strings.text: この時期の魚ならば安くてうまいトビウオがおすすめだ。
strings.translated: For fish at this time of year, I'd recommend flying fish -- cheap and delicious.

strings.text: 通称本トビという。夏から初秋にとれるトビウオの事をさして言う。
strings.translated: They're commonly called "hon-tobi" -- a term for flying fish caught from summer through early autumn.

strings.text: 春にとれるトビウオは春トビというのだが、夏のトビウオをさして「本トビ」と言う。この言葉からも分かる通り、夏のトビウオは格別だ。
strings.translated: Flying fish caught in spring are called "haru-tobi," while those caught in summer earn the name "hon-tobi" -- the "real" flying fish. As the name suggests, summer flying fish are something special.

strings.text: トビウオは油分が少なく淡泊な味だが、とにかく天ぷらがうまい。
strings.translated: Flying fish are low in oil and mild in flavor, but they make truly excellent tempura.

strings.text: 小骨が多いのでさばくのがめんどいトビウオが刺身用になっているのはうれしい……。
strings.translated: They're a pain to fillet because of all the fine bones, so it's a relief to find them already prepared as sashimi...

strings.text: そのまま一口大に切って衣を絡ませれば良いだけだ。
strings.translated: All you have to do is cut them into bite-sized pieces and coat them in batter.

strings.text: それはそうと、夏はキスなんかも旬だったりする。
strings.translated: That aside, summer is also the season for whiting.

strings.text: キスなんかも天ぷらにはうってつけだ。
strings.translated: Whiting is another fish perfectly suited to tempura.

strings.text: 旬のもので作るてんぷらはおいしいし作るのも楽しいが、やはり後片付けはめんどくさい。
strings.translated: Tempura made with seasonal ingredients is delicious and fun to prepare, but the cleanup is a pain, as always.

strings.text: 「揚げ物は洗い物がめんどくさいからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Fried food really is a nightmare to clean up after."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew..."

strings.text: 俺は一通りの洗い物を済ませて、冷蔵庫から麦茶を取り出し、茶の間で腰をおろす。
strings.translated: Once I'd finished washing everything, I took some barley tea from the fridge and settled down in the tea room.

strings.text: 麦茶をコップにうつしながら、手元にあった新聞を開く。
strings.translated: Pouring the tea into a glass, I opened the newspaper that lay nearby.

strings.text: 「また増税かよ。こんな時期に増税とか大丈夫なのか？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Another tax hike? Is it really okay to raise taxes at a time like this?

strings.text: さらなる景気の悪化とかかんべんしてくれよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Spare me from any more economic downturn, please."

strings.text: とりあえず、俺が就職するまでは景気とか良くなっていてほしいもんだ。
strings.translated: At the very least, I'd like the economy to have picked up by the time I hit the job market.

strings.text: 生まれた年度によって、人生がイージーモードだったりハードモードだったりするのはやめてほしい。
strings.translated: It's ridiculous that whether your life is on easy mode or hard mode depends on the year you were born.

strings.text: 去年までは就職率が良かったのに、今年からダメとか、恐ろしすぎる世界だ。
strings.translated: Employment rates were good up through last year and then suddenly aren't -- what a terrifying world.

strings.text: とりあえず、俺が就職する年だけでいいから、景気が回復して求人が増加してほしいもんだ。
strings.translated: Just for the year I'm looking for work -- that's all I ask -- let the economy recover and job openings increase.

strings.text: 「うわ……、若者の失業率ってどんどん悪化してるのか……。これ以上の貧乏など勘弁してくれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whoa... the unemployment rate among young people just keeps getting worse... please, no more poverty in my life..."

strings.text: 新聞を読んでもろくな話題がない。
strings.translated: There isn't a single decent story in the paper.

strings.text: こんなもん読んで暗くなっても仕方がない。
strings.translated: No point getting depressed reading this sort of thing.

strings.text: だいたい、何が起こるか分からない未来の事など考えても仕方がない。
strings.translated: Besides, there's no use worrying about a future you can't predict.

strings.text: 「未来の事は未来になったら考えればいいのだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The future is something to think about when it becomes the present."

strings.text: 新聞は読み飽きたので、今度は手元にあった雑誌を広げた。
strings.translated: Tired of the newspaper, I opened up a magazine I found lying nearby.

strings.text: 女性向けのファッション雑誌。
strings.translated: A women's fashion magazine.

strings.text: 中を開くと、すぐに雫の姿が目に入った。
strings.translated: When I flipped it open, my eyes landed on Shizuku almost immediately.

strings.text: だって付箋が貼ってあるから……。
strings.translated: Well, that was because a sticky tab had been placed there...

strings.text: 「雫はファッション誌なんかにも出ているのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So Shizuku appears in fashion magazines too, huh..."

strings.text: 本当に有名人なのだな……。
strings.translated: She really is a celebrity...

strings.text: たぶん雫が載っているという事で藍が買ったのだろう。
strings.translated: Ai probably bought it because Shizuku was in it.

strings.text: 実際、同じものが本棚にも挟まっている。
strings.translated: In fact, an identical copy is tucked into the bookshelf.

strings.text: 「こうやって見ると、本当に芸能人なんだなぁ……。雫って……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Seeing this, she really is a bona fide star... Shizuku, I mean..."

strings.text: 俺が持つ雫のイメージ。
strings.translated: The image I have of Shizuku.

strings.text: あ、いや、雫ではないのかもしれないが、
strings.translated: Ah, no, maybe it isn't Shizuku at all,

strings.text: なんかそういうものとは、雑誌で見る彼女の表情は乖離していた。
strings.translated: but the expression on her face in the magazine felt worlds apart from anything like that.

strings.text: 「雫は美人というより、本当はかわいらしい感じなんだけどな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shizuku isn't so much beautiful as she is genuinely cute, really..."

strings.text: 表情がぎこちないというか、素朴というか、そんな感じなかわいさ……。
strings.translated: Her expressions are a little stiff, a little unpolished -- that kind of cuteness...

strings.text: 俺は、雫のページをじっと見つめる。
strings.translated: I stared fixedly at Shizuku's page.

strings.text: 一緒に住んでいても、あいつの肌など、こんなまじまじと見つめる事は出来ない。
strings.translated: Even living under the same roof, I could never study her skin this closely.

strings.text: すばらしいラインだな。
strings.translated: What magnificent lines.

strings.text: 胸はそこまでないが……この細身でありながら、柔らかそうで張りのある肌……。
strings.translated: Her chest isn't much to speak of... but that slender frame, that soft and supple-looking skin...

strings.text: 芸術的ですらある。
strings.translated: It's practically artistic.

strings.text: 「おっといかん……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whoa there, that's enough..."

strings.text: こんなページをずっと見ていたら、雫を意識してしまいかねん。
strings.translated: If I kept staring at a page like this, I might start seeing Shizuku as more than she is.

strings.text: 一緒に暮らしていくにあたって、それは厳禁だ。
strings.translated: Living together, that's strictly forbidden.

strings.text: とはいってもかれこれ１０分近く眺めていた様な気もするが……。
strings.translated: Though it feels like I've already been staring at it for close to ten minutes...

strings.text: 俺はぺらぺらと他のページをめくっていく。
strings.translated: I flipped through the other pages.

strings.text: 「女ものの服はひらひらが多いな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Women's clothes really have a lot of frills..."

strings.text: 絵で描いたらめんどくさそうな服ばかりだ。
strings.translated: Nothing but clothes that would be a pain to draw.

strings.text: そういえば……。
strings.translated: Now that I think of it......

strings.text: 今日、あの場所で会った少女……。
strings.translated: That girl I met earlier today, at that place...

strings.text: なんか見覚えがあると思ったのだけど、
strings.translated: I thought she looked familiar somehow,

strings.text: それは顔ではなく服だな……。
strings.translated: but it wasn't her face -- it was her clothes...

strings.text: 何となくでしかないのだが、
strings.translated: It's only a vague impression,

strings.text: あの服……見覚えがあるんだよな……。
strings.translated: but those clothes... I feel like I've seen them somewhere...

strings.text: まぁ、服なんて、大量生産のもんが大半だし、ただでなくても似たり寄ったりのデザインだ。
strings.translated: Well, most clothes are mass-produced, and even without that, the designs all look pretty similar.

strings.text: たしかに、何となく見覚えがある服なんて珍しくもない。
strings.translated: It's certainly not unusual to see clothes that look vaguely familiar.

strings.text: なのだが……。
strings.translated: However...

strings.text: 何か、少し気にかかる……。
strings.translated: Still, something about it nags at me...

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Clothes, huh..."

strings.text: 当たり前だが、都合良く彼女が着ていた服が載っていたりはしない。
strings.translated: Naturally, the outfit she'd been wearing wasn't conveniently pictured in the magazine.

strings.text: 似た様な服はある様な気もするが、同じものではないだろう。
strings.translated: There are things that look similar, but nothing quite the same.

strings.text: 雑誌をめくりながら、あの娘が名乗る前に口にした言葉を思い出す。
strings.translated: As I paged through the magazine, I recalled the word that girl had spoken just before giving her name.

strings.text: “オランピア”
strings.translated: "Olympia."

strings.text: 「……そういえば、あいつ服のタグを見て“オランピア”とか言ってたな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Come to think of it, she looked at the tag on her clothes and said 'Olympia'..."

strings.text: オランピアなんて名前の服のメーカーなどあるのだろうか……。
strings.translated: Is there really a clothing brand called Olympia?

strings.text: まぁ、あってもおかしくないと言えばおかしくないのだけど……。
strings.translated: Well, I suppose it wouldn't be strange if there were...

strings.text: 雑誌にはそれらしい名前など無かった。
strings.translated: But there was no such name in the magazine.

strings.text: 「オランピアねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Olympia, huh..."

strings.text: なんでそんな名前なんだか……。
strings.translated: Why on earth that name...

strings.text: 西洋美術を少しでも知る者であれば聞いた事のある名だ……。
strings.translated: Anyone with even a passing knowledge of Western art would have heard it...

strings.text: 特に俺にはなじみ深いものだ。
strings.translated: And for me, it's especially familiar.

strings.text: フランスの画家エドゥアール・マネの代表作の一つ。
strings.translated: A representative work by the French painter Edouard Manet.

strings.text: それが『オランピア』だ。
strings.translated: That is 'Olympia.'

strings.text: 発表された当時、大変な騒ぎになったと言われる裸婦画。
strings.translated: A nude that caused an enormous uproar when it was first exhibited.

strings.text: 新聞では「女ゴリラ」「ヤクザな小娘」とさんざんな評価を得たという。
strings.translated: The papers of the day gave it savage reviews -- "female gorilla," "yakuza wench," and worse.

strings.text: 展覧会でステッキを振り回して暴れた者すらいたらしい。
strings.translated: There was even a man at the exhibition who ran wild swinging his walking stick.

strings.text: とは言っても、その酷評自体がマネの狙いであったわけだが……。
strings.translated: Though of course, that very outrage was exactly what Manet had been aiming for...

strings.text: 『オランピア』以前。裸の女を描くという行為は、すなわち<r ヴィーナス>女神</r>を描くという行為であった。
strings.translated: Before 'Olympia,' to paint a naked woman was, in effect, to paint Venus.

strings.text: もし仮に、画家自身が<r ヴィーナス>女神</r>を描いてないつもりでも、それらしく仕上げるのが当時の常識であった。
strings.translated: Even if the painter himself had no intention of depicting Venus, the convention of the time demanded she be finished in that guise.

strings.text: 裸婦を描くには大義が必要だったわけだ。
strings.translated: Painting a nude required a grand justification.

strings.text: それをマネはあえて無視した。
strings.translated: Manet deliberately ignored all of that.

strings.text: 履き古されたサンダル。
strings.translated: Worn-out sandals.

strings.text: 金のブレスレット。
strings.translated: A gold bracelet.

strings.text: 首の黒いチョーカーリボン。
strings.translated: A black choker ribbon at her throat.

strings.text: 白いシーツに横たわる姿は、構図なども含め、マネの300年以上前の画家ティツィアーノ作品『ウルビーノのヴィーナス』と瓜二つで有りながら、
strings.translated: Her figure reclining on white sheets -- composition and all -- is nearly identical to 'The Venus of Urbino,' painted more than three hundred years earlier by Titian.

strings.text: その生々しいディティールは、300年前の画家ティツィアーノの“ヴィーナス”とその意味を、完全に分かつものであった。
strings.translated: And yet the raw specificity of its details completely severs it from the meaning of Titian's "Venus" of three centuries before.

strings.text: 当時のフランスで“オランピア”とは“娼婦”の通称であったのだ。
strings.translated: In the France of that time, "Olympia" was a common name for a courtesan.

strings.text: 娼婦の後ろに立つ黒人のメイドが持つもの。
strings.translated: What the Black maid standing behind the courtesan holds.

strings.text: 娼婦の足下に立つ、黒い猫。
strings.translated: The black cat standing at the courtesan's feet.

strings.text: すべてが計算されている。
strings.translated: Every detail is calculated.

strings.text: 理由を知れば、この絵を展覧会で見た者がステッキを振り回して暴れたのも頷ける。
strings.translated: Once you know the reasons, it makes perfect sense that the man who saw this painting at the exhibition would fly into a rage swinging his cane.

strings.text: 何故ならば、娼婦を買った事がある人間ならば、この独特な雰囲気を知っているからだという。
strings.translated: Because, they say, anyone who has ever bought the services of a courtesan knows this peculiar atmosphere.

strings.text: 背後のメイドが持つものは“花束”。
strings.translated: What the maid behind her holds is a "bouquet."

strings.text: 当然、客からのプレゼントだ。
strings.translated: Naturally, a gift from a client.

strings.text: 足下に描かれた猫は目を大きく見開き、手を突っ張らせて背中を丸め緊張している。まるで来訪者を威嚇すらしているかに見える。
strings.translated: The cat at her feet is depicted with wide eyes, back arched, legs stiff with tension. It looks almost as if it's threatening some visitor.

strings.text: その来訪者とは誰であろう。
strings.translated: And who is that visitor?

strings.text: 当然。娼婦を買いに来た客である。
strings.translated: Of course -- it is the client, come to buy the courtesan.

strings.text: そしてその来訪者の視点こそが、この絵を見る者の視点と重なる。
strings.translated: And it is precisely the visitor's viewpoint that becomes the viewpoint of anyone looking at the painting.

strings.text: だからこそ、身に覚えがある人間に対してこの絵は、独特な感じを与える。
strings.translated: And that is why, for anyone with such experiences of his own, this painting gives off a peculiar sensation.

strings.text: 独特な不快感を感じさせる。
strings.translated: It evokes a peculiar sort of discomfort.

strings.text: この絵を見てステッキを振り回した男が感じたものは、そんなものであったのだろう……。
strings.translated: That, most likely, was what the man who saw the painting and swung his cane felt...

strings.text: 『オランピア』は俺にとってなじみの深い絵の一つだ。
strings.translated: 'Olympia' is one of the paintings most familiar to me.

strings.text: 理由はもちろん。
strings.translated: The reason, of course.

strings.text: 夏目家の入り口にずっとかけられているのが『オランピア』の模写だからである。
strings.translated: What has always hung at the entrance of the Natsume household is a copy of 'Olympia.'

strings.text: あの器用な男が描いた絵は、模写というよりも贋作のレベルだ。
strings.translated: What that deft hand painted is less a mere study than a work on the level of a master forgery.

strings.text: 制作者は草薙健一郎。
strings.translated: Its creator was Kusanagi Ken'ichirou.

strings.text: ついこの前に死んだ。世界的な芸術家。
strings.translated: He died only recently. A world-renowned artist.

strings.text: 彼が有名になる前に描いた作品だ。
strings.translated: A piece he'd painted before he became famous.

strings.text: あれがそのまま『オランピア』の習作として市場に出たとしても、大半の人間が見抜けないだろう。
strings.translated: Even if it were put on the market as a study for 'Olympia,' most people wouldn't be able to tell the difference.

strings.text: 下手したら有名美術館のキュレーターですら見抜けずに展覧会に飾ってしまいかねない。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, even a curator at a major museum might well fail to spot it and end up hanging it in an exhibition.

strings.text: 「オランピア……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Olympia..."

strings.text: あの絵と今日出会った娘の事を考えた。
strings.translated: I thought about that painting and about the girl I'd met today.

strings.text: あまり一致するところはない。
strings.translated: There isn't much that matches up.

strings.text: あの娘、吹とか言ってたが、
strings.translated: That girl -- she said her name was Sui,

strings.text: オランピアが名であるなら、
strings.translated: If Olympia were her name,

strings.text: お前は娼婦という事になってしまうな。
strings.translated: then that would make you a courtesan.

strings.text: とか言ったら、あのバールでぶん殴られてたかもしれない。
strings.translated: If I'd said something like that, I'd probably have gotten clubbed with that crowbar.

strings.text: 「その場で言わなくて良かった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Good thing I didn't say it out loud..."

strings.text: 「オランピアか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Olympia, huh..."

strings.text: 娼婦でありながら、気品すらある気の強そうな感じは、ある女性を思い出させる。
strings.translated: That air of a courtesan who is nonetheless dignified, with a strong will, reminds me of a certain woman.

strings.text: たしかに吹も気が強そうではあるとも言えるが……だいぶ幼い感じも受けた。
strings.translated: It's true Sui also seemed strong-willed, in her way... though she also came off as awfully childish.

strings.text: マネの“オランピア”からは、何も彼女につながるものが無い様に思える。
strings.translated: From Manet's "Olympia," there doesn't seem to be anything that ties her to Sui.

strings.text: 「オランピアですか……」
strings.translated: "Olympia, is it..."

strings.text: 「って、わぁっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wha -- gah!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "S-Shizuku, it's you..."

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「何を驚いてるのです？　その動揺っぷり、やましい事を考えてる証拠ですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "What are you so startled about? That flustered look -- proof you were thinking something shameful, wasn't it?"

strings.text: 「んな、アホな。別にやましい事なんて考えて無いわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As if. I wasn't thinking anything shameful."

strings.text: 「直哉はオランピアの事を考えていた？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Naoya, you were thinking about Olympia?"

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ、口に出ていたぐらいだから、そうなのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well, I said it out loud, so yes, I was..."

strings.text: 「つまり水菜さんの事を……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "In other words, about Mizuna..."

strings.text: 「違うわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not it!"

strings.text: 「違うのですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You weren't?"

strings.text: 「オランピアの事が出てきたからといって、マネの代表作と母親を必ず重ねて考えるわけではないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just because Olympia came up doesn't mean I automatically link Manet's masterpiece with my mother."

strings.text: 「マネのオランピアの事を考えていたのですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "So you were thinking about Manet's Olympia?"

strings.text: 「いや、そういうわけでもないのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, not exactly that either..."

strings.text: 「ならば何を考えていたのでしょう？
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Then what were you thinking about?

strings.text: たとえばオペラとか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Like an opera, perhaps?"

strings.text: 「オペラ？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "An opera?

strings.text: あ、いや、オペラの事など知らないが……そんな名のオペラがあるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Uh, no, I don't know anything about operas... is there one by that name?"

strings.text: 「その様な名のオペラは無いです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "There is no opera by such a name."

strings.text: 「無いのかよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There isn't...?"

strings.text: 「はい、そんな名前のオペラはありません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No, there is no opera by that name."

strings.text: 「だったら、何で何の脈絡も無くオペラなんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then why bring up opera out of nowhere...?"

strings.text: やはり雫独特の会話センスは理解しがたい。
strings.translated: Shizuku's peculiar sense of conversation is as difficult to grasp as ever.

strings.text: 「それよりも、直哉が口にしていたオランピアとはいったい誰でしょう？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "More importantly, who exactly is this 'Olympia' Naoya was muttering about?"

strings.text: 「ああ、オランピアは人の名前じゃない。俺には外人の知り合いなどいない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, Olympia isn't a person's name. I don't have any foreign acquaintances."

strings.text: 「ならば、物の名前？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Then, the name of a thing?"

strings.text: 「うむ、だいたいそんな感じだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's more or less it..."

strings.text: 良く分からんが……、
strings.translated: Not that I really get it, but...

strings.text: 「今日、たまたま知り合ったやつがいてな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's this person I happened to meet today..."

strings.text: 「今日知り合った？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Met today?"

strings.text: 「ああ、バールの様なものを持って、俺の家の近所の工事現場周辺をうろうろしてた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, she was wandering around the construction site near my house, carrying something like a crowbar..."

strings.text: 「工事現場のおじさんですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "A construction-site uncle?"

strings.text: 「いや、分かる。たしかに今の説明だったら、単純に工事現場のおっさんだよな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I get it. Sure, from just that description, it does sound like some construction-site old man..."

strings.text: 「だが、吹は名前から連想されるように女の子だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But Sui is, as her name suggests, a girl."

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Sui?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そういう名前なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's her name."

strings.text: 「その女性は、直哉から見てどんな感じだったのでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "This girl -- what did she seem like, from Naoya's point of view?"

strings.text: 「少女趣味というか……なんかひらひらした服着てた。ドレスみたいな分厚い生地のやつ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kind of girlish, I guess... she was wearing something all frilly. Thick fabric like a dress..."

strings.text: 「ひらひらした服……、なるほど、それはまるで人形みたいな感じでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Frilly clothes... I see, so it was rather like a doll's outfit, perhaps?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、そんなところかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, something like that, yeah..."

strings.text: 「吹はバールで何を？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "What was Sui doing with the crowbar?"

strings.text: 「良く分からんが、なんでも工事を止めようとか考えていたらしい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not really sure, but apparently she was thinking of stopping the construction somehow..."

strings.text: 「工事を力尽くで中止ですか。まるで何かの反対運動みたいです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Halting construction by force. It's rather like some sort of protest movement."

strings.text: 「うーん。そうなのかなぁ……。でも、工事反対！　みたいなのって、だいたい団体でするもんだけど、あいつの場合はどう見ても単独犯だった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hmm. I wonder... But things like 'stop the construction!' are usually done by groups, and from what I saw, she was clearly acting alone."

strings.text: 「なるほど、今までの話を吟味して雫は思いました。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Having considered the conversation thus far, Shizuku has arrived at a thought.

strings.text: 直哉が口にしたオランピアと言うのは何なんでしょうか？
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Just what is this Olympia that Naoya spoke of?

strings.text: まったく分かりません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: I have no idea whatsoever."

strings.text: 「あ、すまん。元々の質問はオランピアに関してだよな。えっと、そいつが着ていた服のメーカーがオランピアだったんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, sorry. The original question was about Olympia. Um, the maker of the clothes she was wearing was Olympia."

strings.text: 「服のメーカー？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "A clothing maker?"

strings.text: 「ああ、たぶんなんだけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, probably..."

strings.text: 「たぶんとは？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Probably?"

strings.text: 「そいつがタグを見せてくれてだな、そこにオランピアと書かれていた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She showed me the tag, and it said Olympia on it."

strings.text: 「なるほど、そこでさらに素朴な疑問です。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I see. Which leads to a further simple question.

strings.text: タグというのは通常、服の裏側にあるもの」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Tags are typically located on the inside of clothes."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, they are..."

strings.text: 「そこで、私としてはさらなる素朴な疑問が生まれます。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Which raises an even more simple question for me.

strings.text: その様なものは、服を脱がさないと見られないと思われる」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Such a thing, one would think, cannot be seen without removing the clothes."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、俺が見たというか、教わったという感じであってだな、俺が脱がしたとか無いぞ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it was more like I was shown, or told about it -- I didn't undress her or anything!"

strings.text: 「でも、最初に見せてもらったと言ったのです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But you did say at first that you were shown it."

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ、たしかに言ったけど……その、なんだ雫」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well, yeah, I did say that... um, listen, Shizuku."

strings.text: 「なんでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes?"

strings.text: 「なんか目つきが怖いのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Your eyes are kind of scary..."

strings.text: 「気のせいでしょう……。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You must be imagining it...

strings.text: といいますか何故、そこで私がそのような視線をしなければならないのでしょうか？　これまた疑問です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Or rather, why on earth would I be giving you such a look at this juncture? That, in turn, is another question."

strings.text: 「し、知らんけど……なんか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I don't know... but somehow..."

strings.text: 「とりあえず。オランピアと書かれた服のタグを見たのですね……。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "In any case. So you saw a tag that said Olympia on some clothes...

strings.text: なるほど、ふーん。そうですか……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: I see. Hmm. Is that so..."

strings.text: 「なんか声まで怖くなってる様な気がするのだけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It feels like even your voice is getting scary now..."

strings.text: 「それは気のせいです。といいますか、ここで私の声が恐ろしくなっていく理由などありません。そもそも私は大層機嫌が良いです。稟と話せたのですから」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You must be imagining that. Or rather, there is no reason for my voice to grow terrifying here. To begin with, I am in exceedingly good spirits. Because I was able to talk with Rin."

strings.text: 「だ、だったら……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "T-then..."

strings.text: 「ただ直哉の発言に疑問があったので追求したまでです。直哉にやましい事が無いのなら別に恐ろしくもなんともないと思います」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I was merely pursuing a question I had regarding Naoya's remarks. If Naoya has nothing on his conscience, there is nothing frightening about it at all."

strings.text: 「あくまでも、
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Provided, of course,

strings.text: 直哉にやましい事がないのであれば！
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: that Naoya has nothing on his conscience!

strings.text: です……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: That is..."

strings.text: なんか言葉にとげがある様な……。
strings.translated: There's a definite edge to her words...

strings.text: 「服の裏地なんて普通見えませんから……、
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "The inside of clothes isn't normally visible...

strings.text: 脱がさないかぎり、あるいはめくらないかぎり……いやぁ、そんな事を直哉がするはずはー」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Unless you remove them, or turn them up... surely Naoya would never do such a thing --"

strings.text: 「あ、あのさ雫……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-hey, Shizuku..."

strings.text: 「でももしそれが事実であるならば、女性の服を脱がすほどのプレイボーイっぷりとは、かのご高名な芸術家先生の草薙健一郎に負けず劣らず、モテモテなのですね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But if that is indeed the case, then to be enough of a playboy to strip a woman's clothes off -- you are as much a heartbreaker as the illustrious artist Kusanagi Ken'ichirou himself."

strings.text: 「ち、違う！　あ、あのな！　雫！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no! L-listen! Shizuku!"

strings.text: 「むにゃ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Owf."

strings.text: 「にゃ、にゃにを……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-wha' arf you --"

strings.text: 「冗談です……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It was a joke..."

strings.text: 「じょ、冗談？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A-a joke?"

strings.text: 「はい、冗談です。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, a joke.

strings.text: だいたい、私がその様な事で嫉妬などするわけがありません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: To begin with, there is no way I would be jealous over such a thing."

strings.text: 「だ、だったら、にゃぜ、ほっぺをつねる……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-then whyf are yo' pinchin' myf cheek..."

strings.text: 「稟の事もありますから」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "There is also the matter of Rin."

strings.text: 「なんだよ。なんで稟の事が関係あるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's that? Why does Rin have anything to do with this...?"

strings.text: 「ありまくりなのです。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Everything to do with it.

strings.text: 相変わらず直哉は脇が甘いといいますか、優しすぎるといいますか……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Naoya, as ever, has his guard down -- or rather, is far too kind..."

strings.text: 「にゃ、にゃんの話だっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whaf, whaf are you talkin' abou'?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、それが直哉の良さなのですが……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Well, that is one of Naoya's good points..."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、雫としては、ここでほっぺをつねるというのも不条理であるとは感じてます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "In any case, Shizuku does feel that pinching your cheek here is rather unreasonable."

strings.text: 「雫としてとか関係なく不条理ら！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's unreasonable regardless of what 'Shizuku' feels about it!"

strings.text: 「ふむ……。そうですね。微妙な立場です……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Hmm... I see. It is a delicate position..."

strings.text: やっと雫が手を離してくれる。
strings.translated: Finally, Shizuku releases her grip.

strings.text: 「痛いわ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That hurt!"

strings.text: 「でしょうね。痛くしましたから」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I imagine so. I made it hurt."

strings.text: 「何で痛くする！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why did you make it hurt!"

strings.text: 「直哉は知ってますか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Naoya, did you know?"

strings.text: 「何を？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「教育において、時には体罰も、それなりに有効であるという研究結果があるのですよ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "There are research findings suggesting that, in education, corporal punishment is sometimes reasonably effective."

strings.text: 「何で、俺がお前に体罰を受けなければならない！　なんの教育だ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why do I have to receive corporal punishment from you! What education is this!"

strings.text: 「犬に、危険を教えるのに、軽い体罰は有効です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "For teaching a dog about danger, light corporal punishment is effective."

strings.text: 「何故、俺が犬扱いだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why am I being treated like a dog!"

strings.text: 「いいえ、それはさすがに比喩です。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No, that was, of course, a metaphor.

strings.text: 別に犬でも猿でもいいのですが……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: It could have just as well been a monkey..."

strings.text: なんかどちらにしてもろくな比喩じゃない……。
strings.translated: Either way, it's not much of a metaphor...

strings.text: 「ただ、直哉は、いらぬお節介をすぐに焼く人なのです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It is simply that Naoya is a person who all too readily meddles where he isn't needed."

strings.text: 「今日も、稟との仲を取り持ってくださいましたし……でもそもそも稟と私は会うべきではなかったのですが……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Today as well, you played matchmaker between Rin and me... though, fundamentally, Rin and I should not have met..."

strings.text: 「でも会いたかったんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But you wanted to meet her, didn't you?"

strings.text: 「だとしても、会うべきではない事実は変わらないのです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Even so, the fact that we should not have met remains unchanged."

strings.text: 「ましてや、会ってしまったらまた大きな事件が起きてしまう可能性もあるのです……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "All the more so because, having met, another great incident may well come to pass..."

strings.text: 「いいえ、違います。すでに昨日、稟と会った時点で、すでに起き始めているのかもしれない……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No, I am wrong. It may already have begun, from the very moment I met Rin yesterday..."

strings.text: 「それはどういう事だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What do you mean by that?"

strings.text: 「ふぅ……。説明は出来ません。というかしません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Sigh... I cannot explain. Or rather, I will not."

strings.text: 「なんでだよ。なんかまた起きてるんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why not? Something's happening again, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「そうやって、クビを突っ込むから話さないのです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It is precisely because you would poke your nose in like that that I will not tell you."

strings.text: 「雫は直哉とはついこの間出会ったばかりです。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Shizuku only just met Naoya a short while ago.

strings.text: ただ、それは雫としてです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: But that is only as far as 'Shizuku' is concerned."

strings.text: 「でも私は、私自身は、一生かけても返しきれない恩を草薙の人たちに感じています。だから……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But I -- I myself -- feel toward the people of the Kusanagi household a debt that I could not repay in a lifetime. So..."

strings.text: 「もう、危ない事はしないでください……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Please, no more dangerous things..."

strings.text: 「そんな危ない事はしてないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not doing anything so dangerous."

strings.text: 「詐欺罪」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Fraud."

strings.text: 「ギクッ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Urk."

strings.text: 「あれは危ない事ではないですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Isn't that a dangerous thing?"

strings.text: 「さぁ……俺には縁のない事なので、良く分からんなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well... it's not really something that concerns me, so I wouldn't know."

strings.text: 「本当に、草薙の人たちはそんなのばかりです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Truly, the people of the Kusanagi household are all like that."

strings.text: 「とりあえず今言える事は、その雑誌にある私の写真を熟読してくださいましてありがとうございます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "For the moment, what I can say is: thank you for so intently perusing my photographs in that magazine."

strings.text: 「え？　じゅ、熟読って……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? P-perusing...?"

strings.text: 「私のページをかれこれ１０分以上見ていた」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You spent over ten minutes looking at my pages."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな時からお前はいたのか！？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Y-you've been here since then!?"

strings.text: 「はい、本当は茶の間を横切って麦茶を飲みたかった……、けど直哉が事をなす邪魔になるかと……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes. Truthfully, I wanted to cross through the sitting room to have some barley tea... but I thought I might interrupt Naoya in the middle of his deed..."

strings.text: 「事をなすって何だよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What deed!"

strings.text: 「オナニーとかでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Masturbation, perhaps?"

strings.text: 「しねぇよ！
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I won't!

strings.text: というか、人の家の茶の間でそんな事するやついないだろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Anyway, no one does that sort of thing in someone else's sitting room!"

strings.text: 「なるほど、ならば自室ならばしたと？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I see. Then, in your own room, you would have?"

strings.text: 「しない！　そんな事しない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I wouldn't! I don't do that sort of thing!"

strings.text: 「自室ならしても良いと思いますし、直哉は若い殿方。思いっきり発散すると良いでしょう」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "In your own room I think it would be fine, and Naoya is a young man. It would be good to release yourself thoroughly."

strings.text: そう言って、俺が読んでいた雑誌を指さす。
strings.translated: So saying, she points at the magazine I had been reading.
