strings.translated: "Caught on?"

strings.text: 「ごめんなさい、独り言。『つきのうさぎ』って名前も、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sorry, just talking to myself. Both the name 'The Moon Rabbit'

strings.text: 兎子っていう名前も、全部マスターが名づけ親ってわけ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: and the name Usagiko -- the Master's the one who came up with them."

strings.text: 「あなた、『つきのうさぎ』のサイトの前書き、知ってる？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Do you know the foreword on 'The Moon Rabbit' site?"

strings.text: 「ああ、よく覚えている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I remember it well."

strings.text: 「そう。あれもね、あんな名前だと可愛くて恥ずかしいから、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. That was because that name was too cute and embarrassing on its own,

strings.text: なんか取り繕えるようにって、意味をつけたのよ……まあ、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: so I gave it a meaning to sort of dress it up... well,

strings.text: 適当に付けたわけじゃないけどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: I didn't just slap something on carelessly, though."

strings.text: 「昨日の梱包作業は、もしかしてキマイラで販売してる器じゃなくて……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So yesterday's packing work -- was that maybe not the pieces sold at Chimera, but..."

strings.text: 「ええ、私の器よ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yes, they were mine.

strings.text: マスターが送ってくる器の数は少ないし、店頭販売だけ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: The number of pieces the master sends is small; those are only sold in the shop."

strings.text: 「そういえば、梱包材に包まれて中身の器は見えなかったし、
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Now that you mention it, they were all wrapped up in packing material so I couldn't see the pieces inside,

strings.text: 伝票作業は下でやっていたな……つまり、見せてもらえなかったわけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: and you did the paperwork downstairs... in other words, you made sure I couldn't see them."

strings.text: 「そうよ。誤魔化して悪かったわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. Sorry for tricking you."

strings.text: 「いや、そんなことは別に良い」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that's fine."

strings.text: 側にあった椅子に座ると、長い息を吐き出す。
strings.translated: I sank into a chair beside me and let out a long breath.

strings.text: 衝撃的ではあった。
strings.translated: It had been a shock, no question.

strings.text: 「そうか、お前が兎子さんか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see, so you're Usagiko-san..."

strings.text: 「ん、まあね……なんか悪かったわね。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Mm, well, yeah... Sorry about that.

strings.text: 夢を壊すようなことになっちゃって……あいつが間違えるから……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Ending up shattering your dreams like this... it's that guy's fault for slipping up..."

strings.text: 「あいつ、って、あの荷物の送り主か。マスターじゃないのか？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That guy -- you mean the one who sent the package? Not the master?

strings.text: いや、鳥谷姓じゃなかったな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Come to think of it, the last name wasn't Toritani."

strings.text: 「ええ、なんて言えばいいのかしら、古美術商？　なんか趣味の会とかも
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yeah, how do I put it... an antiques dealer? He runs some kind of hobbyist circle too,

strings.text: やってて、私の作品を目録に入れたから見て欲しいって、連絡があってね。……本名で送れって言ったのに、あんにゃろう……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: and he called saying he wanted me to look because he'd put my work in the catalogue. ...I told him to send it under my real name, that jerk..."

strings.text: 「古美術商が？　お前の器を？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "An antiques dealer? Handling your pottery?"

strings.text: 確かに『つきのうさぎ』の器は素晴らしいものだが、
strings.translated: True, 'The Moon Rabbit's pieces are wonderful,

strings.text: それはあくまでも生活の器としてだ。
strings.translated: but only as vessels for daily use.

strings.text: 古美術商が出てくるような種類のものではないと思うが……。
strings.translated: Not the kind of thing an antiques dealer would come sniffing around for, I would have thought...

strings.text: 「ん、まあね、色々あるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Mm, well, there's a lot going on."

strings.text: 「そうか、色々か」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. A lot going on."

strings.text: 「ええ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「……そうか、まあ、色々と了解した」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Right, well, I've grasped that there's a lot going on."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、落ち着いたみたいね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Looks like you've calmed down, at least."

strings.text: 「まあな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "More or less."

strings.text: 「……卒業したら、陶芸作家としてやっていくのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...After you graduate, are you going to make a go of it as a ceramic artist?"

strings.text: 「まさか。さっきも言ったでしょ？　生活費を稼ぐのが一番の目的だって。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "As if. I already told you, didn't I? The main point is earning living expenses.

strings.text: あと、今は陶芸が面白いからやってるだけ、それだけよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Beyond that, I'm just doing pottery because I find it interesting right now, that's all."

strings.text: 「勿体ない……こんなにいいものを持ってるのに」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What a waste... when you have this much talent."

strings.text: 鳥谷が軽く腕を組むと、ふいっと視線をそらす。
strings.translated: Toritani folded her arms lightly and looked away.

strings.text: 「あなたには言われたくないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's not something I want to hear from you, of all people."

strings.text: それには聞こえないふりをした。
strings.translated: I pretended I hadn't heard that.

strings.text: 真琴
strings.translated: Makoto

strings.text: 「いらっしゃいませ……って、早かったのね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Welcome-- oh, you're early."

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「ああ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 昨日、衝撃の事実発覚ですっかり忘れて受け取り損なった器を、
strings.translated: Yesterday's shocking revelation had driven it clean out of my head, and I'd left without the piece she'd set aside for me,

strings.text: 取りに来たのだった。
strings.translated: so now I'd come to pick it up.

strings.text: 「どうせこれから自習でしょ。何ならあとで、家まで届けるけど？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You're heading straight to self-study now, aren't you? If you want, I can drop it off at your place later."

strings.text: 「まさか。忙しいお前にそんな手間を取らせるわけにはいかないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As if. I'm not about to make busy you go to that trouble."

strings.text: 「ん、そうね、なら……はい」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hm, true enough. Then... here."

strings.text: 箱に入った器を鳥谷から受け取る。
strings.translated: I took the boxed piece from Toritani.

strings.text: 当分、無駄使いはできないが、それに見合うだけの満足がある。
strings.translated: I wouldn't be able to spend freely for a while, but the satisfaction was worth it.

strings.text: 「満足そうな顔しちゃって……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Look at that smug face..."

strings.text: 「手に入ると思ってなかったシリーズだからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's from a series I never thought I'd get my hands on."

strings.text: 「あなた、このまま補習に向かうわけ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So, you're going straight to make-up class from here?"

strings.text: 「いや、一旦家に戻って、器を置いてから向かうつもりだが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I'm going to swing home first, drop this off, then head over."

strings.text: 鳥谷がちらりと、時計を見る。
strings.translated: Toritani glanced at the clock.

strings.text: 「それでもまだ時間はあるわね。ちょっと試食につきあいなさいよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then you've still got a little time. Stay and be a taste-tester for a bit."

strings.text: 「なんだ？　甘いものか？　飯か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For what? Something sweet? A meal?"

strings.text: 「甘い方よ。ていうか……、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The sweet side. Though honestly...

strings.text: 見た目によらず意外に甘いもの好きよね、草薙って」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: you don't look it, but you have a real sweet tooth, don't you, Kusanagi?"

strings.text: 「ああ、まあな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, well.

strings.text: 将来はビールを飲みながらチョコレートケーキを食うような気がする」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I can see myself in the future, drinking beer with chocolate cake on the side."

strings.text: 「酒のあてがチョコケーキ？　ある意味かまわないやつねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Chocolate cake as a beer chaser? In a way, that's a pretty easy-going palate..."

strings.text: 「好きなものと好きなものを組み合わせて何が悪い。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's wrong with combining two things I love?

strings.text: で？　その試食品とやらは、どこにあるんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: So? Where is this so-called sample?"

strings.text: 「ああ、ちょっと待ってて。すぐに持って来るわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ah, hold on a sec. I'll bring it right out."

strings.text: 厨房へと消える鳥谷を見送って、手近な椅子に座る。
strings.translated: I saw Toritani off into the kitchen and took the nearest chair.

strings.text: 今日も常連客ばかりの、静かな店内であった。
strings.translated: As always, only regulars filled the quiet shop today.

strings.text: 「はい、これよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Here you go."

strings.text: コーヒーと、鳥の形をした砂糖のようなものが置かれる。
strings.translated: Coffee, and something that looked like sugar shaped into a bird, were set before me.

strings.text: 「これは？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's this?"

strings.text: 「<r らくがん>落雁</r>よ。稀少糖が手に入ったから、自分で作ってみたの」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's rakugan. I got hold of some rare sugar, so I tried making it myself."

strings.text: 「落雁って、あの砂糖と粉をかためたやつか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rakugan? That stuff made from sugar and powder pressed together?"

strings.text: 「ええ、お盆の時に仏前に供えたりするのを目にすることが多いけど、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. You usually see it as an offering at family altars during Obon,

strings.text: 今は、新しいタイプの落雁も出ててね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: but these days there are new kinds of rakugan too."

strings.text: 「味も、ココア味だったりチャイ味だったり、ラムネ味だったり……
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The flavors range from cocoa to chai to ramune...

strings.text: 形も、ペンギンとかハートとか可愛いのが多いのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: and the shapes -- penguins, hearts, all sorts of cute things."

strings.text: 「そんなもんがあるのか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That kind of thing exists?"

strings.text: 「ええ。稀少糖に少量の蜜だけで作ったから、正確には落雁じゃないのだけど、でも、和三盆とも違う稀少糖みたいだから、便宜的にそう呼んでる」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Mm. I made these with just rare sugar and a little honey, so strictly speaking they aren't rakugan, but the sugar isn't wasanbon either -- it's some kind of rare sugar -- so I'm calling it rakugan for convenience."

strings.text: 「随分と曖昧だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's pretty vague."

strings.text: 「マスターからのやつでね、稀少糖を送るとしか書いてないから、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's from the Master. All she wrote was that she was sending rare sugar,

strings.text: どこで手に入れたものかもわからないのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: so I don't even know where it came from."

strings.text: 「ま、砂糖菓子でもいいんだけど。ちなみに型は、自分で掘ってみたわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, calling it sugar candy would work too. Oh, and I carved the mold myself."

strings.text: 「彫刻刀でか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "With a wood-carving knife?"

strings.text: 「ええ、そうだけど？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yes. Why?"

strings.text: 「多才だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're a woman of many talents."

strings.text: 「あなたに言われてもねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's rich, coming from you."

strings.text: 小皿の中央には、親指の第一関節くらいの大きさの砂糖菓子が、
strings.translated: In the center of the small plate sat a single sugar sweet, about the size

strings.text: ひとつ置かれている。形は鳥だ。
strings.translated: of the first joint of my thumb. It was shaped like a bird.

strings.text: 真っ白に輝くその砂糖菓子を、つまんでみる。
strings.translated: I picked up the brilliantly white sugar sweet.

strings.text: 「これ、鷺か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is this a heron?"

strings.text: 「そうよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right."

strings.text: 「鶴や雁です。さぎも白鳥もです。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Cranes and wild geese. Herons and swans too."

strings.text: 「『鳥を捕る人』か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'The Bird-Catcher'?"

strings.text: 「そう。何度も読んだことがあるわけじゃないけど、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's right. I haven't read it that many times, but

strings.text: あのシーンがとても印象に残っていて、一度作ってみたかったのよね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: that scene left such an impression on me that I wanted to try making it."

strings.text: 「この鷺の砂糖菓子を作るために何度も読み返して、覚えてしまったわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I read it over and over just to make these heron sweets. Ended up memorizing it."

strings.text: 「そいつはな、雑作ない。さぎというものは、みんな天の川の砂が<r こご>凝</r>って、ぼおっとできるもんですからね、そして始終川へ帰りますからね、」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, that's easy enough. See, herons are all made from the sands of the Milky Way, that come drifting together kind of hazy-like, and they always go back to the river,"

strings.text: 「川原で待っていて、鷺がみんな、脚をこういう風にして下りてくるとこを、そいつが地べたへつくかつかないうちに、ぴたっと押えちまうんです。するともう鷺は、かたまって安心して死んじまいます。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "so I wait on the riverbank, and when the herons come coasting down, feet spread out like this, before their feet even touch the ground, I clap them tight. Then the herons stiffen up, all peaceful-like, and die."

strings.text: 「あとはもう、わかり切ってまさあ。押し葉にするだけです。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "After that, it's simple. You just press them flat, like dried leaves."

strings.text: 「鷺を押し葉にするんですか。標本ですか。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You press herons like dried leaves? For specimens?"

strings.text: 「標本じゃありません。みんなたべるじゃありませんか。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Not specimens. Folks eat them, don't they."

strings.text: 「「おかしいねえ。」カムパネルラが首をかしげました。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'Odd, isn't it,' Campanella said, tilting his head."

strings.text: 「「おかしいも不審もありませんや。そら。」その男は立って、網棚から包みをおろして、手ばやくくるくると解きました。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'Nothing odd or strange about it. Look here.' The man stood up, took down a bundle from the rack, and quickly unwrapped it."

strings.text: 「さあ、ごらんなさい。いまとって来たばかりです。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Now then, take a look. I just brought these in."

strings.text: 「「ほんとうに鷺だねえ。」二人は思わず叫びました。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'They really are herons!' the two of them cried out."

strings.text: 「まっ白な、あのさっきの北の十字架のように光る鷺のからだが、十ばかり、少しひらべったくなって、黒い脚をちぢめて、浮彫のようにならんでいたのです。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "About ten pure-white heron bodies, glowing like the Northern Cross from before, lay slightly flattened, black legs tucked up, arranged like a bas-relief."

strings.text: 「「眼をつぶってるね。」カムパネルラは、指でそっと、鷺の三日月がたの白い瞑った眼にさわりました。頭の上の鎗のような白い毛もちゃんとついていました。」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'Their eyes are closed,' Campanella said, gently touching the herons' white, crescent-shaped shut eyes with a finger. Even the spear-like white plumes on their heads were still in place."

strings.text: 指でつまんだ小さな白鷺の砂糖菓子は、かすかにキラキラと輝いて、
strings.translated: The tiny white heron sweet pinched between my fingers glinted faintly,

strings.text: 三日月型の白い瞑った眼も、頭の上の鎗のような白い毛も再現されていた。
strings.translated: its crescent-shaped shut eyes and spear-like white head plumes all faithfully reproduced.

strings.text: 口に入れると、雪が溶けるようにすっと舌の上で消える。
strings.translated: When I placed it in my mouth, it vanished on my tongue like melting snow.

strings.text: 普段口にしてる砂糖とはまるで違う、透き徹るような甘さだった。
strings.translated: Its sweetness was translucent, nothing like the sugar I was used to.

strings.text: 「コーヒーに入れても美味しいかと思って」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I thought it might be nice added to coffee."

strings.text: 「コーヒーにクッキーやチョコレートを添えるみたいに、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Like how you'd serve cookies or chocolate with coffee,

strings.text: しばらくこれをおまけにするつもり」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: I'm planning to offer these as a little extra for a while."

strings.text: 「この稀少糖もそうだけど、マスターは、黒も好きだけど白も好きだから、こうやって色んな白いものを送ってくるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "This rare sugar's the same way -- the Master likes black, but she likes white too, so she keeps sending me all kinds of white things."

strings.text: 「だから、私も、自然と釉薬に白を使う機会が多くなっていった」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So naturally I've ended up using white in my glazes more and more."

strings.text: 「『兎子ホワイト』とか言われても、それはマスターが送ってきた砂や石から生まれた釉薬なのだから、私がしてることなんて微々たるものよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "People call it 'Usagiko White' or whatever, but the glaze comes from the sand and stone the Master sends me, so what I actually do is next to nothing."

strings.text: 「だが、実際作ってるのはお前だ。お前がいなければ、
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But you're the one who actually makes it. Without you,

strings.text: マスターが送ってくるものだって、単なる砂や石のままだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: what Master sends would just stay sand and stone."

strings.text: 「そうね。それは認めるわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "True. I'll grant you that."

strings.text: 「……二度と手に入らない。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "...It'll never come around again.

strings.text: 二度と送られてこない稀少糖で作った砂糖菓子、まさに一期一会だわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Sugar sweets made from rare sugar that'll never be sent again -- truly a once-in-a-lifetime thing."

strings.text: 「こんな風に、二度と手にはいらない石や砂も多くてね……
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There are plenty of stones and sands like this, ones I'll never get my hands on again...

strings.text: それだと、一点物ならいいけど、私の商品としてはうまくない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Which is fine for a one-off piece, but not so great for something I'd sell as a product."

strings.text: 「石や砂……釉薬の原材料か」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Stone and sand... the raw materials for glaze?"

strings.text: 「その二度と手に入らない原材料の中でも、特に忘れられない砂がある」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Among those irreplaceable materials, there's one sand I can't forget."

strings.text: 「鷺が桔梗色の空から雪のように降ってくる天の川の河原……
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "A riverbank of the Milky Way where herons fall like snow from a bellflower-colored sky...

strings.text: マスターは、一度、それと同じような場所に行ったことがあるのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Master once visited a place just like that."

strings.text: 「天の川の砂の上に降りる鷺たち、触れれば融けていく白い鳥たち、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The herons descending onto the sand of the Milky Way, white birds that melt at a touch,

strings.text: 夜にうっすらと白く輝く河原の砂……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: and the riverbank sand faintly glowing white in the night..."

strings.text: 「現物が送られてきたから、そんな土地が無いとは言わないけど……
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Since the real thing was sent to me, I can't say no such land exists...

strings.text: けれど、二度と手に入らない、どんな場所かもわからない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: but I'll never get any more of it, and I don't even know what sort of place it is."

strings.text: 「本人が何度も行こうとしたけど、二度と行けない。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "She tried many times to go back, but she can never reach it again.

strings.text: 自分で書いたヒントも役に立たないのだから、どうしようもないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Even the hints she wrote herself are no use, so there's nothing to be done."

strings.text: 「あー……方向音痴だと言ってたな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah... you did say she has no sense of direction."

strings.text: 「草薙もだけど、マスターも相当なものよ。
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You're bad too, Kusanagi, but the Master is really something else.

strings.text: 自分が通っている学園に行こうとして迷うことも多かったんだから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: She often got lost just trying to get to the school she attended."

strings.text: 「よく各地を放浪して無事でいるな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's a wonder she wanders all over and still stays in one piece..."

strings.text: 「目指す農園に向かって、全然違うところのコーヒーを買い付けてくるのが基本だから。日本だけじゃ飽き足らず、世界をうろついているし……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Basically, she sets out for one coffee farm and ends up buying beans from somewhere completely different. And Japan alone isn't enough for her, so she roams the world..."

strings.text: 「それでよくキマイラに戻れるな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's a wonder she manages to get back to Chimera at all."

strings.text: 「帰ろうと思ってないときに、帰り着いているみたいよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Apparently she finds her way home when she isn't even trying to."

strings.text: 「あ、そうだ。飴も作ったんだけど、食べる？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh, right. I made some hard candy too. Want some?"

strings.text: 鳥谷が、カゴに入った飴を見せる。
strings.translated: Toritani showed me a basket full of candy.

strings.text: 透明な包み紙にくるまっているのは、薄黄色のボタンのような飴だった。
strings.translated: Wrapped in transparent paper, they were pale yellow, button-shaped drops.

strings.text: 「べっこう飴か」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Bekkou-ame?"

strings.text: 「そう。これも型から自分で作ってみたのよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Right. I made these molds myself too."

strings.text: 「はあ！？　板金だろ？？？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What?! That's sheet-metal work, isn't it???"

strings.text: 「お前、多才だなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You really are a woman of many talents..."

strings.text: 「だから、草薙に言われたくないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Like I said, coming from you, that means nothing."

strings.text: 「弓張学園には施設が整っているし、材料と道具があれば、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yumihari Academy has such well-equipped facilities. With the materials and tools,

strings.text: ある程度なんでもできるでしょ。それこそ草薙だって、そうじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: you can pull off just about anything. It's the same for you, isn't it, Kusanagi?"

strings.text: 「まあな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "More or less."

strings.text: 「しかし、お前なんでこんなにいっぱいお菓子を作ってるんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But why are you making so many sweets?"

strings.text: 「ああ、子どもに配るためのお菓子を、頼まれてね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Ah, someone asked me to make sweets to hand out to children."

strings.text: 「べっこう飴って、砂糖と水だけだから、すごいコスパがいいのよね……
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Bekkou-ame is just sugar and water, so the cost performance is incredible...

strings.text: クッキーやケーキとは段違いだわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: Miles better than cookies or cake."

strings.text: 「これが、飴じゃなくてキャラメルとなるとね、
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "If you were going for caramel instead of hard candy,

strings.text: 生クリームも使うし、すごく高くついちゃうんだけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: you'd need cream too, and the cost shoots way up."

strings.text: 「頼まれて？　バザーか何かか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Asked you to? Like for a bazaar or something?"

strings.text: 「まあ、そんなとこよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Something like that, yeah."

strings.text: 「そうか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see."

strings.text: ただの砂糖と水から出来ていても、べっこう飴は美味かった。
strings.translated: Even made from nothing but sugar and water, the bekkou-ame was delicious.

strings.text: ひとつ口に入れて、いくつかポケットに入れた。
strings.translated: I put one in my mouth and slipped a few more into my pocket.

strings.text: 「この暑さじゃ溶けちゃうわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "They'll melt in this heat, you know."

strings.text: 「そのときは、そのときだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If they do, they do."

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 玄関ロビーに向かう途中で立ち止まる。
strings.translated: I stopped on my way to the entrance lobby.

strings.text: あの子……さっきもあそこにいたか。
strings.translated: That child... she was there earlier too, wasn't she.

strings.text: 年齢は、五、六歳と言ったところか。
strings.translated: Five or six years old, I'd guess.

strings.text: とてもそうとは思えない落ち着きがある。
strings.translated: She had a composure that didn't seem to fit that age.

strings.text: この前、日曜学校の子どもを見たからなおさらだ。
strings.translated: All the more so after seeing those Sunday school kids the other day.

strings.text: きちんと足を揃えて座っている。
strings.translated: She sat with her feet neatly together.

strings.text: すぐ脇には、松葉杖が立てかけてある。
strings.translated: A pair of crutches leaned against the seat beside her.

strings.text: 幼い容貌に似合わないまなざしを前方に向けて、
strings.translated: With eyes that didn't match her childish features, she stared straight ahead,

strings.text: 静かにただ座っている。
strings.translated: simply sitting there in silence.

strings.text: そのまなざしの先には何もない。
strings.translated: There was nothing at the end of that gaze.

strings.text: ただの壁だ。
strings.translated: Just a wall.

strings.text: ゆっくりとポケットに手を入れると、さりげなく歩いていって、
strings.translated: Slipping my hands slowly into my pockets, I walked over as if by chance

strings.text: 背もたれのないベンチソファーに座る。
strings.translated: and sat down on the backless bench-sofa.

strings.text: 子どもは右端に、俺は左端に。
strings.translated: The child on the right end, me on the left.

strings.text: ポケットの中で、かさりと何かが指に触れる。
strings.translated: Inside my pocket, my finger brushed against something with a rustle.

strings.text: 昨日、鳥谷からもらったべっこう飴だった。
strings.translated: It was the tortoiseshell candy Toritani gave me yesterday.

strings.text: 「そろそろ、面会時間は終了だぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Visiting hours will be over soon, you know."

strings.text: 子どもがちらりとこちらを見て、
strings.translated: The child glanced my way for a moment,

strings.text: すぐにまた前を向いた。
strings.translated: then immediately turned her eyes forward again.

strings.text: 「ありがとうございます。大丈夫です」
strings.translated: "Thank you. I'm all right."

strings.text: 静かで平坦な声が、子どもの口から零れおちる。
strings.translated: A quiet, level voice spilled from the child's lips.

strings.text: 大人びた台詞だった。
strings.translated: It was a grown-up sort of line.

strings.text: 拒絶にも聞こえた。
strings.translated: It sounded like rejection, too.

strings.text: ポケットの中の飴が、かさかさと指に触れる。
strings.translated: The candy in my pocket rustled against my finger.

strings.text: 「ここのリハビリテーション科には、
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The rehabilitation department here

strings.text: けっこう良いスタッフさんがいるよな。前園さん、まだいるか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: has some pretty good staff, doesn't it? Is Maezono-san still around?"

strings.text: 子どもが、こちらを向いた。
strings.translated: The child turned toward me.

strings.text: 向けられるまなざしは、無音に似ていた。
strings.translated: The gaze she directed at me was something akin to silence.

strings.text: 「まえぞのさん、います」
strings.translated: "Maezono-san is here."

strings.text: 大きくもなく、小さくもない。
strings.translated: Not loud, not soft.

strings.text: やや平坦だが、感情がこもってないわけでもない。
strings.translated: A little flat, but not without feeling either.

strings.text: そんな声だった。
strings.translated: That was the kind of voice it was.

strings.text: 「そうか。俺も少しだけ世話になった。口うるさいが熱心で良い人だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. She looked after me a bit too. Nagging, but earnest -- a good person."

strings.text: 「迎えを待ってるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Are you waiting for someone to pick you up?"

strings.text: 「はい」
strings.translated: "Yes."

strings.text: 「そうか、早く来るといいな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. Hope they come soon."

strings.text: ふるふると首を横にふる。
strings.translated: She shook her head lightly from side to side.

strings.text: 静かな声が、ちいさな口からまた零れ落ちる。
strings.translated: That quiet voice spilled once more from her small mouth.

strings.text: 「いつ来るかは、わかりません」
strings.translated: "I don't know when they'll come."

strings.text: 「忙しいのか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Are they busy?"

strings.text: 「そうか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see."

strings.text: 「ところで……今、俺のポケットの中にあるのは、何だと思う？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "By the way... what do you think is in my pocket right now?"

strings.text: 突然の問いかけについていけないのか、子どもが首を傾げる。
strings.translated: Unable to keep up with the sudden question, the child tilted her head.

strings.text: 俺はかまわずにつづける。
strings.translated: I kept going regardless.

strings.text:
「いいものかもしれない。悪いものかもしれない。小銭かもしれない。
飴かもしれない。ボタンかもしれない。月かもしれない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Could be something good. Could be something bad. Could be some spare change.
Could be candy. Could be a button. Could be the moon."

strings.text: 「おかしなことを、言うのですね」
strings.translated: "You say strange things, don't you."

strings.text: 「まあ、それは認める。で、何が入っていると、思う？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I'll grant you that. So -- what do you think is in there?"

strings.text:
子どもがすこしだけ考える。
おずおずとした感情が、その瞳に宿る。
strings.translated:
The child thought for a moment.
A timid emotion settled in her eyes.
"...Candy."

strings.text: 「正解だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Correct."

strings.text: ポケットの中からべっこう飴を全て取りだして、子どもに渡す。
strings.translated: I took all the tortoiseshell candy out of my pocket and handed it to her.

strings.text: 「これは、今日の分だ。残りは、明日の分だ。明日一日やり遂げたら舐めるんじゃなくて、一回だけやり遂げたら、舐めてみろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This much is for today. The rest is for tomorrow. Don't wait until you've gotten through the whole day tomorrow -- try one every time you get through one thing."

strings.text: 「報酬はこまめにすぐにもらった方が、効率がいいんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rewards work better when you get them often and right away."

strings.text: 「いいんですか」
strings.translated: "Are you sure?"

strings.text: 「ああ、俺の問いかけに正解したから、それはお前の……あー……ええと、名前はなんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. You got my question right, so that's your... uh... hey, what's your name?"

strings.text: 寧
strings.translated: Nei

strings.text: 「俺は直哉だ。寧、その飴はお前の正当な報酬だから受け取っておけ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm Naoya. Nei, that candy is your rightful reward, so take it.

strings.text: 明日の分とか言ったが、食べたければ全部、今、食べてもいい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I said some was for tomorrow, but if you want to eat it all right now, you can."

strings.text: 幼い少女がじっと俺を見つめる。
strings.translated: The little girl stared fixedly at me.

strings.text: 何か迷って、それから、こくりとうなずいた。
strings.translated: She hesitated over something, then gave a small nod.

strings.text: 「ありがとうございます」
strings.speaker: 寧
strings.translated: "Thank you very much."

strings.text: 「ああ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 透明な包み紙をひらいて、幼い少女が飴を口に含む。
strings.translated: She unwrapped the transparent wrapper and slipped the candy into her mouth.

strings.text: ちいさな唇の端に、ほろりとちいさな幸福が滲んだ。
strings.translated: At the corner of her small lips, a tiny happiness quietly bloomed.

strings.text: 俺は安心する。
strings.translated: I felt relieved.

strings.text: この子はとてもしっかりしているが、それでも普通の子だ。
strings.translated: This child was remarkably composed, but she was still an ordinary kid.

strings.text: 俺は一人道路でみんなを見送った後に、玄関の戸を開ける。
strings.translated: After seeing everyone off from the road, I opened the front door.

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 思った通り、戸のすぐ前に雫が立っていた。
strings.translated: Just as I'd thought, Shizuku was standing right on the other side of it.

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「気になって見ていたか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Curious enough to watch?"

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "N-Not really..."

strings.text: 「そ、それでは……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "W-Well then..."

strings.text: 「今度、あいつらが来たら話しかければいいさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Next time those guys come over, you should try talking to them."

strings.text: 「この街にいれば稟と会う機会は多いだろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As long as you're in this town, you'll have plenty of chances to see Rin..."

strings.text: 「稟は基本的には変わらないぞ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin hasn't really changed, you know.

strings.text: 相変わらず優しくて、明るくて、そして元気だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: She's still kind, still cheerful, still full of energy."

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "...Yeah."

strings.text: 小さく頷くと、彼女はすぐに自分の部屋に帰ってしまった。
strings.translated: With a small nod, she quickly retreated back to her room.

strings.text: 「なるほどね……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 雫のあの反応。
strings.translated: That reaction of Shizuku's.

strings.text: あれに近いものを俺は知っている。
strings.translated: I knew something close to it.

strings.text: それは、俺が稟と最初に会った時のものだ。
strings.translated: It was how I'd been the first time I met Rin.

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎が引き合わせた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Ken'ichirou brought us together..."

strings.text: あの時、俺が見た不思議な力が何であるか……。
strings.translated: What that strange power I saw back then really was...

strings.text: 俺はずっと考えていた。
strings.translated: I'd been thinking about it for a long time.

strings.text: 絵を捨てたあの日から、いろいろな事を考えていた。
strings.translated: Ever since the day I threw away painting, I'd been mulling over all sorts of things.

strings.text: 何故ならば、俺はあの時、たしかに片側では当事者であったが、
strings.translated: Because at that time, while on one side I was certainly a party to it all,

strings.text: もう片側では完全な部外者であったから。
strings.translated: on the other side I was a complete outsider.

strings.text: 俺はすべてを知っていたわけではない。
strings.translated: It wasn't as though I knew everything.

strings.text: その両方を知っていたのは、たぶん草薙健一郎だけだったのだろう。
strings.translated: The only person who knew both sides was probably Kusanagi Ken'ichirou himself.

strings.text: 「あいつは、本当に何でも首を突っ込むバカだったからな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That guy was an idiot who really would stick his nose into anything..."

strings.text: 「夏目の婆さんといい、健一郎といい……。血筋なんだろうな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Between old lady Natsume and Ken'ichirou... it must run in the blood."

strings.text: それぞれ財を成しているのに、金目の物はまったく一族に遺産としてまわってこない。
strings.translated: Each of them amassed a fortune in their lifetime, yet not a single thing of value was ever passed down to the family.

strings.text: おかげで俺は相変わらずの貧乏暮らしだ。
strings.translated: Thanks to that, I'm still stuck living in poverty.

strings.text: いやいや、
strings.translated: No, well,

strings.text: 一応は遺産相続を放棄したのは俺だ。
strings.translated: I'm the one who renounced my inheritance in the first place.

strings.text: 誰かのためじゃない。
strings.translated: Not for anyone else's sake.

strings.text: 俺がバカだったから放棄した。
strings.translated: I gave it up because I was a fool.

strings.text: 「さてと、風呂入って寝るか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well then, guess I'll take a bath and go to bed."

strings.text: ただ……。
strings.translated: It's just...

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「夏になってから、あいつ相当忙しそうなんだよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ever since summer started, she's been pretty busy."

strings.text: 受験勉強もやっている様だが、部活関連の仕事も多い。
strings.translated: She seems to be studying for entrance exams too, but she has a lot of club-related work as well.

strings.text: 今、誰よりも働いているのは鳥谷ではないだろうか……。
strings.translated: Right now, isn't Toritani working harder than anyone?

strings.text: 「合宿なんて、また手間のかかる事を計画してるしな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Planning a training camp on top of everything -- another troublesome undertaking."

strings.text: 次に明石。
strings.translated: Next, Akashi.

strings.text: これは論外。
strings.translated: Out of the question.

strings.text: 氷川はそれなりに有力な候補としてあげられる。
strings.translated: Hikawa could be considered a fairly strong candidate.

strings.text: ヤツも弓張に長く住んでいる。土地勘もあるだろう。
strings.translated: She's lived in Yumihari a long time. She should know the area.

strings.text: 鳥谷同様、それなりに察しが良く、頭も回る。
strings.translated: Like Toritani, she's fairly perceptive and quick-witted.

strings.text: 「氷川も悪くはないのだが……うむむ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hikawa wouldn't be bad either, but... hmm."

strings.text: 「氷川を呼び出した事が、川内野にバレると何か怒られそうで怖いしなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If Kawachino finds out I called Hikawa out, she'd probably be mad, and that's scary too..."

strings.text: 「鳥谷、氷川……、あともう一人は……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Toritani, Hikawa... and one more..."

strings.text: 稟である。
strings.translated: Rin.

strings.text: 彼女は、この土地に戻って間もないのだが、弓張に思い入れも深そうだ。
strings.translated: She hasn't been back in this town long, but she seems to have strong feelings about Yumihari.

strings.text: もっといえば、勉強でもそうだったが、一番懇切丁寧に教えてくれそう。
strings.translated: Besides, judging from our study sessions, she'd be the most patient and thorough at explaining the way.

strings.text: 「とは言っても、そもそも稟にそれほどの土地勘があったかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That said, does Rin even know her way around here that well...?"

strings.text: どうしたもんか……。
strings.translated: What to do...

strings.text: いざ連絡しようとなると、それはそれで悩むものだ。
strings.translated: Now that I actually had to contact someone, it turned out to be its own headache.

strings.text: 「さ、さらに分からなくなってきた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I'm getting even more confused..."

strings.text: それから数十分ほど悩みながら歩いていたら、さらに見慣れない風景になっている。なんか知らんが、山が近くなってきている様な気がするし……。
strings.translated: I kept walking for another few dozen minutes as I agonized over it, and the scenery grew even less familiar. I don't know why, but it feels like the mountains are getting closer...

strings.text: 「これは悩んでばかりもいられない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I can't just keep worrying about this."

strings.text: とりあえず、これ以上考えても仕方がないので、目についた電話番号にかけてみる。
strings.translated: There was no point thinking about it any longer, so I called the first phone number that caught my eye.

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「どうしましたか？　草薙くんですよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What's the matter? This is Kusanagi-kun, right?"

strings.text: 「ああ、草薙だ。草薙直哉だ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's Kusanagi. Kusanagi Naoya.

strings.text: 少し困った事になってだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I've kind of gotten myself into a mess..."

strings.text: 「困った事ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A mess?"

strings.text: 俺は事の顛末を稟に伝える。
strings.translated: I told Rin the whole story.

strings.text: 稟は笑いもせずに、驚きもせずに、ただまじめに聞いていた。
strings.translated: She didn't laugh, wasn't surprised -- she just listened seriously.

strings.text: 「なるほど……、という事はこの範囲ですね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see... in that case, it must be around this area..."

strings.text: 「この範囲？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This area?"

strings.text: 「あ、地図を広げながら草薙くんの説明を聞いてたんだよ。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, I was listening to your explanation while spreading out a map.

strings.text: 最初に歩き出した方向から、時間や土地の特徴を聞いて場所の特定が出来ないかなぁ。と思いまして」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: I thought maybe I could pin down your location from the direction you first set off in, the time, and the features of the terrain."

strings.text: 「それでですね。草薙くんが立っている位置から山が見えると思うのです？　その山陰から観覧車が見えませんか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "So then. From where you're standing, you should be able to see the mountains, right? Can you see a Ferris wheel behind those mountains?"

strings.text: 「観覧車？　ああ、そう言えば見えるな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A Ferris wheel? Ah, now that you mention it, I can."

strings.text: 「それって隣の市にある遊園地ですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's the amusement park in the next city over."

strings.text: 「なに？　弓張市から出てしまったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What? Did I leave Yumihari City?"

strings.text: 「出てないよ。たしかに桜ヶ原からは離れてるけど、まだ弓張市内だよ。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You haven't left. You're pretty far from Sakuragahara, sure, but you're still inside Yumihari City.

strings.text: その位置からだと桜ヶ原に帰るよりも、むしろ歌木町に直接向かった方が早いと思います」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: From where you are, rather than heading back to Sakuragahara, I think it'd be faster to head straight for Utagi Town."

strings.text: 「歌木町？　それって桜ヶ原から一駅分じゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Utagi Town? Isn't that one station away from Sakuragahara?"

strings.text: 「はい、そうですね。でも、草薙くんはすでにその距離以上歩いてるから、戻るのはかなり厄介だよ。歌木からそのまま小音羽の夏目くんの家まで歩いた方が良いです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, that's right. But you've already walked more than that distance, so going back would be quite a hassle. It'd be better to walk from Utagi straight to Natsume-kun's house in Kootoha."

strings.text: 「うむ、地図を読みながらの指示なのだから、稟が全面的に正しいのだろうな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, since you're giving me directions off a map, I suppose you're entirely right.

strings.text: 分かった、夏目の家を目指そう。それで、どっちの方向に向かえばいい？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Got it, I'll head for Natsume's place. So, which way should I go?"

strings.text: 「今歩いてる道をまっすぐ行ってください。そうすると繁華街に出ます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Go straight down the road you're walking on now. That'll bring you out onto the main strip."

strings.text: 「繁華街？　こんなところにそんなもんあったっけ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Main strip? Is there something like that around here?"

strings.text: 「はい、飲み屋街がありますので、そこまで歩いたら、また私に電話ください。それまでに用意するから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, there's a district with bars, so once you've walked that far, call me again. I'll have things ready by then."

strings.text: 「ああ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「用意？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ready?"

strings.text: よく分からんが、俺はとりあえず稟に言われた通りに、国道を右側に歩き出す。
strings.translated: I didn't really understand, but for now I did as Rin said and started walking with the highway on my right.

strings.text: 「はぁ、はぁ、はぁ」
strings.translated: "Ha, ha, ha..."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "R-Rin... you..."

strings.text: 「ま、間に合いましたね……はぁはぁはぁ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I made it in time... haa, haa, haa..."

strings.text: 「わざわざ来たのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You came all the way out here?"

strings.text: 「あ、でも自転車です。自転車だからすぐでしたよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, but I took my bike. Since it was by bike, it was quick."

strings.text: 笑いながら汗をぬぐう稟。
strings.translated: Rin laughed as she wiped away her sweat.

strings.text: とてもじゃないが「すぐでした」という感じには見えない……。
strings.translated: There was no way that looked like "quick"...

strings.text: 「あ、これどうぞ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, here, please take this."

strings.text: そう言うと稟は俺に手ぬぐいを渡す。
strings.translated: So saying, Rin handed me a hand towel.

strings.text: 俺はそれを受け取る。
strings.translated: I took it.

strings.text: 「冷たっ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Cold...!"

strings.text: 「草薙くんずっと歩いてたから疲れたんじゃないかと思って、氷水にくぐらせて絞ってきました。もしかして冷たすぎました？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I figured you'd be tired from walking so long, so I soaked it in ice water and wrung it out. Was it maybe too cold?"

strings.text: 「いや、ただ触った瞬間冷たくて驚いただけだ、
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I was just startled by how cold it felt the moment I touched it.

strings.text: ずっと炎天下の中を歩いてきたからすごく助かる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: I've been walking under the blazing sun this whole time, so it's a huge help."

strings.text: 「それは良かった。私も失礼して……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's good. If you'll pardon me, I'll..."

strings.text: そう言いながら稟は乾いた手ぬぐいで汗をぬぐった。
strings.translated: So saying, Rin wiped her sweat with a dry towel.

strings.text: 真夏に自転車かっ飛ばしてきたのだろう。
strings.translated: She must have sped over here on her bike in the middle of summer.

strings.text: 汗だくだ。
strings.translated: She was drenched in sweat.

strings.text: 「あはは、すみません。汗だらけで……私臭くありませんかね？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahaha, sorry. I'm all sweaty... do I smell?"

strings.text: 「んなわけあるかよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As if you would..."

strings.text: 「結構、汗かきますねぇ。なおくんこんな気温の中ずっと歩いてたら熱中症にかかってしまいますよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm sweating quite a bit, aren't I. Nao-kun, if you keep walking around in weather like this, you'll get heatstroke."

strings.text: 「そんな気温の中を、俺を待たせないために、自転車でかっ飛ばしてきたヤツの方が心配だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The one I'm worried about is the girl who sped over here by bike in this weather just so I wouldn't have to wait."

strings.text: 「そ、そんなかっ飛ばしてきたわけじゃないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I didn't really speed over that hard."

strings.text: 「そうか？　立ちこぎしてないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Oh? You weren't standing on the pedals?"

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ立ちこぎはしましたけど……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "W-Well, I was standing on the pedals, but..."

strings.text: 「だろうな。ったく女の子がスカートで立ちこぎなんてしたらパンツ見えるぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Thought so. Geez, if a girl in a skirt stands on the pedals, her panties'll show."

strings.text: 「み、見えないもん！　そんな間抜けじゃないもん！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-They will not! I'm not that clueless!"

strings.text: めずらしく稟が声を荒げる。
strings.translated: Unusually, Rin raised her voice.

strings.text: 「一応後ろ側はスカートの丈は長いし……それにめくれない様に気をつけたし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The back of the skirt is longer, and... and I was careful not to let it flip up..."

strings.text: 「冗談だ。冗談」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It was a joke. A joke."

strings.text: 「そうですか？　なんかあらためて言われたら恥ずかしくなってきました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Was it? Now that you say it outright, I'm getting embarrassed."

strings.text: 「でもパンツ見えてたわけじゃないんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But it's not like your panties were actually showing, right?"

strings.text: 「当たり前です！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Of course not!"

strings.text: 「ただ、このスカートで立ちこぎしてたのはたしかですから……、
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's just, I really was standing on the pedals in this skirt, so...

strings.text: 少しはしたないかなぁと」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: I thought maybe it was a little unladylike."

strings.text: 「戦前生まれじゃあるまいし、その程度ではしたないなんてあるかよ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not like you were born before the war -- something like that isn't unladylike at all.

strings.text: それより相当疲れただろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: More importantly, you must be exhausted, right?"

strings.text: 「いいえ、全然です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No, not at all."

strings.text: 嘘つけ。
strings.translated: Liar.

strings.text: 「それで、草薙くんは熱中症とか大丈夫だった？　気分悪いとかありませんか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "So, are you okay, Kusanagi-kun? No heatstroke or anything? You don't feel sick?"

strings.text: 「何度も言うが全然元気だ。お前と食材の方がよっぽど心配だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I've told you plenty of times, I'm perfectly fine. I'm much more worried about you and the groceries."

strings.text: 「あ、食材。そういえばスーパーの帰りですものね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, the groceries. That's right, you were on your way back from the supermarket."

strings.text: 「ああ買い物に生魚とかあるから心配だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I bought raw fish and stuff, so I'm worried."

strings.text: 「それも聞いていたので、こんなものを持ってきました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I heard about that too, so I brought these."

strings.text: 「これって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This is..."

strings.text: 「保冷剤です。夏場はかならず冷蔵庫で冷やしておいてるんですよ。いろいろと使い道がありますからね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Cold packs. In the summer I always keep them in the fridge. They come in handy for all sorts of things."

strings.text: 稟は鞄からたくさんの保冷剤を取り出す。
strings.translated: Rin pulled a whole pile of cold packs out of her bag.

strings.text: 「こんな大きな保冷剤……重かっただろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Cold packs this big... they must've been heavy, right?"

strings.text: 「たしかに大きめですが、そんな量ありませんし、それに自転車だから。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "They are on the big side, but there weren't that many, and I came by bike, so...

strings.text: あ、あとこれもどうぞ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Ah, and take this too."

strings.text: 鞄からさらに魔法瓶を取り出した。
strings.translated: She then pulled a thermos out of her bag.

strings.text: 「冷やした麦茶を入れてきたのですが。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I put chilled barley tea in it.

strings.text: でも、この炎天下の中だったら自動販売機で何か買ってのんでますよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Although, in weather this scorching, you probably already bought something from a vending machine."

strings.text: 「ふぅ……。お前は分かってないなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hah... you don't get it, do you."

strings.text: 俺は、稟から魔法瓶を受け取ると、コップに注ぎ一気に飲み干した。
strings.translated: I took the thermos from Rin, poured some into the cup, and drained it in one go.

strings.text: 「ぷはぁ……生き返る」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Pwaah...... I'm coming back to life."

strings.text: 「俺みたいな貧乏人が割高な自動販売機なんか使うわけないだろ。こういう心遣いはうれしい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's no way a poor guy like me would use an overpriced vending machine. Thoughtfulness like this really makes me happy."

strings.text: 「よかった。麦茶とか嫌いな人も多いって聞くので、もしお口に合わなかったらと思ってたんだけど」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Oh good. I hear a lot of people don't like barley tea, so I was worried it might not be to your taste."

strings.text: 「いやいや、麦茶はいいぞ。身体を冷やす効果もあるらしいしな。熱中症対策にはばっちりだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, barley tea is great. Apparently it even helps cool the body down. Perfect for preventing heatstroke."

strings.text: 「えへへ、それは良かった」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ehehe, I'm glad."

strings.text: 「お前もどうだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How about you?"

strings.text: 「え？　わ、私ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? M-Me?"

strings.text: 「ああ、熱かっただろ。水分補給しておいた方がいいぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, you must be hot too. You should hydrate."

strings.text: 「え、えっと……よ、良いでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-Um... is it okay?"

strings.text: 「当たり前だろ。あ、そうか、コップに俺が口をつけたからな。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Of course. Ah, right, I already had my mouth on the cup.

strings.text: とりあえずティッシュで良く拭い……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Let me wipe it off with a tissue first..."

strings.text: 「わー、わー」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wah -- wah --"

strings.text: 拭く前に、何故か稟にコップを奪われた。
strings.translated: Before I could wipe it, for some reason Rin snatched the cup away.

strings.text: 「別にそんな事しなくていいです！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You don't need to do that!"

strings.text: 「そうか？　でも何でそんな焦って取り上げる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No? Then why are you in such a panic to grab it?"

strings.text: 「そ、それは、ティッシュもったいないじゃないですか。わ、私は別になおくんが使ったコップでも全然問題ないし、だいたい昔は普通に一つのペットボトルを二人でのんだりしてたし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-That's because it's a waste of tissue. I-I really don't mind at all using a cup you drank from, and besides, back in the day we used to share a PET bottle all the time..."

strings.text: 「そういえばそうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Now that you mention it, that's true."

strings.text: 「そうですよ。では麦茶もらいます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It is. So, I'll have some barley tea."

strings.text: 「こくこく……ふぅ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Gulp, gulp... phew."

strings.text: 「冷えててうまいな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nicely chilled, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「どうした？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's wrong?"

strings.text: 「え？　あ、はい、冷えてておいしいです。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Ah, yes, it's chilled and delicious.

strings.text: そ、それにしても今年は暑いですねぇ。こんなに暑いとは……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: B-But still, it really is hot this year, isn't it. I didn't expect it to be this hot..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、例年にない暑さではあるが、あれじゃねーか？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, it is unusually hot for this time of year, but isn't the real reason...

strings.text: 間接キスとか考えて熱くなったとかさ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: that you were thinking about the indirect kiss and got all worked up?"

strings.text: 稟の顔がみるみる赤くなる。
strings.translated: Rin's face turned red by the second.

strings.text: 「あ、いや、ち、違っ、違います。そんなことないですよ！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, th-that's -- that's not it. It's nothing like that!"

strings.text: 「こ、子供の時に何度もやった事なんですから、今更うれしいとか恥ずかしいとかそんな事思ってませんよ。そんな事ありませんから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "W-We did this all the time when we were kids, so it's not like it makes me happy or embarrassed now or anything! Really, it's nothing like that!"

strings.text: 「もしかして思ったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Were you maybe thinking about it, though?"

strings.text: 「ち、違います……あの……」
strings.speaker: 稟

strings.text: 「すみませんお見苦しいところをお見せしました！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm sorry for showing you such an unseemly display!"

strings.text: 「いやいや、俺こそすまん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, I'm the one who should apologize."

strings.text: 「なんかつまらない冗談で興奮させて」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For getting you all worked up over a lame joke."

strings.text: 「つまらない冗談？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A lame joke?"

strings.text: 「ああ、冗談だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, a joke."

strings.text: 「つまらない冗談で、あんな事をいきなり言ったのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You said something like that out of nowhere, as a lame joke?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, pretty much."

strings.text: 「そ、それじゃ一人でわたわたしてた私がバカみたいじゃないですか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-Then that makes me look like an idiot for flustering myself all on my own."

strings.text: 「いや、そんな反応すると思わなくて、普通に受け流すと思ったからさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I didn't think you'd react like that -- I figured you'd just brush it off normally."

strings.text: 「く、草薙くんは相変わらずですね……。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-You're the same as ever, Kusanagi-kun...

strings.text: 私不機嫌になりました。ぷぃ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: I'm in a bad mood now. Hmph."

strings.text: 稟が怒ってそっぽを向いてしまった。
strings.translated: Rin got angry and turned her face away.

strings.text: こんな怒るとは思わなかったが、なんとなく懐かしいな。
strings.translated: I didn't think she'd get this mad, but somehow it felt nostalgic.

strings.text: こちらに引っ越ししてからの稟はとても行儀が良くて、たしかに社交的ではあったが、昔みたいな人なつっこさは影を潜めていた。
strings.translated: Ever since she moved over here, Rin had been so well-mannered -- sociable, sure, but that puppyish warmth she used to have had faded into the background.

strings.text: 大人びた今の稟が、こんな様にすねた姿を見せる事はほとんどない。
strings.translated: The grown-up Rin of today almost never showed this kind of sulky side.

strings.text: 「た、たしかに昔はよくやりましたけど、今するのと少し違ったんです。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "W-We really did do it a lot back then, but it's a little different from doing it now.

strings.text: 少しちがって、少し心拍数が上がったのです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: It's a little different -- my heart beat a little faster."

strings.text: 「た、ただ……それだけですから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-That's... that's all it is..."

strings.text: 稟の頬はいつもより赤みを帯びている。
strings.translated: Rin's cheeks were flushed more than usual.

strings.text: しっとりと肌が濡れ、うなじ部分が……。
strings.translated: Her skin was damp with moisture, and the nape of her neck...

strings.text: おれはどこかのおやじかよ！
strings.translated: What am I, some old man?!

strings.text: こんな目で幼なじみを見つめるなんて！
strings.translated: Staring at a childhood friend with eyes like this!

strings.text: 「な、なんですか？　そんなに私の事を見つめて……バカにしてるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wh-What is it? Staring at me like that... are you making fun of me?"

strings.text: 「いやいや、そんな事はないぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, nothing like that."

strings.text: とてもじゃないが、稟のしっとりと濡れた肌に見とれていたなんて言えない……。
strings.translated: There was no way I could tell her I'd been captivated by the damp sheen of her skin...

strings.text: 「そうですか……。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really...

strings.text: そういえば草薙くんも顔赤いですよ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Now that I look, your face is pretty red too, Kusanagi-kun..."

strings.text: 「そうか？　そりゃ熱いからだろ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is it? Well, it's hot out.

strings.text: というか夕方だし、赤く見えるだけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Besides, it's evening -- it just looks red."

strings.text: 「う……。なんかすごく簡単に流されました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ugh... you brushed that off way too easily."

strings.text: 「ああ、普通は自分に不都合な質問はこうやって軽やかにスルーするもんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's how you deflect an inconvenient question -- lightly, gracefully."

strings.text: 「という事は、今の質問はなおくんには不都合だったという事なのかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "So then, does that mean my question just now was inconvenient for you, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「うっ……えっと、そんな事より、こんな場所に繁華街あったんだなー」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ngh... u-um, more importantly, I didn't know there was a shopping district in a place like this."

strings.text: 「今度は軽やかでも何でも無くあからさまに話を逸らしましたね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That wasn't graceful in the slightest -- you blatantly changed the subject."

strings.text: 「うるさい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shut up."

strings.text: 「くすくす。ここは泪川町って言うらしいんですよ。私もはじめて来ましたが」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hehe. This is apparently called Namidagawa-cho. It's my first time here too."

strings.text: 「お前もはじめてだったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's your first time here too?"

strings.text: 「はい、家でネット地図を調べてきました。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, I looked it up on the map online at home.

strings.text: 最近は便利ですよね。その場所の写真まですぐに見られるのですから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: It's so convenient these days. You can even see pictures of the place right away."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうみたいだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, so it seems."

strings.text: 「スマートフォンだと地図案内してくれる機能があるみたいですが、私のはガラケーなので、とりあえず紙の地図を持ってきました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Smartphones have this navigation function, apparently, but mine's an old flip phone, so I brought a paper map just in case."

strings.text: 「ああ、すまないな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, sorry about that."

strings.text: 「いいえ、いいえ、それではこれから草薙くんのナビを開始します！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No, no, well then, I'll now begin Kusanagi-kun's navigation!"

strings.text: 「信号三つだから、あと百メートルぐらいで右折かな」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Three traffic lights, so it's a right turn in about a hundred meters."

strings.text: 地図も見ずに稟がつぶやいた。
strings.translated: Rin murmured without even looking at the map.

strings.text: 「本当にカーナビみたいだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You really are like a car navi."

strings.text: 「そうかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You think so?"

strings.text: 「まったく、地図見てないで良くわかるなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Honestly, how do you know without looking at the map?"

strings.text: 「私は地図見るの好きだったりするし、縮尺とかで距離とか何となく覚えちゃうってのはあるかなぁ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I happen to like looking at maps, and I guess I just sort of remember distances from the scale."

strings.text: 「地図が好き？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You like maps?"

strings.text: 「うん、古地図とか見るの好きなんだ。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, I like looking at old maps too.

strings.text: 今の地図と比べるとおもしろいよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: It's interesting to compare them with modern ones."

strings.text: 「そんなめんどくさい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That sounds like such a hassle..."

strings.text: 「めんどくさくないよ。たとえばさ、「池」とか「川」とか「沢」とか「谷」とか地名がついてる場所って、昔は本当に水辺だったりするんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's not a hassle. Like, places with names that include 'pond' or 'river' or 'marsh' or 'valley' -- a lot of them really used to be near water."

strings.text: 「そうなのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so?"

strings.text: 「うん、だから物件買うときとか避けた方がいいって言われるんだ。砂丘地帯とか三角州とか埋立地、あと河川・水田・池とか、あんまり地盤が固くない場所だったんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, so they say you should avoid them when buying property. Dune areas, deltas, reclaimed land, and rivers, paddies, ponds -- places where the ground isn't very solid."

strings.text: 「そういうのも古地図と今の地図を見ると良く分かっておもしろいよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You can see all of that clearly when you compare old maps to modern ones -- it's really interesting."

strings.text: 「そうなのか、ますますめんどくさそうだが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so. Sounds like even more of a hassle."

strings.text: 「あ、でも、少し嘘かも」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, but... maybe I was fibbing a little."

strings.text: 「なんだそりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The what now?"

strings.text: 「地図見るの好きというか……弓張市の地図を見るのが好きだったんだと思う。この街を離れてから、いつもいつも見てたから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's not so much that I like looking at maps... I think what I really liked was looking at maps of Yumihari City. Ever since I left this town, I was always, always looking at them..."

strings.text: 「古地図なんかも、その流れで集める様になったんだ……。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The old maps too, I started collecting them because of that...

strings.text: だから地図を見るの好きというよりは、この街の地図を見るのが好きなのかも」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: So it's less that I like looking at maps and more that I like looking at maps of this town."

strings.text: 「なるほど、それで、こんなに道に詳しいのか。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see, that's why you know the streets so well.

strings.text: 正直、電話であんなに簡単に俺の場所が分かると思わなかった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Honestly, I didn't think you'd figure out my location so easily just from the phone."

strings.text: 「うん、自分でも驚いた。でも説明聞いててだいたい分かった。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, I surprised myself too. But I mostly figured it out from listening to your description.

strings.text: なおくんがどこにいるか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Where you were, Nao-kun..."

strings.text: 「ずっと、ずっと、地図ばかり見てると、地図で風景が見える様になってくるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "When you keep staring at maps for so long, you start being able to see the scenery in them."

strings.text: 「あ、でもこれはさすがに私だけかもだけど……、地図を見ていると、まるでその場にいるみたいに想像出来るんだ。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, but maybe this really is just me... when I look at a map, I can imagine it as if I were actually standing there.

strings.text: だから、なおくんの声だけで、そこがどこなのか何となく分かった……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: So from just the sound of your voice, Nao-kun, I could sort of tell where you were..."

strings.text: 「エスパーみたいだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's like being an esper."

strings.text: 「あ、そろそろ右折だよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, we're about to turn right."

strings.text: 稟と共に右折する。
strings.translated: I turned right with Rin.

strings.text: 「エスパーか、そんな大層なものじゃないけどね。でも想像力って、より妄想力に近いよね。まぁ、私らしいといえば私らしい能力だけど……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "An esper, huh -- it's nothing that grand. But imagination is really closer to delusion, isn't it? Well, I suppose it's a very me kind of ability..."

strings.text: 「お前らしい？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A very you kind?"

strings.text: 「あ、今の無しで、あはは……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, forget I said that, ahaha..."

strings.text: 「でも、私って本当にはじめて油絵の筆握ったのかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But... is it really true I've never held an oil painting brush before...?"

strings.text: 「突然だな。なんでそう思う？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's out of nowhere. Why do you think that?"

strings.text: 「良く分からないけど、なんかしっくりくるというか……懐かしいというか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm not sure, but something about it just feels right... or nostalgic, maybe..."

strings.text: 「俺の知る限り、お前は油絵なんてやってなかったハズだ。俺が知らないところでは分からんが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As far as I know, you never did any oil painting. Can't speak for what you did when I wasn't watching."

strings.text: 「あ、それは大丈夫。私の記憶でも、油絵を描いた事なんて無いから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, that's fine. Even in my own memory, I've never painted in oils."

strings.text: 「でも、なんか筆を持つ感覚が懐かしい様な感じがしてね。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But the feeling of holding a brush somehow felt nostalgic.

strings.text: こんな妄想力たくましい私が本当に筆を持った事がなかったのか……少し不思議で」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Someone as prone to wild imagination as me never actually holding a brush... it's a little strange."

strings.text: 「たしかに、想像する事は、絵を描くという行為にとって非常に大事だからな。妄想力かどうかは知らんが、そういう力は描く原動力とはなる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, imagination really is essential to the act of painting. Whether it's delusion or not, that kind of power is what drives you to paint."

strings.text: 「とは言っても、記憶は無いのだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even so, you don't have any memory of it, right?"

strings.text: 「はい、だからたぶん昔、なおくんが絵を描いてるのを見てたからかなぁ……と」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Right, so maybe it's because I used to watch you painting a long time ago, Nao-kun..."

strings.text: 「ずっとその姿を思い出してたから……。まさに妄想力って感じですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I was always remembering that image of you... That really is what you'd call delusion, isn't it."

strings.text: 「妄想力って、そんなに稟は妄想癖あったか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Delusion, huh -- did you really have that much of a habit of daydreaming, Rin?"

strings.text: 「そうですねぇ。結構な妄想癖ですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, yes. Quite a habit of it."

strings.text: 「そうか？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really?

strings.text: あ、そういえば、昔良く二人で草藪に探しに行ったっけなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Ah, come to think of it, we used to go searching in the tall grass together a lot when we were kids."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事を思い出さなくていいです！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-You don't need to remember stuff like that!"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、でもあれは、お互い子供だったし……まぁ、そんな大層な事ではないだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, but that was... we were both kids, so... it's not really a big deal, is it?"

strings.text: 「そ、そうでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-Is that so?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、俺以上の熱意を持って探していたのはどうかと思うけど」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I do think it was a bit much how you searched with more enthusiasm than I did."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな熱意燃やしてません！
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I wasn't burning with enthusiasm like that!

strings.text: そ、それに今は違いますよ。今はそんなものに興味ありませんっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: A-And I'm different now. I have no interest in that sort of thing anymore."

strings.text: 「まぁ、そうだろうなぁ。今は才色兼備の淑女様という感じしかしないしな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I'd figure. These days you come off as a lady of both beauty and brains."

strings.text: 「そ、そうですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-Is that so?"

strings.text: 「少なくともクラス中の人間はそう思ってるぞ。まぁ美術部の奴らもそう思っているみたいだけど」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "At the very least, that's what everyone in class thinks. And the art club members seem to think so too."

strings.text: 「そっか、そうなんだ。それはうれしいなぁ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really? That makes me happy."

strings.text: 「まぁガキの頃のお前はそういうのじゃなかったけど」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Though back when you were a kid, you weren't like that at all."

strings.text: 「む、昔ですよ。今はみなさんが思う通り、わりかし淑女的な感じですよ。私」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Mgh, that was ages ago. As everyone believes, I'm a fairly ladylike person now."

strings.text: 「そんで？　そんな淑女様はどんな妄想をするんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So? What kind of delusions does a lady have?"

strings.text: 「淑女様は妄想なんてしません」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ladies don't have delusions."

strings.text: 「するって言っただろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You just said you did."

strings.text: 「そ、そうですね。だったら内緒です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-That's true. In that case, it's a secret."

strings.text: 「なんでだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why?"

strings.text: 「さきほどなおくんに不都合な質問に対するスルー技術を教えていただきましたので」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Because you just taught me the technique of brushing off inconvenient questions, Nao-kun."

strings.text: 「う……いらぬ事をした」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ugh... I taught you something I shouldn't have."

strings.text: 「と、とりあえず乙女の秘密という事にしてください。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "F-For now, please just call it a maiden's secret.

strings.text: あ、そろそろ左です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Ah, it's a left up ahead."

strings.text: 見慣れぬ住宅街を左に曲がると、突然見慣れた風景に変わる。
strings.translated: Turning left through an unfamiliar residential street, the scenery abruptly shifted into something I knew well.

strings.text: 「ああ、ここか。ここに出るのか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, so this is where it comes out."

strings.text: 「はい、もう見慣れた場所になりましたよね。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, this is a familiar place by now, isn't it.

strings.text: ルート案内を終了しますか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Shall I end the route guidance?"

strings.text: 「いいや、せっかくだし最後までナビをしてくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, since we've come this far, guide me all the way."

strings.text: 「分かりました。なおくん専用ナビを全うしましょう」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Understood. I'll fulfill my duties as Nao-kun's exclusive navi."

strings.text: 「そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's true."

strings.text: 「あはは、なんかナビとか言って、こうやってずっと二人で歩くの少し役得だったかも」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahaha, calling it navigation and getting to walk together like this the whole way -- maybe that was one of the little perks."

strings.text: 「役得なもんかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's no perk."

strings.text: 「役得ですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It is a perk."

strings.text: 「そんなものか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You think?"

strings.text: 「はいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes!"

strings.text: 「目的地周辺に着きました、ガイドを終了します！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You have arrived in the vicinity of your destination. Guidance ended!"

strings.text: 「ナビありがとう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Thanks for navigating."

strings.text: 「どういたしまして……それじゃ、私もそろそろ帰るよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You're welcome... Well, I should be heading home too."

strings.text: 「……少し待ってくれないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Could you wait a minute?"

strings.text: 「え？　いいですけど……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? That's fine, but..."

strings.text: 「雫！　いるんだろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shizuku! I know you're there!"

strings.text: 俺は玄関前で大声をあげる。
strings.translated: I shouted in front of the entrance.

strings.text: 入り口の戸が揺れる。
strings.translated: The front door rattled.

strings.text: 「そんな近くにいたのかよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You were that close by...?"

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「な、直哉が心配だった」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I-I was worried about you, Naoya."

strings.text: 「ふーん、だったら何でそんなところでのぞき見してるんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hmm, then why are you peeking out from a place like that?"

strings.text: 「そ、それは……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Th-that's..."

strings.text: 「出てこいよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on out."

strings.text: 「せっかく稟も来てるんだし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin came all this way too."

strings.text: 「雫さんは草薙くんを出迎えるために待ってたのですよね。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Shizuku-san was waiting to greet you, Kusanagi-kun.

strings.text: でも見知らぬ私がいるから困っている」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: But since I'm here and she doesn't know me, she's troubled."

strings.text: 「あの草薙くん、今日はありがとう、私帰るから！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, Kusanagi-kun, thanks for today. I'm going to head home!"

strings.text: 「いや、ありがとうは俺の台詞だろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I should be the one saying thanks, shouldn't I?"

strings.text: 「そうかな？　とりあえず邪魔者は帰るから。草薙くんはちゃんと届けたから。うん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Should you? Anyway, the third wheel is heading out. I delivered you safely, Kusanagi-kun. Yep."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事ない！」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Th-That's not true!"

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「はっ！？　え、えっと……あの……わっ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Ha!? U-Um... uh... wah!"

strings.text: 「何を戸ごしにやってるんだよ……今の音はこけたのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you doing on the other side of that door...? Was that the sound of you tripping?"

strings.text: 「はい。でも今の音は傘立てを倒した音かと思います」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes. But I think that sound was the umbrella stand falling over."

strings.text: 「何やってるんだよ。玄関でどたばたと」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you doing, thrashing around in the entryway?"

strings.text: 「自分の発言に驚いてしまいました」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I startled myself with what I said."

strings.text: 「どうでもいいけど出てこいよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whatever, just come out."

strings.text: 「大ゴケしてまして大股開きで下着が丸見えになっているので出られません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I took a nasty fall and my legs are splayed wide, so my underwear is completely exposed -- I can't come out."

strings.text: 「直せよ！　それぐらい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then fix it! At least do that!"

strings.text: 「すみません。傘が絡まってしまって……足が閉じません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I'm sorry. An umbrella got tangled up... I can't close my legs."

strings.text: 「どんな絡み方だよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What kind of tangle is that?!"

strings.text: 「一人ＳＭ状態。大股開きの私を見たら直哉も大興奮。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "A one-woman S&M scene. Seeing me spread-legged like this, you'd get excited too, Naoya.

strings.text: あ？　だから開ける気なの？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Huh? So you're going to open the door anyway?"

strings.text: 「ち、違うわ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-No I'm not!"

strings.text: 「あの、草薙くん、雫さんに悪いよ。そんな無理矢理」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, Kusanagi-kun, that's not fair to Shizuku-san. Don't force it like that."

strings.text: 「無理矢理？　何が無理矢理だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Forcing? What do you mean, forcing?"

strings.text: 「他の人と会いたくないみたいだし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "She seems like she doesn't want to meet other people."

strings.text: 「そんなヤツが玄関でのぞき見なんかするかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Would someone like that peek out from the entryway?"

strings.text: 「だから草薙くんを出迎えに来たんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Like I said, she just came out to welcome you, Kusanagi-kun."

strings.text: 「いや、いつも雫がこんな場所で待っている事はない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, Shizuku doesn't usually wait in a place like this.

strings.text: そうだよな雫」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Right, Shizuku?"

strings.text: 「そうですね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That's right."

strings.text: 雫は嘘をつくとか取り繕うという事がない。
strings.translated: Shizuku isn't the type to lie or put up a front.

strings.text: 素直すぎるヤツ。
strings.translated: She's too honest for that.

strings.text: 「だとさ、稟」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "See, Rin?"

strings.text: 「あ、あの、雫さん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-Um, Shizuku-san."

strings.text: 「えっと、こんな事言うとおこがましいかもしれませんが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Uh, maybe it's presumptuous of me to say this, but..."

strings.text: 「お友達になりませんか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Won't you be my friend?"

strings.text: 「有名人の雫さんにこんな事気楽に言うのもなんだかなのですけど、でも私は雫さんとお友達になりたいと思いました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It might be strange to say something so casual to a celebrity like Shizuku-san, but I really thought I wanted to be your friend."

strings.text: 「戸開けてもいいかな……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Can I open the door...?"

strings.text: 「今開けると、直哉にパンツ見られる。というか食い込んでそれ以上のものが見えてしまう可能性すら感じます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "If you open it now, Naoya will see my panties. Actually, they're wedged in so deep there's a chance he'll see even more than that."

strings.text: 「いつまでも同じ格好してるんじゃねぇよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Stop staying in the same position forever!"

strings.text: 「さっきと同じ格好ではありません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's not the same position as before."

strings.text: 「さっきより悪化中……もう、人様にとても見せられる様な状況ではない。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's gotten even worse than before... it's really not a state I can show to another person.

strings.text: むしろそういう趣味の人は大興奮する事うけあい」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: If anything, someone with those tastes would be highly aroused, guaranteed."

strings.text: 「なんでそんな悪化の仕方するかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "How is it getting worse like that...?"

strings.text: 「私だって動揺する事がある、動揺すれば、こんな事にもなる。よいしょ……よいしょ……あうぅ。く、食い込む……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Even I get flustered sometimes, and when I do, this is what happens. Heave-ho... heave-ho... auu. I-it's digging in..."

strings.text: 「落ち着いて傘を外すといいよ。たしかに傘の柄は服に絡みつくかもしれませんね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Calm down and take the umbrella off. It's true that an umbrella handle might get tangled in your clothes."

strings.text: 「うん、まぁ、これはこれで目覚めそうなのでいい感じかもしれない。あうぅ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah, well, this might feel good in its own way, like I'm about to awaken to something. Auu."

strings.text: やたら艶のある声。
strings.translated: An unnecessarily seductive voice.

strings.text: 「め、目覚めるって……ど、どんな……だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A-Awaken... to w-what... exactly?"

strings.text: 「と、演技を含めて適当な事を言うと過剰に反応する直哉は、目の前の幼なじみにどう思われるか考えてから、股間を大きくすべき」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "The way Naoya overreacts when I say random things, acting included -- he should consider how his childhood friend right in front of him is going to see him before he gets an erection."

strings.text: 「股間なんて大きくしてねぇよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't have an erection!"

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Staaare..."

strings.text: 「違う！　違う！　勃ってない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not! I'm not! It's not up!"

strings.text: 「なら、なんで隠すんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then why are you hiding it?"

strings.text: 「逆に“勃ってない！”とか言って股間見せるヤツの方がおかしいだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The guy who says 'It's not up!' and shows his crotch would be the weird one."

strings.text: 「あ、言われてみれば……そ、そうですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, now that you mention it... y-you're right."

strings.text: 数秒して雫が玄関から出てくる。
strings.translated: After a few seconds, Shizuku came out of the entryway.

strings.text: 「こんばんわ。雫さん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Good evening, Shizuku-san."

strings.text: 「はい、御桜稟です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, I'm Misakura Rin."

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 雫は稟の手を握る。
strings.translated: Shizuku took Rin's hand.

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's Rin..."

strings.text: 「稟だね……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It really is Rin..."

strings.text: 一瞬驚いた稟だが、雫の手を握り返す。
strings.translated: Rin looked surprised for a moment, but she squeezed Shizuku's hand back.

strings.text: 「はじめまして……稟」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Nice to meet you...... Rin."

strings.text: 「はじめまして、雫ちゃん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nice to meet you, Shizuku-chan."

strings.text: 「稟、この街に戻ってたんだね……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Rin, you came back to this town..."

strings.text: 「うん、戻ってきた」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, I came back."

strings.text: 「そっか……そうなんだ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I see...... so that's how it is."

strings.text: 「こうやって手を合わせてると、なんだか不思議だね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Holding hands together like this, it feels kind of strange."

strings.text: 「仏壇のＣＭみたい……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Like a commercial for a Buddhist altar..."

strings.text: 「あ、そういうＣＭあったね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, there was one like that."

strings.text: 「手と手を合わせてー」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "'Palm to palm...'"

strings.text: 「シアン化水素大爆発……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Massive hydrogen cyanide explosion..."

strings.text: なんでそこでボケる……。
strings.translated: Why go for a gag at a moment like this...

strings.text: 「シ　ア　ン　化　水　素　大　爆　発　！」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Mas--sive hy--dro--gen cy--a--nide ex--plo--sion!"

strings.text: 声大きくしてどうする！
strings.translated: Raising your voice won't help!

strings.text: 稟も俺も別に聞こえてないわけじゃねーよ。
strings.translated: It's not like Rin and I couldn't hear you.

strings.text: この沈黙はギャグが滑ってるんだよ。
strings.translated: This silence means the joke fell flat.

strings.text: 「ぷっ……ぷぷぷ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Pfft... pfffft..."

strings.text: 「にやり」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Heheh."

strings.text: 「あははははは……そこはしあわせだよ。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahahahaha... you're supposed to say 'happiness.'

strings.text: だいたいシアン化水素は猛毒だから爆発する前にみんな死んじゃうって」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Besides, hydrogen cyanide is highly toxic, so everyone would die before it exploded."

strings.text: （って！　そんな高度な科学知識を要する様なつっこみをするボケか？）
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: (Wait! What kind of joke requires such advanced scientific knowledge to shoot down?)

strings.text: 「毒でみんな死んだ後に爆発する設定」
strings.speaker: 雫
