strings.translated: "The setup is that it explodes after the poison kills everyone."

strings.text: 「そんな物騒すぎだよ。あははは」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's way too grisly. Ahahaha."

strings.text: 「雫ちゃんはおもしろいなぁ……あははは……あれ、あれれ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Shizuku-chan, you're funny... ahahaha... huh, huh?"

strings.text: 「なんだろ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What is this..."

strings.text: 「もう、あまりにおもしろい事言うから泣けてきちゃったよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Geez, you said something so funny that it's making me cry."

strings.text: 「なんで涙が出るんだろ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Why are tears coming out...?"

strings.text: 「それだけ私のギャグが冴えていたという事、それはそれでお互いいい感じ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It means my gag was that sharp. Which is nice for both of us in its own way."

strings.text: 「そうかも……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Maybe so..."

strings.text: 「……おかえり」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "...Welcome home."

strings.text: 「うん……ただいま……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah... I'm home..."

strings.text: ぽろぽろ涙を流す稟。
strings.translated: Rin's tears spilled over.

strings.text: いつも通りに見える雫。
strings.translated: Shizuku looked the same as ever.

strings.text: だが良く見ると口を強く結んでいる。
strings.translated: But if you looked closely, her lips were pressed tightly together.

strings.text: 「これでいいんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This is how it should be..."

strings.text: たぶん、俺だけではないのだろう。
strings.translated: Probably, I'm not the only one.

strings.text: いいや、俺だけのはずがない。
strings.translated: No, there's no way I could be the only one.

strings.text: だから雫だってそうなのだろう。
strings.translated: So Shizuku must feel the same way.

strings.text: いつまでも囚われている問題でもない。
strings.translated: This isn't something to stay hung up on forever.

strings.text: そうだ……
strings.translated: That's right......

strings.text: 少しでも歩き出さないとな……。
strings.translated: I have to take a step forward, even if just a little......

strings.text: 稟がまた、この土地に戻ってきたのだから……。
strings.translated: Because Rin has returned to this land......

strings.text: ぽろぽろ涙を流す稟の肩を優しく抱き。
strings.translated: She gently wrapped her arm around Rin's shoulders as the tears kept spilling.

strings.text: 「ブイ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "V-sign."

strings.text: 何故か、俺にブイの字をする。
strings.translated: For some reason, she flashed a V-sign at me.

strings.text: どこまでも意味が分からんヤツだ……。
strings.translated: She's a girl I can't make sense of, no matter how far I go...

strings.text: 学校の勉強が一段落してから夕食の後片付けをはじめる。
strings.translated: After my schoolwork wound down, I set about cleaning up from dinner.

strings.text: 数時間ほど浸け置きしておいたが、それでも今日の洗い物は少々やっかいだった。
strings.translated: I'd left everything to soak for a few hours, but even so, tonight's dishes were a bit of a chore.

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「がんばりすぎたな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I went a little overboard..."

strings.text: あれだけ遠出して買い物をしたからな、料理もがんばってしまって当然か。
strings.translated: Well, we did go all the way out to shop, so I suppose it's only natural I got carried away with the cooking too.

strings.text: また稟が手伝ってくれたし……。
strings.translated: Rin helped me out, too...

strings.text: 大勢の食事は楽しい。
strings.translated: Meals with a crowd are fun.

strings.text: それに、夏は旬の野菜が多い。
strings.translated: And summer brings plenty of vegetables in season.

strings.text: 当然夏場は野菜の値段が安くなる。
strings.translated: Naturally, in summer, vegetable prices drop.

strings.text: 安ければ、いつもより料理を豪勢にする事が出来る。
strings.translated: When things are cheap, you can make dishes a bit more lavish than usual.

strings.text: この時期の魚ならば安くてうまいトビウオがおすすめだ。
strings.translated: For fish at this time of year, I'd recommend flying fish -- cheap and delicious.

strings.text: 通称本トビという。夏から初秋にとれるトビウオの事をさして言う。
strings.translated: They're commonly called "hon-tobi" -- a term for flying fish caught from summer through early autumn.

strings.text: 春にとれるトビウオは春トビというのだが、夏のトビウオをさして「本トビ」と言う。この言葉からも分かる通り、夏のトビウオは格別だ。
strings.translated: Flying fish caught in spring are called "haru-tobi," while those caught in summer earn the name "hon-tobi" -- the "real" flying fish. As the name suggests, summer flying fish are something special.

strings.text: トビウオは油分が少なく淡泊な味だが、とにかく天ぷらがうまい。
strings.translated: Flying fish are low in oil and mild in flavor, but they make truly excellent tempura.

strings.text: 小骨が多いのでさばくのがめんどいトビウオが刺身用になっているのはうれしい……。
strings.translated: They're a pain to fillet because of all the fine bones, so it's a relief to find them already prepared as sashimi...

strings.text: そのまま一口大に切って衣を絡ませれば良いだけだ。
strings.translated: All you have to do is cut them into bite-sized pieces and coat them in batter.

strings.text: それはそうと、夏はキスなんかも旬だったりする。
strings.translated: That aside, summer is also the season for whiting.

strings.text: キスなんかも天ぷらにはうってつけだ。
strings.translated: Whiting is another fish perfectly suited to tempura.

strings.text: 旬のもので作るてんぷらはおいしいし作るのも楽しいが、やはり後片付けはめんどくさい。
strings.translated: Tempura made with seasonal ingredients is delicious and fun to prepare, but the cleanup is a pain, as always.

strings.text: 「揚げ物は洗い物がめんどくさいからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Fried food really is a nightmare to clean up after."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew..."

strings.text: 俺は一通りの洗い物を済ませて、冷蔵庫から麦茶を取り出し、茶の間で腰をおろす。
strings.translated: Once I'd finished washing everything, I took some barley tea from the fridge and settled down in the tea room.

strings.text: 麦茶をコップにうつしながら、手元にあった新聞を開く。
strings.translated: Pouring the tea into a glass, I opened the newspaper that lay nearby.

strings.text: 「また増税かよ。こんな時期に増税とか大丈夫なのか？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Another tax hike? Is it really okay to raise taxes at a time like this?

strings.text: さらなる景気の悪化とかかんべんしてくれよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Spare me from any more economic downturn, please."

strings.text: とりあえず、俺が就職するまでは景気とか良くなっていてほしいもんだ。
strings.translated: At the very least, I'd like the economy to have picked up by the time I hit the job market.

strings.text: 生まれた年度によって、人生がイージーモードだったりハードモードだったりするのはやめてほしい。
strings.translated: It's ridiculous that whether your life is on easy mode or hard mode depends on the year you were born.

strings.text: 去年までは就職率が良かったのに、今年からダメとか、恐ろしすぎる世界だ。
strings.translated: Employment rates were good up through last year and then suddenly aren't -- what a terrifying world.

strings.text: とりあえず、俺が就職する年だけでいいから、景気が回復して求人が増加してほしいもんだ。
strings.translated: Just for the year I'm looking for work -- that's all I ask -- let the economy recover and job openings increase.

strings.text: 「うわ……、若者の失業率ってどんどん悪化してるのか……。これ以上の貧乏など勘弁してくれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whoa... the unemployment rate among young people just keeps getting worse... please, no more poverty in my life..."

strings.text: 新聞を読んでもろくな話題がない。
strings.translated: There isn't a single decent story in the paper.

strings.text: こんなもん読んで暗くなっても仕方がない。
strings.translated: No point getting depressed reading this sort of thing.

strings.text: だいたい、何が起こるか分からない未来の事など考えても仕方がない。
strings.translated: Besides, there's no use worrying about a future you can't predict.

strings.text: 「未来の事は未来になったら考えればいいのだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The future is something to think about when it becomes the present."

strings.text: 新聞は読み飽きたので、今度は手元にあった雑誌を広げた。
strings.translated: Tired of the newspaper, I opened up a magazine I found lying nearby.

strings.text: 女性向けのファッション雑誌。
strings.translated: A women's fashion magazine.

strings.text: 中を開くと、すぐに雫の姿が目に入った。
strings.translated: When I flipped it open, my eyes landed on Shizuku almost immediately.

strings.text: だって付箋が貼ってあるから……。
strings.translated: Well, that was because a sticky tab had been placed there...

strings.text: 「雫はファッション誌なんかにも出ているのか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So Shizuku appears in fashion magazines too, huh..."

strings.text: 本当に有名人なのだな……。
strings.translated: She really is a celebrity...

strings.text: たぶん雫が載っているという事で藍が買ったのだろう。
strings.translated: Ai probably bought it because Shizuku was in it.

strings.text: 実際、同じものが本棚にも挟まっている。
strings.translated: In fact, an identical copy is tucked into the bookshelf.

strings.text: 「こうやって見ると、本当に芸能人なんだなぁ……。雫って……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Seeing this, she really is a bona fide star... Shizuku, I mean..."

strings.text: 俺が持つ雫のイメージ。
strings.translated: The image I have of Shizuku.

strings.text: あ、いや、雫ではないのかもしれないが、
strings.translated: Ah, no, maybe it isn't Shizuku at all,

strings.text: なんかそういうものとは、雑誌で見る彼女の表情は乖離していた。
strings.translated: but the expression on her face in the magazine felt worlds apart from anything like that.

strings.text: 「雫は美人というより、本当はかわいらしい感じなんだけどな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shizuku isn't so much beautiful as she is genuinely cute, really..."

strings.text: 表情がぎこちないというか、素朴というか、そんな感じなかわいさ……。
strings.translated: Her expressions are a little stiff, a little unpolished -- that kind of cuteness...

strings.text: 俺は、雫のページをじっと見つめる。
strings.translated: I stared fixedly at Shizuku's page.

strings.text: 一緒に住んでいても、あいつの肌など、こんなまじまじと見つめる事は出来ない。
strings.translated: Even living under the same roof, I could never study her skin this closely.

strings.text: すばらしいラインだな。
strings.translated: What magnificent lines.

strings.text: 胸はそこまでないが……この細身でありながら、柔らかそうで張りのある肌……。
strings.translated: Her chest isn't much to speak of... but that slender frame, that soft and supple-looking skin...

strings.text: 芸術的ですらある。
strings.translated: It's practically artistic.

strings.text: 「おっといかん……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whoa there, that's enough..."

strings.text: こんなページをずっと見ていたら、雫を意識してしまいかねん。
strings.translated: If I kept staring at a page like this, I might start seeing Shizuku as more than she is.

strings.text: 一緒に暮らしていくにあたって、それは厳禁だ。
strings.translated: Living together, that's strictly forbidden.

strings.text: とはいってもかれこれ１０分近く眺めていた様な気もするが……。
strings.translated: Though it feels like I've already been staring at it for close to ten minutes...

strings.text: 俺はぺらぺらと他のページをめくっていく。
strings.translated: I flipped through the other pages.

strings.text: 「女ものの服はひらひらが多いな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Women's clothes really have a lot of frills..."

strings.text: 絵で描いたらめんどくさそうな服ばかりだ。
strings.translated: Nothing but clothes that would be a pain to draw.

strings.text: そういえば……。
strings.translated: Now that I think of it......

strings.text: 今日、あの場所で会った少女……。
strings.translated: That girl I met earlier today, at that place...

strings.text: なんか見覚えがあると思ったのだけど、
strings.translated: I thought she looked familiar somehow,

strings.text: それは顔ではなく服だな……。
strings.translated: but it wasn't her face -- it was her clothes...

strings.text: 何となくでしかないのだが、
strings.translated: It's only a vague impression,

strings.text: あの服……見覚えがあるんだよな……。
strings.translated: but those clothes... I feel like I've seen them somewhere...

strings.text: まぁ、服なんて、大量生産のもんが大半だし、ただでなくても似たり寄ったりのデザインだ。
strings.translated: Well, most clothes are mass-produced, and even without that, the designs all look pretty similar.

strings.text: たしかに、何となく見覚えがある服なんて珍しくもない。
strings.translated: It's certainly not unusual to see clothes that look vaguely familiar.

strings.text: なのだが……。
strings.translated: However...

strings.text: 何か、少し気にかかる……。
strings.translated: Still, something about it nags at me...

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Clothes, huh..."

strings.text: 当たり前だが、都合良く彼女が着ていた服が載っていたりはしない。
strings.translated: Naturally, the outfit she'd been wearing wasn't conveniently pictured in the magazine.

strings.text: 似た様な服はある様な気もするが、同じものではないだろう。
strings.translated: There are things that look similar, but nothing quite the same.

strings.text: 雑誌をめくりながら、あの娘が名乗る前に口にした言葉を思い出す。
strings.translated: As I paged through the magazine, I recalled the word that girl had spoken just before giving her name.

strings.text: “オランピア”
strings.translated: "Olympia."

strings.text: 「……そういえば、あいつ服のタグを見て“オランピア”とか言ってたな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Come to think of it, she looked at the tag on her clothes and said 'Olympia'..."

strings.text: オランピアなんて名前の服のメーカーなどあるのだろうか……。
strings.translated: Is there really a clothing brand called Olympia?

strings.text: まぁ、あってもおかしくないと言えばおかしくないのだけど……。
strings.translated: Well, I suppose it wouldn't be strange if there were...

strings.text: 雑誌にはそれらしい名前など無かった。
strings.translated: But there was no such name in the magazine.

strings.text: 「オランピアねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Olympia, huh..."

strings.text: なんでそんな名前なんだか……。
strings.translated: Why on earth that name...

strings.text: 西洋美術を少しでも知る者であれば聞いた事のある名だ……。
strings.translated: Anyone with even a passing knowledge of Western art would have heard it...

strings.text: 特に俺にはなじみ深いものだ。
strings.translated: And for me, it's especially familiar.

strings.text: フランスの画家エドゥアール・マネの代表作の一つ。
strings.translated: A representative work by the French painter Edouard Manet.

strings.text: それが『オランピア』だ。
strings.translated: That is 'Olympia.'

strings.text: 発表された当時、大変な騒ぎになったと言われる裸婦画。
strings.translated: A nude that caused an enormous uproar when it was first exhibited.

strings.text: 新聞では「女ゴリラ」「ヤクザな小娘」とさんざんな評価を得たという。
strings.translated: The papers of the day gave it savage reviews -- "female gorilla," "yakuza wench," and worse.

strings.text: 展覧会でステッキを振り回して暴れた者すらいたらしい。
strings.translated: There was even a man at the exhibition who ran wild swinging his walking stick.

strings.text: とは言っても、その酷評自体がマネの狙いであったわけだが……。
strings.translated: Though of course, that very outrage was exactly what Manet had been aiming for...

strings.text: 『オランピア』以前。裸の女を描くという行為は、すなわち<r ヴィーナス>女神</r>を描くという行為であった。
strings.translated: Before 'Olympia,' to paint a naked woman was, in effect, to paint Venus.

strings.text: もし仮に、画家自身が<r ヴィーナス>女神</r>を描いてないつもりでも、それらしく仕上げるのが当時の常識であった。
strings.translated: Even if the painter himself had no intention of depicting Venus, the convention of the time demanded she be finished in that guise.

strings.text: 裸婦を描くには大義が必要だったわけだ。
strings.translated: Painting a nude required a grand justification.

strings.text: それをマネはあえて無視した。
strings.translated: Manet deliberately ignored all of that.

strings.text: 履き古されたサンダル。
strings.translated: Worn-out sandals.

strings.text: 金のブレスレット。
strings.translated: A gold bracelet.

strings.text: 首の黒いチョーカーリボン。
strings.translated: A black choker ribbon at her throat.

strings.text: 白いシーツに横たわる姿は、構図なども含め、マネの300年以上前の画家ティツィアーノ作品『ウルビーノのヴィーナス』と瓜二つで有りながら、
strings.translated: Her figure reclining on white sheets -- composition and all -- is nearly identical to 'The Venus of Urbino,' painted more than three hundred years earlier by Titian.

strings.text: その生々しいディティールは、300年前の画家ティツィアーノの“ヴィーナス”とその意味を、完全に分かつものであった。
strings.translated: And yet the raw specificity of its details completely severs it from the meaning of Titian's "Venus" of three centuries before.

strings.text: 当時のフランスで“オランピア”とは“娼婦”の通称であったのだ。
strings.translated: In the France of that time, "Olympia" was a common name for a courtesan.

strings.text: 娼婦の後ろに立つ黒人のメイドが持つもの。
strings.translated: What the Black maid standing behind the courtesan holds.

strings.text: 娼婦の足下に立つ、黒い猫。
strings.translated: The black cat standing at the courtesan's feet.

strings.text: すべてが計算されている。
strings.translated: Every detail is calculated.

strings.text: 理由を知れば、この絵を展覧会で見た者がステッキを振り回して暴れたのも頷ける。
strings.translated: Once you know the reasons, it makes perfect sense that the man who saw this painting at the exhibition would fly into a rage swinging his cane.

strings.text: 何故ならば、娼婦を買った事がある人間ならば、この独特な雰囲気を知っているからだという。
strings.translated: Because, they say, anyone who has ever bought the services of a courtesan knows this peculiar atmosphere.

strings.text: 背後のメイドが持つものは“花束”。
strings.translated: What the maid behind her holds is a "bouquet."

strings.text: 当然、客からのプレゼントだ。
strings.translated: Naturally, a gift from a client.

strings.text: 足下に描かれた猫は目を大きく見開き、手を突っ張らせて背中を丸め緊張している。まるで来訪者を威嚇すらしているかに見える。
strings.translated: The cat at her feet is depicted with wide eyes, back arched, legs stiff with tension. It looks almost as if it's threatening some visitor.

strings.text: その来訪者とは誰であろう。
strings.translated: And who is that visitor?

strings.text: 当然。娼婦を買いに来た客である。
strings.translated: Of course -- it is the client, come to buy the courtesan.

strings.text: そしてその来訪者の視点こそが、この絵を見る者の視点と重なる。
strings.translated: And it is precisely the visitor's viewpoint that becomes the viewpoint of anyone looking at the painting.

strings.text: だからこそ、身に覚えがある人間に対してこの絵は、独特な感じを与える。
strings.translated: And that is why, for anyone with such experiences of his own, this painting gives off a peculiar sensation.

strings.text: 独特な不快感を感じさせる。
strings.translated: It evokes a peculiar sort of discomfort.

strings.text: この絵を見てステッキを振り回した男が感じたものは、そんなものであったのだろう……。
strings.translated: That, most likely, was what the man who saw the painting and swung his cane felt...

strings.text: 『オランピア』は俺にとってなじみの深い絵の一つだ。
strings.translated: 'Olympia' is one of the paintings most familiar to me.

strings.text: 理由はもちろん。
strings.translated: The reason, of course.

strings.text: 夏目家の入り口にずっとかけられているのが『オランピア』の模写だからである。
strings.translated: What has always hung at the entrance of the Natsume household is a copy of 'Olympia.'

strings.text: あの器用な男が描いた絵は、模写というよりも贋作のレベルだ。
strings.translated: What that deft hand painted is less a mere study than a work on the level of a master forgery.

strings.text: 制作者は草薙健一郎。
strings.translated: Its creator was Kusanagi Ken'ichirou.

strings.text: ついこの前に死んだ。世界的な芸術家。
strings.translated: He died only recently. A world-renowned artist.

strings.text: 彼が有名になる前に描いた作品だ。
strings.translated: A piece he'd painted before he became famous.

strings.text: あれがそのまま『オランピア』の習作として市場に出たとしても、大半の人間が見抜けないだろう。
strings.translated: Even if it were put on the market as a study for 'Olympia,' most people wouldn't be able to tell the difference.

strings.text: 下手したら有名美術館のキュレーターですら見抜けずに展覧会に飾ってしまいかねない。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, even a curator at a major museum might well fail to spot it and end up hanging it in an exhibition.

strings.text: 「オランピア……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Olympia..."

strings.text: あの絵と今日出会った娘の事を考えた。
strings.translated: I thought about that painting and about the girl I'd met today.

strings.text: あまり一致するところはない。
strings.translated: There isn't much that matches up.

strings.text: あの娘、吹とか言ってたが、
strings.translated: That girl -- she said her name was Sui,

strings.text: オランピアが名であるなら、
strings.translated: If Olympia were her name,

strings.text: お前は娼婦という事になってしまうな。
strings.translated: then that would make you a courtesan.

strings.text: とか言ったら、あのバールでぶん殴られてたかもしれない。
strings.translated: If I'd said something like that, I'd probably have gotten clubbed with that crowbar.

strings.text: 「その場で言わなくて良かった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Good thing I didn't say it out loud..."

strings.text: 「オランピアか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Olympia, huh..."

strings.text: 娼婦でありながら、気品すらある気の強そうな感じは、ある女性を思い出させる。
strings.translated: That air of a courtesan who is nonetheless dignified, with a strong will, reminds me of a certain woman.

strings.text: たしかに吹も気が強そうではあるとも言えるが……だいぶ幼い感じも受けた。
strings.translated: It's true Sui also seemed strong-willed, in her way... though she also came off as awfully childish.

strings.text: マネの“オランピア”からは、何も彼女につながるものが無い様に思える。
strings.translated: From Manet's "Olympia," there doesn't seem to be anything that ties her to Sui.

strings.text: 「オランピアですか……」
strings.translated: "Olympia, is it..."

strings.text: 「って、わぁっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wha -- gah!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "S-Shizuku, it's you..."

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「何を驚いてるのです？　その動揺っぷり、やましい事を考えてる証拠ですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "What are you so startled about? That flustered look -- proof you were thinking something shameful, wasn't it?"

strings.text: 「んな、アホな。別にやましい事なんて考えて無いわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As if. I wasn't thinking anything shameful."

strings.text: 「直哉はオランピアの事を考えていた？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Naoya, you were thinking about Olympia?"

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ、口に出ていたぐらいだから、そうなのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well, I said it out loud, so yes, I was..."

strings.text: 「つまり水菜さんの事を……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "In other words, about Mizuna..."

strings.text: 「違うわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not it!"

strings.text: 「違うのですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You weren't?"

strings.text: 「オランピアの事が出てきたからといって、マネの代表作と必ず母親に重ねて考えるわけないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just because Olympia came up doesn't mean I automatically associate Manet's masterpiece with my mother."

strings.text: 「マネのオランピアの事を考えていたのですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "So you were thinking about Manet's Olympia?"

strings.text: 「いや、そういうわけでもないのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, not exactly that either..."

strings.text: 「ならば何を考えていたのでしょう？
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Then what were you thinking about?

strings.text: たとえばオペラとか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Like an opera, perhaps?"

strings.text: 「オペラ？
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "An opera?

strings.text: あ、いや、オペラの事など知らないが……そんな名のオペラがあるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Uh, no, I don't know anything about operas... is there one by that name?"

strings.text: 「その様な名のオペラは無いです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "There is no opera by such a name."

strings.text: 「無いのかよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There isn't...?"

strings.text: 「はい、そんな名前のオペラはありません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No, there is no opera by that name."

strings.text: 「だったら、何で何の脈絡も無くオペラなんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then why bring up opera out of nowhere...?"

strings.text: やはり雫独特の会話センスは理解しがたい。
strings.translated: Shizuku's peculiar sense of conversation is as difficult to grasp as ever.

strings.text: 「それよりも、直哉が口にしていたオランピアとはいったい誰でしょう？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "More importantly, who exactly is this 'Olympia' Naoya was muttering about?"

strings.text: 「ああ、オランピアは人の名前じゃない。俺には外人の知り合いなどいない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, Olympia isn't a person's name. I don't have any foreign acquaintances."

strings.text: 「ならば、物の名前？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Then, the name of a thing?"

strings.text: 「うむ、だいたいそんな感じだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's more or less it..."

strings.text: 良く分からんが……、
strings.translated: Not that I really get it, but...

strings.text: 「今日、たまたま知り合ったやつがいてな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's this person I happened to meet today..."

strings.text: 「今日知り合った？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Met today?"

strings.text: 「ああ、バールの様なものを持って、俺の家の近所の工事現場周辺をうろうろしてた……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, she was wandering around the construction site near my house, carrying something like a crowbar..."

strings.text: 「工事現場のおじさんですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "A construction-site uncle?"

strings.text: 「いや、分かる。たしかに今の説明だったら、単純に工事現場のおっさんだよな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I get it. Sure, from just that description, it does sound like some construction-site old man..."

strings.text: 「だが、吹は名前から連想されるように女の子だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But Sui is, as her name suggests, a girl."

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Sui?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そういう名前なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's her name."

strings.text: 「その女性は、直哉から見てどんな感じだったのでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "This girl -- what did she seem like, from Naoya's point of view?"

strings.text: 「少女趣味というか……なんかひらひらした服着てた。ドレスみたいな分厚い生地のやつ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Kind of girlish, I guess... she was wearing something all frilly. Thick fabric like a dress..."

strings.text: 「ひらひらした服……、なるほど、それはまるで人形みたいな感じでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Frilly clothes... I see, so it was rather like a doll's outfit, perhaps?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、そんなところかなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, something like that, yeah..."

strings.text: 「吹はバールで何を？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "What was Sui doing with the crowbar?"

strings.text: 「良く分からんが、なんでも工事を止めようとか考えていたらしい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not really sure, but apparently she was thinking of stopping the construction somehow..."

strings.text: 「工事を力尽くで中止ですか。まるで何かの反対運動みたいです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Halting construction by force. It's rather like some sort of protest movement."

strings.text: 「うーん。そうなのかなぁ……。でも、工事反対！　みたいなのって、だいたい団体でするもんだけど、あいつの場合はどう見ても単独犯だった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hmm. I wonder... But things like 'stop the construction!' are usually done by groups, and from what I saw, she was clearly acting alone."

strings.text: 「なるほど、今までの話を吟味して雫は思いました。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Having considered the conversation thus far, Shizuku has arrived at a thought.

strings.text: 直哉が口にしたオランピアと言うのは何なんでしょうか？
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Just what is this Olympia that Naoya spoke of?

strings.text: まったく分かりません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: I have no idea whatsoever."

strings.text: 「あ、すまん。元々の質問はオランピアに関してだよな。えっと、そいつが着ていた服のメーカーがオランピアだったんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, sorry. The original question was about Olympia. Um, the maker of the clothes she was wearing was Olympia."

strings.text: 「服のメーカー？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "A clothing maker?"

strings.text: 「ああ、たぶんなんだけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, probably..."

strings.text: 「たぶんとは？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Probably?"

strings.text: 「そいつがタグを見せてくれてだな、そこにオランピアと書かれていた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She showed me the tag, and it said Olympia on it."

strings.text: 「なるほど、そこでさらに素朴な疑問です。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I see. Which leads to a further simple question.

strings.text: タグというのは通常、服の裏側にあるもの」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Tags are typically located on the inside of clothes."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, they are..."

strings.text: 「そこで、私としてはさらなる素朴な疑問が生まれます。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Which raises an even more simple question for me.

strings.text: その様なものは、服を脱がさないと見られないと思われる」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Such a thing, one would think, cannot be seen without removing the clothes."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、俺が見たというか、教わったという感じであってだな、俺が脱がしたとか無いぞ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it was more like I was shown, or told about it -- I didn't undress her or anything!"

strings.text: 「でも、最初に見せてもらったと言ったのです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But you did say at first that you were shown it."

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ、たしかに言ったけど……その、なんだ雫」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well, yeah, I did say that... um, listen, Shizuku."

strings.text: 「なんでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes?"

strings.text: 「なんか目つきが怖いのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Your eyes are kind of scary..."

strings.text: 「気のせいでしょう……。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You must be imagining it...

strings.text: といいますか何故、そこで私がそのような視線をしなければならないのでしょうか？　これまた疑問です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Or rather, why on earth would I be giving you such a look at this juncture? That, in turn, is another question."

strings.text: 「し、知らんけど……なんか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I don't know... but somehow..."

strings.text: 「とりあえず。オランピアと書かれた服のタグを見たのですね……。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "In any case. So you saw a tag that said Olympia on some clothes...

strings.text: なるほど、ふーん。そうですか……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: I see. Hmm. Is that so..."

strings.text: 「なんか声まで怖くなってる様な気がするのだけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It feels like even your voice is getting scary now..."

strings.text: 「それは気のせいです。といいますか、ここで私の声が恐ろしくなっていく理由などありません。そもそも私は大層機嫌が良いです。稟と話せたのですから」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You must be imagining that. Or rather, there is no reason for my voice to grow terrifying here. To begin with, I am in exceedingly good spirits. Because I was able to talk with Rin."

strings.text: 「だ、だったら……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "T-then..."

strings.text: 「ただ直哉の発言に疑問があったので追求したまでです。直哉にやましい事が無いのなら別に恐ろしくもなんともないと思います」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I was merely pursuing a question I had regarding Naoya's remarks. If Naoya has nothing on his conscience, there is nothing frightening about it at all."

strings.text: 「あくまでも、
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Provided, of course,

strings.text: 直哉にやましい事がないのであれば！
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: that Naoya has nothing on his conscience!

strings.text: です……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: That is..."

strings.text: なんか言葉にとげがある様な……。
strings.translated: There's a definite edge to her words...

strings.text: 「服の裏地なんて普通見えませんから……、
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "The inside of clothes isn't normally visible...

strings.text: 脱がさないかぎり、あるいはめくらないかぎり……いやぁ、そんな事を直哉がするはずはー」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Unless you remove them, or turn them up... surely Naoya would never do such a thing --"

strings.text: 「あ、あのさ雫……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-hey, Shizuku..."

strings.text: 「でももしそれが事実であるならば、女性の服を脱がすほどのプレイボーイっぷりとは、かのご高名な芸術家先生の草薙健一郎に負けず劣らず、モテモテなのですね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But if that is indeed the case, then to be enough of a playboy to strip a woman's clothes off -- you are as much a heartbreaker as the illustrious artist Kusanagi Ken'ichirou himself."

strings.text: 「ち、違う！　あ、あのな！　雫！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no! L-listen! Shizuku!"

strings.text: 「むにゃ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Owf."

strings.text: 「にゃ、にゃにを……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-wha' arf you --"

strings.text: 「冗談です……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It was a joke..."

strings.text: 「じょ、冗談？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A-a joke?"

strings.text: 「はい、冗談です。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, a joke.

strings.text: だいたい、私がその様な事で嫉妬などするわけがありません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: To begin with, there is no way I would be jealous over such a thing."

strings.text: 「だ、だったら、にゃぜ、ほっぺをつねる……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-then whyf are yo' pinchin' myf cheek..."

strings.text: 「稟の事もありますから」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "There is also the matter of Rin."

strings.text: 「なんだよ。なんで稟の事が関係あるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's that? Why does Rin have anything to do with this...?"

strings.text: 「ありまくりなのです。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Everything to do with it.

strings.text: 相変わらず直哉は脇が甘いといいますか、優しすぎるといいますか……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: Naoya, as ever, has his guard down -- or rather, is far too kind..."

strings.text: 「にゃ、にゃんの話だっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whaf, whaf are you talkin' abou'?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、それが直哉の良さなのですが……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Well, that is one of Naoya's good points..."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、雫としては、ここでほっぺをつねるというのも不条理であるとは感じてます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "In any case, Shizuku does feel that pinching your cheek here is rather unreasonable."

strings.text: 「雫としてとか関係なく不条理ら！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's unreasonable regardless of what 'Shizuku' feels about it!"

strings.text: 「ふむ……。そうですね。微妙な立場です……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Hmm... I see. It is a delicate position..."

strings.text: やっと雫が手を離してくれる。
strings.translated: Finally, Shizuku releases her grip.

strings.text: 「痛いわ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That hurt!"

strings.text: 「でしょうね。痛くしましたから」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I imagine so. I made it hurt."

strings.text: 「何で痛くする！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why did you make it hurt!"

strings.text: 「直哉は知ってますか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Naoya, did you know?"

strings.text: 「何を？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「教育において、時には体罰も、それなりに有効であるという研究結果があるのですよ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "There are research findings suggesting that, in education, corporal punishment is sometimes reasonably effective."

strings.text: 「何で、俺がお前に体罰を受けなければならない！　なんの教育だ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why do I have to receive corporal punishment from you! What education is this!"

strings.text: 「犬に、危険を教えるのに、軽い体罰は有効です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "For teaching a dog about danger, light corporal punishment is effective."

strings.text: 「何故、俺が犬扱いだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why am I being treated like a dog!"

strings.text: 「いいえ、それはさすがに比喩です。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No, that was, of course, a metaphor.

strings.text: 別に犬でも猿でもいいのですが……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: It could have just as well been a monkey..."

strings.text: なんかどちらにしてもろくな比喩じゃない……。
strings.translated: Either way, it's not much of a metaphor...

strings.text: 「ただ、直哉は、いらぬお節介をすぐに焼く人なのです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It is simply that Naoya is a person who all too readily meddles where he isn't needed."

strings.text: 「今日も、稟との仲を取り持ってくださいましたし……でもそもそも稟と私は会うべきではなかったのですが……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Today as well, you played matchmaker between Rin and me... though, fundamentally, Rin and I should not have met..."

strings.text: 「でも会いたかったんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But you wanted to meet her, didn't you?"

strings.text: 「だとしても、会うべきではない事実は変わらないのです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Even so, the fact that we should not have met remains unchanged."

strings.text: 「ましてや、会ってしまったらまた大きな事件が起きてしまう可能性もあるのです……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "All the more so because, having met, another great incident may well come to pass..."

strings.text: 「いいえ、違います。すでに昨日、稟と会った時点で、すでに起き始めているのかもしれない……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No, I am wrong. It may already have begun, from the very moment I met Rin yesterday..."

strings.text: 「それはどういう事だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What do you mean by that?"

strings.text: 「ふぅ……。説明は出来ません。というかしません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Sigh... I cannot explain. Or rather, I will not."

strings.text: 「なんでだよ。なんかまた起きてるんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why not? Something's happening again, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「そうやって、クビを突っ込むから話さないのです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It is precisely because you would poke your nose in like that that I will not tell you."

strings.text: 「雫は直哉とはついこの間出会ったばかりです。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Shizuku only just met Naoya a short while ago.

strings.text: ただ、それは雫としてです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: But that is only as far as 'Shizuku' is concerned."

strings.text: 「でも私は、私自身は、一生かけても返しきれない恩を草薙の人たちに感じています。だから……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But I -- I myself -- feel toward the people of the Kusanagi household a debt that I could not repay in a lifetime. So..."

strings.text: 「もう、危ない事はしないでください……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Please, no more dangerous things..."

strings.text: 「そんな危ない事はしてないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm not doing anything so dangerous."

strings.text: 「詐欺罪」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Fraud."

strings.text: 「ギクッ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Urk."

strings.text: 「あれは危ない事ではないですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Isn't that a dangerous thing?"

strings.text: 「さぁ……俺には縁のない事なので、良く分からんなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well... it's not really something that concerns me, so I wouldn't know."

strings.text: 「本当に、草薙の人たちはそんなのばかりです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Truly, the people of the Kusanagi household are all like that."

strings.text: 「とりあえず今言える事は、その雑誌にある私の写真を熟読してくださいましてありがとうございます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "For the moment, what I can say is: thank you for so intently perusing my photographs in that magazine."

strings.text: 「え？　じゅ、熟読って……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? P-perusing...?"

strings.text: 「私のページをかれこれ１０分以上見ていた」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You spent over ten minutes looking at my pages."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな時からお前はいたのか！？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Y-you've been here since then!?"

strings.text: 「はい、本当は茶の間を横切って麦茶を飲みたかった……、けど直哉が事をなす邪魔になるかと……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes. Truthfully, I wanted to cross through the sitting room to have some barley tea... but I thought I might interrupt Naoya in the middle of his deed..."

strings.text: 「事をなすって何だよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What deed!"

strings.text: 「オナニーとかでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Masturbation, perhaps?"

strings.text: 「しねぇよ！
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I won't!

strings.text: というか、人の家の茶の間でそんな事するやついないだろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Anyway, no one does that sort of thing in someone else's sitting room!"

strings.text: 「なるほど、ならば自室ならばしたと？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I see. Then, in your own room, you would have?"

strings.text: 「しない！　そんな事しない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I wouldn't! I don't do that sort of thing!"

strings.text: 「自室ならしても良いと思いますし、直哉は若い殿方。思いっきり発散すると良いでしょう」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "In your own room I think it would be fine, and Naoya is a young man. It would be good to release yourself thoroughly."

strings.text: そう言って、俺が読んでいた雑誌を指さす。
strings.translated: So saying, she points at the magazine I had been reading.

strings.text: 「その撮影の時に、数枚程度、誤って下着が写ってしまった写真が私の手元にあります」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "From that photoshoot, I have on hand several photos where my underwear was accidentally caught on camera."

strings.text: 「え？　マジで？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Seriously?"

strings.text: 「やはり興味があるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "So you are interested, after all?"

strings.text: 「え？　ち、違う……今のは、けしからんという意味でだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? N-no... I meant that in the sense of, that's outrageous..."

strings.text: 「そんな写真など早急にデータを消した方がいいぞ。そんなものが流失したら大変だ、けしからん！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Data like that should be deleted immediately. If something like that got leaked it'd be a disaster. Outrageous!"

strings.text: 「なぜ、うれしそうに声を荒げているのですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Why are you raising your voice so happily?"

strings.text: 「う、うれしそうじゃない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I'm not happy!"

strings.text: 「そうですか、まぁ、直哉には必要ないものですものね。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I see. Well, it is something Naoya has no need of.

strings.text: データは消去しておきます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: I shall have the data erased."

strings.text: 「そ、そ、そうだね……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "R-r-right..."

strings.text: 「残念そうに見えますが？　別に直哉にあげてもいいのですよ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You look disappointed, though. I could give the data to Naoya, if you'd like."

strings.text: 「まじで？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Seriously?"

strings.text: 「あ、違う！　まじで、軽々しくそんな事言ったらダメだぞ。まじで、だめだめだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no! Seriously, don't say things like that so lightly. Seriously, no, no!"

strings.text: 「そうですね。まぁ、そんなデータがあるとか嘘ですが」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You're right. Well, it was a lie that such data exists."

strings.text: 「嘘なのかよ！！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It was a lie!!"

strings.text: 「今度は、本心から声を荒げた様です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "This time it seems you raised your voice from the heart."

strings.text: 「そんなデータなど存在しません。仮にあったとしてもすぐにデータは消去されるでしょう」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Such data does not exist. Even if it did, it would be erased at once."

strings.text: 「そ、そうだよな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "R-right..."

strings.text: 「けど、直哉がほしいのであれば今この場で撮影しても良いですが？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But if Naoya wants it, I could take the photos right here, right now?"

strings.text: 「まじで！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Seriously!"

strings.text: 「速答です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "An immediate reply."

strings.text: 「い、いや、違う。そのなんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no, that's not it. It's just, you know..."

strings.text: 「写メで良いですか？　ポーズなどいかがしましょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "A cell phone shot would be fine? What sort of pose shall I strike?"

strings.text: 「いやいや待て待て、いかんだろ写メなんて、それは犯罪的だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, wait, wait, cell phone shots are out of the question, that's practically criminal."

strings.text: 「ならやめますか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Shall we stop, then?"

strings.text: 「だ　れ　が　や　め　る　と　言　っ　た　ん　だ　い　？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W h o  s a i d  a n y t h i n g  a b o u t  s t o p p i n g ?"

strings.text: 「結構恐ろしい声を出されるのですね……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That's quite a terrifying voice you're making..."

strings.text: 「え？　そ、そんな声出してないだろ。何言ってるんだよ。いやだなぁ……あはは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? I-I'm not making any voice like that. What are you talking about. Come on now... ahaha..."

strings.text: 「やはりやめましょう」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Let us stop after all."

strings.text: 「な、なんで？　なんでやめるとか言い出すんだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-why? Why are you suddenly saying we should stop!"

strings.text: 「してほしいですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You want me to do it?"

strings.text: 「してほしいです！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I want you to do it!"

strings.text: 「でも困りました……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But we have a problem..."

strings.text: 「困る？　まぁ、そんな写メ撮るのは恥ずかしいだろうけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A problem? Well, I guess taking a photo like that would be embarrassing..."

strings.text: 「いいえ、恥ずかしくは無いのです。別に直哉が見るのでしたら。私はまったく問題ありません。もっと直哉のお役に立てればうれしいぐらいです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No, it is not embarrassing. Not if it is Naoya who will see it. I have no problem whatsoever. If anything, I would be glad to be of even greater use to Naoya."

strings.text: 「問題なのは、直哉の後ろにいる姉さんが、鬼の様な形相になっていっているという事でして……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "The problem is that Ai-nee-san, standing right behind you, is starting to look like a wrathful demon..."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「直哉の命令とあれば、私は何でもします。先ほど玄関で広げていたぐらいに派手に広げても良いです。なんでしたら今度はＭ字開脚に致しましょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "If Naoya commands it, I shall do anything. I could spread them as flamboyantly as I did at the entryway earlier. Or shall I do an M-shaped spread this time?"

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 「先　ほ　ど　玄　関　で　？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "A t  t h e  e n t r y w a y  e a r l i e r ?"

strings.text: 「あれほど食い込ませろと言うのですか、一日に二度もあんな格好させるなんて、本当に直哉は鬼畜ですね。でも仕方ありません。ご命令とあればやらざるを得ないでしょう……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You want me to let them dig in that deeply? Making me strike such a pose twice in a single day, Naoya, you truly are a fiend. But it cannot be helped. If it is a command, I have no choice but to comply..."

strings.text: 「一　日　に　二　度　も　？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "T w i c e  i n  a  s i n g l e  d a y ?"

strings.text: 「違う！　藍違うんだぁぁあぁあ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No! Ai, you've got it wrong! Aaaaahhh!"

strings.text: 「問答無用ぉぉぉお！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "No excuses allowed!"

strings.text: 自室に戻ると、少し気になっていたので、パソコンで検索をしてみる。
strings.translated: Back in my room, since it had been bothering me a little, I tried searching on the computer.

strings.text: 当然、マネの絵画が出てくる。
strings.translated: Naturally, Manet's painting came up.

strings.text: 他にオリンピアのフランス語である事などが分かった。
strings.translated: I also learned that Olympia is the French form of the name, among other things.

strings.text: 「うーん……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: だが有益と思われる情報を得る事は出来なかった。
strings.translated: But I couldn't obtain any information that seemed particularly useful.

strings.text: 「まぁ、どうでもいいか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, whatever..."

strings.text: 俺はパソコンをシャットダウンさせた。
strings.translated: I shut the computer down.

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「料理出来ましたよ！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Dinner's ready!"

strings.text: 夏目の台所から稟の声がする。
strings.translated: Rin's voice came from the Natsume kitchen.

strings.text: 俺や圭に勉強を教えてくれるために稟は夏目の家に来ている。
strings.translated: Rin had been coming over to the Natsume house to tutor Kei and me.

strings.text: それまでは手伝い程度だったが、今日はすべて稟が料理を作ってくれている。
strings.translated: Up until now she'd only helped out, but today she was cooking the entire meal by herself.

strings.text: これは助かるとしか言いようが無い。
strings.translated: All I can say is that it's a huge help.

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「ああ、配膳を手伝おう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, let me help with serving."

strings.text: 「いいえ、全部やりますよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No, I'll do it all."

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 「そういうわけにはいかない。
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "We can't have that.

strings.text: だいたい、お客さんに料理を作ってもらう時点で少しおかしいのだから」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: For starters, it's already a little strange to have a guest cook for us."

strings.text: 「いいんです。どうせ家に帰ったら自分の料理を作らなきゃいけないのですから、私こそ皆さんとご一緒させていただけてうれしいです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's fine. I'd have to cook for myself once I got home anyway, so I'm just happy I get to eat together with everyone."

strings.text: 「そういえば御桜は一人暮らしだったっけなぁ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, Misakura lives alone, doesn't she."

strings.text: 「はい、だから、こういう場はとてもうれしいです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, so occasions like this really make me happy."

strings.text: 「御桜が良かったら、いつでもみんなでご飯を食べようじゃないか」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "If it's alright with you, Misakura, let's all eat together anytime."

strings.text: 「そんな事言われたら甘えてしまいますよ。先生」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "If you say that, I'll get spoiled, sensei."

strings.text: 「甘えなものか、こうやって料理まで作ってくれるのだから」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "How could you be spoiled, when you're the one going through all the trouble of cooking?"

strings.text: 「あはは、でもそんな大層なものじゃないですよ。食べたらがっかりという事だってあります」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahaha, but it's really nothing special. There's always the chance you'll be disappointed once you actually eat it."

strings.text: 「そりゃ、大丈夫だ。あの手さばきでまずい料理なんてできっこない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nah, that won't happen. With those knife skills, there's no way you could make anything bad."

strings.text: 「だと……いいんですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I hope... you're right..."

strings.text: 圭
strings.translated: Kei

strings.text: 「うめぇぇええ！！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "SO GOOOOOD!!"

strings.text: 「そんな大声出す様な味じゃないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's not the kind of taste that warrants yelling like that."

strings.text: 「いやいや、すごいぞ。御桜……料理おいしいなんてもんじゃない」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "No, no, this is amazing, Misakura... 'delicious' doesn't even begin to cover it."

strings.text: 「そんな、でもありがとうございます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really, it's nothing... but thank you."

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「何？　雫ちゃん？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What is it, Shizuku-chan?"

strings.text: 「ぽろぽろ……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Drip, drip..."

strings.text: 「え？　な、何で？　何で泣くのですか？　ダメでした？　まずかったですか？　辛いものでもありましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Wh-why? Why are you crying? Was it no good? Was it bad? Was there something too spicy?"

strings.text: 「いいや、安心しろ、それは癖だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, don't worry, it's just a habit of hers."

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A habit?"

strings.text: 「雫はな。うまいものを食うと涙を流すんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "See, whenever Shizuku eats something delicious, she cries."

strings.text: 「な、涙をですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "T-tears?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、慣れると潤む程度なんだが、違う人が作った料理だとそうやって涙を流すんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, once you get used to it it's just her eyes tearing up a bit, but with food made by someone new, she cries like this."

strings.text: 「ううん。直哉と稟の料理は特別」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "No. Naoya's and Rin's cooking is special."

strings.text: 「そうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: それは、たぶん「心」が関わるからだろう。
strings.translated: It probably has to do with her "heart."

strings.text: この娘にとって、何かを口にするという事は、食事という意味以外があるのかもしれない……。
strings.translated: For this girl, putting something in her mouth might carry meaning beyond just eating...

strings.text: 「この家で他の人が作った料理を最初に食べた時に流した涙は、まったく違う意味合いだった」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "The tears I shed when I first ate food someone else made in this house had a completely different meaning."

strings.text: 「ああ、だろうねぇ……俺も毎日泣いてたもの」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahh, no doubt about it... I was crying every day, too."

strings.text: 「どういう意味だ？　圭」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What's that supposed to mean, Kei?"

strings.text: 「なんでもないれすー」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Nothing at aaall."

strings.text: 違う意味？
strings.translated: A different meaning?

strings.text: そう言えば、藍は歓迎パーティーの時は自分で料理を作るという話だが……でも、この前食べたチャーハンはうまかったが……。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, I heard Ai cooks for herself at welcome parties, but... then again, that fried rice we had the other day was pretty good...

strings.text: 「稟はすごいね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Rin, you're amazing."

strings.text: 「そんな事ないよ。でも雫ちゃんに喜んでもらえてうれしいなぁ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Not really. But I'm so glad you like it, Shizuku-chan."

strings.text: 「実際にうまい。密かに俺は、自分がかなり料理が上手いと思っていたが、稟に比べればたいした事がない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It really is good. Secretly I've been thinking I'm a pretty decent cook myself, but compared to Rin it's nothing."

strings.text: 「そんな事ないって」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's not true at all."

strings.text: 「いいや、やっぱりちゃんと教えてくれた人がいると違うよ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nah, having someone properly teach you really does make a difference.

strings.text: 田舎のばあちゃんに感謝するんだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: You should thank your grandma back in the countryside."

strings.text: 「はい、それはもちろん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, of course I do."

strings.text: 「そういえば、ずっと居た孫がこっち来てばあちゃんは寂しがっているんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Speaking of which, isn't your grandma feeling lonely now that the granddaughter who lived with her all this time has come out here?"

strings.text: 「それが、私がこっちに住めるように計らったのはおばあちゃんでして」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Actually, Grandma was the one who arranged for me to come live out here."

strings.text: 「そうだったのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really?"

strings.text: 「父は反対してたのですよ。だから今もあまり仲が良くなくて、別々に暮らしてます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "My father was against it. That's why we're still not on the best terms, and we live separately."

strings.text: 「でもおばあちゃんは、心残りがあるのなら、それを自分自身で整理してこいって！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But Grandma told me if I had any lingering regrets, I should come sort them out myself!"

strings.text: 「それがどんな結末だとしてもやらないで、一生その事を引きずってウジウジし続けるよりましだって」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That whatever the outcome, it was better than not doing it and dragging it around and moping over it my whole life."

strings.text: 「ちゃんと過去を受け入れてこいと……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That I should properly come to terms with the past..."

strings.text: 「心残り？　なんだ整理とか……なんかあったのか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Lingering regrets? Sorting things out... did something happen?"

strings.text: 「あ、そんな大層な事ではないのですが……なんといいますか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, it's really nothing that grand... how should I put it..."

strings.text: 「圭、そういう事は気軽に聞くものじゃないぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Kei, that's not the sort of thing you casually ask about."

strings.text: 「そ、そうか……そうだよな。うん」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "R-right... yeah, of course. Mm."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、そのばあさんのおかげで俺たちはこうやって旨い飯が食えるのだからいいだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Anyway, thanks to your grandma we get to eat this delicious meal, so isn't that enough?"

strings.text: 「そういう事でいい感じ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That feels right."

strings.text: 「うん……そうかも、な」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Yeah... maybe so."

strings.text: 一瞬圭の顔が曇る。
strings.translated: For a moment Kei's face clouded over.

strings.text: と思った次の瞬間には。
strings.translated: But the next instant--

strings.text: 「いやぁ、今日も学校楽しかったなぁ！　直哉」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Man, school was fun today too, huh, Naoya!"

strings.text: 「何がどう楽しいんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What was fun about it..."

strings.text: 「いやぁ、ルパ～ンみたいだったぞ。俺」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I was like Lupaan, y'know."

strings.text: 「なんだ、そりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The hell does that mean?"

strings.text: 「今日は大変な大捕物だったらしいぞ……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "There was quite the big chase today, apparently..."

strings.text: 「逃げたのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You ran off?"

strings.text: 「で、でも、ちゃんと直哉が来てから授業出たぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "B-but I went to class properly once Naoya showed up."

strings.text: 「ったく、私がどうしても抜けられない仕事があったので、補習を他の先生に代わって頂いたらこれだ。まったく私がどれだけ謝った事か……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Honestly, I had work I absolutely couldn't get out of, so I asked another teacher to cover the make-up class, and this is what happens. You have no idea how much I had to apologize..."

strings.text: 「あははは、のろまな先生がいけないんだぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Ahaha, it's the slowpoke teacher's fault."

strings.text: 「どの口？　どの口がそんな事を言うのだ？　そんな事を言う口など私はいらんな。いらんぞ！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Which mouth? Which mouth is saying that? I don't need a mouth that says things like that. I don't need it!"

strings.text: 「さぼったのですか？　圭くん卒業出来なくなりますよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You skipped class? Kei-kun, you won't be able to graduate."

strings.text: 「でも途中からちゃんと出たんだよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "But I went partway through."

strings.text: 「途中から出ればいいってもんじゃない。それに草薙もずいぶん授業中は上の空だったじゃないか」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Going partway through isn't enough. And Kusanagi, you were completely spaced out during class too, weren't you."

strings.text: 「うむ、面目ない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, my apologies..."

strings.text: 「ったく、お前らまじめにやらないと本当に卒業出来なくなるぞ。結構ウチの学校は厳しいのだからな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Honestly, if you two don't take this seriously you really won't graduate. Our school is pretty strict, you know."

strings.text: 「その様だな。明石も留年したみたいだし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So it seems. Akashi ended up held back too, didn't he."

strings.text: 「明石？　ああ、彼は留年してないぞ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Akashi? Ah, he wasn't held back."

strings.text: 「え？　でも卒業してないだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? But he didn't graduate, right?"

strings.text: 「私も詳しい事はよく分からんが、一時期休学をしてて、その分の授業を終えて試験も終われば卒業らしい」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I don't know the details either, but apparently he took a leave of absence for a while, and once he finishes the missed classes and exams, he'll graduate."

strings.text: 「休学？　あいつそんな事してたか？　ずっと学校に来ていた様だが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A leave of absence? Did he do that? He seemed to be at school the whole time..."

strings.text: 「ふむ、その辺りは良く分からない。彼の担当教員では無いのでな……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Hmm, I don't know much about that side of things. I'm not his homeroom teacher, after all..."

strings.text: 明石が休学？
strings.translated: Akashi took a leave of absence?

strings.text: それは初耳だ……。
strings.translated: That's the first I've heard of it...

strings.text: あいつが休学する意味があるのか？
strings.translated: Was there any reason for him to take a leave?

strings.text: 「どうした？　また考え事か？」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "What is it? Lost in thought again?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、すまん。ちょっとな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, sorry. Just a bit..."

strings.text: 「直哉は最近良く考え事をしている……。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Naoya's been getting lost in thought a lot lately...

strings.text: あの時を思い出す……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: It reminds me of that time..."

strings.text: 「あの時って……お前なぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That time... come on, don't say things like that..."

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "A slip of the tongue..."

strings.text: 「でも、何でも首を突っ込むのは直哉の良い部分でもある。
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But sticking your nose into everything is one of Naoya's good points too.

strings.text: だけど……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: However..."

strings.text: 「だけど……」の後は無いのかよ。
strings.translated: There's nothing after that "however"?

strings.text: 雫はそのまま俺を見つめる。
strings.translated: Shizuku just kept staring at me.

strings.text: 「明石さんがまた何か企んでいる……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Akashi-san is plotting something again..."

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「雫は明石の事を知ってるのか？
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "You know Akashi, Shizuku?

strings.text: 違う学校なのに」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: Even though you go to a different school?"

strings.text: 「<r ・・>雫は</r>明石さんの事は知らない」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Shizuku doesn't know Akashi-san."

strings.text: 「ただ、明石さんという方の名前が出て、直哉が何か考え事をしていたので、何となくそんな推察をしてみました……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's just, when the name Akashi-san came up and Naoya seemed lost in thought, I ended up making that kind of guess..."

strings.text: 「びっくりしたぁ。何で雫が明石先輩の事知ってるのかと思ったよ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "You scared me. I was wondering how Shizuku could know Akashi-senpai."

strings.text: 「お知り合いだと思いました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I thought you were acquainted."

strings.text: 「そうだろうな。何度も明石の名前が出てきたから、<r ・・>雫は</r>その名を復唱しただけだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's how it is. Akashi's name came up over and over, so Shizuku just repeated the name."

strings.text: 「そうか。いやさ、明石先輩だったら、聖ルーアン学園にもその悪名をとどろかせててもおかしくないかなぁ。とか思ったんだけどな」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "I see. Well, if it's Akashi-senpai, I wouldn't be surprised if his infamy had reached Saint Rouen Academy too. Or so I thought."

strings.text: 「明石さんの事は置いておいたとして……直哉」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Setting aside Akashi-san... Naoya."

strings.text: 「なんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「肩に桜の花びらがついてる」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "There's a cherry blossom petal on your shoulder."

strings.text: 肩に手を当てると、本当に桜の花びらが手に付いてきた。
strings.translated: When I brushed my shoulder, sure enough, a cherry blossom petal came off onto my hand.

strings.text: 「本当だ。なんだこりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "It really is. What's this?"

strings.text: 「こんな事あるのだなぁ。なんで花びらが……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, that's a coincidence. Why would there be a petal..."

strings.text: 「枯れてるな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's withered..."

strings.text: 「そりゃそうだろ、もう夏なんだから、どこかで残っていた花びらがついたのだろう」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, of course. It's already summer -- a petal that was left over somewhere must have stuck to you."

strings.text: どこかで残っていた……。
strings.translated: Left over somewhere...

strings.text: 雫は稟の方をちらりと見る。
strings.translated: Shizuku glanced over at Rin.

strings.text: 「千年桜……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "The thousand-year cherry..."

strings.text: 「千年桜？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The thousand-year cherry?"

strings.text: 「何？　何？　何で千年桜なんだよ。
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "What? What? Why the thousand-year cherry?

strings.text: もしかして、それ千年桜の花びらとかなのか？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: Could that be a petal from the thousand-year cherry or something?"

strings.text: 「そんなわけねぇだろ……こいつはどう見てもただの古い花びらだ。藍の言った通り、どこかで残っていた花びらがついたのだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No way that's it... this is obviously just an old petal. Just like Ai said, a petal left over somewhere probably stuck to me."

strings.text: どのタイミングでかは知らないが……。
strings.translated: When exactly, I have no idea...

strings.text: 「むしゃ、むしゃ……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Munch, munch..."

strings.text: 雫は、いつもの通り、脇目もふらずにご飯を食べはじめている。
strings.translated: As always, Shizuku had begun eating her meal without looking up.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Cherry blossoms... huh..."

strings.text: おれはその時まったく違う事が頭をよぎっていた。
strings.translated: At that moment, something completely different was crossing my mind.

strings.text: ずっと考えていた事が、カチリとはまりはじめる感じ。
strings.translated: Things I'd been mulling over began to click into place.

strings.text: 薄桜色……。
strings.translated: Pale cherry pink...

strings.text: 淡い朱色か……。
strings.translated: A faint vermilion...

strings.text: <r あわべにふじ>淡紅藤</r>……。
strings.translated: Pale wisteria pink...

strings.text: それに<r ひすいいろ>翡翠色</r>……。
strings.translated: And jade green...

strings.text: 前に鳥谷が色あせた色だと言っていたが……
strings.translated: Toritani had said before that they were faded colors, but...

strings.text: そうだろうか？
strings.translated: Was that really so?

strings.text: 俺は明石が集めてきた、不自然な上履きの色をもう一度思い出していた。
strings.translated: Once more I recalled those unnatural indoor-shoe colors Akashi had gathered.

strings.text: 「うわぁ……すごいですね。本当にアトリエです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wow... amazing. It really is an atelier."

strings.text: 「ああ、アトリエだ。なんと言っても世界的芸術家が使ってた場所だからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's an atelier. After all, a world-class artist used to work here."

strings.text: 「はい」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes."

strings.text: 「いや、そこは草薙くんのお父さんじゃないですかー。とかつっこんでほしいところだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I mean, this is where I'd want you to butt in with 'that would be your father, Kusanagi-kun,' but..."

strings.text: 「でも、草薙くんのお父さんが世界的な芸術家というのは本当じゃないですか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But it's true that your father was a world-class artist, isn't it, Kusanagi-kun..."

strings.text: 「いや、なんというか、そうなんだけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, that is true, but..."

strings.text: 「そういえば、稟は親父と会った事無かったか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, Rin, have you ever met my father?"

strings.text: 「え？　お会いした記憶はありませんが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? I don't remember ever meeting him, but..."

strings.text: 「そうか……無いか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see... you haven't, huh..."

strings.text: 「たしか稟の親父さんも画家だったよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, your father was a painter too, wasn't he, Rin?"

strings.text: 「そうですね。なおくんのお父さんほど有名じゃないけど」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's right. Though not as famous as your father, Nao-kun."

strings.text: 「いやいや、あいつが無名時代がだいぶ長かったから、俺のイメージだと稟の親父さんの方が相当有名だったよ。週刊誌の表紙なんかも描いてたし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, that guy had a long unknown period, so in my mind your father was quite a bit more famous, Rin. He even did weekly magazine covers and such."

strings.text: 「うん、でも本業は画商だよ。今はもうやめちゃっているみたいだけど……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, but his real profession is art dealer. Though it seems he's stopped doing that now..."

strings.text: 「画商か。そういえば親父と稟の父親は面識あったのかな？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "An art dealer, huh. Come to think of it, did my father and yours ever meet, I wonder?"

strings.text: 「どうでしょうか。それらしい話は聞いてませんが、さすがにまったく接点がないわけでは無かったと思います」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Who knows. I haven't heard anything about it, but I don't think they were completely without any connection."

strings.text: 「だが、稟はさすがに親父と面識は無いよな。たしか俺と稟と知り合いになった頃は、あいつはほとんど海外生活だったしな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Still, you never met my old man, right, Rin? Around the time you and I got to know each other, he was pretty much living abroad."

strings.text: 「そういえば草薙健一郎さんってずっと海外だったのですよね。草薙くんはお父さんとずっと離ればなれだったのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou-san was overseas the whole time, wasn't he. Were you separated from your father the whole time, Kusanagi-kun?"

strings.text: 「そうだな。とは言っても元々ニューヨークに連れて行かれたのを、俺は単身で日本に帰ってきたのだけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. Though, actually, I was originally taken to New York with him, and I came back to Japan on my own."

strings.text: 「そうだったんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is that so?"

strings.text: 「親父より母親の方を取った。だいたいあいつと海外生活なんてまっぴらごめんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I chose my mother over my father. Living abroad with that guy was the last thing I wanted anyway."

strings.text: 「お母さんはずっと日本にいらっしゃったのですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Your mother stayed in Japan the whole time, then."

strings.text: 「ああ、母親は<r ・・>ここ</r>を愛していたからな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, my mother loved this place..."

strings.text: 俺はアトリエにある一枚の絵を取り出す。
strings.translated: I take out one of the paintings in the atelier.

strings.text: 「あ、すごい。だ、誰の絵ですか？　それ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, amazing. Wh-whose painting is that?"

strings.text: 「どうしました？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What's wrong?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや……俺も良く知らんのさ。最近この絵を見つけた」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no... I don't really know either. I found this painting recently."

strings.text: 「美術の事は良く分からないのですけど、その絵ってすごく上手いですよね。まるで写真みたいです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I don't really know much about art, but that painting is incredibly well done, isn't it. It looks just like a photograph."

strings.text: 「ああ、何でも草薙健一郎の弟子が描いたって話だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, apparently it was painted by a disciple of Kusanagi Ken'ichirou."

strings.text: 「草薙健一郎さんってお弟子さんいたのですか？　そんな話はじめて知りました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Ken'ichirou-san had a disciple? This is the first I'm hearing of it."

strings.text: 「そりゃ、そうだ。公にはされてない。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, of course. It was never made public.

strings.text: あいつが認めていた唯一の弟子らしい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Apparently the only disciple he ever acknowledged."

strings.text: 「へぇ……唯一のお弟子さんなのですか、その方は今やさぞかし美術界で活躍されているのでしょうね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh... his only disciple? Then that person must be quite active in the art world now, I'd imagine."

strings.text: 「そうでもないらしいけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Doesn't seem to be the case, though."

strings.text: 「そうなのですか？　にわかに信じがたいですけど……。でもあれなのかなぁ。素人の私には素晴らしく見えても、プロから見たら大した事無いとかですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really? That's hard to believe... But I wonder -- maybe it looks wonderful to an amateur like me, but from a pro's viewpoint it's actually nothing special?"

strings.text: 「まさか、草薙健一郎が唯一取っていた弟子だ。凡人なわけがないだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No way. He was the only disciple Kusanagi Ken'ichirou ever took on. There's no way he'd be ordinary."

strings.text: 「だったら何故……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then why..."

strings.text: 「さぁな。世の中いろいろあるんだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who knows. All sorts of things happen in the world."

strings.text: 俺は手にした絵を再び見直す。
strings.translated: I look at the painting in my hands again.

strings.text: 俺のタッチとも圭のタッチとも、さらに師匠である草薙健一郎とも違う。
strings.translated: Unlike my brushwork, unlike Kei's, and unlike that of our master, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou.

strings.text: 稟の言うとおりまるで写真の様だ。
strings.translated: Just as Rin said, it really is like a photograph.

strings.text: 美術的技法としては、写真を元にして描かれるフォトペインティングやフォトリアリズムの様にも見える。
strings.translated: As an artistic technique, it also looks like photo-painting or photorealism, where a photo is used as the basis.

strings.text: だが、これがその様な手法で描かれたものであるならば、草薙健一郎はこの作家に興味など示さなかっただろう。
strings.translated: But if this had been painted using such a method, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou would never have shown any interest in this artist.

strings.text: この絵が持つ恐ろしさはそういうものではない。
strings.translated: The dread this painting carries isn't of that sort.

strings.text: 「私もこんな写真みたいな絵描きたいです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I want to paint pictures like photographs too."

strings.text: 「白黒のフォトリアリズムなら、陰影の基礎さえ出来ていたらわりかし簡単だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For black-and-white photorealism, if you've got the basics of shading down, it's actually pretty easy."

strings.text: 「そうなんですか？　でもこんな正確なデッサン出来ませんよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really? But I can't draw a dessin this precise."

strings.text: 「ああ、フォトリアリズムは写真をトレスしてアウトラインを描くんだよ。だから正確なデッサンは必要ない。単に根気の勝負だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, in photorealism you trace the photo to draw the outline. So a precise dessin isn't necessary. It's really just a battle of patience."

strings.text: 「そうなんですか？　そういうものなのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really? Is that how it is?"

strings.text: 「ああ、たまにキャンバスに直接映像を投射して、その上から絵の具を載せて描く作家もいるぐらいだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, some artists even project the image directly onto the canvas and paint over it with paints."

strings.text: 「それ以外にも細かいマス目を作って写真の縮尺を巨大化させる模写方法なんてのもある。まぁやり方はいろいろだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Besides that, there's also a method of copying by making a fine grid and enlarging the scale of the photo. Well, there are all sorts of ways."

strings.text: 「とは言っても、基本はデッサンだ。フォトリアリズムなどは基礎が出来上がってから覚えればいい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That said, dessin is the foundation. You can learn things like photorealism after you've built up the basics."

strings.text: 「なるほど、詳しい事は良くわかりませんが、基本大事という事ですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see. I don't really understand the details, but basically, the fundamentals are important."

strings.text: 「そういう事だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's how it is."

strings.text: 「それではよろしくご教授願いますね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then, I look forward to your instruction."

strings.text: 稟に晩ご飯を作ってもらい、そして食事を共にした後に、圭と俺の家庭教師をしてもらった。
strings.translated: After Rin cooked dinner for us and we ate together, she tutored Kei and me.

strings.text: さらに時間が余ったので、少しだけ絵を教える事になった。
strings.translated: Since we had some time left over, I ended up teaching her a bit about painting.

strings.text: 「これがデスケール。この格子状になった窓は、だいたい木炭紙サイズの比率となっている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This is a des-scale. This gridded window matches the aspect ratio of standard charcoal paper."

strings.text: 「デッサンしているものをデスケール越しに覗いて､大体の構図や輪郭的な形のバランスを確認するために用いる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You use it to look at what you're sketching through the des-scale to check the rough composition and the balance of the outline shapes."

strings.text: 「とは言っても、視点が少しでもずれると窓から見えるものはまったく違うものになるし、これ自体も固定でもしておかないとフレーム内は違うものになる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That said, if your viewpoint shifts even a little, what you see through the window changes completely, and unless the scale itself is fixed in place, what's in the frame changes too."

strings.text: 「デスケールを固定、見る時の顔すらも固定したいぐらいだ。
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ideally, you hold both the des-scale and your head completely steady when looking through it.

strings.text: そんなめんどい事してもずれる時はずれるから、まぁ、あまり使わなくなっていく」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: Even with all that trouble, things will shift when they shift, so, well, you end up not using it much."

strings.text: 「それでも、対象物と画面の縮尺がどうあっても上手くいかないならば、ガイドラインとしては使える」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even so, when the scale between the subject and the canvas just won't come out right, it can be used as a guideline."

strings.text: 俺は、デッサンを教える。
strings.translated: I teach her dessin.

strings.text: 正当派なものから、裏技的なデッサン法まで、各種多様。
strings.translated: All kinds of methods, from the orthodox to the tricks of the trade.

strings.text: 「次に人体構造の説明だが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Next, an explanation of the structure of the human body..."

strings.text: 「ミケランジェロやダ・ヴィンチなどは人体解剖学にも精通していた事が知られるが、現代人の我々もなるべく人体構造については細かく知っておいた方が良い」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Michelangelo and da Vinci were famously well-versed in human anatomy, and even today, an artist should study the structure of the human body in as much detail as possible."

strings.text: 「これは解剖学の本だ。骨格と筋肉の機能と名称を図解した本だがこれで説明していくと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This is a book on anatomy. It illustrates the functions and names of the skeleton and muscles, and if I explain using this..."

strings.text: 人体解剖の本を広げたところで気がつく。
strings.translated: As I spread the anatomy book open, I noticed.

strings.text: 「結構、長い時間教えてるな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I've been teaching for quite a while, huh..."

strings.text: 「あ、そうだね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, that's true."

strings.text: 「そろそろ、帰った方がいいんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shouldn't you be heading home soon?"

strings.text: 「あ、そうだね。一人暮らしとはいえども、帰り道は物騒だし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah. Even if I live alone, the way home isn't safe..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、送ってやるけど」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I'll walk you home."

strings.text: 「え？　いいのですか？　では！　と言いたいところですが、そんなご厚意に甘えてばかりではいけません」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Are you sure? Then -- I'd like to say yes, but I can't keep leaning on your kindness like that."

strings.text: 「そんな大層な事じゃないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not that big a deal."

strings.text: 「そうかもしれないけど……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That may be so, but..."

strings.text: 「だったらいいじゃん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then it's fine, right?"

strings.text: 「うーん、うーん。意志が弱いなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hmm, hmm. My willpower is so weak..."

strings.text: 「どうした？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's wrong?"

strings.text: 「すみません。やっぱりご厚意に甘えてよろしいでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Sorry. May I take you up on your kindness after all?"

strings.text: 「問題ない。まぁ代わりに明日料理でも作りに来てくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No problem. Well, in return, come cook for us tomorrow."

strings.text: 「それはもちろんです！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Of course!"

strings.text: 「んじゃ、続きを教えるぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well then, let's continue."

strings.text: 今度は人体構造説明。
strings.translated: Now for the explanation of human body structure.

strings.text: 「ここで重要なのは、解剖で筋肉や骨格を確認しながら自分の身体を触る事だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's important here is to touch your own body while checking the muscles and skeleton in the anatomy book."

strings.text: 「自分の身体を触るのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Touch my own body?"

strings.text: 「ああ、当たり前だが男も女も骨の数も筋肉の数も同じだ。女性だけウエストが細いからと言って肋骨の数が少ないとか無い」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. It's obvious, but men and women have the same number of bones and muscles. Just because women have narrower waists doesn't mean they have fewer ribs or anything."

strings.text: 「ただし、骨格の形や大きさなどに差はある。特に骨盤帯なんかは子供を産む関係もあって形そのものが異なる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "However, there are differences in the shape and size of the skeleton. Especially the pelvic girdle -- because it relates to childbirth, the very shape is different."

strings.text: 「だが言ってしまえばその程度の差だ。人体デッサンの前に、筋肉構造を理解して、さらに自分で自分の身体を触って、それらがどのような形をしているか、どの様に結合しているか、どのように脂肪がついているかを理解する」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But to put it plainly, the differences are only about that much. Before drawing the human figure, understand the muscular structure, and touch your own body to understand what shape they are, how they connect, how the fat is distributed."

strings.text: 「自分で……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "By myself..."

strings.text: 「そう、たとえば、こうやって、ここの首筋の部分があるだろ。触ってみろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes. For example, like this -- see this part of the neck here. Try touching it."

strings.text: 「はい、たしかにありますね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, it's certainly there."

strings.text: 「首の後ろあたりから伸び最終的に鎖骨につながっている筋肉、これを胸鎖乳突筋という。結構目立つ筋肉なのと鎖骨とつながっているので重要だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The muscle that extends from around the back of the neck and eventually connects to the collarbone is called the sternocleidomastoid. It's quite a prominent muscle, and since it connects to the collarbone, it's important."

strings.text: 稟は自らの首を触る。
strings.translated: Rin touches her own neck.

strings.text: 「本当だ。自分の触って、草薙くんの首を見ると分かりやすいです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's true. Touching my own and then looking at your neck, Kusanagi-kun, makes it easy to see."

strings.text: 「そうだな。首から胸にかけては――」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's right. From the neck to the chest --"

strings.text: 俺はワイシャツのボタンを外して胸元をはだけさせる。
strings.translated: I undo the buttons of my dress shirt and open up my chest.

strings.text: 「っっ！　な、なおくん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nnh! N-Nao-kun."

strings.text: 「な、なんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-what?"

strings.text: 「あ、いいえ、そのボタンを外されたので……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's just, you undid your buttons, so..."

strings.text: 「いや、単に首もとから胸の筋肉を見せてやろうと思って……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I just thought I'd show you the muscles from the neck to the chest..."

strings.text: 「わ、分かります。分かりますよ。はい」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I know. I know. Yes."

strings.text: 「なんだよ……。男なんて上半身なんて普通に裸になるだろ。プールとかさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's the matter... Guys go topless all the time. Like at the pool."

strings.text: 「そ、そうなんですけど、そうやってシャツをはだけさせると……その……」

strings.text: 「やれやれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Good grief..."

strings.text: とりあえず玄関をあけ、門越しに叫ぶ。
strings.translated: For the moment, I opened the front door and called out over the gate.

strings.text: 「どなたですかー」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who is it?"

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「あ、あの、私、御桜というものでして……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-Um, I'm Misakura..."

strings.text: 数秒思考が止まる。
strings.translated: My thoughts stopped for a few seconds.

strings.text: へ？　稟？
strings.translated: Huh? Rin?

strings.text: なんで稟が、早朝から夏目の家に来てるんだ？
strings.translated: Why was Rin at the Natsume house this early in the morning?

strings.text: 俺は、夏目のくそ重い扉を開く。
strings.translated: I opened Natsume's ridiculously heavy door.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin?"

strings.text: 「あ、おはようございます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, good morning."

strings.text: 「なんだ？　どうしたこんな朝早くから……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is it? Why are you here so early..."

strings.text: 「え？　あの、ご飯を作りに来ました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Um, I came to make breakfast."

strings.text: 「ご飯を作りに来ただと！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You came to make breakfast?!"

strings.text: 俺は訳のわからない申し出に、すぐさま稟を家に迎え入れる。
strings.translated: Unable to make sense of the offer, I immediately ushered Rin into the house.

strings.text: 「どういうつもりだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just what were you thinking?!"

strings.text: 「ご、ごめんなさいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I'm sorry!"

strings.text: 「貴様、俺に飯を作るとか、何かの陰謀か？　何かの策略か？ 誰の差し金で俺にそんな優しくする！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You, making me breakfast, what kind of conspiracy is this? What sort of scheme? Who put you up to being this nice to me?!"

strings.text: 「へ？　あ、あの……
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? U-Um...

strings.text: 昨晩、約束しませんでしたっけ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: Didn't we make a promise last night?"

strings.text: 「昨晩、約束？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
