strings.text: 「冗談です……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It was a joke..."

strings.text:
「それはそうと稟は相変わらず優しいですね。吹はやさしい人が好きです。
特に<r ・・>吹に</r>やさしくしてくれる人が大好きですからね」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated:
"That aside, Rin is kind as always. Sui likes kind people.
Especially people who are kind to Sui."

strings.text: お前の都合なだけだろ。それ。
strings.translated: That's just about your own convenience.

strings.text: 「何を疲れた顔をしているのですか？　草薙さん？」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Why the tired look, Kusanagi-san?"

strings.text: 「ああ、何でも無い」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, it's nothing."

strings.text: 「まぁ、いいです。私はそろそろお暇します」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Well, no matter. It's about time I take my leave."

strings.text:
「なんだ突然？
授業でも出るのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"What, so suddenly?
Are you going to class?"

strings.text: 「授業？　よく分かりませんが、私はそんな悠長にしている暇は無いのです」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Class? I don't quite understand, but I don't have the leisure for such things."

strings.text: 「暇がないだと？　俺を尾行したり、こんな場所で雑談したりしてるヤツが言う事か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No leisure? Says the girl who was tailing me and idly chatting in a place like this?"

strings.text: 「それも全部目的があってです」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "All of that had its purpose."

strings.text: 「目的ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A purpose?"

strings.text: 「はい」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Yes."

strings.text: 「それにはなおくんを尾行する事も含まれてたんだよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "And tailing you, Nao-kun, was part of that too, right?"

strings.text: 「そうですね」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "That's right."

strings.text: 「吹ちゃんの目的って何かな？　私で手伝える事じゃないかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What is your purpose, Sui-chan? Isn't it something I could help with?"

strings.text: 「手伝いですか……。出来ない事もないでしょうけど……」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Help...... it's not that you couldn't, but......"

strings.text: 「おいおい、稟、こんなヤツにかまうことないぞ。どうせ意味もなく徘徊してるだけだろうし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on, Rin, don't bother with this girl. She's just wandering around aimlessly."

strings.text: 「失礼な！　ちゃんと目的はあります！　吹は探し物をしています」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "How rude! I do have a purpose! Sui is searching for something."

strings.text: 「探し物探し物ってお前は何を探してるって言うんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You keep saying 'searching, searching' -- what exactly are you searching for?"

strings.text: 「それを探しているのです」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "That is what I am searching for."

strings.text: 「ほら、これだぞ、稟」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "See, this is what she's like, Rin."

strings.text: 「それって、私で手伝える事かな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is that something I could help with?"

strings.text: 「あのなぁ。こんな世迷い言を何でまじめに聞いてるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on. Why are you taking this drivel seriously?"

strings.text: 「うん、たしかに曖昧模糊としてるけど、吹ちゃんがふざけている様には見えないから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's certainly vague and hazy, but Sui-chan doesn't look like she's joking......"

strings.text:
ふざけた様に見えないか……。
まぁ、その通りではあると思う。
strings.translated:
Doesn't look like she's joking, huh......
Well, that's certainly true.

strings.text: こいつはたしかにふざけた性格ではあるが、今はふざけている様には見えない。
strings.translated: She does have a playful personality, but right now she doesn't look like she's playing around.

strings.text:
「稟が私を手伝えるかどうか分かりません。
だけど私は稟と一緒にいるのは好きです。
だから手伝ってもらえるのは助かります！」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated:
"I don't know whether Rin can help me or not.
But I like being with Rin.
So it would be a great help to have your help!"

strings.text: 「だったら」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then--"

strings.text: 「待て、何を探しているか探しているなんて、意味不明すぎだ。探しようがないだろそれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wait, 'searching for what you're searching for' -- that makes no sense. There's no way to search for something like that."

strings.text: 「うん、そうかもしれないけど……でもね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, that might be true, but...... still."

strings.text:
「分かった、分かった、その件についてはまた後日だ。
とりあえず、いい加減授業に戻るぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"All right, all right, we'll come back to that another day.
For now, it's about time we got back to class."

strings.text: 「あ、そういえば授業中だった」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, that's right, we were in the middle of class."

strings.text: 「だいたい稟は、なんて教師に言って授業抜け出したんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "By the way, Rin, what did you tell your teacher to slip out?"

strings.text: 「え？　え、えっと……おトイレに……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? U-um...... that I had to use the restroom......"

strings.text: 「すげぇ長いトイレだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's one hell of a long bathroom break."

strings.text: 「そ、そうですね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "R-right......"

strings.text: 「相当な腹下しだと思われるぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "People are going to think you've got serious diarrhea."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事ないもん！　私そんなお腹弱くないもん！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no way! I don't have a weak stomach!"

strings.text:
「そう思われても仕方がないって話だ。
あと鳥谷の話だと、三分の一欠席までは遅刻扱いだって話だし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You can't blame them for thinking that. Besides, according to Toritani, as long as you don't miss more than a third of the period, it only counts as a tardy."

strings.text: 「え？　そうなんですか？　そうするとあと一分もないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Really? Then I've got less than a minute left."

strings.text: 「だから、そろそろ帰るぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So like I said, let's head back."

strings.text: 「そうですね。まぁ、またご縁がありましたら」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Right then. Well, if fate brings us together again..."

strings.text: 「うん、今度は是非探し物のお手伝いをさせてくださいね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, next time please do let me help you look for whatever you're searching for."

strings.text: 「……そうですね。まぁそういう縁があったらまた」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "......Right. Well, if fate allows it, again someday."

strings.text: そう言って、吹は校門の方向に歩き出す。
strings.translated: With that, Sui started walking toward the school gate.

strings.text: というか……あいつ授業出る気あるのか？
strings.translated: Or rather...... does that girl have any intention of attending class?

strings.text: そもそも何者なんだ？
strings.translated: Just who the hell is she in the first place?

strings.text: 「くそぉ……高い壁だなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Damn...... this wall is high......"

strings.text: 何故か俺は弓張学園の壁をよじ登っている。
strings.translated: For some reason, I'm climbing over the wall of Yumihari Academy.

strings.text: こんな行為、普段なら鳥谷から逃げるためぐらいでしかやらない。
strings.translated: Normally, the only reason I'd do something like this would be to escape from Toritani.

strings.text: だが実際、俺は鳥谷から逃げているわけでは無い。
strings.translated: But in reality, I'm not running from Toritani.

strings.text: 今日は部活にも顔を出したし、稟への指導もちゃっちゃっとやった。
strings.translated: I showed up at the club today and gave Rin her lesson quickly enough.

strings.text: 本来ならばこんな泥棒みたいに塀づたいで学校から出る事などあり得ないのだが……。
strings.translated: Under normal circumstances, there'd be no reason for me to sneak out of school along the wall like some thief......

strings.text: 「あんなに女子に囲まれるとは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I never expected to get swarmed by that many girls......"

strings.text: 稟の話は誇張でも何でも無かった。
strings.translated: Rin's story was no exaggeration.

strings.text: あそこまで女子どもが直接的行動に出るとは想像だにしなかった。
strings.translated: I never imagined the girls would take such direct action.

strings.text: 「マスコミの力って怖ぇぇなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The power of mass media is terrifying......"

strings.text: こんな名も無き一般人を一晩で有名人に変えてしまう。
strings.translated: It can turn a nameless nobody into a celebrity overnight.

strings.text: とりあえず、大勢の女子の受け答えなどめんどくさかったので、走って逃げてきた。
strings.translated: Dealing with that many girls was too much trouble, so I made a run for it.

strings.text: 俺が本気に逃げたら誰も追いつけないものと踏んでいたが、正門でさらに多くの女子に待ち伏せされていた。
strings.translated: I figured if I ran seriously, no one would be able to catch up, but even more girls were lying in wait at the front gate.

strings.text: 「冗談でもちやほやされたいなんて言うもんじゃねぇなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Guess I shouldn't have joked about wanting to be fawned over......"

strings.text: 俺はやっとの思いで塀をよじ登ると、民家の塀を伝いながら道に出た。
strings.translated: Barely managing to scale the wall, I made it out to the street by way of a neighboring house's fence.

strings.text: 「やれやれ、ここまで来れば安心だろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew, I should be safe this far out......"

strings.text: 「あー！　あー！　草薙くーん！」
strings.translated: "Aah! Aah! Kusanagi-kuuun!"

strings.text: 塀から着地した瞬間に声をかけられる。
strings.translated: The moment I landed from the wall, someone called out to me.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-who are you?"

strings.text: 香奈
strings.translated: Kana

strings.text: 「はぁ、はぁ、はぁ、ひ、ひさしぶり、長山香奈だよ。ぐ、偶然だね。こんな場所で会うなんて！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Haa, haa, haa, l-long time no see, it's Nagayama Kana. Wh-what a coincidence, running into you in a place like this!"

strings.text: 「な、なんであんたは、そんな息きらせて、汗だくなんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-why are you out of breath and drenched in sweat like that?"

strings.text:
「え？　そ、そんな事ないよ。うん。そんな事ない。
それより、あんたって何ですか、ちゃんと私には長山香奈って名前があるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated:
"Eh? N-no, I'm not. Yeah. Not at all.
More importantly, don't call me 'you' -- I have a name, it's Nagayama Kana."

strings.text: 長山香奈？
strings.translated: Nagayama Kana?

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Who?"

strings.text: 「だ、誰ってひどいですねぇ……。小中でずっと一緒だったじゃないですか。何度も同じクラスでしたし」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "That's mean, saying 'who are you'...... We were together all through elementary and middle school. We were in the same class plenty of times."

strings.text: 「そうだっけ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Was that so......"

strings.text: 「そうですよ。今日もたまたまここを通りかかったら、草薙くんを見つけて、本当に偶然ってすごいですよね！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "It was so. I just happened to be passing by here today and spotted you, Kusanagi-kun. Coincidences really are amazing, aren't they!"

strings.text: たまたま通りかかってねぇ……。
strings.translated: Just happened to be passing by, huh......

strings.text: なんでたまたま通りかかったヤツが、息を切らせているか？
strings.translated: Why would someone who just happens to be passing by be out of breath like that?

strings.text: それ以前に、塀から飛び降りた俺に何のツッコミもないというのも……。
strings.translated: More to the point, she doesn't even question the fact that I jumped down from a wall......

strings.text:
「そうなんだ。
でも弓張の校門からここまで、結構距離あるよねぇ……。
君も相当疲れたんじゃないかい？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I see.
But it's quite a distance from Yumihari's front gate to here......
You must be pretty tired, aren't you?"

strings.text: 「ううん。そんな事ないよ。全然平気だった！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Nope. Not at all. I was totally fine!"

strings.text: 「たまたま、偶然……ねぇ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just happened to be passing by...... huh."

strings.text:
やっぱり校門で待ち伏せしていた女どもの一人か。
さすがにここまで走って追いかけてきたのはこいつ一人だけみたいだが……。
strings.translated:
So she's one of the girls who were lying in wait at the front gate after all.
But it looks like she was the only one determined enough to chase me all the way out here......

strings.text: 「あ、いや、なんと言うか……その、あれですよね。草薙くん、また絵を描き始めたんですね！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Ah, no, um, how do I put it...... it's like, that. Kusanagi-kun, you've started painting again, haven't you!"

strings.text: 「絵を描き始めた？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Started painting again?"

strings.text: 「うん、びっくりしたんだよ。私、ずっとずっと草薙くんの絵好きだったからさ、やめちゃってすごく残念だったから」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Yeah, I was so surprised. I've always, always loved your paintings, Kusanagi-kun, so I was really disappointed when you quit."

strings.text: 「何を勘違いしているか分からんが……違うぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't know what you've got mixed up in your head...... but you're wrong."

strings.text: 「テレビで見ました！　すごいですよね。あれ見た瞬間、“ああ、これは草薙くんしか出来ない”って思いました。あんな事、他の誰にも出来ないよね！　さすがすごいよね」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I saw it on TV! It was incredible. The moment I saw it, I thought, 'Ah, only Kusanagi-kun could do this.' No one else could pull off something like that! You really are amazing."

strings.text:
教会の壁画の事かよ……。
あれは俺がやったものでは無く、明石がやったもんだ。
strings.translated:
She means the church mural......
That wasn't done by me -- Akashi did that.

strings.text: 何がさすがだよ。
strings.translated: "Amazing," my ass.

strings.text: 「なんか、私も学校で鼻が高いんだよ。“あ、これ友達。ずっと同級生だったんだよ”ってね」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "You know, I'm even proud of it at school. Like, 'Oh, this is my friend. We were classmates for years.'"

strings.text: 同級生だったかどうか知らんが、俺はあんたの事はあまり覚えてない。
strings.translated: I don't know whether we were classmates or not, but I barely remember you.

strings.text: 「でも、何でいきなり絵をやめたのですか？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "But why did you suddenly stop painting?"

strings.text: 「関係ないだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's none of your business......"

strings.text: 「なんか事故があったという噂を当時聞いたのだけど……」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I heard a rumor at the time that there was some kind of accident......"

strings.text: 「事故と絵をやめるって良く分からないのだけど……」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I don't really understand how an accident could make you quit painting......"

strings.text: 「でも、もしそんなつまらない事で草薙くんが絵をやめたとしたら、その事故の相手は何千万、何億、何十億って払わないといけないよね」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "But if you really quit over something so trivial, then whoever caused that accident would have to pay you tens of millions, hundreds of millions, billions of yen."

strings.text: 「車か何かだったのかな？　何か障害が残ったとか？　あの時期、たしかに数週間学校休んでいたけど……」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Was it a car or something? Did you get some kind of disability? Back then you were out of school for a few weeks......"

strings.text: 「そういえば、同じ時期に……」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Come to think of it, around the same time......"

strings.text: 「う、うるせえ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sh-shut up!"

strings.text: 「ふぇっ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Hyeh?"

strings.text: 「に、二度と今の事は口にするな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "D-don't ever bring that up again."

strings.text: 「つまらねぇって何だ！　てめぇに何が分かる！　昔知り合いだったかどうか知らんが、分かった様な顔するんじゃねぇ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What do you mean 'trivial'! What the hell do you know?! I don't care if we were acquaintances back then, don't act like you understand!"

strings.text: 「く、草薙くん……」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "K-Kusanagi-kun......"

strings.text: 「お前が俺をどう思っているか知らないが、少なくとも俺はお前を覚えてない。正直迷惑だ。俺につきまとうな！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't know how you feel about me, but at the very least I don't remember you. To be honest, you're a nuisance. Stop following me around!"

strings.text: 昔の知り合いだと？
strings.translated: Acquaintances from the past, huh?

strings.text: くそ、いらない事を思い出させやがって……。
strings.translated: Damn it, making me remember things I didn't need to......

strings.text: 「どけ、お前と話す事なんて無い……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Move. I've got nothing to say to you......"

strings.text: 俺はその場から立ち去ろうとする。
strings.translated: I tried to walk away from the spot.

strings.text: 「く、草薙くぅん……」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "K-Kusanagi-kuuun......"

strings.text: 「ご、ごめんなさいぃ……そんな怒ると思わなくて、でもひさしぶりに会ったのに、そんな怒鳴らなくて……ぐすぐす」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I-I'm sorry...... I didn't think you'd get so angry, but we just met again after so long, and you didn't have to yell at me...... sniff, sniff."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no..."

strings.text: 「私は草薙くんの事が好きだったから、ただ残念だって言いたかっただけなんだけど、たしかに事故の事はあまり知らないけど、でも私は草薙くんの才能を奪ったその事故が悔しくて、ただ私は草薙くんが草薙くんがぁ……うぇーん」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I liked you, Kusanagi-kun, so I just wanted to say it was a shame! True, I don't know much about the accident, I just hated that it stole your talent, and I, I just, Kusanagi-kun, Kusanagi-kuuun...... waaah."

strings.text: 「なっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wha--"

strings.text: 長山という女は道の真ん中でぺったり座り込み、そのまま大泣きしはじめる。
strings.translated: The girl called Nagayama plopped right down in the middle of the road and burst into loud sobs.

strings.text: 買い物帰りの主婦やサラリーマン達が俺の方をじろじろ見る。
strings.translated: Housewives on their way back from shopping and salarymen kept staring at me.

strings.text: 「ご、ごめん。言い過ぎた。な、泣かないでくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I'm sorry. I went too far. D-don't cry."

strings.text: 「だって、だって、あんな事言われたら、私立ち直れないよぉ。うぇーん」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "But, but, after being told something like that, I don't think I can recover. Waaah."

strings.text: 「立ち直れないって、とりあえず立ってくれ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Can't recover -- for now, just stand up."

strings.text: 「立てませーん」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I caaan't."

strings.text: 「いや、子供じゃないんだから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on, you're not a kid."

strings.text: 「うぇーん！　ひどいですっ。本当に立てないのにぃ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Waaah! That's cruel! I really can't stand up!"

strings.text: 「あ、すまん、すまん。ならどうしたらいいんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, sorry, sorry. So what am I supposed to do?"

strings.text: 「抱っこしてください」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Please carry me."

strings.text: 「抱っこ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Carry you?"

strings.text: 「はい、香奈は悲しすぎて立ち上がれないので、抱っこしてください」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Yes, Kana is too sad to stand up, so please carry me."

strings.text: 「だ、抱っこって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "C-carry you......"

strings.text: 「し、雫」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sh-Shizuku."

strings.text: 「だ、誰ですか」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Wh-who are you?"

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「夏目雫です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I'm Natsume Shizuku."

strings.text: 「目薬を使わずに自在に泣けるのは素晴らしいと思います。素人とは思えない見事な芸です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Being able to cry freely without using eye drops is truly impressive. It's a splendid performance for an amateur."

strings.text: 「長山さんは相当、自尊心が高いのでしょう。その自尊心故に“自分が惨めである”と少しでも思えれば、簡単に涙を出す事が出来る。これは一流女優なら大抵が身につけている技能です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Nagayama-san must have quite a lot of pride. Precisely because of that pride, the moment you feel even slightly 'miserable,' you can easily produce tears. It's a skill most first-rate actresses have mastered."

strings.text: 「あ、あなたって、もしかして……女優の草薙葛佳？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Y-you, could you be...... the actress Kusanagi Kusuka?"

strings.text: 「そういう名前も使ってます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I use that name too."

strings.text: 「そういえば……草薙葛佳って名字が同じなんだけど、もしかして草薙くんの親戚なのですか？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Come to think of it...... Kusanagi Kusuka shares your surname. Are you perhaps related to Kusanagi-kun?"

strings.text: 「いいや、草薙葛佳は芸名だ。本名は夏目雫だから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, Kusanagi Kusuka is a stage name. Her real name is Natsume Shizuku."

strings.text: 「なるほど、では他人という事ですよね」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I see, so you're strangers to each other."

strings.text: 「他人って事もないのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, not strangers exactly......"

strings.text: 「では、どういった関係で？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Then what kind of relationship do you have?"

strings.text: 「どういった関係と聞かれると困るのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's a hard question to answer......"

strings.text: 「説明出来ない程度の関係って事ですよね」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "So it's a relationship you can't explain, is that it?"

strings.text: 「それで？　草薙葛佳さん的に私のどこが1.5流なのでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "So? From Kusanagi Kusuka-san's perspective, which part of me was 1.5th-rate?"

strings.text:
「それはですねぇ。
あれだけ見事に泣いてた人が、今、こんな冷静に話していたら、芝居だってバレバレだと思いますよ！」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"That would be, you see.
Someone who was crying so magnificently just now, talking this calmly right after -- it's dead obvious it was an act!"

strings.text: 「あのまま泣きっ面なら良かったのに、私を見た瞬間にあれほど見事な敵意の視線……。詰めが甘いです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "If you'd just kept up the tearful face, but the moment you saw me, you shot me such a splendid look of hostility...... You didn't see it through."

strings.text: 「なるほど……要ははめられたわけね……」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I see...... in short, I was set up......"

strings.text: 「そうなります」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That's right."

strings.text:
「ふーん、さすが短期間で芸能界を上り詰めた女は違うわね。
人を騙すのが得意なんだ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated:
"Hmph, you really are different, aren't you, a woman who climbed to the top of showbiz so quickly.
You're skilled at deceiving people."

strings.text: 「えっへん」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Ehem."

strings.text: 「なにドヤ顔してるのよ。嫌味よ！　私は嫌味を言ったの！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "What's with that smug face? That was sarcasm! I was being sarcastic!"

strings.text: 「そうですか。それは残念」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Is that so. What a shame."

strings.text: 「ちっ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Tch."

strings.text: 「えっと……」
strings.speaker: 香奈

strings.text: こちらに笑顔で振り向く。
strings.translated: She turned toward me with a smile.

strings.text: 「えへへへ、なんかいろいろごめんね草薙くん」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Ehehehe, sorry about all that, Kusanagi-kun."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

strings.text: 「せっかくの二人の再会、邪魔者が入ってきたせいで、なんか変な事になっちゃったねぇ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Our long-awaited reunion, and thanks to an intruder butting in, it turned into something weird."

strings.text: いや、雫が来てくれたおかげで助かったんだよ。
strings.translated: No, thanks to Shizuku showing up, I was saved.

strings.text: 「でも、私はずっと草薙くん……いいえ、直哉くんの事が大好きでしたから、再会出来てとてもうれしいです。それはお忘れ無く」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "But I've always loved you, Kusanagi-kun...... no, Naoya-kun, so I'm really happy we could meet again. Please don't forget that."

strings.text: 「それでは、またお会いしましょう」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Well then, until we meet again."

strings.text: そう言うと長山香奈は立ち去った。
strings.translated: With that, Nagayama Kana walked away.

strings.text: 「た、助かったぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-that was a close one......"

strings.text: 「なかなか手強いですね。彼女……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "She's quite formidable, that girl......"

strings.text: 「手強い？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Formidable?"

strings.text: 「あの娘本気です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That girl is serious."

strings.text: 「本気？　何がだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Serious? About what?"

strings.text: 「直哉の事を好きだという事です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "About liking you, Naoya."

strings.text: 「俺を？　いや、そりゃないだろ。あれはテレビを見て感化されたバカの一人だろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Me? No, that can't be. She's just one of the idiots who got worked up after seeing the TV, right?"

strings.text: 「一応、あの娘は同業です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Technically, that girl is in the same industry."

strings.text: 「同業？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Same industry?"

strings.text: 「とは言っても、地下アイドルとかいうお仕事の様ですが、芸能年鑑で見た事があります」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Though it seems her work is as one of those 'underground idols,' I've seen her in the entertainment yearbook."

strings.text: 「地下アイドル？　なんだそりゃ？　それって自称アイドルみたいな称号じゃなかったっけ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Underground idol? What's that? Isn't that basically a self-proclaimed idol kind of title?"

strings.text: 「かもしれません。ただ彼女、結構骨があります。いろいろ厄介かもしれません」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Perhaps. But she has quite a bit of backbone. She could cause various problems."

strings.text: 「いや、地下アイドルだかなんだか知らんが厄介な事なんて起きないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, whether she's an underground idol or whatever, nothing troublesome is going to happen."

strings.text: 雫は俺を見つめる。
strings.translated: Shizuku stared at me.

strings.text: 「な、なんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what......"

strings.text: 「親子そろって、女を見る目は甘いのですねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Like father, like son -- both of you have poor judgment when it comes to women......"

strings.text: 「な、なんだそりゃ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what's that supposed to mean!"

strings.text:
「ふぅ、どちらにしてもあの娘は気になります。
良くも悪くも直哉の事が大好きだというのは本当みたいなので……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"Sigh, either way, that girl worries me.
For better or worse, it seems to be true that she really loves you, Naoya......"

strings.text:
「だとして、何が厄介になるんだよ。
あんな女に好かれたところで、俺が無視すればいいだけだろうが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Even if she does, how does that become a problem?
Even if a girl like that likes me, all I have to do is ignore her, right?"

strings.text: 「そんな簡単なものでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Do you think it's that simple?"

strings.text: 「違うのかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is it not?"

strings.text: 「あの娘、あの事故に言及してました……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That girl referenced that accident......"

strings.text: 「いや、細かい事は知らないはずだ。単に事故にあって入院していただけだし……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, she can't know the details. As far as anyone knows, I just got in an accident and was hospitalized......"

strings.text: 「だ　か　ら　油断していると大変な事になります」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That. Is. Why. If you let your guard down, something terrible will happen."

strings.text:
雫が強い口調で念を押す。
彼女にこれを言われるとぐうの音も出ない。
strings.translated:
Shizuku hammered it home in a firm tone.
When she said it like that, I had no comeback.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Uh, yeah......"

strings.text: 「それと、テレビ見ました」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Also, I saw the TV broadcast."

strings.text: 「テレビ？　何を見た？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "TV? What did you see?"

strings.text: 「『櫻達の足跡』です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "'The Footprints of the Sakura.'"

strings.text: 「ああ、草薙健一郎の遺作か……。お前も興味あるんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's posthumous work, huh...... You'd be interested in it too, wouldn't you?"

strings.text: 「そうですね。興味はあります」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes. I am interested."

strings.text: 「たとえば、あれのモチーフは、千年桜なのでしょう……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "For instance, its motif must be the thousand-year cherry......"

strings.text:
「どうだろうな。
直接聞くにも当人が死んでしまっているから聞けないが、少なくとも明石はそう考えていたハズだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Who knows.
Since the man himself is dead, I can't ask him directly, but at least Akashi seemed to think so."

strings.text: 「そうですか……そうでしょうね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I see...... yes, I'm sure of it."

strings.text: 「それがどうした？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What of it?"

strings.text: 「雫は何も知りません。でも名が逆になれば話は別です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Shizuku knows nothing. But if the names are reversed, that's another matter."

strings.text: 「……それって」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "......And that means?"

strings.text:
「逆さの名の娘は、直哉が大好きですし、すべてを捧げたいと考えてます。
まぁ、フラれてしまった様ですが……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"The girl with the reversed name loves Naoya dearly, and wants to devote everything to him.
Well, it seems she got turned down, though......"

strings.text: 「何の話だよ。だいたいフってなんかいねぇよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you talking about? And I didn't turn her down!"

strings.text:
「とりあえず、彼女は価値がある能力を持つ者です。
それは直哉は存じ上げているかと」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"In any case, she is one who possesses a valuable ability.
I believe Naoya is aware of that."

strings.text:
「たしかに夢呑みの巫女の力はそういうものだな……。
だったら夢呑みの巫女は何を言いたいんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's true, the power of the dream-swallowing shrine maiden is that sort of thing...... So what is the dream-swallowing shrine maiden trying to say?"

strings.text:
「模倣は魂が入ってなければ模倣のままなのです……
だけど、模倣に魂が入れば、それは既に模倣ではありません……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"An imitation without a soul remains just an imitation......
But once a soul enters the imitation, it is no longer an imitation......"

strings.text: 「どういう事だそれ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's that supposed to mean?"

strings.text: 「千年桜が何故、千年桜と言われているか知ってますか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Do you know why the thousand-year cherry is called the thousand-year cherry?"

strings.text: 「千年前から弓張の丘にあるからだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because it's been on Yumihari Hill for a thousand years, right?"

strings.text:
「いいえ、千年桜は千年咲かない桜の事です。
元々は枯れ木だった桜の森が咲いたという伝承です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"No. The thousand-year cherry means a cherry that does not bloom for a thousand years.
The legend says a forest of cherry trees that had been withered came into bloom."

strings.text: 「それだったら的外れだろ。実際、弓張の丘の桜は毎年咲いているのだから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then that's off the mark. In reality, the cherries on Yumihari Hill bloom every year."

strings.text:
「いいえ、まったく的外れではありません。
千年咲かなかったものを、形にしてしまった人間がいる」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"No, it's not off the mark at all.
There are people who gave form to what had not bloomed for a thousand years."

strings.text: 「千年前に一人……そして数年前に一人……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "One a thousand years ago...... and one a few years ago......"

strings.text: 「数年前に一人？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "One a few years ago?"

strings.text: 「天才は伝承の桜を描き、それを実在させてしまった」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "A genius painted the legendary cherry, and made it real."

strings.text: 「おいおい、もしかして、それが草薙健一郎で、あの『櫻達の足跡』にもそんな力があるとか言うんじゃないだろうなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey, hey, don't tell me that person was Kusanagi Ken'ichirou, and 'The Footprints of the Sakura' has that kind of power too."

strings.text: 「『櫻達の足跡』には元々そんな力は無いと思う。だけど、数年前に描かれた千年桜を再び呼び起こすぐらいの力はある……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I don't think 'The Footprints of the Sakura' has that power on its own. But it has enough power to reawaken the thousand-year cherry that was painted a few years ago......"

strings.text: 「だから、数年前に描かれた千年桜って」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So, when you say the thousand-year cherry painted a few years ago--"

strings.text: 俺の話など途中で、雫が走り出す。
strings.translated: Cutting off my words midway, Shizuku broke into a run.

strings.text: 「わっ、と」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Whoa, there--"

strings.text: 雫はそのまま稟に抱きつく。
strings.translated: Shizuku threw her arms around Rin just like that.

strings.text: 「稟おかえり」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Welcome home, Rin."

strings.text: 「うん、でもおかえりって何だろ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, but what does 'welcome home' even mean?"

strings.text: 「今日も稟は夏目家に来る？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Rin, are you coming to the Natsume house today too?"

strings.text: 「え？　うん、みんなが迷惑じゃなければ行きたいけど、いつもいつも迷惑じゃないかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Yeah, if it's not a bother to everyone I'd like to, but isn't it a bother every single time?"

strings.text: 「迷惑なわけない。稟なら大歓迎。私も大喜び」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's not a bother. If it's Rin, she's more than welcome. I'd be overjoyed."

strings.text: 「稟、相変わらず雫が懐いているな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin, Shizuku's as attached to you as ever."

strings.text: 「うん、雫ちゃん優しいからね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, Shizuku-chan is so kind after all."

strings.text: 「雫が優しいからねぇ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shizuku, kind, huh......"

strings.text: 優しいはずの雫は、先ほどの女には大層厳しく当たっていた様だが……。
strings.translated: The supposedly-kind Shizuku had been awfully harsh with that woman earlier......

strings.text: 「それで？　今日も夏目の家に来るのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So? Are you coming to the Natsume house today too?"

strings.text: 「皆さんが迷惑でなければ是非」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "If it isn't a bother to everyone, absolutely."

strings.text:
「そっか、んじゃ、とりあえず食材買って帰るぞ。
稟から料理で教わる事はまだまだ多いからな。
あと終わったら俺に勉強教えろよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Got it. Then let's buy some ingredients on the way back.
I've still got tons to learn from you about cooking, Rin.
And after that's done, teach me my studies."

strings.text: 「はい、でしたらまた絵を教えてもらえたらうれしいなぁと思います」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, and if you could teach me painting again afterward, that would make me happy."

strings.text: 「ああ、いいぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, sure."

strings.text: 「では、行きましょう」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Well then, let's go."

strings.text: 食事の後に二人で勉強をする。
strings.translated: After the meal, the two of us studied together.

strings.text: 二人で勉強というよりは教えてもらっているだけだが……。
strings.translated: Though "studying together" was really just her teaching me......

strings.text: その後、帰りまでの時間、約束通り、俺は絵を教える事にした。
strings.translated: After that, in the time before she went home, as promised, I decided to teach her painting.

strings.text: 「ほれ入れ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come on in."

strings.text: 「ん？　誰かいるのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hm? Is someone in there?"

strings.text: 「もう……食べられない……」
strings.translated: "No more...... I can't eat any more......"

strings.text: 「圭くん……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kei-kun......"

strings.text: 土蔵のアトリエを開けると、キャンバスに突っ伏す様に圭が寝ていた。
strings.translated: When I opened up the storehouse atelier, Kei was asleep, slumped over a canvas.

strings.text: 圭の周りには真っ黒になった練り消しが散乱している。
strings.translated: Around Kei, blackened kneaded erasers lay scattered.

strings.text: 「これって……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "This is..."

strings.text: 「ムーア展が近いからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The Moore Exhibition is coming up, after all."

strings.text: 「ムーア展？　あの世界最高峰の美術公募展ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The Moore Exhibition? That world-class open art exhibition?"

strings.text: 「ああ、毎年、弓張の美術部員はあれに応募する。んで玉砕してから受験に入るっていうのがおきまりのパターンだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, every year the Yumihari art club members submit to it. Then, after being blown to pieces, they buckle down for exams -- that's the standard pattern."

strings.text: 「圭くんは公募に出すための作品を作ってたんだね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "So Kei-kun was working on a piece to submit......"

strings.text: 「ああ、それにしても、こいつが構図でこんな悩むなんてめずらしいな。下書きなんて適当にやって色のせながら構図を考えるぐらいのヤツなのに……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, though it's unusual for him to agonize over composition this much. He's the type to just do a rough sketch and think about composition while laying on the colors......"

strings.text: 「それだけ本気なんですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "He's that serious about it."

strings.text: 「そうみたいだな。そういえば朝方まで描いてる時もあるみたいだし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Seems that way. Now that you mention it, he's been painting until the small hours some days."

strings.text: 「少しはその力を勉強に使えば良さそうなもんだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It'd be nice if he'd put a fraction of that energy into his studies......"

strings.text: 「とりあえず圭を起こすか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, I'll wake Kei up for now."

strings.text: 「あ、待ってください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, please wait."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hm?"

strings.text: 「今日は無しにしましょうよ。せっかく圭くんがこれだけがんばってるんだから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Let's skip today. Kei-kun is working so hard, after all."

strings.text: 「別にここなら数人いても描けるし、それに寝るんだったら部屋にかえした方がいいだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not like a few more people in here would stop him from painting, and if he's going to sleep, wouldn't it be better to send him back to his room?"

strings.text: 「たぶん圭くんの事だから、起こしたら、またすぐに作業を始めるよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Knowing Kei-kun, if we wake him, he'll just get right back to work."

strings.text: 「そうかもしれないが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That may be true......"

strings.text: 「圭くんは私とレベルが違うんだから、一人で集中してやってほしいな」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kei-kun is on a whole different level from me, so I'd like him to be able to concentrate alone."

strings.text: 「なるほど、んじゃ、ムーア展までお前に教える事は出来ないぞ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. Then I can't teach you until after the Moore Exhibition, you know?"

strings.text:
「そうか……。
あ、だったら私の家なんかどうだろ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"I see......
Ah, what about my place, then?"

strings.text: 「下書きまでならばな。でも油絵を普通のアパートで描く事はお勧めしない。臭いもひどいし、後片付けも大変だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Only up through the rough sketch. But I wouldn't recommend doing oil painting in a regular apartment. The smell is awful, and cleanup is a pain."

strings.text: 「そっか……、でも下書きなら私の家でも教えてもらえるんだよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see...... but you could teach me the rough sketch at my place, right?"

strings.text: 「下書きどころか、お前の場合基礎デッサンが重要だから、自宅でも十分できる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rough sketch and more -- in your case, basic drawing is the important thing, so we can do plenty at your place."

strings.text: 「けど、問題だろ？　一応お前だって年頃の娘だ、一人暮らしのアパートに俺みたいなのが行くって」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But isn't that a problem? You're a young woman, technically, and someone like me showing up at the apartment of a girl living alone......"

strings.text: 「くすくす、そんな気なんてないくせに」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hehe, as if you'd have any thoughts like that."

strings.text:
「わからんぞ。男なんていきなり性欲が爆発するからな。
なんと言っても川内野曰く、俺はセクハラ先輩だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You never know. A man's libido can suddenly explode. And according to Kawachino, I'm the sexual-harassment senpai."

strings.text: 「でも、大丈夫だよ。私住んでるアパートなんて壁が薄いから、少しでも悲鳴あげたら大家さんが飛び込んでくるから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But it's fine. The walls of my apartment are so thin that if I let out even a small scream, the landlord would come rushing in."

strings.text: 「なるほど。では防犯上は完璧というわけだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. So security-wise, it's flawless."

strings.text: 「うん、だから私の家でやっても全然問題ないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, so there's no problem at all doing it at my place."

strings.text:
「分かった。
お前の家で続きを教えよう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Understood.
I'll teach you the rest at your place."

strings.text: 「ただし今日は遅いから、また今度だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But it's late today, so another time."

strings.text: 「そうだね。またタイミングが合った時にでも」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Right. Whenever the timing works out."

strings.text: 「タイミングか、だったら明日は休みなんだから、明日でいいだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Timing, huh -- well, tomorrow's a day off, so tomorrow should be fine."

strings.text: 「え？　本当に？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Really?"

strings.text: 「ああ、本当だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, really."

strings.text: 「うわ、うれしいね。んじゃ、明日はごちそうの下ごしらえして待っているよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wow, I'm so happy. Then I'll prep a feast and wait for you tomorrow."

strings.text: 「そういう気の使い方はいいから、とりあえず、明日という事で」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You don't need to fuss like that -- anyway, let's say tomorrow."

strings.text: 「うん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 稟がうれしそうに笑った。
strings.translated: Rin smiled happily.

strings.text: 稟はとても明るい笑顔で笑う。
strings.translated: Rin's smile is a very bright one.

strings.text: 彼女のこの笑顔が周りの人間をいつでも幸せにする。
strings.translated: That smile of hers always makes the people around her happy.

strings.text: だから雫はあれほど懐いたのだろう……。
strings.translated: That must be why Shizuku has grown so attached to her......

strings.text: おれが玄関外まで稟を送って、帰ろうとしたら、家から声がする。
strings.translated: As I saw Rin off outside the front door and was about to head back, a voice came from the house.

strings.text: 圭
strings.translated: Kei

strings.text: 「大変だぞ！　直哉！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "This is huge, Naoya!"

strings.text: 「なんだよ。大声出して、ご近所様に迷惑だぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's the matter, yelling like that -- you'll bother the neighbors."

strings.text: 「それより、大変なんだ。ニュース、ニュース見てくれ！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Forget that, this is huge. The news, watch the news!"

strings.text: 「ニュース？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The news?"

strings.text: キャスター
strings.translated: News Caster

strings.text: 「死後、草薙健一郎氏の作品が発表される事について、中村製薬は……」
strings.speaker: キャスター
strings.translated: "Regarding the posthumous release of Mr. Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's works, Nakamura Pharmaceuticals has......"

strings.text: 「な！　中村製薬が、草薙健一郎の作品を持っていたらしい。あの『横たわる櫻』は七部作で、ずっと所有していたらしいぞ」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Look! It seems Nakamura Pharmaceuticals had Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's works. That 'Reclining Sakura' is part of a seven-piece series, and they've owned them all along!"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうなんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, is that so......"

strings.text: 「そうなんだって、直哉、草薙健一郎の作品だぞ。お前の父親の！」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "'Is that so'? Naoya, these are Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's works. Your father's!"

strings.text: 「ああ、だが遺産相続はすべて放棄している。だから、俺にはどっちにしろ関係無いさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, but I've renounced all rights of inheritance. So either way, it has nothing to do with me."

strings.text: 「だ、だけど、中村製薬だぞ。あの中村家の」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "B-But it's Nakamura Pharmaceuticals. That Nakamura family's!"

strings.text: 「そうだな。まぁ、そうだけど、別に心配する事もないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sure. Well, that's true, but there's nothing in particular to worry about."

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text:
「まぁいいじゃないか。中村家の事など我々には関係ない。
我々は夏目の人間なのだから……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated:
"Come now, let it be. The affairs of the Nakamura family have nothing to do with us.
We are people of the Natsume house......"

strings.text:
「だいたい、そのニュースは早朝から流れていたぞ。
いまさら大騒ぎとは、あまりに遅い反応だとしか言いようが無い」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated:
"Besides, that news has been running since early morning.
Making a fuss about it now is nothing but a woefully slow reaction."

strings.text: 「え？　そうなの？」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Huh? Really?"

strings.text: 「ああ、お前は少し作品に没頭しすぎだぞ……。どれだけ外部の情報に疎いんだか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, you get too absorbed in your work...... How out of touch with outside information can you be......"

strings.text: 「な、直哉こそ、」
strings.speaker: 圭
strings.translated: "Wh-, you're one to talk, Naoya--"

strings.text:
「はいはい、お説教は勘弁してくれ。
俺はそろそろ寝るぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Yes, yes, spare me the lecture.
I'm going to bed soon."

strings.text:
「直哉の言う通りだ、ご近所に迷惑だから深夜に喧嘩はやめろ。
そろそろ寝てくれ、電気代がもったいない」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated:
"Naoya is right, quit quarreling in the middle of the night -- it disturbs the neighbors.
Go to bed already, it's a waste of electricity."

strings.text: 「最近はアトリエの電気代がバカにならないのだから……」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "The atelier's electricity bill has been no joke lately, after all......"

strings.text: 「てな事で、俺は風呂をもらうぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "On that note, I'll be taking my bath."

strings.text: 圭は釈然としない感じだったが、どちらにしても、今の俺たちには関係ない話だ。
strings.translated: Kei seemed unsatisfied, but either way, it was a story that had nothing to do with us now.

strings.text: とりあえず、俺は風呂に入って、歯を磨いて、寝た。
strings.translated: In any case, I took a bath, brushed my teeth, and went to sleep.

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「ほぅ、ここが稟のアパートか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hoh, so this is Rin's apartment."

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「あはは、女の子が一人で住んでる様には見えないよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahaha, it doesn't really look like a girl lives here alone, does it?"

strings.text: 「セキュリティ的には問題ないのか？　若い女の子の一人暮らしは何かと物騒だろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Isn't it a problem, security-wise? A young girl living alone can be dangerous, right?"

strings.text: 「それなら大丈夫。このアパートって親戚がやっててね。下の階は全部大家さんの家なんだよ。だからアパートというか下宿に近い感じかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's fine on that front. This apartment is run by a relative. The whole ground floor is the landlord's place. So it's less an apartment and more like a boarding house, I guess?"

strings.text: 「なるほど……ね」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see... huh."

strings.text: という事は、まさに変な事が起きようがない状況とも言える。
strings.translated: Which meant this was precisely a situation where nothing strange could possibly happen.

strings.text: とは言っても……。
strings.translated: Even so...

strings.text:
一応は女の子の部屋。
少しは躊躇もする。
strings.translated:
Still, it was a girl's room.
I hesitated a little.

strings.text: 「どうしたのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What is it?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、何でも無い」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's nothing."

strings.text: 「さ、どぞどぞ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Come on, come in, come in."

strings.text: 「ああ、邪魔する……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Right, pardon the intrusion..."

strings.text: 薄い扉をくぐる。
strings.translated: I stepped through the thin door.

strings.text: 稟の部屋は年頃の女の子が住んでいるとは思えないほど殺風景であった。
strings.translated: Rin's room was so bare it was hard to believe a girl her age lived there.

strings.text: 「えへへ、殺風景だよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ehehe, it's pretty bare, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、雫の部屋も似た様なもんだったから、それほど驚きはしないが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, Shizuku's room was about the same, so it doesn't really surprise me..."

strings.text:
「ちゃぶ台もないんだよね。
お客さんの事を考えるなら次から用意しないと……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"I don't even have a low table.
If I'm going to have guests, I'll have to get one next time..."

strings.text: 「いや、別に俺は必要ない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I really don't need one."

strings.text: 稟はお茶を用意して座る。
strings.translated: Rin prepared tea and sat down.

strings.text: 「あ、なおくんも座ってください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, Nao-kun, please sit too."

strings.text: 俺は稟の方を見た後、すぐに目を逸らす。
strings.translated: I glanced at Rin, then immediately looked away.

strings.text: 「どうしましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is something the matter?"

strings.text: うむ、夏目家の暮らしがあるから、女と二人っきりで一つ屋根の下なんてシチュエーションなんてめずらしくないのだが……。
strings.translated: Well, with the way life in the Natsume household was, being under the same roof alone with a girl wasn't exactly a rare situation for me...

strings.text: 「や、やはりちゃぶ台はあった方が良いかもな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "M-Maybe a low table really would be better after all..."

strings.text:
「うん、お茶直置きだもんね。ごめん。
次までに用意しておくから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Yeah, the tea's just sitting straight on the floor. Sorry.
I'll have one ready by next time."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: そういう理由ではない。
strings.translated: That wasn't the reason.

strings.text: 向かい合って互いに正座で座っているという状況というのは何とも……。
strings.translated: Sitting face to face like this, both of us in seiza, was just...

strings.text: （いつも制服しか見てないからなぁ……）
strings.translated: (I've only ever seen her in her uniform...)

strings.text: （それにしても……）
strings.translated: (Even so...)

strings.text: 「ごくり……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Gulp..."

strings.text: 「いや！　いや！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No! No!"

strings.text: 「え？　ど、どうしましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Wh-what's the matter?"

strings.text: 「あ、い、いや、なんでもない。えっと……稟は一人暮らしなんだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, n-no, it's nothing. Um... so you're living alone, huh, Rin?"

strings.text: 「うん、そうだよ。見た通り」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Just like it looks."

strings.text: 何を言ってるんだ？　そんな事わかりきっているだろ。
strings.translated: What am I saying? That much is obvious.

strings.text: 「あの、お父さんとは？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Um, what about your dad?"

strings.text: 「……お父さんですか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "...My father, huh."

strings.text: それまで明るかった稟の表情が大きく曇る。
strings.translated: Rin's expression, bright until then, clouded over deeply.

strings.text: 「なおくんは、私のお父さんの顔ぐらいは知ってますよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nao-kun, you at least know what my father looks like, don't you?"

strings.text: 「あ、まぁ、そうだな……。稟のお父さんは弓張にいるんだったよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, well, yeah... Your dad's over at Yumihari, right?"

strings.text: 「はい、別々に暮らしてます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, we live apart."

strings.text: 「そ、そっか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉

strings.text: 「唯一の親なのに……私って薄情ですよね。父親を一人にするなんて……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "He's my only parent, and yet... I'm cold-hearted, aren't I? Leaving my father all alone..."

strings.text: 「いや、そんな事もないだろ。俺の父親だってずっと一人だった。というかあいつの場合は俺を置いていったといった方がいいけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I wouldn't say that. My old man was alone the whole time too. Well, in his case it's more accurate to say he left me behind."

strings.text:
「でも草薙健一郎さんと草薙水菜さんは愛し合ってたのでしょう。
すごい熱愛の末に結ばれたって聞いてます……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"But Kusanagi Ken'ichirou-san and Kusanagi Mizuna-san loved each other, didn't they?
I heard they got together after this incredible passionate romance..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、あの二人はな。出会いからして少しおかしかったからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, those two, yeah. Even the way they met was a little off."

strings.text: 「そうですか……」
strings.speaker: 稟

strings.text: 「私はお父さんを愛してるのでしょうか……それともまだ憎んでいるのでしょうか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Do I love my father...? Or do I still hate him...?"

strings.text: 誰に問いかけるわけでもなく稟はつぶやく。
strings.translated: Rin murmured, not asking anyone in particular.

strings.text: その表情は「憎んでいる」事実を否定する様なものではなかった……。
strings.translated: Her expression wasn't one that denied the fact of "hating" him...

strings.text: 「あ、ご、ごめんなさいっ。わ、私何を言ってるんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, I-I'm sorry! Wh-what am I even saying?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、まぁ、稟は稟なりにいろいろある事は分かってるつもりだから……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, well, I get that you've got your own things going on, Rin..."

strings.text: 「ごめんなさい……」

strings.translated: "Looking at your body won't stir a single impure thought in my heart!"

strings.text: 「ふーん、医者が患者を診る如くですかぁ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hmm, a doctor examining a patient, is it..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

strings.text: 「だったら、なおくんが言う様に、ワンピースのボタン外しますかぁ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then, like you said, Nao-kun, shall I unbutton the one-piece?"

strings.text: 「医者の視線なのですよね？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's a doctor's gaze, right?"

strings.text: 「と、というか声出てた？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-Wait, was I saying that out loud?"

strings.text: 「普通に声出てました。小声ではありましたけど」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You were saying it plainly. Under your breath, but still."

strings.text: 「それよりもヌードデッサンを子供の時からやっているなおくんには別に何でも無い事なんですよね？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "More importantly, since you've been doing nude sketches since you were a child, Nao-kun, it should be no big deal for you, right?"

strings.text: 「そ、それは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-that's..."

strings.text: 「そりゃ、言われなくても分かりますよ。そういう機会も多いでしょうし、何よりも私なんて……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That much I can figure out without being told. You must have plenty of opportunities like that, and above all, someone like me..."

strings.text: 「あ、あのな、あれは独り言であって、言い聞かせというか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-Hey now, that was me talking to myself, more like a pep talk..."

strings.text: 「どちらにしてもここから下半身の講義です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Either way, from here on it's the lecture on the lower body."

strings.text: 「か、下半身！？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "L-Lower body!?"

strings.text: 「はい、下半身はスカートですからまともに触る事も出来ません」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, my lower body is under my skirt, so I can't properly touch it."

strings.text: 「そ、そうだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "R-Right..."

strings.text: 「ではこのボタンを外しましょう。それの方が分かりやすいですよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "So let's undo these buttons. It'll be easier to understand that way."

strings.text: 「だが、しかし……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But, still..."

strings.text: 「なおくんは、別に私の身体を見ても、いかがわしい気持ちになんかならないのですよねぇ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You don't get any indecent feelings from seeing my body, do you, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: う……。なんか微妙に稟を怒らせてしまった様な気がする……。
strings.translated: Uh... I feel like I've somehow subtly angered Rin...

strings.text: 「そうだ。なおくんが私の身体を触って教える事だって出来ると言ってましたし、私のワンピースのボタン外してください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's right. You said you could even teach me by touching my body, Nao-kun, so please unbutton my one-piece for me."

strings.text: 「わ、ワンピースのボタンを？　俺が？　外す？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "U-Unbutton your one-piece? Me? Undo them?"

strings.text: 稟が立ち上がり、おれの目の前に立つ。
strings.translated: Rin stood up and positioned herself right in front of me.

strings.text: 「はい、ではお願いします」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, so please do the honors."

strings.text: 「お願いしますって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Do the honors, she says..."

strings.text: 「お医者さんの心なんですよね。それともお医者さんごっこの間違いですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's a doctor's mindset, right? Or did you mean playing doctor?"

strings.text: ぬぅ。微妙にバカにされている。
strings.translated: Ngh. She's subtly making fun of me.

strings.text: どうせ、俺が出来ないとふんで言っているのであろう。
strings.translated: She's probably saying it figuring I can't actually do it.

strings.text: 甘い、甘いぞ。稟。
strings.translated: Naive, so naive, Rin.

strings.text: 俺はそんな事でも平気で出来てしまう人間なのだ。
strings.translated: I'm the kind of man who can pull this sort of thing off with ease.

strings.text: 「ふっ……。出来ないとでも思ったか？　稟」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Heh... You thought I couldn't do it, Rin?"

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 「さぁ、ボタンを外してやろうかぁ。さぁ、さぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Come, I'll undo those buttons for you. Come on, come on."

strings.text: 「あ、あのね。そんな手をワキワキしなくても簡単に取れるよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-Um, you don't need to wiggle your hands around like that, they come off easily."

strings.text: そう言うと、稟がボタンを一つ取る。
strings.translated: As she said this, Rin undid one of the buttons.

strings.text: 「ほら、こうやって……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "See, like this..."

strings.text: いや、いや、俺にいかがわしい気持ちなどありはしない！
strings.translated: No, no, I don't have any indecent feelings whatsoever!

strings.text: 「んじゃ、ちゃ、ちゃ、と終わらせますかね……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well then, let's get it over with quick, quick..."

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yeah..."

strings.text: 先ほどの勢いはどこにやら、なにやら二人ともしおらしくなってしまう。
strings.translated: Whatever momentum we had from before was gone, and both of us had somehow gone timid.

strings.text: 俺は震える手でボタンを外す。
strings.translated: With trembling hands, I undid a button.

strings.text: 稟の唇が震える。
strings.translated: Rin's lips were trembling.

strings.text: 震えているのは俺だけでは無いらしい。
strings.translated: Seems I'm not the only one shaking.

strings.text: 二つ目のボタンが俺の手によって外される。
strings.translated: The second button came undone at my hand.

strings.text: 「うん……大丈夫だよ。そのまま……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah... it's okay. Keep going..."

strings.text: さらに俺は次のボタンへ――
strings.translated: And then I reached for the next button--

strings.text: 「どうでしょう？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "How's that?"

strings.text: 「どうでしょうって……何でお前、下が水着なの？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "'How is it,' you say... why do you have a swimsuit on underneath?"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、当然ですよ。触りながら人体図を見るというやり方は教えてもらっていたのですから、肌が露出しつつも人前でも恥ずかしくないものといえば水着が一番ですよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, obviously. You'd taught me the method of looking at the anatomical chart while touching, so of course, a swimsuit is best for exposing skin without being embarrassing in front of others."

strings.text: 「本当は体操着のスパッツとかも考えたのですが、体操着は上着がだぼだぼですし、それに水着はこの前、なおくんの前で披露してますし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Actually, I did consider gym shorts, but the gym shirt is too baggy on top, and besides, I've already shown you my swimsuit before, Nao-kun."

strings.text: 謀られた。
strings.translated: I'd been played.

strings.text: なんか意味もなく期待した。
strings.translated: I'd built up my hopes for nothing.

strings.text: そして勘違いした。
strings.translated: And I'd totally misread the situation.

strings.text: 「い、いや別に……はははは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-No, it's nothing... hahaha..."

strings.text: 「笑ってもらえるかなぁ……。と思ったのですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I was hoping you'd laugh... but..."

strings.text: 「笑っただろ……。渇いた笑いではあったが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I laughed, didn't I... it was a dry laugh, though..."

strings.text:
「あはは、か、渇いた笑いでしたか……、ま、まぁ、そうですよね。
そもそも論として、なおくんが私の下着とか見たいわけないし……。
お笑いとしても成立してないよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Ahaha, a d-dry laugh, was it... w-well, of course.
To begin with, there's no way you'd want to see my underwear, Nao-kun...
So it doesn't even work as a joke."

strings.text: 「あぁ？　いや、お前の下着姿は見たいが？　それが何か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? No, I'd want to see you in your underwear? What of it?"

strings.text: 「え？　ええぇぇえ！？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Whaaaat!?"

strings.text: 稟がそのまま固まってしまう。
strings.translated: Rin froze on the spot.

strings.text:
「何を固まっている。お前の下着など見たくないわけがなかろう。
バカバカしい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"What are you freezing up for? Of course I'd want to see you in your underwear.
Don't be ridiculous."

strings.text: 「え？　ええ？　そ、そうなんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? What? R-Really?"

strings.text: 「俺の笑いが渇いていたのは、期待したからだ！　期待値があったからこそ、渇いた笑いになった。分かったか！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The reason my laugh was dry is because I got my hopes up! It was dry precisely because there was expectation involved. Got it?!"

strings.text: 「は、はいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yes!"

strings.text:
「くだらん事言ってないで、さっさとデッサンの練習をはじめるぞ。
ったく、無駄な期待させやがって」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Enough of this nonsense, let's start the sketching practice already.
Geez, getting my hopes up for nothing."

strings.text: 「えっと、えっと……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, uh..."

strings.text: 俺の率直な感想に稟は戸惑っている。
strings.translated: Rin was flustered by my blunt reaction.

strings.text: まぁ、こういう事はなるべく正直に言った方がいいだろう。
strings.translated: Well, this sort of thing is probably best said honestly.

strings.text: 率直な意見を言っておいた方が誤解も少ないし、問題も起きづらいだろう。
strings.translated: Stating my frank opinion should lead to fewer misunderstandings and fewer problems.

strings.text: これだけ直接的な言い方をしたら、さすがの稟も少しは警戒してくれるだろう。
strings.translated: If I'm this direct about it, surely even Rin would be a little more on her guard.

strings.text: 今の俺が理性を保つのは相当大変だ。
strings.translated: Right now it's taking everything I've got to hold on to my reason.

strings.text: 「えっと、下着になれば良かったのかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, so should I have stripped down to my underwear?"

strings.text: 「ち、違う！　そういう事じゃない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "T-That's not it! That's not what I meant."

strings.text: 「違うの！？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's not!?"

strings.text: 「いや、合っているが、そうじゃないだろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it is, but that's not the point!"

strings.text: 「合ってるけど違うって？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It is, but it isn't?"

strings.text: 不安そうな顔で稟が俺を見つめる。
strings.translated: Rin looked at me with an anxious expression.

strings.text: その表情がまた……。
strings.translated: And that expression, too...

strings.text: っていかん、いかん！
strings.translated: --No, no, get a hold of yourself!

strings.text: 「俺がうれしいからという理由で、お前が下着になっていたら、いろいろいかん、いかんすぎる。だからダメなの！　分かったか！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If you strip down to your underwear just because it would make me happy, that's bad, that's way too bad. So no! Got it?!"

strings.text: 「え？　え、えっと……だ、ダメって事かな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Uh, um... so... it's a no?"

strings.text: 「そう、下着じゃダメだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes, underwear is a no!"

strings.text:
なんか説明が上手く出来ない。
とりあえず、冷静になって一から説明するしかない。
strings.translated:
I can't seem to explain this well.
For now, I'll just have to calm down and explain from the beginning.

strings.text: 「い、一度しか言わないから良く聞け！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "L-Listen well, I'll only say this once!"

strings.text: 「たしかに俺はヌードデッサンを何度もやったし、女性の裸なんぞ対象物でしかない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's true that I've done nude sketches many times, and a woman's naked body is nothing more than a subject to draw."

strings.text: 「だが、誰でも単なるデッサンの対象物というわけではなさそうだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But apparently not just anyone is merely a subject for sketching."

strings.text:
「お前と俺は幼なじみだが、あの頃とはあまりに時間がかけ離れている。
お前は、綺麗に成長した」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"You and I are childhood friends, but so much time has passed since those days.
You've grown up beautifully."

strings.text: 「それは誰もが認めるところだろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's something anyone would agree with."

strings.text:
「だから、正直に言えば、お前のヌードは普通のものとは全然違う。
下着だって全然違うだろう……。特別だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"So, honestly speaking, your nude body is completely different from an ordinary one.
Even you in your underwear is completely different... it's special."

strings.text: 「そ、そそ、それって……えっと……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "T-Th-That means... um..."

strings.text: 「俺は回りくどい事は嫌いだ。だから言うが、俺はお前の身体を冷静な目では見られない。いつでも欲望の対象になりかねない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I hate beating around the bush, so I'll just say it: I can't look at your body with a calm eye. It could become an object of my desire at any moment."

strings.text: 「わ、私の身体が……なおくんの欲望の対象……ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "M-My body... an object of your desire, Nao-kun...?"

strings.text:
「ああ、そうだ。他のヌードなんか全く違う。医者の視点とか大嘘だ。
お前の下着姿はまったく別物だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Yeah, that's right. It's completely different from other nudes. The doctor's gaze thing is a total lie.
You in your underwear is something else entirely."

strings.text: 「そ、それって、なおくんがうれしいという事ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-So... does that mean it makes you happy, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだ。うれしい！　お前の下着姿を見られたらうれしいだろうし、もしヌードデッサンともなれば大はしゃぎだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. It'd make me happy! I'd be happy to see you in your underwear, and if it were a nude sketch, I'd be over the moon."

strings.text:
「ぬ、ヌードデッサンで、ですか？
えっと……そうなんだ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"A n-nude sketch, you mean?
Um... I see."

strings.text: 「……わかったか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Got it?"

strings.text: 「……よかった。ふぅ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Thank goodness. Phew."

strings.text: 「下着になりましょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Should I strip down to my underwear?"

strings.text: 「な　ん　で　だ　よ　！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W  H  Y  T  H  O  U  G  H  ?  ! "

strings.text: 「で、でもそのほうがなおくんはうれしいんだよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "B-But wouldn't that make you happier, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「うれしいけど、下着は違う！　下着じゃいかん！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It would, but underwear is a no! Underwear is not okay!"

strings.text: 「下着じゃダメなのですか？　ってもしかして裸ですか？　ヌードデッサンという事ですか！？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Underwear is not okay? Then, is it nude? You mean a nude sketch!?"

strings.text: 「違げぇ！　ヌードとかそういう問題じゃない！　だいたいこれから下半身を教えるんだぞ？　その意味が分かっているのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wroong! It's not a matter of being nude or not! Besides, I'm about to teach you the lower body, right? Do you get what that means?"

strings.text: 「え？　も、もしかして、そういうポーズを取れ的な……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Y-You mean, take that kind of pose, or something...?"

strings.text: 「そうだ！　そういうポーズ取るんだぞ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes! You'd have to take that kind of pose!"

strings.text: 「は、は、はははははははは裸でででででしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-S-So it w-w-w-would be nude?"

strings.text: 「違う！　裸で、そんなポーズしたら大変すぎだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No! Taking a pose like that in the nude would be way too much!"

strings.text: 「だから、そういうポーズを裸で取る覚悟を決めろと……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "So what you're saying is I have to be prepared to take that kind of pose in the nude..."

strings.text: 「違う、違う、裸なんかになったら、教えるどころの騒ぎじゃないだろうが！　まったく違うものだ！　それは！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, if you go and get naked, we'll be well past teaching anything! That's a completely different matter!"

strings.text: 「そ、そうですね……。だったら下着なのでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "R-Right... so does that mean underwear?"

strings.text: 「違う！　なんでそうなる！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No! How did you get there?!"

strings.text: 「わ、分からないもん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I don't know, okay?"

strings.text: 「な、なんで分からないんだよ！　そのまんまだろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-How can you not know?! It's exactly what I said!"

strings.text: 「だ、だって！！　分からないものは、分からないよ！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "B-Because!! What I don't understand, I don't understand!"

strings.text: 稟が声を荒げる。
strings.translated: Rin raised her voice.

strings.text: 「ご、ごめん。取り乱して……、でもさ、分からないんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-Sorry. Losing my composure like that... but really, I don't understand."

strings.text: 「今だって、普通通り話しているつもりだけど、私は、ちゃんとなおくんと話せているかどうかまだ分かってないんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Even now, I mean to be talking to you normally, but I still don't know whether I'm really able to talk with you properly, Nao-kun."

strings.text: 「普通に話せてるだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're talking normally, aren't you?"

strings.text: 「そう見せてるんだよ。一生懸命そう見せてるだけ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm just making it look that way. I'm trying my hardest to make it look that way..."

strings.text:
「だって……分かりませんよ。
分かるわけないです……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Because... I don't understand.
There's no way I could understand..."

strings.text: 「分からないって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You don't understand...?"

strings.text: 「私……ずっと、長い間、なおくんの事考えてきました……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I've... thought about you, Nao-kun, for a long, long time..."

strings.text: 「手紙が返ってこなくても、私がなおくんに手紙を出し続けたのはそういう理由です……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's why I kept sending you letters even when you never wrote back..."

strings.text: 「私は内心嫌われていたと思っていました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Inside, I believed you hated me."

strings.text: 「ずっと、ずっと、嫌われていると思って生きてきました……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "For the longest, longest time, I lived believing you hated me..."

strings.text: 「そんな事は――」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not--"

strings.text: 「はい、それは分かってます。この街に帰ってきて、再び会えたなおくん……分かった事はたくさんあります」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, I know that now. Since coming back to this town and meeting you again, Nao-kun... there are many things I've come to understand."

strings.text:
「それでも、まだ分からない事ばかりです。
なおくんにとって、私がどの様な存在なのか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Even so, there's still so much I don't understand.
What sort of existence I am to you, Nao-kun..."

strings.text: 「あの頃と同じ、幼なじみなのか、それとも実際は煙たがられているのか、それとも友達なのか、クラスメイトなのか……分からないのです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Whether I'm still your childhood friend the way I was back then, or whether you actually find me a nuisance, whether I'm a friend, a classmate... I don't know."

strings.text:
「ごめんなさい。いつも普通に接するだけでいっぱいいっぱいなのですよ。
だから、こんな事になると、混乱してしまいよく分からなくなってしまうのです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"I'm sorry. It's all I can do just to keep things normal between us.

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A-As wide as I possibly could?"

strings.text: 「ああ、出来る限りだ！　出来る限り、股間に布が食い込むように！　そりゃ、もう、スジがうっすら見えてくるぐらいの勢いでぴちぴちに食い込む様に開かせ！　そして凝視した！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes, as wide as possible! So the fabric would dig into your crotch as much as possible! I made you spread your legs so tightly that even the crease was barely showing through the fabric! And then I stared!"

strings.text: 「ぎょ、凝視！？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-Stared?!"

strings.text: 「ああ、軽蔑したであろう！　俺は、お前の信頼を利用して、お前のまたぐらを穴が空くほど、むしろ空いてくれという勢いで見ていた！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yes, you must despise me! Using your trust, I stared at your crotch as if to bore a hole through it -- no, willing one to open!"

strings.text: 「すまない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm sorry!"

strings.text: 「そ、そんなに見てたのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-You were looking that hard?"

strings.text: 「ああ、見ていた。うっすら股間のディティールが陰影として確認出来るぐらい、集中して見ていた！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I was looking. I was concentrating so hard I could faintly make out the details of your crotch as shadows!"

strings.text: 「な、ななな、なおくんが……そんな目で……私をぉ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-Nao-kun... looked at me... with th-that kind of gaze...?"

strings.text: 「ああ、見ていた！　見入っていた！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I was looking! I was transfixed!"

strings.text: 「見まくっていた！　すまん！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I was staring my eyes out! I'm sorry!"

strings.text: 「な、なおくんが、なおくんが……わたし、わたしのを……わたしのを……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-Nao-kun, Nao-kun was... my, my... my..."

strings.text: 軽蔑しているのだろう。
strings.translated: She must despise me.

strings.text: 稟は目を細めて俺を見つめている。
strings.translated: Rin was narrowing her eyes as she stared at me.

strings.text:
俺を恥ずかしいヤツだと思っているのだろうか？
顔を真っ赤に上気させている。
strings.translated:
Did she think I was a shameful guy?
Her face was flushed bright red.

strings.text:
腹立たしかったのだろう、悔しかったのだろう。
稟の瞳が潤んでいる。
strings.translated:
She must have been angry, must have felt bitter.
Rin's eyes were moist.

strings.text: そして、その怒りのためか、息がどんどん荒くなっていく。
strings.translated: And whether from that anger or not, her breathing was growing more and more ragged.

strings.text: 「わ、わたしをなおくんが、わたしをなおくんが……あの表情って、わたしのわたしのを……見てたなんて……わたしなんかを、なおくんが……あぁ……あぅぅ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-Nao-kun looked at me, Nao-kun was looking at me... with that expression, he was looking at my, at my... at someone like me, Nao-kun was... ahh... auu..."

strings.text: 「なおくんの表情……なおくんの表情……あ、あんな真剣だったのに……それって、わたしを、わたしを……くうぅ、わ、わたしをぉ……くふぅ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nao-kun's expression... Nao-kun's expression... he-he looked so serious, and yet... that was because of me, because of me... kuuh, m-me... kufuu..."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin?"

strings.text: 稟は独り言を延々としゃべっていた。
strings.translated: Rin was muttering to herself endlessly.

strings.text: なんか怒ってるにしては少しおかしい、なんか目の焦点が微妙に合ってない様な感じだし……息が荒いのは荒いが……。
strings.translated: Something seemed off for anger -- her eyes didn't seem quite focused... her breathing was ragged, sure, but...

strings.text: 「だ、大丈夫か？　もしかして、頭に血が上りすぎて、気分が悪いとか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A-Are you okay? Is the blood rushing to your head, are you feeling ill or something?"

strings.text: 俺は、軽く稟の肩に触れる。
strings.translated: I lightly touched Rin's shoulder.

strings.text: 「はぁはぁはぁはぁ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Haa, haa, haa, haa..."

strings.text: 「……あふぅ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "...Afuu."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin?!"

strings.text: 「え？　あ、は、はいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Ah, y-yes!"

strings.text: 「この通りだ、すまんっっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm bowing to you like this -- I'm sorry!"

strings.text: 「だ、だから、俺はお前をエロい目で見ていた！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "S-So, I was looking at you with lewd eyes!"

strings.text: 「え？　あ、うん、そ、そうだったんだね！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Ah, okay, s-so that's how it was!"

strings.text: 「いや、そうだったんだね。　じゃなくてだな！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it's not just 'so that's how it was'!"

strings.text:
「あ、あはは。そ、そんなのいいよ。だ、大丈夫だから、大丈夫だよ。なおくんがどんな目で見たって私は平気だから……。
が、我慢できるよ。今度からはちゃんと我慢するし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Ah, ahaha. Th-that's fine. I-I'm okay, it's okay. It doesn't matter what kind of eyes Nao-kun looks at me with...
I-I can bear it. I'll bear it properly from now on..."

strings.text: 「お前が我慢する事じゃないっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not something you need to bear!"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、我慢するのは気持ちよくなるのを……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, what I meant was, bearing not feeling good..."

strings.text: 「気持ちよくなるのを？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Not feeling good?"

strings.text:
「あ、何でもないです。何でも無い！
そ、そうなんだぁ。へぇ、意外ですねぇ。私なんかに少しは興味あったのですねぇ。そうなんだ！　あははは」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Ah, it's nothing. Nothing at all!
S-So that's how it was. Huh, that's surprising. So you had at least a little interest in someone like me. I see! Ahahaha."

strings.text: 「軽蔑しただろう！　軽蔑してくれ！　俺はそんなゲスなヤツだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You must despise me! Please despise me! I'm that kind of vulgar guy!"

strings.text:
「そんな軽蔑なんて……するわけないよ。
だって、男の子だったら普通な事ですよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"There's no way I'd despise you.
I mean, that's normal for a boy, right?"

strings.text: 「いや、お前は俺を信頼してくれていたわけなんだから！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, but you were trusting me!"

strings.text: 「で、でも、そ、そうなんだ。普通の男の子がそうするように……なおくんがわたしを……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "B-But, so that's how it is. Just like a normal boy... Nao-kun was looking at me..."

strings.text: 「な、なおくんが、わたしで興奮してたんだ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-Nao-kun was getting aroused by me..."

strings.text: 「ああ、興奮してた！　す、すまん！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I was aroused! I-I'm sorry!"

strings.text:
「あ、うん。そうだね！　でも、ぜ、全然分からなかったよ！
逆にいつもより冷静に見えたのに……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Ah, yeah. Right! But I-I couldn't tell at all!
If anything, you looked calmer than usual..."

strings.text: 「ああ、俺も驚いた！　途中から人格でも入れ替わった様に、冷静かつ沈着に、お前の股間を視姦していたんだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I was surprised too! Partway through, it was like my personality got swapped out -- I was coolly, composedly eye-raping your crotch!"

strings.text: 「し、ししし視姦！？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eye-eye-eye-raping?!"

strings.text: 「す、すまん！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "S-Sorry!"

strings.text: 突如稟が立ち上がる。
strings.translated: Suddenly Rin stood up.

strings.text: 俺は踏みつけられると思ったが……。
strings.translated: I thought she was going to stomp on me, but...

strings.text: いきなり走りだしドアを閉められる。
strings.translated: She suddenly bolted off and shut the door.

strings.text:
そりゃそうだ……。
と思った次の瞬間。
strings.translated:
Well, of course...
Or so I thought, in the next moment.

strings.text: 「も、問題ありません！　少しトイレです！　なおくんは悪く無いので、そのままでお願いします！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-No problem! I'm just going to the bathroom for a bit! Nao-kun didn't do anything wrong, so please stay as you are!"

strings.text: 「え？　あ、えっと……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Ah, um..."

strings.text: 「そのままリラックスしていてください！　よろしくお願いします！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Please just relax where you are! Thank you very much!"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yes..."

strings.text: 丁寧な言葉ではあったが、なんか分からん稟の気迫に気圧される。
strings.translated: Her words were polite, but I was overwhelmed by some inexplicable intensity from Rin.

strings.text: 「ど、どうしたの？　お前？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-What's wrong with you?"

strings.text: 「え？　な、なにがかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? W-What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「いや……トイレでなにをしてたのかなぁ……って」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No... I was just wondering what you were doing in the bathroom..."

strings.text: 「た、たいした事してないよ。え、えっとね。ちょっとトイレで用を足そうと思ったらなんか失敗しちゃってね。えへへ我慢してたからかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-It's nothing much. Um, well, I went to the bathroom to relieve myself and I kind of messed up. Ehehe, maybe because I'd been holding it?"

strings.text: 「そういえば、急いでトイレに駆け込んだもんな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Now that you mention it, you did dash into the bathroom in a hurry."

strings.text: 「うん、そうだね。トイレ我慢してたからね。急いで入ったんだよ。うん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I was holding it in, so I rushed in. Yeah."

strings.text: 「そうか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see."

strings.text: 「い、急いで水着を洗ったんだよ。トイレじゃ着替えも無いしね。あ、でもユニットバスだから洗うのには事欠かなかったんだけどね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I hurriedly washed my swimsuit. There wasn't any change of clothes in the bathroom, either. Ah, but it's a unit bath, so there was no shortage of ways to wash it."

strings.text:
待ってる時間に、トイレから水の音がすごい勢いで聞こえて驚いたが……。
そういう事だったのか……。
strings.translated:
While I was waiting, I'd been startled to hear the sound of water rushing at tremendous force from the bathroom...
So that's what that was about...

strings.text: それにしても……。
strings.translated: Even so...

strings.text: 「そこまで細かく説明する事もないぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You don't have to explain in that much detail..."

strings.text: 「あ、そ、そうだね。あはは……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, r-right. Ahaha..."

strings.text: たしかに最初に聞いたのは、俺ではあるけれども……。
strings.translated: Sure, I was the one who first brought it up, but...

strings.text:
「それにしても、やっぱりこの教え方は良くないね。うん良くない。
たしかに良く分かるけど、なんか良くないかもしれないね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Still, this way of teaching really isn't good. Yeah, not good.
I mean, I do understand it well, but somehow it might not be good."

strings.text: 「それに、もうだいたい太ももまわりも教わったし、うん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "And you've mostly taught me about the thighs already, so, yeah."

strings.text: 「そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's true."

strings.text: 「あとは服を着てでいいかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The rest we can do with clothes on, right?"

strings.text: 「ああ、もちろんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, of course."

strings.text: 「んじゃ、着替えるね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well then, I'm going to change."

strings.text: 「えっと……着替え、一応見ちゃだめだからね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um... you can't peek while I change, okay?"

strings.text: 「み、見るわけないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "L-Like I would!"

strings.text: 「うん、恥ずかしいから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's embarrassing..."

strings.text: 「というか、俺少し外に出てるからっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Actually, I'll step outside for a bit."

strings.text: 「あ、なおくん……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, Nao-kun..."

strings.text: 「なんだか……いろいろ大変だな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This is... a lot to deal with."

strings.text: 「なんだかな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really..."

strings.text: 元々何もなかったわけじゃない。
strings.translated: It wasn't like there'd been nothing to begin with.

strings.text: ずっと無い様にしてきたに過ぎない。
strings.translated: It was only that I'd kept it hidden all this time.

strings.text: 「だから、ほんの少しでも気持ちが傾いてしまえば、そんなタイミングが出来てしまえば……後は転がる様に……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So if my feelings tilt even a little, if that kind of opening opens up... after that, they'll just tumble..."

strings.text: 俺は、彼女に対する気持ちへの、大きな変化を感じ始めていた。
strings.translated: I was starting to feel a large shift in my feelings toward her.

strings.text: 稟は昼飯を作ってくれている。
strings.translated: Rin was making lunch.

strings.text: まぁ、何かいろいろあったが、その後はなんとか落ち着いて教える事が出来た。
strings.translated: Well, various things had happened, but afterward I'd somehow managed to teach her calmly.

strings.text:
しかし自分でも驚いた。
あれほど、自分が欲望に忠実であったとは……。
strings.translated:
Still, I'd surprised even myself.
To think I could be that obedient to my desires...

strings.text: とはいいつつも……。
strings.translated: But even so...

strings.text: 鼻歌を歌いながら料理を作る稟の後ろ姿を見つめていると、（自分を弁護している様だが）少しだけ仕方がない様にも思えた。
strings.translated: Watching Rin's back as she hummed and cooked, I could feel -- though this sounded like an excuse for myself -- that it was a little unavoidable.

strings.text: 本当に綺麗になった。
strings.translated: She really had become beautiful.

strings.text: 顔ももちろんだが、身体だって申し分ない。
