strings.translated: Her face, of course, but her body left nothing to be desired either.

strings.text: それに、元々から俺は稟の事が嫌いなわけじゃない。
strings.translated: On top of that, I'd never disliked Rin to begin with.

strings.text: むしろ、ガキの頃から淡い恋心に似たものを感じていた。
strings.translated: If anything, since childhood I'd felt something like a faint affection for her.

strings.text: たぶん、あのままずっと一緒にいたら、あるいは、ただの幼なじみで居られたかどうかも怪しい。
strings.translated: Maybe, if we'd stayed together like that, it was doubtful we'd have remained just childhood friends.

strings.text: 「普通ではいられなかったかもな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I might not have been able to stay 'normal'..."

strings.text: 実際にその後は離ればなれであったから、あのままならばどうなったのか、本当は良く分からない。
strings.translated: In reality, we'd been separated afterward, so I really didn't know what would have happened had things gone on.

strings.text: けど、少なくとも今言える事として、もう普通でいられる自信はない。
strings.translated: But at the very least, one thing I could say now was that I no longer had the confidence to stay normal.

strings.text: 「だからこそ、気をつけないといけないのに……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Which is exactly why I have to be careful..."

strings.text: まったく自分の事ながら不用意というか……なんと言うか……。
strings.translated: Even for me it was careless -- or however you wanted to put it...

strings.text: 困ったものだ。
strings.translated: Troublesome.

strings.text: 「さぁ、料理出来ましたよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "There, the food's ready."

strings.text: 「ああ、配膳手伝うよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, I'll help serve."

strings.text: 「いいですよ。自分で運べますから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's fine. I can carry it myself."

strings.text: 二人で料理を食べる。
strings.translated: The two of us ate together.

strings.text: 稟の手料理。
strings.translated: Rin's home cooking.

strings.text: 何度も口にしているが本当に美味しい。
strings.translated: I'd had it plenty of times, but it was truly delicious.

strings.text: 彼女らしく、この短期間で俺の舌に合わせた味付けをしてくれている。
strings.translated: In her characteristic way, she'd matched the seasoning to my palate over this short time.

strings.text: 「ぷはぁ、食った食った……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Phew, I'm stuffed, stuffed..."

strings.text:
「す、すごい……全部食べると思わなかったよ。
ありがとう……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Th-that's amazing... I didn't think you'd eat it all.
Thank you..."

strings.text:
「ごちそうされたのは俺なんだから、お礼を言うのは俺だろ？
だいたい、出されればそりゃ全部食べるだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I'm the one being treated, so shouldn't I be the one thanking you?
Besides, when it's served, of course I'll eat it all."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、この量って、なおくんが足りなかったなら嫌だなぁ。と思ってすごく多めに作ったのですよ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, I was worried this portion might not be enough for you, so I made a lot extra..."

strings.text: 「残ったらもったいないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It'd be a waste if it were left over."

strings.text: 「余り物は余り物で、また調理し直せる様に作ったから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The leftovers can be re-cooked, I made it that way..."

strings.text:
「ほう、そういう考え方はなかった……。
どうやるんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Oh, I hadn't thought of that...
How?"

strings.text: 「こっちのポトフとか、あとからデミグラスソースを入れればシチューっぽくなって、さらにそれをグラタン皿に入れて上にチーズをかけてオーブンで焼けば」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "This pot-au-feu here -- if you add demiglace sauce later, it becomes stew-like, then you put that in a gratin dish, top it with cheese, and bake it in the oven --"

strings.text: 「……たしかに、デミグラスのグラタンになるな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...You're right, it'd become demiglace gratin."

strings.text: 「はい……徐々に水分を飛ばしていきながら長時間煮込む事になるのでおいしいですよ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes... you slowly let the moisture cook off while simmering for a long time, so it's delicious..."

strings.text: 「ふーん……なんかいろいろ器用だな。本当に家庭的なんだな稟は」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh... you really are versatile. You're truly domestic, aren't you, Rin."

strings.text: 「え？　あ、はい、ありがとうございます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Ah, yes, thank you very much."

strings.text: 「お前と暮らせたら大層楽ちんだろうなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Living with you would be really easy."

strings.text: 「わ、私と暮らすですか。あははは。そうかなぁ。結構、家だとだらしないよ私は……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "L-Living with me? Ahahaha. I wonder. I'm actually pretty sloppy at home..."

strings.text: 「だらしないヤツの部屋じゃないだろ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This isn't the room of someone sloppy..."

strings.text: 「それは、何もないからだよ……えへへ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's only because there's nothing here... ehehe."

strings.text: 「……たしかに」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...True."

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "...Yeah."

strings.text: 稟の頬はいつもより赤い、それはこの部屋で二人っきりになってからだが、なんだか今では目すら潤んでいる様に見える……。
strings.translated: Rin's cheeks were redder than usual. That had been since we were alone in this room together, but now even her eyes seemed to be growing moist...

strings.text: しゃべり方もいつもよりたどたどしくなっている……。
strings.translated: Her way of speaking was more halting than usual too...

strings.text: 「稟、お前、熱とかないよな？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin, you don't have a fever, do you?"

strings.text: 「え？　え？　あ、いいえ、そんな事ありませんよっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Eh? A-Ah, no, nothing like that!"

strings.text: 「そうか？　だったら良いが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really? Well, if you say so..."

strings.text: 「ほ、ほら、こんな元気ですよー」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-See, I'm full of energy!"

strings.text: と言って、稟は力こぶを作るポーズを作る。
strings.translated: Saying that, Rin struck a pose flexing her biceps.

strings.text: 前もあったな、これ……。
strings.translated: She'd done this before too...

strings.text: 「そのポーズと元気はあまり関係ないと思うが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't think that pose has much to do with being full of energy..."

strings.text: 「と、とりあえず、お茶いれてきますね！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A-Anyway, I'll go make some tea!"

strings.text: 「あ、それぐらい俺がするよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, I can do that much myself."

strings.text: 「何を言ってるんですか、今日はなおくんはお客様です。それに絵を教えてくださった先生なのですから、どんと構えてください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What are you saying? Today Nao-kun is a guest. And you're the teacher who taught me painting, so please just sit back and relax."

strings.text: そう言うと素早く稟はキッチンの方に消えていく。
strings.translated: Saying so, Rin quickly disappeared toward the kitchen.

strings.text: 足取りは普通だな。
strings.translated: Her gait was normal.

strings.text: 風邪ってわけじゃないか……。
strings.translated: So it's not a cold, huh...

strings.text: だったらあの目の潤みは……。
strings.translated: Then that moistness in her eyes was...

strings.text: 考えるのはよそう……。
strings.translated: Let's not think about it...

strings.text:
それよりも、このタイミングでお茶とは気が利く。
学校でもそうだが、二人っきりでも本当に気が利くんだな……。稟は。
strings.translated:
More than that, tea at this timing was pretty considerate.
She's like this at school too, but even alone together she's really thoughtful... Rin is.

strings.text: 彼女の後ろ姿を見ながらぼんやりとそんな事を考えていた。
strings.translated: Watching her back, I vaguely thought about that.

strings.text:
「このまま何もしないっていうのもな……。
後片付けぐらいは手伝えるだろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Just sitting here doing nothing is a bit much...
I can at least help clean up..."

strings.text: 畳の上に散らかった資料のたぐいをまとめる。
strings.translated: I gathered up the reference materials scattered across the tatami.

strings.text: 「とりあえずまとめたものを置いておくか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For now, I'll set the gathered stuff aside..."

strings.text: 俺は勉強机の上に本をまとめる。
strings.translated: I stacked the books on the study desk.

strings.text: 「このピンク色の机、子供の時から使ってるやつだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This pink desk -- it's the one she's been using since she was a kid..."

strings.text: 物持ちがいいのだな。
strings.translated: She really takes care of her things.

strings.text: 机の裏にシールが貼ってある。
strings.translated: There was a sticker stuck on the back of the desk.

strings.text: たしか、俺が駄菓子屋で買ったおまけについてきたもんだ。
strings.translated: I think it was a bonus that came with something I bought at the candy shop.

strings.text: こんなもんまでそのままとはな。
strings.translated: To think she'd kept even something like this...

strings.text: 懐かしい。
strings.translated: It brings back memories.

strings.text: あの頃の部屋……すべてはもう失われてしまったが、こうやって机だけは……、
strings.translated: That room back then... it's all lost now, but the desk alone, kept like this...

strings.text: 「いやいや……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no..."

strings.text: 俺は頭を振る。
strings.translated: I shook my head.

strings.text: 何をくだらない事を思いだしてるんだ。
strings.translated: What ridiculous things am I remembering.

strings.text: 「机が懐かしい……。それだけで十分だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The desk brings back memories... that's enough on its own."

strings.text: 俺はふたたび机を撫でる。
strings.translated: I stroked the desk again.

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hm?"

strings.text: 一番下の引き出しが閉まりきっていない……。
strings.translated: The bottom drawer wasn't fully closed...

strings.text: 俺はその引き出しを閉めようとする……が、
strings.translated: I tried to close the drawer... but,

strings.text: 「なんだ？　これ？　なんか引っかかってないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's this? Something caught in it?"

strings.text: 閉めようとすると、また押し出される様に少しだけ引き出しが飛び出る。
strings.translated: When I tried to close it, the drawer popped back out slightly, as if pushed from within.

strings.text: 「引き出しの裏側に何か挟まってる……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Something's stuck behind the drawer..."

strings.text: 俺は引き出しを軽く開けてみる。
strings.translated: I opened the drawer lightly.

strings.text: 「ってぇえ！　何やってるんですかぁぁああ！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Waaait! What are you doooing!?"

strings.text: 稟が走り込むように俺の目の前に立つ。
strings.translated: Rin came running and stood right in front of me.

strings.text: 「え？　いや、引き出しが閉まらないから……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? No, the drawer wouldn't close, so..."

strings.text: 「あ、そ、それね。古いから仕方がないんだよ。うん。だからそこから一刻も早く離れなさい……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, th-that. It's old, so there's no helping it. Yeah. So please step away from there this instant..."

strings.text: 「な、なんで命令形なんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-why the commanding tone..."

strings.text: 「え？　命令形？　そ、そうでしたか？　でもそんな事ありませんよ。お願いですよ。お願い」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Commanding? W-was it? But no, nothing of the sort. Please. I'm begging you."

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ、たしかに勝手に開けたのは俺が悪いし……すまなかった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well, it's true I was in the wrong for opening it without asking... sorry about that."

strings.text: 「い、いえいえ、問題ございません。さぁ、さぁ、こちらの座布団に腰掛けてくださいませ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no, no, no problem at all. Now, now, please take a seat on this cushion."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

strings.text: 俺がその場を離れると稟は引き出しを全開にしてから何かを取り出す。
strings.translated: Once I stepped away, Rin pulled the drawer all the way open and took something out.

strings.text: 稟はそれを洋服の中に入れて、そそくさとその場から立ち去る。
strings.translated: She tucked it into her clothes and hastily left the spot.

strings.text: 「えへへ、これでちゃんと引き出し閉まるから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ehehe, now the drawer will close properly."

strings.text: 「ああ、すまなかった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, sorry about that."

strings.text: ノートほどの大きさのものを稟は抱きかかえている。
strings.translated: What Rin was clutching was about the size of a notebook.

strings.text: それが何か分からないが、人には見られたくないものだったのだろう。
strings.translated: I didn't know what it was, but it must have been something she didn't want anyone to see.

strings.text: 「えっと、これ粗茶ですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, this is just some plain tea, but..."

strings.text: 「ありがとう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Thanks."

strings.text: 「えへへへ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ehehehe..."

strings.text: それ飲みづらいだろ……稟。
strings.translated: That'll be hard to drink like that... Rin.

strings.text:
数冊のノートなのだろう。
服の上からでも分かるぐらいにふくらんでいる。
strings.translated:
It must have been a few notebooks.
They bulged out visibly even through her clothes.

strings.text: おなかにそんなもんを仕込んだらお茶を飲むのも一苦労だろう……。
strings.translated: With something like that stuffed against her stomach, even drinking tea must be a struggle...

strings.text: 「あ、あのさ……稟」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-hey... Rin."

strings.text: 「なんでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes?"

strings.text: 「トイレ借りられる？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Can I borrow your bathroom?"

strings.text: 「だ、大丈夫ですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-sure, no problem."

strings.text: 「ああ……すまない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah... sorry."

strings.text: とりあえずトイレに入り、稟だけの時間を作ってやる。
strings.translated: For the moment, I went into the bathroom to give Rin some time alone.

strings.text: その間にどこかに隠すであろう。
strings.translated: She'd probably hide it somewhere in the meantime.

strings.text: 「ふぅ、どうも調子狂うな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Phew, my rhythm's really thrown off."

strings.text: ずっと離れていた幼なじみ。
strings.translated: A childhood friend I'd been apart from for so long.

strings.text: 稟の言う通り、距離感がつかみづらい。
strings.translated: Just as Rin said, it's hard to gauge the distance between us.

strings.text: 「二人ともあの頃は幼かったからな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "We were both so young back then..."

strings.text: 机の中に秘密などなかった。
strings.translated: There were no secrets inside her desk then.

strings.text: けど、あれから長い時間が経ったのだ……秘密がいくらでもあっても不思議じゃない。
strings.translated: But a lot of time has passed since... it wouldn't be strange for her to have any number of secrets.

strings.text: 「きゃ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kya."

strings.text: 何かが崩れる音と共に稟の悲鳴が聞こえる。
strings.translated: Along with the sound of something collapsing, I heard Rin cry out.

strings.text: 「な、何だ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what the...?"

strings.text: 「り、稟！　どうした！？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "R-Rin! What happened!?"

strings.text: 「あいたた……。え？　あ？　ええ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Owww... Huh? Ah? Eeeh?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey... Rin..."

strings.text: 「そ、それって？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "T-that means...?"

strings.text: 「え？　あ？　え、えっと……これは……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Huh? Ah? Uh, um... this is..."

strings.text: 何　故　か　大量のエロ漫画に稟が埋まっている。
strings.translated: For some reason, Rin was buried under a huge pile of ero manga.

strings.text: 「何それ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's that?"

strings.text: 「え、えっと……お、思い出の品かな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-uh... a m-memento, maybe?"

strings.text: 「思い出の品って……もしかしてそれ、俺たちが昔拾ったエロ漫画？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A memento... don't tell me, that's the ero manga we picked up back then?"

strings.text: 「さっき机の下に隠してたのって……それなのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that what you were hiding under the desk earlier?"

strings.text: 「あははは、面目ない……です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahahaha, I'm... mortified."

strings.text: 「それにしても何でその量？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But why is there so much of it?"

strings.text: 「え、えっと……その……捨てられなくて……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-uh... well... I couldn't throw them away..."

strings.text: 「というか、拾ったエロマンガってそんな量は無かったんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I mean, there wasn't that much of the ero manga we picked up, was there?"

strings.text: 「こ、これはっっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-these!"

strings.text: 「あ、あの、あのですね……なんといいますか、その……気になる連載がありまして……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um, well... how do I put it, uh... there was a serial I was interested in..."

strings.text: 「もしかしてそのまま買ってたの？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't tell me you kept buying them?"

strings.text: 「は、はい……全部揃えられたわけではないのですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yes... I couldn't collect the entire set, but..."

strings.text: 「そ、そうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I see..."

strings.text: 思い出の品。
strings.translated: Mementos.

strings.text: まぁ、たしかにそういうものだ。
strings.translated: Well, that's certainly what they were.

strings.text: 稟と俺は良くゴミ拾いをした。
strings.translated: Rin and I used to pick up trash together often.

strings.text: という名目でエロマンガを集めていた。
strings.translated: Under that pretense, we collected ero manga.

strings.text: 真夏の夕方。
strings.translated: A midsummer evening.

strings.text: 長い長い夕方。
strings.translated: A long, long evening.

strings.text: あれは河川敷だったと思う。
strings.translated: I think it was down by the riverbed.

strings.text: 細かくは覚えてない。
strings.translated: I don't remember the details.

strings.text: ただ一つ分かるのは、子供時代によくありふれた光景。
strings.translated: The only thing I know is, it was a scene common enough in any childhood.

strings.text: 俺は草むらでエロ漫画を見つけていた。
strings.translated: I found an ero manga in the grass.

strings.text: それがヌード写真ならばそれほど興味を示さなかったかもしれない。
strings.translated: If it had been nude photos, maybe I wouldn't have shown much interest.

strings.text: 正直、女性の裸などヌードデッサンで見飽きていたし、俺は裸というのをそういう目でしか見る事が出来なかった。
strings.translated: Honestly, I'd seen enough female nudes in life-drawing classes, and I could only look at nudity through that kind of lens.

strings.text: だからストーリーがあるマンガは、俺にはじめて、女性の裸というものの意味を教えてくれた。
strings.translated: So the manga, with its story, was the first thing to teach me what a woman's nude body actually meant.

strings.text: 数分、いや数十分……もしかしたら一時間ぐらい経っていたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: A few minutes, no, tens of minutes... maybe even an hour had gone by.

strings.text: あまり集中しすぎて、俺は背後の人間の存在に気がつかなかった。
strings.translated: I was so absorbed I didn't notice the presence of someone behind me.
"...staaare."

strings.text: 「って、わぁ、稟！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whoa, waaah, Rin!"

strings.text: 「わぁ、お、驚いた……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Waah, y-you scared me..."

strings.text: 「こっちが驚くわ。な、何で黙って見てるんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're the one who scared me. Wh-why are you just watching in silence!"

strings.text: 「何度か呼んだんだけど……なおくん気がつかなくて……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I called out to you a few times, but... Nao-kun, you didn't notice..."

strings.text: 「それに絵以外で、こんな集中してるなおくん見るのはじめてだったから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Besides, I'd never seen you concentrate like that on anything other than drawing..."

strings.text: 「そ、そんなに集中してたか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-was I really concentrating that hard?"

strings.text: 「うん、すごくしてた……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, incredibly..."

strings.text: 「絵以外って……これだって絵ではある」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Other than drawing... this counts as a drawing too."

strings.text: 「どんな絵なの？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What kind of drawing is it?"

strings.text: 「わ、わわわ、見るなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-wa-waaah, don't look!"

strings.text: 「え、う、うん！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh, o-okay!"

strings.text: そう言うと、稟はそのまま後ろを向く。
strings.translated: With that, Rin turned around.

strings.text: 「こ、これでいいんだよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-this is fine, right?"

strings.text: 「いや、後ろを向くとかじゃなくて……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, it's not about turning around..."

strings.text: 「だったらどうしたらいいの？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then what should I do?"

strings.text: 「どうしたらって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What should you do..."

strings.text: 「なおくんが言うから見ちゃいけないけど……それが何なのかは興味あるし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You told me not to look, but... I'm curious what it is..."

strings.text: 「興味あるって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Curious, huh..."

strings.text: 逆に見せたら引いてくれるだろうとか思ったのだろうか？
strings.translated: Had I thought that if I showed her, she'd back off?

strings.text: それとも、興味がありながら健気に俺の言う事を聞く稟を不憫に思ったのだろうか……。
strings.translated: Or did I feel sorry for Rin, obediently listening to me even though she was curious...

strings.text: 細かくは覚えていない。
strings.translated: I don't remember the details.

strings.text: ただ覚えているのは……。
strings.translated: What I do remember is...

strings.text: 気がつくと、俺と稟は二人でそれを見入っていた。
strings.translated: Before I knew it, the two of us were poring over it together.

strings.text: 「こ、これって……何やってるのかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wh-what are they doing?"

strings.text: 「知らん。俺だって分からん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Beats me. I don't know either."

strings.text: 「でも……なおくん……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But... Nao-kun..."

strings.text: 「嫌なら見るな。見るなら黙って見ろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If you don't like it, don't look. If you're going to look, look in silence!"

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Staaare..."

strings.text: 熟読する稟。
strings.translated: Rin, reading intently.

strings.text: その横顔を今でも覚えている。
strings.translated: I still remember her profile even now.

strings.text: 幼い肌がしっとりと濡れていた。
strings.translated: Her young skin was faintly damp.

strings.text: 肌の色は夕日で分からない。
strings.translated: The color of her skin was lost in the evening sun.

strings.text: ただ真剣に見つめる瞳が微妙に潤んでいた事だけが印象的だった。
strings.translated: Only the way her serious eyes glistened ever so slightly stuck with me.

strings.text: 昼に焼かれたコンクリートが熱を持ち、橋桁の下はまだ蒸し暑い。
strings.translated: The concrete, baked by the day's sun, still held its heat, and it was muggy under the bridge girder.

strings.text: 二人とも汗でシャツまでぐっしょりだった。
strings.translated: Both of us were soaked with sweat right through our shirts.

strings.text: それでも、二人はそれ以上言葉を交わさなかった。
strings.translated: Even so, we exchanged no more words.

strings.text: ただ何度もそのマンガを読み返した。
strings.translated: We just read that manga over and over again.

strings.text: 帰りのチャイムがなってからも見ていたが、徐々に橋桁の下では暗くて読めなくなってしまう。
strings.translated: We kept reading even after the "time to go home" chime rang, but gradually it grew too dark to read under the bridge.

strings.text: 「お前の家、厳しいんだろ？　帰らないとまずいだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Your family's strict, right? You'll be in trouble if you don't get home."

strings.text: 「う、うん……そうだね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yeah... that's right."

strings.text: 「だったら帰ろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then let's head back."

strings.text: 「そうだね。帰らないと……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah. I have to get home..."

strings.text: 俺は稟の手を握って立ち上がる。
strings.translated: I took Rin's hand and stood up.

strings.text: 稟の手の中は恐ろしく熱く汗でぐっしょりしていた。
strings.translated: Her hand was terrifyingly hot, drenched in sweat.

strings.text: 「ど、どうしたの？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wh-what's wrong?"

strings.text: 「あ、い、いや……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, n-no..."

strings.text: 子供時代。
strings.translated: Childhood.

strings.text: それまで何度でも稟の手を握った事があった。
strings.translated: Up until then, I'd held Rin's hand countless times.

strings.text: でも今までその行為に何も感じる事は無かった。
strings.translated: But I'd never felt anything from the act before.

strings.text: 俺はいつでも無邪気に稟と手をつないでいた。
strings.translated: I'd always innocently held Rin's hand.

strings.text: だがその日の俺は……。
strings.translated: But that day, I was...

strings.text: 「あ、いや、俺の手、汗だらけだから……握るの悪いかなぁって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, my hand's all sweaty, so... I thought it'd be rude to hold yours..."

strings.text: 「ううん。全然悪くないよ。それに私の手も汗だらけだから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No. Not at all. My hand's all sweaty too."

strings.text: 「そ、そうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Y-yeah."

strings.text: 「なんかお前の手……熱いな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Your hand feels... kind of hot..."

strings.text: 「な、なおくんこそ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-you're one to talk, Nao-kun..."

strings.text: 沈黙。
strings.translated: Silence.

strings.text: 幼い二人にこんな長い沈黙の時などあっただろうか……。
strings.translated: Had two children so young ever shared such a long silence...

strings.text: 何も話せずにいると稟が口をひらいた。
strings.translated: When neither of us could speak, Rin opened her mouth.

strings.text: 「か、帰ろうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Sh-shall we head home?"

strings.text: 「ああ、帰ろう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, let's."

strings.text: 稟がにっこりと笑う。
strings.translated: Rin smiled brightly.

strings.text: 俺は目を伏せてそのままきびすを返す。
strings.translated: I lower my eyes and turn on my heel.

strings.text: 「あ、なおくん……待って……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, Nao-kun... wait..."

strings.text: 「ゴミって放置してちゃダメだよ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You can't just leave trash lying around..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, pretty much."

strings.text: 「この前も子供会でゴミをたくさん集めたよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The other day too, at the children's group, we collected a lot of trash."

strings.text: 「あれは子供会だからであってな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That was because it was the children's group..."

strings.text: 「でも、普通の時だってゴミを見つけたらゴミ捨てに捨ててるよね。なおくん……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But even normally, when you find trash, you throw it in the trash can. Right, Nao-kun...?"

strings.text: 「い、いや……それは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "N-no... that's..."

strings.text: 昔から、意味不明なところで正義感があった。
strings.translated: Since long ago, I've had a sense of justice in the most nonsensical places.

strings.text: たばこのぽい捨てを見れば、左右確認した後、道路まで飛び出して、水につけてからゴミ捨てに入れた。
strings.translated: If I saw someone toss a cigarette butt, I'd check both ways, dart out into the road, douse it in water, and drop it in the trash.

strings.text: とは言っても、これとそれとは訳が違う。
strings.translated: That said, this and that are different matters.

strings.text: 「そ、それはいいんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-this is fine as is."

strings.text: 「これは、このままでいいの？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You're leaving it like this?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだ。このままでいいんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. It's fine as is."

strings.text: 「それはおかしいよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's weird."

strings.text: 稟がそのエロマンガを手に取る。
strings.translated: Rin picks up one of the ero manga.

strings.text: 「私が捨てておくね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'll go throw them out."

strings.text: 「だ、ダメかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-that's no good?"

strings.text: 「いや、いいんじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, sure, that's fine."

strings.text: 「そうだよね。今までだってちゃんとゴミ捨てはしてたんだから」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Right? I've always been diligent about throwing out trash, after all."

strings.text: 「あれは捨てるために集めてたと思っていたが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I thought you were collecting them in order to throw them out."

strings.text: 「う、うん。そのつもりだったんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yeah. That was the plan."

strings.text: 「でも、まぁ、捨てるに捨てられないよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But, well, they're not so easy to throw away, are they."

strings.text: 俺は稟に覆い被さったエロ漫画の一冊を取り出す。
strings.translated: I pull out one of the ero manga Rin had been sprawled on top of.

strings.text: 「懐かしいなぁ。これとかエロかったよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, memories. This one was pretty erotic, wasn't it."

strings.text: そう言って稟に見せる。
strings.translated: I say that and show it to Rin.

strings.text: 「う、うん、絵も可愛いし、話も結構おもしろかった」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yeah, the art was cute, and the story was pretty interesting too."

strings.text: 「この作家、その後一般誌にうつって、その漫画がアニメ化までされたんだぜ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This author later moved to mainstream magazines, and one of the manga even got an anime adaptation."

strings.text: 「え？　そ、そうなんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? R-really?"

strings.text: 「やはり知らないか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You didn't know, huh."

strings.text: 稟のエロ漫画を眺める。
strings.translated: I look over Rin's ero manga.

strings.text: たしかに量は増えてはいるが、全種類というわけではない。
strings.translated: It's true the quantity has grown, but she doesn't have every kind.

strings.text: たぶん田舎では、マイナーエロ漫画など手に入らなかったのだろう。
strings.translated: Out in the countryside, she probably couldn't get hold of the more obscure ero manga.

strings.text: ましてや、その後、その作家がどうなったかなんて稟が調べられるはずもない。
strings.translated: Much less would Rin have been able to look up what became of those authors afterward.

strings.text: 「この作家の漫画読まないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Want to read this author's manga?"

strings.text: 「え？　読ませてくれるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? You'd let me read them?"

strings.text: 「ああ、他にもいろいろな作家が一般誌にうつって活躍したし、お前が持ってないエロ漫画だともっと可愛い絵を描く作家もデビューしたぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, and lots of other authors went on to work in mainstream magazines too. Some of the artists who draw even cuter than the ero manga you own have debuted since."

strings.text: 「ほ、本当ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "R-really?"

strings.text: 「ああ、だから貸してやるよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, so I'll lend them to you."

strings.text: 「は、はいっ。是非っっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yes, please! By all means!"

strings.text: 「……って、くくく……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...pfft, hehehe..."

strings.text: 「え？　どうしましたか？　いきなり笑い出して？　何か変でしたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? What's the matter? Bursting out laughing all of a sudden? Was something strange?"

strings.text: 「ああ、変だ。やっぱり稟は変だなぁってさ、帰ってきて完璧超人みたいなヤツになってたから、内心少しびびってたんだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's strange. As I thought, Rin really is strange. When you came back you'd turned into this perfect superhuman type, so honestly I'd been a bit intimidated inside..."

strings.text: 「いやぁ、エロ漫画を借りられると聞いて目をきらきらさせるなんて」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But nah -- getting told you can borrow ero manga and your eyes just light up like that."

strings.text: 「うっ……た、たしかに、おかしいですよね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ugh... that's t-true, it is odd, isn't it..."

strings.text: 「変ですよね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's weird, isn't it..."

strings.text: 「ああ、まぁ変だろうな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's probably weird."

strings.text: 「で、でも、私はやっぱりその作家さん達が好きですから……やはり新作が読めるのはうれしいです……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "B-but I still love those artists, so... being able to read new works by them really does make me happy..."

strings.text: なるほど、稟はやはり稟という事か……。
strings.translated: I see -- Rin is Rin after all.

strings.text: 「えっちなお話が好きなんて、おかしな女の子ですよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A girl who loves lewd stories -- I really am a strange girl, aren't I."

strings.text: 「まぁ、おかしいかもしれないが、俺だって好きだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, it may be strange, but I love them too."

strings.text: 「エロ漫画家には絵が上手い人は多いし、メジャー漫画にない熱気だってある。お前が楽しく読んだっておかしくはないだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There are lots of ero manga artists whose art is superb, and they have a passion you don't find in mainstream manga. It's not strange for you to enjoy them."

strings.text: 「なら、今から俺の家に行くか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So, want to come over to my place right now?"

strings.text: 「い、今からですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "R-right now?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、今度でもいいけど、まだ時間あるだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, another time is fine too, but you still have time, don't you?"

strings.text: 「はい、是非行きましょう」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, by all means, let's go."

strings.text: 「ああ、んじゃ出かけるか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "All right, let's head out then."

strings.text: 稟のアパートがある小音羽から俺のマンションがある桜ヶ原町までは電車に乗った後、いつもの通学路を使う。
strings.translated: From Ko-Otowa, where Rin's apartment is, to Sakuragahara, where my condo is, we take the train and then use the usual route to school.

strings.text: いつもの通学路を少し外れた所で……。
strings.translated: And then, just a little off our usual route to school...

strings.text: 香奈
strings.translated: Kana

strings.text: 「わーーーっ、直哉くん、ひさしぶり！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Waaah, Naoya-kun, long time no see!"

strings.text: なんでこいつに出会う？
strings.translated: Why do I keep running into her?

strings.text: 「すごい、すごい、偶然ってあるんだねぇ……。ぜぇぜぇはぁはぁ……」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Amazing, amazing -- coincidences really do happen... huff, puff, haah, haah..."

strings.text: と誰がどう見ても全速力で走ったヤツが、偶然を装って再びあらわれる。
strings.translated: Anyone with eyes could see she'd sprinted here at full tilt, and here she comes again feigning coincidence.

strings.text: 「いくぞ、稟」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Let's go, Rin."

strings.text: 俺は稟の手をひく。
strings.translated: I take Rin's hand.

strings.text:
「って、無視したら嫌ですよ。直哉くん直哉くん！
……って、あ、あなた！？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated:
"Hey, don't just ignore me! Naoya-kun, Naoya-kun!
...huh, wh-who are you!?"

strings.text: 俺に手をひかれていた稟を長山は指さす。
strings.translated: Nagayama points at Rin, whose hand I was pulling along.

strings.text: 「なんで直哉くんの周りにはこんな女ばかりなのよ。葛佳といいこの女といい。レベルが高すぎじゃない？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Why is Naoya-kun always surrounded by women like this? First Kusuka, now this girl. Isn't the level way too high?"

strings.text: 「あ、あの、もしかして直哉くんのファンの娘ですか？　でしたら私は単に同じクラスで同じ部活の人間というだけでして……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um, are you perhaps a fan of Naoya-kun's? If so, I'm merely a classmate who happens to be in the same club as him..."

strings.text: 「んな！　取り巻きと一緒にしないでよ！　私は直哉くんと前から知り合いよ！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Whaaa?! Don't lump me in with the entourage! Naoya-kun and I have known each other from way back!"

strings.text: 「そ、そうなんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-is that so?"

strings.text: 「そうよ、私の名前は長山香奈。直哉くんの幼なじみなんだからね！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "That's right, my name is Nagayama Kana. I'm Naoya-kun's childhood friend!"

strings.text: 「違げぇよ。ふざけるな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're not. Cut it out."

strings.text: 「長山……香奈さん？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nagayama... Kana-san?"

strings.text: 「どうかしましたか？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Is something the matter?"

strings.text: 「あ、いいえ、私は御桜稟と言います」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no. My name is Misakura Rin."

strings.text: 「御桜……稟……って？　御桜？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Misakura... Rin... eh? Misakura?"

strings.text: 「え？　あ、はい」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Ah, yes."

strings.text: 「御桜稟ってあなた！　あなた！　あなたって！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Misakura Rin -- you! You! You're...!"

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「まだつきまとっているのですか？　長山香奈さん」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Are you still hanging around him? Nagayama Kana-san."

strings.text: 「つきまとっているって何よ！　草薙葛佳！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Hanging around, what's that supposed to mean?! Kusanagi Kusuka!"

strings.text: 「長山さんはずっと直哉の後をつけてました」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Nagayama-san, you've been tailing Naoya this whole time."

strings.text: 「なんでそんな事あなたに分かるのよ！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "How would you know something like that?!"

strings.text: 「私も直哉をつけてましたから」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Because I was tailing Naoya too."

strings.text: 「あんたもかよ！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "You were doing it too?!"

strings.text: 「はい、稟と直哉が一緒とあれば、そりゃ仕事を休んででもつけますよ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes. If Rin and Naoya are together, of course I'd tail them, even if it meant taking off work."

strings.text: 仕事休んでつけてたのかよ。
strings.translated: She skipped work to tail us?

strings.text: 「とは言っても、あなたは桜ヶ原駅で直哉を見つけてつけていた様ですが……私は直哉が夏目家を出た瞬間からずっとつけてました」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That said, it seems you only spotted Naoya at Sakuragahara Station and started tailing him from there... I've been tailing Naoya ever since the moment he left the Natsume household."

strings.text: 「って待て！　それだと雫、お前、稟のアパートの間は何をしてた！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wait a minute! In that case, Shizuku, what were you doing while we were at Rin's apartment!?"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、二人を暖かく見守ってましたよ……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Well, I was warmly watching over the two of you..."

strings.text: 「み、見守ってたって、お前なぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-watching over us? Hey, come on..."

strings.text:
「とは言っても、気持ちはです。
実際はその間に近所のスーパーでお総菜を買っていました」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"That's how I felt, at least.
In reality, during that time I was buying prepared foods at the neighborhood supermarket."

strings.text: 「お総菜？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Prepared foods?"

strings.text: そう言うと、結構な量なお総菜を雫は俺に見せる。
strings.translated: As she says this, Shizuku shows me quite a sizable haul of prepared dishes.

strings.text: 「どちらにしても！　人気女優草薙葛佳ともあろう者が、尾行なんてストーカーみたいな真似。ほんっと趣味悪いわね！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Either way! For the great popular actress Kusanagi Kusuka to stoop to stalker-like tailing. What a terrible hobby!"

strings.text: お前が言うか。
strings.translated: Look who's talking.

strings.text: 「それより御桜さん」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "More importantly, Misakura-san."

strings.text: 「あ、はい」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, right."

strings.text: 「あなたって、あの御桜稟よね」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "You're that Misakura Rin, aren't you."

strings.text: 「あのって……どの様な意味でしょうか。私は御桜稟ですが」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That...? What do you mean by that? I am Misakura Rin, though."

strings.text: 「覚えてない？　私は長山香奈。弓しょーで一緒だったじゃない？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Don't you remember? I'm Nagayama Kana. We were at Yumi-Sho together, weren't we?"

strings.text: 「えっと……あ、あの……」
strings.speaker: 稟

strings.text: 「あの頃から稟は可愛い子で有名だった。私は良く覚えてるんだぁ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Even back then, Rin was famous for being cute. I remember it well."

strings.text: 「ほら、稟と私は幼なじみなのよ。当然、その幼なじみである直哉くんだって私の幼なじみなの」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "See, Rin and I are childhood friends. Naturally, that means Naoya-kun, who's also her childhood friend, is my childhood friend too."

strings.text: 「どんな屁理屈でしょう」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "What kind of twisted logic is that."

strings.text: 「何が？　まさに正論じゃない？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "How so? Isn't it sound reasoning?"

strings.text: どう考えても詭弁だろ。
strings.translated: Any way you slice it, that's sophistry.

strings.text: それにしても、この長山ってやつ……結構めんどうだな。
strings.translated: Still, this Nagayama... she's turning into quite a nuisance.

strings.text: よもや稟に絡んでくるとはなぁ……。
strings.translated: Never thought she'd come after Rin too...

strings.text: 雫がこの前言ってたのはこういう事だったのか。
strings.translated: So this is what Shizuku was talking about the other day.

strings.text: 「いつ御桜さんは弓張に帰ってきたの？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "When did you come back to Yumihari, Misakura-san?"

strings.text: 「あ、今年の四月から弓張に転入しました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, I transferred to Yumihari back in April this year."

strings.text: 「へぇ、今年の四月なんだ。でもそれってすごいなぁ。さすが稟だねぇ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Huh, this April. Still, that's amazing. That's our Rin for you."

strings.text: 「何がですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「いやいや、今まで転校してたくせに、帰ってきて数ヶ月であの草薙直哉と二人っきりになれる関係になってるなんて」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I mean, despite transferring away all this time, you come back and within a few months you're already close enough with the Kusanagi Naoya to be alone with him."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな、わ、私は……そんな大層なものではありませんよ……。ねぇ、なお……あ、違っ、く、草薙くん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no, I... it's nothing that impressive... Right, Nao... ah, no, K-Kusanagi-kun."

strings.text: 「そんな関係じゃないねぇ。そんな仲むつまじく手を取り合って？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "That's not what it looks like. Holding hands so lovingly like that?"

strings.text: 「あ、え？　こ、これはっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, eh? Th-this is--"

strings.text: 「こ、これは俺が手を無理矢理ひいただけであってだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Th-this is just me pulling her along by force."

strings.text: 「それに、さっき、稟のアパートで直哉くんと二人っきりとか聞きましたけど？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Also, I heard earlier that you two were alone at Rin's apartment?"

strings.text: 「ふぅ、ウザい女です……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Sigh. What an annoying woman..."

strings.text: 「何か言ったかしら？　葛佳さん」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Did you say something? Kusuka-san."

strings.text: 「稟は困惑してます。見て分からないのですか？　なのにずけずけと幼なじみ風を稟にきかせて」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Rin is confused. Can't you see? And here you are talking her ear off about being childhood friends."

strings.text: 「だって本当に幼なじみだし、ねぇ。稟」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "But we really are childhood friends, right? Rin."

strings.text:
「なるほど長山さんは稟と幼なじみなのですか。
でしたら、稟がどこに住んでいたか知っているのですよね？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "So Nagayama-san is Rin's childhood friend. In that case, you must know where Rin used to live, right?"

strings.text:
「え？　稟が住んでた場所？
……っと、えっと」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated:
"Eh? Where Rin used to live?
...uh, um..."

strings.text: 「答えられない」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "You can't answer."

strings.text: 「わ、忘れているだけよ！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I j-just forgot!"

strings.text:
「いいえ、あなたは、稟の事など何も知りません。長山さん。
なんでしたら、もっと細かく質問しましょうか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"No. You know nothing about Rin, Nagayama-san.
Shall I ask more detailed questions?"

strings.text: 「あの頃から、直哉の側にいる煩わしい存在。それがあなたにとっての稟だったのでは？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Back then, you saw Rin as a nuisance who was always by Naoya's side. Isn't that right?"

strings.text: 「な、何を根拠に？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Wh-what's your basis for that?"

strings.text: 「あなたは昨日、直哉に面と向かって“私はずっと直哉くんの事が好きでした”といいました」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yesterday you told Naoya to his face, 'I've always liked you, Naoya-kun.'"

strings.text: 「そ、そうよ、文句ある」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Th-that's right, got a problem with that?"

strings.text: 「でも直哉は、あなたの事など知らないと言ってます」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "But Naoya says he doesn't know a thing about you."

strings.text: 「だったら何よ！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "So what!"

strings.text: 「私は稟の事だって好きだったわよ！　ある意味本気で……」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I liked Rin too, you know! In a certain sense, seriously..."

strings.text: 「あんたなんかにこの意味は分からないだろうけど！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Not that someone like you would understand what I mean!"

strings.text: 「なるほど……なかなか手強いですね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I see... you're quite formidable."

strings.text: 「当たり前よ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Of course I am."

strings.text: 「草薙葛佳……。いいえ、夏目雫さんでしたっけ？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Kusanagi Kusuka... no, Natsume Shizuku-san, was it?"

strings.text: 「はい、本名は夏目雫です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes, my real name is Natsume Shizuku."

strings.text: 「何で、私と直哉くんとの関係に突っかかってくるのか知らないけど、私はその程度の事は屁でもないわ！　あきらめない」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I don't know why you're butting into my relationship with Naoya-kun, but that much doesn't faze me in the slightest! I won't give up."

strings.text: 「その様ですね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "So it seems."

strings.text: 「……葛佳。いいえ雫。おぼえてらっしゃい」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "...Kusuka. No, Shizuku. You'll remember this."

strings.text: 恐ろしげな声をあげると、くるりと俺たちの方に向きなおる。
strings.translated: Letting out a menacing voice, she whirls around to face us.

strings.text:
「えへへ。また、なんか変な事になっちゃったね。二人とも。
ごめんね。直哉くん、稟」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated:
"Ehehe. Things got weird again, huh, you two.
Sorry, Naoya-kun, Rin."

strings.text: 「ううん。こちらこそ、ひさしぶりの再会なのに……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No. If anything, I'm the one -- and after we finally reunited too..."

strings.text: 「そうね。でも稟にとっては、私なんて覚えておく価値すら無い人間だったみたいだから……仕方がないかも」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "True. But to Rin, I guess I wasn't even worth remembering... so what can I do?"

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事は……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no, that's not..."

strings.text: 「ごめん。今の嫌味に聞こえたかな？　そんなつもりじゃないんだけどね」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Sorry. Did that sound sarcastic? I didn't mean it that way."

strings.text: 「けどさ……」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "But still..."

strings.text: 長山は俺の方を向く。
strings.translated: Nagayama turns to face me.

strings.text:
「一番最初に好きだったのは私だから、私のハズだから。
だから私はあきらめない」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated:
"I was the first to like him, so it has to be me.
That's why I won't give up."

strings.text: 「いや、なんの話か分からんが、あきらめるもなにも……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I don't know what you're talking about, but there's nothing to give up on..."

strings.text: 「んじゃ、今日はこれで、お二人とも今のところはお幸せに」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Well then, that's it for today. May you two be happy for now."

strings.text: 「って、話を聞け！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey, listen to me!"

strings.text: 「聞いてるよ！　でも、んじゃね！」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "I am listening! But, see ya!"

strings.text: 長山はくるりとまわるとそのまま走り出す。
strings.translated: Nagayama spins around and takes off running.

strings.text:
「なんだ、あいつ……。
なぁ、雫！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"What is with her...
Hey, Shizuku!"

strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Rin, Rin, Rin~"

strings.text: 「あははは、そんなに抱きしめたら苦しいよぉ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahahaha, if you hug me that tight it hurts..."

strings.text: どいつもこいつも意味が分からん……。
strings.translated: Every last one of them makes no sense...

strings.text: 「おい、雫。聞いているんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey, Shizuku. I'm talking to you."

strings.text: 「今、取り込み中です。私は稟を堪能している」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I'm busy at the moment. I am savoring Rin."

strings.text: 「いつでもやってるだろう！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You do that all the time!"

strings.text: 「毎日やりたい」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I want to do it every day."

strings.text: 「なんだそりゃ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What the heck is that supposed to mean..."

strings.text: 「時に雫、何でお前はそんな大量にお総菜買ってるんだ？　昼飯にしては多すぎだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "By the way, Shizuku, why are you buying such a huge amount of prepared food? That's way too much for lunch, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「お昼はすでにすましています。これは夕食です」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "I've already finished lunch. This is for dinner."

strings.text: 「は？　夕食？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Dinner?"

strings.text:
「という事で、今日の夏目家の料理はこれで問題ありません。
だから二人ともごゆっくり」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"So there's no problem with the Natsume household's meals today.
Which means, please take your time, you two."

strings.text: 「ゆっくりって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Take our time...?"

strings.text: 「むしろ、少しは自宅に帰れ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Rather, go home once in a while."

strings.text: 「何で命令形なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why the imperative?"

strings.text:
「命令形じゃないと直哉は動きません。
直哉はどうあっても人の事ばかり気にしますから、だから自宅に“帰れ”は命令形になります」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"Naoya won't move unless it's an imperative.
Naoya is always worrying about other people no matter what, so 'go' home has to be an imperative."

strings.text: 「自分のマンションぐらい帰るよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I do go back to my own apartment, occasionally..."

strings.text: 「と言って、帰ったのはいつですか？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Then when was the last time you did?"

strings.text: 「家は生き物です。たまにちゃんと住んであげないとどんどん朽ち果ててしまいます。たまには自宅に泊まってあげてください」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "A house is a living thing. If nobody actually lives in it now and then, it just decays away. So please stay at your own place once in a while."

strings.text:
「それにあの場所は直哉にとって大事なのでしょ……。
私にとっても大事な場所ですし……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Besides, that place is important to you, isn't it, Naoya... It's an important place to me too..."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shizuku..."

strings.text: 「まぁ、今のは気にしないでください。何かの間違いです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Well, don't mind what I just said. It was some kind of mistake."

strings.text: 「間違いなのかよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A mistake, huh..."

strings.text: 「そうしておいてください……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Just take it as one, please..."

strings.text: そう言うと雫は、稟を見つめる。
strings.translated: Saying that, Shizuku gazes at Rin.

strings.text: 稟はいつも通りの笑顔だ。
strings.translated: Rin is smiling as always.

strings.text:
「大丈夫だよ。雫ちゃん。
なおくんがいろいろな人の問題に、首を突っ込むのはみんな知っているし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"It's okay, Shizuku-chan.
Everyone knows that Nao-kun sticks his nose into all sorts of people's problems."

strings.text: 「なんだそりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The what now?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、まぁ、こっちの話だよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, well, it's a matter between us."

strings.text: 「うん……でも、私は稟の味方。稟だけの味方だから。稟の敵が直哉なら私は直哉の敵にだってなる」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah... but I'm on Rin's side. Only on Rin's side. If Naoya becomes Rin's enemy, I'll be Naoya's enemy too."

strings.text: 「な、なんだよそれ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what's that supposed to mean!"

strings.text: 「女の友情は、何よりも強いという事でしょう」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It means the friendship between women is stronger than anything else."

strings.text: 「んで、なんで俺が敵になるんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And why would I become the enemy..."

strings.text: 「あははは、そうだね。そんな事あり得ないから大丈夫だよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahahaha, that's right. That could never happen, so it's fine."

strings.text: 「うん、そうだね」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、今日は直哉は帰って来なくて問題ない。稟も直哉のマンションに泊まっても問題ない」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Anyway, it's no problem if Naoya doesn't come home today. And there's no problem with Rin staying over at Naoya's apartment either."

strings.text: 「い、いや、それはさすがに」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no, that's really..."

strings.text: 「そう？　直哉はオイタしそう？」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yeah? Is Naoya likely to do something naughty?"

strings.text: 「するかよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Like hell I would!"

strings.text:
「まぁ、その辺りは自己判断で。
とりあえず、今日はここでお別れです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated:
"Well, use your own judgment on that.
Anyway, this is where we part ways today."

strings.text: 「それではお二人ともお幸せに～」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "So then, wishing you two happiness~"

strings.text: 「うん、バイバイ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, bye-bye."

strings.text: 「いろいろと意味分からんなぁ。あいつも……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nothing about her makes any sense either..."

strings.text: 「そうでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really?"

strings.text: 「何がだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「私、すごく雫ちゃんに助けられている様な気がします」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I feel like Shizuku-chan has really been helping me out."

strings.text: 「助けられる？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Helping you out?"

strings.text: 「あ、別に明確にそういうのがあったとかじゃないんだけど……なんとなくなんだけどね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, it's not that there was any one clear thing... it's just a feeling, I guess."

strings.text: 「なんとなく……ね」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Just a feeling, huh."

strings.text: なんとなくか。
strings.translated: Just a feeling, huh.

strings.text: そうだよな……。
strings.translated: That's right...

strings.text: 「えっと……エロ漫画は……っと、どこだったかなぁ～？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Er... the ero manga... now where were they~?"

strings.text: 「あはは、大変な台詞だね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahaha, what a wild line to say."

strings.text: 「だって、お前に貸すんだからしょうがねぇだろうが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, what choice do I have when I'm lending them to you?"

strings.text:
「だから、そんな状況にさせてしまっているのが大変だなぁって……。
普通、幼なじみの女の子は、エッチな漫画借りるために、男の子にエッチ本とか探させないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"It's just, being in that kind of situation is a lot for me...
Normally a childhood friend girl doesn't have a boy dig around for erotic books just so she can borrow ero manga."

strings.text: 「そうか？　男も女も性欲はあるんだから、別にいいだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really? Guys and girls both have sex drives, so what's wrong with it?"

strings.text: 「せ、性欲って、わ、私は、こういう本で、そ、そういう事はしてないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-sex drives?! I-I don't, um, do th-that kind of thing with books like these."

strings.text: 「そ、そういう事って何だよ。まったく……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what kind of thing? Honestly..."

strings.text: 「え？　あの、それはなんといいますか……あのぉ……一人エッチ的な？　感じでしょうか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Um, how do I put it... you know... like, doing it solo? That kind of thing...?"

strings.text: 「あ、アホか、そんな事、答えなくていいんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Y-you idiot, you don't have to answer that."

strings.text: 「あ、そ、そっか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, r-right..."

strings.text: 「……でも、まぁ、そういう事は知ってるんだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...But, well, so you do know about those things."

strings.text: 「え？　何をですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Know about what?"

strings.text: 「一人エッチというかオナニーというか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Doing it solo, or masturbating, or whatever..."

strings.text: 「そ、そりゃ、私だって子供じゃないんだから知ってるよっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-that... I'm not a child either, of course I know about it."

strings.text: 「漫画とかゲームだと、だいたいお前みたいなキャラはそういう事は知らないもんだけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In manga and games, characters like you usually don't know about that kind of thing."

strings.text: 「あははは、そっちの方が可愛いよね。一人エッチとか知らない方が可愛い」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahahaha, that is cuter, isn't it. Not knowing about solo stuff is cuter."

strings.text: 「そうか？　知らないとか、俺は残念だけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is it? Personally I'd be disappointed if you didn't know."

strings.text: 「なんでなおくんが残念になるのですか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Why would you be disappointed, Nao-kun..."

strings.text: 「だって、知らないって事は、やった事ないって意味じゃない？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because not knowing about it means you've never done it, doesn't it?"

strings.text: 「あ。そ、そっか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah. R-right..."

strings.text: 「知ってるという事は……やった事あるかもって事だもんね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "So knowing... means I might have done it..."

strings.text: 「そっちの方が夢があると俺は思うけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I think there's more of a dream to it that way."

strings.text: 「そうかなぁ……。知らない方が可愛いよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really...? Not knowing is cuter."

strings.text: 「そんな事ないって、それに考えて見れば、俺と一緒にエロ本探してたお前が知らないわけないな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not true. And come to think of it, there's no way you don't know, considering you were hunting through ero books with me."

strings.text: 「もし知らなかったらカマトトぶっているだけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "If you didn't know, you'd just be playing innocent."

strings.text: 「あ、そうか、そう言われてみれば、そうですよね。漫画の中にそういうシーンは何度も出てきてましたし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, right, now that you put it that way, that's true. Those scenes came up a bunch of times in the manga..."

strings.text: 「でも、稟はやってないんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But you don't do it, Rin?"

strings.text: 「え？　な、何でですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? Wh-why?"

strings.text: 「いや、やってないってさっき言ってただろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, you said earlier you don't do it, didn't you?"

strings.text: 「あ、あれはエッチな漫画を見ながらはやらないって意味です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-that meant I don't do it while looking at ero manga."

strings.text: 「……そうなの？　え？　という事は……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Oh? Huh? So that means..."

strings.text:
「え？
……あ、ああっ！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Eh?
...Ah, ahhh!"

strings.text: 稟の顔が真っ赤になる。
strings.translated: Rin's face turns bright red.

strings.text: 「あ、ああ……、な、なんかやっちゃいましたか？　私、今……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, ahh... d-did I just say something bad? Just now, I..."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、そんな事ないと思うぞ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, I don't think you did..."

strings.text: まさに今“しまった”という顔さえしなければ……。
strings.translated: If only she wasn't making a face right now that screamed "I messed up"...

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ、いいじゃん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well, it's fine, isn't it?"

strings.text:
「そ、そんな軽く言われましても……。
私的には、かなり痛恨なミスなのですが……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"D-don't just brush it off so casually...
As far as I'm concerned, this was a pretty painful slip-up..."

strings.text: 真っ赤になった稟は少しすねたように言う。
strings.translated: Bright red, Rin says it a little sulkily.

strings.text: 「大丈夫だよ。大半の男は性欲がある女の子の方が好きだ。オナニーなんかやりません！　とか言う女の方がつまらん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's fine. Most guys prefer girls who have a sex drive. Girls who go 'I would never masturbate!' are boring."

strings.text: 「そ、そんな事ないよ……。あんな事やる女の子は可愛くないよ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-that's not true... Girls who do that aren't cute..."

strings.text: 「なんだ？　オナニーする女は全否定か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What, are you rejecting all girls who masturbate?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、そういうわけじゃないですが……。少なくとも私がやっているのは可愛くないです……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, that's not what I mean... at least the way I do it isn't cute..."

strings.text: 「お前が……やっている……
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You... doing it...

strings.text: ごくり
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: *gulp*

strings.text: 「あ、いや……何でも無い……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no...... it's nothing......"

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nngh!!"

strings.text: 「も、もしかして、変な事想像させてしまいましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "D-did I just make you imagine something weird?"

strings.text: 「あ、いやいや、別に、何も想像してないぞ！　今日みたいに、足を大きく開いてオナニーしている稟の姿なんて！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no no, I'm not imagining anything at all! Like the image of you spreading your legs wide open and masturbating, like you were today!"

strings.text: 「な、なんですかそれ！　そんな想像間違ってます！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wh-what's that! That's the wrong thing to imagine!"

strings.text: 「すまん、すまん、こんな事想像しちゃまずいよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sorry, sorry, I really shouldn't be imagining that."

strings.text: 「あたりまえです。ああいうのはもっとおとなしくやるものです！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Of course not. That kind of thing is done much more quietly!"

strings.text: 「そ、そうなの？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-is that so?"

strings.text: 「そ、そうです……。たとえば今日みたいに、あんな股広げてなんかあり得ませんよ。なおくんエッチな漫画読みすぎです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-that's right... For instance, there's no way anyone would spread their legs like today. Nao-kun, you've been reading too much ero manga."

strings.text: 「そうなのか？　なんか女の子のオナニーは派手だというじゃないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Is that so? They say a girl's masturbation is more flamboyant, don't they?"

strings.text: 「あ、あのですね！　今更ですけど、
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um, look! This is late to say, but

strings.text: オナニーオナニー言わないでください
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: please stop saying masturbation, masturbation

strings.text: ……恥ずかしいです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: ...it's embarrassing."

strings.text: 「あ、す、すまん……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, s-sorry..."

strings.text: 「よ、良く分かりませんが、男の人はどうなんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I don't really know, but what about guys?"

strings.text: 「な、何が？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what do you mean?"

strings.text: 「だ、だから
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I m-mean,

strings.text: 男の人が一人でする時ですよ……
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: when a guy does it alone...

strings.text: 「お、俺のか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "M-me, you mean?"

strings.text: 「べ、別になおくん限定じゃないよ。一般的にだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-not specifically you, Nao-kun. Just in general."

strings.text: 「一般的にも何も、普通自分以外知らないだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In general or not, you don't know anyone but yourself, normally."

strings.text: 「だ、だったら……、な、なおくんもそういう事するんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-then... d-do you do that kind of thing too, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「そりゃ、人並みには」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, about as much as anyone."

strings.text: 「そっ、そうなんだっ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-I see..."

strings.text: 「何驚いてるんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why are you so surprised?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや……べ、別に……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no... it's n-nothing..."

strings.text: 「こほん、とりあえず、なおくんの人並みというのがどの程度か分かりませんが……。なおくんがする時にですねぇ……。
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahem, anyway, I don't know what 'as much as anyone' means for you, Nao-kun... but when you do it...

strings.text: 股を開いて大声をあげてやりませんよね
strings.translated: you don't spread your legs and cry out loudly, do you?

strings.text: 「男がそんなやり方するわけないだろ。そりゃ静かにするさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's no way a guy does it like that. Of course we do it quietly."

strings.text: 「ですよね。それと一緒ですよ。たぶん……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Right? It's the same thing. Probably..."

strings.text: そうか、言われてみれば分かる様な気がする。
strings.translated: Ah, now that she mentions it, I feel like I get it.

strings.text: たしかに、オナニーなんて静かにやるもんだ。
strings.translated: Indeed, masturbation is something you do quietly.

strings.text: 「声なんてほとんど出ませんよ。股だって閉じてます……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You barely make any sounds. And your legs stay closed..."

strings.text: 「そ、そうか、そういう感じなのか……声を出さずに、股を閉じて……。やはり布団の中とかか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I see, so that's the feel of it... without making any sound, with your legs closed... In the futon, I take it?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、布団の中が多いですけど、たまに勉強机とかでもやりますけど……って！？　す、ストップ！　な、何言わせてるんですか！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, in the futon most of the time, but sometimes at my study desk too...--?! S-stop! Wh-what are you making me say!"

strings.text: 「あ、いや、す、すまん……いろいろ情報聞き出せるとリアルに想像出来るから……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, s-sorry... the more information I get, the more realistically I can imagine it..."

strings.text: 「り、リアルにって……、そ、想像する気だったんですか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "R-realistically... y-you were planning to imagine it...?"

strings.text:
「まぁ、俺も健全な男子なわけだしな。今日の行動を見ても分かっただろ？
性欲に簡単に脳を支配される様な人間だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Well, I am a healthy male. You could tell from my behavior today, right?
I'm the kind of person whose brain is easily hijacked by his sex drive."

strings.text: 「じ、自重してくださいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Sh-show some restraint!"

strings.text: 「とは言いませんけど……私がいない時に想像はやってください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I won't say that, but... please do your imagining when I'm not around."

strings.text: 「お前がいないところだったらやっていいのかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So as long as you're not there, it's fine?"

strings.text: 「知りません。ただ私の前ではダメですっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I don't know. Just not in front of me."

strings.text: 「よ、良く分からんが……分かった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I don't really get it, but... okay..."

strings.text: 「はい、そうしてください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, please do."

strings.text: 「えっと、と、とりあえずエロ本をだな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Umm, so, first, the ero books, huh..."

strings.text: 「そ、そうですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "R-right."

strings.text: 「わ、すごい段ボール……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wow, that's a huge cardboard box..."

strings.text:
「エロ本って捨てられなくてなぁ。どんどん溜まっていくんだよ。
これでも電子図書で買う分が増えたから、少なくなった方なんだがな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I just can't bring myself to throw ero books away. They keep piling up.
And this is actually less than usual, since I've been buying more as e-books lately."

strings.text: 「そ、そうなんですか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I-is that so..."

strings.text: 稟が段ボールの中をのぞき込む。
strings.translated: Rin peered into the cardboard box.

strings.text: 「どうした？　眉間にしわ寄せて」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's the matter? Your brow's all furrowed."

strings.text: 「これ、写真です……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "These are photographs..."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだけど」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, they are."

strings.text: 「なんでこんなもの持ってるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Why do you have these?"

strings.text: 「だ、だってエロ本だし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well, they're ero books."

strings.text: 「女の人の裸です」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "They're of naked women."

strings.text: 「そりゃそうだ。エロ本なんだから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, of course. They're ero books."

strings.text: 「ふーん。なおくんはこういうのも読むのですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hmm. So you read this kind of thing too, Nao-kun."

strings.text:
「な、なんで不機嫌になってるんだよ？
意味わからん。エロ漫画は喜んで読むお前がっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Wh-why are you getting sulky?
Makes no sense. You happily read ero manga."

strings.text: 「そうですね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's true......"

strings.text:
「これだって、一応写真はデッサン練習になるんだよ。
だからこういう本だってあるだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Besides, photos are actually good for dessin practice.
That's why books like these exist."

strings.text: 「デッサン練習ですか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Dessin practice, huh..."

strings.text: 「ああ、ヌードデッサンするぐらいなんだからさ、たとえば……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I mean, we do nude dessin, so, for example..."

strings.text: そう言って男性ヌードの本を取り出す。
strings.translated: Saying that, I pulled out a book of male nudes.

strings.text: 「な、なおくん両刀使い？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-Nao-kun, you swing both ways?"

strings.text: 「違うわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not it!"

strings.text: 「男もあるって事はヌード写真の大半がデッサンに使うもんだって事だろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The fact that there are male ones too means that most of these nude photo books are for dessin practice, right?"

strings.text: 「へぇ……んじゃ、こういう本も出てきたのですが？　これもやはりデッサンに使うのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hmm... Then what about this kind of book that turned up? Is this for dessin too?"

strings.text: ＤＶＤ付きのハメ撮り投稿写真系の本を稟が取り出す。
strings.translated: Rin pulled out a homemade-sex-tape photo book that came with a DVD.

strings.text: 「わ、わわ、それは違うっっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-wa-wait, that one's different!"

strings.text: 「ま、私がとやかく言う事ではありませんけど……カップルがいろいろなプレイされているのをデッサンに使う必然性はあまり感じませんね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, it's not really my place to comment on it, but... I really don't feel there's much necessity in using couples doing various acts for dessin practice."

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ、これは……その……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well, that one is... you know..."

strings.text: 「繰り返し言いますけど、私がとやかく言えるものではありませんから、お気遣い無く……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'll say it again, it's not my place to say anything about it, so please don't mind me..."

strings.text: でも、なんか不機嫌じゃん……稟。
strings.translated: But... you kind of are sulking, Rin.

strings.text: 「不機嫌に見えますか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Do I look sulky?"

strings.text: 「ギクっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Guh!"

strings.text: 鋭いな。稟。
strings.translated: Sharp as ever, Rin.

strings.text: 「すみません。だったら私が悪いです。なんでそんな態度を取ってしまったのでしょうか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm sorry. If so, then I'm at fault. Why did I act that way, I wonder..."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、男がそんな本よんでたら不潔だと思うのが普通だし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, it's only natural to find it filthy that a guy reads that kind of book."

strings.text:
「たぶん、そういうのではないと思います……。
ふぅ……ダメですね。私」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"I don't think it's that, exactly...
Haah... I'm hopeless."

strings.text: 「何が？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Scared of what?"

strings.text: 「何でもありません。さぁ、エッチな漫画を探しましょう」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's nothing. Come on, let's find some ecchi manga."

strings.text: 「あ、そっちの段ボールは薄い本だからダメっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, that box is doujinshi, so no!"

strings.text: 「あ、藍か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, Ai?"

strings.text: 夏目家に電話する。とりあえず今日の夕飯は雫が買ったお総菜ですませてもらって、俺の帰りが遅くなる事を伝えるために……。
strings.translated: I called the Natsume house. To let them know that dinner tonight would just have to be the pre-made side dishes Shizuku bought, and that I'd be getting home late...

strings.text: すると……。
strings.translated: And then...

strings.text: 藍
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 「雫から聞いている。今日はそちらのマンションに泊まるのだろ？　少しは帰らないとダメだぞ。そこは水菜さんの家でもあるんだからな」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "I heard from Shizuku. You're staying at that apartment tonight, right? You've got to come home once in a while, though. That place is Mizuna-san's home too, you know."

strings.text: 「とりあえず、たまには自宅でちゃんと水菜さんの御前で手を合わせてから寝ろよ」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "For now, at least sleep at your own home every so often after paying proper respects at Mizuna-san's altar."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

strings.text: 「それじゃ、そういう事だから、我々は我々でちゃんと出来て……って！　圭！　火吹いてるぞ！　止めろ！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "Well, that's the deal, so we'll manage things on our own here-- Hey! Kei! You're breathing fire! Cut it out!"

strings.text: 「あ、あの藍？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "U-umm, Ai?"

strings.text: 「こ、こっちは大丈夫だからな。安心しろ。それじゃ急ぎの用が出来たので！」
strings.speaker: 藍
strings.translated: "W-we're fine over here. Don't worry. Anyway, urgent business came up, so!"

strings.text: 電話が突然切れる。
strings.translated: The call cut off abruptly.

strings.text: 「大丈夫か？　あいつら？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Are those guys okay...?"

strings.text: 「帰ってあげた方がいいんじゃないかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wouldn't it be better to go back?"

strings.text:
「いや、これで帰ったら逆に藍に怒られる。
相手を信用するのも、家族としては当たり前の事だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Nah, if I went back over that, Ai would just get mad.
Trusting each other is only natural, as a family."

strings.text: 「家族か……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Family, huh..."

strings.text: 「ああ、擬似的なものではあるが、それでもあの家にいる間は夏目家の一員としてやっていこうと思っている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's a pseudo-family, but while I'm in that house, I mean to carry on as a member of the Natsume family."

strings.text: 「そうか……さすがだね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see... that's impressive."

strings.text: 「さすがも何も、俺と夏目の家そのものは遠いもんじゃないからな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not impressive or anything. The Kusanagi and Natsume families aren't really that far apart to begin with..."

strings.text: 「そうなんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really?"

strings.text: 「俺の母親、夏目水菜は、藍や圭や雫の姉だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "My mother, Natsume Mizuna, is the older sister of Ai, Kei, and Shizuku."

strings.text: 「そうだったんですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is that so?"

strings.text:
それ以外もいろいろと夏目と草薙は関係が深いんだけどな……。
まぁ、この辺りは因縁めいた話も多いから稟には話せないが……。
strings.translated:
There's a lot more that ties the Natsume and Kusanagi families together...
Well, there's a fair amount of fated history in there, so I can't tell Rin about it...

strings.text: 「料理、また作っていいですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "May I cook for you again?"

strings.text: 「ああ、でも今度は二人で作らないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, but this time, why don't we cook together?"

strings.text: 「いいですね。是非、是非お願いします」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That sounds lovely. Please, please do."

strings.text: 「その後に勉強も頼むわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And I'll ask you to help me with studying after."

strings.text: 「もちろんです。安心してください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Of course. You can count on me."

strings.text: 豪勢な食事を終えて、二人で勉強する。
strings.translated: After a lavish meal, the two of us studied.

strings.text: 二人っきりの勉強ははじめてではないが、何となく落ち着かない。
strings.translated: It wasn't our first time studying just the two of us, but somehow I couldn't settle down.

strings.text: 普通でいるにはあまりにも一日でいろいろありすぎたから……。
strings.translated: Too much had happened in a single day for me to act normal...

strings.text: 俺もどことなく全身がむずがゆい……。なんとなく火照った感じがある。
strings.translated: My whole body felt vaguely itchy... a bit feverish, somehow.

strings.text: 稟も始終、熱に浮かされた様な感じであった。
strings.translated: Rin, too, seemed feverish the whole time.

strings.text: こころここにあらず。
strings.translated: Not quite there in spirit.

strings.text: なんとなくそんな感じであった。
strings.translated: That was the feeling of it.

strings.text: その後、軽く絵も教えた。
strings.translated: After that, I gave her a light drawing lesson.

strings.text: 自宅のマンションならデッサンだけじゃなく絵の具を使って油絵を教える事だって出来る。
strings.translated: At home in the apartment, I could teach her not just dessin but oil painting with actual paints.

strings.text: とは言っても今日はすでに教えるというほどの時間も無く一日の終わりに近づいてゆく。
strings.translated: Even so, there wasn't really enough time left in the day for anything like a proper lesson as it drew to a close.

strings.text: 「そろそろ終電だよな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's about time for the last train."

strings.text: 「あ、本当だ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, you're right..."

strings.text: 気がつくと終電。
strings.translated: Before I knew it, the last train.

strings.text: 桜ヶ原から小音羽までは歩くには距離がある。
strings.translated: Sakuragahara to Kootoba is a bit far to walk.

strings.text: ましてや深夜で女性一人など帰らせられるものではない。
strings.translated: Much less can I let a woman walk home alone late at night.

strings.text: 俺は急いで桜ヶ原まで稟を送る事にする。
strings.translated: I hurriedly decided to see Rin home to Sakuragahara.

strings.text: たくさんあったエロ漫画であったが、当然一度で持ち運べる量ではない。
strings.translated: There were a lot of ero manga, but of course not an amount she could carry in one trip.

strings.text: 最後までいろいろ悩んだ稟であったが、俺の一言ですべてが解決する。
strings.translated: Rin agonized over it right to the end, but a single word from me settled everything.

strings.text: 「また借りにくればいい。それこそ明日でもいいぜ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You can just come borrow more. Tomorrow, even."

strings.text:
「明日ですか？
それはまた早急ですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Tomorrow?
That's rather soon."

strings.text: 「まぁ、モノのたとえだ。別に明日じゃなくてもいいが」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, it's just an expression. Doesn't have to be tomorrow."

strings.text: 「どちらにしてもムーア展まで絵を教えるのなら、このマンションが一番良いだろう。道具がすべてそろっている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Either way, if I'm going to teach you painting until the Moore Exhibition, this apartment is best. All the tools are here."

strings.text: 「夏目の土蔵が使えないとなれば尚更だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Especially since we can't use the Natsume storehouse."

strings.text: 「はい、ありがとうございます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, thank you very much."

strings.text: 「あ、あのですね。もし、もしですよ。明日の朝までに借りた本を読み終わったら、本を返すにあたり朝お迎えにあがって良いですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, so, if... if, hypothetically, I finish reading the books I borrowed by tomorrow morning, would it be all right if I came over in the morning to return them?"

strings.text: 「ああ、問題ない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, no problem."

strings.text: 「ではぶしつけながら、明日お迎えにあがって良いでしょうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then, pardon my forwardness, but would it be all right if I came over tomorrow?"

strings.text: 「そんな大層な事じゃないだろ。気楽にくればいいさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not that big a deal. Just come whenever."

strings.text: 「えへへ、気楽にって言うほど簡単ではないけど、喜んで行かせていただきますっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ehehe, it's not quite as easy as 'whenever,' but I'll gladly come over."

strings.text: いつもの笑顔で稟が笑う。
strings.translated: Rin smiled her usual smile.

strings.text: 俺は急いで鞄に必要なものを入れて玄関へ走る。
strings.translated: I hurriedly stuffed what I needed into my bag and ran to the entryway.

strings.text: ドアを開けると、稟が待っていた。
strings.translated: When I opened the door, Rin was waiting.

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「おはようございます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Good morning."

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「またせたな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sorry to keep you."

strings.text: 「あ、いいえ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, not at all."

strings.text: 心なしか稟の頬が赤い様な気がする。
strings.translated: Maybe it was just my imagination, but Rin's cheeks looked a little red.

strings.text: 「んじゃ、行くか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well then, shall we go?"

strings.text: 「は、はいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yes!"

strings.text: エレベーターを二人で待つ。
strings.translated: The two of us waited for the elevator.

strings.text: なんとなく落ち着かない。
strings.translated: Somehow, I couldn't settle down.

strings.text:
なんだろう。
この微妙な距離感……今までは無かったものだ。
strings.translated:
What was this?
This subtle sense of distance... it hadn't been there before.

strings.text: 「あのさ、稟」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hey, Rin."

strings.text: 「はいっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes!"

strings.text:
勢いの良い返事。
なんかこちらがどもってしまう。
strings.translated:
Her reply came with too much energy.
It made me stammer.

strings.text: 「よ、良く寝れたか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "D-did you sleep well?"

strings.text: 「あはは、あまり寝られませんでしたねぇ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ahaha, I couldn't sleep much, really."

strings.text: 「そ、そっか……。なんか顔赤いもんな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-I see... Your face does look a little red."

strings.text: 「そうですね。寝不足だからかなぁ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah. Maybe it's the lack of sleep."

strings.text: 「なおくんは良く寝れましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Did you sleep well, Nao-kun?"

strings.text:
「ま、まぁ……寝たのは寝た……。
微妙に寝た時間は遅かったけどな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well... I did sleep... just, it took me a while to actually get to sleep..."

strings.text: 「そうなんですか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is that so......"

strings.text: あの後に猛烈な性欲が押し寄せてきて寝るとかそんなレベルではなかった。
strings.translated: After all that, a fierce wave of lust had come crashing over me -- sleep hadn't even been an option.

strings.text: まぁ、人体デッサンを教える時に稟にあんな姿させて、さらにその後にオナニーの話とかしてしまったら、まともに寝られるわけなどない。
strings.translated: Well, having made Rin pose like that for a life-drawing lesson, and then bringing up masturbation on top of it, there was no way I was going to sleep properly.

strings.text: 「エレベーター来ましたよ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The elevator's here."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

strings.text: 昨日一日で、何かが変わった。
strings.translated: Over the course of yesterday, something had changed.

strings.text: 淡いかたちをしていた思い。そんな気持ちが、だんだん明確になっていく。
strings.translated: Feelings that had been vague in shape were slowly starting to sharpen.

strings.text: まずいなぁ……。
strings.translated: Not good...

strings.text: 稟の横顔をちらりと見る。
strings.translated: I stole a glance at Rin's profile.

strings.text: やはり可愛い。
strings.translated: Cute, as always.

strings.text:
わりかし俺は美女に恵まれている環境であると思う。
雫は当然だが鳥谷だってなかなかのものだ。
氷川だって川内野だって同じくだ。
strings.translated:
I really was blessed with a lot of beautiful women around me.
Shizuku obviously, but Toritani was quite something too.
Hikawa and Kawachino, likewise.

strings.text: だが、稟の様な、優しさがにじみ出る様な独特な可愛さは、他の誰も持っているものではない……。
strings.translated: But that particular cuteness Rin had -- the kind that seemed to seep out with her gentleness -- no one else possessed it...

strings.text:
稟がこちらの視線に気がつく。
そして自然な笑顔。
strings.translated:
Rin noticed my gaze.
And she gave me a natural smile.

strings.text: 俺はなんだか恥ずかしくて視線を外してしまう。
strings.translated: Somehow embarrassed, I looked away.

strings.text: すると、稟も恥ずかしくなったのか、下に俯いてしまう。
strings.translated: Then Rin, perhaps embarrassed herself, cast her eyes downward.

strings.text: エレベーターが下の階につく。
strings.translated: The elevator reached the ground floor.

strings.text: 「や、やっぱりなおくんも、寝不足みたいだね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "L-looks like you're short on sleep too, Nao-kun."

strings.text: 「かもしれないな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Maybe so......"

strings.text: まぁ、単純に下半身的に疲れているというのもあるかもしれないが……。
strings.translated: Well, it might simply be a matter of my lower half being tired...

strings.text: 「終電というのもありましたが……それでもこんな寝不足になるなんて」
strings.speaker: 稟
