strings.text: そのまま動けない稟。
strings.translated: Rin stayed frozen in place.

strings.text: 「学校指定っていまだとスパッツみたいになっているって話も聞くけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I heard that school-issued ones nowadays are like spats..."

strings.text: 「あ、いやスパッツにはなってません、それは競泳用です。それはそれとしてですね。なおくん、あのですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, no, they're not spats, those are for competitive swimming. But putting that aside--Nao-kun, um..."

strings.text: 「なんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What?"

strings.text: 「えっと、えっと、ですね。どこから説明したら良いでしょうか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Um, um, well. Where should I start explaining..."

strings.text: 「いや、競泳用の水着の説明なんてしなくても一目見れば……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, I don't need an explanation of a competitive swimsuit, one look would--"

strings.text: ゆっくりとスカートをあげていく。
strings.translated: Slowly, I lifted the skirt.

strings.text: 稟は焦り固まってしまう。
strings.translated: Rin, flustered, froze.

strings.text:
稟の表情をいぶかしく思った後、
めくったスカートを見ると……何故か肌色が見える。
strings.translated:
After puzzling over Rin's expression,
when I looked at the raised skirt... for some reason, I saw skin-color.

strings.text: あれ？
strings.translated: Huh?

strings.text: あれれれれ？
strings.translated: Huh, huh, huh?

strings.text: 「さ、最近の学校指定の水着の色って……肌色だったっけ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-is the color of school-issued swimsuits these days... skin-colored?"

strings.text: 「た、たぶん、ち、違います」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "P-probably, i-it's not."

strings.text: 「え、えっとさ……もしかして白かな？　限りなく肌色に近い……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "U-um... could it be white? Something extremely close to skin-color..."

strings.text: 「ふ、普通に学校指定の水着は紺色だと思います」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-normally, I think school-issued swimsuits are navy blue."

strings.text: 「え、えっと……紺色がまったく見えないのだけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "U-um... I don't see any navy at all, though..."

strings.text: 「で、でしょうね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "R-right, I suppose..."

strings.text: 「これってつまり……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So this means..."

strings.text: 「あ、あの……もう確認良いですよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um... isn't that enough checking already..."

strings.text:
「申し訳ありませんが……スカートめくってるの直してくださいませんか？
私、驚きのあまり身体がまったく動けません」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"I'm sorry, but... could you fix the skirt you're lifting up?
I'm so shocked my body won't move at all."

strings.text: 「あ、ああ、俺もわりかし手が震えて動かない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A-ah, yeah, my hands are shaking too much to move..."

strings.text: 「い、今がどういう状況だか分かりますよね？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-you understand the situation right now, don't you?"

strings.text: 「分かっている。分かっているから動けなくなった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I understand. It's because I understand that I can't move."

strings.text: 「そ、そんなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no way......"

strings.text: 「大丈夫。今からゆっくり直す……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's okay. I'll slowly fix it now..."

strings.text: 「は、はい、お願いします……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yes, please..."

strings.text: 俺はスカートをゆっくりと直す。
strings.translated: I slowly fixed the skirt.

strings.text: 元通りに……その瞬間。
strings.translated: Back the way it was... in that instant.

strings.text: 「っっ！」
strings.speaker: 稟

strings.text: 「わっ、わわっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wah, wa-wah!"

strings.text: やっと動けた稟はその場で崩れ落ちてしまう。
strings.translated: Rin, finally able to move, crumpled to the floor.

strings.text:
そして机に手を置いた瞬間。
テーブルの上のコーヒーを盛大にこぼしてしまった。
strings.translated:
And the instant she put her hand on the desk,
she spectacularly knocked over the coffee on the table.

strings.text: 「だ、大丈夫か？　やけどとかないか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A-are you okay?! Not burned or anything?"

strings.text: 「あ、大丈夫です。もうコーヒーかなり冷えてたから火傷とかは問題ありませんけど……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, I'm fine. The coffee had already cooled quite a bit, so burns aren't a problem, but..."

strings.text: たっぷりミルクと砂糖を入れたコーヒー。
strings.translated: Coffee with plenty of milk and sugar.

strings.text: まだ無糖なら問題も無かったかもしれない。
strings.translated: If it had still been unsweetened, it might not have been a problem.

strings.text: だが、稟は全身ミルクと砂糖入りのコーヒーまみれである。
strings.translated: But Rin was drenched head-to-toe in coffee laced with milk and sugar.

strings.text: 「う、うぅぅ……すみません。せっかくいれていただいたコーヒーをこぼしてしまいました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-uuu... I'm sorry. I spilled the coffee you went to the trouble of making..."

strings.text: 「そういう問題じゃないだろ。ったく、だいたい俺が悪いんじゃないか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not the issue. Geez, basically this is my fault, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「でも、曖昧な答えをしたのは私ですし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But, I was the one who gave an ambiguous answer..."

strings.text: 「いや、そういう問題じゃない。ったく我ながら考えが足りないというか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, that's not the issue. Geez, I'm not thinking things through, or..."

strings.text: 実際、いつもならそんな可能性だって考慮するだろうに……なんだ？　俺、実は結構てんぱっているのか？
strings.translated: Actually, normally I'd have considered that possibility... what's going on? Am I actually pretty flustered here?

strings.text: 「う、うう……すみませんが……今度は本当にお風呂借りて良いですか」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-uuu... I'm sorry, but... could I really borrow your bath this time?"

strings.text: 「お前が謝る事じゃない。当たり前だ風呂今から用意するから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not something for you to apologize about. Of course. I'll go prepare the bath now."

strings.text: 「あ、藍か？　すまん。今日はこっちで泊まる事になった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "H-hey, Ai? Sorry. Turns out I'm staying over here tonight..."

strings.text: 「あ、うん、まぁ、ちょっとした事故というか……水害があってな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah, well, kind of an accident, or... there was a water-related mishap."

strings.text: 「あ、いや、前回みたいな大事ではないんだ。極めて小規模なものでな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, not a big deal like last time. Extremely small-scale."

strings.text: 「あ、うん……すまん……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah... sorry..."

strings.text: 「ふぅ、良かった。お前に合うサイズの服なんてそれぐらいしか無かったからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Whew, that fits. That's about the only clothing I have in your size."

strings.text: 「なんで女性用の寝間着があるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Why do you have women's sleepwear here?"

strings.text: 「ああ、それは母親のだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, that belonged to my mother."

strings.text:
「お母さんの寝間着なのですか……。
結構新しい様に見えますが」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Your mother's sleepwear...
It looks fairly new, though."

strings.text: 「よく分からんが、一度も袖を通さずに、置いていったもんだから新品同然だろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't really know the details, but she left it behind without ever putting her arms through the sleeves, so it's practically new."

strings.text: 「そうなのですか……何故ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is that so... why?"

strings.text: 「さぁな。あまり詳しくは知らんが。何でも母親がここ一番のために買ったものらしいが、なんかうまくいかなかったらしくてな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Beats me. I don't know the whole story. Apparently my mother bought it for some big occasion, but somehow it didn't work out."

strings.text: 「なんかうまくいかなかった？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Somehow it didn't work out?"

strings.text: 「ああ、ウチの父親と母親は恋愛結婚でな、まぁ、紆余曲折があったみたいだ。その行き違いの一つなんだろう、それも……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, my old man and my mother had a love marriage, and I guess there were plenty of twists and turns. That was probably one of the mix-ups..."

strings.text: なんでも親父の話だと、初めての夜は制服だったらしい。
strings.translated: According to my old man's story, their first night together, she was in her school uniform.

strings.text: 母親は、寝間着になるものだとばかり思っていたので、新調していたとか何とか……まぁ、良く分からんが。
strings.translated: My mother had assumed it would be sleepwear, so she'd bought a new one... well, I don't really get it.

strings.text: 「でも、大切にしてるものですよね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But it's something she treasured, right..."

strings.text: 「ああ、形見でもあるし、なんやかんや母親も気に入ってたみたいだからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, it's a keepsake, and by all accounts my mother was fond of it too."

strings.text: 「そんな大切なものを」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "For me to wear something so precious..."

strings.text: 「と言っても、この家にはそれぐらいしか女物の服なんてないぞ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That said, this is about the only piece of women's clothing in the house, you know?"

strings.text: 「そ、そう言われてみれば……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-now that you mention it..."

strings.text: 「それに、その寝間着は、俺が女泊めた時に使えって母親が言い残したもんだから、まぁいいだろ。古着ってわけでもないし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Besides, my mother left word that this sleepwear was for me to use whenever I had a girl stay over, so it's fine. It's not like it's secondhand."

strings.text: 「いや、そういう意味ではなくて、私で良かったのでしょうか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No, I didn't mean it that way. I mean, was it all right that it was me..."

strings.text:
「そりゃもちろんだ。
まぁ、泊まり云々は無しだろうけど……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"That goes without saying.
Well, the whole staying-over thing wasn't really the plan, though..."

strings.text: 「でも、終電は終わってます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But the last train's already gone."

strings.text: 「ああ、でもタクシー代ぐらいなら出すぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, but I can at least cover the taxi fare."

strings.text: 「なんでなおくんが出すんですか、それぐらい自分で出すよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Why would you pay, Nao-kun? I can pay for that much myself."

strings.text: 「どっちにしても私のすべての服は洗濯中です。脱水乾燥機にかけたとしてもあと一時間ちょっとはかかります」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Either way, all my clothes are being washed. Even with the spin and dryer, it'll take another hour or so."

strings.text: 「そうなるかな？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That long, huh?"

strings.text: 「なります」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That long."

strings.text: 「なら、どうする？　泊まっていくか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then, what'll you do? Stay over?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、私は元々一人暮らしですし……問題はありません」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, I live alone anyway... so it's no problem."

strings.text: 「そっか……泊まるか」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see... you'll stay, then."

strings.text: 「で、でもですね。なおくん！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "B-but you know, Nao-kun!"

strings.text: 「安心しろ、お前は寝室で、俺はリビングで寝る」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Relax, you'll take the bedroom and I'll sleep in the living room."

strings.text: 「そりゃ、そうだ。これだけ部屋がある家なんだから、別々の部屋で寝た方がいいだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Naturally. This house has plenty of rooms, so we're better off sleeping in separate ones."

strings.text: 「で、でも、私達……付き合ってますよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "B-but, we're... going out, aren't we?"

strings.text: 「つ、付き合っているのは付き合っているが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "G-going out, yeah, we're going out, but..."

strings.text: 「いるが？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But?"

strings.text: 「俺がお前に告白したのは今日だ。なんかいろいろと違う気がする」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I only confessed to you today. It feels like a lot of things aren't quite right yet."

strings.text: 「うぬぅ。なんか違うって、何ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ugh. What do you mean by 'not quite right'?"

strings.text: 「知らん。とりあえずリビングと寝室はすぐ側だからドア開ければ会話も出来る。不便はないハズだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Dunno. Anyway, the living room and bedroom are right next to each other, so we can talk with the door open. It shouldn't be inconvenient."

strings.text: 「不便とかの問題じゃない気がするんだけどなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I don't think this is really a matter of convenience..."

strings.text: 「なおくんのお母さんってどんな人だったのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What kind of person was your mother, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そういえば会った事がないんだっけな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, now that you mention it, you never met her, did you?"

strings.text: 「はい、ご病気をされていたので……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Right, since she was ill..."

strings.text: 「そうだな。あの頃は入院していたな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. She was in the hospital back then."

strings.text:
「母親の名前は水菜。旧姓は夏目という事になるのかなぁ。
藍や圭、雫の姉にあたる」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"My mother's name was Mizuna. Her maiden name would be Natsume, I guess.
She was Ai, Kei, and Shizuku's older sister."

strings.text: 「結構、気が強い人でな。まぁ、そこが親父がベタ惚れした部分らしいけどさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She was a pretty strong-willed person. Well, that seems to be exactly what my old man fell head-over-heels for."

strings.text: 「でも、なおくんはお母さんの事、すごく好きだったのですよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But you loved your mother a lot, didn't you, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「そうだな。俺が親父にニューヨークに連れて行かれていった時、自力で母親がいる日本に帰ってきたぐらいだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah. When my old man took me to New York, I made my own way back to Japan to be with her."

strings.text: 「なおくん、ニューヨークにいた時期があるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "There was a time when you were in New York, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「ああ、親父のアトリエがニューヨークにあってな、親父は怪しげな友達と悪巧みを良くしてたよ。元メトロポリタンのキュレーターのディーラーとか、贋作屋とかもいたな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, my old man had an atelier in New York, and he was always up to no good with his shady friends. There was an ex-Metropolitan curator turned dealer, and a forger too."

strings.text:
「とりあえず世界中の怪しげな芸術界隈の連中がうごめいていた。
そういう空気に子供の時から触れさせておきたかったのかもしれないなぁ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Basically, all the shady art-world types from around the world were swarming there.
Maybe he wanted me exposed to that kind of atmosphere from childhood."

strings.text: 「英才教育ですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Elite education, then."

strings.text: 「まぁ、ある時点まではな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, up to a certain point, yeah."

strings.text: 「ある時点？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A certain point?"

strings.text: 「俺が何度か勝手に帰国してたら、親父がもうニューヨークに帰ってくるなって言ってな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "After I ran off back to Japan a few times, my old man told me not to come back to New York anymore."

strings.text: 「何故ですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Why is that?"

strings.text: 「なぁに、あいつらしい優しさだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What can I say, it was his kind of kindness."

strings.text: 「優しさ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kindness?"

strings.text: 「だからお前は、お母さんの側にいてやれ……。俺がいられないのだから、せめてお前だけはお母さんの側に……最後までいてやれって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So he said, you stay by your mother's side... since I can't be there, at least you should be by your mother's side... until the end..."

strings.text: 「……なおくん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "...Nao-kun."

strings.text: 「あ、いやいや、湿っぽくなる話じゃないんだ。あいつはそういうヤツでさ、不器用なんだよ。だから敵も大層多かった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no, no, this isn't meant to get all sappy. He was just that kind of guy, clumsy. That's why he made a hell of a lot of enemies too."

strings.text: 「あいつが、ニューヨークなんて場所で戦わなきゃいけなかったのも、すべてはその性格だ。あいつはとりあえず敵を作る。いらない敵ばかり作るんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The reason he had to fight in a place like New York was entirely because of his personality. He'd make enemies at every turn. Unnecessary enemies, all the time."

strings.text: 「優しいお父さんなんですね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "He sounds like a kind father..."

strings.text: 「いや、最低だよ。あいつは。俺の手に絵画養成ギブスとかつけていやがったし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, he was the worst. That guy strapped painting-training braces on my hands."

strings.text: 「何ですか？　それ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What are those?"

strings.text: 「巨○の星って漫画あるじゃん。それに大リーグ養成ギブスって出てくるんだけど、それみたいなもんかな？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You know that manga Star of the G*ants? There's a thing in it called major-league training braces--kind of like that, I guess?"

strings.text: 「おもしろいお父さんなのですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "He sounds like a funny father."

strings.text: 「ああ、草薙健一郎って男は本当にどうしようもないぐらいバカで、どうしようもないぐらい自由で……そしてもっとも不自由なヤツだった……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, the man called Kusanagi Ken'ichirou was a hopeless idiot, hopelessly free... and also the most unfree man there was..."

strings.text: 「すごい家族の絆ですね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You have an incredible family bond..."

strings.text: 「そうか？　みんなバラバラだったんだぜ？　どいつもこいつもすぐに死ぬし、生涯で一緒にいる時間が極端に少ない家族だぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You think so? We were all scattered, you know? Everyone dying off left and right, an extremely small amount of time spent together over our whole lives."

strings.text: 「うん、でもすごい絆を感じるよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, but I feel an incredible bond."

strings.text: 「だって、いつも草薙健一郎さんの話が出てくると無愛想になるなおくんが、いざお父さんの事を語ったら、悪口言ってるくせに、照れくさそうに、自慢げに、まるで自分の事を誇るみたいに言うんだもん……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Because normally, whenever Kusanagi Ken'ichirou comes up, you get all curt about it, Nao-kun. But when you actually talked about your father, even while you were badmouthing him, you sounded embarrassed, proud, as if boasting about yourself..."

strings.text: 「いつも話したくないのは、それだけお父さんが大事なんだって分かった」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I understood that the reason you never want to talk about him is because your father matters that much to you."

strings.text: 「いやいや、マジで恨んでるのは恨んでるんだよ。あのバカにはいろいろ振り回されたからな……なのに早々に死にやがって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, I really do resent him. That idiot dragged me around every which way... and then he up and died so quickly..."

strings.text: 「仕舞いには、遺言は“みんなに俺の人生が不幸だった事を伝えてくれ、だから心配する事はない。俺の死に祝福を！　笑顔で見送れ！”だからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "At the very end, his will said, 'Tell everyone my life was unhappy, so there's no need to worry. Bless my death! See me off with smiles!'"

strings.text: 「殴りたくもなるだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wouldn't you want to punch him?"

strings.text: 「ううん。いいお父さんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No. He's a good father."

strings.text: 「私、あんまりお父さんと仲が良くないから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm not really on good terms with my father, so..."

strings.text: 「みたいだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So it seems."

strings.text: 「でもさ、子の事を考えない親なんてまずいないって言うじゃないか。お前の親父さんにも親父さんの考えがあったんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But you know, they say there's basically no parent who doesn't think about their child. Your father must have had his own reasons too..."

strings.text: 「私もそう理解しようと思ってたし……未だにそう思っている」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I tried to understand it that way too... and I still do."

strings.text: 「けど……やっぱり……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "But... after all..."

strings.text: 「大丈夫だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's okay."

strings.text: 「俺はもうお前の彼氏なんだから」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm your boyfriend now, after all."

strings.text: 「そういうのもひっくるめて、何とかするさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Including all of that, I'll figure something out."

strings.text: 「なおくん……またそういうかっこいい事言う」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nao-kun... there you go saying cool things again."

strings.text: 「口だけならいくらでも言えるからな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Talk is cheap, after all..."

strings.text: 「嘘つき……」
strings.speaker: 稟
直哉
strings.translated: "R-Rin?"

strings.text: 「お話をするには、遠すぎます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's too far to have a conversation."

strings.text: 「こっちで寝ます」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'll sleep over here."

strings.text: 「ば、ばかソファに入ってくるヤツがいるかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-idiot, who climbs into someone's couch like that?"

strings.text: 「いいんです。だいたいこんな時間に声大きめで話すなんて近所迷惑ですもん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's fine. Talking loudly at this hour would bother the neighbors."

strings.text:
「そりゃ、そうかもしれないが……
でも、リビングのソファーで二人寝るの狭いぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"That may be true, but...
sharing a living-room couch between two people is cramped."

strings.text: 「大丈夫だよ。私は狭いの好きですもん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's okay. I like cramped places."

strings.text: 「そ、そういう問題か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "T-that's the issue?"

strings.text: 「はい、とりあえず入れてくださいよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, just let me in already."

strings.text: 「あ、ああ……寝付くまでだぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A-alright... only until you fall asleep, okay?"

strings.text: 「それでもいいですよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's fine with me."

strings.text: 稟は俺のソファに入り込む。
strings.translated: Rin slipped onto my couch.

strings.text: その後も寝る事はなく、日が昇るまで二人の会話は続いた。
strings.translated: Even after that, she didn't sleep, and our conversation continued until the sun rose.

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「おはようございます。さすがに寝不足ですねぇ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Good morning. You look pretty sleep-deprived, huh."

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「ああ、寝不足だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I didn't get much sleep..."

strings.text: 「夜空が明るくなったので、急いで寝たぐらいですもんね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The sky started getting light, so you rushed off to sleep right after."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah..."

strings.text: 俺はその後もあまり寝られなかったが……。
strings.translated: Even after that, I couldn't sleep much though...

strings.text:
くそ……それにしても朝立ちがきつい……。
稟がいるからオナニーも出来ない。
strings.translated: Damn... my morning wood is killing me... And I can't even jerk off with Rin here.

strings.text:
あんないろいろな事があったあげく、一晩そのまま一つの布団で寝たんだ。
もう、これが朝立ちなのか本立ちなのかさっぱり分からないが、どうでもいいから一発でも抜かないと死んでしまいそうだ。
strings.translated:
After everything that happened, we slept the rest of the night together in the same futon.
I can't even tell anymore if this is morning wood or just plain wood, but whatever it is, I feel like I'll die if I don't get one out.

strings.text: 「ふぁぁあ……眠い。ご飯作りますね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Fwaaah... I'm sleepy. I'll make breakfast, okay?"

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

strings.text: 先に起きた稟が俺が起きたのを確認すると、当たり前の様にキッチンへと入っていった。
strings.translated: Rin had gotten up first, and once she confirmed I was awake, she walked into the kitchen like it was the most natural thing.

strings.text: 俺はそんな稟を見送った。
strings.translated: I watched her go.

strings.text:
リビングからはキッチンが見渡せる。
当然、稟が料理している姿も見る事が出来る。
strings.translated:
From the living room, you can see straight into the kitchen.
Which naturally meant I could watch Rin cook.

strings.text: 俺は洗面台に向かう。
strings.translated: I headed to the washstand.

strings.text: 顔でも真水で洗えば、少しは落ち着くであろう。
strings.translated: Splashing my face with cold water should calm me down at least a little.

strings.text: おれは洗面器であるものを見つける。
strings.translated: Then I spotted something at the sink.

strings.text: 「これって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This is..."

strings.text: 歯ブラシを手にしようとすると、昨日寝支度する前に、稟と一緒にコンビニで買った歯ブラシセットが置いてある。
strings.translated: As I reached for my toothbrush, there beside it was the toothbrush set Rin and I had bought together at the convenience store last night before getting ready for bed.

strings.text:
色はピンク色。
今までこの家には無い色だ……。
strings.translated:
The color was pink.
A color that had never existed in this house before...

strings.text: そんな歯ブラシが俺の歯ブラシと並んでいる。
strings.translated: That toothbrush stood there lined up beside mine.

strings.text: 「なんだ……この幸福感……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What is this... feeling of happiness..."

strings.text: リビングに戻ると、何もする事もなく俺は食卓に座る。
strings.translated: Back in the living room, with nothing to do, I sat down at the table.

strings.text: 「なんか手伝おうか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Want me to help with something?"

strings.text: 「いいですよ。もう少し待ってくださいねー」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's fine. Just wait a little longer, okay?"

strings.text: 「そうか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 俺はリビングの机に座るが、何もする事がない。
strings.translated: I sat at the living room table, but I had nothing to do.

strings.text: 「本当に、何かしなくていいのか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Really, are you sure I don't need to do anything?"

strings.text: 「当たり前ですよ。もうだいたい終わりましたから、あ、なおくんって朝のコーヒー飲みますか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Of course. I'm mostly done already. Oh, do you drink coffee in the morning, Nao-kun?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな。出来たらブラックで頼む」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I do. If you can, I'll take it black."

strings.text: 「はい、かしこまりました」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, understood."

strings.text:
俺は手持無沙汰から、意味も無くテレビをつける。
朝のニュース番組がやっているが、あまり集中して見られるものじゃない。
strings.translated:
With nothing to occupy myself, I turned on the TV for no real reason.
A morning news program was on, but not the kind of thing I could focus on.

strings.text: 「前ちょっといいですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Excuse me, can I get through?"

strings.text: 食卓に料理が並んでいく。
strings.translated: Dishes lined up on the table one by one.

strings.text: 「うまそうだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Looks good."

strings.text: 「ごめんね。昨日コンビニで買えるものでしか料理出来なかったから、あまり大層なものが作れなくて……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Sorry. I could only use what we bought at the convenience store last night, so I couldn't make anything too fancy..."

strings.text: 「いやいや、十分だ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, this is more than enough..."

strings.text: 「なおくんって好き嫌いありませんでしたよね？　あとアレルギーとかは？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You don't have any dislikes, right, Nao-kun? What about allergies?"

strings.text: 「大丈夫だ。何でも食える」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm fine. I can eat anything."

strings.text: 「そうですか、良かった」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really? That's a relief."

strings.text: 献立は、わかめと豆腐の味噌汁。
strings.translated: The menu: miso soup with wakame and tofu.

strings.text: 納豆。
strings.translated: Natto.

strings.text: オムレツ。
strings.translated: An omelet.

strings.text: 大根の梅干しソースのサラダ。
strings.translated: Daikon salad with a pickled plum dressing.

strings.text: 決して、豪勢な料理ではない。
strings.translated: Hardly a lavish spread.

strings.text: だが、何だろうか。このえも言われぬ幸福感は……。
strings.translated: But somehow -- what was this indescribable sense of contentment?

strings.text:
「はい、コーヒーです。
すみません、メニューが和洋折衷で……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Here's your coffee.
Sorry, the menu's kind of a Japanese-Western mix..."

strings.text: 「いやいや、全然かまわない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, I don't mind at all."

strings.text: 「それでは食べましょうかね。いただきまーす」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well then, let's eat. Itadakimasu."

strings.text: 「頂きます」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Itadakimasu."

strings.text: 俺は味噌汁を一口すする。
strings.translated: I took a sip of the miso soup.

strings.text:
味は粉末状のだしの味では無い。
これは煮干しからだしをとったものだ。
strings.translated:
It wasn't the taste of powdered stock.
The dashi had been drawn properly from dried sardines.

strings.text: 「うまいな、ちゃんとだしが取れている」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This is good. The stock's properly made."

strings.text: 「なおくんの家って赤だしなのですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Your household uses red miso, huh, Nao-kun."

strings.text: 「ああ、赤だしは好きだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I like red miso."

strings.text: 「めずらしいですね。でも赤だしって鰹だしの方が合いませんか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's unusual. But doesn't red miso pair better with bonito stock?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、そうなんだが、煮干しの方が値段安いだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, it does, but sardines are cheaper."

strings.text: 「そうですね。本当にその辺りのなおくんの生活力はすごいんですね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see. Your life skills in that department really are impressive."

strings.text: 「何が？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Scared of what?"

strings.text: 「いいえ、値段を気にして料理する人なんて、なおくんの年齢でまずいないだろうなぁ……って」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It's just... you don't often find someone your age, Nao-kun, who cooks with an eye on the cost..."

strings.text: 「金がない一人暮らしだったらそんなもんだろ。ただ俺の場合はそんじょそこらの一人暮らしはじめたての大学生とは、比較にならないぐらい長いってだけだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "When you're broke and living alone, that's how it goes. It's just that in my case, I've been at it way longer than your average college student who's just starting to live on his own."

strings.text: 「うん、そう言われてみればそうかも」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, now that you mention it, that's true."

strings.text: 「あと、母親が金に厳しい人でな。まぁ、その影響はあると思う」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Also, my mother was strict about money. I think that had an influence."

strings.text: 「お金って基本的にどうしてるのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "How do you handle money, basically?"

strings.text: 「親父が母親に送金してた貯金を切り崩している。まぁ、就職まで考えれば、そこまで切り詰めなくても良いだけの蓄えはあるのだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm slowly drawing down the savings my old man used to send my mother. If I think as far as getting a job, I've got enough set aside that I don't have to cut back that hard, but..."

strings.text: 「なるほど、その辺りはお母さんの教育の賜物なんだ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I see. So that side of things is thanks to your mother's upbringing."

strings.text:
「そうだな。倹約は趣味みたいなもんかもしれん。
まぁ、鳥谷にしょせん趣味の範囲だと揶揄される事もあるぐらいだからな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"That's right. Frugality's practically a hobby for me.
Makoto teases me sometimes that it's only a hobby in the end."

strings.text: 「まこちゃんは生活本当に大変みたいだね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Sounds like Mako-chan's really having a hard time getting by."

strings.text: 「親と喧嘩してるらしくて、学費も全部自分で稼いでるらしい。勉強も良くやってるし、あいつはいつ寝てるんだろうな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "She's fighting with her parents, apparently, and she's paying her own tuition. She studies hard on top of it -- when does she even sleep?"

strings.text: 「食事も結構抜いてしまうみたいですしね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "She skips meals pretty often, too, it seems."

strings.text: 「とは言っても、飯とかやると、やれ、貸しだ、借りだ、とうるさい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That said, if you buy her food, she gets all worked up about debts and favors."

strings.text: 「はい、そうですね。それは私も経験済みです」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yes, exactly. I've experienced that myself."

strings.text:
「まぁ、あいつはあいつでいろいろあるんだろ……。
あの校長の娘だって話だし」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Well, she's got her own stuff going on...
They say she's the principal's daughter, after all."

strings.text: 「校長さん良い人そうですね。美人だし」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "The principal seems like a nice person. And she's beautiful."

strings.text: 「美人？　ババァだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Beautiful? Isn't she an old lady?"

strings.text: 「いいえ、年の割には美人です。だいたいそういう言い方は失礼だよ、なおくん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "No, she's beautiful for her age. Really, that's a rude way to put it, Nao-kun."

strings.text: 「まぁ、そうかもしれないが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Well, maybe so, but..."

strings.text: 「あんな風に綺麗に歳を取りたいなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'd love to age that gracefully..."

strings.text: 「あんな風に綺麗にか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Age that gracefully, huh..."

strings.text: 稟のお母さんは綺麗な人だった。
strings.translated: Rin's mother was a beautiful person.

strings.text: だからお前だって十分、綺麗に歳を取る事ができるさ……。
strings.translated: So you can absolutely age just as gracefully...

strings.text: とは言えない。
strings.translated: I couldn't say that.

strings.text: まぁ、気恥ずかしいというのもあるが、稟にはこの手の話は御法度なのだ。
strings.translated: Well, part of it was embarrassment, but talk of that kind was strictly off-limits with Rin.

strings.text: 俺は稟を見つめる。
strings.translated: I gazed at Rin.

strings.text: 歳を取った稟か……。
strings.translated: An older Rin, huh...

strings.text: 稟と一緒になれば、ずっと二人でこんな時間を過ごせるのか……。
strings.translated: If I ended up with Rin, would we spend all our time together like this...?

strings.text: 朝起きて、稟が料理を作ってくれて、食卓を共に囲んでいる。
strings.translated: Waking up in the morning, Rin cooking, sharing a meal across the table.

strings.text: 何とも言えない充足感。
strings.translated: An indescribable fullness.

strings.text: 料理は自分で作るものという意識しかない俺には、誰かが料理をしてくれて、ただ待つという、このあたりがなんともいえず心地よかった。
strings.translated: For someone like me, whose only sense of cooking was that you did it yourself, having someone else cook while I simply waited was, in some way I couldn't articulate, deeply comforting.

strings.text: 特に、朝のひとときを二人で、というのが何とも言えない。
strings.translated: Especially the morning hour, spent with someone -- there was something about it beyond words.

strings.text: 「ん？　どうしましたか？　そんな顔で私を見て？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hm? What's the matter? Why are you looking at me with that face?"

strings.text: 「ど、どんな顔してた？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wh-what kind of face was I making?"

strings.text: 「なんだろ、笑顔とも違う……何かをかみしめている様な……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "How do I put it... it's not quite a smile... more like you're savoring something..."

strings.text: まんまだな。おい。
strings.translated: Right on the mark. Come on.

strings.text: 「ま、まぁ、かみしめていたからな……仕方がない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-well, I was savoring it... so, can't be helped."

strings.text: 「何をかみしめていたのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What were you savoring?"

strings.text:
「それは、なんだ、その……幸せだなぁ……って、
稟みたいな可愛い彼女が出来て、朝にその……料理作ってくれて……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"That was, well, you know... just, how happy I am...
Having a cute girlfriend like you, and in the morning, well... having her make me breakfast..."

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nnn--"

strings.text:
今まで普通にしゃべっていた稟が突然俯く。
そしてか細い声で……、
strings.translated:
Rin, who had been chatting normally until then, suddenly dropped her gaze.
And in a thin voice...

strings.text: 「そ、それは光栄です……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Th-that's an honor..."

strings.text: 「ひ、一晩泊めて頂いてずっと一緒にいられたわけですし……彼女にしていただいたばかりなのですけど……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "S-since you let me stay over, we've been together the whole time... and I only just became your girlfriend, but..."

strings.text: 「いやいや、あれは俺が悪いから、泊めるも何も……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No, no, that was my fault, so 'let you stay over' or whatever..."

strings.text:
「はい……なんか昨日は大変でした。
私のミスではあるのですが……パンツをはいてない姿を二度も見られましたし……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Yes... yesterday was really something.
It was my mistake, but... you saw me without my panties, twice..."

strings.text: 「ど、どうしましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wh-what's wrong?"

strings.text: 「あ、いや……なんだ……そのな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, no... um... it's just..."

strings.text: 朝起きた後に、稟よりも後にソファから出てきたのには理由がある。
strings.translated: There was a reason I got off the sofa later than Rin did that morning.

strings.text: まぁ、当然と言えば当然すぎる理由。
strings.translated: Well, an obvious enough reason -- too obvious, really.

strings.text: 男なら分かるだろうが、朝というのはどうあっても下半身的に元気になってしまうものだ。
strings.translated: Any guy would understand, but in the morning, no matter what, the lower half tends to get lively.

strings.text: ましてや、昨日の今朝である。
strings.translated: Especially the morning after yesterday.

strings.text: まったく収まる様子などなかったので、真水で顔を洗った。
strings.translated: It showed absolutely no sign of settling down, so I washed my face with cold water.

strings.text: それでなんとか収まった様なので、リビングで平常を振る舞っているにすぎない……。
strings.translated: That seemed to more or less do the trick, so I was in the living room acting normal...

strings.text: 「え、えっとな……あの、なんというか……その……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "U-um, well... it's, how do I say this... um..."

strings.text: なので、“昨日の事”など言われたら、俺の股間はすぐに臨戦態勢となった。
