strings.translated: Rin had indeed mistaken a doll for her own mother, but it was not born of any weakness in her heart.

strings.text: すべての不幸と、すべての善意が今の最悪な状況を生んでいる事。
strings.translated: Every misfortune, every well-meant choice, had conspired to breed this nightmare.

strings.text: 否、善意だと知っているが故に稟は信じないだろう。
strings.translated: No -- precisely because she knew it was born of goodwill, Rin would not believe it.

strings.text: 「なおくんの右手を奪い。さらに絵を奪い、お父さんを苦しめた」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I stole Nao-kun's right hand. And then his painting. And I made my father suffer."

strings.text: 「全部私の弱さが招いた事なんだ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "All of it was brought on by my weakness."

strings.text: 「私はお父さんを逆恨みしていた」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I bore a grudge against Father, twisted the blame onto him."

strings.text:
「お母さんを奪ったという嘘の記憶を作り出して……、
自分がお母さんを殺してしまった事実を受け入れられなかったから！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"I fabricated the false memory that he had taken Mother from me...
because I couldn't accept the fact that I was the one who killed her!"

strings.text: 稟は再び走り始める。
strings.translated: Rin began to run again.

strings.text: 汗だくで、まるでもがくように、
strings.translated: Drenched in sweat, as if writhing,

strings.text: ただ走り続ける。
strings.translated: she simply kept on running.

strings.text: もう二人に言葉は無かった。
strings.translated: There were no more words between us.

strings.text: 沈黙の中で、稟は走り、俺は彼女を追いかける。
strings.translated: In the silence, Rin ran, and I chased after her.

strings.text: そして、あの場所にたどり着いた。
strings.translated: And so we arrived at that place.

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "This is..."

strings.text: 気がつくと、俺たちは稟の屋敷跡に立っていた。
strings.translated: Before I realized it, we were standing on the grounds of Rin's ruined estate.

strings.text: もちろんたまたまだ。
strings.translated: By coincidence, of course.

strings.text: だけど、ずっと走り続けたら、いつかはここにもたどり着くであろう。
strings.translated: But if you ran on and on, sooner or later you were bound to end up here.

strings.text: だが、ここでも俺は判断を誤った。
strings.translated: And here too, I misjudged.

strings.text: そこは、俺にとっては、ずっと「あの火災があった屋敷跡」であったが、彼女にとっては、はじめて目にする「あの火災があった屋敷跡」なのである。
strings.translated: For me, this had always been "the site of that fire," but for her, this was the first time she was laying eyes on "the site of that fire."

strings.text: 稟は工事中のマンションに走り出す。
strings.translated: Rin took off running into the apartment building under construction.

strings.text: 「しまった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Damn it."

strings.text: 青白い月明かりの下で、鉄階段の音が鳴り響く。
strings.translated: Under the pale blue moonlight, the sound of iron stairs rang out.

strings.text: 稟はむき出しの鉄の非常階段を駆け上っていく。
strings.translated: Rin sprinted up the exposed iron emergency staircase.

strings.text: まるでその姿は螺旋状に月に向かっている様に見えた。
strings.translated: The sight of her seemed to spiral upward toward the moon.

strings.text: 強い風が吹く。
strings.translated: A strong wind blew.

strings.text: そこは屋上というには、あまりに不完全な場所であった。
strings.translated: The place was far too incomplete to call a rooftop.

strings.text: 多くの鉄骨がむき出しになっており、当然のごとくフェンスなども無い。
strings.translated: Many of the steel beams were laid bare, and, as one might expect, there were no fences or the like.

strings.text: ただ、そこは屋上に位置する場所であることは間違いないらしく、工事用の足場もここの足下で途絶えていた。
strings.translated: Still, it was clearly the topmost point of the structure -- even the construction scaffolding ended here beneath our feet.

strings.text: 「覚えてる……この風景……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I remember... this view..."

strings.text: 「さすがに私の家はこれほど高くなかったけど……それでもここから見える風景は同じだ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Of course my house wasn't nearly this tall... but even so, the view from here is the same..."

strings.text: 「あの時と……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Just like it was, back then..."

strings.text: 「稟……帰るぞ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin... let's go home."

strings.text: 「帰る？　私、どこに帰ればいいのですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Home? Where am I supposed to go home to?"

strings.text: 「帰れないよ……。私、こんな私が帰れる場所なんてあるわけないじゃないですか……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I can't go home... There's no place a person like me could go home to..."

strings.text: 俺が一歩近づくと、稟は一歩遠ざかる。
strings.translated: When I took a step forward, Rin took a step back.

strings.text: 徐々に稟は屋上の縁に近づいてしまう。
strings.translated: Little by little, she drew closer to the edge of the roof.

strings.text: 「稟、危ないからこっちにこい……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin, it's dangerous, come over here..."

strings.text: 「私、なおくんみたいな人の才能をつぶしておいて、今日まで良くも平気で生きてこれたね……。普通だったら、罪悪感で死んじゃうよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I crushed the talent of someone like Nao-kun, and I've managed to live on unbothered until today... normally, the guilt would kill you."

strings.text:
「普通だったら、申し訳なくて生きてられないよ？
そういうものだよ普通……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Normally, you couldn't bear to keep living, out of sheer remorse.
That's how it should be, normally..."

strings.text: 「そんな事許されるはずもない……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "There's no way such a thing could ever be allowed..."

strings.text: まるで取り憑かれた様に稟は自問自答する。
strings.translated: As if possessed, Rin questioned and answered herself.

strings.text: 誰かに吹き込まれたのか……。
strings.translated: Had someone whispered this to her...?

strings.text: いや、そんな人間は一人しかいない。
strings.translated: No -- there was only one person who would.

strings.text:
長山のヤツ。
稟にこんな言葉を投げつけたのか……。
strings.translated:
Nagayama.
Had she thrown these words at Rin...?

strings.text: 「稟、聞け」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin, listen."

strings.text: 「なおくんは優しいから……いくらでも嘘をついてくれるよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You're so kind, Nao-kun... you'd tell me any number of lies."

strings.text: 「私が安心出来る様に、いくらでも自分を犠牲に出来る」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You'll sacrifice yourself endlessly, just so I can feel at ease."

strings.text: 「現に、今日の今日まで、なおくんは私のために自分を犠牲にしてきた」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "In fact, until this very day, Nao-kun has sacrificed himself for my sake."

strings.text: 「みんなから、何故絵を描かないのかと問われても、すべての責任を自分がかぶった」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Whenever anyone asked why you wouldn't paint, you took all the blame onto yourself."

strings.text: 「私が傷つかない様に……私を守るために……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "So that I wouldn't be hurt... to protect me..."

strings.text: 「距離を取っていたのも、そのせいなんだ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That's the reason you kept your distance, too."

strings.text: 「まるで自分の怠惰から連絡をよこさない素振りを見せて……実際は私を守るために距離を置いた……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You made it look as if you just couldn't be bothered to get in touch... but really you were keeping your distance to protect me..."

strings.text: 「不用意に接する事で、私が過去を思い出し、その罪の意識に耐えられないと思って、わざと距離を置いてくれた」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You thought that careless contact would make me remember the past, that I couldn't bear the weight of that guilt -- and so you deliberately kept your distance."

strings.text: 「その優しさすら理解出来ずに、私はこの街に戻ってきた……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "And without even understanding that kindness, I came back to this town..."

strings.text: 「違う、聞け稟」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're wrong. Listen to me, Rin."

strings.text: 「何が違うのですか？　なおくんは私のために犠牲になってたんだよね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What's wrong about it? You've been sacrificing yourself for my sake, haven't you?"

strings.text: 考えられる限り、最悪の記憶の取り戻し方だ。
strings.translated: It was the worst possible way she could have gotten her memory back.

strings.text: 俺の不注意で長山を病室に入れてしまったからだ。
strings.translated: All because my carelessness had let Nagayama into her hospital room.

strings.text: あいつは、稟が罪の意識を最大限感じる形で、真実を伝えた。
strings.translated: She had delivered the truth in exactly the form that would make Rin feel the guilt to its utmost.

strings.text:
いや、真実ならばまだ良い。
その中には悪質な嘘すらまざっている。
strings.translated:
No -- the truth would have been fine.
Mixed into what she told her were malicious lies as well.

strings.text: 「稟！　まず聞け！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin! First -- listen!"

strings.text: 「一つずつ答えていこう」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Let's take this one thing at a time."

strings.text: 「まず、お前が母親を殺したというのは大間違いだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "First -- the idea that you killed your mother is completely wrong."

strings.text: 「あの新聞を読んで、長山はお前の部屋から出火したという事を言ったのだろうけど、あれはお前の部屋ではない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nagayama must have read that newspaper and told you the fire started in your room, but that wasn't your room."

strings.text: 「お前の家ほどの屋敷だ。子供部屋はあの当時は使われてなかったし、すでにお前は子供部屋をあてがわれる年齢でもなかった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's a mansion the size of your family's estate. The children's room wasn't in use at the time, and you were already too old to have been assigned it."

strings.text: 「あれは六年前の話だ。子供部屋はあくまでも昔使われてた部屋にすぎない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This was six years ago. The children's room was nothing more than a room that had once been used."

strings.text: 「さらに言えば出火原因も、お前はもとより誰も悪いわけではない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And what's more, the cause of the fire -- no one was to blame, least of all you."

strings.text: 「配線のショートにおける出火。それが真実だ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A fire caused by an electrical short. That is the truth."

strings.text: 「お前が、母親を殺したなんて、まったくのデタラメだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "The idea that you killed your mother is complete nonsense."

strings.text: 「なおくん、優しいよね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nao-kun, you really are kind..."

strings.text: 「今までも、そうやって、私の事を守ってきてくれたんだよね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "You've been protecting me this way all along, haven't you..."

strings.text: くそ……。
strings.translated: Damn it...

strings.text: やはり信じてもらえない。
strings.translated: Still, she wouldn't believe me.

strings.text: 当たり前といえば当たり前だ。
strings.translated: Which was, if you thought about it, only natural.

strings.text: それがどんな理由であれ、俺は稟をだまし続けてきたのはたしかだ。
strings.translated: Whatever the reason, it was true that I'd kept lying to Rin all this time.

strings.text: 今の稟にとっては、それが優しければ優しいほど、俺の言葉が信用出来ないであろう。
strings.translated: To the Rin who stood before me now, the kinder my words, the less she could trust them.

strings.text: だったら……。
strings.translated: In that case...

strings.text: 「稟っ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin!"

strings.text: 俺は一気に距離を縮める。
strings.translated: I closed the distance in a single burst.

strings.text: さすがに、屋上の縁より先に稟が行くとは思えなかった。
strings.translated: Surely Rin wouldn't go beyond the edge of the roof.

strings.text: だが、事実は違った。
strings.translated: But that wasn't what had happened.

strings.text: 月が大きく見えた。
strings.translated: The moon looked huge.

strings.text: そして、それがえらく恐ろしげなものに見えた。
strings.translated: And it looked terribly, dreadfully ominous.

strings.text: 何故だろうか、青白い光を放ち浮かぶその球体に、俺は恐怖を感じた。
strings.translated: Why, I could not say -- but that sphere hanging there, casting its pale blue light, filled me with fear.

strings.text: その瞬間。
strings.translated: In that instant.

strings.text: 俺が距離を縮めた事で一瞬身を引いた稟。
strings.translated: Rin pulled back for a moment as I closed in on her.

strings.text: その瞬間を狙っていたかの様に風が吹く。
strings.translated: As if it had been waiting for that instant, a wind blew.

strings.text: 複雑に入り組んだ骨組みのマンションは、信じられないほどの風を生み出す。
strings.translated: The apartment building, all intricate crisscrossed girders, generated a wind of unbelievable force.

strings.text: ただ身を引いただけの稟の身体を簡単に浮かしてしまった。
strings.translated: Rin had barely flinched back before the flames caught her body and swept her effortlessly into the air.

strings.text: 稟が俺の視界から消えていく。
strings.translated: Rin was vanishing from my sight.

strings.text: 月が二人を照らす。
strings.translated: The moon lit the two of us.

strings.text: まるで、悲劇の一幕の様に、わざとらしく、俺たちを照らす。
strings.translated: Like a scene from a tragedy, staged and deliberate, it lit us up.

strings.text: 俺は身を投げ出して稟を捕まえようとする。
strings.translated: I threw myself forward and tried to catch her.

strings.text: あの屋敷など問題じゃないぐらい高層階のマンションだ。
strings.translated: It was a high-rise, on a scale that made her family's old estate seem nothing.

strings.text: ここから落ちて無事でいられるわけがない。
strings.translated: There was no way anyone could fall from here and be unharmed.

strings.text: だから俺は――。
strings.translated: And so I --

strings.text: 無音の後に強烈な風の音を俺は聞いた。
strings.translated: After the silence, I heard the fierce roar of the wind.

strings.text: 感触があった。
strings.translated: There was a touch.

strings.text: 咄嗟に出してしまった右腕に、たしかに彼女の温かみを感じた。
strings.translated: In the right arm I'd thrust out on reflex, I could feel, unmistakably, her warmth.

strings.text: 「稟！　無事か！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin! Are you all right?!"

strings.text: 「くそっ……。手に力が入らない……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Damn it... my hand won't grip..."

strings.text: 「な、なおくん、なんでこんなに手が血だらけなの？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-Nao-kun, why is your hand covered in blood?"

strings.text: 稟が血だらけの俺の手を見て驚愕する。
strings.translated: Rin stared in shock at my blood-soaked hand.

strings.text: そんな場合ではないだろ。
strings.translated: This was hardly the time.

strings.text: 自分の生死がかかっている時にまで、俺の手なんか心配するなんて……。
strings.translated: With her own life hanging in the balance, and still she worried about my hand...

strings.text: 「何があったんですか！　右手、すごい怪我です。すぐに治療しないと！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "What happened?! Your right hand -- it's an awful wound. It needs treatment, right away!"

strings.text: 「バカ！　そんな心配してる場合か！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You idiot! Is this really the time to worry about that?!"

strings.text: 「何がバカですか！　ただでなくても私が傷つけた右手を……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "How am I the idiot?! The right hand I already hurt, and now..."

strings.text: 「バカはバカだ！　お前は大馬鹿だ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "An idiot is an idiot! You're the biggest idiot of all!"

strings.text: 「な、なんですか、それ！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wh-what is that supposed to mean?!"

strings.text: 「バカな稟に一度しか言わない！　良く聞け！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'll say this to my idiot Rin only once! Now listen!"

strings.text: 手の感覚が無い。
strings.translated: I had no feeling in my hand.

strings.text: こんな事なら、あんなバカな事をしなければ良かった。
strings.translated: If it was going to come to this, I shouldn't have done that stupid thing.

strings.text: 壁を叩いたりしなければ、まだ稟をちゃんとつかめていただろう。
strings.translated: If I hadn't punched the wall, I'd still have been able to grip Rin properly.

strings.text: だが今は、ほんの数秒後には稟を落としてしまいそうだ。
strings.translated: But as it was, within seconds I was going to drop her.

strings.text: だから俺は言う。
strings.translated: And so I spoke.

strings.text: 優しさとはかけ離れた言葉。
strings.translated: Words far removed from kindness.

strings.text: ただ俺の思いを、稟に伝える。
strings.translated: Just my own true feelings, delivered to Rin.

strings.text: 「お前が俺の右手を奪ったんだろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're the one who took my right hand from me, aren't you!"

strings.text: 「そ、そうです……。だから、はやく手を離してください。それ以上、その右手を傷つけないでください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Y-yes, that's right... So, please, let go of me. Please don't hurt that right hand any more than you already have."

strings.text:
「ふざけるな！　てめぇが奪ったんだろ！
そのせいで俺はお前を掴み続ける事は出来ないんだ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Don't screw with me! You're the one who took it!
That's exactly why I can't keep holding on to you!"

strings.text: 「俺はお前の手を離したくない！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't want to let go of you!"

strings.text: 「お前をずっと離したくない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I don't ever want to let you go."

strings.text: 「でも、今の俺にはその力がない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "But I don't have that strength anymore."

strings.text: 「あと数分も持たず、俺はお前を手放してしまうだろう……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "In another few minutes I won't be able to hold on to you at all..."

strings.text: 「俺の右手に力が無いからだ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Because my right hand has no strength left."

strings.text: 「そして、その力を奪ったのはお前だろ！　稟！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And the one who took that strength from me was you, wasn't it, Rin!"

strings.text: 「な、なおくん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-Nao-kun..."

strings.text: 「だったら、お前が俺の手を掴め！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Then you grab hold of my hand!"

strings.text: 「俺が掴めない！　俺が握れない！　お前の手が！　俺の手を掴め！！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "My fingers are slipping! I can't hold on! Reach out -- grab my hand!!"

strings.text: 「それが責任ってもんだろ！！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's what responsibility is, isn't it!!"

strings.text:
「俺の右手を奪ったと思うのは勝手だ。そう思いたければ思うがいいさ！
だが、だったら責任を取れ！！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Think whatever you like about having taken my right hand. If that's how you want to think of it, fine!
But in that case -- take responsibility!!"

strings.text: 「俺の右手が出来ない事をしろ！！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Do what my right hand cannot!!"

strings.text: 「俺が出来ない事をしろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Do what I cannot!"

strings.text: 「俺の願いを聞き入れろ！！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Grant me my wish!!"

strings.text:
「俺は、お前を離したくない……。
だからお前が俺の右手を掴め……掴んでくれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I don't want to let you go...
So grab my right hand yourself... please, grab it..."

strings.text: 「掴んで……離すな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Grab it... and don't let go."

strings.text: 「お前自身の手で俺を掴み、そして、俺を抱きしめてくれ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "With your own hand, seize me -- and then, hold me!"

strings.text: もう、手に力が入らない。
strings.translated: My hand had no strength left.

strings.text: これまでかと思った瞬間、俺の手に強い圧迫を感じる。
strings.translated: Just as I thought this was the end, I felt a strong pressure on my hand.

strings.text: 稟の手が強く俺の腕を掴んでいる。
strings.translated: Rin's hand was gripping my arm tightly.

strings.text: 「なおくん、なおくん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Nao-kun, Nao-kun."

strings.text:
「泣くのは後だ！　今は、俺の手を掴んで、そのまま登れ。
今の俺にはお前を持ち上げる力も残ってない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Crying comes later! For now, grab my hand and climb up.
I don't have the strength left to pull you up."

strings.text:
「お前を追いかける時に足をくじいた。
そのまま歩き通しで、正直しんどい。まったく力が入らない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I twisted my ankle running after you.
I've been walking on it the whole time, and honestly, it's killing me. I've got no strength left at all."

strings.text: 「だから、早く」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So -- hurry."

strings.text: 稟は俺の手を強く掴む。
strings.translated: Rin gripped my hand hard.

strings.text: 力強く<r のぼ>上</r>ってくる。
strings.translated: With all her strength, she climbed up.

strings.text: これが、あの時に俺が支えた小さな娘だろうか？
strings.translated: Was this really the same small girl I had once held up?

strings.text: 彼女は真っ直ぐ、俺に向かって昇ってくる。
strings.translated: She climbed straight up, toward me.

strings.text: そして俺に抱きつく。
strings.translated: And then she threw herself into my arms.

strings.text: 泣き崩れる稟。
strings.translated: Rin, breaking down in tears.

strings.text: そんな稟を俺はただ抱きしめた。
strings.translated: And I simply held her.

strings.text: 「俺が自分の右腕を失ってまで、守ろうとしたもんだ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You're what I tried to protect, even at the cost of my own right arm..."

strings.text: 「それまで奪わないでくれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't take that from me too..."

strings.text: 「稟……生きてくれ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin... live..."

strings.text: 「俺のために……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "For my sake..."

strings.text: 「そして、お前のお母さんのためにも……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And for your mother's sake, too..."

strings.text: 「ごめん、ごめんなさぃ……なおくん……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I'm sorry, I'm so sorry... Nao-kun..."

strings.text: 「ふぅ……泣くなよ……バカ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Hah... don't cry... idiot."

strings.text: はぁ……、今度こそちゃんと守れたよな。
strings.translated: Haah... this time, at least, I managed to protect her properly.

strings.text: 彼女の過去と共に……。
strings.translated: Along with her past...

strings.text: 今年は例年よりも早い開花らしい。
strings.translated: This year the blossoms opened earlier than usual.

strings.text: 卒業式をむかえる頃には、もう弓張学園は桜に彩られていた。
strings.translated: By the time graduation came around, Yumihari Academy was already decked out in cherry blossoms.

strings.text: 俺は一枚の絵を取りに来た。
strings.translated: I had come to collect a single painting.

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.text: 「今年の部員の作品か……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This year's club members' work, huh..."

strings.text: 卒業を迎え、俺はそれぞれの作品を再び見直す。
strings.translated: With graduation finally here, I looked over each of their pieces once more.

strings.text: 氷川里奈と川内野優美はそれぞれ風景画。
strings.translated: Hikawa Rina and Kawachino Yumi had both done landscapes.

strings.text: この学園の屋上から見た風景を描いている。
strings.translated: Each depicted the view from the rooftop of this school.

strings.text:
氷川のものはなかなかの作品であったが、何故かムーア展は見送った。
三年間かけてじっくりと狙いたいとの事だ。
strings.translated:
Hikawa's was quite the accomplished work, but for some reason she skipped the Moore Exhibition.
She said she wanted to spend all three years aiming for it properly.

strings.text: 川内野のものは、いかにもがんばって描いた油絵といった感じのもの、こちらもムーア展には出さなかった様だ。
strings.translated: Kawachino's had the air of an oil painting she'd struggled hard to complete; it seemed she hadn't submitted hers to the Moore either.

strings.text: 鳥谷の作品もある。
strings.translated: There was a piece by Toritani as well.

strings.text: 作品は陶芸であった。
strings.translated: Her work was a piece of pottery.

strings.text: 陶芸専門の部門は無く、彫刻などと同じものとして扱われた様だが、結果を出す事は出来なかった。
strings.translated: With no dedicated category for ceramics, her work had been lumped in with sculpture, and she came away empty-handed.

strings.text: 鳥谷はこの最後の年にかけていただけに落胆もひとしおであったが、熱意や情熱だけで受賞出来る様な、そんなに簡単なものではない。
strings.translated: Toritani had staked everything on this final year, so her disappointment was especially heavy, yet it isn't so simple that enthusiasm and passion alone can win an award.

strings.text: むしろ、それを目指して学生時代に、これほどの作品を作れた事の方が驚くべきだろう。
strings.translated: If anything, the more astonishing thing is that a student could produce a work of this caliber while aiming at that goal.

strings.text: 鳥谷はその後、国立の美術大学を受験し、見事に合格した。
strings.translated: Toritani afterward took the entrance exams for a national art university and passed with flying colors.

strings.text: これほどの腕があり、さらに学力も申し分ないとなれば順当な結果であろう。
strings.translated: With skill like hers, and academic ability that left nothing to be desired, it was a natural result.

strings.text: トーマスの作品と圭の作品はここには無い。
strings.translated: Thomas's work and Kei's work aren't here.

strings.text: それは、ムーア展に入賞したから……ではない。
strings.translated: That isn't because they won prizes at the Moore Exhibition.

strings.text: トーマスは想像で氷川と川内野と鳥谷と稟のヌード画を制作していたが、制作途中で川内野にバレてしまい、即刻破られてしまったらしい。
strings.translated: Thomas had been producing imagined nude paintings of Hikawa, Kawachino, Toritani, and Rin, but Kawachino caught him mid-production and apparently tore them up on the spot.

strings.text: らしいというのは、その作品を俺が見る事が無かったからである。
strings.translated: I say "apparently" because I never actually saw the works in question.

strings.text: トーマスが描いたものが、ただのヌード作品であったとしたら、どんな理由があるにせよ、破ったという川内野の行為は許されないだろう。
strings.translated: If what Thomas had drawn had been ordinary nudes, then whatever the reason, Kawachino's act of tearing them up would be unforgivable.

strings.text: だが、トーマスが描いたものが四人のM字開脚であり、さらにダブルピースをしているものだったという話であるから、まぁ川内野の行動は大筋において正しいであろう。
strings.translated: But the story goes that Thomas had drawn all four of them in M-shaped leg spreads while flashing double peace signs, so on the whole Kawachino's action was justified.

strings.text: たぶん川内野が見つけるよりも早く、俺が見つけていたら、俺がその絵を破り捨てていただろう。
strings.translated: Probably, had I found them before Kawachino did, I would have been the one to tear those pictures to pieces.

strings.text: さらに殺していたかもしれない。
strings.translated: I might have gone as far as murder.

strings.text: 稟のＭ字開脚のダブルピースなど、存在していいわけがないし、もし仮に存在したとしても、それを目にする人間は世界でただ一人しかいない。
strings.translated: Rin doing an M-spread with double peace signs -- such a thing has no right to exist, and even if it did, there's only one person in the world who should be allowed to lay eyes on it.

strings.text: 俺だ！
strings.translated: Me!

strings.text: あいつは半年間、ずっと何もせずに鉛筆をしこしこしていたのでは無く、四人の身体を舐める様に観察していたらしい。
strings.translated: Turns out that for six months he hadn't just been idly scribbling with a pencil -- he'd been observing the four of them, licking over every inch of their bodies with his eyes.

strings.text: 恐るべし、トーマス。
strings.translated: Fearsome, that Thomas.

strings.text: その情熱をもう少しまともな方向には使えないものだろうか？
strings.translated: Couldn't he channel that passion in a slightly more respectable direction?

strings.text: 圭の作品もない。
strings.translated: Kei's work isn't here either.

strings.text: それは圭が作品を完成させなかったからだ。
strings.translated: That's because Kei never finished his piece.

strings.text: 今の今まで、完成させられないなんて事がなかった圭だが、今回は形にする事が出来なかったらしい。
strings.translated: Kei, who up until now had never failed to complete a work, apparently couldn't get this one into shape.

strings.text: ちなみに受験も失敗している。
strings.translated: Incidentally, he failed his entrance exams too.

strings.text: 浪人などするお金がない夏目家であるから、本来ならば大変な話なのだが、彼は持ち前の明るさで、まったく怯むこともなく、四月から海外へ放浪の旅を予定しているらしい。
strings.translated: The Natsume household has no money for something like a gap year, so ordinarily this would be quite the crisis, but with his innate cheer, he was undaunted, and from April he plans to set off wandering abroad.

strings.text: あいつは少し、怯んだ方が良いと思う。
strings.translated: If you ask me, that guy could stand to be a little daunted.

strings.text: だが、そうは言っても、圭の選択は間違いではないだろう。
strings.translated: Still, that said, Kei's choice isn't the wrong one.

strings.text: あいつは、この国内で美術界のくだらない派閥の中で絵を描く様なタイプではない。
strings.translated: He isn't the type to paint within the petty factions of the domestic art world.

strings.text: あの草薙健一郎がそうであった様に、いや、むしろあいつ以上に圭は自由に海外でやっていくだろう。
strings.translated: Just like Kusanagi Ken'ichirou -- no, even more so -- Kei will spread his wings overseas.

strings.text: その中で、あいつが、いつの日にか健一郎以来の快挙として、ムーア展に入賞する事だって十分ありえる。
strings.translated: Somewhere along the way, it's entirely possible that he might, for the first time since Ken'ichirou, pull off the feat of winning a prize at the Moore Exhibition.

strings.text:
今はまだダメだとしても、いつの日にか彼奴ならやれる。
俺にはそんな気がしている。
strings.translated:
Even if he can't do it yet, someday that guy will manage it.
That's the feeling I have.

strings.text: みんなの作品を見ていく。
strings.translated: I looked over everyone's works.

strings.text: もちろんレベルの差があるにしても、それぞれが良い絵だと思われた。
strings.translated: Of course there were differences in level, but each one seemed to me a fine painting.

strings.text: 最終的には、ムーア展に何一つひっかかりもしなかったが、それでも、十分にこれらは価値がある様に感じられた。
strings.translated: In the end, not a single one had made it through at the Moore Exhibition, but even so, these felt to me more than worthwhile.

strings.text: 素直にそう思える。
strings.translated: I could honestly think so.

strings.text: 最後に稟の作品を見る。
strings.translated: Last of all, I looked at Rin's work.

strings.text: 俺と共に描き上げ、ムーア展に出展した作品だ。
strings.translated: The piece we had painted together and submitted to the Moore Exhibition.

strings.text: 結果は言わずもがな。
strings.translated: The result goes without saying.

strings.text: まぁ、美術室に置いてある時点で察してほしい。
strings.translated: Well, the fact that it's sitting here in the art room should tell you enough.

strings.text: もし受賞などしていたら、その作品はこんな場所ではなく、どこかの展覧会で今も飾られているだろう。
strings.translated: Had it won something, that painting wouldn't be in a place like this -- it would still be hanging in some exhibition hall somewhere.

strings.text: 個人的にはそうならなくて良かったと思っている。
strings.translated: Personally, I'm glad it didn't turn out that way.

strings.text: 「稟の絵を俺の部屋で飾れるのだからな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "After all, this way I get to hang Rin's painting in my own room..."

strings.text: 少しになるが、あれからの話をしよう。
strings.translated: Let me tell you a little of what came after.

strings.text: そんな多く語る事もない。

strings.text: こういう話だけをしていると、その後、すべてが順風満帆であったかの様だが、それほど順調なものでは無かった。
strings.translated: If I told only these stories, it might sound like everything went smoothly from there on, but it wasn't nearly that easy.

strings.text: 特に、あの事件後、数日は、まだ俺が世間から注目を浴びていたし、なんと言っても、ヤツに目をつけられていた。

strings.text: そう長山香奈。

strings.text: あいつは、最後まで稟に絡んできた。

strings.text: すべての記憶を取り戻した稟ならば、あとは軽く背中から押せば、罪悪感によって潰すことが出来ると思ったのであろう。

strings.text: 特に、それが俺との事であるならば……。

strings.text: 稟が病院から退院した後、稟と一緒に登校した。

strings.text: 女子校生Ａ

strings.text: 女子校生Ｂ

strings.text: 「な、なおくん……」
strings.speaker: 稟

strings.text: 「でもさ、なんかイイ感じじゃない。あの二人」

strings.text: 「とってもお似合いって感じするよ」

strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｂ

strings.text: 「知らないの？　今まで、それこそ子供の時から、あらゆる<r こ>娘</r>が草薙くんに告白してきたけど、そのすべての娘がふられてるのよ」

Without even atoning for the crime you committed, you go on playing the victim to slip through."

strings.translated: "I see. If it were Kana-chan, you couldn't go on living."

strings.text: 「当たり前じゃん？　あんた、その男の腕を奪っているのよ？　その男の未来を潰してるのよ？　約束された天才の未来を、あんたがすべて奪ったのよ？」

strings.text: 「うん、そうだね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

strings.text:

普通の人間だったらそんな顔してられないでしょ？
死んでも償いきれないわよ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated:
"That's right. Isn't it? That's what's normal.
A normal person couldn't wear a face like that, could they?
Even if you died, you couldn't atone for it."

strings.text: 「そうなんだ。香奈ちゃんはどうだか知らないけど、でも私は死なない」

strings.translated: "I see. I don't know about Kana-chan, but I won't die."

strings.text: 「はぁ？」
strings.speaker: 香奈

strings.text:

それは香奈ちゃんの言う通りだと思う」

"I stole Nao-kun's talent -- no, I stole many more things than that.
I think what Kana-chan says is right about that."

strings.text: 「けどね。香奈ちゃん。今、私が生きているのは、なおくんがそれらを捨てて、そして拾ってくれた命だからだよ」

strings.translated: "But you see, Kana-chan... the only reason I'm alive today is that Nao-kun cast all of that aside to save my life."

strings.text: 「なおくんがくれた命、簡単に捨てる事なんて、許されるわけがない」

strings.translated: "The life Nao-kun gave me -- I have no right to throw it away so easily."

strings.text:

そう、私はそんな簡単な方法で逃げる事なんて許されない」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"I can't lightly say I couldn't go on living.
Yes, I'm not permitted to run away by such an easy method."

strings.text: 「それに」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Besides."

strings.text: 稟が俺の腕に絡みつく。
strings.translated: Rin wound her arms around mine.

strings.text: 「私の命、私の身体も心もこの人のものです！　今後、この命はなおくんのためだけに使うんだよ」

strings.translated: "My life, my body, and my heart all belong to him! From now on, I'll live this life for Nao-kun's sake alone."

strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "Huh?!"

strings.text: 「なおくんが拾ってくれた命だもの、香奈ちゃんがなんと言おうと大切にする」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "This life is a gift Nao-kun saved for me, so no matter what you say, Kana-chan, I'm going to cherish it."

strings.text: 「バカじゃねぇの？　そうやって自分に都合の良い解釈ばっかりして、あんたは罪人なんだよ。少しはそれらしく振る舞えよ！　だいたい草薙くんはどう思ってるの？」

strings.translated: "Are you an idiot? Always spinning things to suit yourself -- you're a criminal. At least act the part! And what about you, Kusanagi-kun -- what do you think?"

strings.text: 「どうもこうもなく、稟が正しい」

strings.translated: "There's nothing to think about. Rin is right."

strings.text:
「いやさ、それ間違いだよ。草薙くん、完全に洗脳されてる。
というか、そんなバカだっけ？　草薙くんってばさ」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated:
"No, no, that's wrong. Kusanagi-kun, you've been completely brainwashed.
Or rather, were you always this stupid, Kusanagi-kun?"

strings.text: 「あー、えっとねぇ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, umm, you know..."

strings.text: 稟が満面の笑みになる。

strings.text:
「そうそう、あと、言い忘れてましたけど、香奈ちゃん。
なおくんだけが凶暴だと思ってるでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Oh yes, I forgot to mention this, Kana-chan.
You think Nao-kun is the only violent one, don't you?"

strings.text: 「なんだよ、それ？」
strings.speaker: 香奈
strings.translated: "What's that supposed to mean?"

strings.text: 風の音がした。
strings.translated: There was the sound of wind.

strings.text: 「ひっ」

strings.translated: "Eep."

strings.text: 俺も、その瞬間を見切る事が出来ない。
strings.translated: Even I couldn't follow that moment with my eyes.

strings.text: 稟は香奈の胸元に潜り込み、彼女ののど仏に拳を突き立てていた。
strings.translated: Rin had slipped in close to Kana's chest and driven her fist against her throat.

strings.text: 一連の動きは、柔道というよりは、既に格闘技のそれであった。
strings.translated: The whole sequence of movements was less judo than pure hand-to-hand combat.

strings.text: 鼻と鼻が触れあうぐらいの距離で稟は笑顔で言う。
strings.translated: At a distance where their noses nearly touched, Rin spoke with a smile.

strings.text:
「私、なおくんを不機嫌にさせる人、嫌い……。大嫌い。
それ以上、いらない事を言うならこのまま、ここを壊すよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"I hate people who put Nao-kun in a bad mood... I really hate them.
If you say one more unnecessary word, I'll break this right here."

strings.text: 「そしたら、すごく痛くて、息出来なくなって、苦しんで苦しんで。死んじゃうかもねぇ……。香奈ちゃん……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then it'll hurt so much, you won't be able to breathe, you'll suffer and suffer. You might even die... Kana-chan..."

strings.text: こつりとゆっくりと拳を喉に押し当てる。
strings.translated: With a small tap, she pressed her fist slowly against Kana's throat.

strings.text: 「くすくす、潰しちゃおうか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hehe, shall I crush it?"

strings.text: 長山がその場で崩れ落ちる。
strings.translated: Nagayama crumpled to the floor on the spot.

strings.text:
稟の声、稟の不気味な笑顔……今のは相当な迫力があった。
長山でなくても、その場に崩れ落ちるだろう。
strings.translated:
Rin's voice, Rin's uncanny smile... just now, they carried a formidable weight.
Even someone other than Nagayama would have crumpled to the ground.

strings.text: 「ふむ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hmm."

strings.text: 稟は長山を見下ろして言葉を続ける。
strings.translated: Rin looked down at Nagayama and continued.

strings.text: 「香奈ちゃんは勘違いしているのかもしれないけど、私は感謝しているんだよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Kana-chan, you may be misunderstanding, but the truth is, I'm grateful to you."

strings.text:
「香奈ちゃんが真実を教えてくれた。
私が逃げてきた事を思い出させてくれた。だから感謝しているの」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Kana-chan taught me the truth.
She reminded me of what I'd been running from. That's why I'm grateful."

strings.text: 「その真実こそが、私に強い意志を与えてくれたのだから……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Because that very truth gave me a strong will..."

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "R-Rin..."

strings.text: 長山が稟から目線を逸らす。
strings.translated: Nagayama averted her eyes from Rin.

strings.text: 完全に勝負は逸していた。
strings.translated: The match had long since been decided.

strings.text: 長山は何も言わずに逃げる様にそこから立ち去る。
strings.translated: Without a word, Nagayama walked away as though fleeing.

strings.text: 「さーてと、すっきりした。一度、こういう事に柔道使ってみたかったんですよね。あはは」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well then, that felt refreshing. I'd been wanting to try using judo for something like this at least once. Ahaha."

strings.text: 「スカっとしました！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "That felt great!"

strings.text: いや、今の柔道じゃないし……。
strings.translated: No, that wasn't judo just now...

strings.text: 「あれ？　なおくん、少し、引いちゃいましたかね？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hm? Nao-kun, did I put you off just a little?"

strings.text: 俺は苦笑いして首を横に振る。
strings.translated: I gave a wry smile and shook my head.

strings.text: 「いいや、お前の事だ。俺に暴力を振るわせないために、あと長山が二度とこんな事を言わない様に、あえて、恐ろしげな風を装ったんだろ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "No. Knowing you, you deliberately put on that fearsome act so I wouldn't have to resort to violence, and so Nagayama would never say anything like that again. Right?"

strings.text: 「違うよ。私、やりたかったからやったんだよ。私はなおくんに負けず劣らず凶暴だよ。だって、昔っから一緒だったから、知ってるでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Wrong. I did it because I wanted to. I'm every bit as violent as you are, Nao-kun. We've been together since way back, so you know that, don't you?"

strings.text: 稟が笑う。
strings.translated: Rin laughed.

strings.text: 昔と今は少し違うが、こんな凶暴性はたしか無かったと思うが……。
strings.translated: Then and now were a little different, but I was fairly sure she'd never had that kind of ferocity before...

strings.text: ざわ、ざわ。
strings.translated: A murmur, a rustle.

strings.text: にわかに周りがざわつきはじめる。
strings.translated: Suddenly the surroundings began to buzz.

strings.text:
長山のみならず、周囲の人間も動揺しているのだろう。
みんな口元をぱくぱくさせたり、目を見開いている。
strings.translated:
It wasn't only Nagayama -- the people around us were shaken too.
Everyone was opening and closing their mouths, their eyes wide.

strings.text: ああ、さすがに、どん引きしたのか……と思った。
strings.translated: Ah, so even they were put off after all... or so I thought.

strings.text: 「すごいっ、御桜さんってあんな動き出来るの！」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Amazing -- Misakura-san can move like that!"

strings.text: 「というか、かっこよすぎるんですけど、何、今の啖呵！　愛する男のためでもなかなかそんな事言えないよ」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｃ
strings.translated: "More like, she's way too cool. What was that whole speech! Even for the man you love, it's not easy to say something like that."

strings.text: 男子校生Ａ
strings.translated: Schoolboy A

strings.text: 「いや、御桜さん格好いい！　というか凛々しい」
strings.speaker: 男子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "No, Misakura-san is cool! Dignified, even."

strings.text: なんと拍手喝采が起こる。
strings.translated: Astonishingly, applause broke out.

strings.text: 恒例の弓張学園の特殊な校風か？
strings.translated: Was this the usual, peculiar school spirit of Yumihari Academy?

strings.text: 藍の当て身を見て興奮した連中の学校だ。
strings.translated: This was the school of the crowd that had gotten excited watching Ai's takedown.

strings.text: 今の一連のやりとりは、彼らにいい意味で感銘を与えたらしい。
strings.translated: The exchange just now seemed to have moved them in a positive way.

strings.text: まったくどんな基準だよ？　弓張学園。
strings.translated: What on earth are your standards, Yumihari Academy?

strings.text: 「え？　いや、その……あははは……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? No, um... ahahaha..."

strings.text: 稟がみんなの声援に苦笑いで応える。
strings.translated: Rin responded to everyone's cheers with a wry smile.

strings.text: さすがの稟もこんな反応は予期してなかったのだろう。
strings.translated: Even Rin hadn't expected a reaction like this, it seemed.

strings.text: とは言っても……。
strings.translated: Even so...

strings.text: 今の威風堂々とした稟の姿に、拍手喝采を送る気持ちは分からんでも無い。
strings.translated: I could understand the impulse to applaud the dignified figure Rin had just cut.

strings.text: たしかに、かっこよかったし、俺自身、胸がすっとした。
strings.translated: It really had been cool, and I felt refreshed myself.

strings.text: 筋の通った人間は気持ちがよい。
strings.translated: A person who stands by their principles is a pleasure to watch.

strings.text: その姿は、凛々しいという表現にふさわしい者であった。
strings.translated: Her figure just then was one truly worthy of the word "dignified."

strings.text: 対して長山は、単に「難癖をつけてきた振られた女」という立ち位置にその瞬間成り下がってしまった。
strings.translated: Nagayama, by contrast, had at that moment sunk to the position of nothing more than "a jilted woman picking a fight."

strings.text: 今の彼女は、それ以上でも、それ以下でもない。
strings.translated: The Nagayama of now was neither more nor less than that.

strings.text: あの時の長山の顔が忘れられない。
strings.translated: I couldn't forget the look on her face at that moment.

strings.text: 稟の事をただ行儀がよい優等生ぐらいにしか思ってなかったのだろう。
strings.translated: She'd probably thought of Rin as no more than a well-behaved honor student.

strings.text: だが稟は違う。誰よりも強情で、誰よりも一途で、誰よりも強い。
strings.translated: But Rin is different. More stubborn than anyone, more single-minded than anyone, stronger than anyone.

strings.text: 長山程度の人間に潰される様な人間ではない。
strings.translated: She isn't the sort of person who could be crushed by someone at Nagayama's level.

strings.text: 「あれからいろいろあったな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "A lot has happened since then, huh..."

strings.text: 良い事、つらい事、楽しい事、悲しい事。
strings.translated: Good things, painful things, fun things, sad things.

strings.text: 稟の再会から、本当にいろいろな事があった。
strings.translated: Ever since being reunited with Rin, truly all sorts of things had happened.

strings.text: そんな事を考えていると、美術室のドアが開く。
strings.translated: As I was thinking about that, the door of the art room opened.

strings.text: 「その絵を入れる袋をもらえるみたいです！　なので少し来てください」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "It seems they can give us a bag to put the painting in! So come with me for a bit."

strings.text: 「なんで、行くんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why do I have to go?"

strings.text: 「どの袋が一番適してるか、私には分からなくて」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "I can't tell which bag would fit best."

strings.text: 「ったく、分かった。行く」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Sheesh, fine. I'll come."

strings.text: 俺は、彼女と袋を探しに行く。
strings.translated: I went off with her to look for a bag.

strings.text: 稟と直哉がいなくなった美術室。
strings.translated: The art room, now empty of Rin and Naoya.

strings.text: 入れ替わる様に、二人の影が入ってくる。
strings.translated: As if trading places with them, two figures slipped inside.

strings.text: 「これが稟の絵なのですか……」
strings.translated: "So this is Rin's painting..."

strings.text: 「その様ですね……」
strings.translated: "It appears so..."

strings.text: 「どう？」
strings.translated: "How is it?"

strings.text: 「全然だめです」
strings.translated: "It's no good at all."

strings.text: 「そうでしょう。あなたからしたら、全然だめでしょう」
strings.translated: "I suppose so. From your point of view, it's no good at all."

strings.text: 「うん、でも、それで良かったんだと思う」
strings.translated: "Yeah, but I think that's how it should be."

strings.text: 「全然ダメだけど、すごく価値のある絵」
strings.translated: "A completely inept painting, but one with tremendous value."

strings.text: 「そっか……」
「記憶は戻って、でもそれより大きなものは戻らなかった。だから私がまだ存在する」
strings.translated: "Her memories came back, but something larger than that didn't. That's why I still exist."

strings.text: 「それは、あなたが稟の事を心配したからでしょう」
strings.translated: "That's because you worried about Rin, isn't it?"

strings.text: 「良く分からない……」
strings.translated: "I don't really understand..."

strings.text: 「でも、よく分からなくてもいいと思う……」
strings.translated: "But I think it's fine if you don't really understand..."

strings.text: 「へたくそな二人の絵だけど、だけどとても幸せそうだから」
strings.translated: "It's a clumsy painting by the two of them, but they look so happy in it."

strings.text: 「なるほど……」
strings.translated: "I see..."

strings.text: 「また二人でニューヨークにでも住む？」
strings.translated: "Shall the two of us live in New York again?"

strings.text: 「あそこは寒いから嫌です。どうせだったら雫と共に夏目の家にすませてください」
strings.translated: "It's cold there, so no. If we're going to anyway, please let me live in the Natsume house with Shizuku."

strings.text: 「そろそろ私の姿はあなた以外には見えないハズですから」
strings.translated: "It's about time no one but you could see me anyway."

strings.text: 雫
strings.translated: Shizuku

strings.text: 「千年桜の花弁で形を得て、千年桜を模した、草薙健一郎の作品で多くの人に認識される様になった」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Born from the petals of the thousand-year cherry, it came to be known to the world through the paintings Kusanagi Ken'ichirou modeled upon that tree."

strings.text: 「けど、その健一郎の絵も、そろそろありふれたものとなっている」
strings.translated: "But even Ken'ichirou's paintings are starting to become commonplace now."

strings.text: 「もともとが信仰の対象で描かれたものでなかったハズだから……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Because to begin with, they weren't painted as objects of worship..."

strings.text:
「でも、祈りに似た気持ちでそれを描いた人間がいて、見た人間もいた。
だから私は存在出来た」
strings.translated:
"But there were people who painted it with something like prayer in their hearts, and people who looked upon it that way.
That's why I was able to exist."

strings.text: 「どちらにしても、稟と直哉が幸せになってくれれば良い。それは私を生み出したあなたの思いでしょう」
strings.translated: "Either way, as long as Rin and Naoya find happiness, that's enough. That was the wish of the one who created me -- you."

strings.text: 「そうですね……。あなたを作り出した時は、そう思ったのはたしかですし……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That's true... When I created you, I did think that, certainly..."

strings.text: 「けど、今は違う」
strings.translated: "But now it's different."

strings.text: 「違いません。直哉と稟には幸せになってほしいです」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "It's not different. I want Naoya and Rin to be happy."

strings.text: 「素直じゃない」
strings.translated: "You're not being honest."

strings.text: 「そうかもしれません。でもそれでいいんだと思います」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "That may be so. But I think that's how it should be."

strings.text: 「あの二人は勝手にしっぽりやってうまくやっていけばいいのです！」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Those two can just get cozy on their own and manage things however they like!"

strings.text: 「なるほど、それでは、帰りますか？」
strings.translated: "I see. Well then, shall we head back?"

strings.text: 「そうですね……吹……」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Yes... Sui..."

strings.text: 「二人の幸福に栄光あれ」
strings.speaker: 雫
strings.translated: "Glory to the happiness of those two."

strings.text: 吹
strings.translated: Sui

strings.text: 夏休みが終わると、俺は英雄だった。
strings.translated: When summer vacation ended, I was a hero.

strings.text: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: Schoolgirl A

strings.text: 「きゃー、あの人よ。あの人が。草薙直哉！」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "Kyaa, that's him! That's the guy--Kusanagi Naoya!"

strings.text: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: Schoolgirl B

strings.text: 「すごい。すごいかっこいいじゃん」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "Whoa. He's seriously good-looking."

strings.text: 女子校生Ｃ
strings.translated: Schoolgirl C

strings.text: 「見た、見た、テレビ出てたよ。マスコミのあしらい方とかいかにも有名人って感じだったよね」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｃ
strings.translated: "Did you see him on TV? The way he handled the media, he really seemed like a celebrity, didn't he?"

strings.text: 「孤高の天才って感じ」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "He's got that lone genius vibe."

strings.text: 「すごいよねぇ。一晩で教会を作っちゃったんでしょ？」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "Isn't it amazing? I heard he built a whole church in a single night!"

strings.text: （一晩で教会を建てるってお前）
strings.translated: (Built a whole church in one night, seriously?)

strings.text: （俺は豊臣秀吉かよ）
strings.translated: (Am I Toyotomi Hideyoshi now?)

strings.text: 「わ、わわ、こっち見たよ」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ａ
strings.translated: "W-wah, he looked this way!"

strings.text: 「わぁ、かっこいい」
strings.speaker: 女子校生Ｂ
strings.translated: "Waah, so cool!"

strings.text: 直哉
strings.translated: Naoya

strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Haah..."

strings.text:
秋空は高く、
俺は学校では騒がれ、
街ではサインまでねだられる始末。
strings.translated:
The autumn sky stretched high,
and I was the talk of the school,
asked for autographs even out on the streets.

strings.text: 遺作『櫻達の足跡』の完成は大いにマスコミの関心を集める事になった。
strings.translated: The completion of the posthumous work 'The Footprints of the Sakura' drew tremendous attention from the media.

strings.text: 草薙健一郎の死後半年程度で起きた事件であった事も災いした、その作品を完成させたのが草薙健一郎の息子であれば尚更だ。
strings.translated: It didn't help that the whole affair came barely half a year after Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's death -- least of all when the one who completed the work was his own son.

strings.text: すべてはあの校長が狙った通り。
strings.translated: Everything was going exactly as that headmaster had planned.

strings.text: 弓張学園はもとより、何故か弓張市役所に飾られてる絵を見るために一般人やらマスコミやらが大挙して押し寄せているらしい。
strings.translated: Not just at Yumihari Academy--for some reason, throngs of ordinary people and reporters were descending on the Yumihari City Hall to view the painting displayed there.

strings.text: 唯一の救いは、新学期が始まったため、授業の妨げという口実で日曜日以外はマスコミや一般人の立ち入りが規制されているぐらいだろう。
strings.translated: The one saving grace was probably that, since the new term had started, the media and general public were being restricted from entering except on Sundays, under the pretext of not disturbing classes.

strings.text: 学校にいるかぎりにおいては俺がマスコミに追い回されたりする事はない。
strings.translated: So long as I was at school, I wouldn't get chased around by reporters.

strings.text: それだけは唯一助かっている。
strings.translated: That alone was a mercy.

strings.text: それはあの校長の配慮というやつだろうか？
strings.translated: Was that thoughtful consideration on the part of that headmaster?

strings.text: いや、そんな配慮する様な校長には思えんのだが……。
strings.translated: No, that headmaster didn't strike me as the considerate type...

strings.text: 真琴
strings.translated: Makoto

strings.text: 「よ！　有名人！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yo! Celebrity!"

strings.text: 「あぁ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah?"

strings.text: 「あら？　すごい、不機嫌ねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Oh my. You're in a foul mood."

strings.text: 「不機嫌にもなるわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Of course I'm in a foul mood."

strings.text: 「そう？　あんた前までちやほやされたいって言ってたじゃない？　今までと比べものにならないくらいちやほやされてうれしいんじゃないの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Really? You used to say you wanted to be fawned over, didn't you? Aren't you thrilled to be fawned over on a scale you couldn't even compare with before?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだな。おかげさまで、すげぇ堪能してるぜ。はっはっはっ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Thanks to it all, I'm enjoying it immensely. Ha ha ha!"

strings.text: 「本当に素直じゃないのねぇ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You really can't just be honest, can you?"

strings.text: 「何がだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「別にぃ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Nothing."

strings.text: 鳥谷はそっぽを向く。
strings.translated: Toritani looked away.

strings.text: 「なんだよ。お前こそ機嫌悪そうじゃねぇかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What? You're the one who looks like she's in a bad mood."

strings.text: 「はぁ？　なんで私が機嫌悪くなるのよ？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh? Why would I be in a bad mood?"

strings.text: 「知らねぇよ。ただそう感じただけだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Beats me. Just felt that way."

strings.text: 「ふん、まぁ、<r いちげん>一見</r>さんどもの女子が無制限にわらわら湧いてれば、私でなくたって……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hmph. Well, when an endless swarm of first-timer girls keeps popping up out of nowhere, even someone other than me would..."

strings.text: 「お前じゃなくったって、どうしたんだ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Someone other than you would what?"

strings.text: 「知らないわよ。んで？　また何か厄介事でも抱えてるの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "None of your business. So? Are you tangled up in some kind of trouble again?"

strings.text: 「厄介事？　なんでそうなる？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Trouble? How'd you get there?"

strings.text: 「違うの？　だったら取り巻きの娘でも手出したのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You're not? Then have you laid hands on one of your little groupies, maybe?"

strings.text: 「はぁ？　取り巻きの娘？　なんだそりゃ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Huh? Groupies? What are you talking about?"

strings.text: 「後ろよ。後ろ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Behind you. Behind."

strings.text: 「後ろって……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Behind me...?"

strings.text: 「わっ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Wah!"

strings.text: 吹
strings.translated: Sui

strings.text: 「驚く事はありません。吹に攻撃の意思はありませんから！」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "There's no need to be startled. Sui has no intention of attacking you!"

strings.text: 「こ、攻撃の意思って、当たり前だろ。何いきなり人の背後取ってるんだよ！　お前は！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I-intention of attacking?! Of course you don't! What are you doing suddenly slipping behind someone like that! You!"

strings.text: 「んで？　誰なの？　一年生みたいだけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So? Who is she? Looks like a first-year."

strings.text: 「ああ、吹だ。えっと名字は……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, this is Sui. Er, her family name is..."

strings.text: 「あなたこそ誰ですか。草薙乃剣さんになれなれしいですね」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Who are you, exactly? You're being awfully familiar with Kusanagi-no-Tsurugi."

strings.text: 「草薙乃剣さんって誰よ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kusanagi-no-Tsurugi? Who's that supposed to be...?"

strings.text: 「こいつです！」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "This guy!"

strings.text: 「違げぇよ！　俺の名前は草薙直哉だって言ってるだろ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's not it! I keep telling you my name is Kusanagi Naoya!"

strings.text: 「あら？　そうでしたか？」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Oh? Is that so?"

strings.text: 「何を意外そうな顔してるんだよ……前から言ってるだろ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Why do you look so surprised? I've been telling you this from the start."

strings.text: 「前から知り合いなの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Have you known each other long?"

strings.text: 「ああ、とはいってもついこの間だけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, though it's only been for a little while now."

strings.text: 「そうです。ちなみにあなたはいつから草薙さんの知り合いなのですか？」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "That's right. Incidentally, since when have you known Kusanagi-san?"

strings.text: 「一年の時からだから……かれこれ二年と一学期分ぐらいだけど？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Since first year, so... about two years and a term now, give or take?"

strings.text: 「なるほど、では先輩ですね！　よろしくお願いします！」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "I see, so you're my senpai! It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance!"

strings.text: そういう問題ではなくて、鳥谷の方が先輩だろ……。
strings.translated: That's not really the point--Toritani is your senpai by grade anyway...

strings.text: 「んで？　お前はどこから沸いて出たんだ。吹？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So? Where'd you spring from, Sui?"

strings.text: 「沸いて出たとか失礼です。吹はずっと草薙さんのストーキングしてました！」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "'Spring from' is rude. Sui's been stalking Kusanagi-san the whole time!"

strings.text: 「ずっとストーキングしてました！　とか涼しい顔で言うな！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't just say 'I've been stalking you' with a straight face!"

strings.text: 「だったらどう言えばいいのですか！？」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Then how am I supposed to put it?!"

strings.text: 「言い方の問題じゃなくてだな。というかなんでお前は俺をつけてたんだよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's not a matter of phrasing. And why were you tailing me in the first place?"

strings.text: 「理由がほしいですか？」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Do you want a reason?"

strings.text: 「理由もなくつけてるとか怖いわ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Tailing me without a reason is scarier."

strings.text: 「でも大した理由も無かったのは事実ですし、知っている顔がありましたので、あとをつけてみました」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "But truthfully there wasn't much of a reason. I saw a familiar face, so I decided to follow along."

strings.text:
「そんな理由かよ。
それだったらあとをつけるじゃなくて、単に登校中に知ってる顔があっただけじゃねぇかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"That's your reason?
Then it's not really 'tailing'--you just happened to see someone you knew on your way to school."

strings.text: 「んで？　吹ちゃんは草薙とはどういう関係なの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So? What kind of relationship do you have with Kusanagi, Sui-chan?"

strings.text: 「まぁなんといいますか、運命共同体といいますか……」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Well, how should I put it... comrades bound by fate, perhaps..."

strings.text: 「違げぇよ。意味分からない事言うな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Not even close. Don't say things that make no sense."

strings.text: 「こいつはウチの近所に住んでいるらしくて、たまたま何度か会ううちに知り合いになった」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "This girl apparently lives near my house, and we ended up getting to know each other after running into each other a few times."

strings.text: 「まぁ、話してわかる通り、俺の取り巻きとかそういうものではない」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "As you can probably tell from talking to her, she's not one of my 'groupies' or whatever."

strings.text: 「言ってしまえば取り憑きです！」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "To put it plainly, I'm a haunting!"

strings.text: 「お前は幽霊か妖怪のたぐいかよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What are you, a ghost or a yokai?!"

strings.text: 「ふーん。んで吹ちゃんはどこの部活に所属してるのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hmm. So, Sui-chan, what club are you in?"

strings.text:
「私の所属ですか？　私はどこに所属しているのでしょうか。
ねぇ、草薙さん？」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated:
"My club affiliation? Where am I affiliated, I wonder.
Hey, Kusanagi-san?"

strings.text: 「俺に聞くなよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't ask me."

strings.text: 「謎です」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "It's a mystery."

strings.text: 「謎なのかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It's a mystery?"

strings.text: 「相変わらず、変な知り合いが多いのねぇ。草薙は……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You really do keep some strange company, Kusanagi..."

strings.text: 「お前も含めてだけどな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That includes you, you know..."

strings.text: 「だったら、あんたがおかしいから集まってくるんじゃないの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Then maybe they gather around you because you're weird yourself?"

strings.text: 「自分がおかしいのは認めるのかよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So you admit you're weird?"

strings.text: 「まぁ、少しは自覚あるわよ。でも普通にかわいい娘もいるじゃない？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, I'm at least a little self-aware. But there are some perfectly cute girls in the mix too, aren't there?"

strings.text: 「普通にかわいい娘？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Perfectly cute girls?"

strings.text: 「おはようございます。みなさん」
strings.translated: "Good morning, everyone."

strings.text: 「これとか」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Like her."

strings.text: 稟
strings.translated: Rin

strings.text: 「え？　何がですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Eh? What do you mean?"

strings.text: 「別に、ただ稟ちゃんは普通に可愛いって話よ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Nothing. I was just saying Rin-chan is a normal, cute girl."

strings.text: 「そうなんですか。朝からうれしいですね。でもまこちゃんだって、これ！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is that so? What a lovely thing to hear first thing in the morning. But you too, Mako-chan--like this!"

strings.text: 「うにょっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Unyo!"

strings.text: 「ほらほら、こんな巨乳ぶらさげて、こんな細いウエストしてだな。この歩くエロ人形さんっ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Look, look--dangling these huge boobs, with such a slim waist too. This walking indecent doll!"

strings.text: 「って、わ、わわ、む、胸揉むなっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "H-hey, w-wah, d-don't grope my chest!"

strings.text: 「んじゃ、下揉みますか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Then shall I grope down below?"

strings.text: 「って！　スカートの中に手を突っ込むなぁ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Hey! Don't shove your hand up my skirt!"

strings.text: 鳥谷が全力で回避して、稟から離れる。
strings.translated: Toritani dodged with all her might, pulling away from Rin.

strings.text: 「あら残念、もう少しだったのに」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Aw, too bad. I was so close."

strings.text: 「“あら残念”じゃないわよ！　どこの世界に登校中に人のパンツに手突っ込もうとするバカな女が居るのよ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "'Aw, too bad,' my foot! What kind of world has an idiot girl who tries to shove her hand into someone's panties on the way to school?!"

strings.text: 入れようとしたのかよ……。
strings.translated: So she was trying to actually get it in there...

strings.text: 「私です！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Me!"

strings.text: 「胸をはるな！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Don't puff your chest out!"

strings.text: 「そうですか？　私も少し胸があるって自己主張だったんだけど……ダメだったかな？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Really? I was trying to insist that I have a bit of a chest too... was that no good?"

strings.text: 「前言撤回……。こいつも十分おかしいわ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I take it back... This girl's plenty weird herself..."

strings.text: 「うん、うん、私もおかしいよ。仲間、仲間」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Yep, yep, I'm weird too. Friends, friends."

strings.text:
稟も適応性が高いというか、たくましいというか、
学期をすすめるたびに、二人の立場が逆転している……。
strings.translated:
Rin was highly adaptable, or maybe just tough--
with each term, the two of them seemed to be switching roles...

strings.text: 「ったく、突然何をするかと思えば……この娘は……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Honestly, out of nowhere, what were you doing... this girl..."

strings.text: 「だって、朝いきなり“かわいい”なんて言われたら恥ずかしいじゃないですか。そんな事言うまこちゃんにはいくらでも羞恥プレイをお見舞いしたいと思います」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Well, being called cute out of nowhere in the morning is embarrassing, isn't it? Mako-chan, for saying such things, deserves to be treated to as much embarrassment-play as I can dish out."

strings.text: 「“思います”とか涼しい顔でとんでもない事言うなっ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Don't casually declare outrageous things like it's nothing!"

strings.text: 「えへへ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ehehe..."

strings.text: 「ん？　こちらも可愛い娘さんですね。まこちゃんと草薙くんのお知り合いですか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Hm? This girl's cute too. An acquaintance of yours and Kusanagi-kun's, Mako-chan?"

strings.text: 「いや、私は今はじめて出会ったんだけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "No, I just met her for the first time today."

strings.text: 「私は吹です！」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "I'm Sui!"

strings.text: 「あ、うん。私は御桜稟だよ。よろしくね」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah, right. I'm Misakura Rin. Nice to meet you."

strings.text: 「御桜稟……」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Misakura Rin..."

strings.text: 「どうしましたか？」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Is something the matter?"

strings.text: 「いいえ、何でもありません！　御桜稟さんは可愛いですね！　気に入りました！　以後私の事は母親の様に慕うと良いでしょう」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "No, it's nothing! Misakura Rin-san, you're cute! I like you! From now on, feel free to adore me like a mother."

strings.text: 「え、うん……。ありがとう」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Er, right... Thank you."

strings.text: 母親って見た目じゃねーだろ……。
strings.translated: You don't look anything like a mother though...

strings.text: 「ほら、可愛い言われたわよ。胸もみなさいよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Look, she called you cute. You should grope her chest too."

strings.text: 「い、いや、あれはまこちゃんだから出来るんであって、さすがに初対面の相手にするわけではないよ」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "N-no, I could only do that because it was Mako-chan. I can't really do that to someone I've just met."

strings.text: 「なんですか？　稟は私の胸が揉みたくないのですか？」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "What? Rin, you don't want to grope my chest?"

strings.text: 吹が稟に胸を突き出す。
strings.translated: Sui thrust her chest out at Rin.

strings.text: 「え、えっと……これは……、たぶんそれは誤解でして、私がそういう趣味の持ち主とかではなくてですね……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "U-um... this is... probably a misunderstanding, I'm not really the type with those kinds of interests, you see..."

strings.text: 「よく分かりませんが、先ほど勢いよく揉んでたではないですか、さぁ、私の胸も揉むが良いでしょう！」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "I don't quite understand, but weren't you groping enthusiastically just a moment ago? Come on, feel free to grope my chest as well!"

strings.text: 「揉む物なんて無いガキ体型が何言ってるんだよ！」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "There's nothing to grope on a kid's body like yours, so shut up!"

strings.text: 「うにょろぉ、あ、頭をつかんで髪をぐしゃぐしゃするのはやめてくださいっ」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Unyoro, s-stop grabbing my head and messing up my hair!"

strings.text: 「うるさい」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Shut up."

strings.text: 吹は俺の手からするりと抜け出す。
strings.translated: Sui slipped out from under my hand.

strings.text: 「吹は稟に胸を揉んでも良いと言ったのです！　あなたが私の頭をぐしゃぐしゃして良いなどと言ってません！」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "Sui said Rin could grope Sui's chest! I didn't say you could mess up my hair!"

strings.text:
「うるせぇなぁ……。とりあえず揉む揉まないはもうやめれ。
さっきからお前らのコントのせいで視線が痛いんだよ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"Shut up already... For now, drop the whole groping thing.
Thanks to your comedy routine, everyone's stares are killing me..."

strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Stares?
Ah..."

strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Huh?"

strings.text: 元々、注目を浴びていた集団が、胸揉んだりスカートに手を突っ込んでたら、皆に注目されて当然だ。
strings.translated: A group that had already been drawing attention, now groping breasts and shoving hands under skirts--of course everyone was staring.

strings.text: 登校中の連中は、足を止めて俺たちを見ている。
strings.translated: The other students on their way to school had stopped in their tracks to watch us.

strings.text: 「あ、あはは……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "A-ahaha..."

strings.text: 「稟……ちょっと、あんたのせいですごく注目されてるじゃないの……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Rin... hey, thanks to you we're getting a ton of attention..."

strings.text: 「えへへへ、ごめん」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ehehehe, sorry."

strings.text: 「あ！　ちゃ、チャイムだよ！」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated: "Ah! T-the chime! It's the chime!"

strings.text: 「こ、こんなところで立ち話して遅刻とかないわ！」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "N-no way I'm going to be late because I was standing around chatting here!"

strings.text: 「そうだな。とりあえずお前も……あれ？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Right. Anyway, you too... huh?"

strings.text: 先ほどまで居たはずの場所に吹の姿が無い。
strings.translated: Sui was no longer where she'd been standing just a moment ago.

strings.text: 「吹は？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Where's Sui?"

strings.text: 「何をやってるのですか！　遅刻しますよ！　早く学校に入らなくて良いのですか？」
strings.speaker: 吹
strings.translated: "What are you doing?! You'll be late! Shouldn't you hurry inside the school?"

strings.text: 気がつくとヤツはすでに下駄箱にいる。
strings.translated: Before I knew it, she was already at the shoe lockers.

strings.text: 「やれやれ……いつも素早いヤツだなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Good grief... She's always so quick..."

strings.text:
「すごいね。本当に素早い娘だね。
私も全然気がつかなかったよ……」
strings.speaker: 稟
strings.translated:
"Amazing. She really is a quick one.
I didn't notice at all either..."

strings.text: 「そんな事どうでもいいから私達も急がないと」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Never mind that, we've got to hurry too."

strings.text: 吹。
strings.translated: Sui.

strings.text: やはり弓張の学生だったんだな。
strings.translated: So she really was a Yumihari student after all.

strings.text: あいつは何年なんだろうか……。
strings.translated: I wonder what year she's in...

strings.text: 実はヤツに関しては、ずっと気になっている事があった。
strings.translated: Actually, there's something about her that had been nagging at me for a while.

strings.text: 「うーん」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Mmmm..."

strings.text: 俺は教会の前に立ち、壁画、『櫻達の足跡』を睨み付ける。
strings.translated: I stood before the church, glaring at the mural, "The Footprints of the Sakura."

strings.text: 「ったく、息を吸うようにサボるのねぇ」
strings.translated: "Good grief, you skip class as naturally as breathing."

strings.text: 「ああ、元々が怠け者なんでな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah, I'm a lazybones by nature."

strings.text: 「そういう問題なのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Is that really the issue here?"

strings.text:
「それ以外に何が？
それよりお前こそいいのかよ。授業サボって」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"What else would it be?
And besides, is it really okay for you? Skipping class like this."

strings.text:
「予習、復習は欠かさないわ。だからトイレっていうことで出てきても、
問題ないの。あなたはちゃんと予習、復習をやっているのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"I never neglect my prep or review. So even if I step out saying I'm going to the toilet,
it's no problem. Do you properly do your prep and review, I wonder?"

strings.text: 「やっている様にみえるか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Do I look like I do?"

strings.text: 鳥谷は呆れたといわんばかりにため息をつく。
strings.translated: Toritani let out a sigh, as if utterly exasperated.

strings.text:
「それで？
熱心に見ていたみたいだけど、何か気になる事でもあるのかしら？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"So?
You were staring at it pretty intently. Is there something on your mind?"

strings.text:
気になる事か……。
無いと言ったら嘘になるが……。
strings.translated:
Something on my mind, huh...
It'd be a lie to say there wasn't, but...

strings.text: 「授業中くらいなもんだからな、これがゆっくり見られるのは……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Class time is about the only chance I get to look at it in peace..."

strings.text: 「……そうね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "...I suppose so."

strings.text: 鳥谷が壁画を見あげる。
strings.translated: Toritani looked up at the mural.

strings.text: 「本当はあの日に見ておきたかったんだがな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I actually wanted to see it that day."

strings.text: 「プール掃除の日？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "The pool cleaning day?"

strings.text: 「……まぁな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "...Yeah, well."

strings.text:
夏休み中は、ほとんどブルーシートで覆われていた。
それが撤去されたのは夏休みが終わる数日前だ。
strings.translated:
Throughout summer vacation, it had been covered almost entirely by a blue tarp.
The tarp had only been removed a few days before vacation ended.

strings.text:
あげく、夏休みが明けたらあの大騒ぎだ。
休み時間は人だかりで、落ち着いて見られる状況じゃない。
strings.translated:
And then, once vacation was over, there was all that fuss.
During breaks it was mobbed with people; there was no chance to view it calmly.

strings.text: それにしても、鳥谷の勘の良さには舌を巻く。
strings.translated: Still, I have to hand it to Toritani's sharp intuition.

strings.text: かといって、何もかもお見通しというわけでもない。
strings.translated: That said, she doesn't see through everything either.

strings.text:
以前、本人が言っていたとおり、空回りもするし、焦ったり、慌てたり、
そういうところが人間らしいし、好感を持っている。
strings.translated:
Just as she herself once said, she can miss the mark, get impatient, get flustered--
those parts of her feel human, and I like her for them.

strings.text:
そうした人間らしさを弱さと感じているのか、
本人的には、あまり歓迎すべきことではないようだが。
strings.translated:
Whether she perceives that humanity as weakness or not,
she herself doesn't seem to welcome it much.

strings.text: 「いい絵だわ、とてもね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's a fine painting. Truly."

strings.text: 「ああ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Yeah."

strings.text: 「そう、だからこそ……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Yes, and that's precisely why..."

strings.text:
独り言のようなつぶやきだった。
鳥谷の視線が、壁画に集中する。
strings.translated:
It was a murmur, almost to herself.
Toritani's gaze locked onto the mural.

strings.text: じっと壁画を見あげる鳥谷の横顔。
strings.translated: Toritani's profile as she gazed steadily up at the mural.

strings.text:
いい絵だと鳥谷は言った。
実際、そう思っているだろう。
strings.translated:
Toritani had said it was a fine painting.
And she surely meant it.

strings.text:
鳥谷は、基本的に人間が生み出すものを愛している。
けれど、今のまなざしは……何かが違う気がする。
strings.translated:
Toritani, at heart, loves the things that human beings create.
But the look in her eyes now... something felt different.

strings.text: 壁画を通して、別の何かを見ているような……。
strings.translated: As if, through the mural, she were looking at something else...

strings.text: 珍しいと思う。
strings.translated: That was rare, I thought.

strings.text:
鳥谷は、実際にうまくやれているかどうかはおいておいて、
こんな風に隙を見せるのを好まない。
strings.translated:
Setting aside whether she actually pulls it off,
Toritani doesn't like to let her guard down like this.

strings.text:
それだけ、この壁画に集中しているのだろう。
あるいは壁画を通して、見ている何かに――。
strings.translated:
Which meant she must be that absorbed in this mural.
Or in something she was seeing through it--

strings.text: 「この作品、本来ならば明石の名前で世間に出るはずだったんだがな……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "You know, this piece was supposed to have gone out into the world under Akashi's name..."

strings.text:
「そういう作家論的な事は、あの人には分からないわ。
分かるわけがない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"That sort of talk about artistic intent means nothing to her.
It couldn't possibly."

strings.text: 吐き捨てるような鳥谷の言葉に、確信する。
strings.translated: The venom in Toritani's words confirmed it for me.

strings.text:
こんな簡単に、核心に触れるようなことを吐露する。
だからこそ、今の鳥谷はどこか危うく感じる。
strings.translated:
To let something so close to the heart of the matter slip so easily.
That was exactly why Toritani, right now, felt somehow precarious.

strings.text: 「結果、すべては結果なのよ。あの人は……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Results. It's all about results, to that person..."

strings.text:
言った直後に、さすがに喋りすぎたと気づいたのか、
鳥谷は少しだけバツの悪そうな顔をした。
strings.translated:
Right after she said it, perhaps realizing she'd talked too much,
Toritani made a slightly awkward face.

strings.text:
しばし視線が泳いで、それから、俺の様子をそっとうかがう。
俺は素知らぬ顔をして、壁画を見あげつづける。
strings.translated:
Her eyes wandered for a moment, and then she quietly glanced at me.
I kept a straight face and continued looking up at the mural.

strings.text:
そんな風に他人をうかがうなんて、
らしくないだろ、鳥谷。
strings.translated:
Sneaking glances at another person like that--
that isn't like you, Toritani.

strings.text: 鳥谷から、ふ、とちいさな息が漏れた。
strings.translated: A small breath escaped from Toritani.

strings.text: 「草薙」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Kusanagi."

strings.text: 表情も、声の調子も、落ち着いて、静かだった。
strings.translated: Her expression, her tone--both were calm and quiet.

strings.text:
様々な感情を抑制した調子で、真剣な目をして、
俺に告げる。
strings.translated:
Suppressing all sorts of emotions, with a serious look in her eyes,
she told me:

strings.text:
「校長には近づかない方がいいわ……いいえ、そんな強制できないわね。
でも、できたら、近づかないで欲しい」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"You'd do better not to get close to the headmaster... No, I can't force that on you.
But if you can, I'd like you to stay away."

strings.text: 「できるだけ、ね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "As much as possible."

strings.text:
隣りに並んで壁画を見ていた俺達……
今は、互いに正面から向き合っている。
strings.translated:
We had been standing side by side, looking at the mural...
now we were facing each other head-on.

strings.text: 「お前の母親なのに？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Even though she's your mother?"

strings.text: 「母親、だからこそよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "It's because she's my mother."

strings.text: 「親子だったんだな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "So you two really are parent and child."

strings.text: 「校長に聞いたの？」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Did the headmaster tell you?"

strings.text: 「聞いたというか、まあ、呼び出しくらったときに、はじめて知った」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Told me, well--I found out for the first time when I got summoned to her office."

strings.text: 「今の今まで、あなたが知らなかった事の方が驚きだけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "What surprises me more is that you didn't know until just now."

strings.text: 「他人に無関心でな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I'm indifferent to other people."

strings.text: 鳥谷にじっと見つめられる。
strings.translated: Toritani stared at me steadily.

strings.text: 「な、何だよ、落ち着かないな……何か顔についてるか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "W-what? You're making me uncomfortable... Is there something on my face?"

strings.text: 「あなたは他人に無関心なわけじゃない」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "You aren't indifferent to other people."

strings.text: 「むしろ、自分に関心がないんだわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "If anything, you're indifferent to yourself."

strings.text:
「自分に無関心だから……。だから、他人からの好意にも気づかない。
他人がどうでもいいわけじゃなくて、自分がどうでもいいから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Because you're indifferent to yourself... that's why you don't notice when people show you goodwill.
It's not that other people don't matter to you--it's that you don't matter to yourself."

strings.text:
「いいえ、どうでもいい、ですらない。
自分の存在を空気みたいに感じてる。そんな風に思える時さえあって……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"No, it's not even that you don't matter.
You feel your own existence as if it were air. There are even times I think that of you..."

strings.text: 俺はまじまじと鳥谷を見た。
strings.translated: I stared at Toritani in earnest.

strings.text: 「珍しいな、お前がそんな風に人を評するなんて」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That's rare, coming from you. Sizing someone up like that."

strings.text: 鳥谷がふっと肩の力を抜いた。
strings.translated: Toritani suddenly let the tension drop from her shoulders.

strings.text: 「はぁ……何やってんだろう、私ってば。ごめん」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Haah... what am I doing? Sorry."

strings.text: 「謝られても……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Don't apologize to me..."

strings.text: 「それもそっか……あはは、ごめん」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Fair enough... ahaha, sorry."

strings.text: また謝っているし……。
strings.translated: She's apologizing again...

strings.text: やっぱり、今日の鳥谷は特別『らしく』ない。
strings.translated: Really, Toritani today wasn't 'like her' at all.

strings.text:
こういうしおらしい鳥谷真琴を見ているのも悪くはないが、
どうも調子が狂う。
strings.translated:
Watching this meek Toritani Makoto wasn't bad, exactly,
but it did throw me off my rhythm.

strings.text: とは言っても、こいつが元々こういう人間なのは、この三年間で薄々は気がついてはいる。だから、『傍若無人風味な鳥谷』じゃない鳥谷を見られる事は、いつでも悪い気はしない。
strings.translated: That said, over these past three years I've come to dimly realize that this is what she's really like underneath. So getting to see a Toritani who isn't the 'high-and-mighty flavored Toritani' never feels bad.

strings.text: まあ、つられて、俺の方も、少しばかり調子は狂ってしまうのだが……。
strings.translated: Well, she does drag me along a bit, and my own rhythm gets thrown off too...

strings.text: 「でもね、他人に無関心な男が、こんなことをするかしら」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "But you know, would a man who was indifferent to other people do something like this?"

strings.text:
「この教会の壁画……
草薙がいろいろしてくれたから、すべてが良い結果に転がった」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"This church mural...
it's because of everything you did, Kusanagi, that it all turned out well."

strings.text: 「明石だよ。これは」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "That was Akashi. This one."

strings.text: 「もちろん明石先輩がやった事だけど、それを一番サポートしたのは草薙だわ。そして、小牧と小沙智の想いを形にしてくれた」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Of course, Akashi-senpai was the one who did it, but the person who supported him most was you, Kusanagi. And you gave form to the feelings of Komaki and Kosachi."

strings.text: 「なんというか成り行きだけどな」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "It just sort of happened, in a way."

strings.text: 「成り行きであそこまで出来る人間なんていないわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There's no one who could pull that off just by things 'happening.'"

strings.text: 「それに、あれだけじゃないんでしょ？　あなたが関わった事って」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "And it wasn't only that, right? The things you've had a hand in."

strings.text: 「さて、何の事やら」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Now what could you mean by that?"

strings.text: 「そうやって、とぼけてばかりで」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "There you go, always playing dumb."

strings.text: 「前にも言ったけど……あなたが思っているほど、私は鈍感じゃないわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "I've said it before... but I'm not as oblivious as you think I am."

strings.text: 「お前が鈍感だなんて思ったことは、一度もないさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I've never once thought of you as oblivious."

strings.text: 「……それが本心だから、ますます困るのだけど」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "...That's your honest opinion, which just makes it more troubling."

strings.text: 「どういう意味だよ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "What's that supposed to mean?"

strings.text: 「ま、とにかく、そのまま無関心を貫いてくれればいいのだけどね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Well, in any case, I hope you'll keep on being indifferent, just like that."

strings.text: 「邪魔したわね」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Sorry to have bothered you."

strings.text: 鳥谷の視線が、俺の手元に一瞬だけ向けられる。
strings.translated: For an instant, Toritani's gaze flicked to my hand.

strings.text:
俺が草薙健一郎の設計図のコピーを持っていたことは、
とっくに把握されていたらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed she had long since noticed that I was holding a copy of Kusanagi Ken'ichirou's blueprints.

strings.text:
その視線が、“本当は何か検証でもする気だったんじゃないの？”
と、言っているように思えた。
strings.translated: That look seemed to say, 'You were really planning to verify something, weren't you?'

strings.text: 人のことはよく見えるものだ。
strings.translated: It's always easier to see other people clearly.

strings.text: 「ん……まあ、気になることがあったけど、今日はやめておくさ」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Nn... well, there was something bothering me, but I'll leave it for today."

strings.text:
「そう……って、またあなた授業サボる気ね！？
ただでさえ、成績がおぼつかないくせに」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"Really--wait, are you planning to skip class again?!
And your grades are already shaky enough as it is."

strings.text: 「今日も一応、得意な数学を選んだんだが……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I did make sure to pick math, which I'm good at, for today..."

strings.text: 「そういう問題じゃないでしょ！　ったく、とにかく帰るわよ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "That's not the point! Good grief, we're going back, come on."

strings.text: 「ああ、例の三分の一理論か？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Ah, is this your one-third theory again?"

strings.text:
「それもあるけど、私はトイレってことにしてるのよ。
こんなトイレが長いなんて思われるのはご免だわ」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated:
"That too, but I told them I was going to the toilet.
I don't want anyone thinking I take that long in there."

strings.text: 「そうか、だったら……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "I see. In that case..."

strings.text: 「一人で帰れとか無しよ！　稟ちゃんだってすごく怒ってたのだから」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Don't tell me to go back alone! Rin-chan was so mad about it too."

strings.text: 「稟が？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "Rin?"

strings.text: 「そう、どっちが連れ戻すかでノート交換で口論になったぐらい」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "So much so that we argued in a note exchange about which of us would drag you back."

strings.text: 授業中にノートを互いにまわしあい、文章で口論になっている二人を想像する。少しおもしろい。
strings.translated: I pictured the two of them passing notes back and forth in the middle of class, arguing in writing. A little amusing.

strings.text: 「んで、最終的に鳥谷が稟を説得したわけか？」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated: "And so in the end, Toritani, you talked Rin down?"

strings.text: 「最後は公正にじゃんけんで決めたのよ。これまたノート同時交換で……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "In the end we settled it fairly with rock-paper-scissors. Passed via simultaneous note exchange again..."

strings.text: なんかすごいな。
strings.translated: That's kind of impressive.

strings.text:
「そうか、それはすまない。だが、ぶっちゃけどっちでもいいだろ。
俺を連れ戻すのなんか……」
strings.speaker: 直哉
strings.translated:
"I see, sorry about that. But honestly, does it matter which of you?
Dragging me back and all..."

strings.text: 「前だったら、そうかもしれないけど……」
strings.speaker: 真琴
strings.translated: "Before, maybe it wouldn't have mattered, but..."
